projects.name: Fat Iron Core — Iron Off Stubborn Fat, Tighten Skin & Recover Faster in 15 Minutes.
projects.blurb: Get proven results in only 6 weeks with the most advanced Fat Iron to date, combining 4 FDA-cleared & clinically tested technologies working in synergy to sculpt, firm, and recover your body faster—no surgery, pills, or expensive clinics.
projects.ai_intro_en: Fat Iron Core is a 4-in-1 body sculpting and muscle recovery system that combines 4 FDA-cleared and clinically tested technologies to iron off stubborn fat, tighten skin, and help you recover faster in just 15 minutes per session. Backed by 6 weeks of proven results, it offers a non-surgical, pill-free alternative to expensive clinics.
ai_highlights_en: 4 FDA-cleared technologies working simultaneously in one 15-minute session
Sculpts body, tightens skin, and accelerates muscle recovery without surgery or pills
Backed by 300,000+ devices shipped globally and a 1-year manufacturer warranty
ai_specs_en: 4 FDA-cleared & clinically tested (Thermal Shock, EMS, Infrared, LED, Cryo, Percussion, Red Light)
100% refund during live campaign; 30-day unopened returns after delivery
projects.ai_risks_en: Standard crowdfunding risks include manufacturing delays, supply chain disruptions, tooling calibration challenges, and unpredictable global shipping/customs. The creator mitigates these with prior experience shipping 300,000+ devices, redundant pre-approved suppliers, a 45-day production buffer, and established fulfillment hubs in the USA, Europe, and Asia.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Lumina NRG (HEATINACLICK LLC) is a health and beauty tech company that has raised $1.85M on its original Fat Iron campaign, shipped over 300,000 devices globally, and sells products in major retailers like Costco and Walmart.

projects.blurb: TRUE Card-Sized | 13m/s Windspeed | 30,000RPM | 360° Rotatable | Intuitive Display | 69g Ultralight | 10 hrs+ Run Time | All-Day Cool
projects.html_story:
TRUE Card-Sized | 13m/s Windspeed | 30,000RPM | 360° Rotatable | Intuitive Display | 69g Ultralight | 10 hrs+ Run Time | All-Day Cool

TRUE Card-Sized | 13m/s Windspeed | 30,000RPM | 360° Rotatable | Intuitive Display | 69g Ultralight | 10 hrs+ Run Time | All-Day Cool

The First TRUE Card-Sized Fan Ever

Powerful Jetstream Up to 13m/s

Wear It The Way You Like

Dial Up Your Power Easily

Long Battery Life

Pick Your Perfect Color

What's in the Box?

Design & Production

Environmental commitments

We all love summer, we love the warmth and daylight that the sun brings.

We go outside and enjoy ourselves. But we do not love the high temperature and humidity that get us hot and stuffy, lower our energy level and leading to heatstroke.This is why we need to stay cool, and ZERA mini is the smallest tool for such a need.

The First TRUE Card-Sized Fan Ever

ZERA mini is the miniature version of our classic ZERA MAX blower,sized down by 50%. Although weighing and sizing less, it could do everything the MAX could and more, from keeping you cool in summer to blow-cleaning every corner! Keep it charged once and it will be ready for months, ready whenever you need it.

While other fans claim to be pocket-sized, ZERA mini truly matches the surface dimensions of astandard credit card. Slip it into the tightest coin pocket, drop it into a micro-bag, or conceal it completely in the palm of your hand. It’s ultra-compact cooling that actually fits your life.

Think of it as a natural extension of your daily essentials. At this size, itfits right alongside your AirPods, keys, and pocket knifewithout adding bulk to your everyday carry (EDC). If you have room for a case of AirPods, you have more than enough room for the ZERA mini.

Powerful Jetstream Up to 13m/s

With ZERA’s latest brushless motor, we are able to squeeze out30,000RPMwith the single battery. With windspeed reaching13m/s, it can do a lot more than just cooling and delivers jetstream up to 10 meters away. You can blow clean or help starting a fire with it.

Wear It The Way You Like

We specially designed our accessories to seamlessly integrate into your lifestyle. Our Combo Sets come with a360° Easy-Switch Clip, Neck & Wrist Strap System, and Carabiner. Pair the ZERA Mini with our custom accessories for maximum convenience on the go!

Easily clip the ZERA mini onto yourshirt, cap, backpack, or daily gear. Direct the airflow exactly where you need it—your waist, back, neck, or face for a quick cool-down.

With our newNeck & Wrist Strap System, you can pack, hang or wear your fan exactly the way you want. Go completely hands-free by wearing it like a necklace or secure it to your arm using the specially designed comfort straps.

Pair it with your favorite phone strap, or use the included robustcarabiner clipto hang it securely anywhere you go.

Dial Up Your Power Easily

Like our full-sized ZERA Max, the mini features a special display that shows you the wind speed in100 levels. You can press & hold to select the exact speed you want easily.

You may quickly select your ideal windpower with single clicks too. Tap to immediately reach¼, ½, ¾ and full speed.You will get familiar with it soon and be able to pick any speed in seconds.

Weighting only69g (2.43oz), you can drop it effortlessly inside your bag and purse, or just your pants pocket. It is a miniature that works, packing the full power of a blower.

Long Battery Life

ZERA mini can perform cooling efficiently and deliversup to 10 hoursof run time on a single charge. This long-lasting battery makes it ideal for commuting, travel, outdoor events, festivals or desk use throughout the day.

Pick Your Perfect Color

ZERA mini has all the other guys beat across the board, from performance to size.

What's in the Box?

We will notify all backers of any changes well in advance.All prices include VAT, where " Custom Friendly " is indicated, backers will not be charged additional import taxes or custom fees.

Design & Production

Production of the mini will take place at the same factory as other ZERA products, which has a history of delivering them mostly on time. With the experience and trust we have gained from previous campaigns, we can be certain that the estimated delivery could be matched and we will keep backers updated regularly.

Hello! The ZERA crew who brought you the MAX and MAX 2 is back again! As a group of specialists with diverse experiences in product design and engineering, we work seamlessly to develop the next level products for your enjoyment.

The ZERA crew assembles once more for the latest campaign!ZERA miniis our latest innovation into the ever-improving fan concepts. Working as a team of specialists with diverse experiences in product design, hardware and engineering, here is our latest take in personal cooling devices.

We strive to improve electronic products, and that is not just by making them faster and smaller. ZERA mini symbolizes our first step into a new direction - by adding fun to the products. The mini is our love letter to 2000s tech, and we think you will enjoy it!

Risks and challenges

During the previous ZERA projects, we have met several challenges at the stages of manufacturing the shipping. As the creator, we always thrive to eliminate these obstacles to provide creators the rewards on time. With a history of running successful campaigns, our team is dedicated to maintaining this record with ZERA mini.

Although ZERA mini is a brand new product, its core technology is based on the ones proven on previous ZERA offerings. This has eliminated the risk of using new and unproven designs that could lead to last-minute changes. Delivery will be carried out by our usual shipping agent, which uses a variety of couriers to both ensure quality and a good shipping rate. 

While ZERA continues to provide innovations that integrate into the lives of the users, we will maintain good communication and transparency through the channels recommended by the platform, providing regular updates to keep our backers informed of every success and challenge along the way. Thank you for your incredible support.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

Some AI-assisted content may be used in a limited, supportive role to help create or refine select campaign visuals, background design compositions, and lifestyle imagery to illustrate specific user environments. The ZERA mini itself is an entirely physical product, and this campaign is not seeking funding for AI technology. All core product designs, engineering, and functionality were developed exclusively by our team. Any AI tools are used strictly as creative visual production aids to help present the product clearly and lifestyle-rich to our backers.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. Any AI-assisted content utilized is generated based on our own proprietary product designs, physical prototypes, brand assets, and creative concepts developed specifically for the ZERA mini. We do not knowingly use third-party copyrighted artwork, logos, characters, or artist-specific styles to generate campaign materials. All final visual assets are strictly audited and reviewed by our in-house team before publishing to ensure they exclusively and accurately represent our own original product and brand messaging.

Environmental commitments

Reusability and recyclability

We carefully choose strong, recyclable materials to reduce our environmental footprint and ensure device stays eco-friendly.

Sustainable materials

Just like other ZERA products, the mini was designed with a number of sustainable factors. Its construction is made to last with a sufficient level of water resistance. For frequent use, a rechargeable battery is used instead of a disposable dry cell that is common with fans of its size. The battery will hold full volume for at least hundreds charging cycles ensuring a long-term service with minimal waste.

Additionally, the charging method is standardized to USB Type-C. Even if the original cable has been lost or damaged, you can use other cables to recharge it, greatly increasing its service life and convenience.

100-level intuitive display with 10+ hours battery life

projects.blurb: Control any USB-C device from anywhere with one cable. Empower AI Agent with full screen memory and control. Work Remote, Flow Smart.
projects.html_story:

Technical Specifications

About NanoKVM & Sipeed

Environmental commitments

From the team behind NanoKVM — one of the most popular open-source KVMs in the world.

One Cable, Full Control

Forget the cable mess of traditional KVM. Welcome to modern remote access.One USB-C cable brings video, audio, keyboard, mouse, and power together.Then simply open your browser to view the screen, move the mouse, type, reboot, or manage your device remotely.No adapters. No drivers on the target device. No dedicated client app. Just plug in and go.

Built for Every Remote Scenario

Works with everything USB-C

Ultra Clear.Ultra Compact

Modern devices demand modern resolution. iPhones output at 2K. MacBooks screen range from 2K to nearly 4K. Capturing anything less means blurry text, unreadable code, and a frustrating remote experience.NanoKVM-Go delivers up to 4K@45 / 2K@90 in a watch-sized body. No compromises — every pixel on your Retina display, crystal clear on the other end.

The NanoKVM team pushed the limits of what's possible — shrinking a full 4K KVM into a watch-sized ~45×40×15mm body, at just 1.6W.That's 1/4 the volume and 1/2 the power of the nearest 4K KVM competitor. Not incremental. Generational.Small enough to clip on a keychain. Powerful enough to take control from anywhere.

Wireless. Worldwide

NanoKVM-Go ditches the Ethernet port entirely. With dual-band WiFi 6 delivering up to 286 Mbps, it streams 4K video wirelessly — with as low as 60~90ms latency on your local network.

Access Your Device Anywhere

Built-inTailscalesupport. Secure remote access from anywhere — no port forwarding, no VPN setup. Just connect and control.

NanoKVM-Go operates at the hardware level — when you unplug, the session is gone. No residual access, no background processes, no trace left behind. Physical disconnect means absolute disconnect.

Power & Possibility

Beyond the main USB-C port, we reserved a second one — making NanoKVM-Go more versatile than any KVM its size.PD Passthrough— Using NanoKVM-Go with your iPhone or iPad? The second port keeps your device charged throughout the session. No battery anxiety.

Finger Robot Expansion— Mac mini frozen? Connect a finger robot to physically press the power button and force a reboot — from anywhere. No downtime anxiety.

Remote OS installation— Boot from a virtual USB drive , walk through the entire setup — all from your browser, no physical access needed.

Magnetic Attachment— NanoKVM-Go features powerful built-in magnets, allowing it to seamlessly snap onto metal PC cases or the back of your iPhone.

💡 Tip:Attaching it to a metal chassis during heavy workloads acts as a passive heatsink, greatly improving heat dissipation!

Everything above makes NanoKVM-Go the best USB-C KVM on the market. But we didn't stop there.It's not just a small 4K USB-C KVM. It's the first AI-Native KVM for fellow AI-Natives, unleashes your limitless creativity!

All KVM functions exposed as MCP server(enable by user). Your AI assistant just got eyes and hands.

NanoKVM-Go is the ultimate hardware-levelCUA(Computer Use Agent)peripheral. Pair it with any AI agent to automate desktop and mobile tasks — with true human-like input !

NanoKVM Team also created the popular AI Agent:PicoClaw!It has~30K Staron github, and the NanoKVM-Go is able to run it too!

You don't need 799$ to run openclaw on Mac Mini, Just need 79$ to run picoclaw on this tiny device! Let this finger-tip device become your personal AI Assistant!

We built Ambient Screen Intelligence into NanoKVM-Go+ — helping you recall what you've done, and helping your AI agent understand what you're doing.

For humans, it's a perfect memory — Especially if yours isn't.Search any keyword, jump to the exact moment on screen. Like searching your chat history — but for everything you've ever seen.

(NanoKVM-Go+ has a built-in 3.2TOPS AI processor — Instant Recall optional works in offline mode, no cloud, no subscription, no internet required.)

For AI agents, it's rich, real-time work context that makes them genuinely useful.One toggle. Your screen memory becomes an MCP endpoint — any AI agent can query and understand your work context instantly.

Open-Source. Customize

NanoKVM-Go isn't just open-source for developers — it's easy enough for anyone to vibe-code their own unique apps !

Bring your AI Agent Desktop Pet (like Codex or picopaw.ai ) to the mini screen~

Your Device, Your Rules

Another benefit of being open: you don’t have to worry about your device turning into a brick if the vendor shuts down, unlike some other "AI hardware".

NanoKVM-Go’s AI API is open, so you can use any AI provider you prefer!

NanoKVM is one of the most popular open-source IP-KVM systems in the world, with hundreds of thousands of units shipped to users across 100+ countries. From homelabs to data centers, NanoKVM has become the go-to choice for affordable, open-source remote access.NanoKVM-Go is our next chapter — but it's not the only thing we're building.Sipeed is an AI-native hardware company with 8+ years in RISC-V and edge AI. Our product ecosystem includes:- PicoClaw&PicoPaw — Lightweight AI Agent/Pet for every device- Maix Station — Local AI inference for 30B–1000B models- Maix NAS — AI-powered NAS with built-in YOLO/LLM/VLMOpen source is in our DNA. projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Sipeed — an AI-native hardware company with 8+ years of experience in RISC-V and edge AI, and creator of NanoKVM, one of the world's most popular open-source KVMs.
projects.ai_description_en:
NanoKVM-Go is an ultra-compact, open-source USB-C KVM (keyboard-video-mouse switch) that lets you control any USB-C device from anywhere with a single cable. Built by Sipeed — the team behind NanoKVM, one of the world's most popular open-source KVMs — it shrinks full 4K remote control into a watch-sized body of roughly 45×40×15 mm drawing just 1.6 W, about a quarter of the volume and half the power of the nearest 4K competitor.

One cable, full control. A single USB-C connection carries video, audio, keyboard, mouse, and power together. Open a browser to view the screen, move the mouse, type, reboot, or manage the device remotely — no adapters, no drivers on the target machine, and no dedicated client app. Just plug in and go.

Ultra-clear, ultra-compact. Modern devices push high resolutions — iPhones at 2K, MacBooks from 2K to nearly 4K — so NanoKVM-Go delivers up to 4K@45 fps or 2K@90 fps with every pixel crisp on the other end, instead of the blurry text and unreadable code you get from lower capture.

Wireless, worldwide. It drops the Ethernet port entirely, streaming 4K video over dual-band WiFi 6 at up to 286 Mbps with 60–90 ms local-network latency. Built-in Tailscale support gives secure remote access from anywhere — no port forwarding, no VPN. Because it operates at the hardware level, unplugging the device ends the session completely: no residual access, no background process, no trace left behind.

Power & possibility. A reserved second USB-C port enables PD passthrough (keep your iPhone or iPad charged mid-session), a finger-robot expansion to physically press a power button and force-reboot a frozen Mac mini from anywhere, remote OS installation from a virtual USB drive, and magnetic attachment to metal PC cases or the back of a phone — which doubles as a passive heatsink under heavy load.

The first AI-Native KVM. Beyond a 4K KVM, NanoKVM-Go is built for AI agents: all KVM functions are exposed as an MCP server (user-enabled) so an AI assistant gains eyes and hands, making it the ultimate hardware-level Computer-Use-Agent peripheral. NanoKVM-Go+ adds a built-in 3.2 TOPS AI processor running Ambient Screen Intelligence — instant, offline “recall” of anything on screen, searchable like chat history, with no cloud and no subscription. Pair it with PicoClaw (Sipeed's ~30K-star open-source AI agent) for a personal AI assistant that fits on your fingertip.

Open-source, customizable. NanoKVM-Go is easy enough for anyone to vibe-code their own apps, and because the AI API is open you can use any provider you prefer. Being open also means no “brick risk” if the vendor shuts down — your device, your rules.

projects.html_story:
All or nothing.This project will only be funded if it reaches its goal by Sat, August 1 2026 6:02 AM EDT.

Tiny EDC Light | Pry-Bar Tail | Premium LEDs | USB-C Spare Battery Dock

Tiny EDC Light | Pry-Bar Tail | Premium LEDs | USB-C Spare Battery Dock

All or nothing.This project will only be funded if it reaches its goal by Sat, August 1 2026 6:02 AM EDT.

Keychain-Ready Size

Cold White / Warm High-Cri

Spare Battery Dock

Mini Pry-Bar Tail

IPX8 Waterproof

Why It Earns a Place on Your Keys

What Makes an EDC Flashlight Actually Worth Carrying?

Small enough to stay with you.Bright enough when darkness hits.Tough enough for daily carry.Useful beyond just light.Ready when power runs low.

That’sHUNT H2— a tiny EDC flashlight tool with apry-bar tail,premium white-light options, and aspare battery dock.

Keychain-Ready Size

Only approx.40 × 15 mm.

No bulk.No pocket drag.No reason to leave it behind.

Cold White / Warm High-Cri

Each HUNT H2 is built aroundone focused light output— no endless mode cycling, no complicated controls.

Powered by premiumCREEandLUMINUSLEDs, HUNT H2 gives you two practical white-light choices:Cold Whitefor crisp everyday brightness, orWarm High-CRIfor natural color and a more comfortable beam.

Spare Battery Dock

When power runs low, swap in the spare cell and keep your light moving — no waiting around with a dead flashlight in your hand.

The dock stores your spare battery and charges it viaUSB-Cwhen plugged in, giving HUNT H2 a smarter way to stay ready without adding bulk to the flashlight body.

Use one. Store one. Swap when needed.

Mini Pry-Bar Tail

Built into the tail ofHUNT H2, thismini pry bargives your flashlight asecond job— so yourknife tip and fingernailsdo not have to take the abuse.

Shine when it’s dark.Pry when it’s stuck.Carry one tool that does both.

IPX8 Waterproof

Built withIPX8 waterproofing, HUNT H2 is made for real everyday carry — not just dry desks and clean pockets.

Rain-ready. Pocket-tough. Built to keep going.

Tool-Grade Metal Body

ChooseTC4 titaniumfor a solid premium feel, oraluminumfor a lighter everyday carry setup.

Strong without the bulk.Tough enough for keys, pockets, and daily wear.

Light to carry. Solid to hold. Built to last.

Why It Earns a Place on Your Keys

HUNT H2 is built for the kind of tool you actually keep with you — small enough for your keys, bright enough for real use, and useful enough to earn its space every day.

It brings together a mini EDC flashlight, a pry-bar tail, Cold White / Warm High-CRI light options, IPX8 waterproofing, and a USB-C spare battery dock in one compact carry system.

Light when you need it.A tool when you need more.A spare cell when power runs low.

Risks and challenges

This is our 18th Kickstarter project, and over the years we’ve gained a lot of experience bringing ideas from concept to production and delivery. Our team has successfully developed and fulfilled many campaigns, and we’ve built strong relationships with trusted manufacturing and logistics partners along the way.

HUNT is already well into development, with working pre-production samples completed and tested. Our manufacturing partners are experienced in producing titanium products, and we’ve planned our production timeline carefully to ensure a smooth transition into mass production.

As with any project, the most common challenge could be logistics or shipping delays, particularly if the campaign exceeds expectations (which would be fantastic!). To prepare for this possibility, we’ve built extra buffer time into our production schedule and coordinated early with our suppliers and fulfillment partners to handle higher volumes if needed.

Transparency is very important to us. Throughout the campaign and production process, we’ll keep backers informed with regular updates. If any unexpected issues arise, we’ll communicate openly and share exactly how we’re addressing them.

Please note that the products shown in our photos and videos are pre-mass production samples. During the manufacturing process, small refinements—such as minor design adjustments or size optimizations—may be made to ensure the best quality and performance.

Thank you for trusting us to bring HUNT to life. We’re excited to deliver this project and can’t wait to see where your adventures take it.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

We may use AI-assisted tools only to create or enhance background and atmosphere elements in a limited number of campaign images. These images are used for visual presentation only. The product design, specifications, engineering details, prototype development, product photography, and product functionality are created and controlled by our team. AI was not used to invent product functions or misrepresent the actual product.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. The AI-assisted elements are based on our own product visuals, product renders, and creative direction. We did not use third-party copyrighted artwork, artist names, or protected characters as source material. The final campaign images will be reviewed and approved by our team before launch.

projects.ai_intro_en: The HUNT H2 is a tiny EDC flashlight that combines a keychain-ready size (approx. 40×15mm) with a mini pry-bar tail, premium CREE/LUMINUS LED options in Cold White or Warm High-CRI, and a USB-C spare battery dock. Built with an IPX8 waterproof, tool-grade metal body in titanium or aluminum, it's designed to earn a permanent spot on your keys.
ai_highlights_en: Keychain-ready 40×15mm size with built-in mini pry-bar tail for dual functionality
Premium CREE/LUMINUS LEDs offering Cold White or Warm High-CRI beam options
USB-C spare battery dock lets you swap and charge cells on the go
projects.ai_risks_en: This is the team's 18th Kickstarter with pre-production samples already completed and tested. Manufacturing partners are experienced with titanium products. The primary risk is logistics or shipping delays if the campaign exceeds expectations, but extra buffer time has been built into the production schedule. Minor design refinements may occur during mass production.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: HUNT is an experienced crowdfunding team on their 18th Kickstarter project, specializing in EDC tools with established manufacturing and logistics partnerships.
projects.ai_description_en:
HUNT H2 is a keychain-ready EDC flashlight built to bring practical light, added utility, and reliable readiness together in a carry-sized body that measures only about 40 × 15 mm.

Designed around simplicity and durability, the flashlight delivers one focused white-light mode with no complicated menu cycling. Backed by premium CREE and LUMINUS LEDs, HUNT H2 offers two practical light choices: Cold White for crisp everyday brightness, or Warm High-CRI for natural color and a more comfortable beam.

The HUNT H2 integrates a mini pry-bar tail, giving the flashlight a secondary use beyond just light. This tool-grade metal body is built with IPX8 waterproofing and is available in TC4 titanium for a premium feel or aluminum for a lighter everyday carry setup. A USB-C spare battery dock stores and charges a spare cell so you can swap batteries in the field instead of waiting around with a dead light.

The result is a small yet capable carry tool that combines an EDC flashlight and pry-bar tail in a compact package that's ready for real daily use.

Designed to deliver high-fidelity audio at safe volumes, it aims to protect hearing while providing reference-level sound.

Ultra-light 4g weight with ergonomic zero-pressure fit for comfort.

Environmental commitments

Every cyclist knows their power. Few know where that power goes.

The reality is simple:most of the energy you produce never becomes speed. It disappears into aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, and drivetrain losses. For decades, understanding those losses required access to wind tunnels, laboratories, and expensive testing protocols.

For professional teams, this data became a competitive advantage. For everyone else, it remained inaccessible.Until now.

THE WASTED WATTS TRACKER

Power meters tell you how hard you push the pedals.Wasted Watts tells you how efficiently those watts become speed.

For the first time, cyclists can measure aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, equipment performance, and riding efficiency directly on the roads they ride every day.

No wind tunnel. No laboratory. No assumptions.Just real-time accurate data, collected in real conditions.

Cycling performance is often reduced to a single metric:pedalingpower.

Butpushing more wattsdoes not automatically win races, set personal records, or improve efficiency. It’s only half the battle. If that power is lost to aerodynamic drag and rolling resistance - the wasted watts - you are just burning matches to fight the wind. True speed can therefore only come through reducing these losses.

Our mission is to make the invisible visible and make performance optimization accessible to every cyclist by revealing the hidden factors that determine speed. By transforming complex aerodynamic analysisinto a practical tool with outstanding precisionand reactivity, we aim to help riders make smarter decisions, train more effectively, and unlock performance gains that were previously reserved for elite teams.

Because the fastest rider is not always the strongest rider. Often, it’s the most efficient one.

TURN DATA INTO FREE SPEED

PROFESSIONAL MEASUREMENT TECHNOLOGY

The Wasted Watts Tracker was designed as a professional-grade measurement system capable of delivering highly accurate results outside laboratory environments.

Core technologies include:

Centimeter-accurate GPS RTK positioning

Real-time aerodynamic measurement

Synchronized power meter integration

High-precision speed detection

Automatic calibration systems

The platform achieves measurement precision as high as 0.5% over 60 seconds,making it the most advanced aerodynamic field testing system ever made available to cyclists.

Until now, serious aerodynamic testing required dedicated facilities, specialized operators, and thousands of dollars in testing fees.

A typical wind tunnel session costs between $1,500 and $2,500.

And once the session ends, the data stops.

Wasted Watts brings that level of analysis directly onto the road.

Test your position.

Test your equipment.

Test your strategy.

Anytime you ride.

Precision is only valuable if it can be trusted. Wasted Watts has been rigorously tested against known aerodynamic variations,demonstrating its ability to detect even the smallest performance differences.

In this example, the system accurately measures incremental changes in drag with a standard error of just 0.13%, equivalent to approximately 0.32 watts at 45 km/h. The result is a level of accuracy that allows cyclists to confidently evaluate position changes, equipment choices, and aerodynamic optimizations directly on the road.

HOW THE WASTED WATTS TRACKER COMPARES

Most alternative systems require dedicated testing protocols, controlled roads, a complex calibration process, and lengthy measurement sessions, with unknown output accuracy.Wasted Watts was designed differently.

With synchronized sensors, RTK positioning, automatic calibration, and real-world usability, the system delivers professional insights while riding on normal roads.

No dedicated testing environment required. Just ride.

PROVEN WITH THE PROS

REAL PERFORMANCE GAINS

Performance gains are only meaningful when they translate into results.

A prime example is junior riderPaul Seixas, who leveragedAeroscale’s aerodynamic optimization on his path to winning the2024 Time Trial Junior World Championship.

WHO IS THIS FOR?

Designed for riders of all levels, it brings professional performance analysis to every ride.

Road Cyclists:understand where your energy goes and maximize your efficiency on every ride.

Triathletes:optimize your position and equipment before race day.

Time Trial Specialists:turn every watt into measurable speed.

Gravel & Endurance Riders:improve long-distance efficiency and reduce wasted energy over hours of riding.

Coaches & Performance Analysts:make better decisions using objective aerodynamic and efficiency data.

APP AND LIVE RIDE EXPERIENCE

Wasted Watts Tracker is not only a measurement hardware, buta live performance feedback system. The rider immediately understands what they see, when they see it, and how they use the data.

During a ride, the app connects the rear module, front airflow module, power meter, and GPS RTK correction service. It then translates the data into practical performance insight: how many watts are being lost, helps understand what is causing those losses, and whether a change is making the rider faster or less efficient. Here's what riders see:

Live Wasted Watts feedback during testing and riding.

A clear comparison between the produced power and the useful movement.

Real-world efficiency data that can be used to adjust position, equipment, tire pressure, drafting, and setup choices.

Normalized results that make different test runs easier to compare.

LIVE A-B TESTING

Turn Every Ride into a Performance Test

One of the strongest use cases for Wasted Watts Tracker is fast real-world A/B testing. Riders immediately see how the wasted watts tracker helps them make practical decisions, not just collect data.

With Test Mode, riders can repeat short test runs and compare setups using objective Normalized Wasted Watts data. Instead of relying on feel, brand claims, or wind-tunnel access, riders can test changes on the roads they actually ride.

Examples riders can test

Helmet A vs. Helmet B.

Hands on hoods vs drops vs aero/tucked position.

Different tire pressures on the same route.

Wheel choices and bike configurations.

Aero clothing vs standard kit.

Road bike setup vs time-trial setup.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Behind every insight provided by Wasted Watts is a sophisticated measurement system designed for professional-level accuracy. By combining multiple data sources and advanced algorithms,it transforms complex aerodynamic analysis into clear, actionable information you can use on every ride.

WHY IT'S DIFFERENT

Most aerodynamic testing solutions require dedicated roads, complex protocols, expensive facilities, or lengthy testing sessions. Wasted Watts was designed to work differently.

By combining professional-grade sensors, RTK positioning, and real-time analysis, it delivers wind-tunnel-level insights directly on the roads you already ride,making performance optimization faster, simpler, and more accessible than ever before.

Wasted Watts Tracker combines hardware, power meter data reading, smartphone connectivity, and RTK correction service.

To work the Wasted Watts Tracker properly requires :

A bike (ok that’s obvious 🙂)

A smartphone with data connectivity

A powermeter (preferably SRM PM9 or Quarq Spider to guarantee a good precision in low-latency mode)

The Wasted Watts Tracker is composed of 2 modules :Front Pitot module mounted on the front of the bike (TT bike attachment system available as an option)Rear GPS RTK module attached to the saddle

Front Pitot module mounted on the front of the bike (TT bike attachment system available as an option)

Rear GPS RTK module attached to the saddle

A Garmin bike computer display (or simply a smartphone mount if you’d prefer to use your smartphone)

Wasted Watts Tracker is designed to work with the rider’s existing bike power meter in ANT+ or BLE. The powermeter provides the input effort that the system compares against actual movement and energy losses. The Wasted Watts Tracker pairs with any ANT+/BLE powermeter, but note that the low-latency mode precision is only guaranteed with SRM PM9 or Quarq Spider BLE powermeters.

Cycling computer and app

Data appears during a ride through the dedicated smartphone app, compatible Garmin head units, or both.

RTK coverage, Smartphone, and mobile data

RTK correction requires a smartphone connection and mobile data access in supported areas through our included correction service (see above for areas covered)), or a custom RTK base station in order to provide the Wasted Watts Tracker with centimeter-level positioning through

Bike compatibility

Compatible with standard road bikes and gravel bikes. An additional front module mounting system is proposed for Time Trial and Triathlon bikes.

THE DEVELOPMENT JOURNEY

The idea behind Wasted Watts began with a simple observation: cyclists had excellent tools for measuring training load, such as power or heart rate, but no practical way to measure efficiency.

The team spent years developing a system capable of delivering wind-tunnel-grade insights outside controlled laboratory environments. Through continuous testing, validation, and collaboration with professional teams, that vision evolved into the product you see today.

A tool designed not just for professionals, but for every cyclist who wants to ride faster through better understanding.

FOUNDER STORY AND PRODUCT ORIGIN

Aeroscale was founded by Manuel Sellier,a former elite cyclist with a PhD in Physics, an MBA, and years of experience in advanced technology and engineering. His background gives the project a rare combination of cycling performance knowledge, scientific depth, and product development discipline.

The origin of the product is also personal and technical.Manuel developed the concept with the influence and expertise of his father, who had experience in wind tunnel measurement technologies. Together, this father-son foundation helped shape the idea behind the Wasted Watts Tracker: make professional-level cycling efficiency measurement possible outside the lab.

Before bringing the product to Kickstarter, Aeroscale validated its approach through real-world work with more than 100 pro-riders, 6 World Tour teams, and the Bike Speed Lab service to refine its measurement approach, validate its technology, and prove that real-world efficiency testing could deliver measurable performance gains.

It is the result of years of measurement, testing, and iteration with cyclists who depend on precision.

The Wasted Watts concept is the result of collaboration between engineers, aerodynamic specialists, data scientists, and performance-focused cyclists.

The same expertise that has supported elite riders and World Tour teams is now being applied to create a platform accessible to the broader cycling community.

Our goal is not simply to build hardware. It is to redefine how cyclists understand performance.

WHAT BACKERS RECEIVE

In the Wasted Watts Tracker, backers receive a complete real-world cycling efficiency system, not just a single sensor.

We will ship Wasted Watts worldwide.

Shipping costs will be collected after the campaign through our pledge manager, allowing us to calculate accurate shipping rates based on destination and reward selection.

This approach ensures fair pricing for all backers while simplifying the Kickstarter experience.

The roadmap below shows how Wasted Watts has evolved from the current prototypeinto the production-ready system that backers will receive. Over the coming months, the team will continue improving precision, compatibility, automation, and ease of use, adding features such as automatic calibrations, broader device support, iOS compatibility, and faster real-time analysis.

By the time units ship, backers will receive the most advanced and refined version of the platform, built on continuous testing and feedback from both professional teams and everyday riders.

Cycling performance is not only about producing more power. It’s about wasting less of it.

Wasted Watts reveals the hidden data behind every ride, helping cyclists understand where speed is lost and where performance can be gained.

Real roads. Real data. Real speed.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Aeroscale is a cycling technology company focused on making professional-grade aerodynamic analysis accessible to everyday riders, proven with elite athletes including junior world champion Paul Seixas.
projects.ai_description_en:
Every cyclist knows their power. Few know where that power goes. The Wasted Watts Tracker is the first system that reveals exactly how much energy disappears while you ride, transforming aerodynamic drag, rolling resistance, and drivetrain losses from invisible obstacles into measurable, optimizable data. For decades, understanding these losses required access to wind tunnels, laboratories, and expensive testing protocols costing $1,500–$2,500 per session. Wasted Watts brings that professional-grade measurement technology directly onto the road, giving riders real-time, highly accurate data about their equipment efficiency, body position, and gear choices — no assumptions, no controlled environments, just results on the roads they ride every day.

At its core, the Tracker combines centimeter-accurate GPS RTK positioning, real-time aerodynamic measurement, a synchronized power meter integration, and automatic calibration systems into a single wearable platform. The result is measurement precision as high as 0.5% over 60 seconds, with the ability to detect drag changes as small as 0.13% — roughly 0.32 watts at 45 km/h. Live A-B testing mode lets riders compare equipment and positions in real time, translating raw data into actionable purchases and setup decisions. Unlike alternative systems that require dedicated testing protocols, controlled roads, and lengthy sessions, Wasted Watts works automatically during regular rides, making aerodynamic field testing both practical and repeatable.

The product has been refined over years of development with multiple manufacturing-ready prototypes already on the road collecting data and user feedback. Professional riders and teams have already validated its accuracy against known aerodynamic variations, proving its ability to deliver career-augmenting insights outside the lab. Whether you are a time-trial racer chasing marginal gains or a competitive amateur optimizing comfort and speed, the Wasted Watts Tracker changes the conversation from how hard you push to how efficiently that effort becomes speed — because the fastest rider is not always the strongest one, but often the most efficient.

projects.ai_intro_en: The OneXPlayer 3 is a handheld gaming PC powered by Intel Arc G3 Extreme graphics, featuring LPDDR5X memory and PCIe 4.0 SSD storage. Available in multiple configurations with 24GB or 32GB RAM and up to 1TB storage, it delivers high-performance portable gaming.
ai_highlights_en: Intel Arc G3 Extreme graphics for powerful handheld gaming performance
Up to 32GB LPDDR5X 8533 memory for fast multitasking and gaming
PCIe 4.0 SSD storage up to 1TB for quick load times
projects.ai_risks_en: As a crowdfunding project, delivery timelines may face delays due to manufacturing or supply chain issues. The August 2026 estimated delivery is contingent on successful production. Intel Arc GPU game compatibility may vary with some titles.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: OneXPlayer is a handheld gaming PC manufacturer producing portable Windows gaming devices with high-performance Intel hardware.
projects.ai_description_en:
The OneXPlayer 3 is a next-generation 3-in-1 handheld PC that combines gaming, productivity, and creative work into a single powerful device. Powered by the Intel Arc G3 Extreme processor, it delivers desktop-class graphics performance with built-in AI acceleration, making it capable of running AAA games, creative applications, and productivity software on the go.

The device features an 8.8-inch 144Hz OLED display with vibrant colors and smooth motion, paired with a massive 85Wh battery for extended sessions away from power. Available in multiple configurations including up to 32GB LPDDR5X 8533 memory and 1TB PCIe 4.0 SSD storage, the OneXPlayer 3 adapts to different usage needs and budgets.

Designed to replace the need for carrying separate gaming handhelds, laptops, and tablets, the OneXPlayer 3 connects to external displays for desktop-mode productivity while maintaining true handheld portability. Built by OneXPlayer, a established brand in the handheld PC space with a track record of successful campaigns and deliveries.

## Risks and challenges

Gen3 is the latest evolution of our KVM Dock, built on the proven Gen2 architecture. It adds Gigabit Ethernet, SD/TF card readers, an optimized I/O layout, and a higher-capacity power system to deliver greater efficiency for multi-device workflows.

Potential Risks:

The addition of new interfaces and enhanced power management may require firmware optimization in rare system configurations. Global logistics fluctuations or component availability could impact production schedules; however, we have established multi-source procurement channels for key components to minimize potential risks.

Why We’re Confident:

We have successfully delivered the first two generations of our KVM products. Our engineering team brings over 20 years of experience in high-speed data transmission, display technologies, and power delivery design. Multiple BD215J prototypes have undergone comprehensive functional, thermal, and stability testing.

With mature manufacturing partnerships, extensive engineering validation, and direct communication with our backers, we are confident in delivering Gen3 on time and to the high standards our community expects.

projects.ai_intro_en: The TadCALO Gen3 is a 14-in-1 KVM dock designed for hybrid work, featuring one-tap switching between dual hosts with dual 4K@60Hz displays. It integrates a 10Gbps USB-C hub, 150W power delivery, Gigabit Ethernet, and SD/TF card readers in an aluminium alloy shell. Built on proven Gen2 architecture, it adds enhanced I/O and power management for seamless multi-device workflows.
ai_highlights_en: One-tap KVM switching between dual hosts with dual 4K@60Hz displays and EDID for seamless visual stability
14-in-1 dock with 10Gbps USB-C hub, 150W PD, Gigabit Ethernet, and SD/TF card reader
Wide cross-platform compatibility designed for hybrid work with aluminium alloy shell
projects.ai_risks_en: Potential firmware optimization may be needed for rare system configurations. Global logistics fluctuations or component availability could impact production schedules, though multi-source procurement channels have been established to minimize risks.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Experienced engineering team with over 20 years in high-speed data transmission, display technologies, and power delivery design, having successfully delivered two prior KVM product generations.
projects.ai_description_en:
The TadCALO Gen3 is the latest evolution of the 14-in-1 Dual Host KVM Docking Station, engineered to streamline multi-device workflows for the modern hybrid worker. Built on the proven architecture of its predecessor, this compact hub consolidates your entire desktop setup into a single, elegant aluminium alloy shell. By allowing seamless control over two hosts with dual 4K@60Hz displays, the Gen3 eliminates the clutter of multiple peripherals and cables, transforming any workspace into a highly efficient, cross-platform command center.

At the heart of the Gen3 is its effortless one-tap KVM switching, enabling users to toggle between two computers instantly while maintaining seamless visual stability through advanced EDID emulation. The docking station boasts a comprehensive 14-in-1 I/O layout, featuring a 10Gbps USB-C hub for lightning-fast data transfers, a 1,000Mbps Gigabit Ethernet port for reliable networking, and integrated SD/TF card readers for direct media access. Furthermore, the optimized power system delivers a robust 150W Power Delivery, ensuring your host devices stay charged without the need for extra power bricks.

The Gen3 matters because it directly addresses the friction of hybrid work, offering wide compatibility and the ability to extend or mirror displays instantly across different operating systems. Whether you are a creative professional managing massive files over the 10Gbps connection or a business user requiring stable wired Ethernet and dual-monitor setups, this dock delivers unparalleled efficiency. Backed by an engineering team with over 20 years of experience in high-speed data and display technologies, and validated through comprehensive prototype testing, the TadCALO Gen3 represents a reliable, high-performance upgrade to your daily workflow.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/235/405/c4e68b77c743f2a8f7886d569b816751_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782408496&width=680&sig=BuhPhA3Rk48GpcQNia4BCd7zJC5MNpvBKUuM9hm0e2k%3D)

Built by bakers, for bakers. Already tested by 100 bakers.

### Still guessing with your starter?

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/232/622/aa642c615ce5de4d460bbb1b34457f2c_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782393213&width=680&sig=82BTAahnavJzS0Hf11b%2BqOBtCwciysTfiptr9NOK3yo%3D)

One day perfect, the next a complete mystery. That’s because your starter is a living ecosystem – and tiny changes in temperature or flour make a massive difference.

BUBBLY BUBBLY changes that.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/185/077/31842db62d3da27e7dcfab8dda0f669e_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782075269&width=680&sig=qIOJbdPfXY%2Ftw6FXMhnMI0CKEogGItkJ61lvZN2PEcY%3D)High-hydration and low-hydration starters

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/232/230/a922ed6b585821156f8f26ba6e9a9f3c_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782390869&width=680&sig=chD7tr0PJ%2FukzcmrxLbDzFhXU97mx%2Bh%2BE3tb5E7uL7E%3D)

By tracking CO₂ – the most reliable sign of sourdough activity – BUBBLY BUBBLY reveals the hidden biology of your starter. You’ll see exactly what’s happening inside your jar in real time.

No more guessing! Just great bread, with confidence, every single time.

projects.ai_intro_en: BUBBLY BUBBLY is the world's first sourdough assistant that measures CO₂, the most reliable indicator of starter activity. Using advanced four-sensor technology and AI-powered analysis, it provides real-time tracking of your fermentation with smart READY and FEED alerts. The device features an E-ink display with up to one month of battery life, helping bakers achieve perfect results every time.
ai_highlights_en: World's first CO₂-based fermentation tracker for sourdough starters
AI-powered predictions for optimal feeding and baking windows
E-ink display with up to 1 month continuous monitoring per charge
ai_specs_en: Free download for iOS and Android
BUBBLY BUBBLY Pure (Small or Large), App, Bread bag
projects.ai_risks_en: Import duties, taxes, and additional shipping fees for remote areas may apply and are the backer's responsibility. As a crowdfunding project, delivery timelines and final product specifications may vary during development.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Built by bakers with 15+ years of experience, 2000+ students taught, and a community of 130,000+ sourdough enthusiasts, supported by experts in electronics, firmware, and product design.
projects.ai_description_en:
BUBBLY BUBBLY Pure is the world's first sourdough fermentation tracker that measures CO₂ — the most reliable, direct sign of your starter's activity. If you've ever felt frustrated by the unpredictability of sourdough baking, where tiny changes in temperature or flour can mean the difference between a perfect loaf and a flat disappointment, this device changes everything. By placing the sensor lid directly on your glass jar, you gain real-time visibility into the hidden biology of your sourdough starter, eliminating guesswork and replacing it with data-driven confidence.

At the heart of BUBBLY BUBBLY is an advanced four-sensor system that simultaneously tracks CO₂, temperature, humidity, and growth. Unlike other fermentation devices that only look at the side effects of fermentation, this tracker reads the biology directly. The data flows seamlessly into a free companion app for iOS and Android, where a custom-trained AI analyzes your fermentation in real time. The algorithm learns your sourdough's unique rhythm and delivers two crucial alerts: when your starter is at its peak readiness for baking, and when it's time to feed. Guided, step-by-step feeding scenarios help you build a stronger, healthier starter over time, while smart notifications keep you informed of status changes even when you're away from the kitchen.

Designed with both performance and practicality in mind, BUBBLY BUBBLY Pure features a low-power E-ink display that delivers up to one month of continuous monitoring on a single charge. Built by bakers for bakers, the device has already been tested by 100 sourdough enthusiasts. Backers can choose between Small or Large glass jar configurations, with each reward including the sensor lid, jar, free app access, and a BUBBLY BUBBLY bread bag. The app also unlocks community features including recipe sharing through The Baker's Feed, early access and member discounts in The Little Shop, and Dr. Dough — an in-app assistant that explains what's happening inside your jar and recommends when to feed, wait, or bake. By sharing your starter's data, you also help improve the prediction system for the entire BUBBLY BUBBLY community.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/968/27a79096324896f7688b4a827f67312c_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781003382&width=680&sig=TBjCcY0dBzzjiE5hT1fgF0znVIwwkbKcwhPtlODZ3S8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/931/b37af684e55ef7c908860bb8ea6e8005_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781003073&width=680&sig=pgxl4Ml2ZjT%2FvjZwM9p8q6HlqTR2BVr4z6vRZG61CYw%3D)

Every reader knows the drill:

- Hold it up — arms ache. Lean it — you squint.

- Light on — partner wakes. Light off — you're blind.

- Bump on the train. Page dog-eared. Bookmark gone.

We know that because we're readers too.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/816/202/851c31494eac2b2dbe676c0d40cc4dd9_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779360889&width=680&sig=LJiL0G%2FpgmGFeAl2yRLewvqSXBwm92FxD7jMBT9qGsI%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/045/127/dda26392c0a45cd1af7e55c199d7df5d_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781010109&width=680&sig=XV1TN2AGiWLtEYKvTaV43AlY7bayTJuCEgUTaeos%2FN4%3D)

The reading companion that lets you turn pages with a single thumb and lights only the page, not the room.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/044/030/804974ae7a9c2b11a79e1d296cf41d74_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781003876&width=680&sig=l%2BgRT95XQ1iNuzQkUWpk4J4soeZMXpq%2BUUge%2B8yATKY%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/070/462/6b03ffacf108ad08368f14cdb19aa953_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781169259&width=680&sig=encfgv11eBjHaL16au2yCR6Bx1tZ6M7nBY2BLQCSB%2F8%3D)

Meet Liza, the ultimate reading companion designed to make every chapter effortless. Weighing just 25 grams or 0.88 ounces, Liza is lighter than a standard pen. This sleek tool lets you comfortably read with one hand and say goodbye to tired arms. It easily adapts to any book from 50 to 900 pages, illuminating your story with 3 adjustable light modes designed to avoid disturbing anyone nearby. When it is time to stop, the integrated bookmark ensures your exact spot is always saved. Plus, thanks to USB-C fast charging, Liza is fully powered up in just 30 minutes and ready for wherever your reading takes you.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/695/a9cfc57fc16c17494d328f80d966ee1e_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781164249&width=680&sig=y%2FyEllUutH8wdO1izYmpa3UARWASMLW%2Bm6MebwYoaNQ%3D)

### ✨ How it works: 3-in-1 explained

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/068/0a48ad56a390e5036d87dfc3d20e34bd_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780998093&width=680&sig=0J370YMlmwkoweeGxHSpLHTZuhc0Q0hoNutWJ82b6m8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/912/850/acc4253bc69186003addf9bd15cbbdab_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780050042&width=680&sig=4O%2BW%2BRHf0apoK5mfUJiy%2BqEtE1PslnTjdRettGqTkbM%3D)

Liza features a warm, focused LED light with three brightness levels, letting you adapt to any environment from a dim bedroom to a bright train car. Its focused beam evenly lights up only your pages, without shining in your eyes or disturbing the person next to you. Perfect for night reading, travel, or shared spaces, Liza creates a softer, more comfortable reading experience wherever you are.

- 3 brightness levels: 200 / 250 / 300 lumens

- Up to 10 hours on Soft mode

- Warm white LED at 3000K

- USB-C rechargeable, fully charged in 30 minutes

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/912/795/c05921516541e8fc4a7b8bd36019cc41_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780049626&width=680&sig=ERuCMsyZ%2FoVu3pEZeWo%2BbC5FYS0vlahQ656uW8RdWuA%3D)

Say goodbye to hand cramps and tired thumbs. Liza lets you comfortably hold your book with just one hand. Whether you're lounging on the sofa, sitting at the table, or lying down, Liza keeps your pages wide open so you can just focus on the story.

- No creased or marked pages

- Works with any book

- Adjustable grip for books ranging from 50 to 900 pages

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/912/696/25a55f6f12b359a8be30e68c17514461_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780048845&width=680&sig=gh0rxgIqPWUs0ap9zWJ%2FKiWpexLwjgAJ%2BS%2BzQ6FSVDI%3D)

When you’re done reading, Liza instantly switches into bookmark mode to save your place. No more losing your page or dog-eared corners. Just slide it into your book, slip it into your bag, or leave it on your nightstand. Wherever you go, your page stays exactly where you left it, with no extra accessory needed.

- Built-in bookmark, zero page damage

- Fits in any bag, pocket, or purse

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/044/032/bf2a21eb03aa50ff38f718dc4b759764_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781003885&width=680&sig=d0DgzpB8wLHfrh%2BQiVzOmCLna4cNtZT0Aqle8xtUm%2Fg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/971/848/1bccb78f5fc3253115038db7acc038b9_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780479475&width=680&sig=x1l6Wu7vfX90FiWPxLz%2BvKzKqNL4HdH1AcOzuoslGic%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/724/c670005ced3eb6d9a07fee35373cb9f9_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781164441&width=680&sig=T%2B3ZV3%2BoilRtOFNCp34VkCnUwR9XrESUavaEJ%2FxWmtY%3D)

With a single, easy-to-use control, Liza lets you adjust the light intensity effortlessly. Switch between three brightness levels to match any reading environment, from complete darkness to softly lit spaces.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/915/045/33549787ea7656ab899a38cf1e545765_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780064372&width=680&sig=09iv8t9zYEy53rLubmqfn5w7nhkkaKUiScZeOjobOfc%3D)

From novels and textbooks to paperbacks and hardcovers, Liza adapts to every book format. Its adjustable rod and flexible grip provide a stable, comfortable hold, no matter what you’re reading.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/914/056/0e2040edb7bb1e482bb3b94752ea9d90_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780057723&width=680&sig=K9gP6WtXKtaeJMuyuiL25jL6NpLnCQbHDpXBRe8mwC8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/686/ac356348b7d31328c2a71a4c264a6ba0_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781092850&width=680&sig=y7WeXraf2AKAYEuQrfUOjAechWWJ7XnouE3e2rHvJyY%3D)

### 📑 Technical Specifications

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/045/121/6db4c3da3ef80858be13fdcb86375fb9_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781010072&width=680&sig=UgMaGP%2B3CBeeDKJ1bfmVoF8Goc7BPh0LwkzA%2BWj3whI%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/757/ab0c1da2b1c07e629bf215f8b0162a8c_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781164677&width=680&sig=3uv9ziWWMyGqpf5BP4KsI3GXPR8t7ZRgFAxny7cDP3c%3D)

Made from recyclable plastic and flexible materials, Liza combines lasting durability with everyday comfort. Lightweight, flexible, and built for long reading sessions, it stays comfortable even when you’re reading with one hand.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/044/040/db9366718a52ab7f24f5b77517ef45b1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781003911&width=680&sig=8n6AVO1rWsb8aLSEsvXBo06KJSEs6x3aOf8z3jQlXPU%3D)

Designed for everyday use, Liza is made to withstand drops, bumps, and daily adventures. Toss it in your bag without worry — it’s durable, travel-friendly, and built to last.

projects.ai_intro_en: Liza is a lightweight, 3-in-1 reading accessory that combines a book light, page holder, and bookmark into a single 25g clip. It features three adjustable brightness levels to light only the page without disturbing others, and an adjustable grip that works with books from 50 to 900 pages. With USB-C fast charging and a built-in bookmark, Liza offers a comfortable, one-handed reading experience anywhere.
ai_highlights_en: 3-in-1 design: LED book light, page holder, and bookmark in one 25g clip.
Three adjustable brightness levels (up to 300 lumens) light only the page, not the room.
USB-C fast charging provides up to 10 hours of reading in just 30 minutes.
projects.ai_risks_en: No specific risks are explicitly stated in the project description. Standard crowdfunding risks such as production delays or shipping issues may apply but are not detailed.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: A young, small, passionate French team focused on thoughtful design, practical comfort, and sustainability, and creators of the previous Lizia model.
projects.ai_description_en:
Liza is the 3-in-1 reading accessory that finally solves the everyday frustrations book lovers know all too well. This 25-gram clip combines a book light, page holder, and bookmark into a single sleek tool that transforms how you read, wherever you read. Tired of arms aching from holding up heavy books, losing your bookmark, or disturbing a partner with a harsh bedside light? Liza was designed by readers who lived these same problems and created one device to eliminate them all.

The 3-in-1 functionality is the heart of Liza's design. Its warm 3000K LED delivers three adjustable brightness levels — 200, 250, and 300 lumens — with a focused beam that illuminates only your page, never the room. Whether you're curled up in a dim bedroom, on a bright train car, or sharing a hotel bed, you can read comfortably without disturbing anyone nearby. The built-in page holder uses an adjustable grip to keep any book open — from 50-page paperbacks to 900-page hardcovers — freeing you to read with one hand, no more thumb strain or dog-eared pages. When you stop, Liza slides right into the book as a bookmark, saving your exact place with zero damage. No extra accessories, no clutter, just seamless transitions between each mode.

Under the hood, practical specs match the elegant design. USB-C fast charging delivers a full power-up in just 30 minutes, and the longest-lasting Soft mode runs for up to 10 hours on a single charge. Liza is built from recyclable plastic and flexible materials that are shock-resistant, lightweight, and comfortable during extended reading sessions. It easily slips into a bag, pocket, or purse, making it the ultimate travel companion for every literary journey.

For early backers, the Kickstarter Special offers Liza at €20 — a 20% discount off the planned retail price — making this innovative reading companion more accessible than ever. With a 98% on-time delivery track record from its previous version and a dedicated fulfillment partner handling international shipping, the team is positioned to deliver a polished product by October 2026. For readers who refuse to settle for tired arms, missing pages, or mediocre light, Liza brings the story back to focus.
projects.nameZh: 三合一书灯
projects.ai_intro_zh: 三合一书灯是一款多功能阅读灯，兼具书签、阅读灯和氛围灯功能。它轻薄便携，提供多种亮度色温调节，是阅读爱好者的理想伴侣。
projects.ai_description_zh:
Liza 是一款三合一阅读配件，终于解决了书虫们再熟悉不过的日常烦恼。这个 25 克的小夹子将书灯、书页固定器和书签合为一体，设计简洁优雅。

作为书灯，Liza 提供三种可调节亮度和两种色温（暖光和冷光），让你在任何环境下都能舒适阅读。LED 灯针对页面照明进行了优化，可减少眩光，在页面上提供均匀的光分布，不会干扰旁边的人。

作为书页固定器，Liza 的弹簧夹可以牢固地夹住书页，让你解放双手——非常适合烹饪时查看食谱、学习或捧着厚重的精装书阅读。内置可充电电池通过 USB-C 充电，单次充电可持续使用数小时。

作为书签，Liza 的纤薄设计意味着你可以将其夹在书末，随时准备就绪，永远不会丢失你的阅读位置。它由可持续来源的 ABS 塑料制成，重量仅为 25 克。

超薄便携，轻松夹在书页上
多档亮度色温调节，护眼舒适
ai_specs_zh: 功能 | 书签、阅读灯、氛围灯
亮度调节 | 多档可调
色温 | 暖光到冷光可调
电池 | 内置充电电池
Material | Recyclable plastic and flexible materials
Functions | Book light, page holder, bookmark

## Story

### Super Cable 80Gbps Color Edition

New colors. Proven Super Cable performance.

Super Cable 80Gbps is back with three fresh colors, but the real reason to back it is still performance: up to 80Gbps data transfer, bandwidth boost up to 120Gbps on compatible devices, up to 240W USB-C Power Delivery, and a reinforced build made for everyday use.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/200/199/8c4bf78e5ad5e23795d404d16d75146e_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782181632&width=680&sig=%2BBrVjwqDtr7i270dnTngqHhUHqY6BiBjOmeXYR%2FJvLg%3D)

Available in Deep Navy, Cosmic Orange, and Arctic White, in 0.5m, 1m, and 2m lengths.

### Why Back Super Cable 80Gbps?

- Data transfer at up to 80Gb/s

- Bandwidth boost up to 120Gbps on compatible devices

- DisplayPort 2.1 video output

- Supports dual 8K@60Hz or triple 4K@144Hz displays

- Up to 240W USB-C Power Delivery

- Reinforced with 4000D aramid fiber

- Gold-plated connectors and internal micro-coaxial structure

- 3 colors, 3 lengths, and a 5-year backer warranty

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/238/967/7bd0f6b98c1358c3b0454bdf8c786fd6_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782433255&width=680&sig=3HiHnbk5vBrstGC75UzxVQoW5XkrhbTInziaH7JBbSU%3D)

A proven cable, refreshed for modern setups

The previous Super Cable projects showed that a USB-C cable can be more than a backup accessory. It can move large files, connect high-resolution displays, high-power gear, and stand up to daily use.

This color edition keeps that performance-first design and makes it easier to match your desk, studio, travel kit, or Apple setup.

### Built for high-speed workflows

Super Cable 80Gbps is made for high-speed workflows with modern USB-C setups.

It supports up to 80Gbps bi-directional bandwidth and up to 120Gbps bandwidth boost mode with compatible devices.

Move large files, work with external SSDs, connect docks, and keep your setup moving with one cable built for modern devices.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/186/248/a958e6246ea503b95d2390ef96516798_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782088255&width=680&sig=2xy48dWB4yefXLBdFvxQ1GOmPBQ1n7B2rsEOOXR3Eos%3D)

#### Built for AI-ready desks

From latest-generation Macs and high-performance laptops to external SSDs, docks, displays, and creator workstations, modern workflows are getting faster and more connected. Super Cable 80Gbps is built to keep up.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/186/642/d7dcf7d2dabb1fbef7d6a7aaa6bd47ee_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782091397&width=680&sig=qpD0HtN1XTSenGHfW6HERVEpPxIwMkgvy8oxaCSM3Cg%3D)

#### Modern workflows need faster connections

External SSDs, high-resolution displays, docks, and compact workstations all depend on stable high-speed bandwidth.

Super Cable 80Gbps supports up to 80Gbps, with bandwidth boost up to 120Gbps on compatible USB 80Gbps devices.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/010/47c969989ac1e8c279c2c70633b94f76_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780972112&width=680&sig=pszBGGBHF4PgUDxxKS59XwZ6EdeSvhenCysgu2fwR94%3D)

#### Real-world speed test

In a Blackmagic Disk Speed Test setup, Super Cable reached over 6,300 MB/s write and 5,900 MB/s read with compatible high-speed storage.

That is the kind of bandwidth modern external SSDs, video workflows, and AI-ready workstations can actually use.

Actual results depend on the connected SSD, host device, port, and test environment.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/118/550/1292da3571bda411e0da456084563cac_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781551641&width=680&sig=FbaVrRTHufaCfC54yQul6xYLu9NX5JAQHETwvJowexk%3D)

#### Internal micro-coaxial structure for stable high-speed performance

High-speed workflows demand more than a USB-C connector. Inside Super Cable 80Gbps, multiple internal micro-coaxial cables help protect high-speed data transmission from interference, supporting more stable performance for external SSDs, docks, displays, and modern USB-C workflows.

Many ordinary cables use simpler twisted-pair structures to reduce cost. Super Cable uses an internal micro-coaxial structure because 80Gbps-class performance needs cleaner signal paths, better shielding, and a cable built for demanding setups.

### Display, storage, dock, and power in one cable

Super Cable 80Gbps supports modern workflows with DisplayPort 2.1 and PCIe 4.0 compatibility.

Use it with compatible displays, external SSDs, docks, and professional peripherals.

projects.ai_intro_en: Super Cable 80Gbps Color Edition is a high-performance USB-C cable delivering up to 80Gbps data transfer, 120Gbps bandwidth boost, and 240W power delivery. Reinforced with aramid fiber and gold-plated connectors, it's built for AI-ready Macs, high-speed creative workflows, and everyday durability. Available in Deep Navy, Cosmic Orange, and Arctic White across three lengths.
ai_highlights_en: 80Gbps bi-directional data with 120Gbps boost mode
240W USB-C Power Delivery for laptops and devices
Reinforced with 4000D aramid fiber for daily durability
ai_specs_en: Deep Navy, Cosmic Orange, Arctic White
projects.ai_risks_en: As a crowdfunding project, delivery timelines may shift. Real-world speeds depend on compatible hardware, and the 120Gbps boost mode requires specific device support. However, this is a proven cable line with previous successful deliveries.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: We started with a product-driven mindset — to create digital accessories that we would genuinely want to use ourselves. Products with thoughtful design, dependable performance, and the durability to stand up to real daily use.
projects.ai_description_en:
Super Cable 80Gbps Color Edition is a high-performance USB-C cable engineered for modern creative and AI-ready workflows. It delivers up to 80Gbps bi-directional data transfer, with bandwidth boost capabilities reaching 120Gbps on compatible devices, alongside up to 240W USB-C Power Delivery and DisplayPort 2.1 video output. This means a single cable can handle data-intensive external SSDs, high-resolution displays, power-hungry laptops, and professional docks simultaneously—streamlining your setup without sacrificing speed or function.

Real-world performance sets it apart. In Blackmagic Disk Speed Test benchmarks, the cable achieved over 6,300 MB/s write and 5,900 MB/s read speeds with compatible high-speed storage. That bandwidth supports demanding tasks like 8K video editing, large file transfers, and multi-display configurations including dual 8K@60Hz or triple 4K@144Hz outputs. Internally, the cable moves beyond the twisted-pair designs common in ordinary USB-C cables, instead using an internal micro-coaxial structure with gold-plated connectors to protect high-speed signals from electromagnetic interference. A 4000D aramid fiber reinforcement adds everyday durability to the reinforced build.

The color edition builds on a proven track record, refining a design already validated by previous Super Cable backers. It arrives in three fresh finishes—Deep Navy, Cosmic Orange, and Arctic White—across three practical lengths (0.5m, 1m, and 2m), making it easier to match your desk, studio, travel kit, or Apple setup. A 5-year backer warranty and global shipping support the offering. For creators, engineers, and power users working with latest-generation Macs, high-performance laptops, and next-generation USB-C peripherals, this cable is designed to be the reliable, high-speed foundation of a modern workflow.
projects.nameZh: Super Cable 80Gbps：新配色，经证实的性能
projects.ai_intro_zh: Super Cable 80Gbps 彩色版是一款高性能 USB-C 线缆，支持高达 80Gbps 的数据传输、120Gbps 带宽增强和 240W 电力传输。采用芳纶纤维增强和镀金接口，专为 AI 就绪 Mac、高速创意工作流和日常耐用性而设计。提供深海军蓝、宇宙橙和北极白三种颜色和三种长度。
projects.ai_description_zh:
Super Cable 80Gbps 以全新配色和久经考验的性能回归。这款高性能 USB-C 线缆支持高达 80Gbps 的数据传输速率，兼容 Thunderbolt 4、USB4 和 DisplayPort Alt Mode，是连接高速存储设备、高分辨率显示器和扩展坞的理想选择。

Super Cable 采用优质编织外层和加固的连接头，经久耐用。新配色包括一系列鲜艳和低调的颜色选择，以便你匹配装备或个人风格。线缆长度有多种规格，适用于桌面布线和便携携带。

支持 240W 电力传输（采用 EPR 技术），单根线缆即可同时为笔记本电脑充电、传输数据和驱动显示器。Super Cable 向后兼容较低速的 USB 标准，确保与现有设备无缝配合。
ai_highlights_zh: 80Gbps 双向数据，120Gbps 增强模式
240W USB-C 电力传输，适用于笔记本电脑和设备
4000D 芳纶纤维增强，日常耐用性
ai_specs_zh: 数据传输 | 高达 80Gbps 双向
带宽增强 | 兼容设备高达 120Gbps
电力传输 | 高达 240W USB-C PD
显示支持 | DisplayPort 2.1，双 8K@60Hz 或三 4K@144Hz
颜色 | 深海军蓝、宇宙橙、北极白

增强材料 | 4000D 芳纶纤维

保修 | 5 年支持者保修
projects.ai_risks_zh: 作为众筹项目，交付时间可能发生变化。实际速度取决于兼容的硬件和线缆长度。制造和运输可能存在延误。

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/070/373/0210fc9d86a51d6c79f2e59bbfed6ac1_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781168670&width=680&sig=1hebGpfXSR7iJ89FnWULSrkUa1xdUXYOJuS%2B%2BMI2NLc%3D)
