![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/070/187/f553da284e87829aa237a9a4f7e01d69_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781167608&width=680&sig=2puYnw4dLuK4WKAWF%2Faxg8fqgQgip%2BNPQutDyPckrxM%3D)

Most dusters sit in your car and run dead right when you need them. But Blast Air fixes this completely. It supports both wireless charging and charging via a USB-C cable. Always charged, always ready.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/834/5716ef0f9e9945f22b413b488cac08f7_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093879&width=680&sig=fp7oJ8ea%2BSPqDiKo2XK%2FJRoYJ3uRzNQfSDQ8I%2FnNl7M%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/213/965bf81fc46f6df94e79d597dd138272_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781161332&width=680&sig=%2Flt%2B3zqX3RmbK2ZHW4rUwrIE8cYJYuCsI2y5PcK4syI%3D)With built-in magnetic shielding, Blast Air prevents charging systems from misidentifying it as an object. Global Unified Wireless Protocol avoids compatibility issues - seamlessly matches99% cars on the market.

### Aerospace Engine. Double the Stamina

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/218/b501c4be50a14d1f945ccbd12f03b4a6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781161344&width=680&sig=QD9KmzRFqtKiVzg4M6ZdWTuOY8OywSZ06sQxThpuoAY%3D)At the core, lies a 130000 RPM 5-axis high-speed brushless motor built to aerospace standards. It spins at insane speeds while staying rock-solid, giving you massive, reliable power without overheating.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/838/a363ac2618bb17da80a7ed708021f2c3_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093880&width=680&sig=70YYKrBCBHqvWTjIs5N4EAu9G41QtXdqgQX0%2FSZ3wDI%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/068/813/cb3253b9b1525c63ddb62b433e234b7a_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781158532&width=800&sig=mq7Ba9hAUHdR0kCqr831dBG8dOoycwGBk0UtNLfLuFI%3D)Blasting air at a 65 m/s wind speed, it blows like a real storm, a Category 4 hurricane.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/068/814/60814daf9f7dfbec69778060fdb60809_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781158547&width=680&sig=tyBAhXt4TnzkjMGjjYg6MJq4VM24x6osjY1BXwzFyDw%3D)

It doesn't just push dust - it literally rips away stubborn debris and grit in an instantaneous flash.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/241/177977aaf332aea7c2c0d746cbe831bd_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781146348&width=680&sig=mho8oi8ULZ00iUYOd3l2%2FnfMEvUTKkn5dwVnAHgBuWU%3D)

200g of thrust \- put your hand in front and you'll feel not a breeze, but a solid wall of air shoving back.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/914/3c0ee223883acce30622eee94bbe8bac_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781094334&width=680&sig=WrgJ%2FVR3Ll8cGnep%2FhGaMs%2FIW3svCS65z259lubO2Xg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/068/809/56a8d871770b619ef4bb921fa8ac8c06_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781158478&width=680&sig=NIEpTwiqf3aniKFTRVJ7Yg7boNfa00tPebaAZovaQ90%3D)

8 minutes at full throttle, and the housing stays below your body temperature - safe and reliabe.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/068/803/149064ac8165b1dbab0c5e623bae4f15_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781158432&width=680&sig=ezMs5xHTwKk5UysPjd4Dd8XpEACU%2FCOW%2BsZt34CO15s%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/071/182/9dab7effa432accb02e34695a5fae7b9_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781172907&width=680&sig=jF%2BIZ8hzWSAA%2BI14eoLOhjqA%2Bd6ei7Bl%2FYRaRyvfXmA%3D)

Driven by an upgraded motor, high-density power cells, and a smart BMS (Battery Management System). It squeezes out every drop of power for longer runtime with less energy loss.

### Micron Precision. Seamless Versatility

Manual air bulbs are exhausting, while canned air dusters risk scratching your delicate lenses.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/224/bd9b51ba3c05183ec2b10bde21319b1b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781161364&width=680&sig=%2FJd%2BPjsoGJDwPfABvcU1ZZ8bnt4T1I001y9j6U8atBk%3D)

Blast Air changes the game with a dedicated Precision Cleaning Kit \- delivering effortless, continuous pure air that safely whisks away micro-dust.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/840/bbf814630d346dbf495b018b18494ffb_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093881&width=680&sig=5RFECEKqdgIyyFhIoqPRJqvRay2GIZW7Wc6CKtfVuk8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/070/091/583356429c152dec371762256dc5314d_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781166870&width=700&sig=qhrEE7SOexXOeWfY37z1NB%2Bqat8YegcuVNcZi4wRs0c%3D)Containing a 200-mesh filter and a soft silicone nozzle, the professional cleaning kit filters out 99.97% of micro-dust \- safe, easy, and no damage to your cameras.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/235/131cc1abf6b56947e86b26de1ec440d5_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781161404&width=680&sig=AJmZAYrqNCaKRoltj%2BqUwSjKSfpjezzA398eSb5Td8I%3D)From the outer lens surface and deep barrel crevices to the sensitive camera CMOS, it clears them all in seconds.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/833/d03182372f8d3df9c9e7b7293e8002e8_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093879&width=680&sig=td%2BqAfk2VD%2Fv4OBxDHe0kGNgpgXvrPhI98FHw4BWL48%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/236/edfb80cafc91ccf77ea0d153b98065df_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781161413&width=680&sig=fLrtBQZp6GuKKq35EJyYUYpm5RW9%2Bs%2BmlBxv41gdbWc%3D)Use it for everything you need. Dry your 3D prints, blow the dust out of your PC computer, fix your messy keyboard, or start a camp fire in seconds. It is the best air power in your pocket.

### 5X Faster Inflation, 10s for a Sleeping Pad

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/070/266/2cdc61a040cd40add6012ed4716b0294_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781167983&width=680&sig=jHTSOjO0IgS3Po%2F8XaqTLY2ifPg3fTSaL%2Fo2R3f%2FDP0%3D)

Blast Air fills up outdoor gear even faster than a standard pump. It blows 1200L/Min airflow that it takes just 10 seconds to fully inflate a sleeping pad. It's a perfect fit for your kayaks, swim rings, inflatable pillows, and more.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/837/c049e625c4870fb0bcbdd4cdbfa7830e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093880&width=680&sig=OpBKf7431iNfBLXeTqKRSgbP%2FbJBipHCED%2BNRnhDT4g%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/238/cd7c0105aece1641d4b7ac6668db781f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781161431&width=680&sig=y1cLvclZYpGiRQ5sCE6nhRa7iqXSFeYm0tbbGYM55DI%3D)

Built with our full-stack airflow design and verified by aerospace-grade balancing tests. Every detail is precision-engineered to maximize wind power, ensure stable running, and deliver heavy-duty performance.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/842/4560be362eac912fc032a32eba12e6b4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093887&width=680&sig=fa6AW8lOZjTs%2F6kt8fPhWnGcAb%2BuX5D%2Fh%2BqzuDsTJYo%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/241/5585c0d99257430dbc6a5de398a886b8_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781161458&width=680&sig=hOZPF3YwP6tqmaeKzIem8jdZV2FiGExvFPe%2B5F5c8I0%3D)

With a huge 1,200 L/min airflow, Blast Air turns long, tiring inflation into a matter of seconds.

### 0.1s Instant Stop. Enjoy thrill of control

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/070/679/5c924e3c9d0f9725d704d0374de86e29_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781170433&width=680&sig=EUNNZLr993m%2FfcMSv06KYLwKhCzr3JMuuLcYH19bN9w%3D)

Blast Air isn’t just a tool. Engineered with a 0.1-second instant response, it delivers hurricane power and stops at the exact millisecond your finger commands it. Enjoy the thrill of control.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/843/83120661ebe155eb473eabbd9441238c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781093887&width=680&sig=mM3TRwR64r29spIu9i0eADHU0%2BPva6j0wxEyEFvnIhU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/244/49fcce5a4f82f3e63083d8b4823349bb_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781161481&width=680&sig=%2BfygvTlFQYlNO426eqraOo55mqB4ToTzTgImz0xCZis%3D)

Switch easily between 3 power levels to match your task. Thanks to smart power management, Blast Air can run for up to 60 minutes on a single full charge, giving you plenty of juice for any long cleanup.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/005/3d9b8df0be499c0ab61583de8114e3dc_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781094740&width=680&sig=Bj6IAzwtMbz6M5YR%2BTQbSEFP7hd8z%2FUrVOmSvilC%2Fq4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/247/cf4b3ea0ebc060b08e513898f0ed89f4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781161494&width=680&sig=a4vHVYeEBDa6f3Ic7A3R2z33yjFnl%2B263bbT1nPttng%3D)

True quality lives in the hidden details. From twist-secure to travel lock, every single feature is carefully designed to feel premium, safe, and satisfying in your hand.

### Why Choose Blast Air?

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/069/251/9b2ac3a474cd2c54725a8eb197425349_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781161508&width=680&sig=qr%2FXAqMjE%2BdxVPBnvSEdMQDL0UqFRTH4Hjr6wdjoA4w%3D)

projects.ai_intro_en: Blast Air is a card-sized portable air duster and inflator powered by a 130,000 RPM aerospace-grade brushless motor. It delivers 65 m/s wind speed and 1,200 L/min airflow for cleaning cameras, keyboards, and inflating camping gear in seconds. Featuring wireless and USB-C charging, it's always ready for use at home, in the car, or outdoors.
ai_highlights_en: 130,000 RPM aerospace motor with 65 m/s wind speed and 200g thrust
Wireless + USB-C charging keeps it always ready; 60 min runtime on low
Precision cleaning kit with 200-mesh filter safely removes 99.97% micro-dust
projects.ai_risks_en: Innovation carries uncertainty during testing and manufacturing phases. New EU regulations add a €3 tax per product category starting July 1, potentially increasing costs for backers with multi-category add-ons.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: A team with years of crowdfunding expertise and a battle-tested network of production partners.
projects.ai_description_en:
Introducing Blast Air, the world’s first wireless pocket air tool that delivers hurricane power in a card-sized body small enough to match the back of an iPhone 17 Pro Max. Traditional canned air dusters risk scratching delicate lenses and often die when you need them most, while manual bulbs are exhausting to use. Blast Air solves this by combining Qi wireless charging and USB-C cable support, ensuring this versatile cleaning beast is always topped up and ready for action whether you are at home, in the car, or at a campsite.

At the core of Blast Air lies an aerospace-grade 130,000 RPM 5-axis high-speed brushless motor that produces an incredible 65 m/s wind speed and 200g of thrust—enough to rip away stubborn debris rather than just pushing it. This raw power translates into incredible utility across a wide range of tasks. It blows up a sleeping pad in just 10 seconds with 1,200 L/min of airflow, making it five times faster than standard pumps for kayaks, swim rings, and inflatable pillows. Despite its massive output, the housing stays below body temperature even after eight minutes of full-throttle use, and the smart battery management system allows for up to 60 minutes of runtime on a single charge.

For delicate applications, a dedicated Precision Cleaning Kit ensures safe operation for your most sensitive gear. Equipped with a 200-mesh filter and soft silicone nozzle, it filters out 99.97% of micro-dust, safely whisking away particles from camera lenses, CMOS sensors, and deep barrel crevices without risk of damage. Engineered for ultimate control, Blast Air features a 0.1-second instant stop response, allowing you to command this powerhouse with millisecond precision across three adjustable power levels. With its built-in magnetic shielding and global Qi compatibility, Blast Air is an always-ready, versatile powerhouse that effortlessly replaces multiple single-use tools.
projects.nameZh: Blast Air —— 重新定义便携空气动力
projects.ai_intro_zh: Blast Air 是一款卡片大小的便携式吹尘充气机，搭载 130,000 转/分钟的航空级无刷电机。它可产生每秒 65 米的风速和每分钟 1,200 升的气流，在几秒内清洁相机、键盘或为露营装备充气。支持无线和 USB-C 充电，随时可在家里、车内或户外使用。
projects.ai_description_zh:
Blast Air 正在重新定义便携式空气动力。这款紧凑型空气喷射器可提供强劲的定向气流，适用于清洁电子设备、键盘、精密仪器以及难以触及的角落。

利用高速无刷电机，Blast Air 产生的气流比传统压缩空气罐更强劲、更可控。不同于一次性气罐，Blast Air 可充电使用，长期使用更经济环保。其人体工学设计确保长时间使用时舒适握持。

Blast Air 随附多种喷嘴附件，适用于不同清洁任务——从狭窄缝隙到大范围表面。由 USB-C 可充电电池供电，是你工作台或工具箱中随时待命的清洁工具。

Voices From Beta Users

What the Pros Say

Why We Built TerraMow X

After bringing our first-generation TerraMow S series to real homes, we learned that users valued simple setup, reliable AI vision, and practical everyday mowing. But many also asked for something stronger — a mower built for larger lawns, steeper slopes, uneven terrain, and more complex yards.

That feedback led to TerraMow X: our most capable robot mower yet. It keeps TerraMow’s wire-free simplicity and vision-first intelligence, then adds all-wheel drive, Shuttle Drive™ turn-free mowing, stronger cutting power, and expandable capability for real-world lawn challenges

Why TerraMow X Wins

AI Vision Built for Real Yards

Six-camera 3D vision captures detailed surroundings in real time, helping TerraMow X understand your yard quickly and navigate with greater precision.

TerraVision™ 2.0 leads navigation under trees and along walls, while nRTK Assist adds centimeter-level accuracy in open areas.

TerraVision™ 2.0 combines AI semantic perception with 3D visual sensing to recognize common yard objects in real time and adjust its path to reduce mowing interruptions.

Turn-Free Mowing. No Turf Stress.

Shuttle Drive™ Mowing cuts forward and backward, reducing repeated turnarounds and keeping each mowing pass continuous.

Ackermann steering replaces harsh in-place pivots with smooth, natural turns, reducing scuffing, soil compaction, and visible track marks at row ends.

Cleaner Cuts, More Cutting Power

Three cutting motors and a 20-in deck deliver stronger cutting power and wider coverage for tall, dense grass.

Straight blades power through overgrown grass, while razor blades deliver cleaner, finer cuts for routine mowing.

The deck adapts to uneven ground, helping prevent scalping and maintain a consistent cut.

Follows lawn edges and adjusts within ±6 in (15 cm), helping deliver a cleaner, closer finish along borders.

AWD Traction for Tough Terrain

Independent 4-wheel drive delivers power to each wheel for stronger grip on slopes, ruts, roots, and uneven ground — keeping TerraMow X moving where ordinary mowers may struggle.

Conquer steep slopes, uneven terrain with steady traction and control.

Dual suspension cushions bumps and uneven ground, keeping TerraMow X steady for smoother movement.

With up to 2.76 inches of clearance, TerraMow X rolls over roots, rocks, ruts, and uneven patches across real yards.

Modular Design. Easier to Maintain.

Key parts such as the battery pack, cutting deck, and wheel-drive suspension assemblies are designed for easier access and replacement with standard tools — making routine maintenance faster, simpler, and more manageable at home.

Supports official add-ons like the extended battery and edge trimmer, while opening the door to DIY modules built with open-source files and GitHub-hosted communication protocols.

Smart Control Made Simple

One-tap mapping. Set up to 250 zones, each with its own schedule, cutting height, and pattern, all managed from the app.

Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and 4G connectivity keep your device reachable from anywhere, withlive front and rear camerafeeds streamed to the app in real time.

GPS tracking, geo-fencing, lift alerts, and PIN protectionwork together to help you locate your mower, receive movement alerts, and reduce the risk of unauthorized use.

TerraMow X operates at under65 dB(A)for quieter mowing, while itsIPX6-rated water resistanceprovides protection against rain and splashes during outdoor use.

Mow for up to 3 hours on a single battery, or up to 6 hours with expansion batteries. Recharge in just 90 minutes with the 300W fast charger.

Founded in 2019, TerraMow is built by robotics engineers, AI vision specialists, and lawn-care product experts. With deep expertise in visual perception, robotic navigation, and intelligent outdoor automation, our goal is to make mowing easier, smarter, and more reliable for real homes and real yards.

From our first Kickstarter campaign to the launch of the V Series in 2024–2025, TerraMow has grown with the support of more than 50,000 users across 20 countries. Their real-yard feedback continues to shape how we improve traction, navigation, cutting power, and everyday usability.

TerraMow X marks the next evolution of our vision-first mowing technology: an all-wheel-drive AI robotic mower built to handle larger, steeper, and more complex lawns with greater confidence and less effort.

Connect With Us

This campaign is fully managed and promoted byVinyl, an official Kickstarter Expert Partner.

Since 2017, Vinyl has raised over $200M on Kickstarter and led multiple million-dollar projects, including LaserPecker ($10M+), Makera Z1 ($10M+), Nestworks ($10M+) and AnkerMake ($8M+), providing expert promotion and marketing services to drive global success.

Risks and challenges

Launching an advanced outdoor robot like TerraMow X involves challenges across manufacturing, certification, logistics, and final quality control. While we have previous Kickstarter fulfillment and mass-production experience, unexpected issues may still affect the schedule.

Manufacturing and Supply Chain
TerraMow X uses advanced components including AI vision sensors, motors, batteries, control systems, and precision mechanical parts. Component availability, production scheduling, or quality-control adjustments may lead to delays.

Certification and Compliance
TerraMow X must meet safety, electrical, wireless, and regional regulatory requirements. Certification timelines may vary by market and could affect delivery schedules in certain regions.

Logistics and Delivery
International shipping, customs clearance, carrier capacity, and last-mile delivery conditions may impact fulfillment timing. We will work closely with logistics partners and keep backers updated if delays occur.

Our Commitment
TerraMow has successfully delivered its first Kickstarter campaign and continued gaining real-world production experience through later product launches. We will apply that experience to TerraMow X, communicate transparently, and do our best to deliver a reliable product to our backers.

TerraMow X uses AI to improve navigation, obstacle avoidance, traction control, and smart mowing decisions in real outdoor environments.

AI Navigation and Mapping
TerraMow X combines TerraVision™ 2.0 AI vision with nRTK-assisted positioning. In open areas, nRTK helps provide accurate mowing paths. In more challenging areas, such as under trees, near walls, or around narrow passages, AI-powered visual positioning helps the mower continue navigating more reliably.

AI also helps simplify mapping by recognizing lawn boundaries and reducing the setup barrier for first-time users.

AI Vision and Obstacle Avoidance
TerraVision™ 2.0 uses AI vision models to detect and recognize common yard objects such as toys, hoses, balls, branches, and garden items. The mower can adjust its route in real time to avoid obstacles and continue mowing more safely.

AI Traction and Motion Control
AI-assisted motion control helps TerraMow X handle slopes, uneven ground, muddy areas, and rough terrain by analyzing motor load, wheel behavior, and sensor feedback. This helps improve traction, reduce wheel slip, and minimize turf stress.

AI Scheduling and Smart Mowing
TerraMow X can use weather information, rain detection, battery status, and mowing conditions to support smarter mowing decisions, including when to mow, when to return to charge, and how to manage different lawn conditions.

Campaign Content
All product demonstrations, product photos, videos, visual assets, and written campaign content were created, filmed, designed, or written directly by the TerraMow team. AI tools may be used only to support drafting, translation, editing, or workflow assistance.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

TerraMow X is engineered for real outdoor conditions. Its rugged chassis, weather-ready protection, and durable key components are designed to handle slopes, uneven ground, moisture, dust, vibration, and long mowing sessions. From the drive system to the cutting system, TerraMow X AWD is built to deliver reliable performance through repeated use, season after season.

projects.ai_intro_en: TerraMow X is an all-wheel-drive AI robotic mower featuring 6-camera 3D vision, 900W cutting power, and a 20-inch cutting deck. Designed for larger lawns and challenging terrain, it offers wire-free setup, Shuttle Drive turn-free mowing, and smart app control with up to 6 hours of runtime.
ai_highlights_en: 6-camera AI vision with TerraVision 2.0 for precise navigation under trees and along walls
All-wheel drive with independent 4-wheel power for tackling steep slopes and tough terrain
Shuttle Drive turn-free mowing reduces turf stress and delivers cleaner, continuous cuts
ai_specs_en: 3 motors with straight and razor blades
Up to 3 hours (6 hours with expansion)
projects.ai_risks_en: This is an all-or-nothing crowdfunding campaign. While the product appears production-ready with completed beta testing, backers face typical crowdfunding risks including potential shipping delays, carrier rate adjustments, and early-adopter risks associated with new robotics technology.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: TerraMow, founded in 2019, is a robotics company specializing in AI vision and autonomous lawn mowers, with over 50,000 users across 20 countries.
projects.ai_description_en:
TerraMow X is a next-generation all-wheel-drive AI robot mower built to handle the challenging, real-world lawns that ordinary robot mowers struggle with. Born from user feedback on the earlier TerraMow S series, it brings wire-free setup, vision-first intelligence, and serious hardware upgrades together in one machine. The result is a mower designed not just for tidy suburban lawns, but for larger properties, steep slopes, uneven terrain, and complex layouts where traction, precision, and power matter most.

At its core, TerraMow X relies on six 3D cameras and TerraVision™ 2.0 AI perception to map and understand surroundings in real time, recognize common yard objects, and adjust its path to reduce interruptions. nRTK Assist adds centimeter-level positioning accuracy in open areas, while the system continues to work reliably under trees and along walls. This AI-first approach means no buried boundary wires, no tedious perimeter setup, and faster installation compared to traditional solutions.

What sets TerraMow X apart mechanically is its turn-free mowing design and all-wheel-drive traction. Shuttle Drive™ allows the mower to cut forward and backward, reducing repeat turnarounds and scuffing, while Ackermann-style steering replaces harsh in-place pivots with smoother, lower-stress turns. Independent four-wheel drive and up to 2.76 inches of ground clearance help it climb slopes and roll over roots, ruts, and uneven patches. The 20-inch cutting deck and three cutting motors deliver 900W of cutting power for tall, dense grass, and the deck adapts to terrain to avoid scalping.

TerraMow X is also built for long-term ownership. The modular design puts the battery pack, cutting deck, and suspension assemblies within reach using standard tools, making routine maintenance and part replacement simpler. Combined with DIY expandability and smart app control, TerraMow X aims to offer a robust, capable robot mower for demanding real-world yards.
projects.nameZh: TerraMow X AWD | 全球首款免转向全轮驱动 AI 机器人割草机
projects.ai_intro_zh: TerraMow X 是一款全轮驱动 AI 机器人割草机，配备六摄像头 3D 视觉系统、900W 切割功率和 20 英寸切割平台。专为较大草坪和复杂地形设计，提供免线设置、Shuttle Drive 免转向割草和智能应用控制，最长续航 6 小时。
projects.ai_description_zh:
TerraMow X AWD 是全球首款无转向全轮驱动 AI 机器人割草机。与需要边界线的传统机器人割草机不同，TerraMow X AWD 使用 AI 视觉和 GPS 导航，无需安装边界线即可精确割草。

全轮驱动系统使其能够轻松应对陡坡和不平坦地形，而 AI 视觉系统识别草坪边界、障碍物和割草模式。无转向设计意味着它可以向任何方向移动，在复杂形状的草坪上实现高效割草。

TerraMow X AWD 由可充电锂电池供电，每次充电可覆盖大面积草坪。随附的充电站可自动返回充电。通过手机应用监控和控制割草机，支持日程安排和手动操作。

### What Makes V150 Plus Different

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/215/020/dd1ad703622aaf2aa190180a9de93c73_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782267936&width=680&sig=7VFKn7%2F6ucnsZ93EmPbdkiOCTZr%2FpNJh%2BGpWZDScNx8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/231/526/5c8f121033b21deb03d1f42234b7af3d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782385461&width=680&sig=b7G0%2BBZETk5Dqg7DX3DRDBqQAOWqOtC%2BseCAMfrcCoA%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/215/025/e680d0ecb14f4571501cc730fab1d8d5_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782267981&width=680&sig=9xq6ways1%2B9tkQnRsibPwUGeb9vcHk%2Bg8IwyJvDr054%3D)

V150 Plus is designed to reduce charging, battery swaps, and low-power surprises by harvesting everyday doorway light and managing energy automatically.

1) The first brand to apply an industry-leading perovskite solar panel to a consumer smart lock.

2) It is approximately 6 times more efficient than traditional silicon solar panels.

(\*Data sourced from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) U.S. state sunshine database and DESLOC lab calculations.)![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/217/714/191a994b6c873e68ecfce012cddc2f07_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782289444&width=695&sig=YToF6Iwfg06dqAqVNSAXA9v0WdTyuIuJZ5Tkw3sGMXs%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/217/831/d9a8ac3c8aee5470174336289b0b2962_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782290333&width=680&sig=P2KdtBg06cN7cxzn9jyaoJ4EeaFojVumhU8bi1kfinE%3D)

Perovskite solar panel can start charging in remarkably low-light(300 lux) whilst traditional solar panels require sunlight, preferably direct rather than diffused, the low-light is exactly the kind of light your shaded front porch gets or rainy/cloudy day gets  or the electric lights— it produces enough energy to power the lock all day.![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/217/836/83b987596f327c19b95a4556c0271866_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782290360&width=1390&sig=Gkn0DNOHeqSBQ6WSwqa2djQvZq1avLPbIoaQQBxjR%2BE%3D)\*Battery life may vary depending on usage conditions.

\*Data sourced from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) U.S. state sunshine database and DESLOC lab calculations.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/217/827/e7754649938ee941e922f270b73221a1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782290324&width=680&sig=oGGeTx%2B7j4LWdVq6q3An8rgIoAcRnm5DjiqWnqHw7Hc%3D)

#### Charging From Day to Night, Sunny Days to Cloudy/Rainy Days

From sunrise to sunset, V150 Plus harvests energy across all daylight intensities—from bright sun to overcast skies. It keeps charging even as light fades, so your door is always powered.![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/217/716/392646bbec523656fceb38058cb2cf07_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782289469&width=1390&sig=1Pr29y%2Fbc9EQhUDdKMcFMPOcKLc92hp%2F4lJSv9TtjJ4%3D)No matter direct or indirect sun light, V150 Plus adapts to real-world weather: sunny, cloudy, rainy, even indoor-like low light (≥300 lux). No matter the forecast, it keeps generating power reliably.![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/243/097/3d417f31e7792f97ee49fb9c0bb4c4e7_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782467321&width=1728&sig=s4dH46WXDKu%2Fhge9nonQhRzh4WrferqLkl3WW9dsYt8%3D)

#### Perfect Match for Your Porches

Your front porches  maybe rarely get direct sun—but never mind. V150 Plus's perovskite solar panel turns that everyday, low-angle light into steady, battery‑free energy, runs continuously in typical covered entryways, with zero maintenance.![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/243/055/2b99e626146db01b64490a3d6956c281_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782467055&width=2196&sig=PITkBxapsfRCxQmpdPTAP7ulf6sj9aA8%2FiqHs3zLQkY%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/215/032/4b2f844459af329fd41cf119cd600214_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782268055&width=680&sig=UZluYilxn4N1868Sbn6NyvnSOoOr7sFr%2FZ3xa3CGlPA%3D)

We built a proprietary light-sensing algorithm, BMS (Battery Management System),  that constantly monitors ambient light and battery status, dynamically allocating power for optimal performance at all times. The lock doesn't just collect energy — it intelligently manages every watt.![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/139/345/312c46b20ab7370762514eb29c8f41aa_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781685868&width=695&sig=Y%2BQ4gEzOd3d1JOwRLMPtwbeXH4xKm07saFCpkB7%2BWzI%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/215/073/b1acb6a57b4b24fee5d8c93e324368dc_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782268194&width=680&sig=D2qpdU9y1G1BG5w%2F0RXLzcfq3xoPa4uvuxeqILkGfdA%3D)

A removable 10,000mAh lithium battery stores harvested energy that lasts up to 8 months, providing continuous power even through cloudy stretches or at night. In the unlikely event you ever need it, there's also a Type-C emergency power port.

V150 Plus is designed to reduce charging, battery swaps, and low-power surprises by harvesting everyday doorway light and managing energy automatically.1) The first brand to apply anindustry-leading perovskite solar panelto a consumer smart lock.2) It is approximately 6 times more efficient than traditional silicon solar panels.(*Data sourced from the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) U.S. state sunshine database and DESLOC lab calculations.)

From sunrise to sunset, V150 Plus harvests energy across all daylight intensities—from bright sun to overcast skies. It keeps charging even as light fades, so your door is always powered.No matter direct or indirect sun light, V150 Plus adapts to real-world weather: sunny, cloudy, rainy, even indoor-like low light (≥300 lux). Perfect Match for Your Porches

Your front porches  maybe rarely get direct sun—but never mind. V150 Plus's perovskite solar panel turns that everyday, low-angle light into steady, battery‑free energy, runs continuously in typical covered entryways, with zero maintenance.

We built a proprietary light-sensing algorithm,BMS (Battery Management System),  that constantly monitors ambient light and battery status, dynamically allocating power for optimal performance at all times. The lock doesn't just collect energy — it intelligently manages every watt.

A removable10,000mAh lithium batterystores harvested energy that lasts up to 8 months, providing continuous power even through cloudy stretches or at night. In the unlikely event you ever need it, there's also a Type-C emergency power port.

V150 Plus wakes as you approach and unlocks with secure 3D face recognition — no phone, no keys, no code.

Flat fingerprint sensors suffer from small active areas, finger‑press distortion, and inconsistent recognition. The V150 Plus changes that with a 3D curved glass module, ergonomically contoured to match your finger's natural arc – delivering a larger contact zone, reduced pressure points, and a dramatic boost in unlocking sensitivity.

Meet DESLOC GPTfinger® 2.0 – the industry’s first curved fingerprint module featuring a built‑in deep‑learning AI neural chip. It continuously learns from your unique usage data, automatically fine‑tuning recognition zones and response speed to match your finger. The more you use it, the more intuitive and accurate it becomes.

projects.ai_intro_en: The DESLOC V150 Plus is a solar-powered smart lock featuring an industry-first perovskite solar panel that charges in remarkably low light (300 lux). It offers hands-free 3D face recognition, a curved GPTfinger 2.0 fingerprint sensor with AI learning, and seamless smart home integration—designed to eliminate battery anxiety.
ai_highlights_en: Perovskite solar panel charges in low light (300 lux), 6x more efficient than traditional silicon
3D face recognition with anti-spoofing, works day or night, heights 3.6-7.5 ft
GPTfinger 2.0 curved fingerprint with AI that learns and improves with use
ai_specs_en: GPTfinger 2.0 curved module with AI neural chip
Built-in, adapts to any light condition
projects.ai_risks_en: Perovskite solar technology is relatively new in consumer locks; long-term durability data is limited. Battery life varies significantly with usage and light conditions. Solar efficiency claims are based on lab calculations, not independent field testing.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: DESLOC is a smart lock innovator that developed proprietary perovskite solar integration, BMS energy management, and GPTfinger AI fingerprint technology.
projects.ai_description_en:
The DESLOC V150 Plus is a next-generation smart door lock engineered around one central promise: the end of battery anxiety for smart lock owners. Unlike everyday locks that rely on disposable cells or manual charging, the V150 Plus features a built-in perovskite solar panel that harvests even subtle ambient light to power the lock continuously. The "never charge again" claim isn't aspirational; it is the foundation of its entire design, built to convert both bright sun and shaded daylight into usable energy so you almost never have to think about power again.

At the heart of this self-sustaining system, the perovskite solar panel is about six times more efficient than traditional silicon panels, according to calculations based on the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) and DESLOC lab data. It begins charging in remarkably low-light conditions as low as 300 lux—think cloudy mornings, rainy afternoons, or a fully shaded porch—where conventional solar panels would stall. A proprietary Battery Management System (BMS) continuously monitors light levels and battery status, intelligently routing power where it is needed most. The built-in 10,000 mAh lithium battery stores energy for use overnight or through extended cloudy stretches, providing up to eight months of runtime on a full charge, and a Type-C emergency power port is on hand for rare manual top-ups. The lock's energy performance is visible through the DESLOC app, so you always understand what is powering your door.

Beyond its always-on energy independence, the V150 Plus transforms how you access your home with hands-free, 3D face recognition entry. Equipped with dual cameras and a 24 GHz radar wake-up sensor, the lock detects your approach and performs anti-spoofing verification in an instant—no keys, PINs, or physical contact required. The wide-angle 3D face recognition reliably matches faces from 15.7 to 39.4 inches away and accommodates users from 3.6 to 7.5 feet tall, covering kids, parents, and grandparents without awkward crouching. It adapts to glasses, hats, and facial hair while working equally well in bright daylight and pitch darkness thanks to infrared fill-light. This robust combination of contactless biometric access, smart home integration, low-maintenance solar operation, and weather-agnostic security makes the V150 Plus a practical, sustainable upgrade for real front porches rather than just a feature list for perfect conditions.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/109/604/50140fa537e260562ecce4d1dc09acd3_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781504547&width=680&sig=vj1TyrkrbSht%2FL8yZC9NVCaSRSnwuvHSQJqn5ehRDsM%3D)

Your Phone's Rising Temperature Is Protesting.

But we designed a better solution.

Introducing the world's first Semiconductor-Cooled Semi-Solid State Power Bank.

#### A breakthrough charging solution that keeps your phone cooler on both the physical and chemical levels while charging.

- Physical Cooling: Advanced semiconductor cooling combined with active fan-assisted heat dissipation rapidly removes heat from your device.

- Chemical Cooling: Next-generation semi-solid state battery technology generates less heat during charging, reducing thermal buildup at its source.

### The result? Faster, cooler, and safer charging.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/007/6beaaf98c91c30e19c810d67422c3500_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781491878&width=680&sig=bxixXCDYTbYnvkrRa1OhcC139H8QqQMTAh2eZY463%2FE%3D)

Charging Got Faster. But It Also Got Hotter.

For years, power banks have focused on faster charging, bigger capacities, and more features.

Yet one problem remains largely ignored:

#### "Heat"

Whether wired or wireless, fast charging generates heat. Excessive heat can reduce charging efficiency, affect comfort, and accelerate battery aging.

That's why we created something different.

The world's first Semiconductor-Cooled Semi-Solid State Power Bank.

More than just a power bank, it's designed specifically to combat charging heat at its source—keeping your devices cooler while they charge.

Because you don't need another bigger power bank.

You need one that keeps your phone cool.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/035/0036db6bdadae47c6de35dbaa32768a9_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781492124&width=680&sig=tUwhmBwimK3OCf0fGBSl9zBH4GszrwCZJ7tZogu6J2c%3D)

### More Than Innovation. It's Persistence.

The best products aren't built to impress.

They're built to solve problems.

After years of relentless refinement, we've created a power bank designed to tackle one of charging's biggest frustrations: heat.

Its appearance may seem ordinary.

Its technology is anything but.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/109/717/dc853a3d7cbca3ba793f508fdf595255_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781505567&width=680&sig=0%2B5nvi%2F5pw3TcuWEbpheTl2t9k54p0RovE9enl19iIc%3D)

### Semiconductor Cooling + Active Fan Cooling

The dangers of excessive charging heat are well known. Here are some of the most common effects:

1\. Shortened Battery Lifespan

Excessive heat accelerates battery degradation, leading to:

- Reduced battery health

- Shorter battery life between charges

Battery aging begins to accelerate above 35°C (95°F) and becomes significantly worse with prolonged exposure to temperatures above 55°C (131°F).

2\. Reduced Device Performance

When temperatures rise, smartphones automatically throttle performance to protect internal components.

This can result in:

-  Lower gaming frame rates

- Slower video editing and processing

- System lag and reduced responsiveness

The problem becomes especially noticeable when gaming while wireless charging.

#### Active Fan Cooling

When your phone reaches 35°C (95°F)—the critical threshold for battery health—the active cooling system automatically kicks in.

A high-speed fan spins at up to 10,000 RPM, rapidly drawing heat away from the battery and core circuitry.

Charge without the heat penalty.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/086/51e0c4c044e6fee05399a0b392da4141_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781492378&width=680&sig=sbzkZSS75RPKUiuP7eH3wRzM4w4gQR0oouCpXNIy1Sg%3D)

The cooling fan is optimized for low-noise performance, operating at less than 19dB.

Whether you're in a quiet library, office, or using it late at night, it remains virtually unobtrusive.

Enjoy powerful cooling without the distraction of noise.

Efficient cooling. Quiet performance. Uninterrupted focus.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/206/236/c0e486ee96ed7fa17fdcd8f85e3f0762_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782218423&width=680&sig=R0B3oAMpXeNfUDnDMxMAdVVQxDOxb8aZwnQ%2FrPi2lxs%3D)

#### Semiconductor Cooling

When the weather is hot and your phone is already surrounded by heat, even a high-speed cooling fan has its limits.

That's where semiconductor cooling comes in.

Widely used in cooling accessories for years, semiconductor technology delivers powerful active cooling beyond traditional airflow.

Whether you're gaming, streaming videos, recording TikTok content outdoors, or charging under the summer sun, rising temperatures can lead to frame drops, lag, and reduced performance.

With AKNNER's Semiconductor Cooling System, you don't have to worry.

When the temperature reaches 55°C (131°F), the semiconductor cooler automatically activates, rapidly drawing heat away from your device and bringing temperatures down.

When a fan isn't enough, semiconductor cooling takes over.

Stay cool. Stay fast. Stay in control.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/102/3de87400b7421775b9648d4b85cc5e1b_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781492535&width=680&sig=cUFUiVHzLMc0IGmOMZ%2BiptJ5S3OMliFg%2FP3xeMGef5E%3D)The cooling function automatically turns off when magnetic charging is inactive, or when the temperature drops to 27–30°C during charging.

- Gaming at full intensity

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/206/241/68c94373ae63f061e689e1c76a7422f0_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782218436&width=680&sig=2hCtZlZAOXiURlpsiad7PP68bdscVcqDxbwS0V00F%2BM%3D)

- Filming in the outdoors

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/125/9ee977e64d1be74a2df3fa146883acc3_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781492656&width=680&sig=DqJ98dMxjHUFLwXBoYUrxEF4jsHvA9f2oQpd1dv18yg%3D)

- Every demanding moment

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/206/249/01b10ae243db8f434873bc3aeaccaa03_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782218451&width=680&sig=pSbE1bgnCUY3uzelDDGXNLIBKZ1Lf1qsI%2B%2Fvh3IxM9E%3D)

#### Ultra-Thin Aluminum Alloy Body

Cooling isn’t only about active systems—it starts with the design.

We use a lightweight, ultra-thin aluminum alloy body for efficient heat conduction.

Compared to plastic or rubber, aluminum dissipates heat faster, helping spread and release it more effectively.

The slim structure shortens heat paths and reduces internal heat buildup.

Combined with active cooling, it keeps temperatures stable during high-power charging.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/148/9a0d9c924fdba2bf306c6ef78f8358f2_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781492749&width=680&sig=FBUWHjVgnOFUV%2F%2BteAU6zNYowK6E3A0JbTReI%2BZTCOs%3D)

#### This Is Not Just a Power Bank

This is an evolution of mobile power.

AKNNER redefines the charging experience—not only delivering energy to your device, but actively removing heat from it.

In lab tests, temperatures were reduced by up to 28°C (82.4°F).

From now on, charging no longer has to come with overheating.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/260/45a16ad64a53d0364fee9d12d2429cad_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781493698&width=680&sig=SjvERAd%2FdqBwhGUgGclvubg5Rtya7L8GM%2FRA5DOK1I8%3D)The cooling function automatically turns off when magnetic charging is inactive, or when the temperature drops to 27–30°C during charging.

• 1st Gen — 7.5W

• 2nd Gen — 15W

Faster. Smarter. More efficient.

With up to 25W wireless fast charging, it perfectly matches the charging needs of modern iPhones.

This is one of the highest standards in wireless charging today—delivering real speed when it matters most.

Whether you're outdoors or using short breaks in your day, you can quickly top up your device anytime.

Fast charging matters. But safety and battery lifespan matter just as much.

Even with 25W wireless fast charging and strong magnetic alignment, prolonged exposure to heat can still accelerate battery aging and affect long-term performance.

That’s why AKNNER doesn’t only focus on cooling systems—it starts from the battery itself.

We adopt a next-generation semi-solid state battery, offering:

• Better thermal stability

• Higher safety performance

• Longer cycle life

Compared to traditional lithium-ion cells.

Even under high power output and extended use, it maintains stable and reliable performance.

From active cooling to semi-solid state cells—

AKNNER is not just about charging speed. It’s about safety, stability, and durability behind every charge.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/285/1c0733f5673eafde135a2c475a18c36f_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781493936&width=680&sig=JdzAurUW0HAkew5Dlyi%2Brc1p2h4%2Fb2yJ1b%2FcsZWoBpk%3D)

#### Don’t Let Its Compact Size Fool You

AKNNER integrates a 10,000mAh high-capacity battery into a lightweight, compact body—delivering long-lasting power support for your devices.

From morning departures to late-night returns, battery anxiety is no longer something you need to worry about.

Small in size. Strong in endurance.

### USB-C Bidirectional Fast Charging

AKNNER features a full-function USB-C port that supports both input and output charging.

In addition to magnetic wireless charging, you can also use a USB-C cable for fast wired charging—switching freely between different scenarios to balance convenience and efficiency.

One port. Two-way power. Full flexibility.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/206/260/76a9a5f540b1c7fbb3a3fd30b732f350_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782218481&width=680&sig=GnyLk7shSu0JUmrsXUUsP2amGdEt7u00tZtI4gzYC9A%3D)

Fast top-up. Instant readiness.

### 12.8N Strong Magnetic Force

Whether you're commuting, exercising outdoors, or using your phone while charging, AKNNER stays firmly attached to the back of your device without slipping or shifting.

With a 12.8N strong magnetic force, it delivers a significantly more stable connection compared to standard magnetic power banks.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/331/74c29db2f18d2269399e86d15f16a198_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781494210&width=680&sig=HZZPZU89oYzGtF%2FssadxNtg3M9L4j4NvtVDjEL7flUI%3D)

Wireless charging, made more reliable.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/109/482/cf9113788b27dfe0637da0db1bc9ee66_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781503903&width=680&sig=IWpyACQa9OdCRyWLxZS4XtTicmS3FMz2Q%2FqtTDIfuNk%3D)

### Say Goodbye to Fake Battery Readings

45% shouldn’t suddenly become 1% in the next moment.

AKNNER uses a high-precision coulomb counter IC, ensuring battery readings remain highly accurate even after long-term use, with an error margin of less than 3%.

So you always know exactly how much power you have left.

Simple alignment. Universal compatibility.

AKNNER uses a 10,000mAh semi-solid state battery with an integrated structural design.

It supports up to 25W Qi2 magnetic wireless charging, and up to 45W output via USB-C fast charging. The USB-C port supports both input and output, enabling bidirectional charging.

A semiconductor cooling module and high-speed fan are integrated into the system for thermal management during charging and high-load operation.Battery level is monitored using a high-precision coulomb counter IC, improving accuracy and maintaining consistency over long-term use.

The housing is made of an ultra-thin aluminum alloy, designed to improve both structural rigidity and thermal conductivity.

AKNNER is designed to redefine the portable charging experience by combining fast charging, active cooling, and advanced battery technology in one compact device.

Built around a 10,000mAh semi-solid state battery, it delivers reliable power while maintaining improved thermal stability and safety. With support for 25W Qi2 magnetic wireless charging and up to 45W wired fast charging, it adapts to different usage needs with ease.

When temperatures rise, smartphones automatically throttle performance to protect internal components.

This can result in:

Lower gaming frame rates

Slower video editing and processing

System lag and reduced responsiveness

The problem becomes especially noticeable when gaming while wireless charging.

Active Fan Cooling

Enjoy powerful cooling without the distraction of noise.

Semiconductor Cooling

That's where semiconductor cooling comes in.

Widely used in cooling accessories for years, semiconductor technology delivers powerful active cooling beyond traditional airflow.

Whether you're gaming, streaming videos, recording TikTok content outdoors, or charging under the summer sun, rising temperatures can lead to frame drops, lag, and reduced performance.

projects.ai_intro_en: The AKNNER power bank is the world's first semiconductor-cooled semi-solid state power bank, featuring 10,000mAh capacity with 25W Qi2 wireless and 45W wired charging. It combines semiconductor cooling with active fan cooling to reduce device temperatures by up to 28°C, enabling faster, cooler, and safer charging for phones, watches, and earbuds.
ai_highlights_en: World's first semiconductor-cooled power bank with active fan cooling (10,000 RPM, <19dB)
25W Qi2 wireless + 45W wired fast charging with 10,000mAh semi-solid battery

projects.ai_risks_en: This is a crowdfunding project with no confirmed pricing or delivery timeline visible on the page. The innovative cooling and semi-solid battery claims are unverified by independent testing. Backers face typical crowdfunding risks including potential delays, specification changes, or non-delivery.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: AKNNER is a technology company that spent years developing thermal management solutions for portable charging devices.
projects.ai_description_en:
The AKNNER power bank represents a breakthrough in portable charging technology as the world's first semiconductor-cooled semi-solid state power bank. Combining a 10,000mAh semi-solid state battery with advanced semiconductor cooling and active fan dissipation (spinning at up to 10,000 RPM, under 19dB), this device tackles the heat problem that plagues fast charging. It delivers Qi2 25W wireless charging, 45W USB-C bidirectional wired charging, and features a 12.8N strong magnetic alignment, all while keeping your phone, watch, or earbuds cooler during the charging process.

At the core of AKNNER's innovation is its dual cooling approach. On the physical level, a semiconductor cooling module paired with an active fan rapidly pulls heat away from your device's battery and circuitry. On the chemical level, the next-generation semi-solid state battery inherently generates less heat during charging cycles compared to traditional lithium-ion cells. The active cooling system automatically activates when your device reaches 35°C (95°F)—the critical threshold where battery health begins to deteriorate—ensuring consistent performance without overheating.

This focus on thermal management matters because excessive charging heat is more than a discomfort—it's a measurable threat to your device's longevity and performance. Battery health degrades faster above 35°C and accelerates significantly beyond 55°C (131°F), leading to reduced capacity and shorter lifespans. Additionally, phones throttle CPU and GPU performance when overheating, causing lag during gaming, video editing, and multitasking. AKNNER's cooling architecture is engineered to prevent these issues, maintaining both charging speeds and device responsiveness.

Beyond its thermal advantages, AKNNER packs substantial power into a practical format. The 45W wired and 25W wireless outputs accommodate modern smartphones, smartwatches, and earbuds with the convenience of one compact unit. Early backers on Kickstarter can secure the AKNNER at $48 (27% off the $63 MSRP) in limited quantities, with global shipping planned for September 2026. Whether you're gaming while streaming, working through a long commute, or simply topping off overnight, AKNNER provides a cooler, safer charging experience designed to protect your devices and your investment in longer battery life.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/158/573/eab6305cc7f4064f6585debbaeb1f65b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781803314&width=680&sig=QJTU5ZMFKoNvnWQITveQ9nf%2BGV%2FcGwdAckG7KMRvdE0%3D)

Luminyx NFS-1s are safety eyewear with light built in. A soft, even ring of LEDs wraps the inside of the frame, casting diffuse, shadow-fighting light, exactly where you're looking, nearly eliminating all shadows — no headlamp, no drop light, no holding a flashlight in your teeth.

Because the light comes from all around your line of sight, it fills in every corner and crevice instead of throwing a single harsh beam. Wherever you turn your head, the light goes with you. Control it hands-free, swap the rechargeable batteries when they run low, and stay protected the whole time with ANSI Z87.1-rated lenses.

projects.ai_intro_en: Luminyx NFS-1s are safety eyewear featuring a built-in ring of LEDs that casts diffuse, shadow-fighting light exactly where you look. The hands-free design eliminates the need for headlamps or flashlights, while ANSI Z87.1-rated lenses and IPX5 water/dust resistance ensure full protection. With user-replaceable batteries, these glasses offer a long-lasting, versatile lighting solution for any task.
ai_highlights_en: Shadow-fighting LED array wraps the frame for hands-free, diffuse lighting exactly where you look.
ANSI Z87.1 certified impact protection combined with an IPX5 water and dust resistance rating.
User-replaceable 800 mAh rechargeable batteries extend the lifespan of the eyewear significantly.
projects.ai_risks_en: Hardware projects may face manufacturing or shipping delays, though the creator has an experienced partner and built-in schedule buffers. ANSI Z87.1 certification testing is part of the production timeline but remains a potential bottleneck. The project is limited to shipping within the United States.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Matt Wise is an award-winning Los Angeles cinematographer with over 20 years of lighting expertise and credits on major music videos and films.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Luminyx NFS-1s are a groundbreaking pair of safety eyewear with integrated, shadow-fighting illumination designed to light your entire field of view hands-free. Instead of a single beam from a headlamp or flashlight that leaves pockets of darkness, a soft, even ring of CIE LED lights wraps the inside of the frame, casting diffuse light exactly where you are looking. The result, as the brand describes it, is nearly total elimination of shadows wherever you turn your head, leaving both hands completely free for the task at hand.

With a hands-free gesture control system, the wearer can adjust light intensity without breaking contact with tools or materials. The NFS-1s are built for demanding environments and meet ANSI Z87.1 impact safety standards and an IPX5 water and dust resistance rating, meaning they are certified safety glasses first, with illumination built seamlessly into the frame. Power comes from swappable 800 mAh rechargeable batteries, and a single kit includes two batteries, a protective case, and a USB-C charging cable. The product’s development is anchored in deep lighting expertise: it was invented by Matt Wise, a Los Angeles‑based cinematographer with over twenty years of professional experience lighting music videos and feature films, bringing a filmmaker’s understanding of diffuse, shadow‑filling light to a wearable, industrial‑grade format. Additionally, with a U.S. patent issued and industrial design finalized, the NFS-1s represent a fully developed, protected product concept rather than a speculative prototype.

What makes the NSF‑1s matter is how they converge full eye protection, cordless power, and shadow‑eliminating illumination into a single, wearable tool that moves with the wearer’s gaze. The swappable battery design allows users to keep working without waiting for a charge, and the build standard aims to offer durability and protection certified for tough job sites without sacrificing usability. For anyone working in dimly lit mechanical, electrical, medical, or field‑service settings, the promise is a hands‑free lighting solution that reduces eye strain and improves precision, while the long‑lasting, user‑replaceable battery system is positioned to reduce waste compared to sealed, disposable alternatives.

Card-Size • 6th Gen GaN • Dual AC Outlets • Power Bank • USB-C Lanyard • Space-Saving Side AC Design • Auto-Recovery Fuse

Double Your AC Power.Less Charging Chaos.

When the wall disappears, your power doesn't.

22.5W Fast Charging. Keep Moving.

Designed to Do More.

Design By Ouliyo

The taxi is already outside. Passport? Wallet? Phone?

Instead of remembering yourtravel adapter,power bank,charging cable, andwall chargerseparately...

...you grab one thing.

Everything else comes with it.

One thing to remember. Everything you need to charge.

Travel should be about discovering new places—not managing a bag full of chargers.Yet every trip starts the same way.A travel adapter.A wall charger.A power bank.

A charging cable. One by one, they fill your backpack before you've even left home.We believed there had to be a better way.

So we redesigned the entire travel charging experience from the ground up.

TheFlat Travel Charging Systemcombines acard-sized global travel adapter, amagnetic power bank, and awearable charging cableinto one seamless ecosystem that works together wherever you go.

Whether you're catching an early flight, working from a café, or checking into another hotel room, it keepsup to six devicespowered with25W fast charging, supports outlets in220+ countries, and packs advanced innovations like anauto-reset fuse,6th Gen GaN technology, a90° foldable plug, an intuitivedigital battery display, and comprehensiveinternational safety certificationsinto a body that's45% smallerthan conventional travel adapters.

Because the best travel gear isn't the one with the most features.

It's the one you never have to think about.

You're rushing through airport security with your passport in one hand and your coffee in the other. Instead of digging through your backpack for a bulky adapter, you simply pull this from the same pocket as your passport.

At justcard sizeand45% smaller than conventional travel adapters, it disappears into your everyday carry without adding bulk.

Less to pack. Less to carry. More room for the journey.

You arrive at your hotel after a long flight, only to find the power outlet hidden behind a bedside table. A traditional adapter sticks out too far to fit.

Theflat-profile designslides neatly into tight spaces where bulky adapters simply can't.

Designed for real hotel rooms—not showroom walls.

Every millimeter matters when you're packing.

Traditional adapters leave their metal prongs exposed, catching on pockets, scratching devices, and wasting valuable space.

Our90° foldable plugfolds completely into the body, creating a smooth, flat profile that's comfortable to carry and ready whenever you need it.

Nothing sticks out. Nothing gets in the way.

You're charging your phone beside the bed. You roll over during the night, the cable gets tugged—and nothing falls out.

Because the adapter sitscloser to the wall, there's far less leverage pulling it loose. The connection stays secure, even with multiple cables attached.

More stability. Fewer interruptions.

Double Your AC Power.Less Charging Chaos.

Your phone is almost dead. Your earbuds need power before boarding. Your smartwatch is flashing low battery. Your camera has one bar left.

Instead of choosing what charges first, you plug everything in.

With25W fast chargingand support forup to six devices simultaneously, everyone gets powered before takeoff.

One adapter. The entire travel setup.

Tokyo today. Paris next week. New York after that.

Instead of carrying different adapters for every destination, you simply unfold the90° folding plug, switch to the local standard, and plug in.

Compatible with200+ countries and regions, it's ready before your next flight is.

One adapter. Every destination.

When the wall disappears, your power doesn't.

You're charging at the hotel before heading out.Your flight is delayed.

Every outlet at the gate is already taken.

Instead of searching your backpack for a separate power bank, you simplydetach the battery from the travel adapterand keep going.The cable stays connected.

Your phone keeps charging.No digging through your bag.No forgotten accessories.

From wall power to portable power—in one smooth transition.

22.5W Fast Charging. Keep Moving.

Your journey doesn't stop.

Neither should your charging.

Even after leaving the wall, the detachable battery continues deliveringup to 22.5W fast charging, giving your phone the power it needs while you navigate, translate, capture memories, and stay connected.

Because portable power shouldn't mean slower charging.

Fast at the hotel. Fast on the move.

No surprise shutdowns halfway through your journey.

Thedigital battery displaytells you exactly how much power remains before you leave.

Know before you go.

Your charging cable is always where you need it.

The built-in USB-C lanyard lets you carry OULIYO naturally with your laptop, backpack or in your hand—so your cable is always within reach.

Carry it. Don't search for it.

The café only has one available outlet.

Around you, everyone is carrying oversized chargers that generate heat after an hour.

Inside yours is6th Gen GaN technology, delivering more power with less heat in an incredibly compact body.

Smaller charger. Bigger performance.

Halfway through your trip, a sudden power surge trips the protection system. With most adapters, that's the end—you'll need a replacement fuse before charging again.

Ours works differently.

Theauto-reset fuseautomatically restores operation once the fault is removed.

No spare fuse. No wasted vacation time.

Designed to Do More.

Design By Ouliyo

HuiZhou Ouli Technology Co., Ltd. is a professional manufacturer specializing in power strips, travel adapters, travel chargers, mobile phone/laptop stands, and UV disinfection products. For 17 years, we have served every customer with technological R&D, quality, and service as our core values, delivering professional expertise, exceptional quality, and strong reputation.

As a global leader in multi-functional conversion sockets, we are committed to providing convenient solutions for travelers worldwide. We offer competitive, safe, and reliable products, solutions, and services in travel adapters, travel chargers, innovative car chargers, and smart sockets.

Risks and challenges

Launching a hardware product always comes with its own set of challenges. Here’s what you need to know about our travel power hub:

Manufacturing & Supply Chain
We’ve finalized prototypes and partnered with experienced manufacturers, but delays in component supply or production schedules may occur. We will communicate promptly if any adjustments are needed.
Quality & Safety Testing
Our product includes an auto-resetting fuse and built-in safety protections. While we have tested these extensively, unexpected failures may arise. All units will undergo strict QC to ensure reliability.
Shipping & Customs
Your travel power hub is compatible with global plug standards and meets international shipping regulations. However, customs delays or shipping issues may happen depending on your location.
Battery & Charging Performance
The 5000mAh backup battery and fast GaN charging are thoroughly tested. As with all lithium-ion batteries, capacity and performance may vary slightly under extreme conditions.
Product Handling
The device is compact and portable, designed for frequent travel. Users should avoid exposing it to water or extreme physical stress to maintain optimal performance.

We are committed to transparency and communication. Our team will provide updates on production progress, shipping timelines, and any unforeseen issues. Your support helps us bring this innovative, pocket-sized travel power hub to life safely and reliably.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: HuiZhou Ouli Technology Co., Ltd. is a 17-year-old Chinese manufacturer specializing in power strips, travel adapters, chargers, device stands, and UV disinfection products.
projects.ai_description_en:
The OULIYO Nomad is the world’s smallest and smartest travel adapter, designed to eliminate the chaos of carrying multiple charging accessories. By combining a global travel adapter, a magnetic power bank, and a wearable charging cable into one seamless ecosystem, this card-sized device replaces the wall charger, power bank, and cable cluttering your backpack. At 45% smaller than conventional travel adapters, it slips effortlessly into your pocket alongside your passport, ensuring you never have to choose between packing essentials and staying powered up on the go.

Engineered with 6th Gen GaN technology, the Nomad delivers 25W fast charging to power up to six devices simultaneously. It features dual AC outlets, a built-in 5000mAh backup battery, and compatibility with outlets in over 220 countries, making it the ultimate companion for global travelers. Smart features like an intuitive digital battery display and an auto-resetting fuse provide real-time power monitoring and advanced safety protections, while comprehensive international safety certifications guarantee reliable performance wherever your journey takes you.

Beyond its raw power, the Nomad is meticulously designed for real-world travel challenges. Its 90° foldable plug tucks completely into the body, creating a smooth, flat profile that won’t scratch your devices or catch on pockets. The space-saving side AC design and flat form factor allow it to slide neatly into tight spaces—like behind a hotel bedside table—where bulky adapters simply cannot fit. Because the adapter sits closer to the wall, there is far less leverage pulling it loose, keeping your connection secure and stable even with multiple cables attached.

Available now on Kickstarter at a Super Early Bird price of $59 (40% off the $99 MSRP), the OULIYO Nomad is set to ship in August 2026. With limited quantities available, backers have the opportunity to secure the ultimate pocket-sized travel power hub that lets you focus on discovering new places rather than managing a bag full of chargers.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Jaye is a wearable technology company focused on helping people reclaim their attention. We design simple, intentional tools that cut through digital noise and help people follow through on what matters most.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Jaye Band is a minimalist smartwatch designed with a singular purpose: helping you reclaim your attention in an increasingly distracted world. Unlike conventional smartwatches that bombard you with notifications and apps, the Jaye Band takes a radically different approach. It's built to be discreet and unobtrusive, serving as a tool that keeps you focused rather than pulling you away from the present moment. This is wearable technology designed not to add to your digital noise, but to help you tune it out.

At the heart of the Jaye Band experience is the Jaye Companion App, which acts as your personal attention hub. Through the app, you can access insights about your focus patterns, adjust settings, and tailor the device to your specific needs. The package includes the Jaye Band itself, a convenient charging dock for easy power-ups, and full access to the companion app ecosystem. Together, these components form a cohesive system designed to support healthier relationships with technology and time.

The Jaye Band matters because it addresses a growing problem: the erosion of our attention spans by devices that demand constant engagement. By choosing minimalism over feature bloat, the Jaye Band represents a philosophical shift in wearable tech — one that prioritizes human wellbeing over screen time. Available through Kickstarter with Super Early Bird pricing starting at $129 (a $120 savings), the Jaye Band is estimated to ship in December 2026 for US backers and February 2027 for international supporters. The team acknowledges the inherent challenges of hardware development, including potential manufacturing delays and iteration cycles, and commits to transparent, frequent communication throughout the process.

## Story

### A Cluttered, Uninspired Desk

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/310/a2d5d98784a3f11b7e557cc28cba4618_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188781&width=680&sig=CP5wtsJnGNi6nr0bQKHS%2BcWY04Wpmrv5GcjptDDLst0%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/240/850/7fe21abd167852873f00b363b028679b_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782447609&width=680&sig=bP5UDDHG4LAkoLVx5UlasjTpyhGIdMyfOeyxzStybbg%3D)

Is your desk cluttered with chargers, cables, and stands? Power strips overloaded, monitors stuck in one orientation, and ambient lighting requiring extra wiring.

In today’s world, our desks are command centers for productivity and creativity.

Yet, many struggle with desk clutter: tangled cables, limited charging ports, and rigid setups. Traditional arms are just metal poles; they don't solve the "spaghetti wire" mess or provide the ambiance you need.

Are you tired of compromising your setup?

### Meet KOVADEX X1

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/317/b11bd56a18dab077ffd27a14b7c2b1fd_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188801&width=680&sig=q1aA09f4zBuAsD354OeVCTS6venLlRyiFGCBJruRgXg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/191/451/060294864049ea4dd77a57d2c1a00c2f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782128888&width=680&sig=OZXHC8hy2OouLqHs%2Fp556W9hEUMm0zXSccssfKxXqbg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/240/906/383ea09d08804552a8de4fff1563f7c4_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782448351&width=680&sig=dqMja9EJIM3oepHt%2FsSsvYZWSYDOf6VvkTYe8xOEzaM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/200/293/b654515321a8cbe18020f132f61be874_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782182044&width=680&sig=6R6bkZKRAAgf1vl65gGNM%2F1d%2BLocwuWSHahjnniSqdM%3D)

KOVADEX integrates 100W fast charging, full-aluminum dual arms, and 80+ RGB mood lights into one device – one power cord, zero drilling, giving you a clean and productive workspace.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/190/960/0297ec9afdb0bcc0434fc38055dbfb75_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782125686&width=680&sig=zbJW0FjEjTSfmnclxIvoX4TDGfASIpU7tK4MlzHTfLQ%3D)

Support is just the foundation – flexibility is where real performance lives. We use aviation‑grade aluminum alloy, with each arm supporting monitors up to 36 inches. Both arms rotate independently 360°, letting you switch between landscape and portrait in just one second – no need to lift your monitor or re‑route cables. Left screen landscape for coding, right portrait for documents. Landscape for efficient work, portrait for total immersion in gaming – rotate however you like.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/190/962/0f676bd311b289ae3f377c3b321451f0_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782125688&width=680&sig=x9hhIRP1g%2FxWzaXUHkq65aDvPCfRa%2B9%2BkDoXH2Pndwo%3D)

The KOVADEX X1 dual‑arm system is built for creators, gamers, and professionals. Each arm features a high‑performance internal spring mechanism for effortless tilting and rotating, delivering a smooth “zero‑gravity” feel that makes adjustments almost weightless.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/190/869/0c6ba112c6ff8c1317dbe18b106c4269_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782125147&width=680&sig=p%2FmBiF58%2FSdJZhZyIB8YdxNhlxZ77cuolT8TFHD1gdU%3D)

Crafted entirely from premium aluminum alloy, the KOVADEX X1 Dual Arm Set’s base and stand carry a satisfying weight of 5.88 kg. This isn’t just about durability—it’s about the confidence that comes with true stability. Once placed on your desk, it anchors itself firmly, eliminating any wobble or uncertainty, so you can focus entirely on your work.

### 100W Power Station: The Heart of Your Desk

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/321/87c72fa85a5f9d5900c783c877eb4e85_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188831&width=680&sig=0Hrk%2Fd3FCjsgbUWsibLljUrm84GJErBUz9TMQhYLH3s%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/204/276/abbc5a8050f9ed63e3a61142be3699d0_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782208150&width=680&sig=yvvUuoQXwhh5D7jH8xOyL95l6H8Q0Vx5hGQ3EFSWSFc%3D)

Stop searching for chargers all over the place, and stop stressing over limited outlets.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/190/977/eaaf384f5f73eb7bdf23c1af083cd9e1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782125736&width=680&sig=dujCVjLA0zHRRjoczPppSK8W4YymLr4HoxTng7xaN4Q%3D)

KOVADEX X1 features a built-in 100W power delivery system with 3 USB-C and 1 USB-A ports integrated directly into the base.

Whether it’s fast-charging your MacBook Pro, powering your iPad, keeping your smartphone at 100%, or supplying energy to your gaming gear, controllers, and desktop accessories, everything you need is within arm’s reach. One cable to the wall, four devices on your desk.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/191/080/fbf785813f3f3daeff680ab5c77414df_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782126447&width=680&sig=DmR1FIQiC0PXeAzmWAULEDZfqH2yiZk%2FEZJvZiDZsjM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/230/563/1b2bc10be439912e8e9373f291fbc435_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782379342&width=680&sig=trpCt6SavWHotaxoY0qLUXLxMT%2BZMg8R9g8Qrv75xVc%3D)

### 80+ RGB Modes: Set the Vibe for Every Moment

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/322/2c0b15d1d90b1552493c65ce44b12dc2_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188844&width=680&sig=5KkxezCrQ%2F0Bhw6OHUt2rpAy7GWEAP7rqpwHzvd%2FNdk%3D)

Your desk setup should reflect your personality. With over 80+ preset RGB lighting modes, the KOVADEX X1 transforms your workspace into a dynamic masterpiece.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/189/128/a7f862727b6224033f55a7bf58419588_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782115352&width=680&sig=HNjr7bWX3CNDDy%2BVF%2FGQlLmgaB8ymWMCyIhx%2FQRfKhI%3D)

From calming "Deep Sea" blues for focused work to high-energy "Cyberpunk" pulses for late-night gaming sessions, you can switch the atmosphere with a single touch.

It’s not just a monitor arm; it’s a statement piece. No extra light strips to buy, no additional power cables to plug in – it’s ready the moment you turn it on.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/215/652/dc9dd65c60155c1cf2a4191732e065e4_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782272700&width=680&sig=TXeKJXAir5FCV0%2FDLmK0EUCHngFkbEz%2Bbq%2B5DPyEpJ0%3D)

### Magnetic Smart Storage: Clutter-Free, Mind-Free

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/325/239631d2f58f77502c6d370ac7e5c78f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188856&width=680&sig=vU2zrRdar%2FrDkMkLIyt58tNjC1pi2pGajl2LCKdIlGc%3D)

Clear the clutter, clear your mind. KOVADEX X1 base features two strategically placed magnetic brackets on the sides.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/190/309/0e50c7fab35d9e8de21bff48bb0c6eb8_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782123435&width=680&sig=CaMRnnbBHbsf86r4zA4Bd82gnhr5o3qk5ifIus%2BP588%3D)

Safely snap your smartphone, game controller, or headphones onto the base to keep your desk surface pristine. These organizers ensure your essential gear is always organized, visible, and ready for action without taking up precious desk real estate.

\\* Bonus! The two magnetic areas are part of our modular design, so you can easily swap out our included stand and use other compatible accessories.

### Invisible Cable Management

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/327/dd75359a9f88a8e3d7a2f6135218d10f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188869&width=680&sig=DbmfFKrNg%2BrGYHeume0gqwrSodytDN2QUg3Dx6pPIVg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/189/159/3b8dddeef23e217b27873be6ce2b87ae_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782115554&width=680&sig=LgI1i71cUgpZfpiMzzl1Uk8NmOntGuvBqJ79leP2%2F7A%3D)

Hide the mess. Built-in cable channels within the arms keep your power and display wires completely invisible for a clean, professional look.

### No Desk Clamp Needed

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/328/2b24929a540a5d33f333746b11746c36_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188883&width=680&sig=%2FcDaNoK4iLR%2F16hErz%2F2JqOOULAdJXcHjXEHiSO7yVI%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/119/cbd2f431f1dd111b79688c5aaf91b598_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782187067&width=680&sig=LBJE0QfBCrsEZkfHwb%2BJgfkerrYZVJhyq6Sc%2F7ZiFdA%3D)

KOVADEX X1 features a freestanding base with a quick-attach arm design, delivering a true unbox-and-go experience:

1. Snap Into Place: Align the arm with the base slot and click it in securely—no extra tools required.

2. Tighten & Lock: Hand-tighten the joint screw to lock the arm in place. Smooth damping feedback prevents overtightening and ensures stable support.

3. Mount & Power On: Attach your monitor, plug in the power, and you’re ready to go. The entire setup takes less than 5 minutes.

Ideal for renters, gamers, hot-deskers, or anyone who frequently reconfigures their workspace. With KOVADEX X1, spend your time creating—not deciphering assembly manuals.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/361/f101d13d4825f28cb189d35717d3baf4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782189259&width=680&sig=zL8xsK%2BwZs5ufJn6hERcltzawtREIvUKIm3IT1WOyWE%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/203/261ebc019b3ba882d69877582e28bc59_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782187668&width=680&sig=UsaunJLJmE0U4TguvvoIthdYRrTk38tQnNwKkeK06Xo%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/205/106/978ede63a2bb30f53976e181aecc2ada_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782213004&width=680&sig=JTZ1jULPs5vnU4fXev9DeQ05gck3MIMaf%2B%2B%2BMs%2BH9fs%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/239/741/18d8e5c1a5fae9c2791f00fcb74f1469_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782439311&width=680&sig=ue5XZGpS0oD2gEw3Mst7jzkBMk3i2FZVlutoN4CGJ1g%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/251/575/7e8b5b59e525677ebd4bf2a89e7c2be6_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782536919&width=680&sig=CdZmr1PODmAeRNBN%2ByfEIFclT9Hpiou785MELqOdr9k%3D)

### What's in the Box?

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/331/f530a54b466a3d7bd3b82db0e22cf656_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188910&width=680&sig=8gxiU1qs9gcBuCVMw4UgtQ0RydiByzfbUdHZS%2BI%2Fxqs%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/200/850/44fcbbaf7172cabb0a4a78802d39f86d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782185527&width=680&sig=O7c5P%2BWiBppqyJMi5X5YibFhrN5HCDlcKhlW6JoKPQs%3D)

### Rewards

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/333/a076406933e2823bac75ef3e7d1ff5cc_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188924&width=680&sig=tewIaSfMcN1oEam315nz6ZEpDjqSc2rBZ0%2F5%2B4M86qc%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/204/784/d4f753738d9712e3abec6064b547b1ef_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782210952&width=680&sig=rB%2F2DxtHlTaLxfYgkTdLu7TTMUg1o3PICqQQJT195Ek%3D)

Ultra-durable 1.5m 100W braided charging cable with a thickened copper core and tungsten alloy connectors for superior performance and strength.

### About Shipping

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/334/f21ff09095b98b95e4fe0a06a660f602_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188939&width=680&sig=yQGTUpGT20GxHdsETNMv3qa9NK%2FeTnvIkS2LtFa%2B8RI%3D)

### Developed Timeline

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/336/3bbbca9dbc394221b052099d5e5271aa_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188951&width=680&sig=YbGfjftVT0GHtTFP5za6A%2BaCGV69BXUKzoURMumTHVM%3D)
