### Design Journey

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/201/340/7b096dd7bc1d5745f41c5b9b417a2f66_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782188967&width=680&sig=butoPAgeW0UYuORjchIZg8OrVe2UE0fDNRbX2k2l1no%3D)

As a desk enthusiast, my own workspace was a battlefield of cables. RGB risers housed soundbars, topped with power-hungry gadgets and overloaded RGB power strips. I tried various monitor arms, but none on the market truly solved the tangle of cables, inconvenient charging, while balancing aesthetics and functionality. It was a constant frustration.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/143/dde745b9b6530c07110c7c35fcccb5f0_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781238743&width=680&sig=inebOtE1qiJHUGwlmkA3agY2aMQYFuhI5DbbHLEpCNM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/144/33e6f3d3231a335a644e44ba6f560999_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781238746&width=680&sig=91zOrQkIde98Dtaz%2BtLftHEBbnPLQyt8hB3RyagWpoE%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/145/5f21649869f7b821f2d531b46e78578c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781238756&width=680&sig=4XWyd%2BRWcCEcAG9DBJWNeSGx3L8pbPaDujtzOfSK1bs%3D)

We firmly believed that an efficient, tidy, and vibrant workspace is the foundation for creativity. This unwavering pursuit of the perfect desk ignited our resolve to create KOVADEX X1 – an all-in-one "smart desk hub."

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/046/5797ef0b48c371a72ed9658ba43aeb69_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781237925&width=680&sig=W4VfmgRUcJnDIAkVqoojclKx5TPAnHjqvfk1IMfV6tg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/049/a70fc11b9a1a855e6e80b75ff84906cf_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781237940&width=680&sig=QE5cjiAvEMDQsW0hfMbwlNIEx5V%2FieOgJU624b9xSZY%3D)

Starting from scratch, we envisioned KOVADEX X1: a monitor arm integrating 100W fast charging, dazzling RGB lighting, clever magnetic storage, and invisible cable management. Seamlessly integrating these innovations into a minimalist design proved far more challenging than anticipated. Every design detail, from curves to ports, underwent countless refinements and iterations.

[![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/279/604/307d470266ba82957f827a73c8b0c123_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782789274&width=680&sig=lLX%2FloV6JY%2FQVQoxrUmsIH1ghcc9djIwH7BxDEFZSFk%3D)](http://jellop.com/)

This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 7,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1.5 Billion raised between them.

[![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/227/723/0d65a5f0308b6915d7b00763cbd31c7c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1782356701&width=680&sig=uuiwSn5jzVGRYN03S5GTZcGZ4FqP%2FYicB4bMVZlT5jQ%3D)](https://backerplus.com/)

## Risks and challenges

We understand that manufacturing and fulfillment come with inherent challenges. To mitigate these risks, we’ve taken proactive steps, including early pilot production runs, to ensure everything runs smoothly.

Our team is fully committed to delivering a premium product and meeting our promised delivery timeline. Above all, we believe in total transparency. We will keep you in the loop with regular progress updates throughout both development and mass production, so you are always informed and part of the journey.

[Learn about accountability on Kickstarter](https://www.kickstarter.com/help/hc/sections/115001107133)

## Use of AI

### I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

#### What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

We may use AI-assisted tools to help create or refine campaign visuals, product mockups, lifestyle imagery, and marketing copy for the KOVADEX X1 Kickstarter page. Please note that the KOVADEX X1 is a physical hardware product, and this campaign is not seeking funding for AI technology. Any AI tools are used strictly as a creative and marketing aid to help us present our product clearly to our backers.

#### Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. All AI-assisted content is generated using our own proprietary product designs, brand assets, campaign concepts, and original materials created specifically for KOVADEX X1. We strictly avoid using third-party copyrighted artwork, characters, logos, or specific artist styles to generate our campaign content. Any AI-assisted visuals are intended solely to represent the KOVADEX X1 and our campaign messaging. Furthermore, our team will manually review all final materials before publishing to ensure they accurately and authentically reflect our brand.

[Learn about AI policy on Kickstarter](https://help.kickstarter.com/hc/articles/16848396410267)

100W multi‑port charging, 80+ RGB mood light modes, and dual‑arm freedom – no drilling, no clutter. An effortless all‑around upgrade.

A Cluttered, Uninspired Desk

Meet KOVADEX X1

100W Power Station: The Heart of Your Desk

80+ RGB Modes: Set the Vibe for Every Moment

Magnetic Smart Storage: Clutter-Free, Mind-Free

Invisible Cable Management

No Desk Clamp Needed

What's in the Box?

Developed Timeline

A Cluttered, Uninspired Desk

Is your desk cluttered with chargers, cables, and stands? Power strips overloaded, monitors stuck in one orientation, and ambient lighting requiring extra wiring.

In today’s world, our desks are command centers for productivity and creativity.

Yet, many struggle with desk clutter: tangled cables, limited charging ports, and rigid setups. Traditional arms are just metal poles; they don't solve the "spaghetti wire" mess or provide the ambiance you need.

Are you tired of compromising your setup?

Meet KOVADEX X1

KOVADEX integrates 100W fast charging, full-aluminum dual arms, and 80+ RGB mood lights into one device – one power cord, zero drilling, giving you a clean and productive workspace.

Support is just the foundation –flexibilityis where real performance lives. We use aviation‑grade aluminum alloy, with each arm supporting monitors up to 36 inches. Both arms rotate independently 360°, letting you switch between landscape and portrait in just one second – no need to lift your monitor or re‑route cables. Left screen landscape for coding, right portrait for documents. Landscape for efficient work, portrait for total immersion in gaming – rotate however you like.

The KOVADEX X1 dual‑arm system is built for creators, gamers, and professionals. Each arm features a high‑performance internal spring mechanism for effortless tilting and rotating, delivering a smooth “zero‑gravity” feel that makes adjustments almost weightless.

Crafted entirely from premium aluminum alloy, the KOVADEX X1 Dual Arm Set’s base and stand carry a satisfying weight of5.88 kg. This isn’t just about durability—it’s about the confidence that comes with true stability. Once placed on your desk, it anchors itself firmly, eliminating any wobble or uncertainty, so you can focus entirely on your work.

100W Power Station: The Heart of Your Desk

Stop searching for chargers all over the place, and stop stressing over limited outlets.

KOVADEX X1 features a built-in100Wpower delivery system with 3 USB-C and 1 USB-A ports integrated directly into the base.

Whether it’sfast-charging your MacBook Pro, powering your iPad, keeping your smartphone at 100%, or supplying energy to your gaming gear, controllers, and desktop accessories, everything you needis within arm’s reach. One cable to the wall, four devices on your desk.

80+ RGB Modes: Set the Vibe for Every Moment

Your desk setup should reflect your personality. With over80+ preset RGB lighting modes, the KOVADEX X1 transforms your workspace into a dynamic masterpiece.

From calming "Deep Sea" blues for focused work to high-energy "Cyberpunk" pulses for late-night gaming sessions, you can switch the atmosphere with a single touch.

It’s not just a monitor arm; it’s a statement piece. No extra light strips to buy, no additional power cables to plug in – it’s ready the moment you turn it on.

Magnetic Smart Storage: Clutter-Free, Mind-Free

Clear the clutter, clear your mind. KOVADEX X1 base features two strategically placed magnetic brackets on the sides.

Safely snap your smartphone, game controller, or headphones onto the base to keep your desk surface pristine. These organizers ensure your essential gear is always organized, visible, and ready for action without taking up precious desk real estate.

* Bonus!The two magnetic areas are part of our modular design, so you can easily swap out our included stand and use other compatible accessories.

Invisible Cable Management

Hide the mess. Built-in cable channels within the arms keep your power and display wires completely invisible for a clean, professional look.

No Desk Clamp Needed

Snap Into Place:Align the arm with the base slot and click it in securely—no extra tools required.

Tighten & Lock:Hand-tighten the joint screw to lock the arm in place. Smooth damping feedback prevents overtightening and ensures stable support.

Mount & Power On:Attach your monitor, plug in the power, and you’re ready to go. The entire setup takes less than 5 minutes.

What's in the Box?

Ultra-durable1.5m 100Wbraided charging cable with a thickened copper core and tungsten alloy connectors for superior performance and strength.

We offer worldwide shipping. The KOVADEX X1 base and stand are crafted from premium aluminum alloy, giving the unit a solid, high-quality feel at5.88 kg. Please note that shipping costs will vary depending on your destination.

While we will provide an estimated shipping range for your reference during the campaign, the final shipping fee will be calculated based on actual carrier rates at the time of fulfillment.

We are committed to full transparency and will clearly communicate the exact shipping charges to all backers before processing any shipping cost.

Developed Timeline

As a desk enthusiast, my own workspace was a battlefield of cables. RGB risers housed soundbars, topped with power-hungry gadgets and overloaded RGB power strips. I tried various monitor arms, but none on the market truly solved the tangle of cables, inconvenient charging, while balancing aesthetics and functionality. It was a constant frustration.

We firmly believed that an efficient, tidy, and vibrant workspace is the foundation for creativity. This unwavering pursuit of the perfect desk ignited our resolve to create KOVADEX X1 – an all-in-one "smart desk hub."

Starting from scratch, we envisioned KOVADEX X1: a monitor arm integrating 100W fast charging, dazzling RGB lighting, clever magnetic storage, and invisible cable management. Seamlessly integrating these innovations into a minimalist design proved far more challenging than anticipated. Every design detail, from curves to ports, underwent countless refinements and iterations.

This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 7,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1.5 Billion raised between them.

We understand that manufacturing and fulfillment come with inherent challenges. To mitigate these risks, we’ve taken proactive steps, including early pilot production runs, to ensure everything runs smoothly. 

Our team is fully committed to delivering a premium product and meeting our promised delivery timeline. Above all, we believe in total transparency. We will keep you in the loop with regular progress updates throughout both development and mass production, so you are always informed and part of the journey.

projects.ai_description_en:
The KOVADEX X1 is an all-in-one desktop hub that combines a dual monitor arm system with a built-in 100W charging station and RGB mood lighting, designed to eliminate clutter and transform any workspace into a sleek, organized command center. Unlike traditional monitor arms that require desk clamps and leave cables exposed, the X1 anchors itself with a 5.88 kg premium aluminum alloy base that sits firmly on any surface without drilling or additional hardware.

At its core, the X1 delivers serious power and flexibility. The built-in 100W charging station features three USB-C ports and one USB-A port integrated directly into the base, allowing you to fast-charge a MacBook Pro, iPad, smartphone, or gaming accessories from a single wall cable. Each full-aluminum arm supports monitors up to 36 inches and rotates independently 360°, letting you switch between landscape and portrait orientation in seconds — ideal for coding on one screen while reading documents on the other, or switching from productivity to immersive gaming setups.

What truly sets the KOVADEX X1 apart are the thoughtful details that address everyday desk frustrations. Over 80 preset RGB lighting modes let you shift the atmosphere from focused "Deep Sea" blues to high-energy "Cyberpunk" pulses with a single touch, while magnetic snap-on brackets on the base keep your phone, controller, or headphones organized and within reach. Built-in cable channels hide all wiring inside the arms for a clean, professional look. With its tool-free assembly, aviation-grade durability, and striking design, the X1 isn't just a monitor arm — it's a complete workspace upgrade for creators, professionals, and gamers who refuse to compromise between performance and aesthetics.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/016/244/8098cd78e3042207d202ae42274e2ebb_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780801538&width=680&sig=KMwwJn2tKdn0ts89DDeDb5HJD%2BnGgEojx%2FlV0W8en88%3D)

### What is M2

M2 is a fully automated vinyl record flattener designed to safely restore warped records. By precisely controlling heat, pressure, and cooling, M2 helps reduce or eliminate warps that can cause tracking issues, playback instability, stylus wear, and reduced listening enjoyment. Whether caused by manufacturing inconsistencies, improper storage, shipping damage, or simply time, warped records are an unavoidable part of collecting. M2 provides a safe and consistent alternative to risky DIY methods.

Compatible with 7", 10", and 12" records, M2 delivers professional-level results in a compact, easy-to-use system designed for both serious collectors and record stores.

### Independent Reviews

Before launching M2, we provided units to experienced collectors, reviewers, and industry professionals around the world for independent evaluation.

#### Andrew (Parlogram Auctions)

#### John (Brum HiFi / Music Is The Answer)

#### Rick (The Joy of Vinyl Records)

#### Marc (Sound Matters)

#### Norman Maslov

### Real Results

#### See The Difference

The M2 Vinyl Flattener was designed to safely reduce or eliminate these warps through a fully automated process that carefully manages temperature, pressure, and cooling. Below are real-world examples showing records before and after treatment with M2.

### Why Warped Records Matter

A warped record doesn’t just create an audible wobble — it disrupts the entire playback system. Warps introduce irregular vertical and low-frequency motion that your stylus, cartridge, tonearm, and even speakers must react to. Over time, these unnatural movements can affect both sound quality and equipment longevity.

#### Stylus Tracking Distortion & Cartridge Wear

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/016/608/9d2b471501b3ca6dd3785e607d9ae6bf_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780807176&width=680&sig=i4kf4JlB0vBUgtXdKS9c8xF8VNY2fG99Bnut6WGJanQ%3D)

When a stylus encounters a warp, it must ride steep vertical waves instead of a stable groove. This can cause tracking distortion, pitch instability, increased surface noise, and in severe cases, mistracking or skipping.These repeated vertical impacts place additional stress on the cartridge suspension, cantilever, and stylus — accelerating wear beyond normal playback conditions.

#### Irregular Low-Frequency Motion Stresses Speakers

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/016/611/5e84c4b5806457514426858b3a678cd1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780807186&width=680&sig=pZu%2FFt5cV2bNCtFl14kJpT0sf2%2FCp3BLPRtNquK3iqc%3D)

Warped records introduce subsonic low-frequency motion that may be inaudible but still forces your audio system to respond. This causes woofer cones to move excessively, even during quiet passages. Over time, this unnecessary excursion can strain speaker drivers, reduce dynamic range, and create visibly unstable playback as the system attempts to reproduce frequencies that were never part of the music.

#### Warps Reduce Grading & Collector Value

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/016/612/2b77cd2af8e59b845e9c4636c4b0506e_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780807194&width=680&sig=8es4T6%2FJoABd0wXKa7hb9IYBJH8XrW1L14utg7fExqc%3D)

Warping is considered a structural defect in record grading. Even a playable record can be downgraded significantly, reducing resale value and making it less desirable to buyers. A record that would sell quickly when flat may sit unsold for weeks if visibly warped. Restoring a record helps preserve not only its playability, but also its collector value and market appeal.

### Why Existing Solutions Fall Short

Warped records have been a challenge for collectors for decades, yet reliable and accessible solutions remain surprisingly limited. Many enthusiasts find themselves choosing between risky DIY methods and commercial machines that were never designed with the modern collector in mind.

#### DIY Method

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/017/192/41a516df8a32af9ad26a6b864417ee2b_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780815003&width=680&sig=VTY%2FlDWNVppbrA1AbA8SQA03XThToALqzd8aHWsu0h8%3D)

Many collectors resort to DIY solutions such as stacking heavy books on records, sandwiching them between glass plates, or even attempting to flatten them in household ovens. While these methods may occasionally produce results, they lack precise temperature and pressure control, increasing the risk of groove damage, permanent deformation, or inconsistent outcomes.

#### Legacy Commercial Machines

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/017/194/25e45fbeabb97f2f37401892edb050c9_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780815128&width=680&sig=n2L8JQQLwOzrKKeFyc9pzEQyDXpROgwxwjH1vFaV4UA%3D)

Commercial record flatteners have been helping record stores and collectors for decades, but many were designed primarily for professional environments rather than modern homes. While effective, they are often bulky, expensive, and built around design philosophies that have changed little over the years—prioritizing durability over convenience, usability, and contemporary aesthetics.

### Meet M2

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/017/995/08951fa992fe8fed78f3755ca5cae1f6_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780828172&width=680&sig=kFPaXvyXixgVR0DDeDHikenDyLoc%2F9xQoWNcI1wDWdM%3D)

#### Reimagining Record Flattening

We believed record flattening could be safer, more consistent, and easier to use. Rather than modifying an existing design, we started from scratch and spent years rethinking the process from the ground up.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/081/6c63fc839c9b3de80fa5a0294360aeff_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780841347&width=680&sig=jiRKsjgibbsbM04mgFIbutpPfVDe1BNfJN2jSF1UeOs%3D)

#### Compact Modern Design

Designed to fit naturally into today's listening rooms, with convenient vertical storage when not in use.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/075/f8f2d3e1b178f2a99ce208a0a784c148_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780829270&width=680&sig=%2Bq88K%2FB65fe7G5zEAEu3MZawwmBPGyamExu70jbrVXo%3D)

#### Single-Touch Automated Operation

Designed for simplicity, M2 automatically manages the entire flattening process with a single touch.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/185/c17262e1273957c3dd1e33fb27c19e17_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780831308&width=680&sig=Pn9cHnx10inQvZTOnOwHnDODsHvEm9if7XU6P0rwX%2FE%3D)

#### Precision Temperature Control

Intelligent dual-sensor monitoring and adaptive heating profiles precisely manage every stage of the process—from heating and holding to controlled cooling.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/192/6da8c1ac4818d3687cadcf5298cdaf23_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780831516&width=680&sig=zyYu88QaB2QUUbb9A4tMm2ACCr876Wuj1%2BJ%2BTexw0b8%3D)

#### Advanced Materials Construction

Engineered with microcrystalline glass, graphene heating technology, and a high-mass aluminum thermal platform for exceptional flatness and thermal stability.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/428/4d073acfbd0b83803c9f8c38f758b6af_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780834805&width=680&sig=tagez%2FjACO5NMVBpGHBVnejUZOaOWn%2Bs9QBRr2NEBq4%3D)

Warps introduce irregular vertical and low-frequency motion that your stylus, cartridge, tonearm, and even speakers must react to. Over time, these unnatural movements can affect both sound quality and equipment longevity.

Stylus Tracking Distortion & Cartridge Wear

When a stylus encounters a warp, it must ride steep vertical waves instead of a stable groove. This can cause tracking distortion, pitch instability, increased surface noise, and in severe cases, mistracking or skipping.These repeated vertical impacts place additional stress on the cartridge suspension, cantilever, and stylus — accelerating wear beyond normal playback conditions.

Irregular Low-Frequency Motion Stresses Speakers

Warped records introduce subsonic low-frequency motion that may be inaudible but still forces your audio system to respond. This causes woofer cones to move excessively, even during quiet passages. Over time, this unnecessary excursion can strain speaker drivers, reduce dynamic range, and create visibly unstable playback as the system attempts to reproduce frequencies that were never part of the music.

Warps Reduce Grading & Collector Value

Warping is considered a structural defect in record grading. Even a playable record can be downgraded significantly, reducing resale value and making it less desirable to buyers. A record that would sell quickly when flat may sit unsold for weeks if visibly warped. Restoring a record helps preserve not only its playability, but also its collector value and market appeal.

Why Existing Solutions Fall Short

Warped records have been a challenge for collectors for decades, yet reliable and accessible solutions remain surprisingly limited. Many enthusiasts find themselves choosing between risky DIY methods and commercial machines that were never designed with the modern collector in mind.

Many collectors resort to DIY solutions such as stacking heavy books on records, sandwiching them between glass plates, or even attempting to flatten them in household ovens. While these methods may occasionally produce results, they lack precise temperature and pressure control, increasing the risk of groove damage, permanent deformation, or inconsistent outcomes.

Legacy Commercial Machines

Commercial record flatteners have been helping record stores and collectors for decades, but many were designed primarily for professional environments rather than modern homes. While effective, they are often bulky, expensive, and built around design philosophies that have changed little over the years—prioritizing durability over convenience, usability, and contemporary aesthetics.

Reimagining Record Flattening

We believed record flattening could be safer, more consistent, and easier to use. Rather than modifying an existing design, we started from scratch and spent years rethinking the process from the ground up.

Compact Modern Design

Designed to fit naturally into today's listening rooms, with convenient vertical storage when not in use.

Single-Touch Automated Operation

Designed for simplicity, M2 automatically manages the entire flattening process with a single touch.

Intelligent dual-sensor monitoring and adaptive heating profiles precisely manage every stage of the process—from heating and holding to controlled cooling.

Advanced Materials Construction

Engineered with microcrystalline glass, graphene heating technology, and a high-mass aluminum thermal platform for exceptional flatness and thermal stability.

Supports 7", 10", and 12" Records

Compatible with 7", 10", and 12" records, allowing a single machine to handle everything from EPs to full-size LPs.

Restores Severely Warped Records

When standard settings aren't enough, Ultra (U) mode is designed to tackle the most challenging record warps while prioritizing groove safety.

Protective Pad System

Included protective pads provide an additional layer of protection for fragile records, older pressings, and records without groove guards—helping ensure safe and consistent restoration.

Flatten Sealed Records Without Opening Them

The removable center spindle allows unopened records and album covers to be flattened without breaking the factory seal.

Engineered From the Ground Up

Record flattening is not simply a matter of heat and pressure. Consistent restoration requires precise control of temperature, pressure, and cooling throughout the entire process.M2 was engineered from the ground up to meet this challenge. Advanced materials, intelligent temperature control, and precision construction work together as a complete restoration system—delivering reliable results while prioritizing record safety.

Advanced Materials

Every material inside M2 was selected for a specific purpose.The restoration surface combines ultra-flat microcrystalline glass, a graphene heating film, and a high-mass aluminum thermal plate. Together, these materials provide exceptional flatness, even heat distribution, and long-term dimensional stability.This layered architecture helps ensure that heat is delivered evenly across the entire record surface, reducing temperature variations that can affect restoration results.

Intelligent Temperature Control

Temperature is the most critical variable in record restoration.M2 uses dual temperature sensors and a proprietary control system designed specifically for vinyl records. Rather than simply heating to a target temperature, the system continuously manages the entire restoration cycle—from controlled heating and holding phases to carefully regulated cooling.This intelligent process helps maintain stable conditions throughout the cycle while adapting to different ambient environments and record conditions.

Precision Engineered Construction

Performance depends on more than temperature alone.The upper plate assembly weighs over 5 kg and works together with the lower thermal structure to provide consistent pressure across the record surface. Combined with precision-machined components and carefully engineered tolerances, the system is designed to maintain stability throughout every stage of the restoration process.The result is a compact machine capable of delivering professional-level performance while remaining simple and approachable for everyday use.

Three simple ways to use M2.

Whether you're restoring everyday records, protecting valuable collectibles, or flattening sealed purchases, M2 adapts to a wide range of real-world situations.

For most modern records with groove guards, simply place the record inside M2, select the appropriate size and restoration mode, and press start. The fully automated system manages the entire process—from heating and holding to controlled cooling—allowing you to return hours later to a restored record.

projects.ai_description_en:
The M2 Vinyl Flattener by WhiteBridge Technology is a fully automated device designed to safely restore warped records. By precisely controlling heat, pressure, and cooling, M2 can reduce or eliminate warps that cause tracking issues, stylus wear, and playback instability. Compatible with 7", 10", and 12" records, it delivers professional-level results in a compact, easy-to-use system built for serious collectors, audiophiles, and record stores.

Warped records are a persistent challenge for any vinyl enthusiast. Even slight warping introduces irregular vertical and low-frequency motion that forces the stylus, cartridge, and speakers to work harder than necessary. Over time, this can lead to tracking distortion, increased cartridge wear, excessive woofer excursion, and reduced dynamic range. Beyond sound quality, structural warping directly affects a record's grading and collector value. M2 addresses these issues with a scientifically controlled process that prioritizes record safety over aggressive restoration, offering a reliable alternative to inconsistent and risky DIY methods that can permanently damage a disc.

The machine is built on precision engineering principles. Development and testing are complete, and WhiteBridge Technology has already delivered review units to independent collectors and industry professionals worldwide. The company is maintaining close quality control through a vertically integrated manufacturing approach. Ongoing reviews from respected voices in the vinyl community, including professionals from Parlogram Auctions and Brum HiFi, provide further validation of M2's effectiveness.

What sets M2 apart is its commitment to safety without sacrificing results. While no flattener can guarantee identical outcomes across every record due to variations in age, material composition, and warp severity, M2's automated process maximizes the chance of successful restoration. For collectors and retailers looking to preserve both playback quality and market value, the M2 Vinyl Flattener offers a professional, repeatable, and user-friendly solution made possible through its Kickstarter campaign.

projects.ai_intro_en: MemoMind One are privacy-first AI glasses with dual Micro-LED displays, Harman-tuned audio, and all-day battery life. They offer AI translation in 26 languages, real-time transcription, and a proactive memory assistant — all without a camera. Incubated by XGIMI, they weigh just 46.6g and support prescription lenses.
ai_highlights_en: No camera design ensures complete privacy while delivering powerful AI assistance
Dual Micro-LED display with 2000 nits brightness, readable in full sunlight
AI Translator supports 26 languages with real-time dialog and listen-in modes
projects.ai_risks_en: The project mentions production readiness but crowdfunding campaigns carry inherent delivery risks. The Memo+ subscription requires ongoing payment for full AI memory features. The display technology is novel and long-term durability data is limited. Prescription lens compatibility may vary.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Incubated by XGIMI, a display technology company focused on redefining human-AI communication through lightweight, everyday smart glasses.
projects.ai_description_en:
MemoMind One redefines smart glasses by refusing to look like them. At just 46.6g with a natural curvature and flexible hinges that balance core components behind the ears, these are frames you'd choose regardless of their tech. They support your own prescription lenses, ensuring they feel as natural when you put them on as any pair of glasses you already own. This is wearable technology that prioritizes wearability first.

At the heart of MemoMind One are dual Micro-LED projectors delivering a 2000-nit display that floats one to five meters ahead of you, readable even in direct sunlight. The display adjusts in height, depth, and brightness while a downward light design and high-transparency grating keep your information strictly visible to you. Crucially, there's no camera. While most smart glasses center surveillance as a core feature, MemoMind One builds privacy into the hardware itself. A Harman-tuned AudioEFX speaker provides immersive sound, and a full-day battery keeps you powered from morning to night.

The AI suite works quietly throughout your day. An AI Translator handles 26 languages in passive or dialog mode, while the AI Recorder captures meetings, lectures, or moments and delivers structured summaries in seconds. An AI Teleprompter displays live subtitles and prompts in your line of sight, and a memory feature catches fleeting ideas and clusters them into coherent themes over time. Customizable voice and gesture controls activate everything hands-free, and a full iOS or Android companion app manages your dashboard, notifications, audio settings, and firmware.

MemoMind One makes powerful AI invisible and personal, without the privacy trade-offs that plague other smart glasses. Starting at approximately $399 with prescription-ready options and six months of free Memo+ membership included, it delivers what most competitors can't: technology you trust wearing, all day long.
projects.nameZh: MemoMind One：最自然的 AI 显示眼镜！
projects.ai_intro_zh: MemoMind One 是注重隐私的 AI 眼镜，配备双 Micro-LED 显示屏、Harman 调音音频和全天续航。提供 26 种语言的 AI 翻译、实时转录和主动记忆助手——全都没有摄像头。由 XGIMI 孵化，仅重 46.6 克，支持定制近视镜片。
projects.ai_description_zh:
MemoMind One 通过拒绝看起来像智能眼镜来重新定义智能眼镜。仅重 46.6 克，拥有自然曲度和柔性铰链，将核心组件平衡分布在耳后——这些是你即使不考虑科技也会选择的镜框。它们支持你自己的处方镜片，确保佩戴感觉和普通眼镜一样自然。没有摄像头、没有突兀的扬声器、没有让你看起来像科技演示者的 LED 灯。

显示技术采用双目光波导，将信息投射到你的自然视野中——一个 28° 视场角、等效于从 2 米外观看 100 英寸屏幕的单绿色微显示屏。这种低调的方法意味着你可以看到通知、AI 对话、导航提示和实时翻译，而不会遮挡视线。双麦克风阵列和可选的 Memo 按钮（位于铰链处）实现语音交互和主动记录。IP54 防尘防水等级确保日常耐用性，触摸板位于镜腿处用于基本控制。

AI 功能是 MemoMind One 的核心。由微型 AI 芯片驱动的 Memo+ 订阅服务（提供每月免费额度）管理会议记录、日记提示、实时翻译和照片记忆搜索。该设备通过自定义应用与你的手机和电脑同步，保持你的 AI 记忆跨设备一致。一次充电续航约 8 小时，足够支撑整天使用。MemoMind One 起售价 29（早鸟价），提供 Nero Matt 和 Crystal 两种配色。
ai_highlights_zh: 无摄像头设计确保完全隐私，同时提供强大的 AI 辅助功能
双 Micro-LED 显示屏，2000 尼特亮度，在阳光下清晰可读
AI 翻译器支持 26 种语言，具备实时对话和聆听模式
ai_specs_zh: 显示技术 | 双 Micro-LED 投影仪
音频 | 内置 Harman AudioEFX 扬声器
电池 | 单次充电可使用一整天
翻译 | 26 种语言，对话和聆听模式
控制方式 | 语音和手势控制
应用 | iOS 和 Android 配套应用
镜片 | 可定制近视镜片
标准版 + 近视镜片价格 | HK$3,912（约 $499）
projects.ai_risks_zh: 该项目提到已做好生产准备，但众筹活动固有交付风险。Memo+ 订阅需要持续付费才能使用全部 AI 记忆功能。显示技术是新颖的，长期耐用性数据有限。处方镜片兼容性可能因个体而异。
projects.ai_creator_bio_zh: 由 XGIMI（极米科技）孵化，一家专注于通过轻量级日常智能眼镜重新定义人机交互的显示技术公司。

The World's First TES Wellness Earbuds.

Premium Hi-Fi earbuds by day. A private TES wellness session when you need to wind down, reset, or focus.

Big claims are easy. Here's the proof behind ours.

Already proven — not just promised.

Our TES technology is already proven in real-world pilot programs with the original HealingFit device. HealingFit TWS carries that same core TES microcurrent and sound technology into a true-wireless earbud.

How we tested:hospital clinical studies and real-world field testing — using clinical EEG (brainwave) monitoring and user feedback. In our 6-week firefighter field study, gains in sleep and relaxation were statistically significant.

What users felt— Sleep: faster, more restorative · Healing: lower stress after a short session · Study: fewer distractions, longer focus

(Note: HealingFit TWS is a wellness device, not a medical device. It does not diagnose, treat, or cure medical conditions. Individual results may vary.)

Your Racing Thoughts at 3 AM.

The best routine is the one you'll actually keep. That's why we built HealingFit TWS.

What is HealingFit TWS?

One Device. Two Perfect Experiences.

Hi-Fi by day. Wellness when you need it.

By day, HealingFit TWS works as your premium true-wireless earbuds — for music, calls, and everyday life.

When you're ready to reset, snap on the Magnetic TES Link™ for a guided TES and sound session.

Three routines, ready when you are

Sleep Mode:Nightly wind-down designed to help you settle.

Healing Mode:Quick reset routine after a long day.

Study Mode:Focus-ready routine for work or study moments.

One device. Two experiences. Three routines you can repeat.

CES Innovation Awards Honoree

Why it's different.

Not just better listening — smarter recovery. Premium audio that turns into a TES + sound routine, on the same device.

How it works — 3 simple steps.

Designed to be effortless.

Step 1 · Wear it like premium TWS earbuds.Exceptional audio, comfortable secure fit.Step 2 · Snap on the Magnetic TES Link™.Bring the cable close — the magnets align naturally. No setup.Step 3 · Start your routine in the app.Pick a mode, set your TES level, and let the microcurrents and soundscapes take over.

Watch the Blue LED: It turns on only when the TES wellness routine is activated.

Live demo: when the earbud electrodes touch the test jig, the LED lights up — showing the TES microcurrent is active.

TES(Transcranial Electrical Stimulation) — a non-invasive technology widely studied in neuroscience. HealingFit translates it into a gentle, daily microcurrent routine, delivered through your ear-area electrodes.

・Gentle, not forced— supports your nervous system's natural transition, not a "force" into sleep.・You're in control— 15 intensity levels, described as a subtle, rhythmic pulse.・Sound made for it— 15 built-in tracks with binaural beats, tuned to work with TES.

Why the TES Link™ matters.

True wireless earbuds are perfect for music and calls. But a TES + sound session needs a physical connection between the two ear-area electrodes.

Snap on the Magnetic TES Link™ only when you choose a session. It connects the two earbuds for TES delivery while keeping everyday listening fully wireless.One earbud system. Two ways to use it.

Comfort you can personalize.

15 intensity levels— most users describe it as a subtle, rhythmic pulse. Start low, increase gradually.

Built for routines, not just listening

15 built-in tracks—five each for Sleep, Healing, and Study—are designed to pair with TES sessions.

Make it yours:add and edit your own playlist in the app — andlayer TES signals over your favorite music or video apps.

3 Routine Modes (Sleep / Healing / Study)

Sleep — wind down and prepare for rest:a bedtime routine to help you unwind and settle.Healing — reset after a stressful day:a short routine to decompress.Study — focus & clarity:a steady routine for work or study.

My HealingFit app

See HealingFit TWS in Action

Watch a real walkthrough of the My HealingFit app, including live TES controls, routine selection, music control, and everyday wellness features.

This isn't a concept. It's a real, app-connected experience that keeps improving through software updates.

Watch the My HealingFit app walkthrough and see how HealingFit TWS works in real daily use.

Choose Your ModeOpen the My HealingFit app and choose the mode you want — Healing, Study, or Sleep. The moment you select, your earbuds announce the chosen mode by voice.

Find Your SoundTap through 5 MSTS™ sound tunings in Music Mode — the sound shifts in real time as you switch, so you can hear each character and keep the one you love.

Add TES to Your MusicSet your TES level, volume, and ANC mode to suit you, right from the controller screen. As you change the level or switch ANC modes, your earphones confirm each change by voice.

Connect to Activate TESConnect the magnetic TES Link™ cable to both earbuds, and the TES wellness controls activate in the app.

Add TES to Your MusicIn My Mode, you can generate TES signals on the music playing on your smartphone. While your music plays, HealingFit TWS generates TES signals in sync with it — so you can experience TES with the songs you already love. And you can switch music apps anytime.

Worried about losing connection during your routine? Don't be.

The Magnetic TES Link™ snaps into place the moment you bring it close. With skin-safe stainless steel electrodes and a strong magnetic hold, your session stays connected — even as you move or shift in your sleep

Important Safety Information

Do not use the TES functionif you have a pacemaker or any other active implantable electronic medical device.

Do not use the TES functionif you have epilepsy or a history of seizures.

If you are pregnant, have a heart condition or another medical condition, or are under medical care,consult a healthcare professional before using the TES function.

Stop using the TES function immediatelyif you feel discomfort or experience any unusual reaction.

HealingFit TWS is designedfor personal wellnessand is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease or medical condition.

Hi-Fi Audio DNA (MSTS™ + 5 Music Modes)

Hi-Fi audio DNA: we proved the sound. Now we bring it into wellness.

Built on more than 20 years of Bluetooth audio engineering, HealingFit TWS brings MobiFren Sound Tuning System™ (MSTS™) to your everyday listening.

HealingFit TWS carries that same audio DNA into a new category — premium true-wireless earbuds by day, TES + sound wellness when you need it.

Everyone hears differently. That's why the My HealingFit app gives you5 fully tuned MSTS™ sound modes— like 5 great earphones in one pair:

•MobiFren Mode— Clean, natural, and balanced.•BassBoost Mode— Richer low-end energy.•Enhance Mode— Added clarity for vocals, podcasts, and acoustic detail.•Tender Mode— Soft, gentle sound for calm listening.•Space Mode— A wider, more immersive soundstage.

Your wellness routine should never mean compromising your music.

Stable in-ear fit for commute, work, study, travel; A compact charging case that makes your routine easy to carry anywhere.

Open Bluetooth LE · UUID 0xBE00 · No licensing fee · Documentation available now

Connect your own signals to user-controlled TES + sound wellness routines, so users can move beyond measurement and tracking—using HealingFit TWS to support real progress they can see over time.

Real Engineering. Real Production. Built with Care.

We areMobiFren, a dedicated audio technology team from South Korea. For over 20 years, we’ve engineered some of the best-sounding wireless tech on the market.

In 2014, we partnered with the TES Center to ask: "What if earphones could support your mental wellbeing, not just play music?" Years of rigorous testing, composing, and engineering led to this moment.

We have the manufacturing experience, the acoustic expertise, and the scientific partnerships to deliver exactly what we promise.

Founder’s Story

We Refused to Disappear.

My name isJuwon Heo, Founder & CEO ofMobiFren.

I began my career as a mobile engineer at Samsung Electronics, and for more than 20 years, I have devoted my life to Bluetooth audio. I have always believed that if we built something truly great, people would hear the difference. That belief shaped our sound philosophy, and it lives inside HealingFit TWS today.

But great products alone were not enough.

Years ago, a devastating partnership nearly destroyed our company. The distribution network we had built over two decades collapsed, sales plummeted, and a team of around 50 people was reduced to just six.

I chose to fight back.

I put everything on the line to protect the company and the technology we had built through years of effort, sacrifice, and engineering dedication. It was a painful struggle, and in the traditional sense, we may not have won that fight.

But we did not disappear.

Through restructuring, immense hardship, and court rehabilitation, we kept building. We continued advancing our technology, strengthening our patents, conducting clinical research, and proving our methods in the field. Our team became smaller, but our conviction became stronger.

Then came an important turning point:

At CES 2026, HealingFit TWS received an Innovation Award in Headphones & Personal Audio.

That recognition did not erase everything we had been through. But it proved something vital: the idea was real, the technology was alive, and our team still had something meaningful to bring to the world.

So why did we createHealingFit TWS?

"Because I have always believed that technology matters only when it makes everyday life better for the people who use it"

After 20 years in audio, I understood the technical limits of what was possible inside a TWS earphone. And after losing almost everything once, I also understood what kind of product truly matters.

Not just another gadget that tracks your condition.But something people can actually use in daily life to feel better.

"HealingFit TWS is our answer."

It works as a premium everyday wireless earphone. And when you need support for sleep, stress relief, or focus, it transforms into a TES wellness device through a simple magnetic connection.

When you back this campaign, you are not simply buying earphones.

You are supporting a small, resilient team in Gumi, Korea, a team that lost almost everything, chose to stand back up, and kept building anyway.

And we are already thinking beyond one product.

Our vision is a broader family of wellness devices designed to fit naturally into everyday life.HealingFit TWS is where that journey begins. It is not where it ends.

I have already survived the worst.Now I am asking for the chance to show you what comes next.

Juwon HeoFounder & CEO, MobiFren

We build products that are engineered with care, made to be used daily, and supported over time. We’ll communicate transparently throughout the campaign and deliver the quality we stand for.

Thank you for being part of our journey.

Risks and challenges

Bringing a complex device like HealingFit TWS which seamlessly integrates premium audio performance, advanced TES hardware, and intuitive app control into a compact true wireless design from concept to mass production comes with inherent challenges. However, our team is fully committed and prepared to mitigate these risks to deliver a high-quality product to your doorstep.

1. Manufacturing & Quality Control
Achieving the perfect ergonomic fit, precise electrode finishing, and reliable magnetic connections requires extremely tight manufacturing tolerances.

- Our Mitigation: We are collaborating with highly experienced manufacturing partners and implementing rigorous Quality Control (QC) checkpoints. We will continuously validate engineering samples to ensure that mass-produced units meet our strict premium standards.

2. Supply Chain & Global Logistics
In the current global manufacturing landscape, unexpected component shortages or international shipping delays can potentially impact our delivery schedule.

- Our Mitigation: We have already initiated early procurement for critical components and established alternative supply options. Furthermore, we have built realistic buffer times into our production and fulfillment schedules to account for unforeseen logistical hurdles.

3. Compliance & Certification
As an electronic device with a built-in battery and Bluetooth capabilities, HealingFit TWS must pass strict international safety, battery transport, and RF/EMC certifications.

- Our Mitigation: The device was designed from day one with global compliance standards in mind. We are beginning the certification testing process early with our pilot units to identify and resolve any issues long before mass production, preventing last-minute delays.

4. App & Firmware Stability
Ensuring seamless connectivity and app stability across a wide variety of smartphones and operating systems (iOS and Android) is an ongoing technical challenge.

- Our Mitigation: Our priority is delivering rock-solid core firmware at launch. We are conducting extensive internal testing across multiple devices. Post-launch, we are fully committed to providing continuous Over-The-Air (OTA) updates to optimize performance and refine the user experience.

Our Commitment to You
Transparency is our absolute priority. While we have planned meticulously, unexpected challenges can arise in hardware development. If we encounter any roadblocks, we promise to communicate openly, honestly, and provide you with timely updates throughout the entire journey. We are in this together.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

We utilized AI language models (such as ChatGPT and DeepL) to assist with the English translation and copywriting of our campaign story, ensuring our messaging is clear and natural for a global audience. Additionally, we used commercially available AI image generation tools to create a few minor lifestyle background elements in our photos. However, please note that the core product design, 3D renderings of the HealingFit TWS, technical diagrams, and the core concept are 100% original human creations developed entirely by our team.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

"Yes. For text generation and translation, we inputted our own original Korean copywriting into the AI tools. For any AI-assisted background images, we used commercially licensed AI tools (such as Adobe Firefly/Gemini) that are trained on legally cleared or public domain datasets, or we used our own original product photography as the base for generative fill. We hold all original rights to the core product concepts and actual product photos used.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We designed HealingFit TWS to be a long-lasting companion for your wellness journey. Instead of forcing users to buy new hardware for upgraded features, our device is fully integrated with the 'My HealingFit App,' which supports seamless Over-The-Air (OTA) software updates. This ensures your earbuds continuously receive the latest sound frequencies, improved relaxation modes, and performance enhancements. Additionally, we use premium, highly durable materials for the core device and standard, easily replaceable silicone ear tips, maximizing the hardware's lifespan and reducing electronic waste.

Reusability and recyclability

Our commitment to sustainability goes far beyond packaging; it is engineered into the very core of HealingFit TWS. We completely reject the concept of disposable tech. For our electrodes, we chose solid SUS316 stainless steel—the exact same material trusted in surgical implants worldwide. "Medical-Grade Purity. No Compromises." There are no degradable coatings and no shortcuts. The entire electrode is crafted from pure, medical-grade material to ensure permanent, uncompromising safety for your body. This guarantees that HealingFit TWS is built for semi-permanent use, offering the same level of safety and performance not just on day one, but year after year, thereby drastically reducing electronic waste over the product's lifetime.

projects.ai_intro_en: HealingFit TWS are premium true-wireless earbuds that double as a TES (Transcranial Electrical Stimulation) wellness device. By day, enjoy Hi-Fi audio for music and calls. When ready to reset, snap on the Magnetic TES Link™ for guided microcurrent and binaural beat sessions supporting sleep, relaxation, and focus.
ai_highlights_en: World's first TES wellness earbuds — snap on Magnetic TES Link™ for microcurrent sessions
Clinically tested: 6-week firefighter field study showed statistically significant sleep and relaxation gains
3 routine modes (Sleep/Healing/Study) with 15 intensity levels and 15 built-in binaural beat tracks
ai_specs_en: True Wireless Earbuds with TES Wellness
15 tracks (5 per mode) with binaural beats
projects.ai_risks_en: HealingFit TWS is a wellness device, not a medical device — it does not diagnose, treat, or cure medical conditions. Individual results may vary. TES technology, while studied in neuroscience, is delivered here as a consumer wellness product. The TES Link™ requires physical attachment between earbuds, limiting full wireless use during wellness sessions.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: CES 2026 Honoree company behind HealingFit, with TES technology validated through hospital clinical studies and a 6-week firefighter field study showing significant sleep and relaxation improvements.
projects.ai_description_en:
HealingFit TWS is the world's first true wireless earbud that combines premium Hi-Fi audio with Transdermal Electrical Stimulation (TES) wellness technology. Designed with a CES 2026 Awards Honoree pedigree, these earbuds deliver your everyday music, podcasts, and calls while also offering a discreet, private TES session whenever you need to wind down, reset your focus, or ease into sleep. The key innovation is the detachable Magnetic TES Link™, which attaches only when you want to activate TES-powered routines, letting you switch between standard audio mode and therapeutic mode seamlessly. A built-in library of three dedicated routine modes — Sleep, Healing, and Study — is accessible through the companion My HealingFit app on iOS and Android, giving you personalized control over your mental wellbeing.

The audio side of HealingFit TWS is engineered around MSTS™ technology and offers five distinct music modes, so sound quality stands on its own as a premium earbud. On the wellness side, the TES technology is not theoretical — it draws on proven microcurrent delivery validated in hospital clinical studies and extensive field testing, including a statistically significant six-week firefighter study with clinical EEG brainwave monitoring. Users consistently reported faster and more restorative sleep, lower stress levels after short sessions, and longer periods of focused attention. This is pre-production hardware with a track record, backed by real-world proof.

Backers who pledge receive the HealingFit TWS earbuds plus a Stress & Heart-Rate Check bonus feature at launch. To address risks, the team has implemented rigorous Quality Control checkpoints, early procurement of critical components, global compliance testing on pilot units, and a commitment to post-launch OTA firmware updates for continued stability across devices. Designed for the future of mental wellbeing, HealingFit TWS ships with everything you need to make these wellness routines part of your daily life.

projects.ai_intro_en: Craftphilia is an all-in-one frame and tufting system featuring smart automation and an expandable tufting area up to 70×140 cm. Designed for precise positioning and consistent output, it offers a load-and-run workflow for creators seeking unlimited freedom in textile art.
ai_highlights_en: Expandable tufting area up to 70×140 cm with extension kit
Smart automation with precise positioning for consistent output
All-in-one frame system with load-and-run simplicity
projects.ai_risks_en: As a new brand, Craftphilia faces typical crowdfunding risks including potential production material shortages and logistics disruptions beyond their control. However, they commit to prompt communication with backers and have partnered with Vinyl, an experienced Kickstarter marketing firm with over $200M raised since 2017.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Craftphilia Studio is a new brand launching on Kickstarter, partnered with Vinyl, an official Kickstarter Expert Partner that has raised over $200M since 2017.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Craftphilia is the world's first fully automated tufting machine, designed to bring smart rug-making capabilities to creators and craftspeople of all skill levels. The all-in-one frame and tufting system features an expandable tufting area up to 70×140 cm, allowing for projects ranging from small decorative pieces to large statement rugs.

The system integrates smart automation for hands-free operation, with precise positioning technology ensuring consistent stitch quality and pattern accuracy. The Craftphilia Studio software enables users to upload designs, control tufting parameters, and automate the production process. The machine supports a wide range of yarn types and materials for versatile creative possibilities.

Built with an expandable frame design, the Craftphilia grows with your projects—start small and scale up as your skills and ambitions grow. The project is backed by hands-on reviews and demonstrations showcasing its real-world performance and ease of use.
projects.nameZh: Craftphilia：全球首款全自动簇绒机
projects.ai_intro_zh: Craftphilia 是一款一体化框架和簇绒系统，具备智能自动化和可扩展至 70×140 厘米的簇绒区域。专为精确定位和一致输出而设计，提供即装即用的工作流程，为纺织艺术创作者带来无限自由。
projects.ai_description_zh:
Craftphilia 是全球首款全自动簇绒机，旨在将智能地毯制作能力带给各种技能水平的创作者和手工艺人。一体式框架和簇绒系统配备可扩展的簇绒区域，最大可达 70×140 厘米，支持从小型杯垫到大型挂毯的各种项目。

驱动 Craftphilia 的智能控制系统允许你上传任何设计图像，自动将其转换为簇绒图案。内置裁剪和换色辅助功能减少了传统簇绒中劳神耗时的步骤。尽管是桌面级设备，它保持了工业级精度和一致性。

Craftphilia 面向希望扩大生产规模的手工艺人、探索新材料的设计师，以及任何对将数字设计转化为实体纺织品感兴趣的人。通过消除手动簇绒的陡峭学习曲线，Craftphilia 让更多人能够以更少的前期投入进入地毯和纺织品制作领域。

Meet NexFold Fold 7

Not everyone needs the same screen. That's why NexFold comes in two versions.

Go withFHD 1080Pif you're looking for a sharp, capable display for daily work — browsing, writing, video calls, and more.

ChooseQHD 2.5Kif you're a developer, designer, or power user who lives in the details — where pixel density and color precision actually matter.

Same build. Same portability. You decide the resolution.

One Cable Any Laptop

Unlike most portable monitors, Fold 7 supports dual connection modes.

A Fold 7 can be connected tothree different computers at most. The specific connection methods are as follows:

Our product is equipped with a USB C-C cable, a USB A-C cable, an HDMI-mini HDMI cable and a power cord.

① USB C-C cable:three screens are lit through the full-function USB C interface with drivers; Only one screen below is lit up without installing a driver through the full-function USB C interface; Light up the above two screens through the non-full-function USB C interface with the driver; You can't light up any screen through a non-full-featured USB C interface without installing a driver.

② USB A-C cable:connected to the TypeC interface on the side of the display through the USB A interface of the notebook computer, to light up the two screens above; You can't light up any screen without installing a driver through USB A interface.

③ HDMI-mini HDMI cable:Connect to the three mini HDMI interfaces on the side of the monitor through the HDMI interface of the laptop, and light up the three screens respectively without installing drivers.

MacBook + iPad Simultaneous Setup

MacBook Connection:Use a USB data-only cable (USB A-C or non-full-function USB C-C) to link your MacBook.Please note that driver installation is mandatory for this connection to activate the display.

iPad Connection:Connect your iPad directly via a USB-C to Mini HDMI cable. This method is fully plug-and-play and requires no additional drivers.

Universal Compatibility

Compatible with Windows, macOS, Linux, and ChromeOS. If it has a screen, Fold 7 probably works with it.

NexFold Fold 7 began with a simple observation: modern work no longer happens on a single screen, yet most display setups still fail to match real workflows. Traditional desktop monitors take up too much space, single portable monitors offer too little room, and standard triple-monitor layouts often create unnecessary neck strain instead of improving focus.

We believed the problem was not just screen quantity, but screen arrangement. That insight led us to develop an inverted-L layout designed around how people actually work. The vertical display supports sequential tasks such as coding, reading, and document review. The horizontal display is better suited for reference materials, dashboards, and communication. At the center, the laptop remains the primary focus point, creating a workspace that feels more natural, efficient, and ergonomic.

Bringing that idea to life required 18 months of development and 47 prototypes. Across that process, our team refined the structure, hinge system, screen proportions, portability, and overall workflow fit until Fold 7 became a compact multi-screen setup built for real productivity.

projects.ai_intro_en: NexFold Fold 7 is the world's first triple-screen portable monitor with an inverted-L layout, featuring 3 x 16" screens designed for developers, designers, traders, and modern multitaskers. The layout reduces neck movement by 60% and improves task switching by 40% compared to traditional triple-monitor setups. It offers universal compatibility with Windows, macOS, Linux, and ChromeOS via a single cable connection.
ai_highlights_en: Inverted-L triple-screen layout with 3 x 16" displays — 60% less neck movement, 40% faster task switching
Two resolution options: FHD 1080P for daily work or QHD 2.5K for pixel-precise development and design
True portability — one-cable connection, fits 13"–18.5" laptops, built-in kickstand, adjustable clips

projects.ai_risks_en: The project is in small-batch trial production with an all-or-nothing funding deadline of July 14, 2026. Risks include potential manufacturing and delivery delays, driver installation requirements for some connection modes, and the unproven complexity of the hinge and clip mechanism at scale. Kickstarter campaigns carry inherent fulfillment risk.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Led by Jason (CMU Computer Science Master's, founder of a $10M+ funded AI startup) and Jimmy (Co-founder of BayAI Circle, Head of AGI Summit, Visiting Prof. at Caltech); promoted by Jellop.
projects.ai_description_en:
The NexFold Fold 7 is the world's first triple-screen portable monitor featuring an innovative inverted-L layout. Designed specifically for developers, designers, traders, creators, and modern multitaskers, it solves the fundamental flaw of traditional triple-monitor setups that prioritize symmetry over actual usability. By aligning the three 16-inch screens within your natural field of view, Fold 7 reduces neck movement by 60% and speeds up task switching by 40%, proving that more screens shouldn't mean more physical strain or desk clutter.

Expanding your workspace without expanding your physical footprint, the Fold 7 delivers 30% more viewing area than standard 14-inch portable monitors. Its 16:10 aspect ratio provides superior vertical space for lengthy code and documents, significantly reducing scrolling and window switching. To cater to varying professional needs, it comes in two versions: FHD 1080P for sharp daily work like browsing and video calls, and QHD 2.5K for power users who demand extreme pixel density and color precision. Universal compatibility ensures this desktop-class setup works seamlessly with Windows, macOS, Linux, ChromeOS, and even allows for simultaneous MacBook and iPad setups.

True versatility comes from its advanced connectivity and travel-ready portability. Equipped with USB-C, USB-A, and HDMI to Mini HDMI interfaces, the Fold 7 can connect to up to three different computers, supporting both driver-required and plug-and-play setups depending on the connection mode. Setup is remarkably simple and secure; adjustable clips and a built-in kickstand allow it to attach firmly to laptops ranging from 13 to 18.5 inches. By collapsing massive multitasking power into a single, portable device, the NexFold Fold 7 ensures that high-efficiency workflows are no longer tethered to a desk.

projects.ai_intro_zh: NexFold Fold 7 是全球首款采用倒 L 型布局的三屏便携显示器，配备 3 块 16 英寸屏幕，专为开发者、设计师、交易员和现代多任务处理者设计。与传统三显示器设置相比，该布局减少 60% 的颈部移动，提升 40% 的任务切换效率。通过单线缆连接，兼容 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 ChromeOS。
projects.ai_description_zh:
NexFold Fold 7 是全球首款采用创新倒 L 型布局的三屏便携显示器。专为开发者、设计师、交易员、创作者和现代多任务处理者设计，它解决了传统三屏方案优先考虑对称性而牺牲实际可用性的根本缺陷。通过将三个 16 英寸屏幕排列在自然视野内，Fold 7 减少了 60% 的颈部移动，加速了 40% 的任务切换，证明了更多屏幕不应意味着更多的身体劳损或桌面杂乱。

在不扩大物理占地的情况下扩展工作空间，Fold 7 比标准 14 英寸便携显示器提供了 30% 以上的可视面积。16:10 的宽高比为长篇代码和文档提供了卓越的垂直空间，显著减少滚动和窗口切换。为满足不同专业需求，提供两个版本：FHD 1080P 适用于浏览和视频通话等日常清晰工作，QHD 2.5K 适用于要求极致像素密度和色彩精度的专业用户。通用兼容性确保这套桌面级方案可与 Windows、macOS、Linux、ChromeOS 无缝配合，甚至支持同时连接 MacBook 和 iPad。

真正的多功能性来自其先进的连接性和旅行便携性。配备 USB-C、USB-A 和 HDMI 转 Mini HDMI 接口，Fold 7 可同时连接最多三台不同电脑，根据连接模式支持需要驱动程序和即插即用两种方式。安装异常简单且安全——可调节夹子和内置支架使其可牢固固定在 13 至 18.5 英寸的笔记本电脑上。通过将强大的多任务处理能力压缩到单一便携设备中，NexFold Fold 7 确保高效工作流程不再被束缚在桌面上。

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/056/762/620bf5919d4cdd00ad335503c8b293a2_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781081146&width=680&sig=t8t7kvo%2BrR1ynMRSxh3iJFZP%2FWR%2BLJB%2Fdlv5L8gdNvw%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/094/b7eb1e66a363bc2c65a7af2a0d20904c_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781231278&width=680&sig=H8lAFRmeTkNj6RcPjU710UeJ6wJkXHK9M4U%2FobthsjI%3D)

Many must travel with temperature-sensitive items like insulin. But once it loses cooling, it risks total failure.

Ice packs are a gamble. How long will they last? What if there’s a delay? Often, the cooling fails before you even arrive.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/083/668/566c0c277bf5ae98f38375776e49a71f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781257853&width=680&sig=dLdTZD5S8kBUQFeO4j%2BOBBqGneAq88e%2F8GTadYJGZfU%3D)

Don't let fear dictate your life. Stop canceling trips or staying home just to protect your temp-sensitive items. Compromise shouldn't be the norm.

It’s time for a change.

Meet NEVILO.

Powered by semiconductor cooling + biogel cooling, NEVILO replaces the ticking clock of ice packs with reliable, constant temperature stability. No more checking the ice. No more travel anxiety.

Stop planning around your temp-sensitive items, travel should be about freedom.

### Meet NEVILO Travel Cooler Case

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/124/066/5a4ddf4a9369d1d52d7751e52cb1e034_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781591198&width=680&sig=jCbo8p2kDJly9QeiDWVH5LDXZINKM1Fr0aM2sluf5%2B8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/083/667/45f6db2bec8b2f555cc816f8c58b2eb3_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781257847&width=680&sig=KeW%2FG8xU4sppbZXw30f2IIr9JPWohvwGCqNC3X4W%2FyU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/108/897/e01d3e7f18e32c296967d0fab924f434_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781497941&width=680&sig=p0bu7bwFo1WTM3djzG3YincoqAeUPTGxIUaBghHF2XI%3D)

Powered by advanced upgraded semiconductor technology, NEVILO eliminates the bulk and noise of traditional compressors to deliver instant, precise cooling from 2–20°C in a quiet and reliable system.

This electronic cooling is combined with Biogel-assisted passive retention in a single cup-shaped travel cooler case that is neither a disposable ice pack nor just an insulated bottle. It is a visible, adjustable, power-readyportable smart cooler case designed for stable temp-sensitive storage like insulin on the go.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/136/349/80127bdaeaab3f53f57151c1c6eeed7e_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781664578&width=680&sig=SRcAq8lusgwzvABbKIjLP77fLaMF3rnF9viYjEdAEfs%3D)

### How It Works？

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/124/075/e76921425761f43edf8b83f2009dfe19_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781591238&width=680&sig=qUa2Kc84wNnXNMEplj5FVXkuJHZHwcPNIZ5YiEKYydQ%3D)

NEVILO offers 2 different ways to use its cooling function. Follow these steps for optimal performance:

Passive Biogel Cooling — For Transit Best for: flights, commutes, and any situation where you’re on the move.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/124/730/0989e4cbda5580f81c6c8eb55caa5b25_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781595422&width=680&sig=CTi1YWBb1yI11mARoJ60C%2Bw8mr4ibWa9irPgBsE87Pk%3D)

Before your trip, freeze the included Biogel in your freezer for 10–12 hours. Place the frozen Biogel and your items into the cup, then screw the lid on tightly. In this unpowered state, the vacuum-insulated cup body combined with the Biogel maintains low temperatures for approximately 6–8 hours.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/082/259/da5f1d4423ae338f4cf7a555335cb766_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781249552&width=680&sig=MdF8aQzdK2TYeKG1jdXX0eQPAKa1AgAYMLSWg46Tj%2Bk%3D)

✅ During this, NEVILO can be safely stored in a backpack or luggage.

Active Cooling Mode — When You’re Stationary Best for: hotel rooms, car rides, office desks, or anywhere you can set it down in open air.

Once the Biogel loses its cooling effect, activate NEVILO’s built-in active cooling mode. NEVILO comes with a built-in 10,000mAh battery that powers the cooling module independently. On a full charge, it maintains your set temperature for approximately 6–7 hours.

For extended use, we recommend keeping NEVILO plugged in (home outlet, power bank, or car charger) whenever possible. Plugging into external power maximizes your cooling time, providing uninterrupted comfort throughout your journey.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/082/233/f5fbf870c3c539087a3dfc3d795a5aa8_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781249321&width=680&sig=IM7lG%2BkjE9FPU7nW65cTjQAURbI9oFfD%2FLaOSyP4sbw%3D)

we believe trust starts with transparency. We're ready to bring this project to life, but we also recognize there may be challenges along the way — and we're prepared for them.

projects.ai_intro_en: The NEVILO Travel Cooler Case is a portable, cup-shaped cooling device designed for temperature-sensitive items like insulin pens. It combines semiconductor active cooling with biogel passive retention to maintain precise temperatures between 2-20°C, featuring a real-time LED display and TSA-approved design for worry-free travel.
ai_highlights_en: Dual cooling system: semiconductor active + biogel passive for 2-20°C precision control
Compact cup-shaped design fits car cup holders and holds up to 7 insulin pens
Built-in 10,000mAh battery delivers 6-7 hours of active cooling without external power
projects.ai_risks_en: Not a medical device. Temperature rebounds to room level in approximately 20 minutes after power loss. Requires ventilation when active—must not be used in closed bags or luggage. Operating environment limited to 0-35°C. Battery-dependent active cooling requires external power source for extended use.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: For many people who need to carry insulin or other temperature-sensitive items, travel is not just about packing. It also means repeatedly checking whether items has overheated, left a cooled environment, or can continue to be stored properly at the destination.
projects.ai_description_en:
For individuals who rely on temperature-sensitive medications like insulin, traveling often means trading adventure for anxiety. Traditional ice packs are an unreliable gamble, frequently failing before the final destination and forcing travelers to cancel trips or stay home out of fear. The NEVILO Smart Cooler Case changes this paradigm, replacing the ticking clock of ice packs with precise, constant temperature stability. Engineered specifically for life on the go, this TSA-approved, power-ready device ensures that traveling becomes about freedom, not fear.

NEVILO leverages a dual-mode cooling system that combines advanced semiconductor technology with Biogel-assisted passive retention. In passive mode—ideal for transit, flights, and commutes—freezing the included Biogel for 10-12 hours and placing it inside the vacuum-insulated cup maintains cool temperatures for 6-8 hours unpowered. Once stationary, the active cooling mode takes over; powered by a built-in 10,000mAh battery, the upgraded semiconductor module delivers precise, quiet cooling for up to 6-7 hours without the bulk or noise of traditional compressors. 

Precision is at the core of NEVILO's design, featuring an adjustable temperature range of 2°C to 20°C maintained within ±1°C accuracy. A real-time LED display provides instant visibility of the internal chamber temperature, completely eliminating the guesswork of traditional cooler bags, while a Celsius/Fahrenheit toggle keeps users informed at a glance. Despite its specialized function, the compact, vertical travel-cup form factor measuring 291 mm tall is deceptively spacious, holding up to 7 insulin pens. Lightweight and effortlessly portable, NEVILO slips seamlessly into any bag, making both daily commutes and international travel completely hassle-free.
