projects.blurb: The Automatic Resin Management Device That Works With Any Resin 3D Printer
projects.html_story:
The Automatic Resin Management Device That Works With Any Resin 3D Printer

The Automatic Resin Management Device That Works With Any Resin 3D Printer

AutoFILL Solves the Problems

Applications & Industries

Creator Reviews & Beta Tester Feedback

Compatible With Most Resin Printers

Technical Specifications

Versions and Rewards

AutoFILL DIY Kit Version

Pre-Built Fully Assembled AutoFILL

Featured Add-on Items

The Timeline & Budget

Where Your Support Goes

The Team Behind AutoFILL

Why we need you...

Environmental commitments

Resin 3D printing often comes down to managing a few key challenges around the print itself.

Running out of resin mid-print, handling messy manual refills, constantly checking on long jobs, and resin separation during extended prints can all lead to failed prints, wasted time & money.

These are common issues that interrupt workflow and make reliable printing harder than it needs to be.

It’s time to remove the guesswork around resin levels and keep every print consistent from start to finish.

Set it up. Press print. Walk away.

AutoFILL Solves the Problems

AutoFILL is designed to address these issues directly, with features that work in real printing environments.

Every resin printer relies on a stable vat level to produce consistent results.

When levels drop during a print, it can lead to failed layers, incomplete parts, and wasted time. AutoFILL automatically maintains the correct resin level throughout the entire print, eliminating the need for manual top-ups and reducing the risk of failure.

The system monitors the resin level in real time and responds as needed. It adds resin when levels drop, and can also empty or circulate the resin to maintain consistency during long prints or idle periods.

Once installed, AutoFILL becomes part of your normal workflow rather than something you need to think about.

AutoFILL is quick to set up and simple to use.

Just place the UV-safe silicone tube in any-size bottle or container, select the desired automatic mode, and position the sensor. The system runs in the background, maintaining consistent resin levels throughout your print, emptying the vat when needed, or cycling the resin to prevent settling during idle periods such as weekends.

Controlled using a simple rotary dial and colour display.

The menu system is designed to be quick to navigate, even when wearing gloves. From here, you can configure automatic filling, set mixing cycles, empty the vat, adjust safety timers and customise how the system operates with your printer.

The menu is organised into clear, easy-to-follow sections.

Navigate between modes, settings, and information, with a simple structure that makes everything fast to find. Rotate the dial to navigate the menu icons, then press to select the desired function.

AutoFILL is built around practical features designed to solve everyday printing challenges.

Each function works together to maintain stable resin levels, reduce handling, and deliver consistent results across every print.

Built with core features designed by people who actually 3D print.

AutoFILL is designed for day-to-day use, automatically managing resin levels, reducing manual handling, and keeping prints consistent from start to finish. It helps prevent failures, minimises mess, and keeps your workflow running without interruption.

Applications & Industries

Designed for a wide range of resin printing applications.

AutoFILL supports everything from dental and medical models to engineering prototypes, film and television props, and hobby or modelling projects.

Whether you are producing precise functional parts or detailed creative pieces, it maintains consistent resin levels so you can focus on the result rather than managing the process.

Creator Reviews & Beta Tester Feedback

AutoFILL has been tested by creators, engineers, dental professionals and beta users across a range of resin printers and applications. Watch their experiences and see AutoFILL in action.

Dennys Wang | YouTube

Dennys printed the kit components, assembled the system, calibrated AutoFILL and demonstrated it running on his Phrozen Sonic 12K Printer.

“AutoFILL is fast, the interface is simple and intuitive, and the timer safety and sensor system provide excellent protection against overfilling.”

Nathan Bray | The Smelter's Apprentice | YouTube

Nathan printed the kit components, assembled the system, and tested AutoFILL on his Elegoo Jupiter 2, comparing it directly with the printer’s standard resin-feeding system.

“AutoFILL is a much more robust autofill solution. You would literally never run out, regardless of how big your print is, and it’s about as easy as it gets.”

Dr Isidoro Ferito | Dental Laboratory

Dr Isi printed and assembled two complete AutoFILL kits before testing the system in his busy dental practice using high-speed Uniz NBee printers. He demonstrates how automatic resin filling and emptying help maintain consistent printing and reduce interruptions caused by failures throughout the day.

“It takes the concern about resin levels out of the picture. I used to top up 5 or 6 times a day, now I don't have to think about it. AutoFILL removes another manual step from our workflow.”

MorgensternPrinting | 3D Printing CreatorThomas from

Thomas produced an in-depth, independent review of AutoFILL, showcasing the complete experience from installation and assembly through to real-world printing on his Anycubic P1 3D printer. In the video, he demonstrates the key features, highlights the support-free DIY design and shares his hands-on impressions after successfully completing a print using the AutoFILL system.

"The coolest part is that you print and build it yourself. It’s extremely easy to print. My print completed perfectly thanks to the AutoFILL system. Monocure3D have thought of everything."

Compatible With Most Resin Printers

AutoFILL has been designed to work with a wide range of MSLA and DLP resin printers. The adjustable sensor system and flexible mounting options allow AutoFILL to be adapted to many popular printer brands and models.

Technical Specifications

Versions and Rewards

AutoFILL is available in two versions, so you can choose the one that best suits your setup.

AutoFILL DIY Kit Version

A hands-on project that is simple to put together, with a clear, step-by-step guide that makes the whole process easy to follow from start to finish. The parts are designed to fit together neatly, so you can build it with confidence, even if you have not done something like this before.

Includes all electronics, pump, sensor, tubing, fasteners, and 1kg of resin to print the enclosure parts using the supplied STL and STEP files. Ideal for makers, hobbyists and anyone who enjoys building and customising their own setup.

Pre-Built Fully Assembled AutoFILL

A fully assembled and tested unit, ready to install.Includes everything required to connect AutoFILL to your printer and resin container. Best suited to labs, production users, or anyone who wants a plug-in solution.

Featured Add-on Items

Enhance your AutoFILL experience with a range of optional add-ons and accessories. From additional AutoFILL systems and resin supplies to designer housings and bulk resin management solutions, customise your setup to suit your workflow.

The Timeline & Budget

AutoFILL is not just a concept.

Development began in April 2024.

Multiple PCB revisions and mechanical prototypes have been built and tested.

Working units are already running in real printing environments.

The control software and hardware are stable and validated.

A group of beta testers is currently using the system and providing feedback.

This Kickstarter focuses on scaling production and finalising manufacturing, not on inventing the product.

Where Your Support Goes

Every AutoFILL unit is designed, assembled, tested and supported by our team. Your backing helps fund manufacturing, component sourcing, quality control, fulfilment, and ongoing product development to ensure a reliable final product.

The Team Behind AutoFILL

AutoFILL was developed by the team at Monocure3D to solve a common problem faced by resin printer users: long prints failing when the vat runs low.

Drawing on years of experience in resin chemistry, 3D printing, and hardware development, the entire system has been designed, tested, and refined in-house. From the electronics and firmware to the mechanical design, AutoFILL was built by people who use resin printers every day.

The result is a practical, reliable solution that helps maintain consistent resin levels, reduce interruptions, and minimise failed prints.

Meet the Engineer Behind AutoFILL | Owen Dyne

Owen Dyne joined Monocure3D after completing his university work experience with us and is now in his final year of a Bachelor of Mechatronic Engineering at the University of Sydney.

With years of resin 3D printing experience, Owen designed the AutoFILL electronics, including the custom USB-C Power Delivery PCB, and developed the support-free enclosure through hundreds of printed prototypes and refinements. His goal was to create a design that prints reliably without supports, looks professional and is quick and easy to assemble with as few parts as possible.

Owen also leads much of our technical support, where his passion for helping people solve printing problems has made him a valued member of the Monocure3D team.

AutoFILL is designed for efficient, small-batch manufacturing.

Assembly and testing will be handled in controlled production runs.Each unit will be tested before shipping.

Worldwide shipping is planned, with regional fulfilment where possible.

AutoFILL is built to be reliable and easy to maintain. Every unit is backed by a 12-month warranty covering manufacturing faults in materials and workmanship.

If something is not working as expected, our team will work with you to diagnose the issue and provide a solution. This may include troubleshooting support, replacement parts, or repair where required.

Support is provided directly by the team that developed AutoFILL, with practical knowledge of both the system and real-world resin printing. We aim to respond quickly and provide clear, actionable guidance to keep your setup running smoothly.

For kit versions, the warranty covers all supplied electronic components and hardware. Printed parts are user-produced and can be easily replaced using the provided files if needed.

Ongoing support includes access to setup guides, firmware updates, and direct assistance via email. Replacement parts and consumables will also be available for purchase.

Our goal is simple. Keep your AutoFILL running reliably so you can focus on printing.

Why we need you...

AutoFILL is a practical tool. It is not designed to change how resin printing works, but to make it run more smoothly and reliably.

If you are tired of failed prints due to resin levels, AutoFILL is built for you.

Back AutoFILL on Kickstarter and help bring this system into regular production.

Risks and challenges

AutoFILL has already progressed well beyond the concept stage. Working prototypes have been built and tested with beta users, allowing us to refine the design, firmware and assembly process. However, as with any new hardware product, we still face challenges that we continue to manage. We need your help to get it to the next stage. 

The system uses widely available electronic components and standard fittings to reduce supply chain risks. If a specific component becomes difficult to source, compatible alternatives can be substituted without major redesign.

Firmware development is ongoing to ensure reliable pump control, accurate sensor readings and safe operation. This work continues alongside beta testing so we can refine the system before full production.

The kit version requires assembly, so we are preparing clear step-by-step instructions and a full video build guide. The design uses simple mechanical parts and pre-made wiring harnesses to keep the process straightforward.

Production and fulfilment will be handled by the Monocure3D team in Sydney. With more than 45 years of experience in manufacturing and shipping products worldwide, we are well prepared to manage production and delivery.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

AI tools have been used to assist with some of the campaign content, including early concept visuals, layout ideas, and draft text for sections of the Kickstarter page. These were used as a starting point only. All final product design, engineering, photography, videos, and graphics shown in the campaign are original and created in-house. Any AI-assisted content has been reviewed, edited, and refined to accurately represent the product and its features.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. Any AI tools used rely on licensed or publicly available training data provided by the platform. No third-party copyrighted materials, proprietary designs, or identifiable works have been directly used or reproduced. All final content has been created, reviewed, and approved by our team to ensure it is original and does not infringe on the rights of others.

Environmental commitments

AutoFILL is designed to reduce resin waste and extend product life.

By maintaining consistent resin levels and returning unused resin back to the bottle, the system helps minimise spills, contamination and material loss during printing and cleaning.

The housing is not injection moulded. Instead, the structural parts are supplied as 3D printed components. If a part becomes damaged, the customer can simply print a replacement rather than discarding the entire unit. We will also provide STEP files so users can modify or adapt the parts if required.

The system is designed to be serviceable, with components such as pumps, tubing and sensors able to be replaced individually. This approach helps extend the usable life of the product and reduces unnecessary electronic waste.

projects.ai_risks_en:
AutoFILL has already progressed well beyond the concept stage. Working prototypes have been built and tested with beta users, allowing us to refine the design, firmware and assembly process. However, as with any new hardware product, we still face challenges that we continue to manage. We need your help to get it to the next stage. 

The system uses widely available electronic components and standard fittings to reduce supply chain risks. If a specific component becomes difficult to source, compatible alternatives can be substituted without major redesign.

Firmware development is ongoing to ensure reliable pump control, accurate sensor readings and safe operation. This work continues alongside beta testing so we can refine the system before full production.

The kit version requires assembly, so we are preparing clear step-by-step instructions and a full video build guide. The design uses simple mechanical parts and pre-made wiring harnesses to keep the process straightforward.

Production and fulfilment will be handled by the Monocure3D team in Sydney. With more than 45 years of experience in manufacturing and shipping products worldwide, we are well prepared to manage production and delivery.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Monocure3D develops practical resin 3D printing accessories, designed by people who actually 3D print.
projects.ai_description_en:
AutoFILL Resin Management System for 3D Printers

AutoFILL is an automatic resin management device designed to work with any resin 3D printer, eliminating some of the most persistent pain points in resin printing. Running out of resin mid-print, dealing with messy manual refills, constantly monitoring long print jobs, and resin separation during extended idle periods can all lead to failed prints, wasted materials, and inconsistent results. AutoFILL addresses these issues directly by automatically maintaining the correct resin level in the vat throughout the entire print cycle.

The system uses real-time monitoring to track resin levels and respond as needed—adding resin when levels drop, emptying the vat when required, or circulating the resin to prevent separation during long prints or weekend idle time. Users simply place the UV-safe silicone tube into any standard bottle or container, select the desired automatic mode, and position the sensor. Once configured, the system works in the background, requiring no manual top-ups or intervention. Operation is handled through a colour display and rotary dial, with a menu system designed to be navigable while wearing gloves, allowing users to configure automatic filling, set mixing cycles, adjust safety timers, and customize behavior.

AutoFILL is designed for a wide range of resin printing applications, including dental and medical models, engineering prototypes, film and television props, and hobby or modelling projects. Whether producing precise functional parts or detailed creative pieces, consistent resin levels are essential for reliable output. The system is compatible with most resin printers and uses widely available electronic components and standard fittings to minimize supply chain risks, with compatible alternatives available if specific parts become difficult to source. Backers can choose between a DIY kit version, which includes all electronics, pump components, and resin to print the enclosure parts without supports, or a pre-built fully assembled unit. Production and fulfilment will be managed by the Monocure3D team in Sydney, which brings more than 45 years of experience manufacturing and shipping products worldwide to the project.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/011/055/be9ef7d57e7e7c52623f89db7bda8da2_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780746424&width=680&sig=KHnYADDaHJvrL7sq8oFQd1%2B%2FQPNc%2BQIuwgCfgtO%2BKI8%3D)

Memoir was founded by Ashwin Radhakrishna and Mohan Kashivasi, who together bring more than four decades of experience building embedded systems, connected devices, and consumer technology products. Backed by a multidisciplinary team spanning hardware engineering, firmware, software, mechanical design, manufacturing, and product experience, Memoir is being developed end-to-end by the people building it.

The team brings expertise from leading technology companies including Qualcomm, Broadcom, Freescale, and STMicroelectronics, and has collectively contributed to the development and shipment of millions of connected devices used around the world. This experience helps ensure that Memoir is not only thoughtfully designed, but also engineered, tested, and prepared for reliable production at scale.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/271/353/69d200138757f4e59edd175d44235f22_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782739160&width=680&sig=zwpJ%2Fd%2FFY5rhsDqKB8OYzfOmDznLa5QRYTlxosIvEvc%3D)

Over the past year, we've transformed Memoir from an idea into a fully functional product through multiple prototype iterations, extensive testing, and continuous refinement across hardware, software, and user experience.

Memoir represents thousands of engineering hours, countless design iterations, and a relentless focus on creating a display experience that feels more natural, beautiful, and thoughtfully integrated into everyday living. Today, we're excited to bring Memoir to life with the support of the Kickstarter community.

#### Behind the scenes of how Memoir was built

Frame-Integrated PCB Testing

All three MEMOIR frame sizes undergoing live bench testing with the custom PCB mounted directly within each unit, validating power stability, display performance, and hardware integration ahead of manufacturing production.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/385/edf14ffd2db4c25141e3e9e09fafb205_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781090645&width=680&sig=0tlnu5OQx8To4jJIy1MnRYR5q5xYNCui%2F5SPJrvFAI8%3D)

Injection Moulding Preparation

Our mechanical frame design is undergoing iterative 3D print validation to finalize geometry, internal mounting points, and manufacturability ahead of injection mould production.

## Risks and challenges

We're incredibly excited to bring Memoir to Kickstarter, and we're confident in our ability to deliver.

Unlike many crowdfunding projects, Memoir is not just a concept or early-stage prototype. The core hardware, firmware, software, cloud infrastructure, and mobile application have already been developed and validated through multiple prototype iterations. Our focus is now on scaling production and delivering a polished product to our backers.

That said, manufacturing hardware always comes with some level of risk.

The most likely challenge we may encounter is related to component procurement, supplier lead times, or quality control during production. Memoir relies on premium display modules and carefully selected electronic components, and while we've established relationships with experienced manufacturing partners and suppliers, occasional delays can occur due to component availability, production scheduling, or quality assurance requirements.

If any issue arises, our priority will always be quality over speed. Rather than shipping a product that doesn't meet our standards, we'll take the necessary time to resolve the issue and ensure every Memoir frame delivers the experience we've promised.

The good news is that the most challenging part of the journey-product development-is already behind us. With a working product, validated prototypes, established suppliers, and an experienced engineering team, we believe the remaining risks are manageable and primarily related to manufacturing timelines rather than product feasibility.

Our commitment is simple: transparent communication, regular updates, and a relentless focus on quality.

No shortcuts. No surprises. Just Memoir, made right.

## Use of AI

Thoughtfully Integrated AI

Memoir is first and foremost a beautiful way to display and relive your favorite memories. To make that experience even more creative and personalized, the Memoir companion app includes optional AI-powered editing tools.

These features help you transform, enhance, and reimagine your photos before sending them to your Memoir display. Depending on your needs, AI can help:

Replace or enhance backgrounds

Create artistic styles such as sketch, watercolor, oil painting, or cartoon-inspired artwork

Restore and colorize old photographs

Remove unwanted objects or distractions

Generate professional-looking portraits and headshots

Combine and enhance multiple images

Improve lighting, clarity, and overall image quality

Every image is automatically optimized for Memoir's color E-Ink display, ensuring visuals look crisp, vibrant, and natural on the frame.

We use trusted third-party AI technologies to power these capabilities and do not train our own AI models using customer content. Your photos remain yours, and our goal is simply to provide creative tools that help bring your memories to life in new and meaningful ways.

While AI can help create stunning visuals, it remains entirely optional. Memoir delivers a beautiful experience whether you use AI-enhanced images or simply display the photos and moments you already love.

projects.ai_intro_en: Memoir is a paper-like E-Ink digital frame for displaying photos, artwork, and memories. It's wireless, portable, features a long-lasting battery, and works with iOS and Android. Available in 3 sizes with instant updates from your phone and AI features.
ai_highlights_en: Paper-like E-Ink display with TrueTone™ technology for a natural, glare-free viewing experience
Wireless, lightweight, and portable with long-lasting battery and instant phone updates
Available in 3 sizes with AI features, designed as a thoughtful gift for modern homes
projects.ai_risks_en: Primary risks involve component procurement, supplier lead times, and quality control during manufacturing. The team has working prototypes, validated hardware/software, and established supplier relationships. They prioritize quality over speed and will delay shipment rather than compromise standards.

projects.ai_description_en:
Memoir is a paper-like E-Ink digital frame that displays photos, artwork, and curated moments with a calm, natural aesthetic designed for modern living. Available in three sizes — Small (7.3"), Medium (13.3"), and Large — each frame features the Memoir TrueTone™ Display, a screen engineered to mimic the look and feel of printed paper. Unlike traditional digital displays, Memoir runs wirelessly with no visible cables and is powered by a long-lasting battery, making it truly portable. Whether mounted on a wall, placed on a bedside table, or attached to a fridge with the included magnet, the frame is designed to move seamlessly throughout your home and life.

Each Memoir frame is easy to update instantly from your smartphone via a dedicated mobile app compatible with both iOS and Android. The product also incorporates AI features that enhance the user experience, though specific capabilities are not detailed in the provided content. The frames are lightweight and built to feel like wall art while remaining subtle enough to blend into any space. With its combination of portability, elegant design, and effortless connectivity, Memoir aims to make displaying cherished memories as natural as hanging a physical photograph.

Memoir is backed by an experienced team with over four decades of combined expertise in embedded systems, connected devices, and consumer technology, with backgrounds spanning Qualcomm, Broadcom, Freescale, and STMicroelectronics. The product has already been developed and validated through multiple prototype iterations, with hardware, firmware, software, cloud infrastructure, and the mobile application all complete. The remaining focus is on scaling production, with the team prioritizing quality over speed and maintaining transparent communication with backers throughout the process.

projects.name: ADSBee Winglet!
projects.blurb: Winglet is an open source ADS-B receiver designed for portable aircraft tracking and electronic flight bag applications.
projects.hw_reason: ADS-B receiver for aircraft tracking
projects.ai_intro_en: Pants for Birds LLC is a hardware company based in Campbell, CA. We specialize in building embedded solutions for aircraft tracking, with open source schematics and firmware. Our open source ADS-B receiver project, ADSBee, has been deployed in applications ranging from industrial ground stations to weather balloons. We have fielded many requests from users of ADSBee to integrate the additional sensors required for turning it into a fully self-contained electronic flight bag receiver. After half a year of research and development, we're excited to announce the result of our efforts: ADSBee Winglet!
ai_highlights_en: Tri-band Receiver Tracks up to 400 targets simultaneously: aircraft via ADS-B using 1090 MHz Mode S + 978 MHz UAT and drones via 2.4 GHz Remote ID.
It also received FIS-B Weather and TIS-B Traffic reports via UAT.

Built for the Cockpit, Awesome Anywhere Winglet can be affixed to the inside of an aircraft for use during flight, and provides both ADS-B in and GPS position to your favorite electronic flight bag app.
ai_specs_en: backup AHRS with onboard IMU + magnetometer attitude reference
Track logging is also provided via SD card
Cabin carbon monoxide (CO) monitoring with an audible alert for added safety
Detachable holster clip compatible with Sentry-style window mounts
Visible Day or Night Illuminated front panel with ePaper screen, with auto-dimming status lights and backlit keypad
12+ hours of battery life, USB-C fast charging, and a user serviceable battery - no desoldering required!
User serviceable battery - no desoldering required!
User serviceable battery - no desoldering required!
User serviceable battery - no desoldering required!

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Engineers at Pants for Birds LLC have built embedded hardware for demanding applications ranging from industrial warehouse robotics to VR headsets and delivery drones.

### 📖·Our Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/951/892/f3b9f8758b6e5f19a82afe4f76ccffcb_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780364528&width=680&sig=iIvZVH2wncd4Ic8nrJSYsyf3zzp%2BizriAg7JJ5djtvU%3D)

Founded in 2017, the WASHWOW team has spent nine years focusing on the R&D of electrolyzed water technology. Committed to developing chemical-free cleaning solutions, our electrolyzed water cleaning products feature superior environmental friendliness and health benefits, and we aim to raise wider public awareness of such products going forward.

We have successfully launched eight Kickstarter campaigns centered on laundry and personal care categories, with consistent upgrades to electrolysis formulas, electrode design and safety standards. Our core technology is patent-protected, and all our products have passed official third-party testing and certification.

Several members on our team are pet parents. We've long been troubled by cleaning muddy paws after outdoor walks: grime hides deep between paw toes, plain water and wipes struggle to clear hidden residual dirt, while most commercial paw cleaners contain irritating ingredients or are awkward for daily use. We searched widely yet found no product on the market that fully fits our needs.

That’s what pushed us to develop our exclusive paw cleaner. We customized a mild, pet-safe electrolyzed formula via rounds of internal testing, to be gentler on pets and handier for pet owners.

We are not new to the pet industry, but a mature brand with years of experience in electrolytic cleansing. Our products stand up to real tests and the test of time.

It's no fancy gadget — just a practical tool built by a pet parent, for pet parents.

No chemical detergents are required when in use; just fill it with tap water.

About Rokibot Team

Driven by a passion for outdoor innovation, Rokibot combines AI robotics technology with advanced intelligent manufacturing to create reliable outdoor automation solutions. Our mission is to make lawn care smarter, easier, and more accessible for households worldwide.

Rokibot is backed by KEN Holding Co., LTD. (SZSE: 300126), a publicly traded company with over 25 years of experience in precision manufacturing and professional-grade power systems. Backed by this strong manufacturing foundation, Rokibot benefits from extensive engineering expertise, stable supply chain support, and scalableproduction capabilities.

From product design to real-world testing, our team focuses on building outdoor robots that perform reliably in complex lawn environments and everyday use.

Connect with Rokibot

Risks and challenges

Like any crowdfunding venture, there are inherent risks and challenges we need to acknowledge. However, our robust experience in production fuels our confidence in being able to circumvent unexpected issues during the manufacturing process.

In the launch of any new product, it's only natural to encounter surprises along the way. One of the unique aspects of Kickstarter is the invitation it extends to backers to become a part of this creative process, giving you an insider's view into the intricacies of product development and manufacturing.

During the final stages of development and manufacturing, we commit to maintaining open lines of communication, offering regular updates to keep you informed and involved. We truly appreciate your support and understanding as we embark on this journey together, and we strive to ensure your satisfaction with the final product.

1. AI-Powered Perception & Multi-Sensor Fusion System

Our robotic mower uses an AI-powered perception and multi-sensor fusion system to enable intelligent navigation, mapping, and obstacle avoidance.

2. AI Visual Perception & Obstacle Avoidance

The mower is equipped with a stereo vision camera system combined with deep learning-based AI models to understand the environment in real time.

A Dense Depth Estimation Network builds a real-time 3D map of the surroundings by calculating distance information from stereo images.

A semantic segmentation model identifies and classifies common garden objects (such as people, pets, toys, furniture, rocks, and plants).

By combining depth and semantic understanding, the system can recognize not only that an object is present, but also what it is and how far away it is.

This allows the mower to apply different avoidance strategies—for example, maintaining a larger safety distance and smooth path planning around dynamic obstacles like people or pets, while efficiently navigating around static objects such as garden furniture or flower beds.

All processing is performed on-device via an edge computing unit, ensuring low latency and no reliance on cloud connectivity.

3. Multi-Sensor Fusion Navigation & Mapping

For positioning and navigation, the mower uses a multi-sensor fusion system that combines:

Visual-Inertial Odometry (VIO) for motion tracking using camera features and IMU data

Wheel odometry for movement consistency and slip detection

RTK/GNSS positioning for high-precision global localization when satellite signals are available

These inputs are fused to maintain stable and accurate navigation in different environments.

The system automatically adapts to conditions—for example, using RTK in open areas, switching to VIO and wheel odometry under signal loss, and relying on inertial and odometry-based estimation in low-visibility situations.

This ensures continuous, reliable operation even in complex garden environments with trees, shadows, or weak GPS coverage.

4. Data and Privacy Practices for GPS Tracking, App Connectivity, and Cloud Features

Our mower uses GPS functionality primarily for device location tracking and anti-theft protection. This allows users to locate their device in case it is misplaced or stolen, improving product security and ownership management.

projects.ai_intro_en: The Rokibot G7 AWD is a wire-free robotic lawn mower featuring true all-wheel drive that conquers slopes up to 80%. Powered by NetRTK and Visual SLAM navigation, it maps your lawn in minutes without boundary wires or base stations. AI-powered obstacle avoidance and multi-zone mapping deliver hands-free mowing across properties up to 2.5 acres.
ai_highlights_en: True AWD traction conquers 80% (38.7°) slopes and wet, uneven terrain with adaptive suspension
Zero wire setup—NetRTK and VSLAM cameras map your lawn in minutes, no RTK base station needed
AI stereo vision with deep learning detects and avoids people, pets, toys, and garden furniture
ai_specs_en: AI stereo vision with deep learning
projects.ai_risks_en: Standard crowdfunding risks apply, including potential delays during final development and manufacturing. The team acknowledges surprises may arise but commits to open communication, regular updates, and leveraging their production experience to mitigate issues.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Rokibot is an AI robotics company backed by KEN Holding Co., LTD. (SZSE: 300126), a publicly traded manufacturer with over 25 years of precision manufacturing and power systems expertise.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Rokibot G7 AWD is a production-ready robotic lawn mower engineered to tackle the most challenging residential terrain. Unlike conventional robotic mowers that struggle with steep grades and uneven ground, the G7 features a true all-wheel drive system capable of climbing slopes up to 80% (38.7°) while maintaining stability and cutting precision. Its wire-free design eliminates the need for boundary wires or RTK base stations entirely—setup is as simple as walking the mower around your lawn, thanks to integrated NetRTK precision positioning and Visual SLAM navigation that builds accurate real-time maps in minutes.

At the core of the G7's intelligence is its AI-powered obstacle avoidance and multi-zone mapping system. High-definition cameras enable VSLAM visual positioning for reliable navigation even in GPS-challenged areas like under tree cover or near buildings. The mower supports up to 100 customized mowing zones on the G7 AWD 10000 model, allowing users to manage disconnected lawns or complex estates with separate stored maps. Intelligent path planning ensures efficient coverage, while multi-directional mowing alternates angles to prevent grass flattening and promote healthier growth.

Performance-driven engineering sets the G7 apart from residential competitors. A wide 350mm cutting width paired with dual high-torque motors delivers professional-grade cutting speed through dense grass, while an adaptive suspension system maintains steady ground contact across bumps and undulations. The precision 4-wheel drive enables zero-turn capability on the spot without tearing or scuffing delicate turf. Ride-on edge cutting improves coverage along accessible borders, and the turf-protective blade disc ensures a clean, uniform finish every pass.

The G7 AWD is designed for truly hands-free operation with smart auto-return and recharge functionality—when battery runs low, the mower automatically returns to its base, then resumes mowing exactly where it left off. Backed by a 3-year device warranty and 2-year battery warranty, the launch special includes 3 years of free 4G data and free shipping with taxes included. With an estimated delivery of August 2026, the Rokibot G7 AWD brings commercial-grade all-terrain capability to residential lawn care, making it the ultimate solution for properties where standard robotic mowers simply cannot perform.

Devices may look cleaner than ever, yet everyday connectivity often depends on a growing collection of adapters and cables, making workflows feel fragmented and less intuitive.

That led us to ask a simple question:What if these essential functions could come together again in one streamlined device?

DISCORE combines aUSB hub,SD/TF card reader, andexternal optical driveinto asingle compact workstation. One device handles multiple expansion needs, helping reduce cable clutter and minimizing the need for extra accessories in your bag or on your desk.

More than just additional ports, DISCORE is designed to create a cleaner, more focused workspace experience — helping your setup feel simpler, your workflow smoother, and your creative moments less interrupted by small distractions.

9-in-1 Expansion Ports

DISCORE features a minimalist white aluminum-alloy design with a slim and lightweight form factor. It includes4 USB-A ports,1 USB-C port, a built-inCD/DVDoptical drive, and dualSD / TF card slotswith support for high-speed10Gbpsdata transfer.

IntegratedUSB-CandUSB-Aconnection cables allow convenient compatibility with both modern and traditional deviceswithout requiring additional adapters.

Driver-Free Plug and Play

Connect DISCORE, insert a disc, drag in your files, and start burning. Withplug-and-playsetup, creating CDs or DVDs is quick, simple, and hassle-free.

Let the device handle the complexity, so your workflow stays simple.

Featuring bothUSB-CandUSB-Aconnectivity, DISCORE works with both modern USB-C devices and traditional USB-A computers without requiring extra adapters.

Dual Card Slots with High-Speed Read & Write

Insert your camera'sSDcard or your drone'smicroSDcard directly into DISCORE for quick and convenient file transfers. Fewer accessories, fewer cables, and a smoother workflow.Powered byUSB 3.2 Gen 2with up to10Gbpsbandwidth for fast, reliable performance.

One Docking Station, a Desk Freed from Cables

No more juggling multiple cables and adapters for different devices. DISCORE brings commonly used ports together inone streamlined hub, helping reduce desk clutter and simplify everyday connectivity.The result is a cleaner workspace and a smoother workflow, with faster access, easier transfers, and less interruption between tasks.

Keep a Physical Warmth tor Your Data

Compared with a typical hub, DISCORE carries a sense of familiarity from the optical media era. It connects more than ports and storage —it reconnects moments, memories, and archived content from the past.

Old discs that have been sitting unused for years can be accessed again, bringing photos, videos, documents, and personal archives back into view.

DISCORE is more than an external optical drive.It serves as a bridge between past and present, helping stored memories become accessible once again.

Preserve Your Data in a Physical Form

As cloud storage becomes part of everyday life, more and more data exists only in digital spaces we cannot physically see. At the same time, many people are paying closer attention to long-term storage andindependent backupsfor important files.

DISCORE supportsCD and DVD burning, making it easy to archive contracts, family videos, graduation projects, and other valuable content. Once recorded, your files can be stored asa physical backupthat remains independently accessible.

Some memories and important files simply feel more meaningful when preserved

Spend More Time Creating

For photographers, designers, and video creators, interruptions can easily break creative flow. In many cases, it’s not the creative work itself that slows things down, but the constant switching between devices, adapters, and card readers.

DISCOREcombines direct SD / TF access, multiple USB expansion ports, and optical disc archiving in one device, helping streamline file transfers, backups, and everyday workflows.Less time managing accessories,more time focused on creating. Clean workspace, quieter workflow.

Aluminum - light & strong

Crafted with a silver-white aluminum-alloy enclosure, DISCORE is lightweight, durable, and resistant to everyday scratches while offering efficient heat dissipation.

Even during disc burning or high-speed dual-card transfers, the device maintains stable and smooth performance.

Smooth Access at Your Fingertips

Risks and challenges

As with any hardware product, there are potential risks including supply chain delays, component availability, and compatibility issues across different devices. We are working with reliable suppliers, conducting ongoing testing, and building buffer time into our schedule to minimize these risks. Our team is committed to communicating openly if any challenges arise.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We maximize the life of our product by using durable materials, designing for easy maintenance, and ensuring key parts are replaceable. The removable grill plate, charcoal tray, and silicone feet can be cleaned or replaced without throwing away the whole unit. We also run extended durability tests on heat resistance, structural stability, and electrical components. Our goal is to build a product that lasts through years of outdoor use, not just a few seasons.

Reusability and recyclability

We are committed to reducing waste by using recyclable and minimal packaging. All cardboard and paper inserts are made from recycled materials and can be recycled again. We avoid plastic foam and single-use plastics wherever possible. For the product itself, we design key components to be replaceable and repairable, so users don't have to throw away the whole unit when one part wears out. At the end of its life, the metal parts, silicone, and electronics can be separated and recycled through local e-waste or metal recycling programs.

Sustainable materials

We focus on using low-impact materials for our VDC and docking station. The outer casing is made from recycled and recyclable aluminum, which is durable and widely accepted in recycling programs. We avoid adding unnecessary coatings or mixed materials that complicate recycling. The internal circuit boards are manufactured following industry standards to reduce waste. For packaging, we use recycled cardboard and paper-based inserts, with no plastic foam or single-use plastics. Our goal is to keep material impact low while maintaining product quality and reliability.

Environmentally friendly factories

When choosing a factory, we focus on manufacturing experience, quality control, material sourcing, production capacity, and communication. We look for partners with a proven track record in electronics production, strong quality assurance processes, and the ability to meet our delivery timeline.

Sustainable Distribution

We factor sustainability into our delivery plan by working with fulfillment partners that use recyclable or minimal packaging and optimize shipping routes to reduce carbon emissions. We avoid unnecessary plastic wrap and foam inserts, and we consolidate shipments whenever possible to lower the overall environmental impact.

Perfect For Every Moment

Whether you’re traveling alone, capturing romantic couple shots, shooting creator content, taking full-body portraits, gathering group photos, or snapping cute pet moments — Mirloop1 fits every scene.

No more awkward cropped frames, blurry trial shots, or relying on strangers to take your photos. With real-time rear camera preview, you frame the ideal composition on the first try, preserving every precious memory flawlessly.

Pick The One That Feels Like You

Everything You Need To Know

We Built This Because We Needed It

A crooked selfie. A blank phone back. A desk without a timer. We fixed all three.

One of us spent an entire solo trip taking crooked selfies with her rear camera. Timer. Run. Check. Half out of frame. Again. And again. Eight tries for one usable shot.

"I just want to see what my rear camera sees."

That feature didn't exist. So we built it.

Then we looked at the blank back of our phones and thought — why can't it show our favorite photo? Our mood? A looping video of our dog? So we added that.

Then someone wanted mini games during desk breaks. And a timer. Done.

Mirloop1 became the tiny screen we use every day.

We're a small team of designers and photographers.

We test prototypes at our desks, in coffee shops, on trips. Every feature came from a real moment — not a spreadsheet.

We've partnered with experienced consumer electronics manufacturers. The working prototype is ready.

Now we need your support to fund tooling, app refinement, compatibility testing, and quality control — so we can ship something we're truly proud of.

Risks and challenges

Peeksy is a hardware product, so the main challenges may come from production scheduling, component supply, quality control, software and connection optimization, packaging, and international shipping.

We currently have working samples and are testing the product in real use scenarios. However, before mass production, we still need to finalize the product details, confirm materials, complete pilot production, and run quality checks.

Wireless preview performance may vary depending on phone model, system version, connection environment, and usage setup. We will continue testing compatibility and provide clear usage guidance for backers.

There may also be delays caused by component shortages, factory scheduling, customs processing, or logistics conditions. If any changes occur, we will communicate with backers through campaign updates and provide clear information about the production and delivery status.

Our goal is to keep the product simple, reliable, and transparent throughout the process.

projects.ai_description_en:
Meet the Veymio Mirloop1, the all-in-one magnetic selfie screen and personal mini display that finally gives your rear camera the viewfinder it's always been missing. This 1.75-inch round OLED screen attaches magnetically to the back of your phone, transforming the blank rear panel into a functional, personalized display. Whether you're framing the perfect selfie, showcasing your favorite photos and videos, or simply adding a touch of personality to your device, Mirloop1 turns the back of your phone into something truly useful and uniquely yours.

At its core, Mirloop1 solves a universal frustration: your best camera faces away from you. With real-time rear camera live preview, you can see exactly what your lens captures, frame your shot perfectly, and trigger the remote shutter—all without guesswork or awkward trial-and-error. The result is sharper, better-composed selfies and group photos that leverage your phone's superior rear camera instead of settling for lower-quality front-facing shots. Beyond photography, the screen doubles as a dynamic personal display where you can cycle through photos, looping videos, messages, or mood graphics, making your phone an extension of your personality.

The device is remarkably compact and lightweight at just 22.6g and 6.25mm thin, ensuring it doesn't add bulk or interfere with your phone's design. It works seamlessly across iOS, Android, and HarmonyOS devices, with all features managed through a single intuitive app that lets you upload content, switch displays, and sync instantly. The app also unlocks additional functionality like mini games for quick desk breaks and productivity timers, adding layers of utility beyond the core display features. Available in Matte Pink, Matte Purple, and Apple Crange, Mirloop1 is designed to complement your style while delivering genuine everyday value.

Backers can currently secure the Mirloop1 at a Super Early Bird price of $69—a 47% discount off the $129 MSRP—with free worldwide shipping expected by October 2026. An Early Bird tier is also available at $89 for those who miss the limited Super Early Bird allocation. This is a chance to own a clever, well-designed accessory that rethinks what the back of your phone can do, born from real frustrations and refined through hands-on testing by a team of designers and photographers who built exactly what they needed.

projects.name: NexScope: Handheld & Desktop Digital Microscope
projects.blurb: See more comfortably with a 4.6-inch screen, handheld freedom, desktop stability, up to 1000X magnification, and 1080P recording.
projects.html_story:
See more comfortably with a 4.6-inch screen, handheld freedom, desktop stability, up to 1000X magnification, and 1080P recording.

See more comfortably with a 4.6-inch screen, handheld freedom, desktop stability, up to 1000X magnification, and 1080P recording.

Discover the World from a New Perspective

Dual-Mode Design,Seamless Scene Switching

Clear & Comfortable Large Display

Explore the Microscopic World in Greater Detail

See 1000x More, Discover New Possibilities

Quick Focus Adjustment for Detailed Observation

See Familiar Objects in a Different Way

Dual LED Lighting System

Compact and Lightweight for Everyday Carry

Capture and Save Your Discoveries with Ease

Large-Screen Connectivity, Plug and Play

Viewing Adjustable for Comfort

Simple One-Button Operation

Micrecopic Exploration Made Easy

Environmental commitments

We believe that curiosity about the microscopic world shouldn't be limited by bulky equipment or eye strain. That's why we created NexScope—a digital microscope designed to make exploration more comfortable, intuitive, and accessible.

Discover the World from a New Perspective

More than just a microscope, NexScope is a gateway to discovery. Equipped with a 4.6-inch IPS eye-friendly display, a 12MP image sensor, 1080P video recording, a detachable dual-mode design, and expandable storage up to 512GB, it is built to support exploration both indoors and outdoors.

Dual-Mode Design,Seamless Scene Switching

Insert the microscope into the stable base for hands-free observation. Combined with dual-zone LED illumination and adjustable brightness levels, it is ideal for extended observation sessions and detailed inspection tasks.

Detach the main unit and take it wherever curiosity leads. Observe plant textures, inspect collectibles, examine crafts, or explore hard-to-reach surfaces with greater flexibility.One device. Two ways to explore.

Clear & Comfortable Large Display

Traditional microscopes often require users to bend forward and look through a small eyepiece for extended periods. Over time, this can lead to discomfort and fatigue.

NexScope features a built-in 4.6-inch IPS display that allows you to observe comfortably while sitting or standing naturally. The enlarged live view makes observation more enjoyable and accessible for users of all ages.

With 1080P resolution and a smooth 60Hz refresh rate, image movement remains fluid when adjusting focus or examining moving subjects.

Explore the Microscopic World in Greater Detail

With a magnification range from 100x to 1000x, NexScope allows you to explore both larger structures and intricate details.Whether viewing overall patterns or focusing on fine textures, switching between magnification levels is simple and intuitive.

See 1000x More, Discover New Possibilities

Plant Leaves:Under magnification, leaves reveal intricate vein structures and natural patterns that are difficult to appreciate with the naked eye.

Textile Fibers:Observe the woven structures and fiber arrangements that contribute to the texture and characteristics of different fabrics.

Quick Focus Adjustment for Detailed Observation

A smooth hybrid zoom and focusing system allows for precise image adjustment. Each turn of the focus control reveals additional layers of detail, helping you explore subjects with greater confidence.

See Familiar Objects in a Different Way

Electronic Components:Inspect solder joints, circuit traces, and small components with greater clarity, making it useful for electronics observation and educational applications.

Coins and Collectibles:Examine engravings, textures, and surface details that reflect craftsmanship and wear over time.

Dual LED Lighting System

In microscopy, lighting can be just as important as magnification. That's why NexScope features two independent illumination systems designed for different observation needs.

Eight LEDs surround the lens to provide even illumination with reduced shadows, making it suitable for observing the surfaces of opaque objects in handheld mode.The integrated base light shines upward through transparent or semi-transparent samples, making it useful for observing specimens such as plant sections, insect wings, and other thin materials.

Both lighting systems offer six adjustable brightness levels, allowing you to fine-tune illumination and contrast according to your sample and environment.

Designed for exploration without frequent recharging, NexScope combines a 4000mAh charging base with a 3000mAh handheld battery to provide up to 10 hours of operation. From detailed desktop inspections to outdoor discoveries, it keeps you observing longer with fewer interruptions.

Both the microscope and charging base feature USB-C ports, allowing them to share charging cables commonly used for phones, tablets, and other electronic devices.The device also supports operation while connected to power, helping you continue your observations when charging is needed.

Compact and Lightweight for Everyday Carry

Compact and lightweight, the handheld unit is designed for comfortable one-handed operation.Slip it into a tool bag, backpack pocket, or jacket pocket and take microscopic exploration beyond the desk.

Without being limited by cables or fixed workstations, NexScope allows you to bring observation directly to the subject rather than bringing the subject to the microscope.

Imagine discovering a patch of vibrant moss growing on a damp rock during a hike.Simply remove the handheld unit from the base and observe directly in handheld mode. On the 4.6-inch IPS display, tiny spore capsules, delicate textures, and fine surface details become easier to examine and appreciate.

Capture and Save Your Discoveries with Ease

NexScope features a 12MP image sensor capable of capturing photos at resolutions up to 4032 × 3024 pixels.For moving subjects, it supports smooth 1080P video recording at 60fps, helping preserve observations with clarity and detail.

Photos and videos can be saved directly to a TF card with support for capacities up to 512GB. Built-in playback allows convenient review of your captured content anytime.

Large-Screen Connectivity, Plug and Play

Connect NexScope directly to Mac or Windows computers without installing additional software or drivers.Simply plug in the device to view real-time images on a larger display, making demonstrations, presentations, and collaborative observation more convenient.

Compatible with both macOS and Windows systems, NexScope supports image viewing, photo capture, and video recording through a straightforward user experience.With its USB-C connection, it can work seamlessly with laptops, monitors, projectors, tablets, and other compatible devices for real-time sharing and group viewing.

Viewing Adjustable for Comfort

The display offers five adjustable brightness levels, helping maintain clear visibility across a variety of lighting environments, from bright workspaces to dimmer observation areas.Its adjustable screen angle allows flexible viewing positions whether you are sitting, standing, recording notes, or performing quick inspections.

The observation stand features adjustable height control that works together with the manual focusing system.A simple adjustment helps accommodate specimens of different sizes and thicknesses, making it easier to achieve sharp focus across a wide range of observation tasks.The system also supports 17 interface languages, providing a user-friendly experience for users around the world.

Simple One-Button Operation

Essential controls are integrated into an intuitive interface designed for everyday use.Quick adjustments can be made with a simple press, while the streamlined layout helps users get started with minimal setup and a short learning curve.

Micrecopic Exploration Made Easy

NexScope helps transform scientific curiosity into hands-on discovery.Whether exploring leaves at the kitchen table, examining everyday objects, or observing small specimens together, it creates new opportunities for learning, discussion, and shared experiences.

With magnification options suitable for examining fine details, NexScope can help reveal solder joints, surface conditions, and other small features that may be difficult to see with the naked eye.From coin engravings to ceramic textures and fine craftsmanship details, NexScope provides a closer look at the characteristics that make every collection unique.With stable focusing and photo capture capabilities, preserving and sharing those details becomes simple and convenient.

Estimated shipping begins in September 2026.After the campaign ends, backers will receive a survey via PledgeBox to confirm their shipping address, select any applicable options or add-ons, and pay shipping fees before fulfillment begins.

Risks and challenges

Hardware innovation comes with risks. For electron microscopy, precision optics, circuitry, and mechanics must work in perfect sync.

Key challenges we've addressed:

Supply chain – Sensors/lenses may face delays. We've secured backup suppliers and pre-ordered critical materials.

Software – Cross-platform compatibility. We've completed multi-OS testing and offer long-term firmware updates.

Our commitment: In case of force majeure delays, we'll provide weekly transparent updates. Shipments follow payment order.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We maximize product life through modular design, rigorous quality testing, and long-term firmware support. Key components (optics, sensors, circuits) are built for repairability — users can replace individual modules instead of the whole unit. We also provide extended maintenance guides and ongoing calibration support.

Reusability and recyclability

We minimize landfill impact through:
Minimalist, recyclable packaging – Using cardboard and paper pulp instead of foam or plastic.
Reduced material waste – Precision manufacturing cuts down excess raw materials.
Take-back program – End-of-life units can be returned to us for component reuse or responsible recycling.
Repair-first design – Modular parts reduce the need to discard whole units.

Sustainable materials

We prioritize low-impact materials across product and packaging:

Recycled for the microscope body

Glass optics (fully recyclable, no plastic lenses)

Bioplastics or recycled ABS for non-critical structural parts

Paper-based pulp trays and corrugated cardboard for packaging — no virgin foam or single-use plastics

Environmentally friendly factories

We choose factories with strict quality control,environmental certification, fair labor practices, and supply chain transparency — prioritizing those close to our markets to reduce carbon footprint.

Sustainable Distribution

We’ll minimize delivery-related emissions by consolidating shipments, using cardboard-only packaging, and partnering with carbon-conscious logistics providers. Backers will also have the option to combine multiple items into one delivery.

Back it because you believe in it.

Support the project for no reward, just because it speaks to you.

projects.ai_description_en:
# NexScope Handheld & Desktop Digital Microscope

NexScope is a versatile digital microscope that bridges the gap between professional-grade observation and everyday accessibility. Built around a 4.6-inch IPS display, a 12MP image sensor, and smooth 1080P video recording at 60Hz, it delivers crystal-clear real-time imaging without the eye strain of traditional eyepiece-based microscopes. Its detachable dual-mode design lets users slot the main unit into a stable base for hands-free desktop inspection or take it handheld for on-the-go exploration of plant textures, collectibles, electronics, and more — with magnification ranging from 100x up to 1000x for revealing the finest details.

What sets NexScope apart is its thoughtfully engineered illumination system. Two independent LED arrays serve distinct observation needs: eight surrounding LEDs provide shadow-reduced, even lighting for opaque surfaces in handheld mode, while an integrated base light shines upward through transparent or semi-transparent samples like plant sections and insect wings. Both systems offer six adjustable brightness levels, giving users precise control over contrast and lighting conditions. A smooth hybrid zoom and focusing system enables quick, precise adjustments — one turn of the focus control at a time reveals new layers of detail. With expandable storage up to 512GB, every discovery can be captured and saved effortlessly.

Beyond the classroom or workstation, NexScope serves electronics hobbyists inspecting solder joints and circuit traces, collectors examining coin engravings and textile weaves, and curious minds of all ages exploring the hidden structures of everyday objects. The large-screen connectivity option enables a plug-and-play view on bigger displays, and simple one-button operation keeps the focus on discovery rather than setup. Backed by pre-ordered critical materials, multi-OS-tested software, and a commitment to transparent weekly updates, NexScope makes serious microscopy portable, comfortable, and accessible.

Every man wants better performance in bed.

Stronger firmness.

At MYHIXEL, as experts in male health,we’ve created a pump with a level of precision, guidance, and comfort never seen before.

Testimonials From The First Users

Want to hear from real users?

Before launch, we sent the MYHIXEL Sync Pump to 3 men with different goals and asked for complete honesty. Her´s what they found after several weeks of training.

Co-Created With Experts

Great Results with Easy Training

MYHIXEL Sync Pump allows men to actively train and optimize their intimate tissues to support progressive volume, strength, and overall fitness, just as they would any other part of the body.

Get all these benefits with10–15 minute sessions, 3–4 times per week

Feel like you’re 18 again with minimal effort!

4 Guided Training Modes For Specific Goals

Through the Pump Program within the MYHIXEL Hub App, you'll have access tostep-by-step guided protocolstailored to your exact needs:

Designed to safely guide progressive structural tissue flexibility,supporting healthy elongation and cellular elasticity over time,bringing you 2 cm closer to your maximum potential.

A program focused on optimizing blood flow dynamics and enhancing erection,using a clinically backed intermittent pumping technique, the app guides you to your optimal rigidity.It visually warns you of your safe limit to avoid numbness, allowing you to confidently retain firmness.

A highly specific program, with strict clinical pressure limits,designed to support tissue alignment, promote recovery, and maintain long-term penile wellness.

Specially recommended for +45.

Because recovering tissue is delicate, the app establishes a strict limit, guiding you through gentle, repetitive cycles of erection and release to non-invasively model the tissue.

Think of this as "cardio" for your penis to keep the tissues healthy and maximize natural performance. Acting as your digital spotter, the app prompts you to pump to a sub-maximal pressure, hold briefly, and release. These rhythmic "reps" flush the chambers with fresh, oxygen-rich blood to maintain peak vascular fitness.An advanced training protocol combining endurance intervals to maximize vascular performance and muscular pelvic floor support.

*Disclaimer: Vacuum (negative pressure) therapy is an established, non-invasive approach used in urology, with its strongest evidence in improving erectile function and in preserving or recovering penile length in clinical settings such as rehabilitation after prostate surgery. In published studies of vacuum therapy protocols, some participants have reported penile length improvements of up to 2 cm after several months of consistent use. Results vary considerably from one person to another. MYHIXEL Sync Pump is a research and development project currently seeking crowdfunding, and it has not yet been clinically tested to validate this specific outcome. Nothing here should be read as a promise of a particular result, and no outcome is guaranteed.

Real-Time Guidance For Real-Life Results

When talking to dozens of pump users, we realized that there was a common usability issue: Traditional unmonitored systems lack clear visual feedback, making it difficult to maintain precise control and follow training guidance.

The MYHIXEL Sync Pump changes the game.By tracking vacuum levels in real time via Bluetooth, the app works as both your smart control center and live monitoring dashboard.

The app gives you live guidance and personalized recommendations, so you can adjust pressure and session length with confidence.

Safer. Smarter. Better Results

Our training protocols will guide you to the exact optimal pressure level for your specific goal.No more guessing. No more trial and error. Just safe, data-driven growth.

A digital pressure gauge and OLED display show everything in real time. And with the instant release valve, control is always in your hands.

Comfortable. Quiet. Built To Feel Natural

By replacing aggressive medical triggers with a smooth,natural sliding motion, we created a pump that works with your body, not against it.

It ismore comfortable, quieter, warmer in feel, more natural to use, and significantly more compact, practical, and ergonomicthan the bulky options currently on the market.

Ergonomic Coupler

Putting your penis into a vacuum device can feel awkward.Our coupler has a shape that better fits your natural anatomy for a more natural fit and a more comfortable seal.

Easy Cleaning & Transport

The pump easily disassembles into its core parts in seconds, makingcleaning an effortlesspart of your routine.

Simply place the cylinder under running water, add soap if desired, and rinse. Let it dry, and it will be ready to use. You can also dry it with a cloth.

Its compact design makes it easy to carry wherever you go.Instead of bulky, oversized dimensions, our Pump comes in a discreet case that simplifies transport.

The Perfect Combo: Sync Pump + Rings

MYHIXEL Sync Pump pairs effortlessly with MYHIXEL Ringto help maintain the erection, and its removable head makes cleaning and charging simple.

The anatomical shape of our couplers does two things brilliantly. It makes entry into the cylinder smoother and more natural, and it pairs perfectly with MYHIXEL Rings.Once you’ve reached maximum volume and firmness, you can slide the ring into place quickly and easily to lock in your results. A critical moment, made simple.

By combining both technologies, you achieve an unmatched standard of performance:the advanced vacuum engineering of the Pump allows you to condition your tissues to reach their absolute peak capacity, while the targeted design of the Ring locks in that structural power, ensuring you can maintain that elevated firmness and stability for an extended period.

Every Detail Was Carefully Crafted To Create This Masterpiece

Every component of the MYHIXEL Sync Pump has been meticulously designed for maximum comfort, discretion, and precision:

projects.ai_description_en:
The MYHIXEL Sync Pump is the world's first vacuum therapy system with built-in app guidance, developed to help men achieve stronger erectile firmness and measurable progress in penile length. Unlike conventional pumps that offer no direction or feedback, this manual device integrates seamlessly with the MYHIXEL Hub App to deliver a truly personalized training experience. Co-created with world-class urologists and sexologists, the Sync Pump combines controlled negative pressure with real-time digital coaching to make vacuum therapy safer, smarter, and more effective than ever before.

At its core, the Sync Pump features the innovative Sync Puck top module connected to a transparent body with adaptive silicone couplers, allowing users to see the progress and ensure a comfortable, natural fit every time. Through the app's Pump Program, users choose from four distinct guided training modes tailored to specific goals: an elongation protocol designed to support tissue flexibility and cellular elasticity, an erection firmness mode using clinically backed intermittent pumping with visual safety warnings, a delicate recovery program with strict pressure limits ideal for post-surgery or older users over 45, and a "cardio" mode that uses rhythmic sub-maximal pressure reps to maximize vascular performance and pelvic floor support. Each session lasts just 10–15 minutes and is recommended 3–4 times per week, fitting easily into any routine.

What makes the Sync Pump transformative is its ability to replace guesswork with data-driven guidance. The app visually monitors pressure levels and warns users when approaching their safe limit, preventing numbness and injury while helping them train with confidence. Every detail—from the ergonomic coupler to the quiet, comfortable operation—has been carefully crafted to feel natural rather than clinical. Early testers reported significant improvements in firmness and size, with vacuum therapy protocols in published studies showing some men gaining up to 2 cm in length over several months of consistent use. While results vary, the evidence-based approach gives users a clear, measurable path toward better sexual wellness. Available now on Kickstarter at €191 (approximately $219)—a 40% discount from retail—backers can secure this groundbreaking tool ahead of its estimated May 2027 shipping date.

projects.blurb: The first wireless precision screwdriver with HD camera, app control, and deep-reach torque—watch repairs live on your phone.
projects.html_story:
The first wireless precision screwdriver with HD camera, app control, and deep-reach torque—watch repairs live on your phone.

The first wireless precision screwdriver with HD camera, app control, and deep-reach torque—watch repairs live on your phone.

What if your screwdriver had eyes?

HD Visual Feedback

CrossPlatform Connectivity

2 Complete Sets in One Package

See Through the Bit

Live View on Any Screen

Capture & Share Repair

Never Stall High Torque

Forward / Reverse Dual Mode

No More Stripped Screws

Builtin Magnetizer in the Case

Ergonomic AntiSlip Grip

Wired & Wireless Operation

One Cable. Anywhere

Long-Lasting Battery

What's in the box?

You know the feeling.

The pain: When you're working on something tiny and incredibly precise – like a watch movement, a dial with hairline indices, or a circuit board packed with microscopic components – you can't see enough. You reach for a magnifying loupe or a headband magnifier. But now your eye is pressed against a lens, your depth perception is gone, and you keep bumping the tool into the part you're trying to see. You're still working half-blind.

What if your screwdriver had eyes?

Because the HT01 connects directly to the HT01 App on your phone, tablet, or computer – you don't need a magnifying loupe anymore. The live HD view streams to your screen, letting you see every screw, gear, and circuit trace in crystal-clear, zoomable detail. No headband digging into your temples. No eye strain from squinting through a tiny lens. You simply look at your large, bright screen while your hands work freely.

HD Visual Feedback

The HT01 connects to your phone, tablet, or computer via WiFi, streaming a crystal-clear, real-time view of the screw and circuit board directly onto your screen. No more magnifying loupes. No more guessing where the bit will land. See exactly what you're doing – before you touch the screw.

CrossPlatform Connectivity

The HT01 connects to your phone, tablet, or computer via WiFi, streaming a crystal-clear, real-time view of the screw and circuit board directly onto your screen. No more magnifying loupes. No more guessing where the bit will land. See exactly what you're doing – before you touch the screw.

2 Complete Sets in One Package

You get two precision tool sets: the HT01 Visual Electric Screwdriver Set (with HD camera, app connectivity, motor drive) and a full Manual Screwdriver Set (ergonomic handle, same S2 bits). Power when you need it, control when you want it.

Say goodbye to shadows and blind spots – and hello to pinpoint accuracy. The HT01’s integrated LED ring light delivers Max200 lumens of shadowfree, 80° wideangle brightness. It illuminates every screw head, circuit trace, and tiny component, even in the darkest recesses of a device.

See Through the Bit

An integrated HD camera sits directly above the bit, giving you a centered, shadowfree view of the exact point you’re about to drive.

Live View on Any Screen

Stream the live feed to your phone, tablet, or computer via WiFi. Watch your repair unfold on a large display or a portable screen – your choice.

Capture & Share Repair

One tap in the app to take photos or record videos. Document the “before” and “after,” create tutorials, or share your repair victory on social media.

Never Stall High Torque

Engineered with lowspeed, hightorque gearing. Breaks factorytight screws without stalling, yet gentle enough for soft brass standoffs.

Manual Screwdriver Set

Forward / Reverse Dual Mode

Forward to tighten with confidence. Reverse to loosen stubborn screws without stripping the head. Intuitive control at your fingertip.

No More Stripped Screws

Built from S2 alloy steel — the perfect balance of hardness and toughness. Tired of bits that wear out, round off, or snap after a few uses? The HT01 bit is high-hardness, wear-resistant, and built to last. Precision engagement means no rounded corners, no breakage — even under high-torque jobs. A great bit makes every turn feel solid and satisfying.

Comes with a full suite of 69 precision bits made of S2 alloy steel – covering every need: Nintendo Switch, MacBooks, eyeglasses, RC cars, drones, smartphones, and more. All neatly packed in a durable, impactresistant storage case. No more hunting for the right bit. It's all right here.

Builtin Magnetizer in the Case

No more rubbing your bits against a random magnet or buying a separate tool. The HT01 storage case features a builtin magnetizer slot. Simply insert your bit, slide it through, and it's instantly magnetized – perfect for picking up tiny screws from deep holes. No extra gadgets. No mess. It's always there, right inside the case.

Ergonomic AntiSlip Grip

Shaped to fit your palm naturally, with antislip material that stays secure even with oily or sweaty fingers. Less fatigue during long repairs.

Wired & Wireless Operation

When you need wireless freedom, the HT01 runs on battery power. When you plug in USB-C power, it also works while charging. No downtime, no waiting for a recharge. Keep working – your way.

One Cable. Anywhere

Still hunting around for that special charging cable that only works with your device? Say goodbye to niche, proprietary plugs! Our product features a universal USB-C port. Just grab any USB-C cable you see — from your friend's laptop charger, an airport vending machine, a car outlet, or a hotel nightstand. No more forgetting your "exclusive brick," and no more frantically searching for weirdly shaped adapters. Just plug and power up.

Long-Lasting Battery

Powered by a high-capacity 3000mAh 18650 lithium-ion cell. One full charge delivers hours of continuous precision repairs – from smartphones to drones to watch movements. No frequent recharging. No interruptions. Just keep working.

What's in the box?

Support us today and get the HT01 at aspecial Kickstarter launch price—significantly lower than the expected retail value.

The estimated shipping time is inSep2026. And after the campaign ends, you will receive a PledgeBox email to select your final order choices and pay the shipping costs. Following is a list of rough estimates for delivering the base pledges.

Viztool, a brand focused on the innovation of DIY tools, was founded in 2023. It was co-created by a group of passionate DIY enthusiasts who yearned for a portable and visual sharpening tool that could meet the demands of their everyday DIY tasks. It was this love and dedication to DIY that gave birth to Viztool.

Since its establishment, Viztool has been committed to combining advanced design concepts with practical functionality to craft sharpening tools that cater to the needs of DIY enthusiasts. The original design intention of our products revolves around portability and visualization, which means users can easily utilize our products anytime, anywhere, and can intuitively understand the tool's working status and effect through a visual means.

Viztool not only boasts exceptional sharpening results but is also equipped with an advanced visualization system that allows users to observe the sharpening process in real-time, ensuring optimal performance in every operation. Additionally, our sharpening tools are portable, making them suitable for both home DIY projects and outdoor tasks.

In the future, Viztool will continue to uphold the principles of "innovation, practicality, and convenience," and introduce more products that meet the needs of DIY enthusiasts. We believe that through our efforts, Viztool will bring a more convenient and efficient DIY experience to DIY enthusiasts worldwide.

Risks and challenges

We have already completed the engineering validation and testing (EVT) phase. Our supply chain is secured with a reputable manufacturer. The challenge lies in mass production scaling, but with your backing, we can meet the demand and deliver a high-quality, reliable tool to every backer.
