projects.html_story:
Pocket-Sized AI 4G Communicator with Unlimited Range, LTE Communication Device

Pocket-Sized AI 4G Communicator with Unlimited Range, LTE Communication Device

The Revolution in Team Comms: RugOne Xlink 7

Ruggedness & Reliability

Revolutionary 4G & AI Audio

Safety & Navigation

Hardware Design & Smart App

Join RugOne Community

Environmental commitments

The Revolution in Team Comms: RugOne Xlink 7

Traditional radios are heavy, bulky, and restricted by short-range limits. They weigh you down and fail when team coordination matters most.

After extensive development, we engineered theRugOne Xlink 7—the ultimate ultra-resilient 4G communication hub designed to disappear into your gear.

Specs at a Glance

Sized for Freedom: Pocket-Sized, Pro-Grade

Just 84g. Pro-grade communication in an earbud-case-sized frame. From peaks to daily runs, it disappears into your gear, keeping you always connected, never weighed down.

A sleek matte-black body with high-contrast orange, built to stay low-profile through every run and climb.

Born from the soul of the Badain Jaran desert. A premium fusion of warm amber and cool taupe textures. Be the standout on every trail.

All 4 accessories included

Wireless PTT Remote Ring

Keep your hands on the gear and your focus on the path. This tiny remote syncs via Bluetooth to replace your device's PTT button.

With two adjustable velcro straps included, it's a perfect fit for your finger, handlebars, or equipment. Control your comms without ever letting go.

Product Gallery

Ruggedness & Reliability

IP68 & IP69K, MIL-STD-810H Tough

Elite IP68/IP69K waterproofing combines MIL-STD-810H toughness. Built to survive every drop, hit, and freeze, Xlink 7 is as tough as your ambition. It's rugged, reliable, and built to endure.

Masters every climate. Under the hood, Xlink 7 packs a battery that thrives in -30°C frost and remains rock-solid in 55°C heat.

Built-in Flashlight

Why carry more when one device does it all? We've built the ultra-bright TorchX directly into the Xlink 7 so you can leave the extra flashlight at home. High-intensity illumination is just one long-press away.

All-Day Battery Power

Big power in a compact form. Featuring a 1020mAh battery under the hood, Xlink 7 empowers you to stay connected and talk all day long.

Revolutionary 4G & AI Audio

Borderless 4G Networking

Break the limits of traditional radio. With global 4G support, enjoy instant, high-speed, and crystal-clear communication, whether you are across the city or across the globe. Reliable connectivity ensures you're always just a button-press away.

Real-Time Group Chat

3-Way Real-Time Talk. Simultaneous two-way voice for up to 3 devices. Natural, fluid team collaboration with zero waiting time. No holding buttons, no distractions, just pure shredding.

Replay last message whenever you need it. A single press of the Power Button gives you instant access to your most recent voice clip, ensuring no critical details are ever lost.

AI Noise Cancellation

Chip+AI Noise Cancellation

Silence the storm, amplify the voice. A dedicated chip and smart AI intelligently work together to filters out wind roar and chaos. Even at high speeds, your voice remains clear and sharp, cutting through the noise no matter the pace.

One-Key AI Voice Assistant

One button, infinite possibilities. Simply press to talk with your AI assistant in real-time. Control your device, get weather updates, and sync with your crew instantly. Professional-grade intelligence at your fingertips.

Safety & Navigation

GPS + Beidou + Glonass Positioning

Global reach, absolute safety. The integration of GPS, Beidou, and Glonass provides rapid coordinate fixes in any terrain. This keeps you found and your exploration powered by confidence.

Every second counts. Rapid-press the Action Button 5 times to trigger a siren and signal for help. The system will automatically call your emergency contacts, who will instantly receive an alert and your live GPS location via the connected app. Stay safe, stay connected.

All-Scenario Connectivity

Built to conquer the extreme, this ultra-resilient 4G solution keeps transport fleets, construction crews, and emergency responders seamlessly synchronized with zero-lag dispatch and centralized command. Designed for heavy-duty field operations, it combines high-volume audio and instant SOS alerts to ensure reliable communication, rapid coordination, and maximum operational efficiency in the toughest environments.

Hardware Design & Smart App

RugOne Xlink App

Your mobile command hub. The RugOne Xlink App provides a visual command center to manage groups, track team status, and customize your device settings with precision. More than just a tool, your App account acts as a team member, enabling seamless communication between your phone and Xlink 7

Every Button, Explained

Technical Specifications

Join RugOne Community

Risks and challenges

Risks and Challenges

Bringing a complex, pro-grade 4G communication device like the RugOne Xlink 7 to life requires advanced hardware engineering, software stability, and precise global supply chain coordination. We want to be completely transparent with our community about our progress: We have already successfully completed both the EVT (Engineering Verification) and DVT (Design Verification) stages, which means our hardware functionality, IP68/IP69K waterproofing, and MIL-STD-810H durability have been thoroughly tested and verified. We are now actively preparing for the PVT (Production Verification) stage, the final trial production phase right before full mass production.

1. Manufacturing & Supply Chain
Mass-producing a device with military-grade ruggedness involves sophisticated tooling and strict quality control on the assembly line. Because we have already passed the DVT phase with working prototypes, our physical molds and designs are locked in. Entering the PVT stage allows us to iron out factory assembly logistics and optimize production yields, ensuring that the final mass production runs smoothly and flawlessly.

2. Software & Certification
Since Xlink 7 relies on global 4G networks, multi-mode positioning (GPS/Beidou/Glonass), and dedicated AI noise cancellation algorithms, ongoing software polish is essential. Our engineering team is currently fine-tuning the companion app and working closely with certification labs to ensure all carrier and regional telecommunication standards are met seamlessly ahead of schedule.

3. Fulfillment & Shipping
Global logistics can occasionally face unforeseen delays due to customs clearance or regional transport bottlenecks. To mitigate this, we are partnering with experienced international freight forwarders. Furthermore, because all 4 pro-grade accessories are included directly inside the main box, our kitting process is simplified, drastically reducing the risk of missing components or split shipments.

Our Commitment:
We promise to keep you updated every step of the way. Through regular, transparent updates right here on Kickstarter, you will see behind-the-scenes glimpses of our PVT run, final testing, and shipping schedules. Thank you for trusting us and helping us bring the future of adventure communication to the world!

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

All AI-generated content in this project was created entirely by myself (or my team) using officially licensed and publicly available AI tools. No copyrighted third-party assets were used as inputs, and the final outputs fully comply with the terms of service and commercial licensing agreements of the respective AI platforms (Doubao, Jimeng, ChatGPT, and Start AI).

I am incorporating AI in my project in another way.

Artificial intelligence is deeply integrated into the hardware and core functionality of our product.
First, we feature "Chip+AI Noise Cancellation," which utilizes advanced AI algorithms combined with a dedicated hardware chip to intelligently filter out environmental sounds, such as wind roar, ensuring crystal-clear voice communication.
Second, our product includes a "One-Key AI Voice Assistant" feature. By integrating the Gemini API, users can press a button to interact with a smart assistant in real-time for device control, weather updates, and instant team synchronization.

Weighing just 84g, it features IP68/IP69K waterproofing, MIL-STD-810H durability, built-in GPS/Beidou/Glonass positioning, SOS emergency alerts, and a built-in flashlight—designed to keep teams connected anywhere on the planet.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: RugOne — a brand focused on engineering ultra-resilient, pro-grade communication devices for extreme environments and team coordination.
projects.ai_description_en:
Traditional radios are heavy, bulky, and restricted by short-range limits. The RugOne Xlink 7 shatters these constraints as a pocket-sized, pro-grade 4G LTE communication hub designed to disappear into your gear. Weighing just 84g in an earbud-case-sized frame, it delivers unlimited range connectivity. Unlike traditional walkie-talkies that fail when coordination matters most, the Xlink 7 ensures you are always connected whether you are across the city or across the globe, keeping you unweighed down during runs, climbs, and daily adventures.

Engineered for the extremes, the Xlink 7 combines IP68 and IP69K waterproofing with MIL-STD-810H military-grade durability. Built to survive every drop, hit, and freeze, it features a 1020mAh battery that thrives in -30°C frost and remains rock-solid in 55°C heat. To streamline your gear, we've integrated an ultra-bright TorchX flashlight directly into the device—high-intensity illumination is just one long-press away. It also features multi-mode positioning utilizing GPS, Beidou, and Glonass to keep you safe and on track no matter where your adventure takes you.

At the core of the Xlink 7 is revolutionary 4G and AI audio technology. It utilizes dedicated AI noise cancellation algorithms to deliver crystal-clear, instant, high-speed communication, ensuring your voice cuts through any environment. True to its hands-free philosophy, the device comes with all four pro-grade accessories included right in the box. The Wireless PTT Remote Ring syncs via Bluetooth to replace your device's PTT button, and with two adjustable velcro straps, you can attach it to your finger, handlebars, or equipment for seamless, hands-free control. From the desert-inspired amber and taupe aesthetics to the ultralight design, the RugOne Xlink 7 redefines adventure communication.

Our goal is to deliver a reliable, high-quality flashlight at an exceptional value to supporters around the world.

### Our Mission

We believe reliable lighting should be powerful, compact, and accessible.

Our team focuses on creating practical everyday tools that combine performance, durability, and portability.

This flashlight represents that philosophy—a compact lighting solution designed for real-world use.

Thank You

We appreciate your support and trust.

Your backing helps bring a compact yet powerful lighting solution to life, and we are excited to share this journey with our Kickstarter community.

Small enough to carry. Powerful enough to trust. 🔦🚀

## Risks and challenges

We have already completed the product design, prototype development, and initial testing before launching this campaign.

As with any hardware project, the primary risks involve manufacturing schedules, component availability, quality control, and international shipping logistics.

To reduce these risks, we have worked closely with experienced manufacturing partners and established reliable supply chains for key components. We have also conducted product testing to verify performance, durability, and charging functionality before launch.

In addition, we have allocated time in our production schedule to accommodate potential delays and ensure that quality standards are maintained throughout manufacturing.

While unexpected challenges can occur in any production project, we are committed to transparent communication and will keep our backers informed at every stage of production and fulfillment.

Our goal is simple: deliver a reliable, high-quality flashlight that meets the expectations of our supporters worldwide.

Thank you for your trust and support.

## Environmental commitments

[Visit our Environmental Resources Center](https://www.kickstarter.com/environment) to learn how Kickstarter encourages sustainable practices.

### Long-lasting design

Our flashlight is designed for long-term use with a durable aluminum alloy body and a rechargeable battery system.

By creating a product that is reliable, repairable through battery replacement, and intended for years of use, we aim to reduce the need for frequent replacement and unnecessary waste.

### Reusability and recyclability

We strive to minimize unnecessary packaging materials wherever possible.

Our packaging is designed to be compact and recyclable, helping reduce waste during shipping and fulfillment.

Eco-Conscious Packaging

We prioritize recyclable paper-based packaging and avoid excessive plastic materials whenever possible.

Our goal is to reduce environmental impact while ensuring products arrive safely to backers worldwide.

Risks and challenges

---Risks and Challenges

PD500W has moved beyond the concept stage and is now going through validation, creator testing, production preparation, and quality planning. Because this project combines microphone hardware, 2.4GHz wireless transmission, built-in recording, battery power, MaonoLink App control, and AI workflow tools, we want to be clear about the risks we are actively managing before delivery.

Kickstarter rewards are not the same as retail purchases, and estimated delivery dates are estimates rather than guarantees. Our responsibility is to reduce risk where we can, communicate clearly when plans change, and deliver PD500W with the quality creators expect.

---Manufacturing and Production

Final production may be affected by component lead times, assembly yield, tooling adjustments, supplier schedules, or packaging changes. To reduce this risk, we are validating DVT samples, preparing pilot production before mass production, and working with manufacturing partners to check assembly, packaging, and batch quality before fulfillment.

--- Audio, Wireless, and Recording Reliability

PD500W needs to perform reliably across real creator workflows: wireless camera and phone recording, USB-C recording, XLR output, two-person separate-track recording, built-in WAV recording, 32-bit float recording, safety track, timecode, battery life, charging, and use while charging.

Wireless range, battery life, and recording performance may vary depending on environment, interference, settings, connected devices, and usage mode. We will continue testing these workflows and communicate performance conditions clearly. If testing reveals issues that require more work, we may adjust the timeline rather than ship unresolved problems.

--- App, Firmware, and Compatibility

MaonoLink adds an important software layer to PD500W, including presets, sound controls, recording control, AI noise reduction, digital de-popper, transcription, and summary tools. Because the app needs to support Windows, Mac, iOS, Android, wireless mode, and USB mode, additional optimization may be required before or after fulfillment.

We will continue compatibility testing across supported platforms and improve app and firmware behavior through updates where needed. App control is planned for wireless and USB workflows; XLR use through an audio interface does not support MaonoLink control.

--- AI Feature Availability

AI transcription, speech-to-text, and summary are post-recording workflow features. They are not real-time transcription or real-time translation features, and they require an internet connection. Results may vary depending on language, accent, background noise, audio quality, and service availability.

The planned 300 free AI minutes per month, supported languages, account rules, region availability, and any related service terms will be confirmed before launch or fulfillment. We will be transparent about what the AI tools can do, what they cannot do, and any conditions needed for them to work.

--- Certification, Compliance, and Final Specifications

PD500W may require market-specific wireless certification, battery and shipping documentation, product labeling, final documentation review, and compliance checks before rewards can ship. These steps can sometimes take longer than expected, especially for a product with wireless transmission and a built-in battery.

Final certification status, specifications, package contents, and documentation will be updated once they are approved by the product and compliance teams.

---Shipping and Fulfillment

International fulfillment can be affected by shipping rates, courier capacity, customs processing, VAT or import-fee rules, package dimensions and weight, remote-area delivery, address accuracy, and regional policy changes. Final supported markets, shipping fees, and VAT/customs coverage will be confirmed in the campaign shipping policy and/or before fulfillment begins.

Before shipping, we will collect or confirm backer addresses through a Kickstarter survey or pledge manager. Accurate shipping information from backers will be important for smooth delivery.

---Timeline and Communication

Our current plan includes final validation, pilot production, mass production, quality inspection, and shipping to backers. Even with careful planning, hardware production can face unexpected delays.

If the timeline changes, we will share updates with backers, explain what happened, what we are doing next, and how it affects the delivery plan. Maono has experience developing and shipping creator audio products, and our previous Kickstarter projects have taught us how important transparent communication is to backers.

Our goal is to deliver PD500W responsibly, with clear updates, careful quality control, and the product experience creators are backing us to build.

Our project uses AI in a limited way for audio processing and optional creator workflow features. For AI workflow functions such as transcription, summarization, and translation, we use ChatGPT models to process user-provided audio or text content. For AI acoustic processing, such as noise reduction / voice enhancement, we use our self-developed AI processing algorithm embedded in our in-house chip. These AI features appear in the product’s software/app workflow and audio-processing functions. The microphone can still be used as a standard microphone without enabling AI workflow features. Results may vary depending on the recording environment, background noise, language/accent, internet connection, and service availability. We do not use Kickstarter backer data to train AI models.

projects.ai_risks_en: Key risks include manufacturing delays from component lead times and assembly yields, variable wireless/battery performance across environments, potential app/firmware compatibility issues across platforms, AI features requiring internet with variable results, certification delays for wireless/battery products, international shipping/customs complications, and possible timeline adjustments if testing reveals unresolved issues.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Maono is a creator-focused audio brand with experience developing and shipping creator audio products via Kickstarter.
projects.ai_description_en:
MAONO PD500W is a hybrid microphone system built for modern creators who need reliable, high-quality recording across multiple workflows. Designed as an all-in-one solution, it combines professional microphone hardware with 2.4GHz wireless transmission, built-in recording capabilities, and battery-powered operation. Whether you're recording wirelessly to a camera or phone, connecting via USB-C to a computer, or routing through an XLR output on an audio interface, PD500W is engineered to perform consistently across real creator workflows without requiring a tangle of separate devices.

At the heart of PD500W is its versatile recording functionality, which sets it apart from standard microphones. The system supports built-in WAV recording, 32-bit float recording for unmatched dynamic range, a safety track to prevent clipping, and timecode synchronization for multi-device shoots. Two-person separate-track recording lets capture conversations or interviews with isolated audio on each channel, giving editors full control in post-production. These features are packed into a portable form factor that includes battery power and the ability to charge while recording, so creators can shoot for extended sessions without interruption.

What truly elevates PD500W beyond traditional microphones is the MaonoLink App integration, which adds a software layer of intelligent controls and AI-powered workflow tools. Through the app, users can access presets, sound controls, recording management, digital de-popper enhancement, transcription, and summary tools. The AI features — including speech-to-text transcription and content summarization — operate post-recording and require an internet connection, with 300 free AI minutes planned per month. While the app is designed to work across Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android in both wireless and USB modes, it's important to note that XLR connection through a traditional audio interface does not support MaonoLink control.

For creators who juggle multiple platforms, clients, and recording scenarios, PD500W offers a streamlined approach to professional audio. It eliminates the need to choose between wireless convenience and studio-grade sound quality, aiming to deliver both in a single system. As a product still in its validation and production preparation stage with a targeted September 2026 delivery, PD500W represents MAONO's vision of adapting microphone technology to the flexible, multi-device reality of content creation today.

Why Kickstarter?

Tired of choosing between a bulky action cam, a weak basic camera, or a tiny cam with no remote controls?

Wantstable 4K video,instant sharing, andpocket size—all in one device？

——the pocket‑sized all‑in‑one recorder built for real life.

Ultra‑compact 4K camera with Sony sensor, stabilization, app control, low power. Shoot stable, clear footage anywhere—no bulky gear. Never Miss the Moment Because Your Camera Was Too Big to Bring.

🎁Your always‑ready visual storyteller.

AulGo brings 4K SONY clarity, 6-axis stabilization, 5 recording modes, app control, fast sharing, noise-reducing audio, magnetic mounting, and a stylish mini design into one always-ready pocket camera.

Made for vlogs, travel, sports, daily life, backup recording, and creative hands-free shots —it is easy to carry, fun to use, and perfect as a smart everyday gift.

Magnetic Base / Multi-Scene Mounting:Snap. Screw. Shoot Anywhere.

🤳When Your Hands Are Busy, Let AulGo Hold the Shot.

The magnetic base lets you attach AulGo to metal surfaces like a fridge door, basketball rim, metal pole, or car door — giving you more hands-free shooting angles in seconds.

Beyond magnetic mounting, AulGo also features a standard1/4-inch screw mount, making it compatible with a wide range of tripods, gimbals, brackets, and mounting accessories. Whether you’re filming at home, capturing outdoor moments, or using it as a compact backup recorder for driving and road trips, AulGo helps you find the right angle with less setup.

Sometimes the best shot comes from a place your hands cannot hold. With magnetic mounting, 1/4-inch mount compatibility, and flexible accessory support, AulGo helps you record from creative angles — wherever life takes you.

Mini Body. New Stylish.

👌Small Enough to Carry Before You Even Plan to Shoot

With a palm-size design, and two stylish colors, AulGo slips easily into your hand, bag, or pocket — ready whenever inspiration strikes. Big cameras are not always practical. Phones are not always easy to mount. AulGo gives you a smaller, lighter way to record everyday moments without adding extra weight to your day.

4K SONY IMX486: Capture Every Detail

📷Make Small-Camera Footage Look Bigger Than Expected.

For those who demand top - notch visuals. Powered by SONY IMX486 and up to 12MP image capture, AulGo records 4K footage with clearer details for daytime scenes, night views, travel clips, and close-up moments.

Small cameras often struggle with unclear images, low detail, or noisy footage. AulGo is built with a SONY IMX486 sensor to deliver cleaner visuals and richer detail, helping your footage look more polished right out of the camera.

6-Axis EIS Stabilization: Buttery-Smooth Footage Anytime

🚲Your Best Clips Shouldn’t Look Like They Were Shaking Apart.

Ideal for active individuals. Built-in 6-axis EIS stabilization helps reduce shake while walking, riding, or recording action footage — so your videos stay more stable and easier to watch.

Shaky footage can ruin a great moment. Whether you are walking through the city, cycling along a trail, or recording first-person movement, AulGo helps keep the image steadier and more usable.

5-in-1 Recording Modes

🎞One Tiny Camera. Five Ways to Record.

Switch between Normal, Loop, Timelapse, Hyperlapse, and Slow Motion through your phone to match daily vlogs, cycling records, sunsets, travel routes, and action scenes.

Normal RecordingCapture everyday moments in real time — perfect for vlogs, family clips, travel memories, and daily life.

Loop RecordingKeep recording continuously while older footage is automatically overwritten when storage is full — ideal for cycling, commuting, road trips, and backup recording.

TimelapseTurn long moments into short, cinematic clips — great for sunsets, clouds, city lights, camping setups, or creative scene changes.

HyperlapseRecord movement in a faster, smoother way — perfect for walking tours, travel routes, outdoor exploration, and city adventures.

Slow MotionSlow down fast action to reveal more detail — ideal for sports, pets, water splashes, tricks, jumps, and every moment worth replaying.Life does not move at one speed. Some moments need real-time recording. Some need to be sped up. Some deserve to be slowed down. AulGo gives you five ways to capture the same world differently.

🎤Let Your Voice Stand Out from the Street.

The built-in noise-reducing MIC helps capture clearer voice during outdoor selfies, street vlogs, travel clips, and busy public scenes.

Traffic, crowds, wind, and background noise can make your videos hard to hear. AulGo helps reduce unwanted noise so your voice comes through more clearly.

📱Easier Control. Faster Sharing.

Made for tech-savvy creators on the go, AulGo makes shooting, previewing, and sharing easier from start to finish. Preview your shot directly on the built-in 1.47-inch display, or connect through 5.8G Wi-Fi to use the mobile app for live preview, remote control, mode switching, and wireless footage management.

With H.265 encoding, AulGo saves up to 50% more storage space compared with standard H.264 files, so you can record more without filling your card too quickly. When you need a faster workflow, simply connect via USB-C to transfer files directly to your computer.

AulGo is a startup brand created by a small but dedicated team with a shared goal: to develop practical, well-designed products that make everyday recording and outdoor experiences easier, smarter, and more enjoyable.

Our product development and manufacturing partner is based in China, where we work closely with an experienced factory team specializing in compact camera hardware, structural design, production testing, and supply chain management. This allows us to move quickly from product concept to prototype, testing, refinement, and manufacturing preparation.

Although AulGo is a new brand, our team is supported by strong technical resources, fast production coordination, and hands-on experience in bringing consumer electronics products to market. Every product we select or develop goes through careful evaluation, including usability, build quality, practical performance, and real-life application scenarios.

Why Kickstarter?

Kickstarter creates a unique gathering space for creators and innovation enthusiasts alike. As a community-focused platform, it offers an open space for backers to share genuine feedback on the projects they support, enabling thoughtful, direct communication with brand founders and creators. We aim to let our innovative gadgets and services evolve alongside your input. These items will launch exclusively on Kickstarter at first, with the potential to expand to wider markets later if they gain strong popularity. Beyond that, we guarantee Kickstarter backers will always be the first in the world to receive our products, along with exclusive long-term perks and special privileges.

This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 3,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1B raised between them.

Risks and challenges

Potential Risks & Mitigation Plans
1. Manufacturing & Supply Chain Risks
Risk
Supplier limitations or material shortages may cause delays in tooling and mass production.
Mitigation
We have secured two backup suppliers for core parts and signed a fixed schedule agreement with our main manufacturer. Regular progress checks will be conducted throughout production to identify and resolve problems early.
2. Technical Performance Risks
Risk
Minor performance inconsistencies may appear in mass-produced units during daily use.
Mitigation
Pre-production prototypes have passed full professional testing to meet all design standards. Strict in-line quality control will be enforced in mass production. Key function tests will be performed per batch, with defective products removed directly to ensure stable quality.
3. Fulfillment & Shipping Risks
Risk
Global logistics pressure and customs clearance issues may lead to international shipping delays.
Mitigation
We work with an experienced global fulfillment partner for crowdfunding campaigns. All pre-shipping preparations will be finished ahead of schedule. Real-time tracking will be offered to all users, and buffer stock will be reserved to handle unexpected delivery issues.
Our team has solid experience in consumer electronics development and production. Comprehensive contingency plans are in place for all foreseeable risks. We will deliver regular progress updates to backers and maintain full transparency to guarantee smooth delivery.

projects.ai_intro_en: AulGo is an ultra-compact 4K pocket camera featuring a Sony IMX486 sensor and 6-axis EIS stabilization for smooth, detailed footage anywhere. With 5 recording modes, 5.8G WiFi app control, magnetic mounting, and a 1/4-inch screw base, it's designed for vlogs, travel, sports, and creative hands-free shooting. The palm-sized camera includes noise-reducing audio, H.265 encoding for 50% storage savings, and a 1.47-inch display for easy preview and sharing.

Magnetic base + 1/4-inch screw mount for versatile hands-free mounting on any surface

projects.ai_risks_en: AulGo is a startup brand with a small team and limited track record. Manufacturing is handled by a partner in China, which may pose risks related to quality control, production delays, or supply chain disruptions. As with all crowdfunding projects, backers face uncertainty regarding final product delivery, potential feature changes, and the company's long-term support capabilities.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: AulGo is a startup brand by a small dedicated team focused on practical, well-designed recording products, with manufacturing based in China.
projects.ai_description_en:
The AulGo All-in-One 4K Pocket Camera is an always-ready visual storyteller designed for creators tired of choosing between bulky action cams, weak basic cameras, or tiny devices lacking remote control. It solves a common modern dilemma: the desire for stable 4K video, instant sharing, and app connectivity without the burden of heavy gear. By packing professional-grade recording and sharing capabilities into a stylish, palm-sized body, AulGo ensures you never miss a moment simply because your camera was too big to carry. It slips effortlessly into a bag or pocket, making it the perfect smart everyday gift and companion for vlogs, travel, sports, and daily life.

At the core of AulGo's impressive performance is its SONY IMX486 sensor, which captures up to 12MP images and records 4K footage with remarkably cleaner details and richer colors across both daytime and night scenes. For active users and adventurers, the built-in 6-Axis Electronic Image Stabilization (EIS) is a game-changer, smoothing out shakes and jitters while walking, riding bikes, or capturing fast-paced action sports. Paired with 5-in-1 recording modes, 5.8G WiFi connectivity, and a dedicated app for remote control and fast sharing, AulGo replaces multiple pieces of equipment with a single, low-power device that delivers polished footage right out of the camera.

What truly sets AulGo apart is its versatile, multi-scene mounting system. Featuring a built-in magnetic base alongside a standard 1/4-inch screw mount, AulGo can be snapped onto metal surfaces like fridge doors or car roofs, or mounted on tripods, gimbals, and brackets. This "Snap. Screw. Shoot Anywhere" flexibility empowers users to capture creative, hands-free angles from places their human hands simply cannot hold. Combined with noise-reducing audio for clearer sound, AulGo provides all the tools needed for dynamic backup recording, driving logs, and capturing life's most fleeting moments from a fresh perspective.

projects.blurb: They send a note from their phone — a word, a drawing, a sticker — and it lands on your keychain, anytime, from anywhere.
projects.html_story:
They send a note from their phone — a word, a drawing, a sticker — and it lands on your keychain, anytime, from anywhere.

We reached our goal in less than 2 hours! Thank you 🙏 🙏 🙏 🙏Every pledge now pushes toward the next stretch goal.

KEEP is a connected keychain that carries a note from the people you love. They write to you in the free app — a few words, a drawing, a sticker — from anywhere in the world. You get a notification, hold your phone to your keychain for a couple of seconds, and their note appears on the little e-ink screen, where it stays until the next one arrives. No battery to charge, no WiFi, no Bluetooth — just a piece of someone who loves you, with you wherever you go.

Every note starts in the free KEEP app — oniPhone and Android. Write a few words, doodle by hand, or drop a sticker, preview it, and send. It lands on your person's KEEP the next time they tap their phone to it.

A notification lands on your phone. Open the KEEP app, hold your phone to the keychain for a second or two, and the new note appears on the e-ink screen — no pairing, no battery, nothing to charge.

Our team spent eight months making KEEPminimalist— and making sure it's high-quality, durable and effortless to use. The hard part wasn't adding features; it was leaving them out.

KEEP isn't a promise from strangers. It's the second hardware product from the team that has been shipping connected wooden Loveboxes since its first Kickstarter in 2017.

Loved in real homes

It started here, in 2017 — €270,931 from 2,881 backers for the first wooden Lovebox. This June, we come back to where it all began, for KEEP.

“He's deployed six months at a time. Every morning there's a new note waiting on the screen. It's the first thing he looks for.”— Marina · Lovebox owner since 2020

“My dad doesn't text. He draws. A wonky little sun, most mornings. I'd frame every one of them if I could.”— Théo · since 2021

“Grandma doesn't have WiFi and never will. This is the only 'gadget' she's ever kept switched on.”— Lena · since 2018

“My daughter left for university in another country. The Lovebox stayed on her old desk. Now she can take one with her.”— Pascale · since 2019

KEEP wasn't designed in a meeting — it was designed in your inbox. Ten years ago we put love in a wooden box; for a decade you've told us what you wished it could do. KEEP is that wish-list, built: the same heart, made to travel.

For ten years, we've read variations of the same three emails:

"I love my Lovebox. I wish I could carry it with me."— Sophie, Lovebox owner since 2019

"I want one for my grandmother. But she doesn't have WiFi."— Tom, Lovebox owner since 2021

"I send messages to my kids when I travel. I wish they could send me real ones back."— Anna, Lovebox owner since 2018

For ten years, we wrote back: "we hear you, we're working on it." Now, we don't have to anymore.

KEEP didn't come off a spec sheet. It came from eight months of prototypes, dead ends and late nights — and from people in our community who carried early units every day and told us, bluntly, what to fix. By the time it reached this page, it had already lived in real pockets, on real keyrings, on real bags.

"I loved helping the LoveTeam build this — from the glitchy first version to the later ones that just worked and quietly became part of my routine."— one of our KEEP beta testers

The reward tiers

The discount runs inwaves. The earlier you back, the deeper the cut — and the fewer there are. Once a wave's units are gone, the next opens at a smaller discount. Add engraving to any reward afterward.

Every bulk tier ships with the KEEP for Business apps, API access and custom-logo engraving. Made to order — ships after the consumer waves. Need an in-between quantity? Pick the nearest tier and add the extra to your pledge — we bill the additional units at the same per-unit price.

Need custom packaging, a white-label app, or anything we haven't listed? Tell us what you're planning atkeep@lovebox.loveand we'll scope it and send a quote.

Some shops are always first. Back KEEP on Kickstarter and yours becomes one of the very first in the world to carry it — on your shelves months before it reaches open retail. Made for the concept stores, design boutiques and museum counters that like to be a step ahead of the room.

Wholesale prices, for resale. Need an in-between quantity? Pick the nearest pack and add the extra to your pledge — we bill the additional units at the same per-unit price.

Bigger volumes, custom packaging or any custom inquiry? Write tokeep@lovebox.loveand we'll send a quote.

The lowest price it will ever be.Up to half off the $60 retail price — but only in the early waves, and only while they last.

Be among the very first to carry one.Early-wave backers get the first units off the line, shipping September 2026.

You brought it into the world.Your pledges funded the first production run — we passed our $10,000 goal. Every pledge now pushes toward the next stretch goal, free for everyone in the app.

Put a little more love out there.In a world that feels noisier and further apart than ever, you're helping land some warmth in someone's pocket.

The early waves go in order, and they don't come back — backing now locks the best price and the earliest spot.

A stretch goal works like this: the more the campaign raises past its target, the more we get to build. The KEEP itself ships no matter what — but every milestone we pass together unlocks a new feature, free, in the app the people you love already hold.

The design is finished and tested. This campaign funds the production run — not the invention. Here's the plan.

Now · June 2026The campaign is live. Back a wave before it sells out and lock your price.

July 2026Campaign closes. We send every backer a short form to confirm delivery details and collect engraving.

Jul–Aug 2026Production tooling, a final validation build and certification — mostly done already; this is the confirmation pass.

September 2026The first 600 KEEPs ship — the earliest waves and 2017 backers first, with unit-by-unit quality control.

October 2026Every remaining KEEP ships, from our European and US fulfilment hubs — closer to you, fewer customs surprises.

Shipping worldwide

We ship KEEP anywhere in the world.

Shipping is free to the US, the EU, Switzerland, China and Hong Kong. For the UK and  Canada, it's a flat $10 — for any reward. Everywhere else, it's a flat $20. Business and retail orders include shipping.

We fulfil locally wherever we can — so for the EU, the US, China and Hong Kong there areno import taxes. For other destinations, your country may charge import duties when KEEP arrives; those aren't included in your pledge.

Where your order ships from

California, USA→ United States & Canada

Hong Kong→ Hong Kong

Paris, France→ Europe & the rest of the world

Designed in France by the small team that has shipped Lovebox for a decade — with the same factory and fulfilment partners behind the 300,000 units of Lovebox we shipped.

Risks and challenges

Every hardware campaign carries the same handful of risks. Here they are, plainly — and why each one is unusually low for us.

Manufacturing & quality. No production run is ever entirely risk-free — but ours is about as de-risked as hardware gets: we've already shipped 300,000+ connected devices with the same production and quality-control partners, on proven tooling and materials, not a first-time factory.

Component supply (e-ink & NFC). Component markets can always surprise you, and we won't pretend otherwise — but the display and NFC parts are standard and already sourced, with lead times we've built into our delivery dates.

Shipping & logistics. Cross-border shipping is never perfectly smooth — but we already fulfil to 40+ countries every week and ship from regional hubs, which keeps delivery and customs about as predictable as it gets.

Timeline slips. Dates can always move a little, and we'd rather say so up front — but the product is designed, tested and certified-in-progress, so this campaign funds the production run, not the R&D. If anything shifts, you'll hear it first in a backer update, the way we've talked to our community for ten years.

One honest limit: KEEP is water-resistant — rain and a wet pocket are fine — but it is not built for the washing machine or for immersion, and we will never claim otherwise.

Back it because you believe in it.

Support the project for no reward, just because it speaks to you.

projects.ai_intro_en: KEEP is a connected keychain that displays messages from loved ones on a small e-ink screen. Using the free KEEP app on iPhone or Android, anyone can send words, drawings, or stickers from anywhere in the world. When a new note arrives, simply hold your phone to the keychain for a couple of seconds and the message appears — no battery, WiFi, or Bluetooth required.
ai_highlights_en: No battery, WiFi, or Bluetooth needed — just tap your phone to receive notes
E-ink screen displays words, hand-drawn doodles, and stickers from the free app
From the makers of the Lovebox, with a decade of experience in connected keepsakes
ai_specs_en: KEEP for Business apps, API access, custom-logo engraving
projects.ai_risks_en: The design is finished and tested, and the campaign funds production rather than invention, reducing technical risk. However, as with any hardware crowdfunding project, there are inherent risks of manufacturing delays, supply chain disruptions, or quality control issues that could affect the September 2026 shipping timeline.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: The LoveTeam, creators of the connected wooden Lovebox since their first Kickstarter in 2017, with over 2,800 backers and €270,000 raised.
projects.ai_description_en:
KEEP is a minimalist, connected bamboo keychain designed to keep your loved ones close, no matter the distance. Created by the team behind the popular wooden Lovebox, KEEP allows anyone to send a personal note—a few words, a hand-drawn doodle, or a sticker—through a free smartphone app. When a message is sent, the recipient gets a notification. By simply holding their phone to the keychain for a couple of seconds, the note appears on the device's e-ink screen, where it stays until the next one arrives. Remarkably, the keychain requires no battery to charge, no WiFi, and no Bluetooth pairing, making it a truly effortless way to carry a piece of someone you love.

Born from a decade of community feedback, KEEP answers the long-standing wish for a portable way to receive affectionate messages. While traditional love boxes are stationary desk accessories, KEEP is designed for life on the go, making it the perfect solution for deployed partners, far-away grandparents who don't use WiFi, or any family looking to bridge the distance. The e-ink display offers a tangible, constant reminder of connection that a fleeting digital notification simply cannot match. Whether it's a wonky morning sun drawn by a parent or a goodnight wish from across the globe, KEEP transforms digital affection into a physical presence in your pocket.

Beyond its emotional impact, KEEP is a triumph of refined, durable engineering. After eight months of prototyping, the team deliberately stripped away unnecessary features to deliver a high-quality, water-resistant device. Furthermore, this campaign represents a highly de-risked hardware venture: the creators have already shipped over 300,000 connected devices using the same manufacturing partners, standard component sourcing, and established global logistics across 40+ countries. The product is already designed, tested, and in the process of certification, meaning campaign funds go directly toward production rather than risky R&D. With an estimated delivery starting in October 2026, KEEP is poised to deliver a reliable, heartfelt connection right to your keyring.

projects.name: Swellframe: The Always-On Surf Forecast Display
projects.blurb: A beautiful E-ink surf forecast display for your home. No app. No scrolling. No notifications. Just your local break at a glance.
projects.html_story:
A beautiful E-ink surf forecast display for your home. No app. No scrolling. No notifications. Just your local break at a glance.

A beautiful E-ink surf forecast display for your home. No app. No scrolling. No notifications. Just your local break at a glance.

What's in your Box?

Environmental commitments

We will ship to theU.S. in the first waveand to theEuropean Union next. Please be patient with us. Are you inAustralia, New Zealand, the UK, or anywhere else?We have not forgotten you.Sign up hereand we’ll notify you the moment we ship to your region.

Pleasebear with us. We are trying to avoid taking on investors who could force a subscription model on us. But to be fully transparent,certifications and regulations are expensivefor the EU and AUS/NZ, and they take a lot longer than in the U.S. We will make it happen. It is just taking a minute longer than we thought.Your early purchase is madly appreciated!

Swellframeis more than another screen. It’s a purpose-built, always-on surf forecast display designed to help surfers check the waves without getting pulled back into their phone. At a glance, Swellframe shows the conditions that matter most:swell, wind, tide, forecast, and the best time to paddle out. No app to open.No notifications. No ads. No doomscrolling.Just a clean e-ink display that lives on your wall, in your van, or at the shop, updated automatically over Wi-Fi and powered by a rechargeablebattery that lasts 6+ monthson a single charge. More surf. Less phone.

Swellframe launches withno required subscription and no ads, ever.Our commitment is simple: the core surf forecast experience will always remain free, so you can keep checking the waves without getting dragged into another monthly fee, feed, or sponsored distraction. In the future, we may offer optional premium features or third-party integrations that carry their own subscription costs, but the essential Swellframe-owned surf forecasts will always be there.

For anyone who wants to lock in the full Swellframe experience forever, check out ourKickstarter ad-on optionsto securelifetime accessto all Swellframe-owned updates and features, guaranteed without a subscription.

Swellframe comes loaded with a growing lineup of surf spots,from local breaks to iconic wavesaround the world.

Don’t see your go-to spot yet? No worries. Every Swellframe owner can paddle into the portal anytime andrequest a new spot, so your daily surf check stays dialed to the waves you actually chase.

After purchasing your Swellframe on Kickstarter, send us an email athello@swellframe.coto request your surf spot. Please include a screenshot of your order confirmation.

Optional but helpful: share as much local context as you can, including longitude, latitude, best tide, ideal wind direction, preferred swell height, and any other spot-specific details we should know.

7-Day ClassicA clean full-week surf forecast at a glance, with morning and afternoon conditions for each day. Great for quickly seeing how the week is shaping up without digging into hourly details.

7-Day Overview with Session FocusA full week at a glance with morning and afternoon conditions for each day. Includes the best 3 upcoming sessions ranked by quality, so you know exactly when to watch.

2-Day DetailHourly breakdown for the next 2 days, including wave height, wind, tide, session ratings, sunrise/sunset, and water temp. Also includes a “Days to Watch” section that flags upcoming good sessions beyond the 2-day window.

Local InsightsA personalized, editorial-style forecast written by our AI in natural surf language. It greets you by name and breaks down today, tomorrow, and the rest of the week with specific local condition insights.

Swellframe's planned retail price is$139. Kickstarter backers get the best pricing we'll ever offer, full stop.

The first public tier is$97, 30% offretail. We also built bundles for people who want one at home, one at work, one at the surf shack… or one for the person who keeps texting"how's it looking?"

And for our original launch-list crew:we promised the first 500 sign-ups 30% off. Well, surprise. You're gettingalmost 40% offretail, because you were here before Swellframe ever hit the lineup. Thank you for paddling out early.

What's in your Box?

We’ve submitted Swellframe’s final production design for agency compliance testing. And because Flo is German, we’re especially proud to be working with TÜV Rheinland. Testing is currently underway to confirm Swellframe meets the applicable requirements for the markets we plan to ship to. Any required marks, labels, and certification details will be finalized before our shipping boxes go to print. We’ll continue to keep backers updated before fulfillment begins.

Swellframe was started by two very different kinds of surfers.

Tommy and Flo their kiddos (Tommy's dad in the background)

Tommy grew up on the Jersey Shore, became a pro surfer, traveled the world chasing waves, and built deep roots across the surf industry. Flo grew up landlocked in Germany, with almost no natural path into surfing, found it only in his early 20s, remains an absolutely average surfer, and has been technologically obsessed for as long as he can remember.

That unlikely combination became the whole point. Tommy brought the surf brain, industry instinct, creative madness, and firsthand understanding of what surfers actually care about. Flo brought the software, product obsession, late-night technical grind, and a slightly unreasonable belief that the daily surf check could be made calmer, simpler, and better.

We’re also dads, and that changed how we think about time, attention, and the little moments that actually matter. The more life filled up, the more obvious it became that every unnecessary phone check had a cost. We still wanted to know when the waves were good. We just didn’t want the surf check to become another excuse to disappear into a screen.

Together, we started building the thing we wished existed: a quiet, always-on surf forecast that lives in your home and keeps you connected to the ocean without pulling you into your phone. Built in Ocean Township, New Jersey, Swellframe is the result of two very different paths meeting around one shared idea.Read the full story.

Check the waves, not your phone.

Risks and challenges

Swellframe is a hardware product, and hardware always comes with real risks. We want to be upfront about the areas we are watching most closely.

The biggest risk is supply chain timing. Swellframe depends on specialized components, especially the e-ink display, PCB components, batteries, enclosures, and packaging materials. We have already started securing key parts and working with suppliers, but delays can still happen. Component lead times, shipping delays, customs, manufacturing capacity, or quality issues at the supplier level could impact our delivery timeline.

To reduce this risk, we are not starting from zero. We have working prototypes, we have already tested the core experience, and we are actively locking in the most important parts of the supply chain before launch. We are also building in buffer time where possible and working with suppliers that can scale with us.

Another challenge is manufacturing consistency. Swellframe needs to look good, feel simple, and work reliably in real homes. Moving from prototypes to production means validating the enclosure, screen fit, battery performance, firmware stability, and final assembly process. Small changes in materials or tolerances can create unexpected issues, so we are taking extra care during testing and production planning.

Certification and compliance are also part of the process. Because Swellframe includes wireless connectivity and electronics, we need to complete the required testing before shipping. This is a standard part of bringing a connected hardware product to market, but it can introduce delays if any changes are required.

There is also a software and data reliability challenge. Swellframe is designed to show a simple, always-on surf forecast, but behind that simplicity are forecast data sources, connectivity, firmware, and our own forecast logic. We will continue testing across different surf spots, Wi-Fi environments, and usage patterns to make the experience as reliable as possible before fulfillment.

Finally, there is always the risk that timelines move. Our goal is to deliver as promised, but we would rather be honest and ship something we are proud of than rush a product that is not ready. If anything changes, we will communicate clearly with backers and share updates along the way.

We started Swellframe because we wanted a calmer, simpler way to check the waves without reaching for our phones. We are committed to making that real, and we are taking the risks of building a hardware product seriously.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Founded by Tommy (pro surfer from Jersey Shore) and Flo (German software/tech enthusiast), two dads who built the surf forecast display they wished existed.
projects.ai_description_en:
Swellframe is a purpose-built, always-on surf forecast display designed to bring calm back to checking the waves. This elegant e-ink device lives on your wall, in your van, or at the shop, showing the conditions that matter most—swell, wind, tide, forecast, and the best time to paddle out—at a single glance. No app to open, no notifications, no ads, no doomscrolling. Just a clean, beautiful display that updates automatically over Wi-Fi and runs on a rechargeable battery that lasts six months or more on a single charge. It's the simplest way to stay connected to your local break without getting pulled back into your phone.

At its core, Swellframe is about more surf and less screen time. The device comes loaded with a growing lineup of surf spots, from local breaks to iconic waves around the world, and the core surf forecast experience launches with no required subscription and no ads—ever. The team is committed to keeping Swellframe-owned forecasts free, so you can check the waves without another monthly fee, feed, or sponsored distraction. For those who want to lock in the full experience forever, Kickstarter add-ons offer lifetime access to all Swellframe-owned updates and features, guaranteed without a subscription.

Behind the simplicity is serious hardware engineering. Swellframe combines a specialized e-ink display, custom PCB, long-life battery, and a refined enclosure into a product that looks good, feels simple, and works reliably in real homes. The team has already built working prototypes, tested the core experience, and is actively securing key supply chain components to minimize delays. While hardware always carries risks—from component lead times to manufacturing consistency and certification requirements—the founders are taking those challenges seriously, building in buffer time, and prioritizing a product they're proud of over rushing to market. The first wave of shipments is headed to the U.S., with the European Union to follow, and the team is working to expand to Australia, New Zealand, the UK, and beyond as certifications allow.

Don't let heat limit your performance.SoLid's active cooling fan + multi-zone airflow keeps SSDs stable — reliable for high-speed transfers, pro recording, and long hours of creation.

What's in the Box ?

Risks and challenges

We're being upfront: hardware is hard. Manufacturing delays, component sourcing, and shipping hiccups are real risks we've seen happen to projects we admire. To minimize them, we've already completed engineering prototypes, locked in a manufacturing partner, and built buffer time into our delivery schedule. We'll communicate openly if anything shifts — no surprises, no excuses. Just honest updates and a commitment to getting this hub into your hands as promised.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We design for longevity, not obsolescence. The NVMe SSD is user-replaceable, every port is rated for thousands of insertion cycles, and we avoid glued-in batteries or proprietary components that become unavailable in a few years. We want this hub to still be on your desk — or in your bag — five years from now, not sitting in a drawer or a landfill.

Reusability and recyclability

We design for longevity, not obsolescence. The NVMe SSD is user-replaceable, every port is rated for thousands of insertion cycles, and we avoid glued-in batteries or proprietary components that become unavailable in a few years. We want this hub to still be on your desk — or in your bag — five years from now, not sitting in a drawer or a landfill.

Sustainable materials

We prioritize materials that are durable, recyclable, and responsibly sourced. The enclosure is made primarily from aluminum — a material that can be recycled repeatedly without losing quality. The transparent window uses acrylic, which requires less energy to produce than glass and is fully recyclable. We also minimize plastic use in packaging, opting for recycled cardboard and soy-based inks wherever possible. Every material choice balances performance with environmental responsibility.

Environmentally friendly factories

We consider three things above all else: quality, ethics, and communication. First, we audit the factory's production capabilities, quality control processes, and track record with similar electronics. Second, we ensure they meet fair labor standards and environmental regulations — no shortcuts on working conditions or waste disposal. Third, we prioritize factories that are responsive and transparent, because good communication prevents most production problems before they start. We don't chase the lowest price. We chase the right partner.

Sustainable Distribution

We're keeping it simple and practical. Packaging will use recycled cardboard and minimal plastic — no oversized boxes or foam inserts. We're also consolidating shipments to reduce air freight wherever possible, even if it means a slightly longer wait. For backers in the same region, we'll explore local fulfillment centers to cut down on long-haul transport. None of this is perfect, but it's a start. We'll keep looking for better ways to deliver without trashing the planet.

Magnetic attachment effectiveness across different phone cases and real-world thermal performance remain unverified until product ships.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: We meticulously refine every detail, from material selection to craftsmanship, always prioritizing stability and reliability. We believe good products don't need to be flashy; they quietly integrate into your work and life, delivering quality in every connection. We don't chase specifications, we only care about the experience. Born for efficiency, existing for simplicity. Connection should be this simple.
projects.ai_description_en:
The SoLid 4-Bay Magnetic SSD Hub is the ultimate all-in-one workflow solution designed specifically for creators who are tired of the accessory chaos that comes with high-end video production. As devices become more powerful, shooting 4K and ProRes video rapidly depletes built-in storage, forcing creators to juggle a mess of dongles, card readers, chargers, and drive cases. Worse, long recordings cause traditional SSDs to overheat, leading to speed drops or catastrophic recording interruptions. SoLid solves this by integrating high-capacity storage, expansion, power delivery, and professional external recording into a single, compact device, ensuring your creative flow is never compromised by "storage full" warnings or thermal throttling. 

This powerhouse dock supports up to four M.2 NVMe SSDs (sizes 2230 to 2280) for a massive combined capacity of up to 8TB, delivering data transfer speeds of up to 20Gbps via USB-C. It is purpose-built for high-bitrate workflows, natively supporting Apple ProRes external recording—including direct-to-SSD and long continuous recording for setups like the iPhone 16 Pro shooting 4K 120fps. Beyond storage, SoLid functions as a comprehensive expansion hub, featuring HDMI output up to 4K120Hz/8K60Hz, USB-A ports, an SD card reader, and 120W USB-C PD pass-through charging. A built-in magnetic modular system allows for the instant attachment of phones or handheld devices, keeping your rig clean and mobile. 

What truly sets SoLid apart is its commitment to sustained performance through active cooling and its striking aesthetic. Unlike traditional hubs that rely on passive cooling, SoLid features a high-speed active cooling fan combined with a large-area honeycomb ventilation design. This multi-zone airflow circulates cool air through the chassis, rapidly dissipating heat from the SSDs, controller chip, and PCB to maintain stable write speeds during intensive use. Visually, the hub boasts a transparent cyberpunk design with a clear mecha shell that reveals the internal structure—neon-like PCB traces, controller chip, and spinning fan are all on display, illuminated by a built-in LED ambient light that glows when powered. SoLid delivers hassle-free creation in one go.

## Story

### WHY AVELUN SOLARLUN EXISTS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/696/0a4fa020024e7017478a1433b4926993_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149447&width=680&sig=ptLE9jo67dpWubvGKmHKs5Y0vU4k1cjMbQCGY9Rd%2B9w%3D)

You packed light. Your battery didn’t.

9 out of 10 people have missed a photo, a call, or a trail because their phone died.

A regular power bank helps — until it runs out.

A traditional solar panel helps — if you are willing to carry the bulk.

A small solar power bank looks convenient — but often relies on a tiny solar strip that is too limited for real outdoor charging.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/683/7e3a09c7602d10470632372ba604ae3f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098372&width=680&sig=T24fUX9KBtj4FNy5pJ68CITsSTtLNYshvoOF6SStF4w%3D)

We built Avelun SolarLun so you never have to choose between staying light and staying powered.

### MEET AVELUN SOLARLUN

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/699/869ebf4b6cce67ff0453ca467e992de1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149466&width=680&sig=NFTa%2BWOsfSONr2hrRIoI%2FBLzCkU8oMPkCTPOQiE4zJM%3D)

AVELUN SOLARLUN is made of two independent modules that work separately or together.

The power bank module stores energy and charges devices anytime.

The solar charger module unfolds into a 6-fold flexible solar array and can charge devices directly through Type-C.

When snapped together magnetically, the solar panel helps recharge the power bank using sunlight.

This gives you more flexibility than a regular power bank, more portability than a traditional solar kit, and more usable solar area than most tiny solar power banks.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/701/798048257b7684bb4cdfe5d6c63e597a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098513&width=680&sig=xZ6Wr1pfXWN0qjI1x5n5COFz5YkdhutqwXHCqLLCur4%3D)

### ONE SYSTEM. THREE CHARGING MODES.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/046/547/874e71663d4438ccaf181e0c9821af9e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781017263&width=680&sig=Fcn8DzOAC48gFEPtAWLU4oxrvH1jdX%2BFdT2NteMB1LY%3D)

Most power banks only work until they run out. Most solar chargers only work when the sun is available. SolarLun brings both together in one modular system.

Use stored power anytime. Charge devices directly from sunlight. Snap the battery onto the panel to recover energy outdoors. One compact system gives you more ways to stay powered when outlets are not nearby.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/702/e1047466ccf62dae4ae73026bcedbe49_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098531&width=680&sig=A3r4FhKpXDi%2Bby%2FvIaviwtqG4miIQ2PXl%2FsAD8bxb8k%3D)

### POWER WHEN THE SUN ISN’T AROUND

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/702/e5e98a548d4c00829f11dc5ea3998f22_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149494&width=680&sig=oG2i%2FBsLtGVs810Wle%2FSmZzQEm2AK9vp%2BZjGA%2BdP7zM%3D)

When sunlight is not available, use SolarLun as a portable power bank. The detachable 7,800mAh battery module gives you reliable backup power for phones, cameras, earbuds, lights, and other everyday devices.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/707/92d09a18681ef28f8dadfc98409e62c8_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098550&width=680&sig=OI9DMXlPOsjymDPqjfJciCysYoDqy0R6ewa0bc9YXog%3D)

### POWER DIRECTLY FROM THE SUN

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/705/40aef3db4fa8cbbab5141d314b59839d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149508&width=680&sig=HPOZMDe9j92BVRJ8nwoC4cS5V4lwNZDAyBbIn0%2FR5Fk%3D)

When sunlight is available, SolarLun works as a standalone solar charger. Unfold the 6-fold solar panel, connect your device through the USB-C output, and use sunlight to power phones, GPS devices, cameras, USB lights, and other small electronics.

This mode is ideal when you want to save the battery module for later, charge during the day, or keep essential devices running while you are outdoors.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/712/5562b08e19759c0f738b168186bee570_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098574&width=680&sig=6BFnrwAz%2BggNmDuKzNvr8iGgvqw%2BrRL8V0ctUz7pIR4%3D)

### SOLAR RECOVERY FOR LONGER DAYS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/708/df58e0e19a35f2e93d8184f5c8117a7c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149525&width=680&sig=Jw2So8%2BKR2kHO0oH7%2FxqWS%2FVSl4y5ZnwBXgYWHeP67w%3D)

When your battery module runs low, SolarLun gives you another way to recover power outdoors. Snap the power bank onto the solar panel, place it in stable sunlight, and let the panel help recharge the battery during the day.

No complicated clips. No loose mounting parts. No awkward alignment. Just snap, connect, and recover power when outlets are not around.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/717/78963a91d61aa0c872b343b31b1a19f3_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098587&width=680&sig=YIjgoqmYBnXvjiGx5f3aoBGyo2%2FMuVnw%2BFK%2BLXtg2lA%3D)

### THE CORE DIFFERENCE

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/722/d339e7d3ddbc9166f5c5b7b0f1b2aae6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098612&width=680&sig=ydz0kACQdOH%2F8HOlmwHZ4XC6JJwbvfbiuGh3TKsx1cs%3D)

### 6-FOLD SOLAR CHARGER

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/046/584/04c0998480b7c11c436507cfdc7e7101_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781017351&width=680&sig=A%2FVbrWirrv8Lu3dhR1zQGgw0BejwoIJnfB0uXAve1zw%3D)

Avelun SolarLun uses a 6-fold flexible solar panel that opens wide when sunlight is available.

Folded, it is compact for bag carry.

Opened, it becomes a real solar charging surface.

The solar panel includes its own Type-C output, so it can directly charge compatible electronic devices in sunlight — even when it is not connected to the power bank module.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/733/42a21706c3c666b601802d277d2e676a_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781098675&width=680&sig=VdZFGyBgckabAT%2B0QKyUUD88Zw5SkQ88NhDWUdJr4PY%3D)

### 18W SOLAR POWER

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/738/50274dde7c2dd29cf90eaee40209f379_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781098700&width=680&sig=pwfuSK7y8yqc%2F%2FTG94AVj4FHdM2jqhuUNqMkhaScoFI%3D)

### 7,800mAh POWER BANK MODULE

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/061/044/824486b8c3f0a666bef477685e1696ca_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781105218&width=680&sig=pB6XWmifWnk4digQEA5mL9kcUmc0n2pkYDybRwA4uZ8%3D)

The detachable 7,800mAh battery module gives SolarLun instant backup power when you need it most. Use it like a regular power bank to charge your phone, earbuds, camera accessories, USB lights, or other everyday devices — no sunlight required.

Then, when daylight is available, connect it back to the solar panel and let SolarLun help recover energy from the sun. It is everyday backup power with a way to recharge beyond the wall outlet.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/061/047/db49725e6d889e7cb6b48657021c8000_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781105236&width=680&sig=Pu8%2Fe56MkSA32GbA7pB9dO5rUzPEbZZTSP2N%2F2%2FztCc%3D)

### TYPE-C + USB-A OUTPUT

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/061/052/c5f317cf5d821d2ea13082ab0620e6b1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781105265&width=680&sig=PBtE8zcK0U71cwhr%2F5cLJYVeK4nGVBju5ZPuyB8WO3w%3D)

SolarLun is built to work with the devices you already carry. The battery module gives you Type-C and USB-A output for everyday charging, while the solar panel includes its own Type-C port for direct sunlight charging.

Use the battery when you need stored power. Use the solar panel when daylight is available. From phones and cameras to earbuds, lights, GPS devices, and accessories, SolarLun gives your gear more ways to stay powered.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/061/057/b4a366b6936b047ffa6b9f15d9beb597_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781105278&width=680&sig=SIbJ7SEIRw%2BKbUdt0jC%2Bualjh90zK2I8SyQqhAA%2FpwQ%3D)

### FOLDABLE— AND BUILT FOR REAL CARRY

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/046/614/36f4f0df4f63c3f174b73bf6f6a32bba_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781017409&width=680&sig=Ijj8aSZtIdf5n%2BUpfH2wSTwxanfvoXe%2BGYIRffMNBO8%3D)

SolarLun is designed to go with your everyday gear, not sit at home like a bulky solar panel. Fold it down for easy packing in a backpack, travel bag, car kit, or emergency box. When sunlight is available, unfold the 6-fold panel to create a larger charging surface for real outdoor use.

Compact when you carry it. Useful when you open it.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/061/068/f4de2a94e303eb8991eaf13fe2d143f7_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781105316&width=680&sig=bhjfc0olridZYOMYfFMXJ5DLn1p92vZHeK315HkicvA%3D)

### BUILT FOR TRAVEL, OUTDOORS, AND EMERGENCIES

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/046/617/6cdd1062a85cc7512ffb9f36c6ee6b9f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781017419&width=680&sig=EJqIaLB0N1v4ChSV7tnOnZJmTklGCVRAxQsu2%2FlVSaI%3D)

From road trips and camping nights to hiking breaks, photography days, and power outages, SolarLun gives you flexible backup power when outlets are hard to find.

Battery when you need it. Solar when you can use it. Recovery when you need to keep going longer.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/746/31b2f2d28de85b34f7d8fccb97378cca_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098722&width=680&sig=%2FmXxYlEWYHgUchgBjyt13NDufe7kML4YjfyaVuZsjig%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/745/c51f1abafefbbd85c4ef852ae39d7c39_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149791&width=680&sig=xA5xpOkznivqbwAp1drLrda7R%2FK1md2WudPuiPzaKoY%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/750/5f8fbf61e3863bb1e4af396f506b6340_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098734&width=680&sig=Y25f2yCuK2BH9h8BSCE52ReFBZt6%2BtaSmoVuZX6Xnqo%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/752/91b8766560ea7587dcfe53d5939c8376_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149823&width=680&sig=1WXPw3uZVZUJm4xB3b5ePZTXfDQcmwuX%2FP1kPi9R74A%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/755/d558f8cc9a73bfcbcb501e99ed52f780_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098748&width=680&sig=ZUriy4cGeHNfcgH1dqsmtKDzWRRR1KEnGCBOLa1j8lY%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/046/636/961d1f035a59cda5333fe24c7f82cbde_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781017504&width=680&sig=V3tvueXArGQ8xzAkOgOmGjDP5%2FiokqKEOxCpNB%2Fi468%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/059/785/39bad82118ced86f159d2367a158af02_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781098844&width=680&sig=jOg87z64%2BerA%2FFe7YfFXeXtOnPadGpMMdicyNxnUwhA%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/071/228/09a7275b79d3b29b1cb1f2fa306c54be_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781173129&width=680&sig=3d3GXd63jG9vfMtim9SnvV6ZEp0IdgWk3fBCnHkKa7I%3D)

We are a small team of outdoor enthusiasts and product engineers. We love hiking, camping, photography, and travel — but we also rely on our devices for maps, photos, music, and emergencies.

For years, we carried power banks that died too fast, and solar panels that were too bulky or too slow to be useful.

We tried the tiny solar power banks on the market. They looked convenient, but the solar strip was a decoration — not a real charging solution. We tried large foldable solar panels. They worked, but we couldn’t fit them in a daypack.

So we decided to build our own.

We wanted a modular system: a real 7,800mAh power bank for instant backup, a 6-fold solar panel with enough surface to actually charge, and a magnetic connection that let us use both together — or separately.

Months of prototyping. Dozens of folding hinge designs. Countless tests in direct sun, partial shade, rain, and dust.

The result is Avelun SolarLun.

Not a power bank with a tiny solar sticker. Not a bulky solar panel you leave at home. A modular system that gives you three practical ways to stay powered — battery now, solar direct when you can, and solar recovery when your power bank needs a top-up outdoors.

We made this for people who move — and who don't want to stop for an outlet.
