WHY AVELUN SOLARLUN EXISTS

You packed light. Your battery didn’t.9 out of 10 people have missed a photo, a call, or a trail because their phone died.A regular power bank helps — until it runs out.A traditional solar panel helps — if you are willing to carry the bulk.A small solar power bank looks convenient — but often relies on a tiny solar strip that is too limited for real outdoor charging.

We built Avelun SolarLun so you never have to choose between staying light and staying powered.

MEET AVELUN SOLARLUN

AVELUN SOLARLUNis made of two independent modules that work separately or together.The power bank module stores energy and charges devices anytime.The solar charger module unfolds into a 6-fold flexible solar array and can charge devices directly through Type-C.When snapped together magnetically, the solar panel helps recharge the power bank using sunlight.This gives you more flexibility than a regular power bank, more portability than a traditional solar kit, and more usable solar area than most tiny solar power banks.

ONE SYSTEM. THREE CHARGING MODES.

Most power banks only work until they run out. Most solar chargers only work when the sun is available. SolarLun brings both together in one modular system.

Use stored power anytime. Charge devices directly from sunlight. Snap the battery onto the panel to recover energy outdoors. One compact system gives you more ways to stay powered when outlets are not nearby.

POWER WHEN THE SUN ISN’T AROUND

When sunlight is not available, use SolarLun as a portable power bank. The detachable 7,800mAh battery module gives you reliable backup power for phones, cameras, earbuds, lights, and other everyday devices.

POWER DIRECTLY FROM THE SUN

When sunlight is available, SolarLun works as a standalone solar charger. Unfold the 6-fold solar panel, connect your device through the USB-C output, and use sunlight to power phones, GPS devices, cameras, USB lights, and other small electronics.

This mode is ideal when you want to save the battery module for later, charge during the day, or keep essential devices running while you are outdoors.

SOLAR RECOVERY FOR LONGER DAYS

When your battery module runs low, SolarLun gives you another way to recover power outdoors. Snap the power bank onto the solar panel, place it in stable sunlight, and let the panel help recharge the battery during the day.

No complicated clips. No loose mounting parts. No awkward alignment. Just snap, connect, and recover power when outlets are not around.

THE CORE DIFFERENCE

6-FOLD SOLAR CHARGER

Avelun SolarLun uses a 6-fold flexible solar panel that opens wide when sunlight is available.Folded, it is compact for bag carry.Opened, it becomes a real solar charging surface.The solar panel includes its own Type-C output, so it can directly charge compatible electronic devices in sunlight — even when it is not connected to the power bank module.

18W SOLAR POWER

7,800mAh POWER BANK MODULE

The detachable 7,800mAh battery module gives SolarLun instant backup power when you need it most. Use it like a regular power bank to charge your phone, earbuds, camera accessories, USB lights, or other everyday devices — no sunlight required.

Then, when daylight is available, connect it back to the solar panel and let SolarLun help recover energy from the sun. It is everyday backup power with a way to recharge beyond the wall outlet.

TYPE-C + USB-A OUTPUT

SolarLun is built to work with the devices you already carry. The battery module gives you Type-C and USB-A output for everyday charging, while the solar panel includes its own Type-C port for direct sunlight charging.

Use the battery when you need stored power. Use the solar panel when daylight is available. From phones and cameras to earbuds, lights, GPS devices, and accessories, SolarLun gives your gear more ways to stay powered.

FOLDABLE— AND BUILT FOR REAL CARRY

SolarLun is designed to go with your everyday gear, not sit at home like a bulky solar panel. Fold it down for easy packing in a backpack, travel bag, car kit, or emergency box. When sunlight is available, unfold the 6-fold panel to create a larger charging surface for real outdoor use.

Compact when you carry it. Useful when you open it.

BUILT FOR TRAVEL, OUTDOORS, AND EMERGENCIES

From road trips and camping nights to hiking breaks, photography days, and power outages, SolarLun gives you flexible backup power when outlets are hard to find.

Battery when you need it. Solar when you can use it. Recovery when you need to keep going longer.

We are a small team of outdoor enthusiasts and product engineers. We love hiking, camping, photography, and travel — but we also rely on our devices for maps, photos, music, and emergencies.For years, we carried power banks that died too fast, and solar panels that were too bulky or too slow to be useful.We tried the tiny solar power banks on the market. They looked convenient, but the solar strip was a decoration — not a real charging solution. We tried large foldable solar panels. They worked, but we couldn’t fit them in a daypack.So we decided to build our own.We wanted a modular system: a real 7,800mAh power bank for instant backup, a 6-fold solar panel with enough surface to actually charge, and a magnetic connection that let us use both together — or separately.Months of prototyping. Dozens of folding hinge designs. Countless tests in direct sun, partial shade, rain, and dust.The result is Avelun SolarLun.Not a power bank with a tiny solar sticker. Not a bulky solar panel you leave at home. A modular system that gives you three practical ways to stay powered — battery now, solar direct when you can, and solar recovery when your power bank needs a top-up outdoors.We made this for people who move — and who don't want to stop for an outlet.

projects.ai_description_en:
The Avelun SolarLun is a modular 3-in-1 solar power bank designed for everyday carry, travel, and emergencies. Traditional power banks eventually die, solar panels are often too bulky to carry, and mini solar chargers typically rely on weak, tiny strips. SolarLun solves this by combining a detachable 7,800mAh battery module with a 6-fold flexible 18W solar panel, ensuring you never have to choose between staying light and staying powered. It is a versatile power solution built to keep your essential gear running wherever your adventures take you.

The system operates through three distinct charging modes to maximize power flexibility. Use the 7,800mAh power bank module as a reliable portable battery to charge phones, cameras, earbuds, and USB lights anytime. When the sun is out, unfold the 6-fold solar panel and charge devices directly through the built-in USB-C output, saving the battery for later. Better yet, magnetically snap the power bank onto the solar panel to recover energy outdoors. There are no complicated clips or loose mounting parts—just a simple snap, place in sunlight, and recharge on the go.

Designed for real portability, SolarLun folds down to a compact size for easy bag carry, yet unfolds into a robust, high-yield solar charging surface when needed. The Type-C and USB-A shared output ensures compatibility with the devices you already own, while the magnetic snap-on design makes power recovery instantaneous. Whether you are a weekend hiker, a dedicated traveler, or simply preparing for unexpected power outages, SolarLun offers a smarter, more adaptable way to keep your essential devices powered in any situation.

projects.ai_intro_en: The WETOX D2 is a V2L discharge adapter for Tesla vehicles, available in NACS and CCS2 versions. ai_specs_en: Silicon Carbide (SiC) modules, Pure Sine Wave
40% more efficient than conventional brands, no battery heating trigger
Bluetooth, Smart App (iOS/Android), OTA firmware updates
Built-in LCD with real-time power and SOC, diagnostic codes

projects.ai_risks_en: Compatibility depends on Tesla's hardware: NACS vehicles require 'CCS and 3rd-party NACS DC charging: Enabled' (post-2022 models usually have it); older models need a CCS ECU retrofit. As with any early-stage V2L market, there is risk of software bugs, though WETOX claims in-house protocol development and OTA updates to address issues.

projects.blurb: Blue-Light MEMS precision | Gaussian Splatting | 0.03mm accuracy | Capture, process, export 3D models all from a single handheld device
projects.html_story:
Blue-Light MEMS precision | Gaussian Splatting | 0.03mm accuracy | Capture, process, export 3D models all from a single handheld device

Blue-Light MEMS precision | Gaussian Splatting | 0.03mm accuracy | Capture, process, export 3D models all from a single handheld device

Every 3D scanner on the market makes the same tradeoff: accuracy or portability. Geometric fidelity or visual realism. Professional workflow or beginner accessibility.

AiScan O1 refuses to choose.

Developed by ChaoXiLi — a 3D vision technology company specializing in high-precision scanning solutions — AiScan O1 is the first handheld 3D scanner to integrateblue-light MEMS structured-light scanningwithon-device 3D Gaussian Splatting. Two fundamentally different capture technologies, unified in a single770g standalone device.

The result: 0.03mm metrological accuracy for engineering applications, and photorealistic 3DGS rendering for visual applications — from the same hardware, in the same session,with no PC required.

An8-core processor, 32GB RAM, and 7-inch 2K AMOLED touchscreenhandle the entire pipeline —scan, edit, mesh, export— on-device. Two built-in AI features eliminate manual parameter configuration and prevent incomplete captures.

This is not an incremental update to existing 3D scanning technology. It is a structural advancement.

3D Gaussian Splatting Why It is and Why It Matters

Conventional 3D scanners reconstruct surfaces astriangulated mesheswith UV-mapped textures. This approach is well-suited for CAD and manufacturing workflows, but fundamentally limited invisual fidelity— mesh rendering cannot accurately represent translucency, sub-surface scattering, anisotropic reflections, or fine volumetric structures like hair and fabric.3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)is a different representation entirely. Instead of polygon surfaces, 3DGS encodes a scene as a collection of oriented3D Gaussian primitives— each carrying position, covariance, color, and opacity. The result is acontinuous, differentiable representationthat captures how light actually interacts with materials.

Blue-Light MEMS Structured-Light Engine

The primary scanning system uses aMEMS (Micro-Electro-Mechanical System)phase-shifting projector emitting coded blue structured-light patterns onto the target surface. Adual-cameradepth system — one near-range, one far-range — captures the deformed patterns and triangulates surface geometry.

Blue wavelengths(≈450nm)have shorter wavelength than infrared alternatives, enablingfiner fringe patternsandhigher spatial resolution. Blue light also exhibitslower interferencefrom ambient lighting conditions — direct sunlight, fluorescent overhead, mixed indoor/outdoor environments — making AiScan O1 reliable across diverse scanning environments without controlled lighting.

Why dual-range cameras

A single depth camera forces a compromise betweennear-field detailandfar-field coverage. AiScan O1’s dual-camera architecture scans objects from100mm(close detail work on small parts, jewelry, dental models) to1000mm(large assemblies, furniture, human bodies), covering a scan volume from10×10×10mm up to 4×4×4m— without swapping lenses or reconfiguring hardware.

Performance benchmarks

Near-field accuracy: 0.03 mm (comparable to desktop-class metrology scanners)

Far-field accuracy: 0.1 mm

Scan speed: up to 15 frames per second

Point cloud density sufficient for reverse engineering, dimensional inspection, and rapid prototyping workflows.

AI-Driven Scanning Workflow

3D scanning has historically required operator expertise — selecting scan modes, adjusting exposure, configuring alignment parameters, evaluating coverage completeness.AiScan O1 automates the two most failure-prone steps.

A range of preset scanning modes is available-Universal (Standard) , 3DGs (Lifelike Visual), Low Glossy (Metal/Paint), Relief (Engraving) , and Dark (Dark/Black). Users can choose the most suitable mode based on their scanning needs, with full parameter control for advanced customization.

After a scan session ends, the AI evaluates the captured point cloud for coverage gaps. The system identifies up to three incomplete regions per evaluation cycle, highlights them on the 3D model, and provides directional guidance for targeted rescanning.

This eliminates the most common failure mode in handheld 3D scanning: discovering missing data only after returning to a desktop workstation, when rescanning is no longer possible.

The detection-and-rescan loop can be repeated until the model achieves full coverage. In testing, this typically requires 1-2 additional passes for complete reconstruction.

7-Inch 2K AMOLED Display

AiScan O1 integrates a7-inch 2K resolution AMOLED touchscreen— thelargestandhighest-resolution displayin any handheld 3D scanner currently available.

The AMOLED panel provideswide color gamut, high contrast ratio, and low power consumption— particularly suited for evaluating color-accurate texture captures and for outdoor use where high brightness is needed.

Screen mirroring via USB-C DisplayPort is supported for users who prefer working on a larger external monitor.

Complete Standalone Pipeline

AiScan O1 performs the full 3D scanning workflow on-device, without requiring a connected PC at any stage:

Hardware supporting this pipeline:

8-core 2.4GHz application processor

512GB onboard storage

25.9Wh battery (~2.5 hours continuous scanning)

65W USB-C fast charging

Wi-Fi 6 connectivity

The on-device pipeline does not replace desktop software for advanced post-processing — it eliminates the requirement for it. Users who prefer desktop workflows can export raw point clouds and process in their software of choice.

Technical Specifications

AiScan O1 is developed by ChaoXiLi, a 3D vision technology company specializing in high-precision scanning solutions. Founded to integrate advanced AI and optical engineering capabilities for both consumer and professional 3D scanning applications, ChaoXiLi brings together deep expertise in MEMS optical systems, embedded AI inference, structured-light algorithms, and precision hardware manufacturing.

ChaoXiLi is a leading Chinese enterprise focused on the research and development of AI sensing instruments, with strong technical foundations in industrial AI fields such as AI acoustics and AI 3D vision. The company is dedicated to redefining sensing technologies through artificial intelligence, helping industries achieve safer and more efficient operations.

Backed by strong R&D and manufacturing capabilities, ChaoXiLi holds over 200 patents in 3D vision and AI processing, operates through ISO 9001-certified manufacturing facilities, and has established a reliable supply chain and mass-production infrastructure, supported by a dedicated global customer service team.

The company is also supported by China’s National Next-Generation Artificial Intelligence Open Innovation Platform and China’s National Key Laboratory of Cognitive Intelligence. In recent years, ChaoXiLi has demonstrated outstanding technical leadership by winning the DCASE Challenge Championship for four consecutive years (2022–2025), taking first place in the PHM Data Challenge, and setting a world record in 3D object detection on the nuScenes autonomous driving benchmark.

AiScan O1 is not a concept product or early-stage prototype. It is a production-ready product built by an established technology company with proven expertise in hardware development, AI engineering, and scalable manufacturing.

Proven by Awards & Certifications

We started ChaoXiLi with a specific thesis: the gap between industrial metrology equipment and consumer 3D scanners is not a technology limitation — it’s an integration problem. The core components exist: high-precision MEMS projectors, capable embedded processors, efficient AI inference engines, Gaussian Splatting algorithms. What didn’t exist was a single device that unified them into a coherent, standalone workflow. AiScan O1 is that device. Industrial-grade accuracy for engineers. Photorealistic rendering for creators. AI automation for everyone. No cables, no laptops, no compromises. We believe professional-quality 3D capture should be as accessible as a digital camera. AiScan O1 is our first step toward making that real.

Affiliate Program

Risks and challenges

Manufacturing
AiScan O1 has completed prototype development, extensive internal testing, and beta validation with external users. Tooling is finalized and manufacturing facilities are ISO-certified with established production lines for precision optical and electronic assemblies. Key component suppliers are contracted with inventory buffers for critical parts (MEMS projectors, AMOLED panels, image sensors).

Risk
Global supply chain disruptions or component shortages could cause delivery delays. Mitigation: We maintain secondary sourcing for all critical components and will communicate timeline changes immediately and transparently.

Regulatory Compliance
AiScan O1 has received FCC certification (FCC ID: 2BTZJ-AiScan O1). CE certification for EU markets is in progress and expected to complete before fulfillment begins. The device complies with IEC 60825-1 laser safety standards for both Class 1 and Class 3R operation modes.

Shipping and Logistics 
Fulfillment will be managed through established logistics partners with distribution centers in the United States, Europe, and Asia. Free shipping is included for US, EU, and UK backers. Shipping to other regions will be available at cost. Import duties and customs fees vary by destination country and are the responsibility of the backer. Full tracking information will be provided for every shipment.

Software and Firmware
The on-device software is production-ready and has been validated through our beta testing program. Post-launch firmware updates will be delivered via Wi-Fi OTA, including performance optimization, new features, and bug fixes informed by community feedback. We are committed to ongoing development of both the on-device software and the planned AiScan Studio desktop application.

3DGS Processing 
The 3DGS pipeline involves edge computing for model reconstruction after on-device capture. We are actively optimizing processing speed and output quality. Network connectivity is required for 3DGS mode. Availability and processing time may vary based on server load during initial launch period.

Our Commitment 
ChaoXiLi has the financial resources, engineering talent, supply chain relationships, and manufacturing infrastructure to deliver AiScan O1 to every backer. Every unit ships with a 1-year manufacturer warranty.

AiScan O1 incorporates two on-device AI features:1.AIScan Mode — A machine learning classification model that analyzes the target object and automatically configures scanning parameters (scan mode, exposure, alignment method, point density). The model was trained on proprietary datasets of 3D scanned objects collected and annotated by the ChaoXiLi engineering team. No third-party copyrighted content was used in training.2.AICompleteness Detection — A neural network that evaluates 3D point cloud coverage and identifies regions with insufficient data density. Trained on proprietary scan data generated during internal development and beta testing.
Does this project use AI-generated content? No. All campaign images, videos, renders, and text are created by the ChaoXiLi team and its production partners. No generative AI tools were used to produce campaign content.
How is AI output incorporated into the final product? The AI features provide automated parameter configuration and scan quality assessment. They do not generate creative content. The end-user’s 3D scan output is determined by the physical scanning hardware and structured-light algorithms — the AI assists the scanning process but does not synthesize or generate the 3D model data itself.
Data and consent: All training data was generated internally by ChaoXiLi. No external datasets, scraped content, or third-party creative works were used. No consent issues apply.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: ChaoXiLi is a 3D vision technology company specializing in high-precision scanning solutions.
projects.ai_description_en:
AiScan O1 is a handheld standalone 3D scanner that unifies two fundamentally different capture technologies—blue-light MEMS structured-light scanning with 0.03mm metrological accuracy and on-device 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)—in a 770g portable device. Designed by ChaoXiLi, this all-in-one system handles the entire 3D scanning pipeline: capture, process, edit, mesh, and export, all without requiring a connected PC or external hardware.

The device is powered by an 8-core processor, 32GB RAM, and a 7-inch 2K AMOLED touchscreen, which together manage on-device reconstruction workflows. Two built-in AI features automate parameter configuration and prevent incomplete captures, reducing manual setup and improving scan consistency for users across skill levels.

The dual scanning modes serve distinct purposes in professional and creative contexts. The blue-light MEMS structured-light engine delivers engineering-grade precision for metrology, CAD, and quality inspection. The 3D Gaussian Splatting mode produces photorealistic volumetric representations, capturing complex visual properties like translucency, anisotropic reflections, volumetric details such as hair and fabric, and sub-surface scattering. This combination makes AiScan O1 suitable for diverse applications including reverse engineering, cultural heritage preservation, VFX asset creation, and medical modeling.

Key technical features include an AMOLED display, Wi-Fi OTA firmware updates, support for marker-based tracking, a turntable and calibration accessories, and a 512GB onboard storage variant. The scanner complies with laser safety standards and has received FCC certification. With both engineering accuracy and photorealistic rendering available in a single handheld unit, AiScan O1 eliminates the conventional tradeoffs between accuracy and portability, and between geometric fidelity and visual realism, in professional 3D capture workflows.

projects.blurb: Helping future engineers prepare faster, build practical skills, and explore hardware.
projects.html_story:

From First Circuit to Real System

Why Electronics Feels Hard to Start

What’s Inside the Lab Kit

The Project-Based Learning Path

Is This Lab Kit for Me?

Why This Is Different

Back the Project

Join Our Community

Environmental commitments

So, you want to get into electronic engineering.

Not just watch another tutorial. Not just collect another box of parts. Not just blink an LED and wonder what comes next. You want to understand how circuits become signals, how signals become data, and how data becomes a working system.

From First Circuit to Real System

Congratulations, you found it. That’s what this lab kit is built for.

A project-based electronics engineering learning lab that takes you from your first circuit to a real integrated system — with hardware, experiments, guided lessons, and a final build that brings everything together.

By the time of completion, you are expected to program the embedded hardware for multiple cool engineering applications.

Why Electronics Feels Hard to Start

To learn math, you need a pencil and paper. To step into programming, you need a computer.To get into electronics, however, you need much more: components, breadboards, wiring, power supply, multimeter, function generator, oscilloscope, sensors, dev-boards, and a way to understand how everything connects.

Books, video tutorials, DIY kits, and formal college programs all have value, but none fully solve the beginner’s gap on their own. What matters most is a path that turns curiosity into real understanding through connected, hands-on progress.

That’s the gap this lab kit is built to close: a structured, hands-on path that brings the hardware, experiments, curriculum, and final project together.

What’s Inside the Lab Kit

TheFundamental EE Starter Kitcombines hardware, guided experiments, learning materials, and a complete project into one integrated learning experience. Inside, you'll find:

Hardware Components(breadboards, discrete components & accessories)

Printed Lab Manual(color printed, 12 labs + 1 project + appendix)

Online LMS Access(interactive widgets and quizzes, accessible anytime)

Final Integrated Project(pre-assembled and soldered, as shown below)

[Optional]Lab-On-The-Go Hardware Kit(learn more at Rewards section)

Each part is connected by design: you get your hands dirty with real hardware, follow the lab manual to build practical engineering skills, deepen your understanding through the LMS, and ultimately bring everything together in a final integrated project that reinforces and extends what you’ve learned.

The Project-Based Learning Path

The conventional path usually make you learn the pieces first and hope you can connect them later.We do the opposite:you start with a real system in mind, then build the engineering path piece by piece until every concept has a purpose.

Every lab contributes to the same goal: turning separate electronics concepts into one functional system you can build, test, debug, and understand.

The path includes:

Components & breadboarding

Power & regulation

Op-amps & analog front end

Microcontrollers & MicroPython

ADC / GPIO / serial communication

Final integrated audio system

Is This Lab Kit for Me?

This lab kit is designed for curious beginners who want a serious, hands-on way into electronics engineering without jumping straight into a full degree program or getting lost in disconnected tutorials.

For Future EE / ECE / CE Students

This lab kit gives you a structured, hands-on map of circuits, signals, power, measurement, and embedded systems, so you do not enter engineering feeling lost. By the time September arrives, you will already have touched real components, built real circuits, and developed a clearer sense of what the field actually feels like.

For Current Engineering Students

For current EE college students, you may be choosing a technical direction, or building the foundation for future projects, advanced coursework and internship. This course helps you turn classroom theory into hands-on engineering skills, so circuits, signals, power, and embedded systems start to feel more connected.

For Other Technical Professionals

As a software developer, mechanical engineer, physics/math student, maker, or STEM professional, you may not need a full EE degree, but you may need electronics to unlock better projects, products, or career paths. This lab kit gives you a structured, hands-on way into circuits, signals, microcontrollers, and embedded systems, so electronics becomes a practical tool you can use.

Why This Is Different

Not Just Hobby Electronics, But an Engineering Learning Path

Hobby electronics is a great place to start, but engineering is more than making a circuit work.

This lab connects hands-on projects with the principles behind them. From circuits, measurement, signal processing, microcontrollers, to system integration, all helping learners understand not onlywhat works, butwhy it works.

Not One Learning Format, But A Complete Learning Environment

Books explain concepts. Videos demonstrate techniques. Breadboards reveal the building process. PCBs show how complete systems come together.

You don't just choose one of them, you get everything! This lab kit combines all of them into one experience: real components, guided experiments, a printed manual, LMS content, measurement practice, and a final integrated project.

Not Learning Everything First, But Thinking Through Projects

Electronics is a large field, and trying to learn everything before building anything often leads to frustration.

Instead, you start with a working project and learn concepts as they become relevant. The project creates the questions, and those questions drive deeper learning.

Not One-Way Content, But a Guided Feedback Loop

Building a project is only the beginning.

Through the complementary Learning Management System (LMS), learners can complete lessons, submit lab activities, take quizzes, and interact with guided learning tools designed to reinforce key concepts throughout the course.

Back the Project

This Kickstarter is the first production window for this electronics learning kit. By backing now, you help us finalize the hardware kits, printed lab manuals, LMS content, packaging, and fulfillment, while getting early access before a wider release.

Which Learning Setup Is Right for You?

Pledge 1 or Pledge 2?

The choice comes down to one question: do you already have access to electronics instruments? Both pledges include the same learning path, hardware, manual, and LMS content. The only difference is whether you would like to includeLab-On-The-Goas your portable measurement and debugging toolkit.

In engineering, building is only part of the process. Measurement and debugging are where much of the learning happens. Lab instruments (with LOTG or your own workbench) allows you to observe signals, verify circuit behavior, and investigate problems firsthand, helping transform trial-and-error into genuine understanding.

What about Pledge 3 and Pledge 4?

If this is your first time backing one of our projects, Pledge 3 expands beyond the Starter Kit with the Fundamental EE Core pathway. Built from several learning kits developed and refined through previous campaigns, it brings together four major areas of electronics engineering:

• Introductory Embedded Systems• Digital Circuits and FPGA• Analog Circuits and Semiconductor Devices• Analog Signals and Filtering

Pledge 4 combines the complete Fundamental EE pathway with Lab-On-The-Go. Because the instruments can be used across the Starter Kit and all EE Core kits, it creates a unified environment for building, measuring, and debugging as your skills grow.

If you're looking for the most complete experience from day one, and expecting more fun projects coming out, this is the option we would recommend.

Join Our Community

Open Documentation

Before receiving your kit, feel free to explore theopen access documentationand browse some of the projects already built entirely using this platform. Many of these projects were created by our volunteer students, often with the help of AI-assisted (vibe coding) workflows.

Interestingly, this once again demonstrates an important reality of modern engineering: while AI can dramatically accelerate software development, turning an idea into a working system still requires a solid understanding of electronics, hardware integration, testing, measurement, and debugging.

Discord Channel

Learning engineering is not just about following instructions. It is about experimenting, asking questions, sharing ideas, and improving through iteration.

Join our Discord community to connect with other learners, share your projects, discuss electronics, and continue building beyond the kit.

Discord link:https://discord.gg/urh8hW2YFa

Build. Learn. Improve. Together.

This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 3,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1B raised between them.

Risks and challenges

Bringing an electronics learning lab to life involves both hardware and educational content, so we want to be transparent about the main risks.

The first risk is hardware sourcing and component availability. Some electronic components, modules, tools, or measurement devices may change in price or availability during production. To reduce this risk, we are designing the kit around commonly available parts, keeping backup component options, and testing alternatives before final fulfillment.

The second risk is quality control. Because this kit involves real circuits, learners need reliable components, clear wiring instructions, and safe power setups. We will run sample builds, verify the lab procedures, and check the core components before shipping so the learning experience is not disrupted by avoidable hardware issues.

The third risk is content completion and refinement. The printed lab manual, LMS lessons, quizzes, and project instructions need to be clear enough for beginners while still meaningful for serious learners. Our plan is to continue testing the learning path with early users, educators, and pilot learners, then refine the content before final release.

The fourth risk is manufacturing, packaging, and fulfillment timelines. Coordinating hardware kits, printed materials, packaging, and shipping can create delays, especially for international backers. We will work with suppliers early, keep the package structure as standardized as possible, and communicate clearly if any timeline changes occur.

Finally, because this is a learning product, there is a risk that different learners may need different levels of support. Electronics can involve debugging, mistakes, and iteration. To address this, we are building the learning experience around guided experiments, troubleshooting notes, LMS support, and project submission/review options where applicable.

Our goal is not to promise a risk-free project. Our goal is to manage the risks carefully, communicate honestly, and deliver a polished first version of a serious project-based electronics engineering learning lab.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

This project is designed as a reusable electronics learning lab, not a single-use activity kit. Core components, tools, breadboards, power modules, and measurement equipment can be reused across multiple experiments, future projects, and continued learning beyond the included curriculum.

Reusability and recyclability

Many parts in the kit are reusable, including electronic components, jumper wires, breadboards, modules, development boards, and tools. We will also aim to use recyclable or minimal packaging where possible and avoid unnecessary single-use materials.

Sustainable Distribution

We plan to standardize packaging sizes, consolidate kit contents efficiently, and reduce unnecessary packaging volume where practical. This helps lower waste and makes shipping more efficient for backers.

projects.ai_description_en:
The Fundamental EE Starter Kit is a project-based electronics engineering learning lab that takes you from your first circuit to a fully integrated hardware system — all within one tightly coordinated experience. It combines genuine breadboard hardware, discrete electronic components, a printed color lab manual with 12 guided experiments plus a comprehensive appendix, and permanent access to an online LMS featuring interactive quizzes and widgets. The kit also ships with a pre-assembled and soldered final integrated project, giving backers a tangible takeaway that ties every concept together — from basic circuits to embedded programming for real engineering applications.

At its core, the kit is built around a structured learning path that turns curiosity into competence. Each of the 12 labs walks you through essential circuit fundamentals, component behaviour, and measurement techniques using real tools like a multimeter, function generator, and oscilloscope. The printed manual serves as your daily companion, while the online LMS lets you test understanding on your own schedule. The final integrated project challenges you to combine multiple hardware blocks and program the embedded board for practical applications, bridging the gap between isolated exercises and real-world engineering work.

For learners who want to go further, the EE Core Path adds a Lab-on-the-Go portable toolkit — your own compact electronics lab for building, measuring, and debugging wherever you study. Both tiers are designed to address the core frustration of getting started in electronics: the overwhelming distance between watching a tutorial and actually understanding how circuits, signals, data, and working systems connect. By keeping the hardware standardized, the components commonly available, and the learning path carefully tested with early users and educators, the kit focuses on what actually matters — hands-on progress, reliable components, and clear guidance from blinking an LED to building something real.

ZAPO features two built-in USB-C retractable cables.Pull them out when needed and gently retract them after use—no manual cable wrapping required.The retractable cables support intelligent power distribution up to 160W and 120W, making them suitable for charging laptops, tablets, phones, and more.*Actual charging performance depends on device compatibility and charging conditions.

Extends up to 70 cm for flexible charging and retracts neatly when not in use, helping keep your desk clutter-free.

Small footprint, great order

The base occupies only about 6 × 6 cm of desk space.Unlike traditional flat charging layouts, ZAPO uses a vertical tower-style structure to help free up more usable desktop space.A cleaner setup with fewer visible cables.

The bottom is equipped with anti-slip silicone padding for stable placement while helping reduce scratches on desk surfaces.The detachable figure-8 power connector design also makes storage and travel more convenient.

One snap to charge, angle freely adjustable

Built with an integrated magnetic alignment system for compatible devices.Simply place your phone on the charging area and it automatically aligns into position, helping provide a more stable and convenient wireless charging experience.

ZAPO also supports a 0–60° adjustable angle.Tilt it upright for charging, or rotate it into a convenient phone stand for watching videos, video calls, or browsing while charging — helping reduce the need for an extra desk stand.

Small size, mighty power

Have you ever plugged a laptop into a multi-port charger, only to notice your phone charging more slowly afterward?

ZAPO is built with next-generation GaN technology, delivering high power density in a compact form factor.Compared with conventional charger designs, it offers a more space-efficient solution while supporting up to 370W total output power.Power multiple devices from a single charging station, including laptops, phones, tablets, earbuds, smartwatches, and more.

Dual retractable USB-C cables deliver up to 160W and 120W PD fast charging, providing flexible power for laptops, tablets, smartphones, and other everyday devices Compatible with PD 3.1, QC 3.0, QC 4+, FCP, SCP, and AFC, ZAPO is designed to support a wide range of charging needs from a single compact station.With a universal 100–240V AC input, it's ready for use in many regions around the world.

One main cable, plug and play

Just connect the detachable figure-8 power cable to the back of the charging station and plug it into a wall outlet.

One outlet and one main cable help simplify your desktop setup and reduce cable clutter.The power cable is approximately 1.2 meters long and can be stored separately for travel or organization.

Smart allocation, no math needed

ZAPO features a built-in smart power management chip that automatically recognizes connected devices and dynamically distributes power output.Prioritizes power delivery for laptops while intelligently distributing remaining power to other connected devices.

NFC Smart Shortcuts

An NFC touch area is integrated into the side of the device.With a simple tap, compatible devices can launch preset actions, shortcuts, or personalized workflows.Using the companion app, you can customize NFC triggers for actions such as:

Opening frequently used apps

Activating work mode

Launching navigation

Running personalized shortcuts

Setup is simple on NFC-compatible devices.

Make charging a pleasure

Smart safety protection system

Fast charging should be powerful, but it should also be reliable. ZAPO features a built-in multi-layer protection system designed to help safeguard both your devices and the charger during everyday use. It includes protection against over-current, over-voltage, over-temperature, short-circuit, overcharge, and low-voltage conditions. When abnormal operating conditions are detected, the system can automatically regulate power output or temporarily stop charging to help maintain safe and stable performance.

Won’t disturb your rest or focus at night

Designed for everyday environments, ZAPO operates with low noise levels to help minimize distractions while charging. A soft ambient LED light ring provides charging status visibility without being overly intrusive, helping create a more comfortable atmosphere during evening use. Whether on a bedside table, office desk, study area, or in a shared living space, ZAPO is designed to fit naturally into your daily routine.

Not just good-looking – built to last

The housing is made from ABS + PC engineering-grade materials and paired with aluminum alloy heat-dissipation components for durability and improved thermal performance.

The wireless charging area uses multi-strand pure copper coils to help improve charging efficiency and reduce heat buildup during use.Charging connectors feature gold-plated or nickel-plated finishes to help improve durability and resistance to daily wear.

Bring order to your digital life

Charging shouldn't be the most complicated part of your day — at the office, in the bedroom, or while traveling.With one ZAPO charging station and a single power cable, multiple everyday devices can be powered from one organized setup.A cleaner desk can make everyday routines feel simpler.

Wide compatibility

Risks and challenges

We're experienced in hardware, but we know things can go wrong. The main challenges are manufacturing delays and certification timelines. We've partnered with a reliable factory, pre-ordered key components, and built in buffer time. We'll communicate openly if any issues arise. Our goal is to deliver ZAPO as promised—on time and with quality you can trust.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We built ZAPO to last. It uses high-grade GaN components rated for 50,000+ hours of operation, a fanless design with no moving parts to fail, and durable materials that resist wear. No planned obsolescence. Just a charger you can rely on for years.

Reusability and recyclability

We designed ZAPO with sustainability in mind. The packaging uses 100% recycled cardboard with no plastic inserts—everything is biodegradable or fully recyclable. The charger itself is built with durable, repairable materials to extend its life, reducing electronic waste. We also avoid excessive coatings and glues, making disassembly and recycling easier at the end of its long life.

Sustainable materials

ZAPO uses a durable, recyclable PC/ABS shell with no harmful coatings or paints. The silicone anti-slip pads are non-toxic and long-lasting. Internal circuit boards are lead-free and RoHS-compliant. We avoid PVC, brominated flame retardants, and other hazardous substances—keeping both your desk and the planet a little cleaner.

Environmentally friendly factories

We choose factories that share our values—fair treatment of workers, responsible waste management, and clean production processes. We look for proper certifications, visit facilities in person, and maintain open communication. For us, a good product starts with a factory we can trust.

Sustainable Distribution

We'll minimize carbon footprint by consolidating shipments, using regional fulfillment centers to shorten delivery distances, and choosing carriers with green logistics programs. Packaging will be plastic-free and sized to reduce weight and waste. We're also exploring carbon-offset options for backer rewards.

We're committed to reducing waste at every stage. This includes digital-only user manuals, minimal use of adhesives in packaging, and designing ZAPO for easy disassembly so components can be recycled or reused at end of life. We also work with suppliers who follow responsible sourcing practices. Small choices, done consistently.

projects.ai_description_en:
Meet ZAPO, a 6-in-1 all-in-one desktop charger built to eliminate cable clutter and charging chaos. If you regularly sit down at your desk only to find charging cables tangled together and multiple power adapters fighting for space, ZAPO is the solution. It integrates magnetic wireless charging, a dedicated earbuds charging area, dual retractable USB-C cables, USB-C and USB-A expansion ports, programmable NFC functionality, and a soft ambient light ring into a single compact station. Powered by a robust 370W GaN architecture with intelligent power distribution, ZAPO replaces your scattered charging setup, allowing you to charge your phone, smartwatch, earbuds, and laptop simultaneously from just one main power cable.

What sets ZAPO apart is its innovative approach to cable management and usability. It features two built-in retractable USB-C cables that extend up to 70 cm for flexible use and retract neatly afterward—no more manual wrapping or tangled wires in your travel bag. These cables support intelligent power distribution up to 160W and 120W, capable of handling everything from smartphones to laptops. For wireless devices, the integrated magnetic alignment system ensures a perfect snap-to-charge connection every time, with a freely adjustable angle for comfortable viewing. Plus, programmable NFC shortcuts let you launch apps or set routines with a simple tap.

Beyond its powerful charging capabilities, ZAPO is designed with a remarkably compact footprint. Sitting at just 6 x 6 cm, its vertical tower-style structure frees up valuable desk space compared to traditional flat chargers. The base features anti-slip silicone padding for stability and scratch prevention, while a detachable figure-8 power connector makes packing and traveling effortless. A smart safety protection system, along with a non-disturbing night-friendly ambient light, ensures safe, peaceful charging whether you are working late or catching up on sleep.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/871/6954eb795d1de73715b7823bb26b3774_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781087550&width=680&sig=42PjImcA4Q1ZcSDN6v3gWBJbI%2BhdJAwWH19Vxel3yWE%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/041/490/3809fe2e2ae2970b2db4cf2681505ca2_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780990228&width=680&sig=%2Fu7N3MIUfbJSpnjI0PFStdI%2BNuxzZcBVA4hBDifbzbw%3D)

WildForm is more than a terrarium. It is a living landscape inspired by nature itself — a handcrafted ecosystem terrarium that combines realistic mountain rockwork with an integrated humidity system.

Designed for both reptile habitats and planted displays, WildForm creates a more natural, more immersive, and more convenient environment for your animals and plants.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/041/734/38ca5301eb5dc6dcaf0489352258df8f_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780991601&width=680&sig=sNVCyawPpMie6xMLmMMAidxXyTr5jFbU5zwpa2BCjcg%3D)

Unlike ordinary enclosures with visible spray tubes and awkward add-ons, WildForm’s misting nozzle is seamlessly embedded into the mountain structure. The result is a clean, realistic look that feels like part of the landscape, not an accessory attached to it.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/042/131/d6bce638c05131ad0c99c5d66f779066_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780993512&width=680&sig=e8sCl2gL98OcqKHof9qz%2BaV6YRgTWcB3yoFjvR%2Fdsqk%3D)

### Integrated Humidity System

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/042/143/ce901c662b641ba81e1b05088cc02996_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780993555&width=680&sig=hP153EUwyv%2FpUZuELLW5cA0mOS%2Fk95nUSneAWgXzh50%3D)

WildForm includes a built-in misting system that helps maintain stable humidity inside the tank.

With scheduled misting, you can reduce the need for daily manual spraying and create a more consistent environment for humidity-loving species and moisture-dependent plants.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/042/183/db8a584c8d0754176277c882b891f31f_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780993720&width=680&sig=k%2FAEVWCY1Sbljlu%2BfifzdrzWJ3%2BhYpHvfsME2bB%2Bc4Q%3D)

### Two Misting Modes

WildForm supports both continuous misting and intermittent misting, giving users flexibility to match different animal or plant care routines.

- Continuous misting for stronger humidity support

- Intermittent misting for natural rain-forest style cycles

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/009/f97bf215018c154dfd131bc0e19166c4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780997728&width=680&sig=zhAVKzCsD3npBF2w7ZdgyVsG35EL%2Bog3t8xdnFZzv04%3D)

### Quiet Operation

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/016/869b440acd6fa9f67fd4d0ceda357dc0_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780997754&width=680&sig=bzVQOt7t9PS1bAqEcIVKu1hZ%2BI8dAdpxom6ftlowqbk%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/060/219c526c8112edf59f7c252b010f6c43_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780998019&width=680&sig=vhwKWmmHTmVSkUeixpP2EeChhkUHdWQb3W2tIrZtYAI%3D)

Many reptiles respond better to stable humidity, natural-looking terrain, and less frequent disturbance.

WildForm helps create a habitat that feels closer to an animal’s native environment while reducing the need to open the enclosure repeatedly.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/044/413/8f964d58dc7f94e7caebbe9b41aca624_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781006254&width=680&sig=wfy20tor7JRNK6%2Fx6SQxKpjmWeUoQ9gVZPJuBdqoh%2BM%3D)

The misting system helps create a moist microclimate that supports healthy growth and a lush rainforest look.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/056/692/da348457a2ec2c30a86caa18cb8f966a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781080787&width=680&sig=uiVeherRJINKnU9RIzxqtUyG5vBH%2BM8nxZRnvY8te4I%3D)

## Risks and challenges

Bringing a handcrafted, ecosystem-based product to life comes with unique challenges — but we’ve designed this project with reliability and scalability in mind.

Each terrarium involves a detailed manual crafting process, including sculpting, finishing, and system integration. As demand grows, maintaining consistent quality while scaling production is a key focus. To address this, we’ve already standardized our production workflow and are working with experienced manufacturing partners to ensure stable output and quality control.

Another challenge lies in the integration of the smart misting system. To ensure long-term reliability, we have tested the system across extended usage scenarios, optimizing for durability, consistency, and low noise performance.

Logistics and international shipping are also factors we take seriously. We are developing protective packaging solutions and working with trusted fulfillment partners to minimize the risk of damage during transit.

While unexpected delays can occur, we are committed to transparent communication and will keep all backers updated throughout the production and delivery process.

projects.ai_description_en:
WildForm is a handcrafted ecosystem terrarium designed to bring the rainforest indoors with the convenience of automated humidity control. Each unit features a sculpted mountain rockscape with a misting nozzle seamlessly embedded into the structure, eliminating the exposed spray tubes and awkward add-ons common in ordinary enclosures. The integrated water reservoir is cleverly concealed within the same rockwork, so the tank looks like a natural landscape rather than an aquarium appliance. For backers who already own a terrarium, this misting system is also offered as a standalone upgrade for custom builds.

At the heart of the design is the integrated humidity system with two programmable modes. Users can choose continuous misting for stronger humidity support or intermittent misting to create natural rainforest-style cycles that mimic day-night moisture changes. Because the misting is scheduled, it removes the need for daily manual spraying while keeping ambient conditions stable for humidity-loving reptiles, tropical mosses, and moisture-dependent plants. The pump is engineered for silent or near-silent operation, helping it stay unnoticed in quiet rooms without disturbing nocturnal pets.

WildForm is not limited to reptile keepers. It doubles as a bioscape for planted displays and tropical moss arrangements, supporting a moist microclimate that encourages healthy growth and a lush, layered appearance. Regular humidity paired with natural-looking terrain and less frequent enclosure opening creates a habitat that feels closer to an animal’s native environment while reducing routine maintenance. Refilling is simple: lift the hidden cover, add water, and close it again, keeping equipment out of sight.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/881/888/98a32febd0da1e9d5e06633cf8ec962c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779853820&width=680&sig=6V3e53ckDviphk37tLLBecQT%2BoDcxD1gHjVQQm5j4Io%3D)

Tired of This Before Every Screen Cast?

- Connecting to Wi-Fi before you can even start sharing?

- Repeatedly troubleshooting devices before a meeting begins?

- Lag, stuttering, or disconnects caused by unstable networks?

- Short HDMI cables, cluttered ports, and a messy desk setup?

- Laptop battery draining during long presentations?

What if your HDMI connection could become wireless — and one device could share content across multiple screens at the same time?

With LinkHub, screen sharing becomes simpler, cleaner, and more flexible.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/881/910/5ce4061872aa5804294ff87728c5ae20_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779853933&width=680&sig=9PONTMn%2Fjf9soKjTsd2V7BnBytU0fbZPw%2FowRJ8rw9I%3D)

LinkHub is a hardware-based wireless screen casting system designed to work without Wi-Fi. No apps, drivers, or complicated setup required — simply plug in and connect automatically.It delivers stable low-latency transmission, clear 4K visuals, and multi-screen wireless sharing, making collaboration easier for meetings, classrooms, exhibitions, and home entertainment.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/883/217/3d6188ce1d982257295c0a088166f75f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779861598&width=680&sig=Fm5s%2BtniZh%2BvQgIhKwUQYF7QdUOUybUqSgdJQoCE6FE%3D)

Compatible with both USB-C and HDMI devices, LinkHub also supports up to 100W PD pass-through charging during screen casting, helping create a more efficient and streamlined wireless display experience.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/881/931/a11538ddca754c934e2dfab73c85d711_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779854014&width=680&sig=A482%2Fn%2B6kcLjna55zwIplFEEhJcNe9XPdweNyVJbaW0%3D)

## Risks and challenges

espite our thorough preparations, any hardware project still faces inherent risks and challenges. In terms of production, certain components in the supply chain (such as wireless transmission chips) may experience delivery delays or price fluctuations; we have mitigated this risk through advance inventory preparation and agreements with backup suppliers. ## Environmental commitments

[Visit our Environmental Resources Center](https://www.kickstarter.com/environment) to learn how Kickstarter encourages sustainable practices.

### Long-lasting design

To extend the lifespan of this 4K wireless projector, we addressed the issue from the design and hardware perspectives: selecting high-quality, age-resistant electronic components and optimizing the internal heat dissipation structure to prevent long-term chip damage from overheating. Simultaneously, the device incorporates intelligent power management, automatically switching to a low-power standby mode when idle to reduce unnecessary circuit losses. Furthermore, we continuously provide OTA firmware updates to constantly optimize connection stability and power consumption strategies. Following our usage recommendations—avoiding high-temperature and humid environments and disconnecting the power supply when not in use—further ensures the product's long-term reliable operation.

### Reusability and recyclability

To reduce the amount of production materials and packaging waste ending up in landfills, we have implemented several measures from the design and supply chain perspectives. First, the main body of the product uses recyclable engineering plastics and a modular structure, which facilitates future dismantling and material recycling.

### Sustainable materials

To minimize negative environmental impact, we prioritize recyclability and low ecological footprint in our material selection. The product casing is made from post-consumer recycled (PCR) engineering plastics, ensuring structural strength while reducing the use of virgin plastics.

### Environmentally friendly factories

When selecting production partners, we not only focus on manufacturing capabilities but also conduct a comprehensive evaluation across three dimensions: environment, social responsibility, and product quality. First, we prioritize assessing whether the factory ensures compliance with environmental regulations regarding wastewater, exhaust gas, and solid waste treatment. Second, we review the factory's social responsibility compliance, including employee health and safety, working hours management, and whether it uses conflict minerals.

### Sustainable Distribution

Sustainability requires us to add extra screening and testing processes in material procurement, factory audits, and packaging, which may delay the overall delivery schedule by approximately 2-3 weeks compared to traditional solutions. However, by securing environmentally friendly material inventory in advance, signing long-term agreements with certified factories, and maintaining transparent communication with our supporters, we strive to keep the impact within a predictable range.

Compatible with both USB-C and HDMI devices, LinkHub also supports up to 100W PD pass-through charging during screen casting, helping create a more efficient and streamlined wireless display experience.

LinkHub works without Wi-Fi, app downloads, or driver installation. Simply connect the transmitter to your computer and the receiver to the display for automatic screen casting. No more repeated setup, device searching, or interruptions caused by unstable network connections — making presentations and sharing easier to start.

Truly plug in, cast instantly, and enjoy a smoother, more convenient viewing experience anytime.

Even in meeting rooms, classrooms, or exhibitions, LinkHub helps reduce lag and disconnections, with wireless transmission distances up to 50m in open spaces.

projects.ai_intro_en: LinkHub X is a hardware-based wireless screen casting system that delivers 4K@30Hz video without requiring Wi-Fi, apps, or drivers. It supports one-to-multi screen synchronization with up to 50m range and 100W PD pass-through charging, compatible with both USB-C and HDMI devices across Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
ai_highlights_en: True plug-and-play wireless casting with no Wi-Fi, apps, or drivers required
4K@30Hz output with low-latency hardware-based transmission and 50m range
One-to-multi screen sync with 100W PD pass-through charging during casting
projects.ai_risks_en: The product page does not explicitly disclose risks. Potential considerations include: actual range may vary in non-open environments, 4K limited to 30Hz may not suit high-frame-rate gaming, and compatibility with all device types is not guaranteed despite broad platform support.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: We are a hardware team focused on wireless screen mirroring technology. Our core members have many years of industry experience in audio and video transmission, embedded development, and consumer electronics. After multiple rounds of software and hardware iterations and real-user testing, our wireless screen mirroring device is dedicated to providing a stable, low-latency wireless display experience for office meetings, home entertainment, and educational scenarios.
projects.ai_description_en:
LinkHub is a hardware-based wireless screen casting system designed to work completely without Wi-Fi. By using an independent hardware transmission architecture instead of relying on network streaming or software compression, LinkHub delivers stable, low-latency 4K@30Hz video output along with synchronized audio across one or multiple displays. No apps, drivers, or complicated network setup are required — simply plug the transmitter into your source device and the receiver into your display for instant automatic pairing and casting.

The standout feature of LinkHub is its 1-to-multi wireless sync capability. A single transmitter can broadcast simultaneously to multiple receivers, keeping all screens synchronized with smooth, stable visuals. This makes it an ideal solution for conference rooms, training sessions, exhibitions, and classrooms where content needs to be shared across several displays at once. A single button press handles pairing, eliminating the need for device switching, cable splitters, or connecting multiple screens to one computer.

LinkHub is available in two transmitter versions — USB-C with up to 100W PD pass-through charging and HDMI for broader device compatibility — giving users flexibility across laptops, tablets, smartphones, gaming consoles, and other devices. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux, offering both mirror and extended display modes without any driver installation. With dual-band 2.4GHz + 5GHz transmission that automatically switches to the optimal signal, LinkHub maintains smooth casting with wireless distances reaching up to 50 meters in open environments while keeping end-to-end latency controlled for responsive, natural-feeling interactions whether moving cursors, switching slides, or streaming 4K video.

LinkHub addresses common frustrations with traditional wireless screen casting: unstable networks causing lag and disconnects, messy cable setups, drained laptop batteries during long presentations, and complex device troubleshooting before meetings. By removing Wi-Fi dependency from the equation and enabling true one-device-to-multiple-screen sharing with clean 4K output, it creates a simpler, more reliable display experience for professional collaboration and entertainment alike.

What People Are Saying

See how oLand truly feels in action —GizmoChinashowcases real interactions in this hands-on review experience.

Four Ways to Interact with oLand

Use Pod touch controls, AI voice chat, a tank-facing camera, and mmWave presence sensing to trigger different kinds of interaction.

Pod Touch Controls

Each pet comes with its own character-themed Pod.

Hold to talk:Press and hold the Pod to start AI voice chat. Your pet listens, responds in character, and remembers past conversations — so the next reply can build on what you shared before.

Moli Asks First, You  Press Back:When you’re busy, working, or just not in the mood to speak, your pet can start the interaction for you. Moli may pop up with a simple question on screen — like “How are you feeling right now?” — and you can answer by pressing the Pod to choose A or B. A quiet little check-in, no voice needed.

Tank-Facing Camera

A built-in camera faces only the inside of the tank. It tracks your real marimo, detects your hand, and recognizes objects placed inside the tank.

Reach In. It Notices:When your finger enters the tank area, Moli notices immediately — pausing, turning, and reacting to the movement in front of it.

The Soul of Marimo, Set Adrift:The tank-facing camera locates the real marimo inside the tank, so holographic Moli can appear from the same position instead of a fixed point on screen.

mmWave Radar Presence Detection

Walk up. It wakes:A built-in mmWave radar detects when you're near, so your pet can wake when you approach and settle down when you leave. It also stays synced with local time, weather, and season — so the world inside oLand changes with the real world around it.

Arcade and Meditation Modes

New Animations Every Day

365 animated moments, synced to real time.

A Hologram That Shares Space With The Real World

Half real. Half holographic. Completely alive.oLand projects a floating holographic layer above the tank below. That layer can display your pet, responsive scenes, and media uploaded from your phone.

A 5-inch high-brightness panel projects upward onto a 45° transparent holographic film, creating a crisp floating image that appears to live above the tank below.

Turn Any Memory Into a Hologram

Every Pet Has Its Own Power

Different personalities. Different rituals. Different reasons to fall in love.

Swap the Pod. Change the pet:Each Pod carries a unique NFC identity. Swap the Pod, and your holographic pet changes instantly, along with its personality, reactions, and core feature.

A Mini World, Built by You

oLand's built-in container is a tiny terrarium, gallery, and holographic stage, all in one.

Smart Home Integration

Marimo: The Easiest Pet Plant

Marimo are rare spherical algae, loved for their soft green shape and quiet, calming presence. Even if every plant you've owned has somehow died, marimo are still on your side. Low-maintenance and built for long-term living, real marimo are available as an add-on — shipped alive and ready to move in.

We'll keep shipping options as backer-friendly and transparent as possible, with clearer regional details shared before final pledge collection.

Risks and challenges

We’ve been building oLand since 2023 through concept development, prototyping, engineering samples, and repeated refinements to both the hardware and the overall experience. That gives us strong confidence in the product, but we also want to be transparent: bringing a product like oLand from prototype to full-scale production comes with real challenges.

Because oLand combines a holographic display system, AI interaction, and physical hardware, the main risks are manufacturing scale-up, software readiness, and logistics. Final production can reveal unexpected issues with component availability, assembly consistency, or calibration. To reduce these risks, we are continuing to refine the product with our manufacturing partners and building time into our schedule for final validation, quality control, and any necessary production adjustments.

On the software side, our AI features will continue to improve after launch. We will be clear about what is ready at shipping and what will be introduced through future updates, so backers know exactly what to expect.

Because oLand is manufactured in mainland China, changes in tariffs, customs policies, or global shipping conditions could affect delivery costs or timelines. We are working closely with our manufacturing and logistics partners to minimize these risks as much as possible.

Most importantly, we are committed to regular, honest communication throughout the process. If challenges come up, we will share updates openly and work hard to deliver a product that lives up to what we’ve promised.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

oLand uses AI as part of the product experience in multiple ways, including AI-powered voice chat with your pet, character-based interactions such as personalized fortune-style moments and yes-or-no decision support, object recognition through the tank-facing camera, and a passive viewing mode with dynamic animations personalized around time, weather, seasons, and your daily life.

We also used AI in a limited way in certain Kickstarter page materials to enhance the appearance of some product still images. This use is for visual polish only and does not appear in any functionality demo videos.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. Any AI-assisted materials used on the Kickstarter page are created from product renders, photos, and brand assets developed by our team or used with permission. AI is used only for limited visual enhancement, and we do not use AI to generate or alter functionality demo videos.

For the product itself, our AI experience is built around original oLand characters, our own product design, and user-provided inputs. User interactions and data are used only to support the intended product experience for that specific user. We do not use third-party copyrighted works without permission to train custom models, and user data will not be used to train public datasets without explicit consent.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

oLand is designed to stay with you over time.
The tank is easy to clean and refresh, and the experience can keep evolving with new pets, scenes, and uploaded content.
Instead of a one-time novelty, it’s made to remain part of your desk for the long run.

projects.ai_description_en:
oLand is a healing desk companion that blends real plants, holographic life, and tactile interaction into a single, calm ecosystem. Created by ALLTIME, it projects a living mini world onto your workspace, housing real marimo moss balls alongside a floating, responsive AI pet. Above a physical tank sits a crisp, holographic layer generated by a 5-inch high-brightness panel and a 45-degree transparent film, creating an image that truly shares space with your real world rather than just glowing on a flat screen.

The core of oLand’s charm is how naturally it responds to you. You can interact in four intuitive ways: through voice, touch, sight, and presence. The tactile fidget-toy-style Pod character comes with the system, and holding it starts an AI voice chat where Moli, the digital pet, listens, responds in character, and remembers past conversations. You can also let Moli make the first move, reading a simple check-in on-screen like “How are you feeling right now?” and choosing between two A/B options on the Pod. A built-in camera faces the tank, tracking the real marimo and detecting when your finger enters the space, allowing the holographic pet to react to your movement. mmWave radar completes the puzzle by sensing your approach, waking the pet up when you arrive at your desk and settling it down when you leave, syncing the world to your actual presence.

That world is ever-changing. oLand delivers 365 new animated moments synced to real-time, and further activities animate for arcade and meditation modes. You can even slot in your own memories, uploading personal media from your phone to turn any photo into a personalized hologram. Since personality lives in the Pod, swapping hardware changes how the pet interacts with you. By day a desk-side stress reliever, by night a sleeping, purring holographic companion, oLand evolves with software updates and smart home integration.

With an accessible Super Early Bird opening price and an oLand Duo set for sharing, this physical-digital pet ecosystem anchors its creative vision in practical perks—six months of free software subscription, one-year warranty, and estimated worldwide shipping by late 2026—without compromising the rich, calm magic of its design.

ROOTBOARD - The Open Pocket Linux Computer

A Raspberry Pi-powered handheld Linux computer with a real keyboard, integrated display, speaker, and fully open hardware. Built for makers, developers, cyberdeck enthusiasts, educators, and anyone who believes technology should be open, understandable, and customizable.

A Computer You Can Truly Understand

In a world filled with locked-down devices, proprietary firmware, and hardware that actively discourages modification, RootBoard takes a different path.

RootBoard is a compact handheld Linux computer designed around a simple philosophy:

Technology should be open.

No proprietary keyboard controllers.

No hidden firmware.

No black boxes.

No unnecessary complexity.

Just a Raspberry Pi-powered platform with a real keyboard, integrated display, rechargeable battery support, and software you can inspect, modify, and make your own.

Whether you're writing code in a coffee shop, debugging an embedded project in your workshop, managing servers on the go, or building your own cyberdeck, RootBoard is designed to be your pocket-sized Linux companion.

Most handheld Linux devices force users to compromise.

Some sacrifice the keyboard to reduce size.

Others rely on proprietary keyboard microcontrollers running closed firmware.

Many use custom hardware that becomes difficult to repair, modify, or reproduce.

We wanted something different.

A device that encourages exploration.

A device that teaches.

A device that invites modification.

A device that feels like it belongs to the maker community.

RootBoard was created for people who enjoy understanding how their tools work.

Because the best computer isn't the one that hides complexity.

It's the one that lets you learn from it.

Real Keyboard. Real Productivity.

Many handheld devices rely on thumb keyboards, multiple function layers, or complex key combinations.

RootBoard provides a dedicated keyboard designed for actual work.

No Function Layer Frustration

Press the number key.

Need punctuation?

Press the punctuation key.

Need to write code?

Type naturally.

Whether you're editing Python scripts, writing shell commands, managing configuration files, or chatting over SSH, RootBoard provides a practical typing experience that makes real work possible.

Powered by Raspberry Pi

RootBoard embraces one of the most popular maker ecosystems in the world.

Compatible with:

Risks and challenges

Risks & Challenges
Bringing a hardware product from prototype to production is an exciting journey, but it also comes with challenges. We've developed working prototypes and carefully planned our manufacturing process, yet we believe in being transparent with our backers about the potential risks involved.
Product Refinements
RootBoard is still evolving. As we move from prototype to mass production, we may make improvements to the hardware, enclosure, PCB layout, firmware, or accessories to enhance reliability, usability, manufacturability, or overall performance.
The final production version may differ slightly from the prototypes and renders shown on this campaign page. Any changes will always be made with the goal of delivering a better product without compromising the core functionality or vision of RootBoard.

Manufacturing & Supply Chain
Electronic components and manufacturing schedules can sometimes be affected by supplier availability, global logistics, or unexpected production challenges. We have selected experienced manufacturing partners and are working with readily available components whenever possible, but delays can occasionally occur despite careful planning.

Quality Assurance
Every RootBoard will undergo testing and quality inspection before shipping. While this process helps ensure a reliable product, it may also extend production timelines if additional testing or refinements are required. We believe it's better to spend extra time delivering a high-quality product than rushing unfinished hardware.

Software Development
RootBoard is built on Raspberry Pi OS and open-source software. During development, we will continue improving the software experience, documentation, drivers, and setup process. Some software features, user interfaces, or configuration methods may evolve before the final release as we incorporate community feedback and optimize the overall experience.

Open-Source Development
Because RootBoard is an open-source project, we expect both the hardware and software to continue evolving after launch. Community contributions, bug fixes, and feature enhancements may result in improvements beyond the initial release. We're committed to supporting this ecosystem and making updates available whenever possible.

Shipping & Logistics
International shipping may be affected by customs processing, local import regulations, weather conditions, or courier delays. While we'll work closely with our logistics partners to ensure timely delivery, some shipments may take longer than estimated depending on the destination country.

Our Commitment
We have experience developing and launching hardware products and understand the challenges involved in bringing electronics to market. Throughout the campaign and production process, we'll keep our backers informed with regular updates, manufacturing progress, testing milestones, and any changes to the schedule or product.
Our goal is simple: deliver a high-quality, open-source handheld Linux computer that meets the expectations of our community.

projects.ai_description_en:
RootBoard is a compact, open-source handheld Linux computer designed to put a full desktop computing experience in your pocket. Built around a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W (sold separately), the kit includes an integrated display, a full physical keyboard, a built-in speaker, and power management circuitry. Unlike typical handhelds with cramped inputs, RootBoard promises a real keyboard for productive typing, paired with the familiar flexibility of Raspberry Pi OS. It’s a do-it-yourself platform that invites makers, developers, and educators to assemble a truly portable Linux terminal that you can inspect, modify, and truly call your own.

Where RootBoard shines is in its blend of practical productivity and tinkering freedom. The full-size keyboard eliminates the “function layer frustration” of tiny devices, letting you write code, manage servers via SSH, dive into electronics projects, or explore retro computing without compromise. The integrated display and speaker transform it into an all-in-one cyberdeck for on-the-go hacking, debugging embedded systems, or learning Linux. Because the hardware is fully open, there is no proprietary keyboard controller, no hidden firmware, and no black boxes—giving you complete transparency and control over the machine you take everywhere.

RootBoard matters because it puts the open computing movement into your hands as a device you can type on. It’s a philosophy you can use: technology should be understandable, modifiable, and free from unnecessary locks. Whether you’re a seasoned maker building a custom cyberdeck, a teacher running coding workshops, or a curious tinkerer who believes devices should serve their owners, RootBoard delivers a transparent, hackable Linux terminal. Backers can secure the kit for a special Kickstarter price of $115 (a $34 savings off the $149 retail price), with worldwide shipping and delivery expected in November 2026. You supply your own Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W, microSD card, and battery cell—everything else you need to build your open pocket computer is included.
