### Our Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/153/719/3d4d2dde6b44ddd10f46ce6e0c06ce62_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781775163&width=680&sig=dAPqCfP6X%2BAs3zXX8yZLXlGwnBRaGHlRmr2BcONUOEk%3D)

#### Why We Created OMIMIO M8

OMIMIO M8 was created from a simple observation: the way people use desktop audio has changed.

Today, one desk may need to serve many roles. It can be a gaming station, a music listening space, a movie setup, a streaming corner, or a compact Hi-Fi system. But most audio devices are still designed for only one purpose. Some focus on headphones, some on speakers, some on gaming, and others on Hi-Fi listening. For many users, building a setup that works across all these scenarios often means making compromises.

We wanted to create a better desktop audio experience.

That is why we built OMIMIO M8: an all-in-one desktop DAC, headphone amplifier, and preamp designed for modern users who move between gaming, music, movies, and high-resolution audio every day. It combines powerful decoding, strong headphone output, balanced speaker connectivity, customizable sound control, and intuitive operation in one compact device.

With OMIMIO M8, our goal is to make high-quality desktop audio more flexible, more accessible, and easier to enjoy across every part of your day.

OMIMIO M8 was shaped through multiple rounds of prototyping, testing, and refinement. As with any hardware project, there may be challenges during production and fulfillment.

The first is supply chain risk. Key components such as audio chips, Bluetooth modules, and display screens may be affected by lead-time changes or market fluctuations. To reduce this risk, we have planned core component procurement in advance and prepared alternative sourcing options for critical parts.

The second is manufacturing consistency. We will implement standardized testing procedures covering audio performance, connectivity, Bluetooth functionality, display performance, controls, and overall system stability to ensure reliable product quality.

In addition, OMIMIO M8 is designed to work with PCs, gaming consoles, Bluetooth devices, headphones, and speakers. We will continue firmware optimization and compatibility testing before mass production and provide firmware updates when necessary to improve the user experience.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: OMIMIO is a hardware team creating versatile all-in-one desktop audio hubs that combine DAC, amplification, and preamp functionality for modern multi-use setups.
projects.ai_description_en:
The OMIMIO M8 is an all-in-one desktop Hi-Fi audio hub that consolidates a high-performance DAC, headphone amplifier, and preamplifier into a single, compact unit. Designed for modern users who seamlessly transition between gaming, music listening, movie streaming, and high-resolution audio throughout their day, it eliminates the need for multiple specialized devices. Whether you're powering demanding Hi-Fi headphones or driving a pair of active speakers, the M8 serves as the central command center for your entire desktop audio setup.

At its core, the M8 features a robust audio architecture built around the AK4493S DAC, XMOS XU316 processor, OPA1612 op-amps, and TPA6120 amplifier chipset. This combination delivers exceptional decoding capabilities, supporting PCM up to 768kHz/32bit and DSD512, while providing up to 2100mW of output power to effortlessly drive even the most power-hungry headphones. The inclusion of dual XLR balanced outputs ensures clean, stable signal transmission with reduced noise and interference, making it equally suited for professional monitoring and high-fidelity listening.

Beyond raw performance, the M8 distinguishes itself with a 1.28-inch circular display featuring an intuitive UI and dynamic LED audio visualization strips that react in real-time to your music, transforming sound into a visual experience. The comprehensive connectivity suite includes optical, coaxial, Bluetooth, and mic inputs alongside 3.5mm, 4.4mm balanced, RCA, and dual XLR outputs, ensuring compatibility with PCs, gaming consoles, mobile devices, and a wide range of audio equipment. An angled ergonomic layout and smart controls further enhance daily usability.

Developed through extensive prototyping and acoustic tuning, the OMIMIO M8 represents a deliberate response to the fragmented desktop audio market. By unifying powerful decoding, versatile connectivity, and immersive visual feedback into one thoughtfully designed device, it offers a streamlined, high-quality audio solution that adapts to every aspect of your digital life without compromise.

## Story

Darkness doesn't wait.

It doesn't care that your hands are full, or that you've already tried everything. It just closes in — and suddenly, one beam isn't enough.

We've been there.

That moment when one light isn't enough, and there's nothing else within reach.

So we built something different.

FlexTorch Duo splits in two. One module mounts magnetically to metal surfaces, keeping your hands free. The other unfolds into a wide-area light, flooding the space around you.

Two independent light sources. One tool. Deployed in seconds.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/100/717/15ee6ef5bb7b15b89e926fa460ed61f1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781421562&width=680&sig=BsYVbVkSJB8WUFw9trmfcJwxoaHH495zVebYBhLVNRc%3D)

It also includes a magnesium fire starter, a rescue whistle, and emergency signal lights -because real emergencies are never clean or predictable.

FlexTorch Duo isn't just a better flashlight.

It's the tool you wish you had every time a flashlight wasn't enough.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/902/837/41605566ff18360016b33f5bbe40ba6c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779980105&width=680&sig=VU6K4%2BpuelbXVhPM1dtiUQupZzqfZnoPpZ33R%2FhvkTk%3D)

Pack lighter. Carry less. Stay ready.

Whether you're camping, signaling for help, starting a fire, or facing the unexpected, FlexTorch Duo has you covered. It splits, mounts, lights,charges, and helps you stay prepared - all in one compact tool. Built for the moments when one flashlight simply isn't enough.

### Why FlexTorch Duo Is Different

FlexTorch Duo isn't just another flashlight. It's a modular lighting system built for real outdoor situations — from handheld illumination and hands-free tent lighting to warning signals, reading light, and compact camp use. One tool. Multiple ways to adapt.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/139/832/c842e7ea4c4791c452e452b2ce29a9ed_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781688450&width=680&sig=zlRjRXEbGnKVRs%2FKe1oEEQ3fR%2FpvE1FWOGNBHtnq15s%3D)

### Built Around a Modular Split System

FlexTorch Duo starts with a simple idea: one light should do more than shine in one direction.

Its two modules twist-lock together as a compact flashlight, then split apart when the situation changes. Contact pins transfer power between the upper and lower sections, while dual 2,500 mAh batteries allow the modules to work together or independently for extended runtime.

The upper module unfolds into four wide-area light panels, delivering up to 1,200 lumens for camp setups, repair work, and emergency situations. The main beam provides focused long-range lighting, while the side lights support close-range tasks. Red and blue signal modes help keep you visible when safety matters most.

Beyond lighting, FlexTorch Duo integrates a bottle opener, package opener, magnesium fire starter, emergency whistle, and backup power bank. It is not just a flashlight with extra features — it is a modular outdoor system built to light, mount, signal, charge, and assist when ordinary gear is not enough.

projects.ai_intro_en: FlexTorch Duo is a modular flashlight combining a retractable camping light, spotlight, and warm light dual-mode side light. It features a built-in power bank, magnetic mount, emergency whistle, and magnesium fire starter, making it ideal for everyday carry and outdoor adventures. Its compact design packs versatile lighting and survival tools into one device.
ai_highlights_en: Modular split system for separate, versatile lighting
Built-in power bank, magnesium fire starter, and emergency whistle
Telescopic camp lantern with three-level brightness adjustment
projects.ai_risks_en: Risks include potential delays from global supply chain disruptions, tariffs, battery shipping regulations, and transportation cost fluctuations. The team has prepared for these variables, will use certified logistics partners, and commits to transparent communication if issues arise.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Jellop is an ad tech company that has supported over 3,500 successful Kickstarter projects, raising more than $1 billion.
projects.ai_description_en:
The FlexTorch Duo is a modular flashlight that transforms from a compact everyday carry light into a versatile camping lantern, all built around a unique split design. Its telescoping body reveals a dual-function main beam for focused spotlighting, while a retractable element creates a warm light dual-mode side light that’s perfect for ambient campsite glow or close-up reading. This means one device handles bright task lighting and soft area illumination, adapting to everything from night trails to tent relaxation.

Beyond primary lighting, the Duo integrates hands-free convenience and safety features. A magnetic top mount and built-in rear clip let the light stick securely to metal surfaces or clip onto a belt and pack. Red and blue signal lights add visibility and emergency signaling, while a three-level brightness adjustment gives precise control over output. The unit also packs a built-in power bank, so you can charge a phone or headlamp directly from the flashlight’s own battery when you’re away from outlets.

Thoughtful survival tools are hidden throughout the body. A magnesium fire starter lets you spark a flame in the outdoors, a built-in bottle and package opener handles camp provisions, and an emergency whistle ensures you can signal for help without extra gear. Bringing it all together is a weather-ready construction built to handle rain, dust, and rough handling, making the FlexTorch Duo equally at home in your pocket or hanging from a tent loop.

Inside the box you receive the flashlight along with both an 18650 battery and an LP883759 battery, a user manual, and a charging cable. With every feature—spotlight, camp lantern, reading light, power bank, fire starter, opener, and whistle—packed into a single, portable device, the FlexTorch Duo is purpose-built for anyone who demands reliable, multi-role illumination for everyday carry and outdoor adventures.

Ice for Every Moment

What's in the Box?

Why Kickstarter?

Stuck with only one ice type? Waiting 2 hours for a single batch?

Cleaning it yourself every time? And when you finally get your sphere ice — it melts too fast and ruins the whole drink?

There's a better way.

JoyMayLab makes sure it never happens again.

One machine. Two ice styles. Ready for different drinks and different moments.

Two Ice Shapes🧊

Most home ice makers give you just one option — one shape, one size, one way to chill.

But everyday drinks and slow-sipping drinksneed different ice.Iced coffee, soda, and juice need quick bullet ice. Whiskey and cocktails deserve large sphere ice that melts slowly.

JoyMayLab gives you both in one machine.

One Machine. Two Ice Types. Every Drink, Covered. 🧊

No extra molds. No second ice maker. No complicated cleanup.

With fast ice-making, one-touch cleaning, smart status indicators, 1-year warranty, and fast shipping, JoyMayLab makes better ice easier for every drink moment.

Large Sphere Ice⚪

You paid good money for that whiskey.Don't let cheap ice ruin it.

Regular ice melts fast — watering down your drink before you're even halfway through. The flavor fades. The experience disappears.

The ice ball melts up to 3x slower than crushed ice.Your whiskey stays cold.Stays strong. Stays exactly the way it was meant to be tasted — sip after sip, to the very last drop.

One ball. Zero compromise.Not just for whiskey.

🔥BBQ & Parties— Keeps every drink cold from the first guest to the last round. No constant refills. No warm beer killing the vibe.

🍓Fruit Sodas & Summer Drinks— Crystal clear, slow-melting, and stunning in the glass. Cold, full-flavored, never watered down.

Fast Bullet Ice✅

Hot day. Warm drink. No ice ready.

With JoyMayLab, press start and fresh bullet ice drops into the basketin 6–8 minutes.

From iced coffee and soda to juice, lemonade, and party drinks, bullet ice helps cool every everyday drink quickly and easily.

After drinks, parties, or daily use, the last thing you want is to take apart and scrub your ice maker.

JOYMayLab makes cleanup simple with a one-touch auto-cleaning mode that helps rinse the system in just 10 minutes.

Less mess after every use. More time to enjoy your drinks — and a fresh machine ready for the next round.

Smart Status Indicators✨

Smart indicators make ice-making easier.

Power light on — the machine is running.Ice Full light on — the basket is full and ready.Red Add Water light on — refill the tank before the next cycle.

Everything is clear at a glance.

🤩4-Step Ice Making

1️⃣Pour clean water into the water tank.No complicated setup — just add water and get ready to make fresh ice.

2️⃣Connect the power cord and turn the machine on.JOYMayLab is designed for simple home use, so you can start making ice anytime.

3️⃣Select Bullet Ice or Sphere Ice based on your drink.Use bullet ice for everyday refreshment, or sphere ice for whiskey, cocktails, and slow sipping.

4️⃣Fresh ice is ready to serve.Add it to your drink and enjoy the perfect chill at home.

## Story

### Meet VoltArk

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/731/5bb133159da5c923d539b11923d48f77_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762890&width=680&sig=44W35Dcfldf3pwCDOULWI7Xw8Tw0DOmZIXQBKLUO%2B8k%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/704/35f4005549c5a60a841e3a1d142a23e1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762620&width=680&sig=mz7oaakt3P4t9rC4lStV68LL9AvjewtWLuxrJG0nPM8%3D)

Meet VoltArk - a compact high-power travel charging hub built for people who cross borders with more than

one device.

With 6 USB-C ports, 1 USB-A port, built-in US / EU / UK / AU travel plugs, and a side USA / JP socket, VoltArk

helps reduce the chargers, adapters, and cable clutter you carry on every trip.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/157/063/12cb1f1821e3f631a6e9ed375c810e54_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781793998&width=680&sig=%2BUWYdpWgk0oIYuhxzSE%2FuYQFUhle2oja2mfYxLvIT%2BE%3D)

### All Your Travel Power

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/733/d05c97a5301d39f5c069e3de78631b48_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762896&width=680&sig=FJLF8pGRA%2BVW2oydDafNb6V7bXgHUvJsbIS1XiBmNLk%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/212/c4514e7f68085115051136bfe8d144a5_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781766265&width=680&sig=DGf4QVgSFugE4Kb0JW87O0RpN4XkR1Cr9r0LJRRn6kM%3D)

VoltArk combines high-output USB charging with global plug compatibility in one travel-ready adapter.

Power your laptop, phone, tablet, earbuds, camera, watch, and more without packing a separate charger for every device.

Designed for international travel, business trips, remote work, and multi-device setups, VoltArk keeps your charging simple wherever the next outlet is.

### Travel Charging is a Mess

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/734/539371757a64020e5e7043f91e606f85_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762901&width=680&sig=l1IkfUtLpSklMgURclArzHjToXMDlD%2BfZ3D67k2JHlk%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/622/404feb0ef1ba21dacd2b6bad1b63e0d5_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781761965&width=680&sig=F9V4Sj43KzjdvRZ95B4kaNBFuuU2HDArlqwF3SWej1Q%3D)

Every trip starts with the same checklist: laptop charger, phone charger, tablet charger, travel plug adapter,extra cables, and a backup plan for the outlet you did not expect.

Wrong plugs, low battery, limited outlets, and underpowered chargers can turn a simple trip into a messycharging setup.

VoltArk was built to simplify that.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/653/59b81754278122c70bd6697ffce5268b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762220&width=680&sig=cVXx5uG9NtYCwpuq%2Fm7KXuw26b70rPNzNpfZOu%2FKcww%3D)

### One Device. Less to Pack

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/743/f20242ee1481205004ac4294facf1e82_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762952&width=680&sig=UnjOwif4E1DXmDrp9XotZK9ilRLllgThk7xdLHtFsl4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/156/854/b5dea68f5cb84006c3f4b831efd84871_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781792936&width=680&sig=TULbam6dC%2Fr6gE6MBiBNaTfcr5A79J7Zh%2FIgOAaAQRo%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/156/672/676fc6222c6a21fc3e1d6acd609ae2c1_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781791934&width=680&sig=K4UU6xtcmmcsIOp9uOUtUiempIIe19v%2BZzB7DZ2q8Dk%3D)

Instead of carrying a laptop power brick, phone charger, tablet charger, and separate travel plug adapters,VoltArk brings the essentials into one compact travel hub.

It is designed to reduce cable clutter in your bag, free up space on your desk, and make charging easier whenyou move between countries, hotels, airports, offices, and shared workspaces.

- Replaces multiple chargers and travel adapters

- Reduces desk and luggage clutter

- Built for high-power, multi-device travel

- Includes global plug support and a side USA / JP socket

### 235W Max USB Output

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/729/611d8c60344b4a1b734006e80538961f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762875&width=680&sig=iunDQtIRC9273dvgwgKQ8UEPureH1e2M%2Fef4%2FbIRsIk%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/706/5a79275ba7604d1aa00ebca7fe7ec952_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781762635&width=680&sig=RvaknSZA%2FDl%2Bhlp5ybS62fs7fDpCpSWky9T7S%2BH%2FMl8%3D)

VoltArk delivers up to 235W total USB output, giving you enough power for demanding travel setups that include a laptop, tablet, phone, earbuds, camera, watch, and power bank.

Whether you are working from a hotel room, editing on the road, or keeping everyone charged during a family trip, VoltArk helps keep your essential devices powered from one outlet.

### Dual 140W USB-C

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/766/eb861ad02bc2d0169f96d1ca81d38ab2_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781763111&width=680&sig=VI3%2FkXrGIxKb8it20mmzF%2BHH64GJ5MqhaPb6MyTj7b4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/781/a13efd3bb82b4f9df6c6b5864fde4a91_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781763260&width=680&sig=V3GN6%2BVg88su8u8eTj%2FpR42jXg9NQvWWd%2FjtWMIQK2s%3D)

USB-C1 and USB-C2 each support up to 140W PD 3.1 fast charging, giving VoltArk the power needed for laptop-class devices.

Use one high-power port for a laptop, or connect a laptop and another USB-C device while VoltArk manages the available output across the ports.

### Charge 7 Devices at Once

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/796/098a5925759f470b97cfb653fb595122_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781763363&width=680&sig=uu2OCSPxx8sY2On%2FRWPdQx69EcsJG%2FilVFP9ADQwRc8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/157/086/3854daf62f787cd619b09da675cee741_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781794122&width=680&sig=UBkWO2kw9tes9J29xmbruIawLxbxnXbgMymEm0BTXjY%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/156/735/1c820eab4537cf404201a610d2c059a7_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781792250&width=680&sig=9D3we7IneHD7BvfixL8m4Ce0lu524pQVt3x6CHkAWXk%3D)

VoltArk gives you 6 USB-C ports and 1 USB-A port, so your daily travel kit can charge from a single outlet.

Connect your laptop, tablet, phone, earbuds, smartwatch, camera, and power bank without fighting for spaceor swapping chargers throughout the day

### Smart Power Distribution

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/805/8077bdf3840440bc2e1cc4a996efe4a6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781763405&width=680&sig=kibckdOFxm8zqDc3rR46lRr2hXaoUKaNoKz7p5sx7EU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/837/46abfbcd9beb2ef4e1ce6db715b1e062_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781763594&width=680&sig=TS1c7CSvtA%2F%2FnzrW4GJGUr6n1B5IygJZoSu5%2BJkAZw4%3D)

VoltArk automatically balances power across connected devices, so you do not need to choose a charging mode or manually configure each port.

Plug in what you need, and VoltArk distributes available power based on the connected devices and port combination.

### Built-In Plug for the World

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/875/db028b84ffdb533e9001e133475fec60_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781763815&width=680&sig=uOuTDau27B22x8PyIqpsXZU5IKjLIMX5IAF1qpMh9sM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/154/380/0f819831550fe083ce3c594d7f8c9ef1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781778653&width=680&sig=oKQhfyvG1ep2Wrl9Yt9s%2FYMNSsUosBqm948DYzR1Qik%3D)

VoltArk includes built-in US, EU, UK, and AU travel plugs, helping you connect in many of the most common travel destinations without carrying separate plug adapters.

Slide out the plug you need, connect to the wall outlet, and power your devices from one compact adapter.

### More Than USB Charging

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/017/c34088bcbb38a6f932da8b17fc0283ec_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781764663&width=680&sig=U3p9wXEUX0YIVb6o9oLOJC6oVC9n3TtkCWFE5i9eM4Y%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/250/ba1ee74cee980ef1812be88fe7cf288b_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781766570&width=680&sig=3Ikqo4JL8igg2eIPVt5yaAZxnNpYGZRUOmnq0WtZuhc%3D)

VoltArk is not only a USB charger. It also works as a travel power adapter, giving you AC outlet support for compatible plug-in devices.

The side USA / JP socket is a key travel feature: it gives US and Japan plug devices a direct place to connect,helping reduce the need for a separate conversion plug when you travel.

### GaN III Technology

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/090/214ab0324ecd414bdbafcf6f1030b295_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765323&width=680&sig=qAppkgapxuATVSH7ux%2BuRnshsd%2Fx7AQRa%2B9EzUkRr5Q%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/097/93c75061209b3634ded3dc583544d89d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765357&width=680&sig=NHeK46y%2FoxUI9OiS1oq1uNhn0dRhMa53C3EBU3zbzYs%3D)

GaN III technology helps VoltArk deliver high output in a smaller travel-ready form factor.

Compared with traditional charger designs, GaN technology supports efficient power delivery, improved thermal management, and a more compact structure for daily travel use.

### Safety You Can Trust

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/108/ff4fafc656b89fbc83ab326fd4a977f4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765482&width=680&sig=qHn4qBcPQhGW9%2Bl8aVSvYjNwcmi8n7N3oJ2wqTR9e4I%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/112/a400fe402e92efae1d2ca3ddec49d4a4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765523&width=680&sig=%2BwnIiauFsOuLBMmvuEeXrJmrIpRpkqIst%2FJDN9CxZJ0%3D)

VoltArk is designed with multiple protection systems to help guard against over-voltage, over-current,over-temperature, and short-circuit conditions.

A replaceable 250Vac 10A fuse adds another layer of protection for AC use, while the compact body is built for repeated travel.

### Built for Every Traveler

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/124/1d1eae5cb0236ae73f262085cc41af4f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765615&width=680&sig=BF%2FUlPNUrfw9Kb%2BQ639mgxxcbd9jIEx6jPkIdoEaRlc%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/158/208/7347ea1609bcbbebed4183e64818ca5f_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781800951&width=680&sig=XoZPG1ZtJbcvPcYTHr25dyIWAMEazTm6DElNjKCqoFA%3D)

Whether you work, create, travel, or share power with family, VoltArk keeps your essential devices charged from one compact hub.One outlet. Less clutter. More freedom to move.

### Specifications

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/152/6705d687e23e55a273854f5395e14d1b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765891&width=680&sig=jEhnEyyeNVxcyH2jU8bJoijKvxss8KW9h8hKidp4BUM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/321/8d483e2944b7d306216326649aebb61b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781767133&width=680&sig=XMz0Ptk6gownCclXy%2BRFOb3Q7q803s4XuE8xuYmsc7o%3D)

VoltArk combines USB charging, built-in travel plugs, AC outlet support, a side USA / JP socket, replaceable fuse protection, and GaN III power architecture in one compact adapter.

### What Is in the Box

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/326/3a22e93c0670b125f6928a1840ad8601_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781767157&width=680&sig=4o72TyX7jqYqDqJBCKMl%2F7%2BLUZTvfXD6FxDooLLR%2Bu8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/342/926278fbed2236f29641fb2bb9ab1893_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781767234&width=680&sig=iEyfIqyPzS0FolgsLDMHYyKhHSQSXtKF7bWjQVROHcQ%3D)

## Risks and challenges

VoltArk faces potential risks including supply chain disruptions, fluctuating component and raw material costs, certification timelines, and delays in international logistics. As a high-power travel charging adapter with multiple USB-C ports, built-in travel plugs, and a universal AC socket, ensuring product safety, stable power output, heat management, and consistent quality during mass production is a key challenge. projects.ai_creator_bio_en: VoltArk is a hardware brand focused on practical charging solutions for modern travelers. We design compact, powerful, and reliable products that help people stay connected anywhere in the world.
projects.ai_description_en:
VoltArk is a 235W global travel power hub designed to eliminate the clutter of multiple chargers and travel adapters by combining high-power charging and worldwide plug compatibility into a single compact device. At its core, the hub features dual 140W USB-C ports capable of fast-charging demanding laptops and devices, alongside additional USB outputs that allow users to charge up to seven devices simultaneously. Built-in US, EU, UK, and AU plugs let travelers use the hub in virtually any country, while a side USA/JP AC socket accommodates plug-in devices that need a traditional outlet. Powered by GaN III technology, VoltArk delivers efficient, stable power output with reduced heat generation compared to conventional adapters.

The hub is engineered for travelers and professionals who carry multiple high-power devices and need one reliable solution for laptops, phones, tablets, cameras, and more. Its smart power distribution system allocates wattage intelligently across connected devices, ensuring optimal charging speeds without overloading. A fire-resistant PC shell, replaceable 250Vac 10A fuse, and multiple built-in protection systems address safety concerns common with high-power multi-port chargers, making it suitable for both personal use and sharing with family or travel companions.

What sets VoltArk apart is its combination of extreme power density and universal travel readiness in a single unit that fits easily in a bag. By consolidating global plug adapters, multi-device charging, and a universal AC socket into one streamlined hub, it reduces the number of accessories travelers need to pack. The estimated delivery window of September 2026 reflects the complexities of mass-producing a high-wattage, multi-certification travel device, with the team working closely with suppliers and testing partners to manage supply chain risks, certification timelines, and consistent quality control throughout fulfillment.

projects.html_story:
Dual-TEC Cooling / Powerful Twin Fans / 20°C Instant Chill / 4-Speed Control / UPF 50+ Shield / Easy Machine Wash / 4H Battery

Dual-TEC Cooling / Powerful Twin Fans / 20°C Instant Chill / 4-Speed Control / UPF 50+ Shield / Easy Machine Wash / 4H Battery

Why choose SubZ

10-Second Instant

Active Dual-TEC & Twin-Fan

Ergonomic 3D Airflow

4-Speed Intelligent Control

UPF 50+ & Moisture Wicking

Multi-Scenario Modular Cooling

Easy Machine Washable

What's in the box

Why Kickstarter

Imagine standing under a relentless midday sun, where the air is thick and the heat feels like a physical weight. You reach for a traditional cooling vest, only to find that its fans are simply circulating the same sweltering air against your skin. You’re left drenched in sweat, with the "cooling" gear adding nothing but bulk. We believed there had to be a better way to reclaim the outdoors. Meet SubZ—not just another fan jacket, but a wearable climate control system designed to deliver an Arctic breeze whenever and wherever you need it.

Why choose SubZ

10-Second Instant

Chill It eliminates the wait for relief. Within just 10 seconds of activation, it delivers a powerful cooling sensation that can reduce your core body temperature by 15°C to 20°C (27°F to 36°F). Whether you are hiking a trail or working on-site, it provides an immediate escape from the heat.

Active Dual-TEC & Twin-Fan

It redefines cooling through its Dual-TEC Peltier modules, which actively convert electricity into cold energy. Unlike traditional jackets that rely solely on passive fans to move hot air, its Twin-Fan system works in tandem with the TEC modules to blast actual chilled air across your body.

Ergonomic 3D Airflow

It is engineered for comfort without compromise. The internal 3D airflow structure ensures that cold air is distributed uniformly across your upper body, preventing uncomfortable cold spots. Its lightweight, modular design feels natural and non-restrictive, making it perfect for active movement.

4-Speed Intelligent Control

It adapts to your specific environment with a single touch. You can cycle through 4 adjustable cooling levels to find your perfect balance. From a gentle Level 4 breeze to the maximum power of Level 1 for extreme heat, you are always in total control of your microclimate.

UPF 50+ & Moisture Wicking

It serves as your ultimate outdoor shield. The 100% nylon fabric provides a professional UPF 50+ rating, blocking harmful UVA and UVB rays. Simultaneously, its moisture-wicking technology actively regulates sweat, ensuring you remain dry and comfortable even in high humidity.

Multi-Scenario Modular Cooling

It seamlessly adapts to your every adventure. Whether you arehikingsteep trails,fishingunder a blazing sun,campingin the wild, or handlingprofessional outdoor labor, it delivers uncompromising relief. Itsdetachable modular coreeasily swaps between different compatible garments, ensuring you have the perfect active cooling companion for any scenario.

Easy Machine Washable

It simplifies maintenance for a busy lifestyle. Thanks to the two-step quick-release system, you can detach the electronic cooling modules in seconds. The jacket itself is fully machine washable, ensuring your gear stays fresh and hygienic after every adventure without the hassle of hand-washing.

What's in the box

We're a dedicated team of thermal engineers and technical apparel designers with a focus on active cooling solutions. Our lead engineer specializes in TEC Peltier module integration, while our product lead brings years of experience in ergonomic wearable tech and high-performance fabrics. Having successfully developed innovative temperature-control wear, we are thrilled to introduce SubZ—our first global launch that redefines active cooling and outdoor sun protection.

Why Kickstarter

We chose Kickstarter to validate demand before mass production. Your backing helps us secure larger orders for Dual-TEC modules and high-speed motors, ensuring better pricing without compromising hardware quality. More importantly, early backers will help shape the final experience—such as ergonomic fit, airflow distribution, and power optimization—through direct feedback. This isn't just funding; it's co-creation with outdoor enthusiasts who demand real, active climate control.

Risks and challenges

Component Sourcing: Specialized Dual-TEC modules and 7200 RPM brushless motors require a 6–8 week lead time. Solution: We have already locked in early batches of core electronics and UPF 50+ fabrics. Bulk orders are scheduled early to counter any potential 2026 hardware shortages.
﻿
Regulatory Compliance: Electronic safety (CE/FCC) and textile quality testing are currently in progress. Solution: A 6-week contingency period is built into our schedule for any potential re-evaluations. Our estimated shipping dates already account for this built-in buffer.
﻿
Freight Variability: International shipping rates and transit times remain unpredictable. Solution: To bypass last-mile bottlenecks and reduce costs, we have established direct partnerships with regional fulfillment hubs in the US and EU, guaranteeing smoother and faster deliveries.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: A dedicated team of thermal engineers and technical apparel designers specializing in TEC Peltier module integration and ergonomic wearable cooling technology.
projects.ai_description_en:
SubZ is a wearable climate control jacket that combines thermoelectric cooling (Dual-TEC Peltier modules) with a powerful Twin-Fan system to deliver active, crisp, refrigerated airflow across your upper body. Unlike conventional cooling garments that merely recirculate ambient hot air, SubZ's TEC modules actively convert electricity into cold energy, while the 7200 RPM brushless fans blast genuinely chilled air through an ergonomic 3D internal airflow structure. The result is a 10-second instant chill sensation that can reduce core body temperature by 15°C to 20°C whenever heat becomes oppressive.

The jacket features four intelligent cooling speeds, letting you dial from a gentle Arctic breeze up to maximum power for extreme sun exposure. Built from 100% UPF 50+ nylon with moisture-wicking properties, SubZ serves as both a personal air conditioner and a serious UV shield, blocking harmful UVA/UB rays even during the most grueling midday treks, fishing excursions, professional outdoor labor, or festival days. The modular cooling core detaches via a quick-release system, making the garment fully machine washable—a practical advantage that keeps the gear fresh and hygienic without hand-washing hassle.

Available in three distinct styles—the hooded Alpine, the streamlined Urban, and the Summit with color-blocked sleeves—SubZ adapts to varied outdoor scenarios without bulk or restriction. Each unit runs on a high-capacity 10000mAh or 20000mAh power bank, providing hours of continuous relief. Billed as the alternative to stuffy, sweat-soaked traditional cooling gear, SubZ offers a lightweight, wearable solution that puts climate control—sun protection included—firmly in the wearer's hands. The project is on Kickstarter now, with backers getting Super Early Bird pricing starting at $119 against a $249 MSRP. Estimated delivery is September 2026 to anywhere in the world.

A compact RX/TX Bluetooth 5.4 audio adapter that connects 3.5mm AUX devices with wireless headphones, speakers, phones, and car audio s

A compact RX/TX Bluetooth 5.4 audio adapter that connects 3.5mm AUX devices with wireless headphones, speakers, phones, and car audio s

Still Using Wired AUX? Go Wireless Instantly.

ONE ADAPTER. TWO WAYS TO CONNECT.

TX MODE: Use Your Headphones Anywhere.

Listen Together With Two Headphones.

RX MODE: Add Bluetooth To AUX Devices.

Bluetooth 5.4 With Premium Codecs.

Instant RX/TX Mode Switching.

Simple TX Mode Setup Process.

Simple RX Mode Setup Process.

Remembers Previously Paired Devices.

Multifunction Button With LED Indicators.

Compact Design For Everyday Carry.

20-Hour Battery Life.

Technical Specifications.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX

Choose Your Reward.

Environmental commitments

Still Using Wired AUX? Go Wireless Instantly.

Many devices still use a 3.5mm AUX port.

Airplane entertainment systems, TVs, monitors, treadmills, computers, car AUX systems, old speakers, and amplifiers often still rely on wired audio input or output.

But today, we are used to listening with Bluetooth headphones, Bluetooth speakers, phones, and tablets.

Then the problem appears:

You want to watch a movie on an airplane with your own Bluetooth headphones, but the seat screen only has a 3.5mm headphone jack.

You want to watch TV at night without disturbing anyone, but your TV does not support Bluetooth audio output.

Your car AUX system and old speakers still work well, but they cannot easily play music from your phone wirelessly.

You do not need to replace these devices.

You only need to change the way they connect.

ONE ADAPTER. TWO WAYS TO CONNECT.

Sometimes, you want to send audio from an AUX device to Bluetooth headphones.

Sometimes, you want to play music from your phone through AUX speakers or a car audio system.

AVIX brings both needs into one compact device.

Switch to TX mode to connect 3.5mm audio devices, such as TVs, airplane entertainment systems, treadmills, and computers, to Bluetooth headphones.

Switch to RX mode to play Bluetooth audio from your phone, tablet, or computer through car audio, old speakers, or home audio systems via AUX.

Whether you are traveling, watching movies, working out, driving, or listening at home, you no longer need to keep searching for different cables and adapters.

TX MODE: Use Your Headphones Anywhere.

You may already be used to your own Bluetooth headphones.

But many devices still only offer traditional 3.5mm AUX audio output.

Airplane entertainment systems, TVs, monitors, treadmills, computers, and game consoles can all create this problem.

When you encounter this kind of port, you may have to find a wired headset again, or simply give up using the Bluetooth headphones you already like.

Now, just plug AVIX into a standard 3.5mm AUX audio output, and you can send the sound wirelessly to Bluetooth headphones or Bluetooth speakers.

On a trip, you can use your own Bluetooth headphones to watch movies on an airplane entertainment system.

At night, you can watch TV and listen privately without disturbing others.

At the gym, you no longer need to be limited by headphone cables.

For devices that still use AUX audio output, AVIX helps them fit better into today’s wireless listening habits.

Listen Together With Two Headphones.

Using Bluetooth headphones alone is convenient.

But when two people watch TV together, travel together, or enjoy airplane entertainment together, connecting only one pair of headphones is not always enough.

In TX mode, AVIX supports connecting two Bluetooth headphones at the same time.

Two people can use their own familiar headphones and listen to the same 3.5mm audio source together.

No need to share one pair of earbuds.

No need to fight over one side of the headset.

No need to carry an extra splitter.

Whether you are watching a movie at home or sharing entertainment while traveling, listening together becomes easier.

RX MODE: Add Bluetooth To AUX Devices.

Many speakers, car audio systems, and amplifiers still sound good.

They just do not have Bluetooth.

Replacing the whole setup only because it cannot play music from your phone wirelessly may not be worth it.

In RX mode, you can send music from your phone, tablet, or computer to AVIX via Bluetooth, then output it through 3.5mm AUX to your existing audio device.

Your car AUX system can play music from your phone.

Your old speakers can keep working.

Your home audio system or amplifier can also connect to wireless audio more easily.

You do not need to give up your existing equipment just because it does not have Bluetooth.

As long as it has a standard 3.5mm AUX input, it can return to everyday use.

Bluetooth 5.4 With Premium Codecs.

Everyday listening is not just about making a connection.

The connection should feel stable, clear, and easy to use.

AVIX uses Bluetooth 5.4 and supports common Bluetooth audio codecs, including aptX, AAC, and SBC.

Whether you are watching TV, flying, working out, driving, or listening at home, you can switch more easily between AUX devices and Bluetooth audio devices.

Simpler connection.

More natural use.

Finally, less restriction from cables.

Instant RX/TX Mode Switching.

Different scenarios should not require complicated setup.

Want to send audio from a TV, airplane entertainment system, treadmill, or computer to Bluetooth headphones? Switch to TX.

Want to play music from your phone through car AUX, old speakers, or a home audio system? Switch to RX.

The side physical switch makes mode selection clear and direct.

No need to enter menus.

No need to keep checking the manual.

You can see the switch and know how AVIX is set.

Simple TX Mode Setup Process.

Switch to TX mode.

Press and hold the multifunction button for about 3 seconds to power on.

Enter Bluetooth pairing mode.

Connect your Bluetooth headphones.

Connect AVIX to a standard 3.5mm audio output device.

Start wireless listening.

TVs, monitors, airplane entertainment systems, treadmills, computers, and other AUX audio output devices can all connect to Bluetooth headphones this way.

Simple RX Mode Setup Process.

Switch to RX mode.

Press and hold the multifunction button for about 3 seconds to power on.

Search for and connect to AVIX from your phone, tablet, or computer.

Connect AVIX to car AUX, speakers, or another 3.5mm AUX input device.

Play music or audio content.

The sound will come out through your original AUX audio device.

Devices without built-in Bluetooth can now play wireless audio more easily.

Remembers Previously Paired Devices.

When you often use the same Bluetooth headphones, car audio system, or home speaker, the most annoying part is not pairing once.

It is having to pair again and again.

AVIX can remember paired devices. Next time, simply power it on and switch to the right mode to reconnect faster.

Whether you are using your Bluetooth headphones again on an airplane or playing music in your car every day, just turn it on and use it without pairing again and again.

Multifunction Button With LED Indicators.

Everyday use should be simple.

The front button on AVIX combines common controls with a semi-transparent light-through design, allowing LED status to show directly through the button area.

Power, pairing, play / pause, answer / hang up, and clearing pairing records can all be handled through this button.

Main controls include:

Press and hold for about 3 seconds to power on.

When powered on, press and hold for about 3 seconds to power off.

When powered on, press and hold for about 10 seconds to clear pairing records.

In RX mode, click to play / pause music.

In RX mode, click to answer / hang up a call.

In RX mode, press and hold for about 3 seconds to reject an incoming call.

LED status includes:

When powering on, the blue light stays on for about 1 second.

When no device is connected, red and blue lights flash alternately to indicate pairing mode.

After TX mode is connected, the red light flashes once every 5 seconds.

After RX mode is connected, the blue light flashes once every 5 seconds.

When powering off, the red light stays on for about 1 second.

When charging, the green light stays on.

When fully charged, the green light turns off.

When the battery is low, the green light flashes once every 2 seconds.

You can quickly understand the current status without checking a screen.

Compact Design For Everyday Carry.

Many times, you need this kind of tool unexpectedly.

An airplane seat entertainment system, a hotel TV, a treadmill, car AUX, or an old speaker at home may all need a compact and easy-to-carry audio adapter.

AVIX measures about 24.5 × 56 × 12 mm and fits easily into a pocket, headphone case, travel pouch, or everyday tech bag without taking up much space.

The nylon-braided audio cable also adapts more naturally to different connection positions. Whether the port is behind a TV, in a car console, on the side of a monitor, or near an airplane seat, it helps make connection and storage easier.

For travel, commuting, workouts, or daily use, you can keep it in your pocket and take it out when you need it.

20-Hour Battery Life.

Traveling, commuting, watching TV, or playing music in the car should not be interrupted by a low battery.

AVIX has a built-in 400mAh rechargeable battery and charges via USB-C.

Charging time is about 2 hours.

Usage time is up to 20 hours.

For long flights, daily commuting, late-night TV, and in-car music playback, you can use it with more peace of mind.

No need to keep it plugged into power during normal use, and no need to charge it frequently.

If you often encounter 3.5mm AUX ports and want to use Bluetooth headphones or phone music, AVIX is made for you.

It is suitable for:

Frequent travelers

Bluetooth headphone users

People who want to use Bluetooth headphones with airplane entertainment systems

People who want to use Bluetooth headphones with TVs or monitors

Drivers who need Bluetooth playback through car AUX

People who want to keep using old speakers

Anyone who needs a compact audio adapter

It is a small tool that can be useful on airplanes, with TVs, in cars, at the gym, and at home.

You may not use it every single day.

But when you run into a 3.5mm AUX port, you will be glad you brought it with you.

Technical Specifications.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX

Choose Your Reward.

Shipping will be charged after the campaign ends.

Final costs will be confirmed based on the destination.

Estimated prices include international shipping, VAT, duties, and standard customs clearance.

Risks and challenges

The main risks for AVIX are production scheduling, component supply, battery shipping, and final quality control.

Before mass production, we will confirm the final sample, key components, packaging, and inspection standards.

Because AVIX includes a built-in rechargeable battery, we will choose suitable logistics channels according to each destination region.

Before shipment, we will check the product appearance, RX/TX modes, Bluetooth connection, audio playback, charging function, buttons, indicator lights, and basic call function.

Any small adjustments before production will focus on improving stability and user experience, without changing the core functions.

The AVIX product itself was photographed from real physical product samples. The AI-assisted elements do not change the actual product design, shape, ports, materials, functions, specifications, or technical information. They are used only to improve visual presentation and image quality. All product descriptions, specifications, and technical information shown on the campaign page are based on the actual product.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. The AI-assisted visuals were created using our own or authorized photos of real physical product samples as the basis. We have the right to use these product photos and materials in this campaign.

AI image tools were used only for background enhancement, lighting adjustment, scene styling, and visual presentation. The AVIX product itself is not AI-generated, and the AI process does not change the product’s design, shape, ports, materials, functions, specifications, or technical information.

No third-party copyrighted images, logos, characters, brand assets, or protected materials were used as inputs.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

AVIX is designed with a stable shell structure, reliable interface design, and a rechargeable battery to support long-term use in travel, car audio, home entertainment, and everyday audio scenarios.

We hope the product can help reduce the need for users to frequently replace disposable audio accessories or low-durability adapters.

Reusability and recyclability

AVIX uses a rechargeable and reusable design, allowing it to be used across different 3.5mm AUX audio devices and Bluetooth devices.

At the end of the product lifecycle, we also encourage users to dispose of the product according to local electronic recycling requirements, helping reduce the environmental impact of electronic waste.

Sustainable materials

For material and packaging choices, we will try to use materials that are suitable for long-term use, easy to manage in production, and easier to recycle. We will also reduce unnecessary decorative parts and excessive packaging.

Environmentally friendly factories

During production, we will work with our manufacturing partner to control material use, reduce unnecessary rework and waste, and lower the risk of scrap or repeated production caused by quality issues through sample confirmation before mass production and inspection before shipment.

Sustainable Distribution

AVIX is compact and lightweight, making it suitable for compact packaging and consolidated shipping. We will try to optimize packaging size and logistics arrangements while ensuring product protection, reducing unnecessary shipping space and packaging material waste.

projects.ai_description_en:
AVIX is a compact Bluetooth 5.4 audio adapter designed to bridge the gap between legacy 3.5mm AUX devices and modern wireless audio gear. In a world where most of us have moved on to Bluetooth headphones, speakers, and phones, countless everyday devices still rely on wired audio connections. Airplane entertainment systems, treadmills, older TVs, car AUX ports, and home amplifiers all feature 3.5mm jacks that leave wireless listeners stranded. AVIX solves this by functioning as a two-way adapter: it can transmit audio from an AUX source to Bluetooth headphones or speakers, or receive Bluetooth audio and output it through a wired AUX connection. This dual RX/TX capability means a single small device can handle both directions of audio conversion, eliminating the need to carry multiple adapters or replace perfectly functional equipment.

In TX mode, AVIX plugs into any 3.5mm audio output and wirelessly streams sound to Bluetooth headphones or speakers. This is especially useful for watching movies on airplane seat-back screens, listening to TV at night without disturbing others, or working out at the gym without being tethered by a cable. A standout feature is the ability to connect two pairs of Bluetooth headphones simultaneously, making it easy for two people to share the same audio source during travel or at home without splitters or sharing earbuds. In RX mode, the adapter reverses the flow: it receives Bluetooth audio from a phone, tablet, or computer and outputs it through a 3.5mm AUX cable to car stereos, older speakers, or home audio systems that lack built-in wireless connectivity.

The device is built around Bluetooth 5.4 with support for premium audio codecs, ensuring stable, high-quality wireless transmission. A single multifunction button handles power, pairing, and mode switching, with LED indicators providing clear status feedback. AVIX remembers previously paired devices, so reconnecting is quick and hassle-free. The built-in rechargeable battery delivers up to 20 hours of use on a single charge, and the compact form factor makes it easy to slip into a pocket, bag, or glove compartment. Whether you are traveling, driving, working out, or relaxing at home, AVIX turns any 3.5mm AUX port into a wireless audio hub, letting you use the Bluetooth devices you already own with the wired equipment you already have.

### One System. Yours to Architect.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/658/94f5b658dba4d99bd2ec65a08b5c0edc_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985265&width=680&sig=Z%2FTmm2CoFCCDlOpfC7BfOJ%2FBiLWjV60Ho1TDmgF8pow%3D)

Everything you carefully choose to wear says something about you—your watch, your ring, your belt, your shoes.

Except one thing. The piece of mass-produced metal sitting at your waist. The row of fixed holes forcing your body to adapt to it. For centuries, it has remained virtually unchanged.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/055/172/5d9ebbd9e18a48e382b5be1e2d7b4ee1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781070712&width=680&sig=9m%2B0ktnewbmSArWCSUZuG6BCgkIO%2BY%2FVFx28W9MAaG8%3D)

So we decided to tackle something nobody had seriously reimagined before. We weren't interested in making a better belt buckle. We set out to create an entirely new waist-carry system.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/999/769/bd93df8f932e2e5286692722b0d2196c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780655152&width=680&sig=Z22zhlyGQMxt5czR1A9%2Bs6tGmitgZWXmbFuLAGL1ub0%3D)

Built around three independent layers of engineering, each fully customizable, individually replaceable, and endlessly adaptable.

They are:

- Interchangeable Faceplates — designed for different moods, different occasions, and different versions of you. Swap them in seconds and give your everyday carry a fresh identity.

- A Micro-Adjust Belt System — no holes, no compromises. It responds naturally to every movement and every breath for a fit that moves with you.

- The Core Chassis — the foundation of the entire system. Secure, reliable, and engineered to support everything above it.

Each layer stands on its own. Together, they become something greater. You're not simply buying a belt buckle. You're assembling a mechanical companion built around you.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/221/fb056fe3c697821dd54607be70851e79_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780973808&width=680&sig=gIGy8LbDqmwRuYlZ56ZhweOq6zq%2F%2FJO1ICWDZ4Sd5qU%3D)

We call it TiVerse. One titanium core. Unlimited possibilities.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/461/f802ce1b5d2c823941b65d6c66181c80_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780975489&width=680&sig=hp4KNwBF92w2J7FkQmKN1%2FcWcVMEUSYC1evr0xlwCCo%3D)

### Now It Adjusts to You

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/676/99017489eb859b03b2d49bb8b5f32d28_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985374&width=680&sig=noVZHY4xSsAWWMXmADjq4ZQg5Go7KyAy8n28nkku8pc%3D)

People change. Belt holes don't. The moment they're punched at the factory, they're frozen in place forever. For years, you've been the one making compromises.

One hole is too tight. The next is too loose. And somehow, that's just been accepted as normal.

Worse yet, those holes are slowly destroying the belt you carefully chose.

They stretch. They deform. The edges fray and wear down.

A belt that should last decades often fails at the holes first.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/984/021/38366dd2cf08129f64f978a449c2154b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780554893&width=680&sig=KKnBrkflOOFTkUOrFGW6krmHMfnYClMJYpqpW7YwKGM%3D)

At Titaner, we don't believe objects are static. Their value comes from the relationship they build with you.

Something that has been with you for ten years—through ordinary days and unforgettable moments—will always mean more than something brand new in a display case.

That's why we build products meant to stay with you for life. And to do that, they must be able to evolve with you. So we did something simple. We got rid of the holes.

TiVerse uses a hole-free micro-adjustment system. Stop anywhere. Adjust anytime.

It follows your body instead of forcing your body to follow it.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/055/208/8fa39ba86743c6819167d7112f4ff4ef_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781070889&width=680&sig=UG%2BXSTpvzv4a8dmpV9qZWXUbDLaCZir7O3b7%2By1iTS0%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/054/246/3176da58f0dd8cc817ecddda7f025b45_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781063421&width=680&sig=IkWPojscQOmZ9a5j47fDdVM7yNmCBag%2B5tOpvcQe7Hc%3D)Showing the side opening structure. The side profile of the product may differ from the final version.

Without holes, the belt can finally focus on doing one thing well:

- Moving with you.

- No replacing it because your waist changed.

- No fighting for the perfect fit.

Just effortless adjustment, day after day.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/025/681/50bb3eb280692da216812dff8ac53972_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780897526&width=680&sig=BwgNi1uVsqGd14Jq%2FEDq3hickd7%2FQr6a4Iv51cMpfJ0%3D)

We re-engineered the entire experience. No holes. No stretching. No gradual loosening. Locked securely at your waist, day after day.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/047/292/3c9a9c3469bcf5c417f10eb5f965fc43_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781020531&width=680&sig=H5SISTA8YMRtqD6ySNML5yoYwyrdW%2FrbNVAsXzYO694%3D)You read that right — TiVerse is designed to stay firmly in place, with no unexpected loosening.

One belt. From day one to year ten. The fit stays the same.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/027/852/eb9cdcb1ca4db801ce918367656d609f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780908087&width=680&sig=eQGr5fFs6cw2iSg4ZNx9W5CExsxuiHMIQqWVQJ5CK8I%3D)The reward comes standard with a 120 cm version.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/043/098/9b12e329949657122d3fcdf1261ce840_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780998239&width=680&sig=q0%2FzoanD3ZrdQLwqibHhlEGbrh6c8ycNnB4CZHdbsuo%3D)

For hundreds of years, belts worked like this: You adapted to them. They wore themselves out.

Now the relationship has changed. It adapts to you. And neither of you has to wear out in the process.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/984/043/055520dde56001fbf276eb8e8a54f6c0_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780555068&width=680&sig=rglzoYg5XIbeL8hWz3pVyqSLvIeQxQXAGtaUibmtnO8%3D)

Objects are alive through the stories they share with us.

And from this moment on, that relationship is redefined.

[![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/617/68709c7e38efcbc45e824c21e14b2a3d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985076&width=680&sig=6nh9TFzLleyzxNNx8I3CqtbO%2F7P06pwJjbWIh0jgzNc%3D)](https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/titaner-cici/titaner-tiverse-the-infinite-modular-titanium-belt-buckle/pledge/new?clicked_reward=false)

### Nothing Falls. Tested in Hell.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/681/fcfb4859245c88e5a886745e158c711a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985412&width=680&sig=Lnh5cqVWY1Jfq2ABLlh5FcpOq3WC%2FcaUnhmJLLiv8Lw%3D)

The moment happens fast. You stand up from your chair and suddenly feel your belt loosen.

Everyone knows that feeling. Your face heats up instantly. Your hand shoots toward your waist before you even think about it. For half a second, the entire room seems to freeze.

Even if nobody actually saw it, you're convinced they did. That's not your fault. It's what cheap belt buckles do best—failing exactly when you need them most.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/000/079/a726d551991b976b1c142e89bdd7219d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780656678&width=680&sig=uuYF%2FXQFbu7GX8DQkw4PqXLS5boUvXf7s5N2hnE0iX0%3D)

The TiVerse chassis is the backbone of the entire system. Every faceplate attaches to it. Every security mechanism starts here.

So we designed a locking system that's intentionally harder to trigger by accident.

To release TiVerse, two separate actions must happen at the same time:

- Press the latch inward — in a direction that naturally resists accidental contact.

- Lift the faceplate upward.

One action alone won't release it.

Not gravity. Not pressure. Not an accidental bump.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/025/693/31ec264f76ab0ec63db37d9db181068c_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780897594&width=680&sig=g8IPmKNrCCTr219iIOd4UFvYCAIcn7%2FOWm5sitMH8Is%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/025/698/44c994fb68074ea44c299fbd6b8fb087_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780897638&width=680&sig=5xwTsT0RcYEQdaSHUxSCp%2BwNG2bT3xx8HtX8GHQq1nU%3D)

We're not here to convince you with a spec sheet.

At Titaner, real-world testing has always been the final authority.

For material demonstration purposes only. These tests involve hazardous operations — please don't try this at home.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/450/750c579116167497ba83421e8fbf8ebb_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780975405&width=680&sig=RysUDlLJCA7EHsK1ZEvIyVHZW0ihmaPKBVYEwqp%2B2vo%3D)The finished product contains magnets and springs. Please do not heat it at high temperatures.

The mechanical architecture prevents accidental release.

The titanium construction prevents structural failure.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/044/342/6d5fc3791883a84dbb64964c8363420e_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781005850&width=680&sig=DNWBN3%2B5G74oMJPznzsXpcyU2hv8RSVHNSF1GWwNOks%3D)A safe and reliable connector for your emergency tow rope.

Nothing Falls. Not a slogan. A receipt.

Security isn't just something you know. It's something you feel. The moment TiVerse closes, the hidden mechanism inside the titanium chassis snaps into place with a sharp, satisfying click. That sound isn't just fidget-worthy.

It's reassurance. A quiet but unmistakable confirmation that everything is locked exactly where it should be. From that moment on, you don't have to think about it anymore.

You can trust it.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/000/181/6a25c0a0041c55e358a7fd91f26d72f1_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780657114&width=680&sig=29jBJ%2BKfto9Ox%2BG8Ey7SxoP5V%2F6Wg3aY805wTU8JDOA%3D)

But strength is only half the story. What about customization?

At Titaner, details are where the fun begins. Even the titanium connector tube—the structural core that joins both sides of the chassis—is available in four distinct mechanical designs. Because if you're building a system around yourself, every detail deserves a choice.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/413/9e03fad62a71dc19dd08ac8563120d6d_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780975243&width=680&sig=rThepKNzj0PLhGWS2JhM0D3OMksk8vWOlKfgmn5Bu8w%3D)

## Risks and challenges

1\. Manufacturing Challenges

Bringing a new product to life on Kickstarter always comes with its share of challenges — from potential production delays to quality control issues. We’re fully aware of these risks and have taken proactive measures to minimize them.

Our team has carried out extensive pre-launch testing and partnered with trusted manufacturers renowned for their precision craftsmanship and reliability. We’ve also established a real-time communication system with our production partners, allowing us to respond swiftly to any unexpected issues and ensure a smooth, uninterrupted workflow.

2\. Fulfillment & Shipping

Timely delivery is essential to a great backer experience. We understand that international logistics, customs processes, and shifting demand can all affect timelines. That’s why we’ve developed a robust fulfillment strategy in advance, working closely with reputable logistics providers to ensure efficient and reliable global delivery.

Backers will receive regular updates throughout every stage — from production to final shipment — along with tracking information once their orders are on the way.

Our Commitment

While every Kickstarter project carries a degree of uncertainty, we are fully committed to delivering exactly what we promise. We’ve laid the groundwork, built dependable partnerships, and are prepared to act quickly and transparently should any challenges arise.

Your trust and satisfaction remain at the core of everything we do.

One System. Yours to Architect.

Everything you carefully choose to wear says something about you—your watch, your ring, your belt, your shoes.

Except one thing. The piece of mass-produced metal sitting at your waist. The row of fixed holes forcing your body to adapt to it. For centuries, it has remained virtually unchanged.

So we decided to tackle something nobody had seriously reimagined before. We weren't interested in making a better belt buckle. We set out to create an entirely new waist-carry system.

Built around three independent layers of engineering, each fully customizable, individually replaceable, and endlessly adaptable.

Interchangeable Faceplates — designed for different moods, different occasions, and different versions of you. Swap them in seconds and give your everyday carry a fresh identity.

A Micro-Adjust Belt System — no holes, no compromises. It responds naturally to every movement and every breath for a fit that moves with you.

The Core Chassis — the foundation of the entire system. Secure, reliable, and engineered to support everything above it.

Each layer stands on its own. Together, they become something greater. You're not simply buying a belt buckle. You're assembling a mechanical companion built around you.

We call it TiVerse. One titanium core. Unlimited possibilities.

Let's be honest. You've been staring at them since the beginning. The faces resting quietly on the chassis.

Each one was created for a different mood, a different occasion, a different side of yourself.

They're not decorations. They're statements.

So—which one are you wearing today?

Your waist is the canvas. TiVerse is the brush.

And changing your look couldn't be easier. No tools. No hassle.

Just one hand, and your style transforms instantly.

Each faceplate is secured by dual N52 neodymium magnets. Their placement is carefully engineered so everyday movement, pressure, or impact won't accidentally release them.

They stay exactly where they belong—until you decide otherwise.

We've designed dozens of faceplates. The three launching today weren't chosen by us alone—they were voted in by the Titaner Discord community.

Got another design you'd love to see? Tell us in the comments.

Note:TiVerse does not include faceplates by default. You can choose your preferred designs and quantities through Add-Ons.

Want to help shape future Titaner products?

Join our Discord community and become part of the process.

And there's one more thing. Inside every faceplate isa writable NFC chip.

Your partner's phone number.

Your office access card.

An anniversary date.

Or anything else that's uniquely yours.

The front is what everyone sees.The NFC chip is what only you know.

Pretty cool already, right? At Titaner, we're rarely finished there.

We're currently developinga flashlight faceplatefor TiVerse. Most of the time, it sits quietly on your belt like any other faceplate. When you need light, remove it, activate it, and it instantly becomes a compact emergency flashlight. Powered by two LR41 button batteries, it delivers approximately1.5 hours of continuous illumination.

It's currently undergoing final testing and will be available soon as an Add-On.

Wondering what they're made from?

G10 composite. The same material trusted for tactical knife handles, firearm grips, and rugged outdoor equipment. Extremely resistant to scratches, impacts, and wear.

And because every sheet develops its own unique texture, no two faceplates are ever exactly alike.

Every day, your fingertips leave behind a little more character.

Three months from now, your faceplate won't just look used. It'll look lived with.

Now It Adjusts to You

People change. Belt holes don't. The moment they're punched at the factory, they're frozen in place forever.For years, you've been the one making compromises.

One hole is too tight. The next is too loose. And somehow, that's just been accepted as normal.

Worse yet, those holes are slowly destroying the belt you carefully chose.

They stretch. They deform. The edges fray and wear down.

A belt that should last decades often fails at the holes first.

At Titaner, we don't believe objects are static.Their value comes from the relationship they build with you.

Something that has been with you for ten years—through ordinary days and unforgettable moments—will always mean more than something brand new in a display case.

That's why we build products meant to stay with you for life.And to do that, they must be able to evolve with you.So we did something simple. We got rid of the holes.

TiVerse uses a hole-free micro-adjustment system. Stop anywhere. Adjust anytime.

It follows your body instead of forcing your body to follow it.

Without holes, the belt can finally focus on doing one thing well:

Moving with you.

No replacing it because your waist changed.

No fighting for the perfect fit.

Just effortless adjustment, day after day.

We re-engineered the entire experience.No holes. No stretching. No gradual loosening. Locked securely at your waist, day after day.

One belt. From day one to year ten. The fit stays the same.

For hundreds of years, belts worked like this: You adapted to them. They wore themselves out.

Now the relationship has changed. It adapts to you.And neither of you has to wear out in the process.

Objects are alive through the stories they share with us.

And from this moment on, that relationship is redefined.

Nothing Falls. Tested in Hell.

The moment happens fast. You stand up from your chair andsuddenly feel your belt loosen.

Everyone knows that feeling. Your face heats up instantly. Your hand shoots toward your waist before you even think about it. For half a second, the entire room seems to freeze.

Even if nobody actually saw it, you're convinced they did. That's not your fault.It's what cheap belt buckles do best—failing exactly when you need them most.

The TiVerse chassis is the backbone of the entire system. Every faceplate attaches to it. Every security mechanism starts here.

So we designed a locking system that'sintentionally harder to trigger by accident.

To release TiVerse,two separate actions must happen at the same time:

Press the latch inward — in a direction that naturally resists accidental contact.

Lift the faceplate upward.

One action alone won't release it.

Not gravity. Not pressure. Not an accidental bump.

We're not here to convince you with a spec sheet.

At Titaner, real-world testing has always been the final authority.

⚠️NoteFor material demonstration purposes only. These tests involve hazardous operations — please don't try this at home.

The mechanical architecture prevents accidental release.

The titanium construction prevents structural failure.

Nothing Falls. Not a slogan. A receipt.

Security isn't just something you know. It's something you feel. The moment TiVerse closes, the hidden mechanism inside the titanium chassis snaps into place with a sharp, satisfying click. That sound isn't just fidget-worthy.

It's reassurance. A quiet but unmistakable confirmation that everything is locked exactly where it should be. From that moment on, you don't have to think about it anymore.

You can trust it.

But strength is only half the story. What about customization?

At Titaner, details are where the fun begins. Even the titanium connector tube—the structural core that joins both sides of the chassis—is available in four distinct mechanical designs. Because if you're building a system around yourself, every detail deserves a choice.

Always On You. Always With You.

You wear it longer than you realize.

You may not think about it when you buckle it on in the morning. But from that moment forward, it's there.

Through meetings.

The drive home.

Every movement throughout your day happens with this small piece of titanium quietly resting at your side.TiVerse moves with every breath you take.

TiVerse has seen every version of you.

The busy days. The important days. The ordinary days.

And perhaps that's what makes it different.It may be the only piece of metal you wear that you never have to worry about.

Day or night. Home or away. Whenever you need it, it's there.

That's why TiVerse includes a dedicated tritium slot. A self-powered micro light source that can glow continuously for up to 25 years without batteries.

In complete darkness, that faint glow at your waist quietly reminds you:

It's still there.

Our Craftsmanship & Materials

Titaner has been building titanium products forover 21 years.

And if there's one manufacturing process we know better than anything else, it'sprecision CNC machining. It's the craft behind every detail of TiVerse.

We approach titanium the same way Michelangelo approached marble. Patiently. Deliberately. Removing everything unnecessary until only the final form remains. Each component spends hours under high-end CNC machines before it ever reaches your hands.

Every edge is fully CNC-chamfered and rounded. To be honest, it's a slow and expensive process that many manufacturers simply skip. But true quality doesn't need to be explained. The moment your thumb glides across the surface, you'll know. The smoothness speaks for itself.

For this campaign, TiVerse is available in two signature Titaner finishes:

TITANER Micro-Milled Finish

TITANER Micro-Blasted Finish

Engineered for a Lifetime.

To us, “engineered for a lifetime” is more than a phrase engraved into metal.It’s a philosophy of growing, evolving, and building together with the people who actually use our products.And this Kickstarter campaign is part of that process.

Our designers don’t work behind closed doors.They build alongside you — our most trusted collaborators and long-time supporters— listening carefully to every idea, suggestion, and real-world experience. Because great products are never created in isolation.

They’re shaped by the people who rely on them every single day.

So speak up. Share your ideas.Tell us what you want to see next.

Together, let’s turn TiVerse into something truly timeless.

projects.ai_intro_en: For centuries, it has remained virtually unchanged. So we decided to tackle something nobody had seriously reimagined before. We weren't interested in making a better belt buckle. We set out to create an entirely new waist-carry system.
ai_highlights_en: A century-quality modular titanium EDC belt buckle — tritium pendant, hole-free, NFC-embedded & LED flashlight faces, fits any scenario
Interchangeable Faceplates — designed for different moods, different occasions, and different versions of you
A Micro-Adjust Belt System — no holes, no compromises
projects.ai_risks_en: Manufacturing Challenges
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Founded in 2005, Titaner is a team of outdoor enthusiasts, industrial designers, and craftsmen dedicated to designing and manufacturing premium titanium products.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Titaner TiVerse is the world's first truly modular EDC belt buckle — a reimagined waist-carry system where three independent, fully customizable layers work together. At its heart is the Core Chassis, a precision-engineered titanium foundation that serves as an unshakeable base. Clamped onto that chassis is a Micro-Adjust Belt System with no holes and no compromises, responding naturally to every movement and breath so the fit genuinely moves with you. Resting on top are the Interchangeable Faceplates — sealed in place by dual N52 neodymium magnets so they stay secure during any challenge, yet can be swapped in seconds with just a single hand.

Each faceplate is built from century-quality materials and houses a writable NFC chip, giving a piece you wear daily a piece of personal history — whether that's a partner's phone number, office access, or an anniversary date. The faces aren't decorations; they're statements. The Discord community voted in the three launch designs, but the platform was built to expand, offering a system that can be shaped by the people who use it.

Engineered for a lifetime and tested for real-world use, this isn't a belt buckle — it's a mechanical companion you assemble around yourself. One titanium core. Unlimited possibilities.
