projects.name: EH-01. A compact experimental sampler synth.
projects.blurb: A compact experimental sampler synth. No menus. No LEDs. No screen. Just control.
projects.html_story:
A compact experimental sampler synth. No menus. No LEDs. No screen. Just control.

A compact experimental sampler synth. No menus. No LEDs. No screen. Just control.

Sampling on EH-01

Built to last. Built to be changed.

EH-01 Browser Studio

Final production appearance

Environmental commitments

Multiple synth systems, SD + memory playback, glitch, loop, morph, record and repeat in a small hands-on instrument built for immediate noise, rhythm and strange little moments.

Built for strange samples, rough textures, glitchy rhythms, vocal tones, noise, loops and fast sound-making. It is designed to be played directly: turn a knob, hit a key, break the sound, record it, move on.

This campaign will fund the first small production run of EH-01.

EH-01 combines a compact sampler, digital synth engine and hands-on effects system in a small desktop instrument. It includes built-in memory sample banks/drum machine, SD sample playback, USB MIDI/audio, internal recording, VOX vocals, waveform shaping, filtering, bitcrushing, delay, reverb, chorus and direct control over the sound.

The goal is immediacy. EH-01 is not built around a screen or menu system. The controls are exposed on the front panel so the instrument can be played, pushed and abused without stopping to scroll through settings.

EH-01 is a throwback to an era before every object needed a screen.

Pocket calculators, cassette futurism, wired headphones, compact communicators, military controls and slightly overbuilt pieces of equipment designed to do one thing well.

Its visual language sits somewhere between punk electronics and low-budget NASA hardware: practical, strange, direct and a little optimistic about the future.

EH-01 is not trying to disappear into an app. It is a physical instrument with exposed controls, visible structure and a clear sense of purpose, something you pick up, plug in and use.

EH-01 grew out of years of small synth experiments, prototype boards, sample engines, handmade enclosures and late-night “what happens if this knob does that?” moments.

I wanted a compact instrument that felt direct and physical, something closer to an object you play than a device you operate. No hidden pages, no touchscreen, no carefully polished preset machine. Just a small box of samples, synthesis, controls, low-latency response and a large audio range.

The result is EH-01: a small experimental synth/sampler designed for quick ideas, odd sounds, rough rhythms, quickly recordable and playable noise.

At the heart of the instrument is a Teensy 4.1, a high-speed 32-bit ARM Cortex-M7 processor running at hundreds of megahertz, paired with a dedicated stereo audio codec for true 44.1 kHz digital audio output.

The platform provides abundant RAM, hardware floating-point processing, native USB MIDI, and high-throughput storage access, allowing multiple synth voices, envelopes, filters, modulation sources, delay, and sample playback to run simultaneously with low latency and a clean 44.1 kHz stereo audio output.

The result is a compact but serious computing core designed to deliver stable, responsive, full-range audio performance without relying on batteries or external sound hardware.

The first run will be built in small batches. Electronics will be assembled, programmed and tested in batches, while cases and knobs will be produced using small-batch moulding processes. If the campaign reaches higher volumes, repeated parts such as knobs, and potentially keycaps, may move to injection moulding to improve consistency and speed up production.

Features include:• 8 playable key buttons• 13 direct hands-on control knobs• Multiple sound engines: synth, memory sampler, SD sampler and VOX/formant voice mode• Built-in memory sample banks• SD card sample playback• Internal recording mode• USB MIDI note and CC control• USB audio output• Stereo audio output for headphones, mixer, interface or powered speakers• Firmware updatable over USB• Batteryless design with no sealed internal battery• Waveform selection with classic and custom digital waveforms• Filter cutoff and resonance• Attack, decay and release controls• LFO, wobble, chaos and modulation controls• Bitcrusher from clean 16-bit down to brutal 2-bit• Delay, reverb, chorus and master EQ• SD hold/latch playback for drones, loops and layered textures• Browser/Web MIDI companion control support• Replaceable knobs, keycaps, switches and hardware where practical

Sampling on EH-01

EH-01 is built aroundhands-on sample playback and manipulation. You can load your own sounds, assign them to the playable keys, then reshape them using the physical controls.

Loading your own samples

The Edgehog Systems website includes a sample editor and uploader designed specifically for the EH-01. Samples can be trimmed, processed and arranged into banks, then transferred directly to the EH-01 over USB.Banks can also be exported manually to the supplied SD card.

The SD card will arrive with factory samples already installed, along with space for your own material.

Depending on the selected mode, those sounds can be:

triggered as one-shots

held and played for their full duration

looped or repeated

filtered and shaped

pitch-shifted or degraded

combined with the synth, noise and effects sections

The controls are immediate and physical. There is no screen-based sample editor and no menu system to navigate while playing.

Built to last. Built to be changed.

The EH-01 is deliberately simple where simplicity matters. There is no sealed internal battery to wear out, swell or become impossible to replace, and no Bluetooth connection adding latency or pairing problems. Power and communication are handled through a reliable wired connection.

The controls use quality Taiwanese potentiometers with solder tabs rather than tiny sealed surface-mount parts. They are firmly mounted, serviceable and replaceable if one is ever damaged. The note keys use proper mechanical switches for a solid feel and long working life.

The enclosure, knobs and keycaps are designed as separate, easily swappable parts. This makes repairs straightforward and gives owners room to customise the EH-01.

After launch, 3D-printable files will be made available for users who want to create their own cases, knobs, caps and accessories. Production EH-01 units are planned to use professionally finished moulded or cast components, with no visible 3D-printed parts in the final product.

For advanced users, accessible circuit pads provide a starting point for hardware modifications, external controls and experimental expansion. These are intended for people who understand what they are doing.. and accept the consequences.

EH-01 will be available in the original grey/white/yellow colourway and a black edition. You do not need to choose your colour when pledging. Colour selection will be collected after the campaign through the backer survey or pledge manager.

EH-01 Browser Studio

The EH-01 includes a set of local browser tools that work together as a lightweight audio studio. No installation or account is required—connect the EH-01 by USB and open the tool you need.

MIDI Consoleexpands the hardware into a full control surface and sequencer. Adjust every section of the EH-01, trigger notes, build 16 or 32-step patterns, automate controls, store presets and arrange patterns into longer sequences.

Sample Builderis used to record, import, trim and shape sounds before loading them into the EH-01.Build complete eight-sample banks, audition them over MIDI, then transfer them directly by USB or export them to the SD card.

Tapeis a simple multitrack recorder and arrangement workspace. Record the EH-01 or another audio input, import clips, move and trim recordings across tracks, add fades and crossfades, then save the project or export the finished mix.

Each section runs independently in the browser, with navigation between the tools and the main EH-01 website.

Try the browser studio tools here.Only officially supported for Chrome and Edge desktop.https://edgehogsystems.com/EH01_MIDI_Console.htmlhttps://edgehogsystems.com/EH01_Sample_Builder.htmlhttps://edgehogsystems.com/EH01_Tape.html

Final production appearance

The EH-01 units shown in campaign photos are working prototypes and representative of the planned production version.

Final production units may include minor changes to colour tone, surface finish, knob shape, keycap style, button colour, printed markings or small enclosure details as the design is prepared for manufacturing.

The control layout, core functions and overall character of the instrument will remain the same. Any changes will be made to improve durability, consistency, usability or production quality.

Because EH-01 will be produced in small batches, slight cosmetic variation may also occur between individual units.

All sounds in our videos (besides voice-over) were made using the EH-01 and browser studio.

Risks and challenges

EH-01 has working prototypes, tested firmware and a planned production process, but this is still the first production run of a hardware product. The main risks are parts delays, small-batch case and knob production, scaling the build process, quality control, firmware refinement, and international shipping delays.

The production plan is based around batch assembly. Electronics will be assembled, programmed and tested in groups, while enclosures and knobs will be produced using small-batch moulding processes. If the campaign reaches higher volumes, some repeated parts such as knobs, and potentially keycaps, may move to injection moulding to improve consistency and speed up production.

There may be small cosmetic variations between units, especially in cast or small-batch parts. These variations will not affect the function of the instrument, and parts that do not meet the required standard will be rejected during quality control.

Small-batch production may result in minor cosmetic variation between units. Final colours, textures, knobs, keycaps, buttons and printed details may differ slightly from prototype photography, but these changes will not alter the core control layout or function of the instrument.

Firmware is already working on the prototypes, but small refinements, bug fixes and improvements may continue during production. EH-01 is designed to be firmware-updatable over USB, so updates can also be released after fulfilment if needed.

Shipping will be charged after the campaign through Kickstarter Pledge Manager. International shipping from Australia can be affected by postage costs, customs processing and delays outside my control. I will provide estimated shipping ranges before launch and keep backers updated if anything changes.

The goal is to keep the project realistic, focused and transparent. If delays or problems come up, I will communicate them clearly through project updates rather than pretending everything is fine while the workshop quietly catches fire.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

EH-01 is designed as a long-lasting, robust repairable instrument rather than a sealed disposable device. It does not rely on an internal battery, reducing battery waste and avoiding a common failure point. The design uses standard mechanical controls, replaceable switches, knobs, keycaps and fasteners where practical, and the firmware can be updated over USB so the instrument can continue to improve after manufacture. The enclosure and hardware are designed for service access, repair and small-part replacement rather than replacement of the whole unit.

Reusability and recyclability

EH-01 will use minimal, mostly recyclable packaging such as cardboard mailers/boxes and paper-based inserts where practical. The product is designed to avoid disposable batteries and uses replaceable external cables rather than sealed-in consumables. Small parts such as knobs, keycaps, switches and fasteners are designed to be replaceable, helping keep the unit in use rather than sending the whole product to landfill if one part wears out or is damaged. I will also keep spare parts available where practical.

Sustainable materials

Where practical, I will use recyclable cardboard packaging, paper-based inserts and minimal plastic packaging. The product is designed as a small-batch durable object rather than a disposable device, with reusable moulding processes for the enclosure and replaceable hardware components.

projects.ai_description_en:
The EH-01 is a compact experimental sampler synth built for those who crave immediacy and physicality in their sound design. Rejecting the modern reliance on menus, LEDs, and screens, this instrument offers a throwback to an era of direct, unmediated control. Drawing aesthetic inspiration from punk electronics, cassette futurism, and low-budget NASA hardware, the EH-01 is designed to be pushed and abused without stopping to scroll through settings. It’s a physical object you pick up and play, exposing its controls on the front panel to foster quick ideas, odd sounds, and rough rhythms.

Functionally, the EH-01 combines a compact sampler, a digital synth engine, and an extensive hands-on effects system into a small desktop instrument. It is built for strange samples, glitchy rhythms, vocal tones, and noise, providing multiple synth systems alongside SD and memory playback. Users can engage in glitch, loop, morph, record, and repeat functionalities, manipulating sound directly through VOX vocals, waveform shaping, filtering, bitcrushing, delay, reverb, and chorus. It features a built-in memory sample bank/drum machine and internal recording, ensuring everything you create can be captured instantly.

At the core of this hands-on powerhouse is a Teensy 4.1, powered by a high-speed 32-bit ARM Cortex-M7 processor running at hundreds of megahertz. It features a dedicated stereo audio codec for true 44.1 kHz digital audio output. This robust platform provides abundant RAM, hardware floating-point processing, native USB MIDI, and high-throughput storage access, supporting multiple synth voices with low-latency response and a massive audio range.

Ultimately, the EH-01 stands out because it refuses to disappear into an app. It is not a carefully polished preset machine, but a slightly overbuilt piece of equipment designed to do one thing well: make strange little moments happen. Designed to be firmware-updatable over USB, its capabilities can continue to evolve even after fulfillment. Whether you are breaking a sound or forging a rhythm, the EH-01 delivers a rare, direct connection to the music-making process.

projects.html_story:

MEET AMKOV GO1 Detachable Kids Print Camera

2-In-1 Detachable Design

Print Smarter, Save More

Colorful DIY Prints

Built For Creative Focus

All-Day Battery

Fun Details Kids Will Love

Every parent wants their child to spend less time in front of screens—and more time exploring, observing, and creating.So you buy them a print camera.But the reality is often different:

That's why we decided to rethink the kids' print camera from the ground up.Instead of forcing photography and printing into a single device, we separated them.The result is the AMKOV G01 — the world's first detachable kids print camera.Not just another camera that prints.A new way for kids to create.Children can focus on capturing moments first, then choose and print only the photos they truly love later.Less weight. Less waste. More creativity. More freedom. More time enjoying the moment.Shoot first. Print later. Create better.

MEET AMKOV GO1 Detachable Kids Print Camera

2-In-1 Detachable Design

A revolutionary 2-in-1 camera system that separates photography from printing—helping kids stay focused on creativity while reducing weight, waste, and distractions.

At just70g—lighter than an egg—the detachable camera is designed specifically for young creators. Lightweight enough for all-day adventures, it's comfortable to wear, easy for small hands to hold, and won't weigh kids down during play.

With less bulk and more freedom, children can move naturally, explore confidently, and stay focused on capturing the moments that matter.

When playtime is over, simply reconnect the camera to the printing dock.Kids can review their photos, pick their favorites, and print only the memories they truly want to keep.By separating shooting from printing, G01 reduces waste, saves paper, and lets children stay fully focused on capturing the moment.

The printing dock houses a1300mAh high-capacity battery. Once connected, it automatically charges the camera—one device, two functions. No extra power bank needed, just uninterrupted fun wherever you go.

Print Smarter, Save More

Traditional print cameras: shoot → print → waste.

With AMKOV G01, kids can shoot → select → print. By previewing photos before printing, families save paper, reduce unnecessary prints, and let children choose the photos they love. Kids learn to enjoy the process of creating and sharing, printing only the moments they want to keep.

Colorful DIY Prints

Using ink-free thermal printing, kids can print photos instantly without ink or toner.Choose from black, red, or blue thermal paper, then customize each print with drawings, notes, and colors. Every photo becomes a canvas for creativity and self-expression.

Built For Creative Focus

By separating shooting and printing, kids can fully immerse themselves in exploration.With 48MP photos, they can focus on interesting angles, exploring their surroundings, telling stories, and expressing creativity.

All-Day Battery

Designed for a full day of exploration.The camera features a 600mAh battery, and the printing dock holds 1300mAh.On a single charge, you can print up to500 photos, capturing parties, family moments, vacations, and everyday adventures without worrying about running out of power.

Fun Details Kids Will Love

G01 lets kids record1080p full HD videos, capturing movement, action, and everyday adventures. From playground slides to family games, every moment comes alive in vivid detail.

Theflip-up lenslets kids see themselves while framing shots, so they can take selfies and group photos without asking for help. Perfect for family moments and creative videos, it empowers children to create independently and build confidence.

The1.8-inch IPS screengives kids a clear, bright view of their photos and videos, making framing, reviewing, and selecting shots simple and fun.

Attach G01 to playground equipment, railings, refrigerators, and other metal surfaces for hands-free shooting. Kids can capture unique perspectives, record their adventures, andcreate hands-free.

Full-edge silicone protection.Available in Pink or Blue. Built for everyday drops.

G01 features an intuitive three-button layout that even 3-year-olds can master in minutes. With built-in safeguards to prevent accidental exits, kids can focus on capturing moments without confusion or frustration.

It is both a 1080P 2.7K mini camera you can wear, and a CCD-style compactcamera with a flip screen.It captures smooth hands-free 1080p POV video as youmove naturally.Snap the mini camera into the custom-designed base, and it instantlytransforms. The base features a precision magnetic dock and USB-C connectorthat align automatically, locking securely in just one second with a satisfying click.All in one device.

At Amkov, we are dedicated to redefining the art of photography and videography through cutting-edge technology and exceptional craftsmanship.Our mission is to empower creators, photographers, and content professionals with tools that combine innovation, performance, and elegance. Each of our products is meticulously engineered to deliver unrivaled precision, versatility, and ease of use, enabling you to capture your world with unparalleled clarity and creativity. With a commitment to excellence, Amkov continues to lead the way in providing seamless, intuitive solutions for visual storytelling, wherever inspiration strikes.

Risks and challenges

With our collective experience in product development, manufacturing, and supplier development, we are confident that we can deliver outstanding products.
Rest assured that we will guarantee final delivery to every backer in this campaign. However, potential delays may arise due to unexpected factors. Please note that we have proven partners in production and logistics. We promise to keep our backers informed throughout the campaign in a completely transparent way about production and shipping. projects.ai_intro_en: The AMKOV G01 is the world's first detachable kids print camera, weighing just 70g—lighter than an egg. Kids can shoot first, then reconnect to the printing dock to select and print only their favorite photos, saving up to 70% on printing paper while staying creative and screen-free.
ai_highlights_en: 2-in-1 detachable design: 70g camera separates from printing dock for lightweight, all-day shooting
Print smarter: Preview and select photos before printing to save up to 70% on paper waste
Creative focus: 48MP photos, 1080p video, flip-up selfie lens, and colorful DIY thermal prints
projects.ai_risks_en: This is an all-or-nothing campaign with a funding deadline of July 30, 2026. While the creators cite experience in product development and manufacturing, common crowdfunding risks such as production delays, supply chain issues, or quality control challenges are not explicitly addressed.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Amkov is a technology company dedicated to redefining photography and videography through cutting-edge innovation, empowering creators with high-performance tools for visual storytelling.
projects.ai_description_en:
The AMKOV G01 is the world's first detachable kids print camera, built around a simple but powerful idea: shoot first, print later. Instead of forcing photography and printing into a single bulky device, the G01 separates the two functions—letting kids focus entirely on capturing moments while exploring, free from distractions. At just 70 grams, the camera body is lighter than an egg, designed for small hands and all-day adventures. The result is a creative tool that reduces waste, saves up to 70% on printing paper, and keeps children engaged in the real world rather than staring at screens.

The detachable camera features 48MP photos and 1080p full HD video recording, along with a 1.8-inch IPS screen for clear framing and review. A built-in flip-up lens lets kids take selfies and group photos independently, building confidence and creative ownership. The camera runs on a 600mAh battery for extended playtime, while the companion printing dock packs a 1300mAh high-capacity battery capable of printing up to 500 photos on a single charge. When the camera reconnects to the dock, it automatically charges—no extra power bank needed, just uninterrupted fun wherever the day takes you.

Printing is where the G01 truly shines. Using ink-free thermal paper, kids can print instantly without ink or toner, choosing from black, red, or blue paper to match their mood or message. Each print becomes a canvas for DIY customization—drawings, notes, and personal touches turn photos into one-of-a-kind keepsakes. By letting children select and print only their favorite shots, the G01 teaches mindful creativity and reduces unnecessary paper waste. Whether attached to playground equipment, railings, or used handheld, the AMKOV G01 empowers kids to explore, observe, and create on their own terms.

But love shouldn't mean living with chaos.

Why Existing Solutions Fall Short

There are plenty of ways to manage pets at home — but most only solve part of the problem. Physical barriers can block movement, but they take up space and affect the appearance of your home. Underground fences require installation, wiring, and ongoing maintenance. Repellent sprays can be messy and inconsistent. Traditional dog trainers can help correct unwanted behaviors, but they can't protect specific spaces. Pet owners often end up buying multiple products just to solve one problem.

What is Bounda?

The All-in-One Wireless Pet Boundary & Training System

Bounda is more than a traditional pet barrier. It's a wireless pet boundary and training system designed to help pet owners manage both space and behavior with a single device. Simply place a transmitter near the area you want to protect. When your pet enters the boundary, the receiver collar provides a gentle correction to help them learn where they should and shouldn't go. Keep pets away from kitchens, nurseries, furniture, doorways, and other restricted areas—without walls, wires, or complicated installation. And unlike traditional pet barriers, Bounda also includes a built-in training function to help correct behaviors such as barking, chasing, and resource guarding.

Kitchen/Trash Can Guardian

Place the Bounda transmitter next to the trash can or at the kitchen doorway, setting a coverage radius. Your dog will no longer be able to rummage through drawers and cabinets. Coming home will no longer be a "battlefield."

Living Room Sofa/Furniture Protection

Place the Bounda next to the sofa or under the coffee table. Your cat will no longer jump onto the sofa and leave scratches, and your dog will no longer leave muddy paw prints on your new carpet.

Nursery/Hazardous Area Isolation

This is essential for families with babies—place the transmitter at the nursery doorway to prevent pets from approaching the crib. Two kinds of love, without disturbing each other.

Patio/Garden Outdoor Protection

Switch to the 5-8 level wide radius mode to cover the entire garden. Your dog can play freely in the yard without running onto the road. IP67 waterproof, it's safe even in heavy rain.

Dog Training mode

Dog Training Mode

Besides setting restricted areas, the remote control can also be used directly as a dog training device—when your dog barks excessively, guards its food or toys, or chases cars or people, pressing the remote will emit sound/vibration/static correction signals. Unlike traditional dog training devices, you don't need to purchase a second set of equipment—the F620 already provides that.

Unlimited scalability with muliti-zone protection for the entire home

Place multiple transmitters around your home – kitchen, nursery, front door, garden. Each creates its own invisible boundary. Protect every room, every entrance, every corner your pet shouldn’t enter. Unlimited scalability. No pairing needed. Just plug and protect.

Only 51 grams. So light, your cat will forget they’re wearing it.

51g lightweight receiver for cats & small/medium dogs. Adjustable collar fits 12–73cm (Teddy, French Bulldog). Smart sleep mode saves power, giving up to 72h battery life for all-day comfort.

IP67 Waterproof

IP67 Waterproof

Rain or Shine, It Just WorksBoth the collar receiver and the transmitter are rated IP67.That means they can withstand powerful water jets – not just light rain, but heavy downpours, garden sprinklers, and even an accidental splash from a hose.

Easy to Operate

Minimalist and Easy to Use — Ready Right Out of the Box

Setup in 10 mins – no pairing, no app. Open box → place transmitter → collar on → power on. A/B channels for different pets. 6 range levels & 3 modes (beep/vibration/static) – all on device.

Risks and challenges

Bounda – Risks and Challenges
As with any hardware project, we want to be transparent about the potential risks and our plans to overcome them.

1. Manufacturing and Component Sourcing
Bounda uses dual‑band LF + 2.4G modules, IPX6‑rated housings, and rechargeable batteries. Global supply chains can be unpredictable.
Mitigation: We have secured secondary suppliers for key components and buffer stock for the first production run. Our factory partner has 8+ years of experience in pet electronics and maintains a 98% on‑time delivery record.

2. Firmware and Calibration
The product’s accuracy depends on proper calibration of signal strength and boundary detection. In rare cases, environmental interference (e.g., metal structures, home appliances) may affect performance.
Mitigation: We will provide a detailed troubleshooting guide and video tutorials. All units undergo 100% factory calibration before shipping, and we offer free firmware updates (if needed) via a simple USB connection.

3. Shipping and Fulfillment
Delays in international shipping or customs clearance could push delivery beyond August.
Mitigation: We have already booked air and sea freight capacity. Backers will receive tracking information and real‑time updates. We also keep a 15% safety stock for lost or damaged parcels.

4. User Education
Some backers may find the concept of “invisible boundary” unfamiliar and need time to train their pets.
Mitigation: We will include an illustrated quick start guide, video tutorials, and 24/7 email support. A dedicated FAQ section on our website will also address common setup issues.

5. Kickstarter Specifics
If the campaign does not reach its goal (though we are already over 100% funded for our previous projects), or if unforeseen costs arise.
Mitigation: We have a backup budget from our successful WILL campaign. Bounda shares components with our existing products, reducing engineering risk.

We are committed to full transparency and will post regular updates on production, testing, and shipping. Your trust is our priority.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We believe the greenest product is the one you don’t have to replace. That’s why Bounda is built to last from the very first sketch.

1. Modular, repairable design
The receiver collar uses a replaceable battery – users can swap it with standard tools. Common wear parts (housing, charging port) are also available as spare parts, so you never need to throw away a full unit.

2. No subscription, no planned obsolescence
Bounda runs entirely offline. No app dependency, no cloud services that can be shut down. Years from now, your device will work exactly as it does today – no forced upgrades.

3. Rugged materials + IPX6 waterproof
The housing is made of UV‑resistant engineering plastic. IPX6 rating means rain, sprinklers, or muddy puddles won’t cause early failure. It’s built for real outdoor life.

We are committed to making Bounda a product you can fix, keep, and trust – not another piece of e‑waste.

Reusability and recyclability

We take a proactive approach to reducing waste

1. Recycled and minimal packaging
All boxes are made from FSC‑certified recycled cardboard. We avoid plastic inserts; instead, we use molded pulp trays (made from recycled newspapers) to hold the transmitter, collar, and accessories. The user manual is printed on recycled paper with soy‑based ink.

2. Bulk shipment to fulfillment centers
Instead of individually wrapping each unit in plastic, we ship products in bulk cartons to our regional warehouses. This reduces single‑use plastic waste by over 60% compared to traditional e‑commerce packaging.

Sustainable materials

We use recycled ABS for the transmitter and collar housing, reducing virgin plastic use. The collar strap is made from GRS‑certified recycled polyester. Packaging uses FSC‑certified recycled cardboard and molded pulp trays. No PVC, no foam, and no single‑use plastics.

Environmentally friendly factories

We manufacture in our own factory, which meets strict 6S standards (Sort, Set, Shine, Standardize, Sustain, Safety). This gives us full control over quality, working conditions, and environmental practices – from material sourcing to assembly and waste management. No outsourcing, no compromise.

Sustainable Distribution

Because we control production in our own 6S factory, sustainable choices (recycled materials, minimal packaging) are already built into our process – no extra lead time. Bulk shipping to regional hubs reduces waste and actually speeds up fulfillment. Sustainability and on‑time delivery go hand in hand for us.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Through market research, I kept seeing the same struggle: “I love my dog, but how do I keep him off the couch, out of the nursery, or away from the trash?” Physical fences are ugly. Buried wires are a hassle. Monthly fees add up.
projects.ai_description_en:
Bounda is a wireless pet boundary and training system that replaces physical fences, shock mats, and repellent sprays with an invisible barrier. Designed to solve two common challenges at once, it protects the spaces that matter—like kitchens, nurseries, doorways, and trash cans—while gently correcting unwanted behaviors such as escaping, food guarding, or chasing. The system is built around a simple transmitter placed near the area you want to keep off-limits. When your pet wearing the receiver collar enters the boundary, the collar delivers a gentle correction, helping them learn where they should and shouldn’t go—no wires, no installation, and no unsightly barriers.

The hardware is engineered for real-world pet ownership. The collar and transmitter both feature IP67 waterproofing, so they can be used indoors or outdoors regardless of weather. An advanced dual-band LF + 2.4G module ensures stable, accurate boundary detection that’s less affected by household metal structures or appliances. Rechargeable batteries power the receiver, and setup is straightforward with no complex calibration—the unit undergoes 100% factory calibration before shipping. Included in the Bounda Standard set are a Wireless Boundary Transmitter, a Remote Trainer for additional behavioral training, and a light-equipped collar for nighttime visibility.

Bounda matters because it consolidates what used to require multiple products into one compact, elegant device. Pet owners no longer need to choose between safeguarding their home and training their pets—the system delivers both simultaneously. The invisible boundary keeps rooms clean, furnishings intact, and pets safe from dangerous zones, while the training function reinforces good habits. Easy to operate, energy-efficient, and backed by spare kits for extended coverage, Bounda is an all-in-one solution that transforms how you manage your pet’s environment, any corner of your home, any indoor or outdoor space.

What's in the Box?

The First Multi-Modal AI That Helps You Understand Your Dog’s Emotions.Dogs don’t communicate through barks alone.They express emotions through sound, movement, expression, and behavior.EAR-BUS A12 combines all of these signals to help you understand what your dog is really feeling.Not just listening. Seeing. Understanding. Connecting.

OUR BREAKTHROUGH EAR-BUS A12 Understands the Whole Picture.

We built the first Multi-Modal AI system designed specifically for dog emotion understanding.Instead of guessing from one bark, A12 analyzes:

Sound (barks, whines, growls)

Facial expressions

Behavioral patterns

Environmental context

A more complete and accurate understanding of your dog’s emotional state.

Upload a photo and A12 analyzes facial expressions, posture, and visual cues to understand your dog's emotions.

Video unlocks the full story.A12 analyzes movement, vocalizations, expressions, and context to detect emotional changes over time.

Captures and analyzes your dog's vocalizations in real time to detect emotional patterns.

Your Personal AlDog Expert

Built-in Al assistant specialized in dog behavior and wellness. In any pet‑related scenario, you can chat with the A12 AI agent via text or voice. Ask anything—from “Why does my dog keep licking his paw?” to “How to calm separation anxiety?”—and get thoughtful, science‑based answers.

Smart Comfort Musicfor Dogs

The A12 doesn’t just translate—it comforts. When it detects a specific emotion, it automatically plays music designed for that mood. Available on both the device and your phone.

PS：No manual intervention required. A12 automatically provides emotional support when your dog needs it most.

BUILT ON REALDOG DATA

The A12’s AI translation model is trained on sound data from the 20 most common dog breeds worldwide, allowing it to understand how different dogs express themselves in various situations.

Continuously learning from real-world canine vocalizations, A12 evolves to better understand what your dog is feeling—from excitement and happiness to hunger, anxiety, and alertness—helping transform everyday barks into meaningful emotional insights and deeper companionship.

PS: The system prioritizes identifying emotional states and behavioral intentions rather than producing literal word-for-word translations.

Unlimited Translations No Subscription Required

Many pet translation apps charge per translation or require ongoing subscriptions.The A12 is different. Once you own the device, you get unlimited bark translations—no per-use fees and no subscriptions. Simply turn it on, and it’s ready to interpret your dog’s sounds anytime.

Communication with your dog should feel natural and free, without limits or extra costs.

High-Fidelity Audio Hardware

To capture your dog’s full vocal range—from 1,120 Hz to 20 kHz—the A12 is equipped with high-performance acoustic hardware. Under normal conditions, it can pick up barks from up to 10 meters away, ensuring even the subtlest emotional changes are never missed.

Adorable Pet-Style Design

The A12 features a cute, pet-inspired design, with a rounded body and adorable ear-shaped details—making it feel like a little companion by your side.With its soft colors and clean look, it’s more than just a smart device. It’s also a charming desktop decor piece that brings a warm, relaxing touch to your desk, bedside, or living room. To complete the design, the A12 charging dock is shaped like a mini doghouse, giving the device a little home of its own.The dock features a built-in RGB ambient lighting system, with red, green, and blue gradient effects and a soft breathing light that creates a warm, relaxing atmosphere.

Long Battery Life

The A12 is powered by a built-in1000mAh battery, deliveringup to 24 hours of continuous use. Whether at home or on the go, you won’t have to worry about running out of power.

With the included 2-in-1 charging dock, simply place the device in to start charging. It supports 5V / 1.5A fast charging and reaches afull charge in about 1.5 hourswhile keeping your desk clean and organized.

projects.ai_intro_en: The EAR-BUS A12 is a multi-modal AI device designed to understand your dog's emotions by analyzing sound, facial expressions, behavioral patterns, and environmental context. It provides unlimited bark translations with no subscription required and automatically plays comfort music based on your dog's emotional state. Featuring a cute pet-style design with an RGB doghouse dock, it also includes a built-in AI assistant for dog behavior and wellness advice.
ai_highlights_en: Multi-modal AI analyzes sound, expressions, and behavior to understand dog emotions with 85% accuracy.
Unlimited translations with no subscription required, plus automatic comfort music for your dog.
Adorable pet-style design with an RGB doghouse charging dock and 24-hour battery life.
projects.ai_risks_en: Potential challenges include slight delivery delays due to supply chain disruptions for specialized components or unexpected production bottlenecks. The company commits to promptly syncing any updates on production progress and delivery schedules to all backers.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Shenzhen EAR-BUS Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2019, is a tech startup specializing in TWS earphones, audio equipment, smart wearables, and digital electronics, supported by a 25-member R&D team.
projects.ai_description_en:
The EAR-BUS A12 is the world’s first multi-modal AI system designed to decode your dog’s emotions, bridging the communication gap between humans and their furry companions. Dogs express themselves through more than sound—they use movement, facial expressions, and environmental context. Instead of guessing from a single bark, the A12 analyzes the whole picture, combining audio, visual cues, and behavioral patterns to deliver 85% accuracy across 16 emotional categories. This isn't about literal word-for-word translation; it’s about decoding emotional states and behavioral intentions to foster a deeper, more empathetic connection.

The A12 leverages advanced AI to interpret your dog's feelings immediately. Upload a photo to analyze facial expressions and posture, or use video to track emotional changes over time. Its high-fidelity audio hardware captures your dog’s full vocal range from 1,120 Hz to 20 kHz from up to 10 meters away. Beyond translation, A12 acts as a personal AI dog expert, offering science-based text or voice answers to wellness questions—like how to calm separation anxiety. It even provides automatic emotional support by playing smart comfort music calibrated to your dog's current mood, requiring no manual interaction.

At its core is robust, real-world dog data. Trained on 160,000 minutes of sound data from the 20 most common breeds, the AI continuously learns to better recognize emotions ranging from excitement to alertness. Unlike other pet translation apps, the A12 offers unlimited translations with no subscription requirements or per-use fees. Once you own the device, it is ready to interpret your dog’s sounds anytime, ensuring that communication feels natural and entirely free.

The A12 features a cute, pet-inspired design with rounded bodies and adorable ear-shaped details, doubling as charming desktop decor. The charging dock is shaped like a mini doghouse with an RGB ambient lighting system featuring soft breathing effects. Powered by a 1000mAh battery, the device delivers 24 hours of continuous use and reaches a full charge in just 1.5 hours via 5V/1.5A fast charging in its 2-in-1 dock.

projects.blurb: World's First Desktop DAC/Headphone Amplifier with an Operating System
projects.html_story:
All or nothing.This project will only be funded if it reaches its goal by Sat, July 25 2026 7:58 AM EDT.

World's First Desktop DAC/Headphone Amplifier with an Operating System

World's First Desktop DAC/Headphone Amplifier with an Operating System

All or nothing.This project will only be funded if it reaches its goal by Sat, July 25 2026 7:58 AM EDT.

1.Why a DAC/AMP OS?

The MUSE HiFi M300 was designed for today’s streaming era. Unlike Android-based players, it eliminates the need to manage multiple apps and files. High-quality HiFi has never been this accessible.

2.The Challenge

Unlike Android-based players, DAC/amps run on MCU hardware, so the M300’s operating system was built from scratch. It uses precise algorithms to manage complex operations reliably, ensuring high-quality, stable audio. This is why a dedicated DAC/amp OS didn’t exist before.

· Balanced:Neutral and accurate, perfect for classical music and monitoring.

· Tube Amplifier:Warm and full-bodied, ideal for pop and jazz with rich harmonics.

· ACG:Transparent and lively, tailored for anime songs and game soundtracks.

Why Hardware Tuning Matters

Unlike digital EQ, which can introduce phase shifts and unnatural tones, the M300 shapes sound through physical circuits. This preserves dynamics, tonal richness, and precise transients for consistent, immersive audio that digital processing can’t match.

· Lossless Signal Path:Full dynamic preservation without digital artifacts.

· True Analog Character:Tubes, transistors, and high-quality components add warmth and natural harmonics.

· Ultimate Detail:Analog circuits preserve fine details and fast transients for a lifelike listening experience.

To help every user find a visual style that matches their aesthetic, we've designed three independent UI themes:

Cyberpunk: Neon lights and a high-tech feel, perfect for gaming-focused desktop setups.

Minimalist: Clean, understated, and refined—blends seamlessly into modern home and office environments.

ACG Style: Bright and lively, with a playful anime vibe that showcases personality and passion.

You can freely switch between interface themes based on your home décor, desktop style, or even your mood of the day.

Traditional HiFi equipment can be intimidating, with complex buttons and menus. The MUSE 300 makes it easy. One button powers on/off, switches modes, adjusts volume, and selects inputs. No learning curve. Anyone can master it in seconds.

MUSE OS: Born for Music Lovers, Built for DAC/Amps

The MUSE HiFi team are music lovers first. We love the convenience of streaming, millions of tracks at your fingertips, but noticed a gap in the HiFi market. Most DAC/headphone players run on Android, which is powerful but not designed for audio. Complex menus, uncontrollable latency, and background processes make it heavy and cumbersome.

After three years, we created MUSE OS, an operating system built from the ground up for DAC/amps on MCU hardware. Simple to use, power on, press play, but incredibly sophisticated behind the scenes, integrating over 200 MCU interfaces for pure, high-quality audio.

MUSE OS connects directly to streaming platforms, eliminating tedious file downloads. Our goal is to make HiFi simple, accessible, and part of everyday life.

Founded in 2022, Musehifi has rapidly risen in the audio world with its signature tube-infused warm sound. Combining in-house R&D, exclusive tube resources, and a powerful supply chain, the brand delivers exceptional value and competitive pricing. Its portable DAC/Amps have earned global acclaim from influencers and strong partnerships with top distributors worldwide.

Brand Development

Musehifi – A Brief History

Founded in 2022, Musehifi has quickly built a distinct identity in portable audio.

2022 – The BeginningFirst model: M1 – a feature-rich portable DAC/Bluetooth device known for multiple output options and clean, noise-free sound.

2023 – Refining the SoundM3 and M3II – improved clarity, detail, dynamics, and mid-range vocal performance.

2024 – Technical EvolutionM4 and M5 Ultra – continued advancing the brand's engineering and sound quality.

2025 – The Mature SignatureM6 Double – tube mode delivers richer, thicker sound texture with a wide, solid soundstage, marking the maturity of Musehif's sonic identity.

Musehifi Product Lineup

Musehifi offers a well-structured product portfolio covering everything from portable to desktop audio.

M Series – Portable DAC/Amps (Core Lineup)Includes M1, M3, M3II, M4, M5 Ultra, and M6 Double.Coming soon: M3 Ultra and M7 Player.

U Series – DAC/Amps with Dedicated OSUpcoming models: U3 and U7.

S Series – SpeakersMore details to come.

E Series – EarphonesMore details to come.

Muse Series – Desktop DAC/AmpsComing soon: Muse 300 and Muse 600.

Risks and challenges

Before launching our project on Kickstarter, we've already sourced our suppliers and parts and have made a trial manufacturing run. We went through multiple rounds of manufacturing feedback with our partners and built a detailed schedule. Most of the work of preparation production such as connecting the factory and the suppliers has been done. We have produced some samples to test. Once we start mass production (after the campaign), We feel confident in saying that we are very capable of executing whatever it takes to run a successful campaign, and most importantly, to deliver the product on time.

We are excited about delivering our new products to our backers, and we will be completely engaged with our supporters during this process with full transparency. Any updates will be relayed in a timely manner, and we are open to any feedback or questions that arise along the way.

projects.ai_description_en:
The MUSE HiFi M300 is the world's first desktop DAC and headphone amplifier powered by a dedicated operating system—MUSE OS. Unlike conventional DAC/amps that rely on Android-based platforms not optimized for audio playback, this operating system was built from scratch on MCU hardware, requiring over 200 custom audio-focused interfaces to ensure stable, high-quality sound. Designed specifically for today's streaming era, the M300 eliminates app management and file downloads by connecting directly to streaming platforms, delivering millions of tracks through a streamlined, purpose-built interface that removes the complexity and latency of traditional Android players.

What sets the M300 apart is its approach to sound shaping through hardware-based tuning rather than digital EQ. Digital equalization often introduces phase shifts and unnatural tonal artifacts, but the MUSE 300 employs physical analog circuits—tubes, transistors, and precision components—to sculpt your listening experience. This preserves full dynamic range, maintains fine detail in fast transients, and delivers true analog warmth that digital processing cannot replicate. Users can switch between three distinct sound signatures: Balanced mode for neutral, accurate playback suited to classical music and studio monitoring; Tube mode offering warm, full-bodied harmonics ideal for pop and jazz; and ACG mode delivering transparent, lively performance tailored for anime soundtracks and game audio.

Recognizing that high-end audio equipment can intimidate newcomers, Musehifi designed the M300 around one-button operation—power on/off, mode selection, volume input switching, and source selection all through a single intuitive control. The interface itself offers three customizable UI themes (Cyberpunk, Minimalist, and ACG Style) to match any desktop setup or personal aesthetic. With a pledge price of approximately $375 (HK$2,936) and free worldwide shipping backed by successful pre-production trials and established supplier relationships, the MUSE 300 represents a significant accessibility milestone: sophisticated, reference-quality audio that is genuinely approachable for everyday listeners.

ZENCH True 45W Cordless Ultrasonic Cutter

Not every “45W” cutter delivers true 45W performance.

ZENCH is engineered for true 45W continuous output, up to 50W peak power, and 40kHz ultrasonic precision — powered by a larger custom lithium battery system built for real-world cutting.

FCC and CE compliance documentation has been completed for added confidence.

Cleaner cuts. Better control. Real power makers can feel.

Built for Real Cutting PowerStable output. Cleaner control. Longer sessions.

Cut More Materials. Make More Possible

Real projects use more than one material.With true 45W ultrasonic power and 40kHz precision, ZENCH helps makers cut, trim, shape, and detail 3D printed parts, resin, PVC, acrylic, leather, PCB, EVA, wood, and more — with cleaner control and less cutting resistance.

Cordless Freedom. Plug-In Endurance

Use ZENCH cordless for detailed handheld work, or plug in with USB-C direct power for longer cutting sessions. With dual power support, you can keep working without being limited to battery-only operation.

Move freely. Plug in anytime. Keep cutting.

Precision for Real Making

True 45W Power. 40kHz Precision Cutting

ZENCH combines true 45W output with 40kHz ultrasonic vibration to create fast micro-cuts with less resistance. AI auto frequency tracking helps maintain stable performance as materials, pressure, and cutting conditions change.

Real power you can feel. Cleaner cuts you can see.

Fast Charging. Safer Battery Control

ZENCH supports both USB-C fast charging and dock fast charging, so you can power up quickly, charge a spare battery, and get back to cutting with less waiting.

The built-in battery safety lock keeps the battery securely connected during use, storage, and transport.

Stay Cool. Cut Longer

Less heat. More stability. Better cutting performance.

Engineered From the Inside Out

True 45W performance starts with the right internal architecture. ZENCH uses a larger custom lithium battery module — rather than a small standard cell layout — to help deliver stable true 45W continuous output and up to 50W peak power.

One Tool. Multiple Blade Options

Different blades for different materials, details, and cutting tasks.

Cut, carve, trim, groove, and polish with blade options built for different materials and workflows.

More Tungsten Steel Blade Options. More Ways to Create.

What's in the Box

For early backers who want the core ZENCH cutting experience at the best launch price.

The complete kit for 3D printing cleanup, model making, DIY cutting, PCB trimming, leather work, PVC, acrylic, EVA, and more.

Get 2 ZENCH kits for your workshop, studio, repair bench, or maker team. Perfect for creators who want one for daily use and one as backup.

Certified for Reliable Use

FCC and CE compliance documentation for added confidence in everyday use.

Tested. Documented. Built for confidence.

Our Launch Partners

BackerRock offers ROI-guaranteed promotion for projects.

Risks and challenges

Launching a new hardware product on Kickstarter always comes with challenges, and we want to be transparent with our backers. ZENCH Wireless Ultrasonic Cutter has completed FCC and CE compliance testing, and our team has already gone through product development, prototype testing, and performance validation. However, mass production may still involve adjustments in tooling, component supply, assembly, or quality control.

International shipping may also bring uncertainties such as customs clearance delays, local regulations, logistics changes, or shipping cost fluctuations. We will work closely with our manufacturing and logistics partners to reduce these risks and keep fulfillment moving as smoothly as possible.

If anything unexpected happens, we will communicate openly through Kickstarter updates and keep backers informed about the issue, our solution, and the expected delivery timeline. Our goal is to deliver a reliable ultrasonic cutting tool and provide a clear, trustworthy experience for every backer.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

We used AI-assisted tools to help refine parts of our Kickstarter page presentation, including image background cleanup, color consistency, layout adjustment, image resizing, translation, and copywriting support.

All product photos, videos, prototypes, specifications, certifications, and functional demonstrations are based on the actual ZENCH Wireless Ultrasonic Cutter.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

All original product photos, videos, product designs, specifications, and brand materials used in this project are owned or created by our team. AI-assisted tools were used only to refine our own materials for presentation purposes.

No third-party copyrighted product images, videos, or brand assets were used as AI-generated content without permission.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

ZENCH is designed as a long-lasting tool rather than a disposable cutter. It features an aircraft-grade aluminum alloy body, replaceable battery, replaceable blades, and an active cooling system to support stable long-term use. By making the main tool reusable and serviceable, we aim to extend product life and reduce unnecessary replacement.

Reusability and recyclability

ZENCH uses replaceable blades and a replaceable battery, allowing users to maintain the tool instead of replacing the entire unit. We encourage backers to dispose of used blades, batteries, and electronic components responsibly according to local recycling and waste management regulations. We will also work to reduce unnecessary plastic in the packaging where possible.

Environmentally friendly factories

We work with manufacturing partners that follow local production, safety, and environmental regulations. During production, we aim to reduce unnecessary waste and ensure that manufacturing materials and production waste are handled according to proper factory procedures.

Sustainable Distribution

We will work with experienced logistics partners to optimize packaging size, consolidate shipments where possible, and reduce unnecessary transportation steps. Our goal is to deliver rewards safely while keeping the fulfillment process as efficient and responsible as possible.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: At ZENCH, we create high-performance tools for makers, repair work, and precision tasks. Our ultrasonic cutter delivers true 45W power, 50W peak output, and portable control for cleaner cutting. Contact us: hello@zenchcutting.com
projects.ai_description_en:
The ZENCH True 45W Cordless Ultrasonic Cutter is a precision cutting tool engineered for makers who demand real power and versatility. Unlike many cutters that claim 45W but fall short, ZENCH delivers true 45W continuous output with up to 50W peak power, driven by 40kHz ultrasonic vibration. This combination produces fast micro-cuts with noticeably less resistance, giving users cleaner edges and greater control across a wide range of materials. The tool operates cordlessly for handheld freedom or plugs in via USB-C for extended sessions, ensuring you're never limited by battery life alone.

ZENCH handles an impressive variety of materials including 3D printed parts, resin, PVC, acrylic, leather, PCB, EVA, and wood. Its AI auto frequency tracking continuously adjusts to maintain stable performance as cutting conditions change, whether you're trimming delicate details or shaping thicker stock. The active cooling system reduces heat buildup during prolonged use, supporting longer, more stable cutting sessions without performance drop-off. Multiple tungsten steel blade options let users switch between cutting, carving, trimming, grooving, and polishing tasks with a single tool.

Built around a larger custom lithium battery module rather than standard small cells, ZENCH provides the sustained power delivery that real-world cutting demands. The replaceable battery design, USB-C fast charging, and optional dock charging keep downtime minimal, while a built-in battery safety lock secures the pack during use and transport. FCC and CE compliance documentation is completed, adding confidence for everyday use. Whether you're cleaning up 3D prints, trimming PCBs, working leather, or shaping acrylic, ZENCH offers a certified, versatile cutting solution designed to perform when it matters most.

Portable Light for Indoor & Outdoor

In our busy, fragmented lives, what we truly long for is not more stuff—but better moments.

A gentle light that transforms ordinary evenings into memorable experiences, bringing warmth to gatherings, comfort to quiet nights, and atmosphere to every adventure.

EVLA was designed to light up the moments that matter—indoors or outdoors.

Whether you're camping outdoors, relaxing in the living room, reading in bed, enjoying coffee on the balcony, gathering with friends in the backyard, or adding a warm touch to your workspace,

EVLA is yourportable atmosphere maker—bringing light, comfort, and personality to every corner of your life.

Where Atmosphere Meets Everyday Living

Designed with a clean silhouette and carefully crafted lighting, EVLA blends naturally into any environment, creating an inviting atmosphere without overwhelming the space. Whether placed beside your bed, on a balcony table, in a cozy living room, or under the stars at a campsite, EVLA feels perfectly at home.

Outdoors, it elevates every adventure. Indoors, it enriches every moment.

Beneath its elegant design, we've integrated a thoughtful collection of features designed to elevate your everyday moments:

Dynamic ambient lighting, adjustable brightness, multiple lighting modes, portable cordless freedom, long-lasting battery performance, and intuitive controls—all working together seamlessly to create the perfect mood for any occasion.

Every feature is designed with balance and simplicity in mind.

EVLA doesn't demand attention—it quietly transforms the way a space feels.

Designed for Everyday Moments

1. Convenient Top Hook

Designed for effortless portability, the built-in hanging cord and carabiner let you place your light wherever you need it.

Hang it from a tent ceiling, tree branch, backpack, or bedside rack to instantly transform any space.

From the outdoors to everyday living, it brings warm ambient lighting wherever you go.

Hang it. Carry it. Enjoy it anywhere.

2. USB-C Rechargeable Design

Outdoor adventures shouldn't be interrupted by a lack of power.

EVLA features a built-in rechargeable battery and convenient USB-C charging, allowing you to recharge easily at home, in your vehicle, or with a portable power bank.

No disposable batteries. No unnecessary waste. Just reliable illumination whenever you need it.

From weekend camping trips and patio evenings to quiet moments by your bedside,it’s always ready for what’s next.

3. Multi-Mode Ambient Lighting

At the heart of EVLA is a collection of carefully designed lighting modes, created to match every moment.

Switch between a realistic flickering flame effect, warm ambient glow, colorful mood lighting, and practical white light to create the perfect atmosphere for any occasion.

Whether you're camping beneath the stars, relaxing before bed, or hosting an evening gathering,these versatile lighting modes transform ordinary spaces into memorable experiences.

Light that does more than illuminate — it creates atmosphere.

4. Built-In White Noise & Nature Sounds

EVLA features a selection of soothing ambient sounds, including gentle rainfall, forest ambience, ocean waves, soft wind, white noise, and relaxing melodies.

With intuitive touch controls on the side, you can easily switch between different sounds with a simple tap and create the perfect atmosphere whenever you need it.

Whether you're falling asleep in a tent, reading before bed, meditating, or taking a quiet break from a busy day, these calming sounds help transform any space into a peaceful retreat.

A simple way to create your own peaceful space, wherever you are.

5. IP54 Water-Resistant Design

A little rain shouldn't stop the adventure.

Designed with an IP54-rated water-resistant construction,EVLA is built to handle everyday outdoor conditions with confidence.

From damp campsites and misty mornings to unexpected drizzles on the patio, it continues to deliver reliable lighting when the weather takes an unexpected turn.

Enjoy your outdoor moments with peace of mind, knowing your lighting companion is designed for real-world environments.

6. Universal 1/4-Inch Mount

Hidden on the bottom of EVLA is a universal 1/4-inch threaded mounting interface.

This professional-standard connection allows it to be mounted on tripods, light stands, camera mounts, tent poles, and a wide variety of third-party accessories, dramatically expanding how and where it can be used.

Whether elevated above a campsite, mounted beside a workstation, or integrated into your own creative setup, EVLA easily adapts to your needs.

7. Made for Indoor & Outdoor Living

From bedrooms to campsites, balconies to RV adventures, bedside tables to tent ceilings, EVLA is designed to fit seamlessly into any setting.

Whether you're reading before bed, relaxing on the patio, traveling, camping, or simply enjoying a quiet evening at home, it naturally becomes part of your daily routine.

One light covers 90% of your everyday moments.

It provides light when you need visibility, creates atmosphere when you need comfort, and delivers soothing sounds through its built-in speakers when you need relaxation.

By combining lighting, built-in speakers, portability, and versatility into one beautifully designed device, it makes everyday moments more enjoyable.

More than just a lantern, it’s a personal atmosphere companion designed to bring warmth, comfort, and a sense of calm to the moments that matter most.

Why Kickstarter?

We believe great lighting does more than brighten a space, it shapes the atmosphere around us. Designed for both indoor and outdoor living, EVLA combines ambient lighting and immersive sound to make everyday moments more comfortable and memorable.

Behind this project is a team with years of experience manufacturing consumer electronics for global brands. From design and engineering to production and quality control, we understand how to create products that are both reliable and beautifully crafted.

Why Kickstarter?We want to connect directly with our earliest supporters, hear your feedback, and bring this vision to life together.

We are also thrilled to share with you the journey of EVLA , from initial concept to finished product. Our production line is now ready, and the first small-batch pilot production has been completed. We are waiting for your support to embark on this new journey together.

Risks and challenges

EVLA is a hardware product that has already reached the prototype stage and is currently undergoing final preparation for mass production.

While we have functional prototypes and established manufacturing support, there are still risks involved in bringing the product to large-scale production and global distribution.

These risks may include production adjustments, component availability, manufacturing scheduling, and logistics or shipping delays.

We are working closely with our manufacturing partners to reduce these risks as much as possible. Based on our current prototype validation and production preparation, we believe we are well positioned to deliver EVLA as planned.

We will continue to provide regular updates throughout the production and fulfillment process.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We designed EVLA with durability and long-term use in mind. The product is built with a stable structure and reusable components to extend its lifespan, helping to reduce the need for frequent replacements and unnecessary waste.

Reusability and recyclability

EVLA and its accessories are designed for repeated use. We aim to reduce the use of single-use materials wherever possible. Packaging materials are selected with recyclability in mind to minimize environmental impact.

Sustainable materials

We prioritize durable and practical materials in product development. Where possible, we aim to use materials that are recyclable or have lower environmental impact, without compromising product performance or safety.

Environmentally friendly factories

We work with our long-term manufacturing partners who are committed to improving production efficiency and reducing waste during the manufacturing process. We continuously aim to optimize production methods to minimize environmental impact.

projects.ai_description_en:
EVLA is a portable atmosphere lamp designed to transform ordinary spaces and moments into something memorable. With its compact capsule silhouette, it blends effortlessly into any environment — from a bedside table or living room corner to a campsite under the stars — creating an inviting ambiance without overwhelming the space. Built for both indoor and outdoor use, EVLA brings warmth, comfort, and personality wherever you need it most.

At its core, EVLA delivers multi-mode ambient lighting that goes far beyond simple illumination. You can switch between a realistic flickering flame effect, a warm ambient glow, colorful mood lighting, and practical white light, letting you tailor the mood to any occasion — whether you're hosting an evening gathering, winding down before bed, or camping outdoors. The light is complemented by built-in ambient sounds, including gentle rainfall, forest ambience, ocean waves, soft wind, and white noise, helping you set a calming atmosphere with both sound and light working in harmony. Intuitive controls make it easy to adjust everything on the fly.

Practical design choices keep EVLA ready for everyday life and adventure alike. A built-in top hook with hanging cord and carabiner lets you hang it from a tent ceiling, tree branch, backpack, or bedside rack — instantly turning any spot into a cozy retreat. It's USB-C rechargeable with a built-in battery, so there are no disposable batteries to deal with, and it tops up easily at home, in a vehicle, or from a portable power bank. The unit is also waterproof, making it a reliable companion outdoors regardless of the weather. Every feature is designed with balance and simplicity in mind — EVLA doesn't demand attention, it quietly transforms the way a space feels.
