## Story

Radar alerts, GPS emergency response, automatic incident detection and 360° visibility in one lightweight vest.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/978/901/e9465c6e3234e99dafedcda42d522f74_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780518127&width=680&sig=s%2B6nLGdgtN%2Baeun1%2FlSQhIuNpr1qHP64EcchWt46Psk%3D)

### RunSafePRO - the smart running vest that protects you every step of the way.

#### Designed for runners, hikers, walkers and cyclists. To keep you seen, connected and protected.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/977/889/337c61b8c1e3b3e7c4a2e17ba6958f58_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780512691&width=680&sig=56mWIV1FP%2Bogz2o4fUAZfibaX1wBUcceiyks%2F4l1Og0%3D)

#### RunSafePRO is a smart safety vest for runners, walkers and cyclists who often move alone.

A connected safety vest and app that keeps you aware of what’s happening around you, visible to others, and protected if something goes wrong.

It works in the background, so you can focus on your run, walk or ride.

#### Early backers can secure RunSafePRO for $119 USD / €99 compared with the planned retail price of $175 USD / €149.

Pre-launch VIPs receive 12 months of app access included. Early backers receive 6 months included. App access bonuses end after the first 1,000 vest rewards.

Estimated delivery: October 2026.

### What is RunSafePRO?

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/979/049/6fff8e3fdcfc5f1c0026f9ba1a124201_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780518851&width=680&sig=ZOAoIMW%2FZAdHr9ugdIodu%2FgbX2EmRplX8BRT0bCUZW4%3D)

#### Four layers of safety in one vest:

- Rear radar alerts for approaching traffic

- Immediate control with GPS panic alerts

- Automatic incident alerts if you can’t respond (hit‑&‑run detection)

- 360° visibility with lights and reflective elements

All this technology fits into a lightweight design that’s comfortable enough to wear every day.

#### Be among the first to back RunSafePRO and secure the early launch offer.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/402/974/d6ddbf40f56a26e5baa71d079a2c30a8_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1776626029&width=680&sig=rSnT3LFOIst4l%2FcLCdYuTTd5ZpPKxDX82SE5z%2Br25nM%3D)

### Rewards

#### You can focus on your pace while RunSafePRO takes care of the rest.

Save over 32% during the Kickstarter launch.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/126/909/eb1f2b810ca9087b9c6b77b2b406d845_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781608149&width=680&sig=8llkn06MTA0Qf0kfn1xNcgkRA7j%2F2qJZ00cxD1oWP9A%3D)

#### Why Kickstarter?

RunSafePRO is now at the stage where working prototypes are being tested, refined and prepared for production. By backing this campaign, you help us move from prototype refinement to the first production batch.

### Why RunSafePRO exists

That was the question that started RunSafePRO. Why can’t you run or walk with confidence, knowing you’re safe and in control?

Many people already adjust how they move before they even start.

They choose different routes, avoid certain times or stay alert in ways that break their rhythm. RunSafePRO was built to reduce that uncertainty.

#### RunSafePRO helps you move with more awareness and confidence.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/030/844/254f0c2afa14196494617c1e87a22de8_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780926285&width=680&sig=RFSaAnKFeShn8xj%2Fus3jPq2x0Hjm%2FypLDr8q%2FOWf5hE%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/051/714/709/2c65eec912adf1fe85377a84490c7d66_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1763585697&width=680&sig=BE4kVeDHQx2%2B62aIpRtDoE5suMEeWl%2FISTfvGMDUvrQ%3D)

### What problem does it solve?

#### RunSafePRO is our answer: a smart vest that turns fear into freedom.

RunSafePRO brings fragmented safety tools into one integrated vest, without unnecessary bulk. It combines awareness, visibility and protection in one piece of gear.

Instead of relying only on reaction, RunSafePRO works in the background while you move:

- Detects what is approaching from behind

- Alerts you when approaching traffic is detected

- Starts an automatic check-in if you stop moving unexpectedly

No juggling separate safety tools.

No reliance on one manual action.

Just one system designed to support you while you move.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/403/002/9c006628bb956be88f74009c05ed9d21_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1776626409&width=680&sig=Qxs%2Bzl3ubSBtSwCUtqh8yhn%2BMl8sxUqPQT5Yq8WvDFQ%3D)

### How to use

#### From setup to safety in 3 simple steps

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/034/843/83a5d7e1a84815990a0821b64ada0a2e_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780946478&width=680&sig=187xiWjVMXVLw2mC21vkqhsy7mfl8op%2BX0yU0Qi8VMU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/034/032/3f40996a9edc4369a2d996a609d2db88_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780942306&width=680&sig=0hRxg2tnWUuaLzaNgyXM0Hl9CP5rBhiK%2FdUg4jFsdWU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/034/933/19400da50583b78b3a7200105dd40487_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780946811&width=680&sig=hpKsL2o5VT37J9ODMunrSJZnJI3E8K0c7buPkCoaQuI%3D)

#### Stay focused.

#### Once set up, RunSafePRO works in the background during your run, walk or ride.

### How does RunSafePRO protect you?

#### 1\. Stay aware without turning around

The built-in radar continuously scans for approaching vehicles or cyclists up to approx. 100 feet / 30 meters away and alerts you instantly with gentle vibrations, sound and light alerts.

Whether you're running city streets or cycling through traffic, stay one step ahead of what's behind you.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/030/854/35949ee2aad42b952682a787e435c8df_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780926365&width=680&sig=AyD82n2pYk6myPf11X25WrFjCIrfsNiX4VvsAwD8Pk4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/125/719/1f454c05750d470ae4209a03079ee640_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781601502&width=680&sig=qKNv5rUZhgakoJWu2sCLFip%2BTCjQidHSlgEqyBCBpkM%3D)

#### 2\. Send a GPS alert when you need help fast

If you feel unsafe or need help fast, press the panic button to send your GPS location to selected contacts, either silently or with a loud audible alarm.

Press once to send your current GPS location silently to your primary contacts. Press twice to trigger a loud alarm and alert your entire emergency network.

RunSafePRO is not designed for constant public tracking. It shares your location only when an alert is triggered. It’s just there when you need it.

Help is a discreet press away, without unlocking or holding your phone.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/030/875/dd143c1c717f66433be0e948b166f97b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780926478&width=680&sig=xJivZBKFLuiJOTvQzNaB7LNELUokSR3M4W3xAAGnubw%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/125/443/1ac656cdabd59d9aa98b44286a9e47a6_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781600287&width=680&sig=Qy%2F2bIv06aquyPdbAyf%2Fv4cuHU17ZtHtkTeGCB22yRk%3D)

#### 3\. Protected even when you can’t respond

If you stop moving unexpectedly, the system checks in. If there is no response, the vest sounds a loud alarm and sends your current GPS location to your emergency contacts.

So you're never truly alone, even if you cannot reach your phone.

A safety net you don’t have to think about.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/030/899/06ac6d6bdb7bb390d4dbe2cc10eb8b52_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780926550&width=680&sig=dzF03tpbxQdFbMnSN6OHdjiDc5aAjfnUhbt2bEUWuYM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/403/064/da67080db02f3c7f03a082039e2a1054_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1776626976&width=680&sig=8PIC%2BRhkdeh3OzIq6qPwQL6yARDgGufO1tXcG2mP7XY%3D)

#### 4\. Stay visible in low light and changing conditions

Adaptive 360° lighting and reflective materials help you be seen from every angle.

The lighting adjusts to your environment, helping drivers, cyclists and others notice you sooner. Adaptive lights respond to changing visibility, while reflective panels support visibility from multiple angles.

Whether it is dawn, dusk or low light, you can focus on the road instead of managing separate visibility gear.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/403/032/ef0f9dd54fda339f87b02ed52b3fed14_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1776626715&width=680&sig=9eV8dbhUi280PY6OHbRHbQn2moaYXaAzw1%2BjSv71jbg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/125/349/fae2674fd51e433e1174faf6781f22db_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781599834&width=680&sig=fnkIJy2jztYsL%2FhXwiHCkFAuYu8gGcZl%2FBwFZpS1TGA%3D)

### Why RunSafePRO beats the rest

#### “Do I need another device?”   No.

Most safety solutions address only part of the problem.

- Lights help you get seen.

- Apps notify after the fact.

- Wearables rely on manual action.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/035/350/eaac1ec3f43300af2536f4f9c9dd4862_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780949011&width=680&sig=V6F7HwuofWGp%2BcM8HhzJt50cTeIhLuRP%2BFaNW457aWU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/031/320/f39ebe4a93c5c1ec74344a3f0d324a21_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780929699&width=680&sig=nMW87r5rtDX5W7NC5x49Gtg3ZMvlheQn7wZk0Afmjyc%3D)

### Who is RunSafePRO for?

Is it for me? RunSafePRO is not just for elite athletes or marathoners. It’s for anyone who often moves alone. It is built for casual joggers, hikers, dog walkers, cyclists and commuters.

It is also for families who want peace of mind when loved ones are out on the road.

If you have ever wished you felt safer while running or walking, this vest was designed for you.

- For runners focused on performance.

- Cyclists navigating traffic.

- Walkers choosing quieter routes.

- And commuters moving early or late.

#### Join the first group moving with full awareness and control.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/030/931/7600b6dc026e128d0960924b44c34d92_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780926677&width=680&sig=MPwtcrEjy4zIRwgk9ysov0HkwbakuZsTlIXxIKvGa6M%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/051/714/075/df418adf20bbf9fc64ad8487a358742d_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1763581403&width=680&sig=HWWFckwTp1SSxcZepaeIq%2FCWXlQbMECinyuXaTUgbuw%3D)

### Tech Specs

Designed to feel lightweight, secure and practical during running, walking and cycling.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/979/156/a141621492fc2f5350aa5b59f861990d_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780519358&width=680&sig=dwR%2Bgl05UoWPqsaChQctl1n%2F4wxtWUPr%2BNY1C753k5Y%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/126/774/b0dc0333090d5bb6cba7369fbb3d3a0e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781607465&width=680&sig=Mphc4wLu6%2FbIzp4D5XE%2BgS%2FJtcrdIEtXZQBYZM59JOw%3D)

### Your safety network, built into the app

We believe smart safety gear should be simple, accessible and easy to use. With RunSafePRO you can import contacts from your phone and choose who should be notified if an alert is triggered.

With RunSafePRO, you can import contacts from your phone and choose the people you trust most. They receive a notification when you add them as an emergency contact.

Personal and location data will be handled carefully and your vest is fully GDPR compliant. Because we care about you and your loved ones.

### App access and subscription

RunSafePRO uses a minimal subscription to maintain and improve our iOS and Android app, cloud service, message delivery, and safety updates.

The app service is planned from $0.99 / €0.99 per month. You can add up to 50 emergency contacts and keep your vest ready whenever you need it.

Consistency in safety is priceless, and our subscription ensures the system is always there when you need it.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/036/183/584bbfc87dd02c72ec6acb3b01ba544e_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780952714&width=680&sig=foLNUwWs5SVD5WN0rsZRbYGhmbk8MgtiKLSu9TcUmXA%3D)

Your RunSafePRO vest, app access and the essentials to get started.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/033/268/8c6196bde0164b882ea0552752cf88b7_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780938229&width=680&sig=HZx%2ByLEYy7B7%2FftOUJ%2BEjNDRSgoZB3e1VLagkPx01pw%3D)

We’re moving step by step toward production, testing and delivery.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/979/162/a0a58b1154e45ec804a60b165f5a5d6a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780519408&width=680&sig=aKx00ewZuOk5NmGb4eCxtgJKtQhdeE9uo3pQqs1E5E0%3D)

### Prototype

#### Where we are now

- We have developed working prototypes that integrate radar detection, GPS alert logic and emergency alert flows into one electronics module. We are now validating GPS alert and contact notification flows.

- We have designed and produced a lightweight vest with integrated lighting components. We are now improving comfort, adjustability and reliability.

- The electronics module is currently being reduced in size so it mounts securely in the back of the vest.

- Current testing focuses on reliability, responsiveness and comfort during real-world movement.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/126/076/293f8ece73f56e2f6288d0e0904438de_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781603587&width=680&sig=BiuaulJwcUkeWkEKHqNXbQ7vDp%2FmTZnYUthFIdW0qL0%3D)

The early development has already been funded by our team. Your backing helps us validate demand, prepare the first production batch and bring RunSafePRO to life.

### Why did we create RunSafePRO?

#### RunSafePRO started with a close call.

Someone close to us came back from a run shaken. Nothing happened. But it could have.

That moment exposed a gap:

Awareness depends too much on the individual.

We brought together engineers, runners and safety experts to build a system that removes that dependency.

“Everyone should be able to go outside and exercise with peace of mind.” Remco Barbier, former athlete and RunSafePRO ambassador

Our goal is simple: Make movement feel controlled again. Our mission is to make an active life safer for everyone.

A connected safety vest and app that keeps you aware of what’s happening around you, visible to others, and protected if something goes wrong.

It works in the background, so you can focus on your run, walk or ride.

What isRunSafePRO?

Four layers of safety in one vest:

Rear radar alerts for approaching traffic

Immediate control with GPS panic alerts

Automatic incident alerts if you can’t respond (hit‑&‑run detection)

360° visibility with lights and reflective elements

All this technology fits into a lightweight design that’s comfortable enough to wear every day.

Be among the first to back RunSafePRO and secure the early launch offer.

You can focus on your pace while RunSafePRO takes care of the rest.

Save over 32% during the Kickstarter launch.

Pre-launch VIPs receive 12 months of app access included. Early backers receive 6 months included.App access bonuses end after the first 1,000 vest rewards.

Why Kickstarter?

RunSafePRO is now at the stage where working prototypes are being tested, refined and prepared for production. By backing this campaign, you help us move from prototype refinement to the first production batch.

Why RunSafePRO exists

That was the question that started RunSafePRO. Why can’t you run or walk with confidence, knowing you’re safe and in control?

Many people already adjust how they move before they even start.

They choose different routes, avoid certain times or stay alert in ways that break their rhythm.RunSafePRO was built to reduce that uncertainty.

RunSafePRO helps you move with more awareness and confidence.

What problem does it solve?

RunSafePRO is our answer: a smart vest that turns fear into freedom.

RunSafePRO brings fragmented safety tools into one integrated vest, without unnecessary bulk. It combines awareness, visibility and protection in one piece of gear.

Instead of relying only on reaction, RunSafePRO works in the background while you move:

Detects what is approaching from behind

Alerts you when approaching traffic is detected

Starts an automatic check-in if you stop moving unexpectedly

No juggling separate safety tools.No reliance on one manual action.

Just one system designed to support you while you move.

From setup to safety in 3 simple steps

Once set up, RunSafePRO works in the background during your run, walk or ride.

How does RunSafePRO protect you?

1. Stay aware without turning around

The built-in radar continuously scans for approaching vehicles or cyclistsup to approx. 100 feet / 30 meters awayand alerts you instantly with gentle vibrations, sound and light alerts.

Whether you're running city streets or cycling through traffic,stay one step ahead of what's behind you.

2. Send a GPS alert when you need help fast

If you feel unsafe or need help fast, press the panic button to send your GPS location to selected contacts, either silently or with a loud audible alarm.

Press once to send your current GPS location silently to your primary contacts. Press twice to trigger a loud alarm and alert your entire emergency network.

RunSafePRO is not designed for constant public tracking. It shares your location only when an alert is triggered. It’s just there when you need it.

Help is a discreet press away, without unlocking or holding your phone.

3. Protected even when you can’t respond

If you stop moving unexpectedly, the system checks in. If there is no response, the vest sounds a loud alarm and sends your current GPS location to your emergency contacts.

So you're never truly alone, even if you cannot reach your phone.

Asafety netyou don’t have to think about.

4. Stay visible in low light and changing conditions

Adaptive 360° lighting and reflective materials help you be seen from every angle.

The lighting adjusts to your environment, helping drivers, cyclists and others notice you sooner. Adaptive lights respond to changing visibility, while reflective panels support visibility from multiple angles.

Whether it is dawn, dusk or low light, you can focus on the road instead of managing separate visibility gear.

Why RunSafePRO beats the rest

“Do I need another device?”No.

Most safety solutions address only part of the problem.

Lights help you get seen.

Apps notify after the fact.

Wearables rely on manual action.

Who is RunSafePRO for?

Is it for me?RunSafePRO is not just for elite athletes or marathoners. It’sfor anyone who often moves alone. It is built for casual joggers, hikers, dog walkers, cyclists and commuters.

It is also for families who want peace of mind when loved ones are out on the road.

If you have ever wished you felt safer while running or walking, this vest was designed for you.

For runners focused on performance.

Cyclists navigating traffic.

Walkers choosing quieter routes.

And commuters moving early or late.

Join the first group moving with full awareness and control.

Designed to feel lightweight, secure and practical during running, walking and cycling.

Your safety network, built into the app

We believe smart safety gear should be simple, accessible and easy to use. With RunSafePRO you can import contacts from your phone and choose who should be notified if an alert is triggered.

With RunSafePRO, you can import contacts from your phone and choose the people you trust most. They receive a notification when you add them as an emergency contact.

Personal and location data will be handled carefully and your vest is fully GDPR compliant. Because we care about you and your loved ones.

App access and subscription

RunSafePRO uses a minimal subscription to maintain and improve our iOS and Android app, cloud service, message delivery, and safety updates.

The app service is planned from $0.99 / €0.99 per month. You can add up to 50 emergency contacts and keep your vest ready whenever you need it.

Consistency in safety is priceless, and our subscription ensures the system is always there when you need it.

What’s included?

Your RunSafePRO vest, app access and the essentials to get started.

Delivery Timeline

We’re moving step by step toward production, testing and delivery.

Estimated delivery: October 2026, depending on final production and fulfillment timelines

Backers will receive regular updates throughout development, production and fulfillment.

Shipping, VAT and taxes

We want RunSafePRO to be accessible to as many runners, walkers and cyclists as possible. That’s why we’re working with our fulfillment partners to keep shipping and applicable VAT/taxes as low and predictable as we can.

Shipping and applicable VAT/taxes will be collected after the Kickstarter campaign, when you complete your Pledge Manager survey. This allows us to calculate the correct amount based on your delivery location.

Our goal is simple: no inflated pledge price, no hidden margin on shipping, and clear costs before we ship your RunSafePRO.

Where we are now

We have developed working prototypes that integrate radar detection, GPS alert logic and emergency alert flows into one electronics module. We are now validating GPS alert and contact notification flows.

We have designed and produced a lightweight vest with integrated lighting components. We are now improving comfort, adjustability and reliability.

The electronics module is currently being reduced in size so it mounts securely in the back of the vest.

Current testing focuses on reliability, responsiveness and comfort during real-world movement.

The early development has already been funded by our team. Your backing helps us validate demand, prepare the first production batch and bring RunSafePRO to life.

Why did we create RunSafePRO?

RunSafePRO started with a close call.

Someone close to us came back from a run shaken. Nothing happened. But it could have.

That momentexposed a gap:Awareness depends too much on the individual.

We brought together engineers, runners and safety experts to build a system that removes that dependency.

projects.ai_description_en:
RunSafePRO is a connected safety vest that combines rear radar alerts, GPS panic response, automatic incident detection, and adaptive 360° visibility into one lightweight design. Built for runners, hikers, walkers, and cyclists who often train or commute alone, it works quietly in the background to keep you aware of your surroundings without breaking your rhythm. The built-in radar scans for approaching vehicles or cyclists up to 30 meters behind you, instantly alerting you through gentle vibrations, sound, and light when something enters your personal space.

The vest addresses a common problem: adjusting your life around safety concerns. Instead of relying on reaction or carrying multiple disconnected devices, RunSafePRO brings fragmented safety tools into one integrated system. It detects what approaches from behind, starts an automatic check-in if you stop moving unexpectedly, and eliminates the need for constant manual intervention. This means you can move with more confidence and less uncertainty, whether you are running city streets or cycling through traffic.

If you are involved in a hit-and-run or become unresponsive, the automatic incident alert activates to notify your emergency contacts via GPS. Despite housing advanced technology, the vest remains lightweight and comfortable for daily outdoor use in rain, heat, and sweat. Pre-launch VIPs and early backers receive 12 or 6 months of app access included, and the campaign offers the vest for €99 / $114—over 32% off the planned retail price. Estimated delivery is October 2026.

🚀 Makerplot 2.0

The Modular 3D Printable Plotter Without Linear Rails

Faster. Bigger. Smarter. Still radically simple.

Makerplot 2.0 is the evolution of the original Makerplot, redesigned from the ground up to deliver higher speed, greater precision, and unlimited scalability while preserving the philosophy that made it unique:

Extreme mechanical simplicity.

No linear rails

No ball bearings

No metal guide rods

No expensive CNC components

Just 3D printed parts, standard screws, affordable electronics, and your creativity.

🎯 Why Makerplot 2.0?

Most DIY plotters become more complex as they become larger.

Makerplot 2.0 takes the opposite approach.

Its modular architecture allows you to build machines in different sizes using the same design philosophy and the same printable components.

Choose the size that fits your workspace or expand it whenever you want.

Designed to be:

Easy to assemble

Open source friendly

Makerplot 2.0 is more than a plotter.

It is a mechanical platform designed to demonstrate how simplicity can outperform complexity.

⚡ Faster Motion System

Unlike the original version based on geared motors, Makerplot 2.0 uses:

Arduino compatible controller

NEMA17 stepper motors

Standard stepper drivers

This configuration provides:

Better positioning accuracy

Smoother motion

Greater reliability

Compatibility with the maker ecosystem

The result is a machine capable of producing cleaner drawings while significantly reducing plotting time.

A4:Perfect for education, lettering, illustrations and everyday projects.

INFINITE EXPANSION:Thanks to its modular architecture, the system can be extended indefinitely by combining additional structural modules.

projects.ai_intro_en: Makerplot 2.0 is an improved, fully 3D printable modular CNC plotter that eliminates the need for linear rails, ball bearings, or metal guide rods. It uses NEMA17 stepper motors and Arduino-compatible controllers for faster, smoother motion and greater precision. Available in A4, A3, A2, and unlimited expansion formats, it provides an accessible mechanical platform for education, art, and creative experimentation.
ai_highlights_en: No linear rails or bearings needed - just 3D printed parts and standard screws
Modular design available in A4, A3, A2, and unlimited expansion formats
Faster NEMA17 stepper motors with Arduino-compatible controller for better accuracy
ai_specs_en: Included with configuration files and tutorials
projects.ai_risks_en: Since Makerplot 2.0 uses no linear rails or bearings, final precision depends on print quality and proper assembly. The project addresses this by providing clear print settings and calibration instructions to ensure consistent results.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Hi! I'm an engineer with a passion for cycling and tabletop games. I love designing practical and creative 3D-printed solutions, bringing innovative ideas to life. As both a maker and a gamer, I enjoy blending functionality with immersive design—whether it's crafting accessories for RPG enthusiasts or creating unique, useful objects.
projects.ai_description_en:
Makerplot 2.0 is an improved, fully 3D printable Arduino CNC plotter designed around extreme mechanical simplicity. Rejecting the conventional reliance on hardware like linear rails, ball bearings, or metal guide rods, this next-generation plotter relies entirely on 3D printed structural parts, standard screws, and affordable electronics. This radical approach ensures the entire mechanical system can be printed on any standard desktop 3D printer, making replacement parts accessible anywhere while dramatically reducing costs. It serves as an accessible platform for experimentation, demonstrating how simplicity can outperform complexity.

Beyond simple plotting, Makerplot 2.0 delivers higher speed and greater precision by utilizing an Arduino compatible controller paired with NEMA17 stepper motors and standard stepper drivers. This configuration provides better positioning accuracy and smoother motion, while the firmware includes software-based backlash compensation to ensure clean, consistent drawings. Furthermore, its completely modular design means users are never locked to a single size. The platform supports A4, A3, and A2 formats, and its architecture allows for unlimited scalability. Users can build a compact educational plotter or expand it indefinitely to accommodate large-format artwork, adapting the machine to their ideas rather than the other way around.

Makerplot 2.0 matters because it democratizes CNC technology for Arduino beginners, creative coders, and CNC enthusiasts. It comes fully equipped with a comprehensive digital kit that includes all STL files, firmware, software packages, electronics wiring guides, and step-by-step illustrated assembly instructions requiring no special tools or custom hardware. Whether you want to learn the fundamentals of motion systems or create beautiful generative art, Makerplot 2.0 delivers a sustainable, open-source, and cost-effective entry point into the maker ecosystem.

projects.html_story:
A cross-platform item tracker with Find My & Android Find Hub support, precision finding, alerts, and 365-day battery

A cross-platform item tracker with Find My & Android Find Hub support, precision finding, alerts, and 365-day battery

The Problem We Solved

What Makes TrackPod Different

🛡️ Never Lose Again

✨ Tiny But Mighty

🍎 Compatible with Multiple Apple Devices

🔋 Battery Life That Actually Lasts

🎉 Kickstarter Special

⏳ Our Roadmap to Launch

TrackPodis the next-generation tracking device that does what AirTags couldn't: work seamlessly acrossbothAndroid and Apple ecosystems without compromise.

The Problem We Solved

You own an iPhone, your partner uses Android. Your keys disappear. Your bag gets left behind. Your wallet vanishes at the worst possible moment. Traditional trackers? They only work if everyone uses the same phone. TrackPod breaks that barrier.

What Makes TrackPod Different

Truly Universal CompatibilityTrackPod works with Apple's Find My on iPhonesandintegrates with Android's Find Hub. One device. Both platforms. No app required. Just attach and go.

Battery That Actually LastsForget annual replacements. TrackPod runs on a standard button cell battery that lasts a full365 dayswith ultra-low power consumption. When it does run out, simply pop in a new battery—no charging cables, no hassle.

Built ToughWith anIPX65 water rating, TrackPod laughs in the face of spills, splashes, and surprise rain. Whether it's in your gym bag, on your keys, or attached to your luggage, it's ready for anything.

Precision PositioningKnow exactly where your stuff is with advanced precision positioning technology. No more "somewhere in the apartment"—get the exact location.

Hear It. Find It. Keep It.TrackPod features abuilt-in speakerthat gives audible alerts when you need it. Press the Play Sound button to trigger an alert on the device. Lost your keys under the couch? Listen for the beep.

Smart RemindersTrackPod's intelligent reminder system alerts you when you're about to leave without your tracked item. Heading to the door without your bag? Your phone gets a pop-up notification before you walk out.

Rename & PersonalizeCall it "Work Keys," "Travel Bag," or "That Thing I Always Lose"—TrackPod lets you rename your device for instant recognition.

One Device, One ConnectionClean, simple, focused. TrackPod connects to one device at a time, keeping things straightforward and reliable.

In a world of complicated trackers with short battery life, platform limitations, and dependency on apps you don't want, TrackPod is refreshingly simple. It's the tracker designed forreal life—reliable, durable, inclusive, and honest about what it does.

🛡️ Never Lose Again

Smart Departure AlertsLeaving without your bag? Your keys? TrackPod alerts you with a pop-up before you walk away. It's your digital guardian.

Works EverywhereAndroid Find Hub. Apple Find My. One device. Both platforms. No app needed.

365-Day BatteryRevolutionary button-cell battery that lasts a full year. No charging. No dead batteries when you need it most.

Built ToughIPX6.5 water rating. Drop it. Spill on it. It keeps working.

Hear It. Find It.Built-in speaker + precision positioning means you'll always know exactly where your item is.

Set It & Forget ItNo app. No complicated setup. Just attach, rename, and go.

✨ Tiny But Mighty

🍎 Compatible with Multiple Apple Devices

TrackPod seamlessly integrates with your entire Apple ecosystem. Whether you're using an iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, or Mac, TrackPod connects effortlessly through Apple's Find My network.

One TrackPod. All Your Apple Devices.

Attach TrackPod to your keys, bag, or wallet, and track it from any Apple device you own. Switch from your iPhone to your iPad? No problem. Use your Apple Watch to locate your item? Done. TrackPod works across your entire Apple universe without any additional setup or app installation.

Precision Positioning Across Devices

Get real-time location data and precision positioning no matter which Apple device you're using. Your iPhone shows you the exact location. Your Apple Watch gives you direction. Your Mac keeps you updated. It's all synchronized and seamless.

Works With Find My

TrackPod taps into Apple's trusted Find My network, meaning you get the reliability and accuracy you expect from Apple, plus access to the entire network of Apple devices around you—even when your item is out of Bluetooth range.

Zero Complications

No app to download. No separate accounts. No confusing settings. Just authentic Apple integration that feels natural and works instantly.

🔋 Battery Life That Actually Lasts

365 Days of Uninterrupted Protection

TrackPod's revolutionary button-cell battery lasts a full year with ultra-low power consumption. That's 12 months of continuous tracking, alerts, and peace of mind—without a single charge.

No More Dead Batteries at Critical Moments

Forget about charging cables, power banks, or that sinking feeling when your tracker dies right when you need it. TrackPod keeps working month after month, year after year.

Simple Battery Replacement

When the year is up, simply pop out the old button cell and insert a new one. No special tools. No trips to the service center. No buying a brand new device. Just a quick, easy swap that costs just a few cents or maybe a dollar.

🌍 Works for Unlimited Distance & Global Position Tracking

Find Your Items Anywhere in the World

TrackPod isn't limited by distance. Whether your item is in the next room or on the other side of the world, TrackPod's global positioning system keeps you connected.

Unlimited Range Tracking

Forgot your bag at the airport in another city? Left your keys at a friend's house across the country? TrackPod works seamlessly across unlimited distances. There's no "out of range" with TrackPod.

Global Positioning Technology

Using advanced GPS and global network connectivity, TrackPod pinpoints your item's exact location anywhere on Earth. Real-time updates mean you always know where your belongings are, no matter how far away.

Precision Anywhere

Whether you're tracking something in your home, your city, or internationally, precision positioning technology delivers accurate location data instantly. No guessing. No approximations. Just exact coordinates.

The Peace of Mind You Deserve

In our connected world, your belongings shouldn't have boundaries. TrackPod breaks down those barriers and gives you true global protection.

Keys & WalletsNever search for your keys again. Attach TrackPod to your keychain and locate them instantly with precision positioning or the built-in speaker.

Bags & BackpacksTravel with confidence. Whether it's your daily work bag, gym backpack, or carry-on luggage, TrackPod ensures you never leave without it.

Phones & TabletsMisplaced your device? TrackPod helps you find it in seconds with audible alerts and exact location tracking.

Travel & Adventure

Luggage TrackingMonitor your suitcases at the airport. Get alerts if luggage is left behind before you walk away from the baggage claim.

Travel AccessoriesAttach to cameras, chargers, headphones, or travel essentials. Never lose travel gear again.

International TravelGlobal positioning means your items are tracked worldwide. Perfect for backpacking, business trips, or relocations.

Pet CollarsKeep tabs on your furry friends. Attach TrackPod to your pet's collar for peace of mind.

Children's ItemsMonitor backpacks, jackets, and school supplies. Get alerts if your child leaves something behind.

Valuable ElectronicsProtect laptops, cameras, and expensive gadgets with constant tracking and smart reminders.

Business & Professional

Work EquipmentTrack company laptops, equipment, and assets across offices or job sites.

Tools & GearConstruction crews and professionals can monitor expensive tools and equipment in real-time.

Delivery & LogisticsMonitor packages and shipments with precision global tracking.

Sports & Outdoor

Sports EquipmentKeep track of bikes, skis, snowboards, golf bags, and sports gear at all times.

Hiking & Camping GearAttach to backpacks, tents, or expensive outdoor equipment for adventure tracking.

Water SportsIPX65 water rating means TrackPod survives kayaking, boating, and beach adventures.

🔊 Find Items by Sound

Hear Exactly Where Your Item Is

TrackPod's built-in speaker makes finding lost items instant and effortless. Just press the play sound button and listen for the beep.

One Button. One Sound. Found.

When you need to locate your item, simply tap the play sound button on your phone or device. TrackPod immediately emits a loud, distinctive beep that cuts through noise and clutter.

Crystal Clear Audio Alerts

The speaker delivers clear, audible alerts that help you pinpoint your item's exact location. Whether it's under the couch, in the back of a closet, or buried in your bag, you'll hear it.

Perfect for Everyday Situations

Keys in the Couch: Press play sound and follow the beep

Wallet in the Jacket: Hear exactly which pocket

Make It Yours with Custom Names

Rename your TrackPod to match your items and lifestyle. Call it "Work Keys," "Travel Bag," "Pet Collar," or anything you want. Instant recognition. Zero confusion.

Custom Names for Instant Identification

Instead of generic tracker #1 or #2, give each TrackPod a meaningful name. When you get an alert, you'll know exactly which item needs attention. No more guessing.

Risks and challenges

Manufacturing & Quality Control
As with any hardware product, scaling from prototypes to mass production can present manufacturing and quality-control challenges. We are working closely with experienced suppliers and testing partners to ensure every TrackPod meets our performance and reliability standards before shipping.
Component Availability
Electronic components and batteries can occasionally experience supply-chain delays. To reduce this risk, we are sourcing from established suppliers and planning inventory in advance to help maintain our production timeline.

Shipping & Fulfillment
International shipping timelines can be affected by customs processing, carrier delays, or regional logistics disruptions. We will provide regular updates throughout production and fulfillment and will work with trusted logistics partners to deliver rewards as efficiently as possible.

Our team is committed to transparent communication and proactive planning throughout the project, and we will keep backers informed at every stage of development, production, and fulfillment.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

AI-generated content was used only for certain marketing and presentation materials within this campaign. Specifically, AI-assisted tools were used to create and enhance some promotional graphics, product renders, background visuals, and portions of the campaign video. These materials were reviewed, edited, and refined by our team before publication.

No AI-generated content was used in the design, engineering, functionality, specifications, prototyping, manufacturing, or fulfillment planning of the product. All product development decisions and technical work were completed by our team.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Yes. We used commercially available AI tools in accordance with their terms of service and licensing agreements. We did not intentionally use copyrighted third-party works, trademarks, or proprietary content without permission as inputs for generating campaign materials. All AI-generated graphics, renders, and video elements were created using prompts and assets that we had the right to use, and any generated content was reviewed and edited by our team before publication.

To the best of our knowledge, the AI-generated content used in this campaign complies with the applicable usage rights and licenses provided by the AI platforms used.

projects.ai_description_en:
TrackPod is a cross-platform item tracker designed to work seamlessly across both Apple and Android ecosystems — a combination most trackers simply can't offer. Compatible with Apple's Find My network and Android's Find Hub, TrackPod eliminates the platform barrier that has left mixed-device households in the lurch. No dedicated app is required; just attach it to your keys, bag, wallet, or luggage, and start tracking immediately through the native ecosystem you already use daily.

At the heart of TrackPod is a 365-day battery powered by a standard button-cell that requires no charging — swap it out when it runs low and you're back in action. Precision positioning technology guides you to your exact item rather than leaving you guessing within a general area, and a built-in speaker lets you trigger an audible alert to locate items hidden under cushions, in bags, or in pockets. Smart departure alerts notify you when you're about to leave without your tracked item, acting as a digital safety net before you walk out the door.

Built for real life, TrackPod carries an IPX6.5 water rating, shrugging off spills, rain, and sweat whether it's on your gym bag or luggage. Its compact, lightweight form factor makes it unobtrusive on everyday items, while the ability to rename each device — "Work Keys," "Travel Bag," or anything you choose — keeps your tracked items instantly recognizable. With compatibility across iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Mac, one TrackPod integrates effortlessly across your entire Apple setup.

TrackPod is available now on Kickstarter starting at just $25 for a single unit (Early Bird), with shipping to anywhere in the world and an estimated delivery of September 2026. For a tracker that bridges platforms, delivers a full year of battery life, asks for zero app downloads, and is built to survive daily use, TrackPod represents a refreshingly honest take on what an item tracker should be.

One year ago. Our first MVP, tested at a public library. Almost every childfigured it out within 30 seconds. Average session:over 40 minutes. We watched quiet kids turn intokids who couldn't stop talking, going from one-word whispers tofull sentencesby the end.

Early Reactions

What's in the Box

The Perfect Gift

The best gift for a child aged 4 to 12.Not a toy they'll put down. A creative identity they'll grow into.

Lifetime Creation

Every backer on Kikstarter getsunlimited AI sticker creation.

Not just a printer.

We didn't set out to build a printer.

The device is just the starting point. The app tracks how your child's vocabulary grows. The World Builder turns stickers into full stories. The Activity Hub turns creativity into a daily habit.

Together, they're one system with one goal: give your child a reason to keep creating.

The free companion app for iOS and Android.See every sticker your child has ever made, track how their vocabulary grows, and reprint anything in one tap.

Included free for 2 years with every Creator 1.

Molds are complete. The factory is moving. It's no longer a question of if — only when.

June 2026— Kickstarter campaign live

July 2026— Campaign ends. Production confirmed.

July – August 2026— Final production run & quality check

August – September 2026— Shipping begins. Founding members first.

Risks and challenges

Creator 1's tooling and molds are complete. We are in the pre-production phase — the physical hardware exists and works. The risks ahead are about time, not invention.

Software and hardware integration.
Final tuning of the software-hardware system may take longer than planned. If it does, we expect a delay of approximately one month from our current estimate. We will not ship a product that hasn't passed our internal quality bar — we'd rather be honest about a delay than rush something into your child's hands.

Safety certification and compliance.
Creator 1 is a children's product, and we take that seriously. Drop testing and regulatory certifications across key markets (including children's product safety standards in the US, EU, and other regions) can extend beyond initial timelines. We have already submitted our applications. If certification takes longer than expected, this may push our ship date. We will update backers the moment we know more.

Our commitment.
We will post a project update immediately if either of these timelines shifts — not weeks later, not buried in fine print. Backers who've trusted us with their money deserve to know first.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

The sticker images shown throughout this campaign were created using Creator 1 itself — the product being funded. Every image was generated by the device in response to a real child's spoken prompt, exactly as the product works in everyday use. These images are genuine product outputs, not marketing visuals created with external AI tools. They accurately represent what Creator 1 produces.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

Creator 1's image generation is powered byfal.ai, used under a commercial license that permits integration into consumer products and the generation of user-created content. We selected this provider specifically for its commercial licensing terms. The AI model operates within a closed, safety-filtered pipeline and does not retain or reproduce user inputs. All generated outputs are original sticker images produced in direct response to each child's unique spoken prompt.

I am incorporating AI in my project in another way.

AI is not a feature of Creator 1 — it is the product's primary operating mechanism. When a child holds the button and speaks, three AI layers activate in sequence: (1) voice-to-text converts the spoken prompt into text; (2) a 3-layer safety filter reviews and rewrites any unsafe content into something appropriate before any image is generated; (3) an image generation model produces the sticker artwork. The entire pipeline is bounded — no open-ended generation, no data stored on children, no outputs beyond the sticker image. The product is fully COPPA compliant with zero data collection on child users.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

Creator 1 is designed to last for years. It's USB-C rechargeable with no disposable batteries and requires no ink cartridges — the only consumable is standard thermal paper. We chose thermal printing specifically to eliminate ink waste from the product's lifecycle. Lifetime AI generation is built into the device from day one, so nothing becomes obsolete as the child grows.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Engineer, entrepreneur, and father of three. Over the past decade, I built two hardware companies and shipped products to 100+ countries, with deep expertise in thermal printing and global supply chains. Now, inspired by my daughter, I'm building creative AI-era products to raise the next generation of makers and creators.
projects.ai_description_en:
Creator1 is a screen-free device that transforms a child's spoken idea into a real, printable sticker they can color, stick, and build on. Designed for children ages 4 to 12, the product replaces passive screen time—where the average child now spends 4.5 hours a day watching rather than making—with a hands-on creative experience. The concept is simple: a child presses a button, says a word or phrase, and within moments holds a sticker they made themselves. Whether they say "a unicorn on a pizza slice" or "a robot with feelings," Creator1 generates a one-of-a-kind sticker to match.

The device is backed by a suite of tools that extend well beyond printing. A free companion app for iOS and Android lets parents see every sticker their child has ever made, track how their child's vocabulary grows over time, and reprint any design in one tap. A "World Builder" feature turns stickers into full stories, while an Activity Hub helps turn creative expression into a daily habit. Every Kickstarter backer receives lifetime unlimited AI sticker creation and a free app subscription for two years, making the purchase an ongoing creative platform rather than a one-time toy.

Creator1 is more than a printer—it's a complete creative ecosystem built around one goal: giving children a reason to keep creating. The company reports that early testing at a public library saw nearly every child figure out the device within 30 seconds, with average sessions lasting over 40 minutes. Even quiet children reportedly moved from one-word whispers to full sentences as they became engaged in the process. Creator1 positions itself as a meaningful alternative to tablets and phones, grounding children's imagination in something physical and tangible rather than ephemeral on a screen.

The product ships as a complete unit with molds and tooling already finished. The Founding Family tier is available at $79—39% off the projected $129 retail price—and includes a 12-month warranty. A Gift Edition at $99 comes in a premium gift box with a pastel paper pack included, positioned for birthday or holiday giving. Both tiers ship in Red or White, with color selection confirmed after the campaign. The company has indicated that all sticker images shown throughout the campaign were generated by Creator1 itself in response to real children's spoken prompts, demonstrating the product's output as it will ship to backers.

## Story

### Meet UKNIGHT

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/030/6308696903fb27f11388fc4a70ef5905_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781764851&width=680&sig=x%2Byf9VYu%2FWdgvKLh2VIFIh09Cp6iV92UqTd8de5RF9A%3D)

Most desktop speakers are just black boxes that play sound.

UKNIGHT was built to feel alive.

Part retro gadget, part ambient lantern, part pixel-art desk companion — UKNIGHT transforms your workspace, bedside table, gaming setup, or camping corner into something with personality. The glowing twin lanterns pulse beside your music, the pixel display quietly keeps time, and the top platform turns your favorite minifigure into the “pilot” of your own tiny atmosphere machine.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/139/114/e255ceb4c7298cdd2551aed99140c7bf_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781684763&width=680&sig=%2FY8IcUKQ9fLN0%2FWTxHeawzUdgmJB3Lg2mXSiroezq0Q%3D)

This isn’t just a Bluetooth speaker.

It’s the centerpiece your desk has been missing.

### A Speaker Designed Like a Sci-Fi Artifact

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/032/eddccf21f396676123161e019b64a2b7_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781764868&width=680&sig=cI4%2BXJ54AJtw1ESPTmQuXUuhiw%2FIpwg4PCXTbe4mx0o%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/139/296/73d82fddc75e7fd1c5db679290ecf603_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781685628&width=680&sig=CCGWMv%2FJSZ1AMIHNv7N9Pr4ets2xaW6zeanB6aSWq9M%3D)

UKNIGHT doesn’t look like traditional audio gear because it wasn’t designed like one.

Inspired by retro-futuristic consoles, pixel displays, and miniature exploration vehicles, the entire form factor was crafted to feel collectible before it even powers on. The glowing side lanterns create the silhouette of a tiny rover, while the front pixel display brings back the charm of old-school digital devices — only reimagined for modern setups.

It’s lightweight enough to carry around, but solid enough to feel like a real piece of gear.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/152/059/cad4d5df390eed28772ebdf49c417175_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781765031&width=680&sig=lGRojaE2%2BiSil9ziAWjh4JrH20Bsap6HSd3mXjf4%2F88%3D)

projects.ai_description_en:
UKNIGHT is a Bluetooth 6.0 speaker that reimagines desktop audio as a living, breathing sci-fi artifact. Drawing inspiration from retro-futuristic consoles and miniature exploration vehicles, this compact device combines a portable speaker, dual rotating lanterns, and a pixel-art display into a single collectible form. Measuring just 187 × 88 × 70 mm without its base, UKNIGHT functions as ambient lantern, pixel-art desk companion, and atmosphere engine simultaneously — designed to feel like a tiny rover that transforms any workspace, bedside table, gaming setup, or camping corner into something with personality.

At its core, UKNIGHT delivers surprisingly powerful audio with a signal-to-noise ratio above 90dB and Bluetooth 6.0 connectivity for faster pairing, lower latency, and stronger stability. The twin rotating lanterns — inspired by VTOL aircraft and orbital satellites — adjust independently and offer smooth 10%–100% brightness control with two distinct modes: Constant Light for task visibility and Breathing Light for atmosphere. Producing up to 200 lumens of illumination, these light modules turn the speaker into a portable atmosphere engine that adapts effortlessly from focused desk lighting to soft ambient glow.

What gives UKNIGHT its soul is the retro pixel display and the top-mounted minifigure platform. Beyond simply showing time and animated equalizer visuals inspired by classic digital devices, the screen keeps the speaker visually alive even when music stops playing. The Bluetooth auto-sync clock always stays accurate once paired with your phone. Meanwhile, the customizable minifigure platform invites you to attach your favorite building-block figure, transforming the entire product into a miniature sci-fi scene where your chosen character becomes the "pilot" of your personal atmosphere machine.

Designed for movement and versatility, UKNIGHT includes an outdoor hanging strap for attaching to tents, bags, or hooks, making it equally suited for late-night gaming sessions, workspace ambiance, bedside relaxation, or camping adventures. It’s an object built to be used and displayed — a tiny, glowing centerpiece that brings together sound, light, and personality in a way that traditional black-box speakers simply cannot.

projects.blurb: A 5000mAh pocket power system with magnetic snap-on modules for charging, cooling, lighting, misting, and daily carry.
projects.html_story:
A 5000mAh pocket power system with magnetic snap-on modules for charging, cooling, lighting, misting, and daily carry.

A 5000mAh pocket power system with magnetic snap-on modules for charging, cooling, lighting, misting, and daily carry.

Free 2-in-1 Fast Charging Cable

Share&Earn: 20% Cash Back

Introduction to SplitGo

7 Magnetic Modules

Double the Power - From 5,000mAh to 10,000mAh

SplitGo Comparison

Rewards & Add-ons

Environmental commitments

Free 2-in-1 Fast Charging Cable

As a small thank-you to our Kickstarter backers, we’ll include1× 2-in-1 Silicone Fast Charging Cablewith every pledge.

You don’t need to add it separately — it will be packed together with your reward before shipping.

One cable will be included per backer.

Share&Earn: 20% Cash Back

Introduction to SplitGo

7 Magnetic Modules

With five lighting modes — Spotlight, Strobe, Ambient, Candlelight, and Emergency — it can handle different moments from night walks and camping setups to power outages and roadside situations.

Press to switch between modes, or long press to adjust the brightness. Use it as a focused beam when you need visibility, a soft ambient light when you’re relaxing outdoors, or an emergency signal when the situation calls for it.

Double the Power - From 5,000mAh to 10,000mAh

From iPhone fast charging to high-speed USB-C charging, SplitGo gives you a small backup power source that’s ready when your battery starts running low.

Carry one small battery. Use it in more ways.

Charge your phone when you need power, or snap on a module when you need light, airflow, mist, shaving, or an emergency spark.

SplitGo Comparison

Why carry multiple gadgets when one modular system can do more?

Rewards & Add-ons

Estimated delivery: September 2026We’re working to keep production, quality checks, and shipping on schedule.

We are a small product team focused on creating practical everyday-carry gear for modern life, travel, and outdoor use.

Why do we always need to carry so many separate gadgets? A power bank, a flashlight, a mini fan, a shaver, a lighter, a mist sprayer — each one can be useful, but carrying all of them separately quickly becomes bulky and inconvenient.

So we began exploring a different approach: one compact power source that can work with different functional modules. Instead of designing another regular power bank, we wanted to build a modular system that can adapt to different situations — from daily commuting and short trips to camping, outdoor activities, and emergency moments.

Our team has experience in product design, electronics development, mechanical structure, supply chain coordination, and crowdfunding operations. During the development of SplitGo, we worked closely on the magnetic connection structure, battery module design, module stability, charging performance, and the overall user experience of switching between different functions.

We know that a modular product is not only about adding more accessories. Each module needs to feel useful, easy to attach, and reliable in real situations. That is why we spent time refining the connection method, testing different module combinations, and making sure the product stays compact enough for everyday carry.

See SplitGo in Real Use

For this Kickstarter campaign, our goal is to bring SplitGo to backers who want a more flexible and practical power system — something that can charge your devices, support useful add-ons, and reduce the need to carry multiple small gadgets.

We’re excited to share SplitGo with the Kickstarter community and continue improving it with your support and feedback.

Risks and challenges

SplitGo is a modular electronic product, so the main challenges are magnetic connection stability, contact pin durability, battery safety, production consistency, and module performance.

Before mass production, we will continue testing the magnetic structure, battery protection system, charging performance, and each functional module.

If there are any changes caused by tooling, component supply, certification preparation, or quality control, we will keep backers updated throughout the process.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

SplitGo is designed as a modular power system. Instead of replacing the whole device, users can keep using the core battery module and switch between different functional modules based on their needs. This helps extend the product’s usable life and reduce unnecessary replacement.

Reusability and recyclability

The modular structure allows one 5000mAh battery module to power multiple snap-on modules, such as charging, fan, flashlight, mist sprayer, and shaver modules. By combining several daily-use tools into one system, SplitGo helps reduce the need to carry and purchase multiple separate devices.

SplitGo uses a replaceable modular structure, making it easier for users to continue using compatible modules in the future. We are also working to refine the product structure before mass production to improve durability, assembly stability, and long-term usability.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: A small product team focused on practical everyday-carry gear for modern life, travel, and outdoor use, with experience in product design, electronics, mechanical structure, supply chain, and crowdfunding.
projects.ai_description_en:
SplitGo is a compact magnetic modular power system built around a 5000mAh pocket battery core that snaps together with interchangeable modules to become the exact tool you need, when you need it. Instead of hauling a separate power bank, flashlight, fan, mist sprayer, shaver, lighter, and multiple cables, you carry one slim base battery and the functional cartridges that match the moment. The magnetic connection is designed to be quick and confident, letting you go from charging your phone to lighting a dark campsite paths with a simple snap.

The system includes seven magnetic modules that cover everyday carry, outdoor use, and unexpected situations. A multi-mode flashlight offers spotlight, strobe, ambient, candlelight, and emergency settings, with press-to-switch and long-press brightness control. A mini fan delivers instant airflow for hot commutes or tent stuffiness. An arc lighter provides windproof, flameless ignition, while a nano mist sprayer adds a refreshing touch on the move. A shaver module handles quick touch-ups, and the charging modules expand your power-sharing options: a single charging module, a dual charging module, and the ability to double the base battery from 5000mAh to 10000mAh by stacking a second battery module for longer trips or heavy use.

Designed for people who value simplicity without sacrificing capability, SplitGo keeps bulk down and versatility high. Each module is tested for magnetic connection stability and contact durability, so the flashlight stays tight during a night hike and the mist module clicks into place without wobble. The core 5000mAh battery supports fast charging for modern phones, and every pledge comes with a free 2-in-1 silicone fast charging USB-A to USB-C cable—no separate purchase needed, packed with your reward before it ships. Whether you are commuting, traveling, camping, or preparing for emergencies, the system adapts to the day instead of making you carry a bag full of single-use gadgets.

SplitGo is also built with longevity in mind. The modular design means you can keep the core battery and upgrade or replace individual functional modules over time, rather than discarding an entire device when your needs change. This approach reduces e-waste while making it easy to swap in new capabilities as they become available. As a small product team focused on practical everyday-carry gear, we have spent significant time refining the magnetic structure, battery protection, charging performance, and module stability to feel reliable in daily use. With an estimated delivery in September 2026, your support helps bring this flexible, modular power system from concept to pocket, and we are committed to keeping you updated throughout production and testing.

projects.blurb: The Defenders And Disciples Behavioral Optical Decision Device (DADBODD) is a visual stimulus shot timer for firearms training.
projects.html_story:
All or nothing.This project will only be funded if it reaches its goal by Sat, July 18 2026 4:00 PM EDT.

The Defenders And Disciples Behavioral Optical Decision Device (DADBODD) is a visual stimulus shot timer for firearms training.

The Defenders And Disciples Behavioral Optical Decision Device (DADBODD) is a visual stimulus shot timer for firearms training.

All or nothing.This project will only be funded if it reaches its goal by Sat, July 18 2026 4:00 PM EDT.

Two Problems with Firearms Training

Three Versions. Thousands of Hours. One Mission

The Latest DADBODD

What the DADBODD Does

Built for the people who actually need it

Why Kickstarter?

Warranty and Repair

Two Problems with Firearms Training

1. Front Sight Focus

Most firearms training courses tell students to focus on their front sight so that the target is blurry.

However, in a real-life shooting, you need to be threat focused so that you can process the threat in real-time while also knowing when it is no longer a threat.

2. Scripted Training

Firearms training is mostly scripted.

We tell the student what the drill is, how many shots to fire, and where to shoot. They wait for the buzzer or command to fire, then they complete the drill.

No thinking. No processing. Just theatrics.

But in a real-world gunfight, you don't know how many shots you will need to fire.

I'm Taylor. Marine veteran, former police officer, and mechanical engineer.

I've spent years in the military and law enforcement, watching people train hard with the wrong tools and walk away with a false sense of readiness because of the training problems I listed above.

So I decided to create a solution.

I wanted to create anaffordable anduser-friendlyvisual stimulus shot timer so that students had to stay threat-focused and process information from the threat while shooting.

We say we shoot to stop the threat, but very rarely do we train to stop shooting when the threat stops.

So, one night, after some divine inspiration, I wired the first circuit.

That was the beginning of the Defenders And Disciples Behavioral Optical Decision Device... or.... theDADBODD

Three Versions. Thousands of Hours. One Mission

Version 1was rough. It worked, but barely.

Version 2was better and good enough to get into the hands of real instructors and start collecting real feedback.

Version 3is what you're backing today.

Every iteration was built in my office or garage, tested at the range, and refined based on what actually happened when real people used it under real conditions.

No focus groups.

No venture capital.

Just a founder with a vision who couldn't sleep until it was right.

Here's a video of me critiquing V2 and revealing V3:

The Latest DADBODD

After sending V2 out to instructors all over the U.S. to test and give me feedback, I finally was ready to build V3, which is what you are backing if you support this project.

What the DADBODD Does

The DADBODD is a handheld visual stimulus shot timer for firearms training. Instead of a beep, it uses a laser (colored light that tells you when to shoot, when to stop, and what to do in between).

It runs two modes:

DADBODD Mode— the core training tool. The laser fires a visual stimulus at a random interval. You engage based on what you see.

Shot count, reaction time, and post-threat shots are all tracked.

The device tells you how many shots you fired during the threat window and how many you fired after it ended. That last number matters more than most people realize.

DADBODD mode can be used via Manual fire where someone controls when the laser turns on/off, or in Auto mode for solo training where the laser fires randomly.

Shot Timer Mode— a full-featured traditional shot timer built right in. Par times, mic sensitivity adjustment, review mode. Everything you'd expect from a standalone timer, in the same device.

MANTIS Mode— The DADBODD also works with MantisX training systems.

One tool. Three training systems. $199.

Built for the people who actually need it

This isn't a gimmick or a range toy.

It's for the concealed carrier who takes their responsibility seriously. The officer who wants to train smarter between qualifications. The instructor who wants to run decision-making drills without a $1,000 piece of equipment.

The DADBODD is patent pending.

It has been tested in the field by working instructors. And it was built by someone who has stood in the situations this device trains for.

Why Kickstarter?

I didn't want to build a product without first proving the market existed. The performance of this Kickstarter project will dictate whether that market exists.

I spent the last year getting feedback from instructors and individual users just like you to ensure I provide the product you want, not the product I think you want.

I'm not a corporation. I'm a founder building this by hand in Tennessee. Kickstarter is how I fund the first production run and get the DADBODD into the hands of the people who need it most.

85 people and counting have already put money down before this campaign even launched. These are our DADBODD Pre-Launch VIPs. They believed in this before there was a Kickstarter page, a video, or a polished product photo.

If you train with a gun, or if you care about someone who does, this is the tool that's been missing.

Support the DADBODD Kickstarter.

Train to a Higher Standard.

Warranty and Repair

Life happens. Here's how we handle it if life happens to your DADBODD.

Every DADBODD comes with a 1-year Limited Warranty covering manufacturing defects, workmanship issues, and firmware faults. If your unit fails due to a manufacturer's defect during that year, we'll repair or replace it at no charge.

What's covered:

Defects in materials and workmanship

Firmware bugs and faults affecting normal operation

Battery failure (6 months from delivery)

What's NOT covered:

Drops, impacts, gunshots, burns, or other physical damage

Water, moisture, or liquid exposure

Damage from solvents, unapproved cleaners, fuels, sunscreens, or insect repellents

Heat damage from being left baking in a vehicle on a hot day or baking in the sun.

Any disassembly of the device voids the warranty entirely, regardless of the original cause of the issue

Modifications, unauthorized firmware, modifying the firmware, or third-party repair attempts

Normal cosmetic wear and tear

When something breaks that's not covered - "DADBODD Makeover" Repair Service:

Dropped it on the concrete and cracked the body? Left it in a hot truck all day? Give it to a Marine and they broke it? Sometimes life beats up your gear. If your DADBODD is damaged in a way that's outside the warranty, we offer a flat-rate repair service:

Most damage is repairable (even damage done by a Marine). If a unit is beyond economic repair, we'll let you know and offer options.

How the DADBODD Makeover works:

Email me atTaylor@DefendersAndDisciples.comwith your serial/order number, description of the issue, and photos/videos.

We review your photos/videos and provide an initial assessment.

If repair looks viable, we'll provide an RMA number for a $50 diagnostic/repair fee, and ship-to address.

You pay the diagnostic/repair fee and ship the device to us (insured, tracked shipping recommended).

We diagnose the damage and send you a repair quote. The $50 diagnostic fee applies toward the final repair cost.

If you approve the quote, we repair or replace at our discretion and ship the device back (you cover return shipping).

If you decline repair, we return the device at your cost or scrap it with your permission. The diagnostic fee is non-refundable and retained as payment for our assessment.

Typical turnaround: 2-4 weeks from receipt of approved work.

Full Limited Warranty terms:https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vT893Je95-0vasyiWjcedQDkfEhybCPxKbOzSWp7JF-cNMTu-gYdqbHNKwkF9DimIzZb2FL4KAnERY0/pubQuestions:Taylor@DefendersAndDisciples.com

Risks and challenges

The DADBODD is a first production run from a small founder-operated company. Here's what you should know upfront.

Hardware: This is not experimental technology. The device has been range tested and is functionally complete.

Compliance: FDA CDRH laser product registration is in process. FCC compliance documentation is being finalized. Both will be completed before any units ship.

Timeline: I'm building and fulfilling these units myself in TN. I've accounted for component lead times and have sourced suppliers. If anything impacts the timeline, I will communicate with backers immediately and publicly.

Large Scale Production: If the DADBODD Kickstarter project goes exceptionally well and we have way more orders than I can reasonably assemble on my own, we will explore other means for manufacturing. However, you will still receive a DADBODD that performance equal or better than the current version. 

I'm not a corporation with a warehouse. I'm a Marine veteran and former cop who built this because the training tool I needed didn't exist at a price real people could afford. I will do whatever it takes to deliver every unit on time.

COVERAGE & DELIVERY RISK

I have built and tested working prototypes with active 
military, law enforcement, and instructor contacts. The 
hardware and firmware are mature. I've manufactured 
small batches successfully and have validated our 
production process.

That said, hardware manufacturing at scale carries real 
risks: supply chain delays, quality control issues at 
volume, and the possibility of defects that don't show 
up until units are in customer hands. We've reserved a 
portion of pledge funds specifically to address quality 
issues, support, and warranty claims after delivery. 
We are not spending 100% of pledge revenue on production.

If a defect emerges that affects multiple units, our 
commitment is straightforward: we will communicate 
openly with backers, repair or replace affected devices 
at no charge, and resolve the issue. Honest 
communication is the standard we hold ourselves to.

I've built this device because I believe in it. I'm 
in this for the long term. DADBODD is the start of 
a product line, not a one-time campaign.

Most courses teach students to focus on their front sight while the target goes blurry—fine for marksmanship, but counterproductive when real threats demand constant situational awareness and split-second decision-making. Meanwhile, heavily scripted drills tell shooters exactly how many rounds to fire and when, eliminating the cognitive processing required in actual defensive encounters. The DADBODD forces users to remain threat-focused, interpret visual cues from the target, and exercise judgment about when to engage and—crucially—when to stop shooting once the threat has been neutralized.

This is not experimental technology. The current device is the product of thousands of hours of iterative development across three versions, refined through real-world testing with active military, law enforcement, and firearms instructor contacts. The hardware and firmware are mature, range tested, and functionally complete, meaning backers receive a training tool built on validated engineering rather than an unproven prototype. The project is led by Taylor, a Marine veteran, former police officer, and mechanical engineer who created the DADBODD after watching people train hard with inadequate tools and walk away with a false sense of readiness. This first production run is built and fulfilled personally in Tennessee by the founder himself, not a corporate warehouse.

Two reward tiers are available: the base DADBODD at $199 includes one device in all black with an instruction manual, while the $299 Range Kit adds a color upgrade, Swiss Arca mount, retroreflective panel, and hard case for a complete training setup. Both tiers ship to the United States only with an estimated October 2026 delivery. Every unit ships with a 1-year Limited Warranty against manufacturing defects, plus a flat-rate repair service for damage outside warranty coverage, and the founder has reserved a portion of pledge funds specifically for post-delivery quality support and warranty claims. FDA CDRH laser product registration and FCC compliance documentation are being finalized and will be completed before any units ship. This campaign represents the beginning of a product line, not a one-time project—built by someone who has been in the trenches and refuses to let backers down.

projects.blurb: The production technology of the future is now on your desktop!
projects.html_story:
The production technology of the future is now on your desktop!

The production technology of the future is now on your desktop!

🛠️ What is the product?
