🛠️ What is the development process of the project?

💖 Why would you support this project?

Environmental commitments

Today, 3D printers are widely being used in various fields, including healthcare, medical, construction, manufacturing, education, and many others. The possibilities offered by this technology are being actively utilized in more and more industries every day.Kare 3D is a startup established with the goal of developing and producing 3D printers. While developing our products, we aim to offer solutions with superior features compared to our competitors, focusing on criteria such as functionality, accessibility, and durability.With the 3D printer we have developed, we aim to produce high-tech products and grow our startup to offer competitive solutions in the global arena.

The founder of Kare 3D, Ümit Coşkun, graduated from the Department of Electrical and Electronics Engineering. His interest in 3D printers started in high school and developed through experiments in his father’s workshop. After graduating from university, he brought this passion to life by founding his own company.Kare 3D specializes in the production of desktop 3D printers and has launched a campaign on Kickstarter to grow this innovative technology. Under the leadership of Ümit Coşkun, our goal is to develop high-tech products and offer competitive solutions on the global stage.

🛠️ What is the product?

At Kare 3D, we aim to produce high-performance and affordable desktop 3D printers. Our 3D printer stands out with a print head capable of heating up to 550°C and a print bed that can reach up to 150°C. These high-temperature features allow you to print with a wide range of materials. Additionally, our printer can reach printing speeds of up to 500 mm/s, making it faster than many competitors.Supporting both metal and plastic printing, this innovative technology can help you bring your ideas to life. Please support our Kickstarter campaign to help us make this technology a reality. Thank you for joining us!

🌟 What are the advantages of the product?

Kare 3D Printer: Superior Performance and Versatility•High Temperature Capacity: Enjoy the freedom to work with a wide range of materials, thanks to a print head that can heat up to 550°C and a print bed that can reach 150°C.•Versatility: Our desktop 3D printers, capable of printing with both metal and plastic, offer solutions suitable for any project.•Additional Equipment: Take your projects a step further with the Kare Metal Set, which includes a sintering furnace and a washing set for metal printing.•High Print Speed: With a print speed of up to 500 mm/s, our printer allows for faster and more efficient production.Discover the advantages of high-performance and affordable 3D printers with Kare 3D. Support our Kickstarter campaign to help bring our innovative technology to life. Thank you for joining us!

WHAT ARE THE ADVANTAGES OF OUR PRODUCT?

Kare 3D Printer: Superior Performance and Versatility•High Temperature Capacity: Enjoy the freedom to work with a wide range of materials, thanks to a print head that can heat up to 550°C and a print bed that can reach 150°C.•Versatility: Our desktop 3D printers, capable of printing with both metal and plastic, offer solutions suitable for any project.•Additional Equipment: Take your projects a step further with the Kare Metal Set, which includes a sintering furnace and a washing set for metal printing.•High Print Speed: With a print speed of up to 500 mm/s, our printer allows for faster and more efficient production.Discover the advantages of high-performance and affordable 3D printers with Kare 3D. Support our Kickstarter campaign to help bring our innovative technology to life. Thank you for joining us!

🔍 Get to Know the Kare S Series

Technical Specifications:

Print Head Temperature:Up to 550°C

Print Bed Temperature:Up to 150°C

Print Speed:Up to 500 mm/s

Print Materials:Metal and plastic

Build Volume:S1: 200 x 200 x 200 mm / S1 Plus: 200 x 200 x 480 mm

Resolution:10 microns

Display:4.3-inch touchscreen

Connectivity:USB, SD Card, Wi-Fi

Extruder Type:Direct Drive / Orbiter Extruder

Software Compatibility:Compatible with Kare Slicer, Cura, Simplify3D, Repetier-Host

Frame Material:Aluminum frame

Power Supply:110V/220V, 50/60Hz

Introducing the New Kare3D Printer UI Interface

At Kare3D, we are excited to introduce our newly developed printer UI interface, designed to enhance user experience and streamline the 3D printing process. Our innovative interface offers a range of features that make it easier than ever to create high-quality prints with precision and ease.

✨ Kare UI Key Features

Intuitive Touchscreen:Our 4.3-inch touchscreen display provides a user-friendly and responsive interface, allowing you to easily navigate through settings and options.

Real-Time Monitoring:Keep track of your print progress in real-time with detailed status updates and live visuals of your ongoing projects.

Customizable Settings:Fine-tune your printing parameters with ease. Our interface allows you to adjust temperature, speed, and other settings to suit your specific needs.

Preset Profiles:Save and load custom profiles for different materials and projects, ensuring consistent and reliable results every time.

Remote Access:With Wi-Fi connectivity, you can control and monitor your printer from anywhere using your smartphone or computer.

Automatic Updates:Stay up-to-date with the latest features and improvements. Our UI interface supports over-the-air updates, ensuring your printer always has the latest enhancements.

🎁 What rewards will backers receive?

Our backers will receive special discounts and early access to Kare3D printers when they support us with a certain amount. Additionally, they will have the opportunity to purchase the Kare metal set, which includes the necessary sintering oven and washing kit for metal printing, at advantageous prices. Moreover, they will receive a jacket and fleece from Teknofest, Turkey’s aerospace and technology festival, as a gift.

🔍 Discover Our Product Family

🛠️ What is the development process of the project?

We have successfully completed the prototype phase and have tested our products extensively. Now, we are raising funds to start the production and distribution process. With the support of our backers, we aim to move into mass production and deliver our products to users worldwide.

💖 Why would you support this project?

At Kare3D, we aim to offer innovative and versatile solutions in 3D printing technologies. Our products are suitable for both hobbyists and professionals, offering a wide range of applications. With your support, we want to bring this innovative technology to a broader audience.

Risks and challenges

As with any innovative project, Kare 3D faces several potential risks and challenges. We are committed to transparency and have outlined these below along with our plans to overcome them:

1. Production Delays: Manufacturing new technology can sometimes lead to unforeseen delays. To mitigate this, we have partnered with experienced manufacturers and suppliers, and we have built in buffer time to our production schedule to account for any unexpected issues.

2. Supply Chain Disruptions: Global supply chain disruptions can impact the availability of necessary components. We have established relationships with multiple suppliers to ensure we have alternative sources for key components and are closely monitoring global supply chain dynamics.

3. Technical Issues: Developing a 3D printer with advanced capabilities such as 550-degree print head and 150-degree print bed, as well as achieving 500 mm/s print speeds, involves technical complexities. Our team consists of experienced engineers and technicians who have successfully completed similar projects. We are also conducting extensive testing and quality assurance to ensure reliability and performance.

4. Market Competition: The 3D printing market is highly competitive. We differentiate ourselves with unique features such as high-temperature printing capabilities and high-speed printing. We are confident that our advanced features and competitive pricing will position us well in the market.

5. Customer Support and Service: Providing timely and effective customer support is crucial. We have established a dedicated customer support team that is trained to handle technical inquiries and provide prompt assistance to our backers.

6. Regulatory Approvals: Ensuring compliance with international safety and quality standards is essential. We are working with regulatory experts to ensure our products meet all necessary certifications and standards in the markets we aim to enter.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We employ several strategies to ensure the longevity of Kare 3D printers:

1. High-Quality Materials: We use high-quality and durable materials in the production of our printers. This ensures the device operates reliably over a long period.

2. High-Temperature Components: Our print head can reach up to 550 degrees Celsius, and the print bed can reach up to 150 degrees Celsius. These high-temperature components allow working with a wide range of materials, enhancing the device's performance.

3. Advanced Engineering: Our team consists of experienced professionals in 3D printer design and engineering. Our designs are optimized for durability and long-lasting performance.

4. Extensive Testing: Each printer undergoes rigorous testing for durability and performance during the production phase. These tests ensure that our printers operate smoothly for an extended period.

5. Easy Maintenance and Support: Our printers are designed to be easily maintained by users. Additionally, we have a dedicated support team to assist our users with technical support and spare parts supply.

6. Upgradeable Hardware and Software: The hardware and software of our printers are designed to be compatible with future updates. This allows users to keep their printers up-to-date with new features and improvements.

projects.ai_intro_en: The Kare S Series is a high-performance desktop 3D printer featuring a 550°C print head and 150°C heated bed, enabling printing with both metal and plastic materials at speeds up to 500 mm/s. Developed by Kare 3D, this innovative printer aims to deliver professional-grade capabilities at an accessible price point for makers and professionals alike.
ai_highlights_en: High-temperature printing up to 550°C nozzle and 150°C bed for diverse materials
Ultra-fast print speeds up to 500 mm/s for efficient production
Dual metal and plastic printing capability with optional Metal Set
projects.ai_risks_en: As a crowdfunding project, backers face typical risks including potential delivery delays, manufacturing challenges, and the uncertainty inherent in supporting early-stage startups.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Kare 3D is a startup founded by Ümit Coşkun, an Electrical and Electronics Engineering graduate passionate about 3D printing since high school.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Kare 3D Desktop Metal 3D Printer represents a leap forward in accessible manufacturing technology, bringing high-performance production capabilities directly to your workspace. Developed by a startup founded by Electrical and Electronics Engineering graduate Ümit Coşkun, this printer is engineered to democratize advanced 3D printing across diverse industries, from healthcare and education to manufacturing and construction. By prioritizing functionality, accessibility, and durability, Kare 3D empowers creators, engineers, and hobbyists to bring their most ambitious ideas to life without the prohibitive costs typically associated with high-tech manufacturing. 

At its core, the Kare 3D printer delivers exceptionally high-temperature performance and rapid output, setting it apart from traditional desktop machines. It features a print head capable of reaching 550°C and a print bed that heats up to 150°C, allowing users to work with an extensive range of high-performance materials, including both metal and plastic. Furthermore, the printer achieves remarkable print speeds of up to 500 mm/s, drastically reducing production times while maintaining precision. For users focusing on metal fabrication, the Kare Metal Set provides a complete post-processing ecosystem, featuring a sintering furnace and washing set to turn printed metal prints into fully functional, solid parts.

The true value of the Kare 3D printer lies in its unparalleled versatility and competitive edge. By combining metal and plastic printing capabilities with industry-leading temperature thresholds and high-speed output, it offers a level of material freedom and performance usually reserved for much more expensive industrial equipment. Whether you are prototyping complex components, creating durable end-use parts, or experimenting with advanced high-temperature filaments, the Kare S Series provides the robust tools necessary to succeed in a highly competitive global market.

✨ Your Workspace Shouldn't Be A Mystery

Modern workspaces depend on displays, storage devices, networks, chargers, and peripherals working together seamlessly. Yet most docking stations give you almost no visibility into what's actually happening behind those connections.

🎨Create Without Limits

Keep tools, references, and ideas visible in one organized workspace.

🎬Enjoy More Than One Screen

Turn everyday viewing into a cleaner and more immersive experience.

🎉 Choose Your Reward

❤️ About Lemoreleexpand

With over 10 years of experience in the connectivity and consumer electronics industry, the Lemoreleexpand team has remained focused on developing practical and innovative products designed for modern digital lifestyles. Our team combines expertise in hardware engineering, industrial design, product development, and manufacturing to create solutions that improve how people work, connect, and interact with technology every day.

Our goal has never been to create generic accessories. Instead, we aim to build smarter workspace tools that solve real productivity challenges faced by modern users, creators, remote workers, and professionals. From product architecture to user interaction design, we believe every detail should contribute to a cleaner, more efficient, and more intuitive workflow experience.

Throughout the years, we have continued refining our manufacturing processes, quality control standards, and product testing systems to ensure reliable long-term performance across different devices and usage environments. We believe innovation is not only about adding more features, but about creating products that genuinely improve the user experience in meaningful ways.

Through this Kickstarter campaign, we hope to bring Lemoreleexpand to a wider global audience while continuing to gather feedback from creators, professionals, and technology enthusiasts around the world. Your support will help us further expand our vision of building smarter and more connected workspace solutions for the future.

Risks and challenges

As with any hardware product, bringing Lemorelee from development to large-scale production involves several challenges, including manufacturing coordination, component sourcing, firmware optimization, compatibility testing, and logistics management. Because this product supports multiple operating systems, display protocols, and connected device types, extensive testing is required to ensure stable performance across a wide range of usage scenarios.

To minimize these risks, our team has already completed core product development, structural design, and functional validation before launching this campaign. We are also working closely with experienced manufacturing and supply chain partners to maintain consistent production quality and delivery timelines. Additional testing and optimization will continue throughout the production stage to further improve compatibility and long-term stability.

While unexpected delays related to supply chains, international logistics, or component availability may still occur, we are committed to maintaining transparent communication with our backers throughout the entire process. Our priority is to deliver a reliable, high-quality product that meets both our standards and the expectations of our supporters.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Lemoreleexpand is a team with over 10 years of experience in connectivity and consumer electronics, focused on developing practical products for modern digital lifestyles.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Lemoreleexpand Smart Dock redefines what a desktop docking station can do by bringing real-time workspace visibility directly to your desk. Unlike traditional docks that leave you guessing about connection speeds, display status, and charging power, Lemoreleexpand features a built-in Workspace Dashboard that displays monitor resolution, refresh rate, network performance, storage activity, and charging information at a glance. No more digging through system settings or launching diagnostic tools — the information you need is always right in front of you, making it easier to identify bottlenecks before they impact your workflow.

For users who demand more screen real estate, Lemoreleexpand delivers impressive expansion capabilities through a single USB-C connection. The dock supports up to dual 4K displays at 60Hz via built-in HDMI and DisplayPort connectivity, giving you the visual clarity and screen space needed for demanding creative or professional workflows. Whether you're running mirrored displays for presentations or independent multi-screen setups for multitasking, the dock adapts to match how you actually work. A dedicated one-touch control button lets you quickly manage your display configuration without navigating software menus.

Powering both your laptop and the entire dock, the Lemoreleexpand provides 100W PD charging alongside 10Gbps data expansion for USB devices, memory cards, and Gigabit Ethernet connections. The design prioritizes thermal management to keep the dock cool even under heavy workloads, which is essential for maintaining stable performance during extended use. With taxes included in the Super Early Bird price of $89 and worldwide shipping planned for September 2026, Lemoreleexpand aims to eliminate the mystery of modern workspaces and give you total control over your digital environment.

The project has already completed core development, structural design, and functional validation, with ongoing compatibility testing across multiple operating systems and device types to ensure reliable performance for all backers.

projects.name: Smart Joystick Controller -ESP32-S3 for Robotics & Gaming
projects.blurb: Programmable ESP32-S3 handheld with LCD, dual joysticks, haptic feedback, and real-time control for robots and games.
projects.html_story:
Programmable ESP32-S3 handheld with LCD, dual joysticks, haptic feedback, and real-time control for robots and games.

Programmable ESP32-S3 handheld with LCD, dual joysticks, haptic feedback, and real-time control for robots and games.

Smart Joystick Controller Features:

Built Around ESP32-S3

Meet theSmart Joystick Controllerthe compactESP32-S3-based handheld device designed for people who like to build, experiment, and interact with technology in a more direct way.

At its core, it’s a controller — but it’s also a programmable platform. You can use it to control robots, play games, interact with your computer, or develop entirely new use cases of your own.It combines physical controls, a built-in display, and wireless capability into a single device that fits comfortably in your hand.

Most controllers are designed for a single purpose. Gaming controllers are closed systems. Development boards lack physical interaction. Robotics controllers are often bulky or limited.

Smart Joystick Controller Features:

ESP32-S3 Dual-Core Processor

2.0" Color LCD Display

Dual Analog Joysticks with 5-Axis Control

6 Programmable User Buttons

Real-Time Video Display Support

USB Type-C for Programming and Power

Built-in Vibration Motor for Haptic Feedback

IR Transmitter for Remote Control Applications

Battery Connector for Portable Operation

Dedicated Power Switch

Reset & Boot Buttons for Development

Wireless Connectivity via ESP32-S3

Fully Programmable and Open for Custom Development

Compatible with Arduino, ESP-IDF, and MicroPython

Compact Handheld Design

We wanted something that brings all of this together — a device that is:

Useful across multiple domains

The Smart Joystick Controller is the result of that idea.

Built Around ESP32-S3

The controller is powered by the ESP32-S3, which means it’s not just a device you use — it’s a device you can program.

Custom control systems

Wireless communication tools

IoT applications

It works with familiar environments like Arduino, a, and ESP-IDF.

USB Type-C Interface

Wireless Wi-Fi Communication

Bluetooth Communication

IR Transmission Capability

Haptic Feedback Motor (Vibration)

Battery Connector

Power Status Indicator LED

USB Powered Operation

Integrated Display for Real-Time Feedback

The 2.0-inch LCD is more than just a screen. It allows you to:

View live video from a connected robot

Display system data or telemetry

Build your own user interfaces

This turns the controller into an interactive system rather than just an input device.

Precise Physical Controls

The hardware is designed to feel responsive and flexible:

Dual analog joysticks with 5-axis control

Six programmable buttons

Dedicated reset and boot buttons

This setup makes it suitable for both gaming and precise robotic control.

Feedback and Interaction

To make interaction more engaging and informative, the controller includes:

RGB LED for visual feedback

Vibration motor for haptic response

Power indicators and onboard controls

These features help create a more immersive and responsive experience.

Connectivity and Expansion

The Smart Joystick Controller is built to connect easily:

USB Type-C for power, programming, and PC connection

Battery connector with power switch

IR transmitter for additional control possibilities

You can use it as a standalone device or connect it directly to your computer.

What You Can Do With It

Robotics Control- Use the controller to operate robotic cars, drones, or custom builds. With the onboard display, you can view live camera feeds while controlling movement in real time.

Gaming- Turn it into a portable gaming device or use it as a controller for PC games. You can even develop your own games tailored to the hardware.

PC Interaction- Use it as a USB controller or build custom HID-based tools for interacting with your computer in new ways.

Development Platform

This is where the device becomes most powerful. It’s a platform for experimentation.

You can prototype ideas, test interfaces, and build complete systems around it.

This product is designed for:

Makers and hardware enthusiasts

Developers working with embedded systems

Educators and students

Anyone interested in building and experimenting with technology

What You’ll Receive

Each unit includes:

Smart Joystick Controller

USB Type-C cable

Documentation and example projects

We’re launching on Kickstarter to bring this product to a wider community and to build it together with early supporters.

Your support helps us move into full-scale production and continue developing new features and improvements.

Risks and challenges

We believe in full transparency.

While we have completed functional prototypes and validated the core hardware (ESP32-S3 controller, motion sensor integration, and LED cascade system), there are still potential challenges that can arise:

🔹 Component Availability

Global supply fluctuations for ESP32 modules or electronic components could affect production timelines. To reduce this risk, we are working with multiple suppliers and planning buffer inventory for critical parts.

🔹 Manufacturing & Assembly

Scaling from prototype to mass production may introduce minor delays related to PCB fabrication, assembly, or quality control. We are partnering with experienced manufacturing facilities to ensure consistency and reliability.

🔹 Firmware Optimization

As this is a modular and expandable system, firmware optimization for large multi-board setups may require additional fine-tuning. We have already tested multi-board configurations and will continue improving performance before shipping.

🔹 Shipping & Logistics

International shipping timelines may vary depending on region and customs processing. We will use reliable, trackable shipping methods to minimize issues.

We are committed to proactive communication. If any unexpected challenges arise, we will keep backers informed with regular updates and clear timelines.

Our goal is simple: deliver a high-quality, expandable, motion-responsive LED system that exceeds expectations.

projects.ai_risks_en: Key risks include global component shortages affecting ESP32 module availability, potential delays in scaling from prototype to mass production, firmware optimization challenges for multi-board configurations, and variable international shipping timelines. The team is mitigating these through multiple supplier partnerships, buffer inventory, experienced manufacturing partners, and trackable shipping methods.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: The Open Gadget is a hardware innovation company focused on creating open, programmable electronics for makers, developers, educators, and technology enthusiasts. We design products that combine creativity, learning, and real-world applications, empowering users to build, experiment, and innovate.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Smart Joystick Controller is a handheld devices built around an **ESP32-S3** microcontroller, combining a compact form factor with a set of I/O interfaces that let developers embed input, output, and wireless capabilities into a single unit. It integrates a **2.0-inch color LCD**, **dual 5-axis joysticks**, vibration feedback, RGB LED, an IR transmitter, and programmable buttons, and connects to a host computer or other devices over **Wired Connectivity** and **Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth**.

As a prototyping tool, the controller provides immediate access to its sensors and peripherals through standard libraries. The ESP32‑S3 processor’s GPIO, wireless radios, and modest storage can be used to read joystick positions, display status information on the LCD, send commands wirelessly, or log data to a USB‑connected PC, allowing developers to focus on higher-level logic without extensive hardware design work.

The platform is intended for accessible physical computing, such as building custom control panels, interactive exhibits, or robotics prototypes. The combination of haptic feedback, color indication, and programmable buttons often helps evaluate ergonomics and control mappings without soldering additional circuit boards. By treating the controller as a self‑contained interaction module, developers can more quickly experiment with how users engage with programmable systems.

## Story

### WHY NORAVO SUNBAG EXISTS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/658/e0b17f02b8bf4ac60d3d9a0069be426b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781086172&width=680&sig=llG3cWXCnAdukwqd2rwUr2ZCU828syWzWVknxbiEntg%3D)

You pack light. You take only what you need for the day — your phone, camera, earbuds, wallet, keys.

But open your sling. Cables tangled. Power bank buried under a jacket. Lens cap somewhere at the bottom. You spend more time digging than doing.

And by afternoon, your phone is at 10%. Your camera battery is blinking. Your earbuds case is empty.

There’s no outlet in the park. No charger on the street. And even if you brought a power bank, it’s lost somewhere in the mess — or already dead.

A regular sling just carries things. It doesn’t help you stay organized. It doesn’t help keep your gear powered.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/657/e8a1147488be703f0155150fe6a3b3e2_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780977148&width=680&sig=P9XCPpKXl1goRxy%2FVCvFIXKeaV8LkeVkfxASpaYps3I%3D)

You don’t need a bigger bag. You need a smarter one.

### MEET NORAVO SUNBAG

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/667/8dec5e64e6e37d8433afaef912ff1221_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781086216&width=680&sig=pmCN5FAqJkaVMM82kHQK3fI8R9zOEfAw57OHj7jQr3Y%3D)

A sling that carries your day. And charges it, too.

8 liters of organized space. Two flexible solar panels — front and back. Up to 17W of sun‑power. USB‑A and Type‑C. Plug. Wait. Go.

Oxford fabric. Water‑resistant zippers. 0.93kg. Details that work while you walk.

No battery. No complexity. Just the sun, your gear, and the moments between outlets.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/310/3507dea920e736a873d5ef772d9166cc_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781084382&width=680&sig=DKLGtlJOjF8zmcFvlHAml4itLy8%2Ff9t6obQwlO%2BMyyg%3D)

### SUN ON BOTH SIDES

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/039/687/db2a909bbcd59ecff2230cf5afdec810_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780977366&width=680&sig=7VseO1IbIoOoW6hvTJ2QYZ6kBiPNIsJ%2FQZxoc70DTxk%3D)

You don’t always face the sun — and your bag doesn’t either. That’s why NORAVO SunBag places flexible solar cells on both sides of the sling, so it can collect light from more angles throughout your day.

NORAVO SunBag integrates flexible solar cells into both the front and back of the sling. Whether you‘re walking, sitting, or leaning against a wall, one side is always catching light.

The flexible design means no rigid boards — just a comfortable, natural shape that moves with you.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/067/646/4eebaa9e35fd585d0b9dfb897298b9e7_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781149068&width=680&sig=LsDg%2FgB5QbS1udZkuFgPCk4qzTAdqdym%2BmXXOp1iZRQ%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/041/042/0116ae342aa479257303e488f4145cc6_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780987804&width=680&sig=fb7%2BsXEsh3ECxDQ9jGMvnoTIiv33%2ByQoHx6hSgpbXDM%3D)

Noravo SunBag gives you realistic solar top-up power for outdoor days — up to 17W in ideal direct sunlight, and around 8–9W in typical one-side use. Not a wall charger replacement, but a useful way to keep small devices going between outlets.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/714/31800657f30c7a90b07bb7aafcfb7afd_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781086470&width=680&sig=s7Rce0TS%2FGmPLVEmieYfAevZqdgIlDsmQPl8udEeg3Q%3D)

### POWER WHERE YOU NEED IT

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/718/fc71315c19a11ad24ace606f8f230de9_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985606&width=680&sig=TLkBDXnivXvh1iLotTx37egOwTr0YvT1hOrs%2BLm2wX8%3D)

With a built-in USB-A + Type-C junction box, NORAVO SunBag can charge small devices directly from sunlight — no wall outlet, no separate power station, and no complicated setup.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/751/294d217d5eed1d8cd6e4c2906736a51f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781086749&width=680&sig=0N9WLT5fSzPUMQ%2BRBXMb5vBPnsRM48H8ZHR2QJRc%2FYc%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/803/403/f97c70cb71432b331feaf1388e87769c_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779282315&width=680&sig=LG5Av5c4f7CSy9yb6IDGpE3Y%2BHU2o03Zm%2BrurC3HU88%3D)

### JUST RIGHT FOR A DAY OUT

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/745/6ac670b3a8f5e768d86c683dc444b979_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985811&width=680&sig=EpqfpjbaGwU9xUhi6jgUwejJ0L0KqAWSczwPQCUwjzM%3D)

NORAVO SunBag is not just built to charge — it is built to carry. The 8L interior gives your everyday essentials a clear place, from your phone and camera to earbuds, wallet, keys, cables, and small notebook.

No oversized backpack. No messy sling. Just enough organized space for workdays, city walks, photo sessions, and the moments between.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/623/992400590514c5021c958de0c3685ea5_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781085943&width=680&sig=iGlM8EATYs7tD%2B52kxcQIpqjuQAQXCbMX7j1SOISYlc%3D)

### BOTTOM STRAP. BIG FREEDOM.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/773/74043e4b24b83241d0bcc69214b0e055_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780985949&width=680&sig=87AZmuf4%2FDW9Y2zDOGaXPpQtXbVpyFtRQ1KM6tDI5VM%3D)

Some gear is better carried outside the bag. NORAVO SunBag’s bottom strap lets you secure a mini tripod, rolled jacket, or soft extra gear without taking up your main compartment.

Your camera stays ready. Your essentials stay organized. Your hands stay free.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/626/1fa2fc2b7bed58f6ec2c64b945721140_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781085951&width=680&sig=DlMLoiURCAA3CvcV%2F3rHRITBScIVeYzNxauhXHKBjAU%3D)

### LIFE WITH NORAVO SUNBAG

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/175/9eff9b0694ee383b78573ffa035fcba9_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781083594&width=680&sig=Aga7epLE3i%2FQCU1YknLg2Nq4%2FGJpKCaogQy2sH7jEYw%3D)

Commute, walk, shoot, rest, or travel light. NORAVO SunBag keeps your essentials close and gives your small devices a solar top-up when sunlight is available

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/071/199/d37755a51f248e8523c6324e418f3214_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781172986&width=680&sig=7lEbzHSrCSgTi%2BM%2BZW0dYUJrobDQkG7IEFMaHSt6gCA%3D)

### MADE FOR REAL LIFE — FABRIC

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/806/794ae37bda56ec467067204964357278_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780986103&width=680&sig=OOSeVDhtGc04kVUXG2Z3o7sfMX%2BaHtpCiNlNleu7mqE%3D)

Light rain, splashes, scratches, and daily friction are part of real carry.NORAVO SunBag is designed to handle everyday movement while helping keep your essentials protected.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/630/7d9bb9a6ef189c7e4242c95065e2541f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781085979&width=680&sig=hd98A34Y7TbjOOKFENR4hLK6lSVVEWXIa1Bj8GaBAE0%3D)

### DETAILS THAT LAST

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/818/52d3c674d0bb5e4353e78a61725a790f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780986163&width=680&sig=sIJPbFqOl9uRngK%2BQ4gGlkvRLyLi0xU0SpnVWaGK1Tw%3D)

A sling is only as good as the parts that hold it together. NORAVO SunBag uses durable hardware, reinforced stitching, and a hidden magnetic closure to make everyday carry feel smoother, stronger, and more secure.

Details you don’t see — until you need them.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/631/ef478846c0702db993f0ea57743e3c8f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781085985&width=680&sig=xE1V%2FrHm7%2FOjq4QjjsO6rZgGH%2BOn5mfmAx8e8r71nT4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/040/823/ad8605d123ce1ca7112c9501c7f149ae_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780986215&width=680&sig=UqSMrESA1wihQfclt6eTmj5xQYLaANuNrX%2FBDhXW4xA%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/633/4db6354f7d0cfc2ae9154ce859b65b5a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781085996&width=680&sig=PEelBD4MNOq6TXSLZuHMqRr%2B1CRGD71gvXjqaSJ4nT4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/071/195/9881186e8675169bbb372275a07c4247_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781172973&width=680&sig=UbVyHLKJbbEJBh96Bz6Y696qPzUePnyWEU%2BkoH6jH%2FI%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/058/039/e94f1b1188051e335c7ab30425196d33_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781088578&width=680&sig=GA2eqJD%2FOj81LLjJlhvBY8sf%2FRaiz%2Bkc6aYtwt5jpTU%3D)

### FROM SKETCH TO NORAVO SUNBAG

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/876/6447a0c090f0104ffa6482a6223ca6b1_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781087577&width=680&sig=FhiycBinw4kbQnWFD6XHTKWqITx2g%2Bgy5lCdjt0DY%2Bo%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/638/a9337edd823c641af45ef3c94b4eea5c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781086019&width=680&sig=VrIQXrrgDWcKQRYXAo9IXc7jXL701jpxDjdVjmK9rgo%3D)

### THE TEAM BEHIND NORAVO

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/057/891/3c802d11472e9f73fc8626a976762cca_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781087760&width=680&sig=vw80j25AGPp8sM6%2Bk7tlz%2B7ykt50Q3%2FbbQyYF3EErbY%3D)

Noravo began with a simple belief: everyday gear should make life easier, not heavier.

As a small team of product designers, engineers, and outdoor photography users, we often found ourselves carrying more than we wanted — a camera, a phone, earbuds, cables, a power bank, and sometimes a tripod. The bag was full, the cables were tangled, and the battery was still something we had to worry about.

That is where the idea for our solar camera bag started.

We did not want to create a bulky outdoor bag with solar panels added only for appearance. We wanted to design something people would actually carry — compact enough for daily movement, organized enough for camera gear, and useful enough to help small devices stay powered when outlets are not around.

Building this product meant balancing three things: carry comfort, camera protection, and practical solar charging.

The bag had to feel right on the shoulder.

The storage had to keep everyday gear easy to reach.

The solar panels had to be useful, flexible, and honest in real outdoor conditions.

THE TEAM BEHIND NORAVO

WHY NORAVO SUNBAG EXISTS

You pack light. You take only what you need for the day — your phone, camera, earbuds, wallet, keys.But open your sling. Cables tangled. Power bank buried under a jacket. Lens cap somewhere at the bottom. You spend more time digging than doing.And by afternoon, your phone is at 10%. Your camera battery is blinking. Your earbuds case is empty.There’s no outlet in the park. No charger on the street. And even if you brought a power bank, it’s lost somewhere in the mess — or already dead.A regular sling just carries things. It doesn’t help you stay organized. It doesn’t help keep your gear powered.

You don’t need a bigger bag. You need a smarter one.

MEET NORAVO SUNBAG

A sling that carries your day. And charges it, too.8 liters of organized space. Two flexible solar panels — front and back. Up to 17W of sun‑power. USB‑A and Type‑C. Plug. Wait. Go.Oxford fabric. Water‑resistant zippers. 0.93kg. Details that work while you walk.No battery. No complexity. Just the sun, your gear, and the moments between outlets.

SUN ON BOTH SIDES

You don’t always face the sun — and your bag doesn’t either. That’s whyNORAVO SunBagplaces flexible solar cells on both sides of the sling, so it can collect light from more angles throughout your day.NORAVO SunBagintegrates flexible solar cells into both the front and back of the sling. Whether you‘re walking, sitting, or leaning against a wall, one side is always catching light.The flexible design means no rigid boards — just a comfortable, natural shape that moves with you.

Noravo SunBag gives you realistic solar top-up power for outdoor days — up to 17W in ideal direct sunlight, and around 8–9W in typical one-side use. Not a wall charger replacement, but a useful way to keep small devices going between outlets.

POWER WHERE YOU NEED IT

JUST RIGHT FOR A DAY OUT

No oversized backpack. No messy sling. Just enough organized space for workdays, city walks, photo sessions, and the moments between.

BOTTOM STRAP. BIG FREEDOM.

Some gear is better carried outside the bag.NORAVO SunBag’sbottom strap lets you secure a mini tripod, rolled jacket, or soft extra gear without taking up your main compartment.

Your camera stays ready. Your essentials stay organized. Your hands stay free.

MADE FOR REAL LIFE — FABRIC

Light rain, splashes, scratches, and daily friction are part of real carry.NORAVO SunBagis designed to handle everyday movement while helping keep your essentials protected.

DETAILS THAT LAST

A sling is only as good as the parts that hold it together.NORAVO SunBaguses durable hardware, reinforced stitching, and a hidden magnetic closure to make everyday carry feel smoother, stronger, and more secure.Details you don’t see — until you need them.

Noravo began with a simple belief: everyday gear should make life easier, not heavier.As a small team of product designers, engineers, and outdoor photography users, we often found ourselves carrying more than we wanted — a camera, a phone, earbuds, cables, a power bank, and sometimes a tripod. The bag was full, the cables were tangled, and the battery was still something we had to worry about.

The team has developed the prototype and product specifications and will work closely with manufacturing partners to manage production and delivery. Backers will be updated if timeline changes occur.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Noravo is a small team of product designers, engineers, and outdoor photography users creating smarter everyday gear.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Noravo SunBag is the world's first solar sling designed for daily carry, solving the constant frustration of dead batteries and tangled cables during everyday outings. Traditional slings merely store your gear, but they don't help keep it powered or organized. If you've ever dug through a bag for a buried power bank only to find it dead, or watched your phone die on a long walk, you know the struggle. Noravo SunBag merges an 8L organized carry solution with a dual-sided solar charging system, ensuring your essentials stay powered simply by stepping into the sun. 

At the heart of the SunBag is its unique "Sun on Both Sides" design, featuring flexible solar cells integrated into the front and back of the sling. This innovative setup means the bag collects light from multiple angles—whether you're walking, sitting, or leaning against a wall—without requiring you to adjust its position. It delivers up to 17W of power in ideal direct sunlight (around 8-9W in typical one-side use) through built-in USB-A and Type-C ports, providing a realistic solar top-up for small devices between outlets. At just 0.93kg, it offers a comfortable, natural shape that moves with you, eliminating the need for bulky, rigid solar panels or separate power banks.

Beyond its charging capabilities, the SunBag is built to carry your daily essentials seamlessly. The 8L interior provides a dedicated space for your phone, camera, earbuds, wallet, keys, and cables, keeping everything organized instead of jumbled at the bottom. A clever bottom strap allows you to secure external gear like a mini tripod or a rolled jacket without sacrificing interior space. Built for real life, the bag uses durable Oxford fabric, water-resistant zippers, reinforced stitching, and a hidden magnetic closure to protect your gear from light rain, splashes, and daily wear, making it the perfect companion for commutes, city walks, and outdoor photography sessions.

The Rotary Mouse: The Freedom to Scroll

A game-changing mouse that lets you scroll up to 2.5× faster.

Its rotary wheel replaces repetitive flicking with a simple stirring motion to give you smoother, more precise control across webpages, timelines, spreadsheets, code, and more, with less strain on your fingers.

Scroll up to 2.5× faster compared to regular mouse

Built-in rotary wheel with tactile clicks for smooth, continuous control

Also support regular vertical scrolling

Practical jog wheel or steering wheel replacement

Incorporate range-of-motion (ROM) exercise to reduce finger strain

The Problem: We've Been Scrolling for Decades

The mouse wheel hasn't changed for 30 years.

We’re still flicking tiny wheels to move through massive amounts of content: documents, spreadsheets, code, timelines, and more.

It’s slow. It’s repetitive. And it’s hard to control, even with infinite scroll wheels.

All those micro-movements waste time and putting constant strain on your fingers.

Scrolling should feel better than this.

The Solution: A New Way to Scroll

Instead of repeatedly flicking a wheel up and down, the Rotary Mouse introduces a continuous rotary motion.

You don’t flick. You rotate with tactile clicks while exercising your finger.

Place your finger on the wheel and turn it like a dial. As you rotate, the screen moves smoothly and precisely, giving you direct, real-time control over speed and direction.

Scroll slowly for precision. Spin faster to move quickly. Stop exactly where you want.

Rotary Mouse Vs. Standard Mouse

Rotary Scroll Vs. Infinite Scroll

Learn The Difference

Incorporate Range-of-Motion (ROM) Exercise

The Rotary Mouse incorporates smooth, circular motion that expands ROM and spreads movement more naturally.

Less strain. Better feel over time.

What Ergonomist Said

It was very comfortable to use, with ease of access. It felt more natural on the hand and fingers for avoidance of stress and strain. I would recommend it to my posture ergonomics clients. -Candace Grant - Posture Therapist - Ontario, Canada*

3,000 Upvotes on Reddit

Our Rotary Mouse has already gained strong organic traction, earning over 3,000 upvotes on Reddit across communities like sim racing, PC enthusiasts, and product design.

This isn’t just an idea, it’s something people actively want.

Independent Reviews

The Honest Gadget

“It just feels like a softer, more fluid motion compared to repeated flick scrolling… I can absolutely see why this design could be genuinely useful and even feel a bit therapeutic.” *

“This is one of those products where the moment you use it, you will know instantly just how useful it is.” **

“It wasn’t uncomfortable at all.” *

Hey Bubbles Studio

“I ditched the standard mouse for this” *

What People Said

Unique Features

As Jog Wheel Replacement

Video editors have found the Rotary Mouse to be an affordable alternative to jog wheels. It can perform the same function as a jog/shuttle controller in DaVinci Resolve, Adobe Premiere Pro, and Final Cut Pro.

These early adopters use it to scrub timelines scrub timelines, jog frame-by-frame, zoom in and out, or navigate clips with precise clickable detents.

Steering Wheel Alternative

Most driving games rely on bulky wheels or imprecise keyboards. This mouse introduces a new practical way to drive, with a built-in rotary dial that maps directly to steering. Also comes with sensitivity setting via AutoHotKey to adjust to your comfort in driving.

Get smooth, analog control in a compact form that fits right on your desk. Whether you're cruising in Euro Truck Simulator 2, American Truck Simulator, or driving in racing sims like Assetto Corsa, BeamNG.drive, iRacing and others. It’s a simpler, more precise way to steer.

🏁 Rotary Mouse Earns Its Nürburgring Certificate

To really put Rotary Mouse to the test, we handed it to experienced sim racer and coachAmmar Dizdarevićand challenged him to tackle one of the world's most demanding racing circuits—the legendary Nürburgring Nordschleife.

After completing the lap, this was his verdict:

"I stand by my words that this product is viable for sim racing. It has received its Nordschleife certificate. If it can survive this then it can survive pretty much anything."— Ammar Dizdarević, Sim Racer and Coach

Steering Presets For Arsetto Corsa, ATS and ETS2 Are Now Available on Our Website

You may read our tutorials on how to use the Rotary Mouse in driving simiulation games like Assetto Corsa, American Truck Simulator (ATS) and Euro Truck Simulator 2 (ETS2)

Assetto Corsa Steering Wheel Set Up Tutorial

ATS/ETS2 Steering Wheel Set Up Tutorial

More tutorials coming soon for more games.

Pixel-Precise Control (No Jitter)

In addition to its faster rotary scrolling, the Rotary Mouse also supports standard scrolling through the familiar vertical flicking motion. This ensures a seamless experience for everyday use, just like a traditional mouse.

Still supports the familiar vertical flick. No learning curve required.

The Rotary Mouse started with a simple problem: finger joint strain

Our founder, Melvin Wong, had been spending long hours at the computer every day. Over time, the constant up-and-down flicking began to take a toll. The repetitive motion led to strain in his finger joints, making something as simple as scrolling uncomfortable.

There had to be a better way.

With over 20 years as a tech entrepreneur with two exits, and a background in electronics engineering, Melvin returned to what he loved most: building things from scratch. As a two-time hackathon grand champion and mentor/judge, he approached the problem not just as a user, but as an engineer.

Instead of flicking, he experimented with a different motion, which is rotating. That small shift made a big difference.

The stirring motion felt more natural and relieved the strain on his fingers. It encouraged a wider, more flexible range of motion while reducing the stiffness caused by repetitive scrolling.

But something unexpected happened. It wasn’t just more comfortable, it was faster!

By switching to continuous rotary input, Melvin found he could move through content significantly quicker. This inadvertently boosts scrolling speed by up to 2.5 times.

The Rotary Mouse is the result of that journey.

A simple idea, rethinking one of the most overlooked interactions we do every day.

Current Progress

Here are some of the early progress we made in our pursuit to bring the Rotary Mouse to the world.

Prototyping and Building Pre-Production Units

We used PLA and SLA 3D printing techniques to create our early prototypes. We started selling fully-functional Founder's Editions (pre-production units) in March 2026 and sold over 30 units.

Hosting Pop-Up Booth At Digital Media City (DMC)

In May 2026, we hosted a pop-up booth at Digital Media City (DMC) in Seoul for three days, where visitors got hands-on with the Rotary Mouse. The response was encouraging, with strong feedback on its ability to scrub video timelines quickly and precisely. We even sold some pre-production units.

Our team has the experience of delivering projects and grants before deadlines and we believe that shipping on time by December 2026 is attainable.

Melvin Wong - Founder & Engineer

Melvin has been a tech entrepreneur for over 20 years, successfully building and exiting two startups. Rediscovering his passion for electronics, he is now pursuing his dream of creating gadgets that contribute to the greater good of humanity.

He holds a bachelor’s degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering. He is the grand champion of two hackathons and has served as a mentor/judge for several others.

He established Airra Labs Inc., a Canadian incorporated company (Incorporation Number: BC1576688) to pursue this project and a few other game-changing mice.

You may learn more about him onWikipediaor contact him atmelvin@rotarymouse.com

Matt Bechberger - Consulting Designer

Matt is an electronics and product designer, and the founder of Reveni Labs. He launched five projects on Kickstarter and raised over $600,000 from almost 3,000 backers. His most successful launch is theLUMO - the New Light Meteron Kickstarter.

* Reviewers/testers were not compensated. They received a complimentary sample unit solely for testing purposes. All opinions expressed are their own.

** Reviewers received a nominal review fee and a free sample unit. All opinions expressed are their own.

*** Actual paying customer.

Risks and challenges

Our core team comprised of a founder (Melvin Wong) with 20 years of tech startup experience with two acquisitions, and a seasoned Kickstarter creator (Matt Bechberger) with three fully completed campaigns, raising over $600,000 from almost 3,000 backers. During his entrepreneurial journey, the founder has received five development grants and fully completed all milestones with some exceeding the promised results by two folds.

We are certainly committed to standing by this product and my workmanship and have spent thousands filing seven patents (4 design patents, 3 provisional utility patents), and we have included enough financial and technical flexibility in the product price and production to absorb any unforeseen costs or problems during the fulfillment of the rewards.

We have proven our product development and manufacturing ability by selling over 30 pre-production units without any refunds or returns. This means that even if our funding goal falls short, we shall be able to find other means to deliver our promised product without sacrificing usability and quality.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

We shall be utilizing ABS plastic for the mouse housing and robust rotating mechanism for the rotary wheel to ensure the mouse is long-lasting.

Sustainable Distribution

We aim to use recyclable materials in our packaging such as paper-based tapes, and paper-based honeycomb shreds ("crinkle cut").

projects.ai_risks_en: As a crowdfunding project, typical risks include potential delivery delays and manufacturing challenges. The unconventional rotary scrolling mechanism may require user adaptation despite claims of seamless transition from standard mice.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Founded by Melvin Wong, who developed the Rotary Mouse after experiencing finger joint strain from prolonged computer use and repetitive mouse wheel flicking.
projects.ai_description_en:
The Rotary Mouse is a computer mouse with a built-in rotary wheel that replaces repetitive flick scrolling with a continuous, tactile click-based stirring motion. Designed for faster, smoother, and more precise control across webpages, documents, timelines, spreadsheets, code, and creative timelines, the device aims to reinvent a core interaction that has remained largely unchanged for three decades.

The project is led by a founder with 20 years of tech startup experience and two acquisitions, alongside a seasoned Kickstarter creator who has raised over $600,000 from nearly 3,000 backers across three completed campaigns. Development has been supported by five fully completed grants, and the mouse is backed by seven filed patents (4 design, 3 utility). More than 30 pre-production units have been sold with zero returns, giving the team real-world validation before mass production. An ergonomist has highlighted the reduced strain and natural hand motion, while the design incorporates range-of-motion exercise to make scrolling feel better over time.

Beyond everyday use, the Rotary Mouse is positioned as a practical replacement for jog wheels in video editing, a steering wheel alternative for sim racing, and a pixel-precise control tool with no jitter. The device is offered in multiple versions, including a Sim Edition built for driving sims with ready-to-use presets. Early backing on Kickstarter accesses the product at a significant discount compared to the projected retail price, and rewards include wiring, warranty, and a “Founding Backer” mention. With a global shipping target of November 2026, the campaign aims to move the mouse from a reinvented scroll concept to an everyday tool.

## Story

### Meet 10PM

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/812/610/8ca0ae39c9a56e52ca28874fd664a234_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779335963&width=2550&sig=LkHqthsYaPZ%2FKCotaB2oHErN%2FKQ38%2BvKePyYyNPYjqs%3D)10PM is an ambient light designed to create a quiet sense of presence.

As you move, the glow subtly shifts with you through a pseudo-pupil effect inspired by nature.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/773/854/489a3b9ba05a6f7e55e51002dd7dccc0_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779115669&width=1152&sig=peSoc1PEdWebmjuWeoXbbqikstyb7Auka0EOPWW%2BKlI%3D)

### DESIGN RECOGNITION

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/835/180/5f7b4e5c64ef4d8258965db5fd4931f6_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779482292&width=680&sig=nuYL2CR9df6VnBOlPVjtqsNwn9kxCQCFnIJN87M%2FkIw%3D)

### HOW 10PM WORKS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/764/429/464a5d412853fea74a9e9fb45043c6c6_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779054032&width=700&sig=ictCnA0Ze1IYKQYao5QTyVFhznJax%2F8WEBWFMXZCYn8%3D)Activate 10PM with a simple double knock.

The hidden control keeps the form quiet and uninterrupted, creating a more intentional and ritual-like interaction.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/827/039/484b3cb6ec5690e3c4df86d9816fa468_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779430086&width=700&sig=P30xfNps2ci9TcUMEuK8E1gcY1bN4PSdQ6F0Kj5LyFA%3D)The glow subtly shifts within tones of coral, sunset orange, and warm pink with gentlevariations in rhythm, creating a calm presence with the softness of candlelight and twilight.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/764/424/b7491ef06b0faf8ce5e1e683e3b8320a_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779053997&width=700&sig=QoifQq4NsMx6Zs2zHCgybMDEwrvJvV%2FSMtb4pI%2BFeNc%3D)Inspired by the pseudo-pupil effect found in natural optics, 10PM subtly mirrors your movement as you pass by.

#### Inspired by the Pseudo-Pupil Effect

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/793/037/aad9b6183314d8ba8c233ccbc89eb5a9_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779216028&width=612&sig=LE%2FY4YpMAuzmqVBt4oeeLJaEI1iOssX8HD%2FYKbAs33Q%3D)

The pseudo-pupil is an optical effect found in the compound eyes of creatures such as mantises and dragonflies.

Each facet reflects and absorbs light differently depending on the viewing angle, causing a dark spot to appear and shift with the observer.

10PM draws inspiration from this phenomenon to create a subtle sense of presence through light and movement.

### FEATURES

### 01\. Light that moves with you

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/793/848/68a29e99b10498cb14ceee1619d46b27_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779220716&width=2550&sig=jr65WE6IEFrvhJesh6HnWcYYuVxCTqPqYYuyBLFPQIs%3D)The light glides through the surface of the cube and mirrors your movement.

### 02\. Precision-machined aluminum

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/792/123/fa8bf6ba0e70f1c644991587c5a7bc8e_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779211533&width=1855&sig=KpLv%2Fdu%2FT2ti8fNCxjc%2Bqd1%2BMIWTClMNcrh9OT%2FIX14%3D)

Machined from solid aluminum using advanced 5-axis CNC machining, each cube features more than two thousand precisely angled apertures. Together, they form the optical structure that gives 10PM its shifting appearance.

### 03\. Custom-tuned glow

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/618/661/0856bdcb34ca0f6b9c1300061bd55a39_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1778069177&width=6334&sig=CBVup3nRMfMU4TZqIKbM28z9pQbpZFy1lPjXDhDrvCY%3D)Rather than relying on standard RGB color mixing, 10PM uses custom-tuned LEDs developed to produce a carefully selected rangeof warm tones, shaped by the character and atmosphere we envisioned for the light.

### 04\. Hidden interaction

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/817/430/57d92de5d2e59e7a2fa5f17188a1ef23_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779367100&width=864&sig=RAw%2FDophx4Rbu7Dgc4kaQ7Ktc5uZS7GZrcXi2XHDMUQ%3D)Rather than pressing a button, 10PM responds to a simple double knock. The control remains hidden within the form, allowing the interaction to become part of the experience itself. Familiar in everyday life yet uncommon in consumer electronics, the gesture feels natural, deliberate, and memorable.

### 05\. A quiet presence in the home

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/808/782/03aba2e0d3d4c1ac3f955401204df91c_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779307979&width=3300&sig=MBwxyvR8HeLXb55lC5rJ1yxrVftdiAbv7lw%2F6ctBGQk%3D)Designed to fit naturally into a wide range of interiors, 10PM remains understated in the background while adding a subtle sense of warmth and presence to the space. Its simple form allows the light itself to become the focus.

### 06\. Thoughtful details

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/810/142/f23950a0571eb4b30957610ee24cb326_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779316417&width=4620&sig=vk1CQ8BNW721smurTNXIoc8ogCAvSllvpaBglmDU3hk%3D)From the braided USB-C cable to the anodized aluminum finish, every detail was designed to complement the character of the light and the object as a whole.

### SPECIFICATIONS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/731/245/31f7a7b6634faf9f83fdbc237eb04aa8_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1778777228&width=680&sig=LTS8onRgEJ%2BLghfkj42XwgNO0Rd1co%2FyYlaVKwizdbA%3D)

### REWARDS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/204/546/8004fe6708e427c7b8f86550dc1921c6_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782209647&width=680&sig=hGNwKuBSLnIsSnGp0viv%2FoLntBwS4pwjAR5KI0hc7Ms%3D)

### SHIPPING

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/121/775/e58af8757ab194491dd4ccd95fc95362_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781572820&width=680&sig=W304SEa9n6dpIAqniVDlofh4CsaAp%2B2EI7IhxVn3uMg%3D)

Shipping and applicable taxes will be collected after the campaign through the post-campaign survey. Don't see your country listed? Contact us.

### TIMELINE

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/867/005/8da9f5da0236017e8790463bff8a1961_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779770625&width=680&sig=s29c4%2ByV%2FiuSr2Y9VKlKPtZNRumla%2FnaXi02xVzv2pc%3D)

### DESIGN JOURNEY

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/624/648/b43c2af4a4d6f78403aa11cdfb1cbcba_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1778097926&width=680&sig=Mdc%2F4QQX0btjOWQ39Qt%2BJnv7%2B5B4Z33NsE%2BvDaVJ4zo%3D)

### WHY 10PM

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/129/967/b5bc2b3c353147e80faa7d587451c8bb_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781624287&width=680&sig=8RyxVAQQNH%2FORUvH1XpcX85YzycTNOEdrdDSB%2BpbB0U%3D)

I founded Once to create products that turn technology into emotion. We’re just at the beginning. 10PM is the first step on that path. My work focuses on designs that feel deeply personal yet universally resonant, creating not just a product, but an experience that feels both inevitable and unexpected.

[![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/197/250/23dba60f0e6b78ee1456b948c27cb81b_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782159363&width=680&sig=qP5dlwhfTIZ9YNTSBys2si1MOLf7wZelLuLIUM2kyPg%3D)](https://www.launchboom.com/?utm_source=LBAcampaign&utm_medium=banner&utm_campaign=partner) [![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/903/423/307d470266ba82957f827a73c8b0c123_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779983204&width=680&sig=GUZfxWtKNfnOewcbvdut3gL72%2B7JC0oLQ6Uhw%2B20FOo%3D)](http://jellop.com/?utm_source=)

This project is promoted by Jellop, the ad tech power behind the best Kickstarters with 3,500+ successful Kickstarter projects with over $1B raised between them.

## Risks and challenges

We have worked extremely hard to make this product ready for Kickstarter and full-scale manufacturing. We’re confident in our ability to produce our product at quality in mass and fulfill all our perks on time. However, things don’t always go as planned. Here are a few of risks that may come up, and our plan to address them:

MANUFACTURING: We have a trusted manufacturer lined up and will have quality assurance people on site during production. Despite this, manufacturing delays can still happen. Whether it’s an unexpected backlog, bad timing with holidays, or a quality assurance issue on the ground floor, we’ll let you know immediately. Our #1 priority is product quality followed by timely delivery.

FULFILLMENT: Sometimes, stuff happens that can’t be planned for: a supplier misses a deadline, a package gets held up at customs, a shipment gets lost, or a global pandemic shuts down shipping ports around the world. Those things can cause delays. We are using an experienced logistics team to get our products to you. We’ll keep open and honest communication with you through our process so you know where your product is and when it’s going to get to you.

[Learn about accountability on Kickstarter](https://www.kickstarter.com/help/hc/sections/115001107133)

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Founder of Once, creating products that turn technology into emotion through designs that feel deeply personal yet universally resonant.
projects.ai_description_en:
10PM is a biomimetic ambient light that creates a quiet sense of presence in your home, responding to your movement through a phenomenon called the pseudo-pupil effect. Inspired by the compound eyes of mantises and dragonflies, where each facet reflects and absorbs light differently depending on the viewing angle, 10PM makes a dark spot appear and shift as you pass by. The result is a subtle, organic interaction where the light glides through the surface of the cube and mirrors your movement, transforming a simple object into something that feels almost alive.

At the heart of 10PM is precision engineering. Each cube is machined from solid aluminum using advanced 5-axis CNC machining, featuring more than two thousand precisely angled apertures that form the optical structure responsible for its shifting appearance. Rather than relying on standard RGB color mixing, the light uses custom-tuned LEDs developed to produce a carefully selected range of warm tones—coral, sunset orange, and warm pink—with gentle variations in rhythm. The effect is a calm presence with the softness of candlelight and twilight, designed to fit naturally into a wide range of interiors without demanding attention.

Interaction with 10PM is hidden and ritual-like. Instead of pressing a button, you activate the light with a simple double knock, a gesture that remains concealed within the form for a more intentional and memorable experience. Every detail has been considered: the braided USB-C cable, the anodized aluminum finish, and the understated presence that allows the light itself to become the focus. Priced at $299 retail with early bird specials starting at $249, 10PM is designed by Once as a first step toward turning technology into emotion—creating not just a product, but an experience that feels both deeply personal and universally resonant. Estimated delivery is November 2026.

projects.name: H.A.M.U. high-accuracy measurement unit
projects.blurb: The HAMU are designed for measurement of the DC, low frequency, pulse, and stepped signals of voltage with a high signal-to-noise ratio while operating over a wide range of ambient temperatures. It is a universal small-sized sealed unit with external functional connectors. HAMU can be used as an independent device and as part of high-accuracy and/or high-sensitive measurement systems. It was created to make high-accuracy measurement not only affordable and easy to use, but also an excellent tool for anyone interested in measurement electronics.
projects.html_story: Project storyCreatorLeonFrancmore infocontactCategoryProductivityTagsarduinobatteriescomputersdronese-bikesiotlaptopspcprofessionalrobotssensorsmart homestudentsBacking informationCrowdfunding riskslearn moreWe are a small international team of professional electronic engineers and we were not satisfied with the existing commercial modules with high-resolution ADC.The goalof our project is to create a new segment of measurement devices that implement the maximum functionality of ADCs, an efficient design and high-accuracy comparable to reference voltmeters.The motivationfor creating HAMU was the lack of low-cost technical means on the market for measuring and analyzing signals from highly sensitive detectors, low-noise electronic circuits, and systems with a small output voltage increment, while having a compact design and the ability to reconfigure operating algorithms to create precision electronic devices(for example, diagnostic systems for the condition of moving parts of high-speed passenger trains, compressors, turbines, aircraft engines; systems for searching for ultra-small leaks and predicting dangerous situations in infrastructure gas networks, analyzing the tightness of spacecraft and vacuum equipment; magnetometric and seismometric equipment for studying rocks, predicting dangerous phenomena during mining operations; hydroacoustic devices for searching for underwater objects or orienting underwater vehicles).Theconceptof the project is to provide the user with an adaptive tool to solve their technical problems. Firstly, there are no internal amplifiers in HAMU.This is because the use of a specific amplifier type is an individual decision for many projects, and the high-accuracy of HAMU allows measurement of the output signals of some detectors and circuits in direct with a high signal-to-noise ratio. Secondly, HAMU allows measurement the noise spectral density. This is an important function for determining the optimal measurement technique based on the analysis of output signals from sensors and electronic circuits connected to the unit. This is an important function for determining the optimal measurement technique based on the analysis of output signals from sensors and electronic circuits connected to the unit. Thirdly, HAMU has two data input/output ports (USB and UART). The selection of the input signals conversion algorithm is carried out using the “mode selection connector”, commands from a personal computer, portable devices, or an external controller at the discretion of the user. The conversion mode parameters (each algorithm has default parameters) are set using specific commands from external devices, as is the subsequent data output. Fourthly, the creation of a personal measurement method and an algorithm for converting data into digital form will be available to all HAMU users in the future.

projects.ai_description_en:
**HAMU** (High-Accuracy Measurement Unit) is a new class of precision measurement device designed for engineers, researchers, and developers who need accurate signal analysis without a costly overhead. Created by an international team of professional electronic engineers, HAMU addresses a clear gap in the market: there have been no low-cost, compact solutions for measuring and analyzing signals from highly sensitive detectors, low-noise electronic circuits, and systems with very small voltage increments — until now. Built around the idea of maximizing the functionality of high-performance analog-to-digital conversion, HAMU delivers accuracy and versatility that can approach that of reference voltmeters, while remaining adaptive enough to become the core of custom precision instruments.

What sets HAMU apart is its philosophy of simplicity and flexibility. First, there are no internal amplifiers — a deliberate omission that lets designers pair their own optimal gain stage with HAMU’s high-precision signal path, and still measure low-amplitude detector outputs directly with a high signal-to-noise ratio. Second, HAMU includes noise spectral density measurement as a core capability, enabling users to evaluate sensor and circuit noise characteristics and choose the best measurement technique for a given application. Third, HAMU can be configured via USB or UART ports and a “mode selection connector,” with each conversion algorithm offering default parameters that can be adjusted by commands from a PC, portable device, or external controller — giving users full control over how signals are acquired, converted, and output.

HAMU is designed as a universal, reconfigurable tool for a remarkably broad range of precision measurement tasks: from monitoring vibration and wear in high-speed train components, turbines, and aircraft engines, to detecting micro-leaks in gas infrastructures and spacecraft, to supporting magnetometric, seismometric, and hydroacoustic research and navigation systems. For projects in e-bikes, drones, robotics, IoT, smart home, audio, or industrial automation, HAMU provides a single platform that can be tailored to complex sensor interfaces and data logging setups. Available in multiple models and limited quantities at $699 and $889 price points, HAMU empowers engineers to build sophisticated measurement systems without designing every component from scratch — bringing reference-class accuracy to compact, everyday development and field deployments. A future update also aims to make personal measurement methods and custom conversion algorithms available directly to the HAMU user community, reinforcing its role as a living, evolving platform for precision instrumentation.

What's in the Box

The Problem: Weak. Wasteful.

Canned Air?It’s wasteful, freezes your hands, sprays liquid residue, and loses pressure in seconds.

Generic Electric Dusters?They are just noisy toys with weak plastic fans that can't move sticky dust.

You need real power.You need raw power. You need consistent velocity. You need VoltGale.

Meet VoltGale. We packed 1000W turbo power into a compact cordless blower built for real-world cleaning, drying, and blasting tasks.

With up to 1300g of thrust, 55m/s high-speed airflow, a 65,000 RPM motor, and a massive 40,000mAh battery, VoltGale delivers serious air power anywhere you need it — from garage cleanup to outdoor gear, home spaces, and daily utility.

Engineered for Extreme Air Power

1300g Violent Thrust

Not just wind — real thrust.

1300g of thrust turns airflow into visible force.From blasting snow off surfaces to rippling water and spinning heavy objects, VoltGale delivers a concentrated air stream that doesn’t just blow — it pushes, moves, and proves its power.

1000W Turbo Airflow System

Powered by a1000W turbo motor system, VoltGale spins up to65,000 RPM to generate a focused 55m/s high-speed airflow— delivering fast acceleration, stable output, and serious blowing performance in a compact cordless body.

This incredible wind speed delivers powerful gusts that quickly blow awaywater droplets,snowandleavesfrom surfaces, ensuring efficient and thorough cleaning in no time.

4-Speed Control（Turbo Mode）

we optimized the airflow dynamics.The VoltGalefeatures 4 adjustable wind speeds, allowing you to select the most suitable setting for different scenarios and needs.

40,000mAh Power System

A large-capacity battery gives VoltGale the endurance to support high-power airflow without being tied to a wall outlet. From quick cleanup to longer outdoor tasks, it is built to keep serious air power ready in your hand.

Emergency Power Station

More than a turbo blower, VoltGale can also work as a backup power source for essential devices. When your phone, light, or small USB-powered gear runs low, itspower bank functionhelps keep you connected and prepared.

Intelligent AI Protection

Power means nothing without protection.

VoltGale is equipped with multiple intelligent safety systems, including overheat protection, overcurrent protection, short-circuit protection, and motor stall protection.These safeguards continuously monitor operation to help ensure stable performance, protect internal components, and extend the lifespan of the device even during demanding use.

Sleek & Stylish Design &Comfortable Grip

VoltGale boasts a sleek and stylish design like theHammer of Thor. Crafted with attention to detail, it not only delivers outstanding functionality but also adds a touch of sophistication to your cleaning routine.

Weighing just1.350kg(compared to traditional 3kg blowers) and measuring221 x78x88mm, the VoltGale is3x smallerand designed for convenient one-bag carrying. Carry it anywhere, store it effortlessly—cleaning has never been this convenient.

What's in the Box

Risks and challenges

Hardware development is a complex process, and we want to be transparent with our backers about the challenges ahead.

Manufacturing and Tooling:VoltGale is currently in the prototype stage. Moving from prototype testing to final tooling and mass production may involve small adjustments to the internal structure, button feel, surface finish, and accessory fit. We will continue testing and refining these details to ensure stable performance and consistent build quality.

Battery and Safety Testing:VoltGale uses a high-capacity 16.8V 10,000mAh battery system and supports 65W USB-C fast charging. Battery safety, thermal control, and charging stability are important parts of our development process. We will complete the necessary testing and safety checks before shipment.

Supply Chain and Fulfillment:Key components such as the motor, battery cells, aluminum body parts, and turbine components may be affected by supplier lead times or logistics changes. To reduce this risk, we will work closely with our suppliers and prepare backup plans when possible.
We will keep backers updated throughout production, testing, and fulfillment. If any delays or changes occur, we will communicate them clearly and work to solve them responsibly.

projects.ai_description_en:
The VoltGale 1300g High-Thrust Cordless Turbo Blower is a handheld power tool designed to replace weak canned air and underpowered electric dusters with serious, portable air-moving capability. The product addresses a clear frustration: traditional cleaning aids freeze your hands, lose pressure in seconds, or simply lack the force to move stuck-on debris, snow, or water from surfaces. VoltGale aims to deliver industrial-grade thrust in a compact, battery-powered body that can be carried anywhere.

At its core, the VoltGale packs a 1000W turbo motor system that reaches 65,000 RPM and generates up to 1300g of thrust with a focused 55m/s high-speed airflow. This level of power allows the blower to blast away water droplets, snow, leaves, and heavy dust from garage floors, outdoor gear, and home spaces. A 4-speed control system, including a Turbo Mode, lets users match the airflow intensity to the specific task, from delicate drying work to maximum-force clearing.

The product is built around a 40,000mAh battery system that supports up to 12 hours of operation and 65W USB-C fast charging, keeping the unit untethered and ready for extended outdoor or utility use. Beyond air blowing, VoltGale doubles as an emergency power station, with a power bank function that lets you charge phones, lights, and small USB devices when you are off-grid or during outages. Intelligent AI-based protection systems monitor for overheating, overcurrent, short circuits, and motor stalls to safeguard internal components and extend the device's lifespan during demanding sessions.

Despite its performance, the VoltGale is designed for portability and comfort. Weighing 1.350kg and measuring just 221 x 78 x 88mm, it is roughly three times smaller than traditional 3kg blowers and fits easily into a bag or storage space. The unit is styled with a sleek, Thor's hammer-inspired aesthetic and features a comfortable grip for extended handling. The reward bundle includes the VoltGale unit, a 4-in-1 USB cable, and a user manual, with shipping fees collected after the campaign via PledgeBox and estimated delivery scheduled for November 2026.
