projects.name: Beacon: The Easy Way to Find Any Phone or Tablet
projects.blurb: Make nearby phones and tablets ring at the press of a button. Find up to 16 devices.
projects.html_story:
Make nearby phones and tablets ring at the press of a button. Find up to 16 devices.

Make nearby phones and tablets ring at the press of a button. Find up to 16 devices.

The Easy Way to Find Any Phone or Tablet

Easily Locate Up To 16 Devices

Better Than the Alternatives

Works Anytime, Anywhere

Cheap Long-Lasting Battery

Why I Built Beacon

Why Kickstarter?

Environmental commitments

The Easy Way to Find Any Phone or Tablet

Just press a button to make any nearby phone or tablet ring in seconds - even on silent or do not disturb.  No internet or account setup required.  Works with iOS and Android devices.

Easily Locate Up To 16 Devices

Having 4 buttons doesn't mean you're limited to finding 4 devices.  Holding a button while turning Beacon on sets the group.  With 4 groups of 4 channels, you can easily track down up to 16 devices individually.

Better Than the Alternatives

Beacon is designed specifically for finding nearby phones and tablets.  The existing options are not.Trackers are designed to help you use your phone to find your stuff.  "Find My Device" networks can help in some situations, but they require another device, internet access, more setup, and more time.Beacon is designed to be faster and simpler for finding nearby phones and tablets.

Works Anytime, Anywhere

Beacon uses Bluetooth, soit works anywhere without relying on an internet connection or cell service.  You can take it camping in the middle of nowhere and it will still work.  While you're home, keep it in a drawer, hang it on a hook, or stick it on the fridge so it's always ready when you need it.

Beacon comes with a completely free app that works withboth iOS and Android.  And the best part isthere are no ads, no subscriptions, no accounts, and no data collection.

You can adjust your settings in the app on the fly: group, channel, volume, vibration, and whether the sound plays once or loops until you find your device and hit the stop button.

Cheap Long-Lasting Battery

Most users shouldeasily hit 8-12 yearsbefore the battery runs out.  And when it finally does, it'scheap and easy to replaceit yourself with a readily-available CR2032 coin cell battery.  Check the FAQ if you want to see the math.

Why I Built Beacon

A few years ago, I built the first prototype of Beacon with one simple idea in mind: there's a ton of options for using your phone to find a tracker, but why hasn't anyone made a dedicated device to find your phones and tablets yet?  Admittedly, the first iteration was pretty terrible.  But having a working proof of concept filled me with excitement and I started thinking of all the ways I could make it better.

Before I got around to making any major improvements, I got laid off from my tech job.  After taking some time to reflect, I decided it was the right time to go all in and finish Beacon as an independent project.

Since then I've refined the hardware and software over and over, turning Beacon into something I'm genuinely proud of: an honest product that's both practical and polished.

Why Kickstarter?

Beacon is already built and working, but there are still significant upfront costs involved in bringing it to market.  The biggest one is Bluetooth qualification.  Since Beacon uses Bluetooth, I need to complete the required Bluetooth SIG qualification process before I can legally sell it.  That fee is pretty hefty, and a major hurdle for an independent project like this.

This campaign will help to cover some of that cost, along with the first production run and fulfillment.  Kickstarter is what helps me turn Beacon from a finished project into something I can actually ship.

Risks and challenges

Beacon is already at the end of development.  The hardware, firmware, and apps are built and I've spent a significant amount of time prototyping, testing, and working through the manufacturing process.  Because of that, this project is much closer to production than a typical "early concept/prototype" campaign.

That said, every physical product has some risk.  There may still be minor adjustments needed during app submission, final production, packaging, or fulfillment.  At this point though, I don't expect any major technical unknowns.

My goal is to keep the process realistic and manageable while being transparent about what's going on and communicating clearly with backers if anything needs to change along the way.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

Beacon is designed to last a long time.  The easily replaceable battery is expected to last 8-12 years with typical use.  The switch and buttons should also hold up for decades before wear starts to become an issue.

I also plan to provide the .stl files for the case, so if the original is ever damaged anyone can 3D print a replacement rather than just throwing the whole thing away.

Back it because you believe in it.

Support the project for no reward, just because it speaks to you.

ai_highlights_en: Works anywhere via Bluetooth without internet or cell service
Free app with no ads, subscriptions, accounts, or data collection
Long-lasting CR2032 battery lasts 8-12 years and is easy to replace
projects.ai_risks_en: Beacon is already built and at the end of development with hardware, firmware, and apps complete. Minor adjustments may be needed during app submission, final production, packaging, or fulfillment, but no major technical unknowns are expected. The main hurdle is covering Bluetooth qualification costs.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Independent creator who built the first prototype years ago, then went all in on Beacon after being laid off from a tech job, refining it into a polished, practical product.
projects.ai_description_en:
Beacon is a dedicated Bluetooth device designed to instantly locate your misplaced phones and tablets at the press of a button. Unlike traditional trackers that require you to use your phone to locate a separate physical tag, Beacon reverses the paradigm by letting you find your own devices directly. The core function is straightforward: press a button, and any nearby phone or tablet will ring in seconds, even if it is set to silent or Do Not Disturb. It works entirely independently of an internet connection or cellular service, making it a reliable solution anytime, anywhere—whether you are in your living room or camping in the middle of nowhere. The completely free companion app supports both iOS and Android without requiring any account setup, ads, or data collection.

What sets Beacon apart is its versatility and long-term reliability. While the device features four buttons, you are not limited to finding just four devices. By holding a button while powering on the device, you can set group and channel combinations, allowing you to track down up to 16 devices individually. The app provides easy, on-the-fly customizable settings for volume, vibration, whether the ringtone plays once or loops continuously until found, and your specific group or channel. Furthermore, Beacon boasts an impressive battery life of 8 to 12 years on a cheap, readily available CR2032 coin cell battery that is incredibly easy to replace yourself.

Beacon matters because it addresses the common frustration of losing track of phones and tablets faster and more simply than existing alternatives. Traditional "Find My Device" networks require another device, internet access, more setup, and more time. Beacon eliminates those hurdles entirely. Because the hardware, firmware, and apps are already fully built and extensively tested, the project is much closer to production than typical early-concept campaigns. Backing Beacon supports a genuinely practical, polished, and honest product that solves a very real everyday problem.

#### With StrokeKeeper, your scorecard is always accessible and editable. Golf courses auto-load by proximity, from our 39,000 course database. But the best part is, you don’t even have to pick up your phone, on iPhone 14+, our Live Activity Widget can be visible at all times!

### How it works, Part 1

### How it works, Part2

### Development Status

StrokeKeeper is no longer just an idea.

We have completed product supply, product design, developed the mobile application for iPhone (iOS) with Android on the way, partnered with a manufacturer of button hardware (fully tested, fully certified), and conducted real-world testing with golfers over 3 months.

Our manufacturing partner has agreed to set aside up to 1,000 buttons for our Kickstarter launch. There is a delivery window of approximately one month to fulfill these first-ordered buttons.  We are actively working to ensure a delivery timeline for our Kickstarter backers that may number over this initial order, currently that window is at 6-8 weeks.

StrokeKeeper buttons are supplied by a major manufacturer in the smart button space. Rigorous testing covers connectivity, latency, and durability. Buttons are pressed repeatedly (often hundreds of thousands of times) to verify switch lifespan and tactile feel. Testing how long the internal batteries (like CR2032 or CR2) last under various operating modes, checking for battery drain during idle or active states. Evaluating physical resistance against splashes. Testing the strength of Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connections to ensure messages translate without delay. Ensuring the button reconnects instantly when moving back into actionable range.

Our software development team has tested for button trigger recognition, verifying that a single push, double push, and hold each trigger distinct actions consistently. Ensured the button communicates seamlessly our StrokeKeeper App on both iOS and Android.

Today, the StrokeKeeper app is available in the Apple App Store, and our prototype devices have already been used during live rounds of golf to validate the user experience and reliability of the system.

### Founder Story

There we were—Margie and Becky—kicking off our golf shoes and sitting down for a pizza, cold beverages in hand. Between laughs and bites, one of us sighed about tallying our golf scores; the other chimed in, “Can make this easier??”

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/975/985/706ea01b8777d0be5426a9e743480d18_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780502882&width=680&sig=BQL%2BYOHLYLPaPHCAPtDbYgQOpJnUhzmH%2FYmtorCaU78%3D)

That spark became StrokeKeeper. We’ve been building it ever since, and we’re so excited to share the Kickstarter launch with you!

Like many golfers, we found ourselves constantly interrupting our rounds to keep score.

Whether it was reaching for a phone, searching for a pencil, or trying to remember a score from two holes ago, scorekeeping often pulled us out of the game.

We believed there had to be a simpler way.

So we set out to create a scorekeeping system that disappears into the background of your round.

The result is StrokeKeeper: a simple wearable device and companion app that lets golfers track their score with a single tap while keeping their focus where it belongs—on the next shot.

As golfers ourselves, we've spent countless hours refining, testing, and improving the experience. We're excited to share StrokeKeeper with golfers everywhere and grateful to every backer helping us bring it to a larger audience.

## Risks and challenges

Bringing any hardware product to market involves challenges, and we believe it's important to be transparent about them.

The good news is that StrokeKeeper is well beyond the concept stage. We have already developed working hardware prototypes, completed extensive real-world testing, and launched the StrokeKeeper app in the Apple App Store. Kickstarter funding will help us transition from pilot production into larger-scale manufacturing, supply, and fulfillment.

That said, there are still risks involved in bringing StrokeKeeper to backers.

Manufacturing and Production

As with any hardware product, manufacturing timelines can be affected by component availability, production scheduling, or unexpected delays from suppliers. To reduce these risks, we have already completed product design and prototyping, identified manufacturing partners, and built additional time into our production schedule. We have secured an agreement with our smart button manufacturer for the first 1,000 items (buttons/clips) to be available on expedited basis.

Quality Assurance

Delivering a reliable product is one of our highest priorities. Before any smart buttons are shipped to us, production units will undergo quality assurance testing to verify functionality, connectivity, and overall performance.

Software Development and Support

The StrokeKeeper mobile app is already operational and available in the Apple App Store. While this significantly reduces software-related risk, ongoing updates, bug fixes, operating system changes, and future enhancements will continue after launch. We will actively support the platform and communicate any significant software updates to our community. Android development is complete, an testing/refinements are currenlty ongoing. We fully anticipate Google Play Store launch prior to Kickstarter Campaign ending.

Supply Chain and Logistics

Global shipping and supply chain disruptions can occasionally affect inventory availability, manufacturing schedules, and delivery timelines. While many of these factors are outside our direct control, we are planning conservatively and building flexibility into our fulfillment schedule to help minimize potential impacts. Of course, this may only impact those orders above and beyond the 1,000 button supply we've secured an agreement for.

Shipping and Fulfillment

Shipping timelines can vary based on carrier performance, customs processing, and regional delivery conditions. We will work with experienced fulfillment partners and provide regular updates throughout the fulfillment process so backers always know where things stand.

Our Commitment to Backers

Perhaps the most important challenge for any Kickstarter project is maintaining clear communication. If delays or unexpected obstacles arise, we commit to being transparent with our backers. We will provide regular updates, explain any challenges we encounter, and share the steps we are taking to keep the project moving forward.

We've invested significant time, resources, and personal passion into developing StrokeKeeper. With a working prototype, a live mobile application, successful field testing, and a defined path to production, we believe we are well-positioned to deliver on our promises and bring StrokeKeeper into the hands of golfers everywhere.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Two golfers, Margie and Becky, who created StrokeKeeper after experiencing the frustration of traditional scorekeeping during their rounds.
projects.ai_description_en:
StrokeKeeper is a lightweight, wearable smart button designed to solve the enduring frustration of tracking golf scores. Traditional scoring methods—fumbling for a pencil, balancing a scorecard, or pulling out your phone—force you to break your focus and disrupt the natural rhythm of your game. StrokeKeeper eliminates these distractions entirely. By clipping securely to your hat, belt, or golf golf glove, the device ensures you stay in the zone, removing the need for paper scorecards or constant screen checking.

Using StrokeKeeper feels entirely intuitive and mimics the physical satisfaction of a simple click. You tap the button once per stroke and long-press to advance to the next hole, requiring zero screen interaction mid-round. The seamless connection to the StrokeKeeper mobile app elevates the experience further. Boasting a massive database of 39,000 golf courses that automatically loads based on your proximity, your scorecard is always accurate and accessible. For iPhone 14+ users, the Live Activity Widget keeps your score visible at all times, meaning you genuinely never need to touch your phone to know how you stand.

StrokeKeeper is a crowdfunding project that stands out for its high level of maturity. Rather than shipping an unproven concept, the team has already developed working hardware, conducted extensive real-world testing, and launched the app in the Apple App Store, with the Android app in final testing ahead of its Google Play Store launch. Manufacturing agreements are already secured for the first 1,000 units, ensuring an expedited path from pilot production to fulfillment. With a clear, transparent roadmap and a practical solution that lets golfers focus entirely on their swing, StrokeKeeper delivers a polished, necessary upgrade to the modern golfer's game.

## Story

### BitCards: Build Real Logic Circuits. Save the Ship.

A hands-on STEM adventure where kids learn digital logic, sensors, and microcontrollers by completing space rescue missions with real hardware.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/052/901/421/e4f671e741df68a431811e69601f21ea_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1773166049&width=680&sig=Tmn2vy5GnkS9gEB6f%2FNXMXTNNtSLAAQ%2FIHqLigjJuPQ%3D)Before kids learn to code, let them discover how computers think.

### The ship is losing control.

#### The crew needs you.

Somewhere deep in space, the BitCards spacecraft has suffered a critical systems failure.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/555/94a815f467816b35e3bd799e7e088721_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779555769&width=680&sig=Y%2B%2FAV53mKukJ5U34pUZjaHZrW5SpAxIaV8bLa6aLtlk%3D)

The navigation grid is unstable.

The engine core is offline.

The sensors are sending corrupted signals.

And Mission Control has one message:

“We need a young engineer.”

BitCards turns digital logic into a hands-on space rescue adventure. Kids don’t just watch lessons. They connect real logic cards, complete missions, trigger LEDs, control signals, and discover how computers actually make decisions.

Before they write code, they learn the language every computer is built on:

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/849/865/0919cfc377628f9e6be750314155ec9e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779648268&width=680&sig=vnbQZHdhcbw9fvvnfLvWyPG38tmPf2JGPSmLnlEsfng%3D)

### What Is BitCards?

BitCards is a hands-on STEM learning system where kids learn digital logic, sensors, and microcontrollers through story-driven missions.

Instead of starting with code, BitCards starts with the foundation behind every computer, robot, game console, and smart device:

AND. OR. NOT. XOR. Memory. Signals. Inputs. Outputs.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/349/7e5f258ac76671014ce46c215012c86b_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782036533&width=680&sig=eELI5vtNjdgtdPUEA63MNcxqiRYe%2F68IxMaBm6QY1y0%3D)

Each BitCards logic card represents a real digital logic concept. Kids connect the cards, test the result, and use them to solve missions inside the BitCards platform.

Every mission moves the story forward.

One mission may ask them to restore the ship’s door control system.

Another may require them to activate emergency lights.

Another may challenge them to repair the launch sequence before time runs out.

They are not just learning electronics.

They are saving the ship.

### Welcome to the BitCards Mission Control Program

The spacecraft Astra-7 is drifting off course.

A meteor storm damaged its control systems, and the ship’s AI can no longer operate safely without human help.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/713/ff41de98013601670e6e18337645d0bb_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782041876&width=680&sig=A5CHorwwlufbimjBAmqpRXGT74NNdVtH4JlAIZoRvoA%3D)

To bring the ship back online, young engineers must complete real logic missions using physical BitCards.

Each card controls a part of the system.

Each connection changes the signal.

Each correct solution brings the ship one step closer to safety.

Build the logic. Restore the system. Save the mission.

### How It Works

#### 1\. Choose a mission

Open the BitCards platform and select your mission.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/697/9f7cef749cf52af34c73a324d96d046e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779557108&width=680&sig=evKk%2B0ePkKzuq8%2BeIjDUAaIjRS3LEQECPoFKZ3qcowo%3D)

Maybe the engine room is offline.

Maybe the airlock is stuck.

Maybe the navigation system is confused.

Maybe the ship needs emergency power.

Each mission teaches one important concept through a real challenge.

#### 2\. Connect the logic cards

Use physical BitCards to build the required logic circuit.

For example:

Input A + Input B → AND Card → Output LED

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/357/b95d1747735e80f4db7f77a72dea6fa6_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782036604&width=680&sig=U0MZsOWMfQeKAp1jQ%2F%2F4eUobrZr4ujq%2BuVtjrqYc41g%3D)

Kids can see how signals move, how gates react, and why the output changes.

No abstract theory first.

No boring textbook start.

Just real cause and effect.

#### 3\. Test your solution

Connect your logic setup to the Hexter Core microcontroller and test it inside the mission.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/363/f0d6ce224f20d14a1441c6ca107c6831_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782036759&width=680&sig=v0JUEzu%2Fqb8V2AHwOQ8AJIMmPX1%2FZyq2lryD8s4uSvM%3D)

If the circuit works, the system comes back online.

If it fails, the platform helps the child troubleshoot, try again, and understand what went wrong.

Because in engineering, mistakes are not failure.

They are part of the mission.

#### 4\. Unlock the next level

After learning logic gates, kids move into more advanced challenges:

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/710/7ddf4f533793f99401ab080081eac186_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779557267&width=680&sig=enW9285oJUvWVRcVWqYn0rN7Tw1BBwHdZ6GPnybgqUE%3D)

Digital signals

Embedded systems

Real-world problem solving

BitCards grows with the learner — from simple logic to real hardware thinking.

### Meet Hexter Core

Hexter Core is the mission controller of the BitCards universe.

It connects the physical cards to the digital platform and helps kids bring their circuits to life.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/697/90226f62ac9a370c45a6b9100e4e2e82_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782041636&width=680&sig=3H%2BgVsMJp%2BnOjA65xPAZACAjITma3AT2N8xTYE1tAGw%3D)

With Hexter Core, kids can:

- Connect logic cards

- Read inputs and outputs

- Trigger mission events

- Use sensors

- Control lights, buzzers, and other components

- Move from logic gates into microcontroller-based projects

Hexter Core is the bridge between physical learning and interactive missions.

It is where logic becomes action.

### Mission Examples

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/651/7b1934345b2236b5117019fe36e78dae_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779556654&width=680&sig=NPQI3TNpJe1X6jfYnZLIkk%2Ftmnckg%2F0DTyvVGC4K02U%3D)

#### Mission 01 — Restore Emergency Lights

Use an AND card to activate emergency lights only when both safety signals are active.

#### Mission 02 — Repair the Airlock Warning

Use an OR card to trigger the warning if either pressure sensor detects danger.

#### Mission 03 — Override a Fault Signal

Use a NOT card to invert a corrupted signal and restore control.

#### Mission 04 — Decode Navigation Lock

Use XOR logic to unlock the correct navigation pattern.

#### Mission 05 — Sensor Protocol

Connect sensors to Hexter Core and help the ship react to the real world.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/655/4b48c2c277586921fdc4f28dae4bbc10_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779556674&width=680&sig=NryOgpkPZbj4SzYKfuEiygidaBoxEF3YuvOs9mSUNeI%3D)

### BitCards Is Not Another STEM Kit

Most STEM kits start with code.

BitCards starts with logic.

Coding is powerful.

But before code runs, computers rely on something deeper:

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/720/3afb3fed7c1c7980f4e73d567d6955ae_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782041956&width=680&sig=cX8QOtgLyYL1kBXGj3IeH4sNvZTb%2B7c3mwbTqG5TTsY%3D)

Every button press, every sensor reading, every robot movement, every game controller, and every smart device depends on logical decisions.

BitCards helps kids understand those decisions before they jump into programming.

That means when they eventually learn to code, they are not just copying blocks or following steps.

They understand what is happening underneath.

They understand how machines think.

### ❤️ Why We Built BitCards

This project started with a simple question:

What if children could learn how computers think before they ever write their first line of code?

Not through boring theory.

Not through complicated diagrams.

Not by staring at a screen for hours.

But by touching, connecting, testing, failing, trying again, and discovering.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/844/d104818b0651bb06f17ce62754b24aa2_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779558714&width=680&sig=mil7vDoVw59pTDyd7Vl6GBPgu7RL9wF4Ss%2FADtW2DCw%3D)

That is the heart of BitCards.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/843/726f7920d03e4226c0e6632b8c5cbc43_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779558704&width=680&sig=Z7cjW7oPgWT31xNzNdUIw1VsM6zJQaQMrXlPor%2FVVFE%3D)

A child can take a logic card, connect it, press a button, see a light turn on, and suddenly understand something that usually feels abstract and difficult.

That small moment matters.

Because the first time a child understands how something works, something changes.

They stop being only users of technology.

They start becoming builders.

### A Very Personal Mission

My name is Harun Osmanović, and I am the founder of BitCards.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/884/86c54926d1131dff5633941b47299f62_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779559064&width=680&sig=gqalXQLtmlJqrqQ1zIhsf1MN8s9fH%2F5wVCr8BzesGjk%3D)

I am a hardware engineer, but BitCards is more than an engineering project to me.

It is personal.

My son, Omar, has just been born.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/876/50c65e5db1dd9b9d0a24d1d4e838985a_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779559018&width=680&sig=nWLwInar2jWt3%2BN%2B8vE6UGMROLNxxEPakjdMbPEpSb4%3D)

He is still too small to hold a logic card, too young to understand electronics, and years away from building his first circuit.

But one day, I want him to grow up in a world where technology does not feel like magic that only a few people understand.

I want him to touch it.

Question it.

Break it.

Fix it.

Build with it.

And most importantly, understand it.

BitCards was built for that future.

For Omar.

For your children.

For every curious kid who deserves a better, easier, and more exciting way to learn how technology works.

### Built for the Way Children Actually Learn

Children do not learn best by memorizing definitions.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/181/367/2949438344902db2586902e59dcf072f_original.JPG?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1782036852&width=680&sig=I%2Fcv6h2ppeY1rs0Mp72dQsYX2YJZvGuodVeHpDrsP0M%3D)

They learn by exploring.

They learn by asking “what happens if I do this?”

They learn by playing, repeating, testing, and seeing real results.

That is why BitCards is built around physical interaction.

Every card represents a real logic function.

AND. OR. NOT. XOR. Flip-Flops. Counters.

Instead of reading about these concepts in a textbook, students can hold them in their hands and see how they behave.

BitCards turns abstract digital logic into something visible, physical, and understandable.

And that changes everything.

### More Than Hardware

BitCards is not just a product.

It is an ecosystem.

Each device has its own unique identity through a MAC address and can be registered to one user inside the BitCards platform.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/909/09d647cd0eb5f91a94f5b73da08a8c8d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779559193&width=680&sig=BeFt5zJGoDJ3bvb5PBCDTzvyZvh1uwA5ukrU0256RC4%3D)

That means every kid can have their own device, their own progress, their own missions, and their own learning journey.

This is not just “plug it in and upload code.”

This is a complete learning experience:

physical cards, sensors, microcontrollers, guided missions, challenges, achievements, and future expansions.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/918/c033b7e15a533fc6b1a5d7c4a6394a42_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779559252&width=680&sig=2OXXDe4xK%2FA9q4Xel%2FY4rwfkR%2F0uuvF1tdbTKj%2FmkxM%3D)

Hardware and software working together.

Learning and play working together.

Curiosity and engineering working together.

### The BitCards System

BitCards consists of three main elements.

#### 1\. Logic & Sensor Cards

Each card represents a real digital component or sensor.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/930/5cf21821280cfe134441aba130006a8d_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779559339&width=680&sig=7WxeSTdZnkq%2FL5SxnfTW8DXPPJvCe55g7OEt%2Flvl%2FWM%3D)

Simple. Durable. Intuitive.

Insert a card and immediately see how the logic behaves.

#### 2\. Hexter Core Board

At the center of the system is the Hexter Core.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/927/7ce490cc7f5c57410f97acee69014935_original.webp?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779559307&width=680&sig=sHUghnopAULifF5C0xZr0wXpJjuJVSDdZNSRl96i6F0%3D)

A modular board that connects cards, power, and sensors.

It acts as the bridge between logic circuits and real-world electronics.

#### 3.BitCards Platform

Learning doesn't stop with the hardware.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/666/d0396d98f210898501119a830792ee5d_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779556776&width=680&sig=Da5VZyS07wsDOQx5vJlNBC%2B6KOFsw2Tr4%2Fq9HMgfvwc%3D)

The BitCards platform includes:

- Interactive missions

- Guided experiments

- Logic puzzles

- Challenges and achievements

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/841/670/b74391af80d50a580525024a572f077b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779556804&width=680&sig=DmzT9x8VX603VB5%2F5yvD%2Bt4HghQ36YZSx0i0WiQYmQc%3D)

Students progress through levels while learning real engineering concepts.

Explore the BitCards Platform: [https://platform.argas-solutions.com/](https://platform.argas-solutions.com/)

### Created With Engineering, Psychology, and Love

BitCards was not built by one person sitting in a room trying to copy what already exists.

It was shaped by a small team that cares deeply about education, electronics, and how children grow.

I worked on the hardware and engineering side.

My wife, who holds a master’s degree in psychology and specializes in child development from early childhood through adolescence, helped shape the way we think about learning, attention, curiosity, and cognitive load.

Because for us, this was never only about making a cool STEM gadget.

It was about creating something that feels safe, meaningful, and exciting for young minds.

Something that does not overwhelm children.

Something that invites them in.

Something that says:

“You can understand this.”

“You can build this.”

“This world belongs to you too.”

### Our Bigger Vision

We believe the world does not need more children who only know how to use technology.

The world needs children who understand it.

Children who can think logically.

Children who can solve problems.

Children who can build, create, and imagine better systems.

Today, BitCards starts with logic cards, sensors, and a learning platform.

But this is only the beginning.

Like any hardware project, BitCards involves several challenges including manufacturing timelines, supply chain availability, and logistics.

Another challenge is scaling fulfillment if the campaign exceeds expectations. To address this, we are planning fulfillment with experienced logistics partners and scalable shipping solutions.

BitCards: Build Real Logic Circuits. Save the Ship.

A hands-on STEM adventure where kids learn digital logic, sensors, and microcontrollers by completing space rescue missions with real hardware.

The ship is losing control.

The crew needs you.

Somewhere deep in space, the BitCards spacecraft has suffered a critical systems failure.

The navigation grid is unstable.The engine core is offline.The sensors are sending corrupted signals.And Mission Control has one message:

“We need a young engineer.”

BitCards turns digital logic into a hands-on space rescue adventure. Kids don’t just watch lessons. They connect real logic cards, complete missions, trigger LEDs, control signals, and discover how computers actually make decisions.

Before they write code, they learn the language every computer is built on:

What Is BitCards?

BitCards is a hands-on STEM learning system where kids learn digital logic, sensors, and microcontrollers through story-driven missions.

Instead of starting with code, BitCards starts with the foundation behind every computer, robot, game console, and smart device:

AND. OR. NOT. XOR. Memory. Signals. Inputs. Outputs.

Each BitCards logic card represents a real digital logic concept. Kids connect the cards, test the result, and use them to solve missions inside the BitCards platform.

Every mission moves the story forward.

One mission may ask them to restore the ship’s door control system.Another may require them to activate emergency lights.Another may challenge them to repair the launch sequence before time runs out.

They are not just learning electronics.

They are saving the ship.

Welcome to the BitCards Mission Control Program

The spacecraftAstra-7is drifting off course.

A meteor storm damaged its control systems, and the ship’s AI can no longer operate safely without human help.

To bring the ship back online, young engineers must complete real logic missions using physical BitCards.

Each card controls a part of the system.Each connection changes the signal.Each correct solution brings the ship one step closer to safety.

Build the logic. Restore the system. Save the mission.

1. Choose a mission

Open the BitCards platform and select your mission.

Maybe the engine room is offline.Maybe the airlock is stuck.Maybe the navigation system is confused.Maybe the ship needs emergency power.

Each mission teaches one important concept through a real challenge.

2. Connect the logic cards

Use physical BitCards to build the required logic circuit.

Input A + Input B → AND Card → Output LED

Kids can see how signals move, how gates react, and why the output changes.

No abstract theory first.No boring textbook start.

Just real cause and effect.

3. Test your solution

Connect your logic setup to the Hexter Core microcontroller and test it inside the mission.

If the circuit works, the system comes back online.

If it fails, the platform helps the child troubleshoot, try again, and understand what went wrong.

Because in engineering, mistakes are not failure.

They are part of the mission.

4. Unlock the next level

After learning logic gates, kids move into more advanced challenges:

Digital signalsSensorsMicrocontrollersEmbedded systemsReal-world problem solving

BitCards grows with the learner — from simple logic to real hardware thinking.

Meet Hexter Core

Hexter Core is the mission controller of the BitCards universe.

It connects the physical cards to the digital platform and helps kids bring their circuits to life.

With Hexter Core, kids can:

Connect logic cards

Read inputs and outputs

Trigger mission events

Control lights, buzzers, and other components

Move from logic gates into microcontroller-based projects

Hexter Core is the bridge between physical learning and interactive missions.

It is where logic becomes action.

Mission Examples

Mission 01 — Restore Emergency Lights

Use an AND card to activate emergency lights only when both safety signals are active.

Mission 02 — Repair the Airlock Warning

Use an OR card to trigger the warning if either pressure sensor detects danger.

Mission 03 — Override a Fault Signal

Use a NOT card to invert a corrupted signal and restore control.

Mission 04 — Decode Navigation Lock

Use XOR logic to unlock the correct navigation pattern.

Mission 05 — Sensor Protocol

Connect sensors to Hexter Core and help the ship react to the real world.

BitCards Is Not Another STEM Kit

Most STEM kits start with code.

BitCards starts with logic.

Coding is powerful.

But before code runs, computers rely on something deeper:

Every button press, every sensor reading, every robot movement, every game controller, and every smart device depends on logical decisions.

BitCards helps kids understand those decisions before they jump into programming.

That means when they eventually learn to code, they are not just copying blocks or following steps.

They understand what is happening underneath.

They understand how machines think.

❤️Why We Built BitCards

This project started with a simple question:

What if children could learn how computers think before they ever write their first line of code?

Not through boring theory.

Not through complicated diagrams.

Not by staring at a screen for hours.

But by touching, connecting, testing, failing, trying again, and discovering.

That is the heart of BitCards.

A child can take a logic card, connect it, press a button, see a light turn on, and suddenly understand something that usually feels abstract and difficult.

That small moment matters.

Because the first time a child understands how something works, something changes.

They stop being only users of technology.

They start becoming builders.

A Very Personal Mission

My name is Harun Osmanović, and I am the founder of BitCards.

I am a hardware engineer, but BitCards is more than an engineering project to me.

It is personal.

My son, Omar, has just been born.

He is still too small to hold a logic card, too young to understand electronics, and years away from building his first circuit.

But one day, I want him to grow up in a world where technology does not feel like magic that only a few people understand.

I want him to touch it.

And most importantly, understand it.

BitCards was built for that future.

For your children.

For every curious kid who deserves a better, easier, and more exciting way to learn how technology works.

Built for the Way Children Actually Learn

Children do not learn best by memorizing definitions.

They learn by exploring.

They learn by asking “what happens if I do this?”

They learn by playing, repeating, testing, and seeing real results.

That is why BitCards is built around physical interaction.

Every card represents a real logic function.

AND. OR. NOT. XOR. Flip-Flops. Counters.

Instead of reading about these concepts in a textbook, students can hold them in their hands and see how they behave.

BitCards turns abstract digital logic into something visible, physical, and understandable.

And that changes everything.

BitCards is not just a product.

It is an ecosystem.

Each device has its own unique identity through a MAC address and can be registered to one user inside the BitCards platform.

That means every kid can have their own device, their own progress, their own missions, and their own learning journey.

This is not just “plug it in and upload code.”

This is a complete learning experience:

physical cards, sensors, microcontrollers, guided missions, challenges, achievements, and future expansions.

Hardware and software working together.

Learning and play working together.

Curiosity and engineering working together.

Each card represents a real digital component or sensor.

Simple. Durable. Intuitive.

Insert a card and immediately see how the logic behaves.

At the center of the system is theHexter Core.

A modular board that connects cards, power, and sensors.

It acts as the bridge betweenlogic circuits and real-world electronics.

Interactive missions

Guided experiments

Challenges and achievements

Students progress through levels while learning real engineering concepts.

projects.ai_intro_en: BitCards is a hands-on STEM learning system where kids learn digital logic, sensors, and microcontrollers through story-driven space rescue missions. Instead of starting with code, children connect real logic cards to build circuits, trigger LEDs, and control signals to save the Astra-7 spacecraft. The system bridges physical learning and interactive missions using the Hexter Core microcontroller.
ai_highlights_en: Story-driven space rescue missions teach digital logic through hands-on circuit building.
Hexter Core microcontroller connects physical logic cards to interactive digital missions.
Teaches foundational logic (AND, OR, NOT, XOR) before introducing programming code.
ai_specs_en: BitCards logic cards, Hexter Core microcontroller
AND, OR, NOT, XOR, Memory, Signals
Logic gates to sensors, microcontrollers, and embedded systems
projects.ai_risks_en:
Like any hardware project, BitCards involves several challenges including manufacturing timelines, supply chain availability, and logistics.

The core components of BitCards are printed circuit boards and electronic components, which means production depends on component availability and factory scheduling. To reduce this risk, the system has been designed using widely available electronic components and standard PCB manufacturing processes. We are also working with experienced electronics manufacturers to ensure consistent production quality.

Another challenge is scaling fulfillment if the campaign exceeds expectations. To address this, we are planning fulfillment with experienced logistics partners and scalable shipping solutions.

Software development for the BitCards learning platform is another important part of the project. The platform is already under active development and will continue to evolve alongside the hardware.

Finally, as with any international shipping project, there may be delays related to customs or transportation. We will communicate transparently with backers and provide regular updates throughout the process.

Our goal is to deliver a reliable and well-designed educational product, and we are committed to working through any challenges to ensure backers receive their rewards.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Hardware creator and STEM enthusiast building tools that help people understand technology. Currently creating BitCards — a hands-on system that teaches kids how computers think using real logic circuits.
projects.ai_description_en:
BitCards is a hands-on STEM learning platform that transforms digital logic education into an immersive space rescue adventure. The system consists of physical logic cards that represent fundamental computing concepts—AND, OR, NOT, XOR, memory, and signals—along with the Hexter Core microcontroller and Logic Dock. Rather than starting with abstract code or textbook theory, children connect real electronic cards to build working circuits, seeing immediately how inputs become outputs and how computers make decisions at the most foundational level.

The experience is driven by a compelling narrative: the spacecraft Astra-7 has suffered a critical systems failure, and young engineers must complete logic missions to restore navigation, repair engine controls, activate emergency systems, and save the crew. Each mission presents a real challenge—perhaps restoring a door control system or debugging a sensor array—that requires connecting the right combination of BitCards to produce the correct signal. The physical cards plug into the Logic Dock, and kids can test their solutions in real time, watching LEDs respond and signals flow through their circuits. It’s cause and effect made tangible.

BitCards matters because it teaches the language every computer is built on before a single line of code enters the picture. By working with real hardware and immediate feedback, children develop genuine intuition for how digital systems operate—knowledge that underpins everything from game consoles to robots to smart devices. The platform includes guided missions, platform access to additional content, and a Hexter Core microcontroller that bridges physical logic into programmable behavior. With Early Bird pricing at £159 for the Complete Logic System (15 cards, Hexter Core, Logic Dock, mission guide) and a Discovery Pack starting at £49, BitCards offers an entry point for every aspiring engineer ready to save the ship—and learn computing from the ground up.

Risks and challenges

AudioVUES Flow is an innovative consumer hardware product that combines window treatment technology with integrated Bluetooth audio. As with any new hardware product, there are risks and challenges involved in bringing it from prototype development to production.

At the time of this campaign, AudioVUES has completed its engineering design phase and is currently moving into prototype manufacturing and testing. The primary risks involve prototype refinement, manufacturing validation, component sourcing, testing, and production timelines.

To reduce these risks, we have already invested significant time and resources into product development, engineering, intellectual property protection, and supplier research. Our engineering package has been completed, allowing us to move forward with prototype fabrication and real-world testing.

Potential challenges may include:

Prototype revisions and performance optimization
Manufacturing and tooling delays
Component availability and supply chain fluctuations
Production scheduling and quality control

We plan to address these challenges through ongoing prototype testing, close collaboration with engineering and manufacturing partners, careful supplier selection, and maintaining transparent communication with our supporters throughout the development process.

As the founder of AudioVUES, I bring more than 13 years of experience in the window treatment industry and remain actively involved in every stage of product development. While challenges are a normal part of bringing a new hardware product to market, we are committed to navigating them responsibly and delivering a product that meets our vision and our supporters' expectations.

We believe the opportunity to create a new category within the smart home and window treatment industries is worth the challenge, and we appreciate every supporter who joins us on this journey.

We have used AI to generate the voiceovers for the campaign.

Future Material Choices
- Recycled aluminum or steel in the headrail.
- Sustainable or recycled fabrics.
- Non-toxic finishes and adhesives.
- Potential future 'Eco Edition' made from majority recycled and low-carbon materials.

Sustainable Distribution

Reduced Packaging Waste (Future DTC consideration)
- Use recyclable boxes, minimal plastic.
- QR codes instead of printed manuals.

Energy-Efficient Smart Shade Functionality
- Automatic light filtering and UV blocking via blackout or solar fabrics reduce heat gain/loss in a room.
- This lowers HVAC energy usage, contributing to energy-efficient homes.
- Ties into the green building movement and appeals to LEED-certified construction or eco-conscious consumers.

Multi-Functionality Reduces Device Clutter
- Replaces the need for a separate speaker system.
- Fewer devices = less e-waste, fewer plastic enclosures, and reduced shipping emissions.
- Supports a 'minimal impact' design philosophy.

projects.ai_description_en:
AudioVUES Flow is the world's first Bluetooth-integrated window shade audio system—a sleek, modern window shade that transforms into a premium speaker the moment you press play. Engineered to disappear, this innovative product combines high-fidelity audio technology with contemporary window treatment design, eliminating the need for bulky standalone speakers that clutter your space. It seamlessly merges two essential home elements into a single, elegant solution, allowing you to enjoy rich sound without compromising on room aesthetics or window functionality.

This product matters because it creates a wholly new category at the intersection of smart home technology and interior design. Backed by a founder with over 13 years of experience in the window treatment industry, AudioVUES Flow represents a fresh perspective on how we integrate technology into our living spaces. The device is built on completed acoustic validation and thorough mechanical engineering, ensuring that the final product delivers on its promise of hidden, high-quality audio performance.

Currently in the prototype manufacturing and testing phase, the development milestones include a completed PCT international filing for intellectual property protection, finished acoustic validation, and ongoing mechanical manufacturing discussions. While the path from prototype to production involves inherent risks—including potential tooling delays, component sourcing, and supply chain fluctuations—the team is mitigating these challenges through careful supplier selection, ongoing real-world testing, and close collaboration with engineering and manufacturing partners.

For backers, supporting this project means securing Kickstarter-exclusive pricing and gaining early access to a pioneering product. Early adopters have the chance to be among the first 100 owners and can play a vital role in shaping the future of the AudioVUES brand through private feedback opportunities. By backing AudioVUES Flow, supporters aren't just buying a speaker; they're helping to launch an entirely new smart home paradigm.

## Story

### Brand New PCB Architecture

![Brand New Architecture Separation Of LEDs And Keys](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/117/919/18d15b46c88c9bff94533e5f92a6d7db_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781548660&width=680&sig=L9U7gzvgvBY8sE8Dn%2BCo2qJTKJKMhMD87g83681rXnw%3D)

Two separate PCB boards, each with its own chip. —one exclusively for key input, the other for RGB lighting.

By physically isolating the lighting circuitry, it eliminates signal noise and thermal interference generated by RGB lighting components. This allows the main keyboard circuit board to focus entirely on high-speed, accurate key processing.

The result is a cleaner signal path, improved consistency, and a more reliable typing and gaming experience—engineered for users who demand uncompromising performance.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/006/e8c7a6b5db9726888a3a17f979f460e3_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780828519&width=680&sig=NGgTdpJIieQNAZmJHnZHffnIE2VY39bc3I59y5Jf%2F84%3D)Left-Key PCB, Right-LED PCB

### Engraved Feather Aluminum Case

![Engraved Feather Aluminum Case](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/065/28344573aad0bdb5a0fbf71eca76ea7e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857250&width=680&sig=WVcPfLXqXuU8Zfea6UYjxvSe6W%2F8KPo4vxkT%2B6Hk0W8%3D)

Milled from a single block of aluminum. Only CNC machining can shape aluminum into a clean, solid block, never spliced.

The #200-grit anodized processing, creating a smooth, matte surface that resists scratches and fingerprints, with a subtle sheen and a reassuringly solid feel in hand.

The final signature detail is a laser-engraved feather pattern that subtly shifts with light and movement.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/862/0a0eca0de2aba6c490439be6679ed84e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780839808&width=680&sig=yTZAWfZ1A2C0BpVO1zP%2Bd%2FaoPKSmXm7lTaqOt5aERIs%3D)GH60 Case

### Fusion 61-RGB

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/067/af8bbbd7af3a625fb38f72b02596c045_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857256&width=680&sig=OpnHVZzZjlIFtzplURQezH5bM6GaTN6kIrJa8LUoRrM%3D)

Dual RGB LEDs for brighter, more balanced RGB Effects. Larger keys — including Left Shift, Right Shift, Backspace, and Enter — 4 RGB LEDs each. Spacebar — 10 RGB LEDs for a fuller, smoother lighting.

Comes with 22 types of RGB Effects. You can control the RGB hue, saturation, brightness, effect speed, and different modes.

### Fusion 61-Features

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/070/d35c76faef9282478a164b1c05b46d69_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857261&width=680&sig=7d6XOvUNgofmn7OWefVmGaM2Uli4JcUMAJZPy5P7OZA%3D)

Boasting ultra-fine 0.005mm actuation accuracy, every subtle keystroke can be precisely recognized. No missed inputs, no delayed feedback, delivering absolute precise control.

Unlike many keyboards built on generic third-party solutions, our hardware and firmware are developed entirely in-house for performance.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/071/75c079e2b47bfe8ade59ab00865d3d64_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857266&width=680&sig=uVIyoIwskVaYwLyU0vkFQ1JEDu5t58WQwtAE%2BrJg%2Fdg%3D)

Powered by an 8K polling rate and finely tuned firmware, the Fusion 61 achieves ultra-low latency of just 0.125 ms. Every input is registered with extreme speed and precision, giving you faster reactions, smoother control.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/908/a63b11c543a2ebce0b74794c5d4d8c5a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780840345&width=680&sig=maih28SABPetMEewe5LMJQH2QCQ7rCvj8rEBzvg8564%3D)

### Frozen RGB Switch

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/117/979/3da7c0dd60fe7f01211ce29effaeb270_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781548978&width=680&sig=mzChYsotFHfZFKuS9psbXUKTJ7IZxTjcAViVlfHRA1I%3D)

Unlike traditional mechanical keyboards, Hall Effect keyboards use magnetic sensors to detect every keystroke with exceptional speed and accuracy. This technology delivers ultra-fast response times, precise input recognition, and fully adjustable actuation points, allowing you to customize each key to match your gaming or typing style.

Semi-Transparency Housing, Turn your keyboard into the undisputed visual centerpiece of your desk. The fully pure structure eliminates all light obstruction. RGB beams penetrate losslessly, creating a polished, ice-like radiant halo without any dark spots.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/336/b269872f5993a33cbd796c21b11c4aad_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843917&width=680&sig=%2BDGWRKNA8CVVhzritbLpBBEjxRBXcZVJPcj0QH7pJCg%3D)

The Fusion 61 supports multiple types of magnetic switches, It is compatible with options such as Magnetic Jade, Magnetic White, Hornet Magnetic, and TTC KOM switches. Simply install your preferred switches and calibrate them through software for a custom fit.

### Typing Sound

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/117/773/fbaf61538979a38552ba96d2a7db7a81_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781547929&width=680&sig=OXN%2F1u%2F%2FY0oDYfU1CYxO2jZgmCN5%2BbGmK3U%2B3cHwEWU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/075/b71f6542f5a5fccd9191d93984c6458f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857279&width=680&sig=5LfBtFpsCuCu2tkK5OEmSBo%2BsxTxYrUXgh8Rw0uspHs%3D)

Customize every key’s actuation point from 0.1mm to 3.4mm. Go ultra-light for gaming, or set a deeper trigger for more stable, confident typing.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/937/195/2056f3a02e4414f5e03dcc610f7fbb7a_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780274184&width=680&sig=QUZQsD%2BFS1p%2BMwxZIb%2FaJT0InoHCRslkfIR4pgoZzvc%3D)

### Rapid Trigger

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/080/5a330eb930df8d3ba151b50887742abf_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857309&width=680&sig=QfHEJ8kz29sVAvu3T8KqgMoULOz6WJJegpt%2BDMM%2Faic%3D)

With Rapid Trigger, every key resets and re-triggers the moment its travel direction changes — no need to return to the top position. This eliminates the fixed reset limitation of traditional switches, giving you faster repeated inputs, sharper movement, and tighter control when speed matters most.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/937/198/f6cbaff2c89b6599298bdf065a9244e7_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780274223&width=680&sig=51VD9R5bLLQPerbQzjIXmd7Gk0KzYUtpjpBSPtqtPD0%3D)

### Fusion 61-Software

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/082/4c5061764a37ca127157147655636282_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857316&width=680&sig=xSmtKRMdBeVFcPUxVMMfwSizLX9HlKwb4j%2B%2B0%2FIAXPE%3D)

Software offers a simple and intuitive settings page. Level up to a keyboard enthusiast effortlessly.

In-house web driver, compatible with all operating systems. You can try it on our website: [photongaminggear.com](https://photongaminggear.com/)

Customize settings with software to enhance your gaming experience.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/866/750d269919397fba68c4a8b54acaed67_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1780848029&width=680&sig=GjZF5MtXSOVpGsdqGh1PpR%2Bxc1E69tAusQPcINnNyLU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/021/083/1b98ccfa142cecaee637a57f938f2c4b_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780857323&width=680&sig=dnPiMXD6OSV7UHZYSyGm%2FTAr1%2FliVTRd3NaDJX4Wj54%3D)

SOCD — Directional Input Control. Manages conflicting inputs like left/right or up/down. Essential in - fighting games (clean directional inputs), PS movement (precise strafing and counter-strafing) - ensures your inputs stay clean and predictable.

4-in-1 DKS — Dynamic Keystroke. One key. Multiple actions. In FPS games, a single press can smoothly trigger - aim, shoot, reset - allowing complex sequences (up to 4 actions) to happen in one motion.

MT — Mod Tap. Tap for one action. Hold for another. In action or RPG games, you can combine - quick skills (tap), charged abilities (hold) - without moving your fingers.

TGL — Toggle. Turn continuous actions on or off. Perfect for - auto-run in open-world games, repeated actions in farming or grinding - free your fingers without losing control.

RS — Rapid Successive Priority. When multiple keys are pressed, the deeper press takes priority. In competitive scenarios, this ensures intentional actions override accidental ones — critical for movement and control accuracy.

### Structure

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/041/281/1452da7973a768735394fc8e8e6e0e45_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780988975&width=680&sig=6Mdl6ixAkA%2BVVBzTqmyPCs0AId%2FPq67NdDUahn8%2B94k%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/041/285/63691927e7e9c28dc706b4c69a6ed492_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780988979&width=680&sig=3VuJ%2FLi6aRb6Sk91C56W73NP4IcPmywV0L4FVHNJv20%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/126/399/e6e5a044a40d182c32d4baf54377e6bc_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781605114&width=680&sig=7yY1AzejgeqPbGt2IXC%2BWc4ws%2BfiLJMik7XWflj%2Brj0%3D)Mainboard PCB 4 layers ENIG surface finish

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/126/401/b16e1a9787f95ddcd8f21a1f40f7a3d8_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781605120&width=680&sig=oVxYsqLzoV7Wlc6mm0sSOxTI%2FoUpky4fjEbAmOt8RmQ%3D)RGBboard PCB 4 layers ENIG surface finish

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/356/538381d750f6385c26d6ffcaa2070fbb_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780844127&width=680&sig=Ul47h0khMQtp0CodkuSrX8dBGGsqxAVcrenb%2Fsm6D%2Bg%3D)

No software installation is required. Personalize your keyboard directly through Photon Gear Hub, our web-based driver. Adjust key functions, actuation settings, lighting effects, and more from your browser with ease. Fusion 61 is compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.

### Specifications

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/283/afb778dd4f8a28ebe0935ef3d9bfa0c3_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843397&width=680&sig=zCzjCVUA1DWMmrkbo2fqIsA8jy%2BrIepGM%2FzhMXt9BQY%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/018/853/ddda4a6079c7c20d6c15652faa138395_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780839678&width=680&sig=H2PZOW4PnTBOGacxXLmEjBmwlnWALuysk7VhkppUnsA%3D)

### Reward

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/280/515e3be390a17d032eadf81dac7836d4_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843389&width=680&sig=JR0%2Bq3AOLtxpDRWR%2FDIWidbiMZ%2B4WMKilHUKi%2B8OKg4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/247/374c068a1c540cb6a14d6ed5b2edba8a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843056&width=680&sig=3VsTJ5hunWO2hd3DsYAkqW%2Bo2RzocVcIVgFT2Gp9qrQ%3D)

### Timeline

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/277/d55313d11c2c4c92c78a97363a8fbd65_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843379&width=680&sig=twoqapjt6DSF0P%2BDirE6qymFVcSWG8FuNsZgzqPRR%2Bw%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/300/5d7d1a22b73bbeea3dedd2f8436d4000_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843628&width=680&sig=V5JOWast1kSu1iqmEUnfpzcwtcgxxTDFdAjvJmnf3Gc%3D)

### Our Journey

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/019/273/c75b13bc2b07515c3892140ed2403a1e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780843370&width=680&sig=HdlpPFhYwftwWxCEJEQf%2BCVMuEV2%2Fq1cl0VNqKXbSfw%3D)

Before creating our own keyboard, we worked as a professional hardware development team and keyboard PCB solution provider, helping bring keyboard products to life。

We spent years working on the parts that define real performance: circuit board, firmware, signal processing, RGB control, and manufacturing reliability. The deeper we went, the more we realized that a truly high-performance gaming keyboard cannot be created by simply combining good components. It has to be designed from the foundation up. So we decided to build our own.

It is the result of years of hardware experience, finally brought together in one keyboard.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/937/654/82abf73dcc3b6f0195890ed8f48e3f03_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780277846&width=680&sig=xG9LGtvhly4ozOh1xR%2FVVBvjno7BjsxaOFzp1ZPObdo%3D)

[![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/124/887/4a43412d1d4f4e7f9c4837cc81957c9e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781596781&width=680&sig=UWNdxrwQ8jEWV2DTaYjS40Nj4nLc%2F4CYE9wzH4jwJCM%3D)Affiliate Program](https://photongaminggear.kickbooster.me/boost/fusion-61-the-ultimate)

## Risks and challenges

With years of experience in keyboard development, the Photon Gaming Gear team is confident in the quality, user experience, and production schedule of the Fusion 61.

That said, unexpected challenges may arise during manufacturing or fulfillment. To reduce potential delays, we have included additional time in our production schedule and prepared contingency plans for possible issues. Our team is committed to providing backers with a smooth and worry-free crowdfunding experience.

Shipping times may vary depending on the destination country or region. Once the campaign reaches its funding goal, we will work closely with our logistics partners to process and deliver orders as efficiently as possible.

Please note that import duties, taxes, or customs fees may apply depending on local regulations. These charges are not included in the pledge amount or shipping fee and will be the responsibility of the backer. We recommend checking your local customs policies before placing an order.

Should any unexpected issues occur, we promise to communicate openly and keep our backers informed about the situation, our proposed solutions, and any changes to the timeline.

Thank you for supporting Photon Gaming Gear and the Fusion 61. You can back our project with confidence.

projects.ai_description_en:
The Fusion 61 is a 60% rapid trigger Hall effect magnetic gaming keyboard from Photon Gaming Gear, built around a brand-new dual PCB architecture that physically isolates key input circuitry from RGB lighting to eliminate signal noise and thermal interference. At its core are Hall effect magnetic switches that detect every keystroke magnetically, delivering 0.005mm accuracy, ultra-fast response times, and fully adjustable actuation points so you can customize each key to match your gaming or typing style.

Rapid Trigger technology means each key resets and re-triggers the moment its travel direction changes—no need to return to the top position. This removes the fixed reset limitation of traditional switches, giving you sharper movement and tighter control at speed. The Frozen RGB switch features a semi-transparent housing with a pure, obstruction-free structure that lets RGB beams penetrate losslessly, creating an ice-like radiant halo with no dark spots. Dual RGB LEDs per key (four on larger keys, ten on the spacebar) deliver brighter, more balanced lighting across 22 customizable effects, with control over hue, saturation, brightness, and speed.

The engraved feather aluminum case is CNC-milled from a single block of aluminum—never spliced—with #200-grit anodized processing for a smooth, scratch-resistant, fingerprint-resistant matte surface with a subtle sheen. A laser-engraved feather pattern shifts with light and movement, adding a signature visual detail. The keyboard supports multiple magnetic switch types including Magnetic Jade, Magnetic White, Hornet Magnetic, and TTC KOM, simply install and calibrate your preferred switch through software.

The Fusion 61 runs on an in-house web-based driver, Photon Gear Hub—no software installation required—compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux. Its 8kHz polling rate drives response times down to 0.125ms. Backed by years of keyboard development experience and a team that previously worked as professional hardware developers and PCB solution providers, Fusion 61 ships with a pledge starting at CA$137 (Super Early Bird, originally $139 MSRP) and estimated delivery in August 2026.

projects.ai_intro_en: The M7 Multifunctional Car Jump Starter combines a 4000A peak battery booster, 12000mAh power bank, 150 PSI tire inflator, and ultra-bright flashlight with SOS mode into one compact device. It can jump-start a dead car battery in just 30 seconds and fits all 12V common vehicles including cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats, and campers.
ai_highlights_en: 4000A peak current jump starts dead car batteries in 30 seconds
Built-in 150 PSI tire inflator with auto-stop and real-time pressure monitoring
12000mAh power bank with USB fast charging for mobile devices
ai_specs_en: All 12V common vehicles (cars, trucks, motorcycles, boats, campers)
3 brightness modes (eco, standard, high) with zoom function
Jump starter, power bank, tire inflator, flashlight, emergency window breaker
projects.ai_risks_en: The creator acknowledges general risks and challenges without specifying details. They use AI-generated images for product display and covers, claiming proper licensing has been obtained. No specific product risks or manufacturing challenges are detailed.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: A product developer focused on innovative automotive tools, utilizing AI-generated imagery with proper licensing for product presentations.
projects.ai_description_en:
The M7 Multi-Functional Jump Starter is the ultimate all-in-one roadside companion that replaces a clutter of bulky gear with a single, handheld device. Built around a powerful 4000A peak current battery, it can jump-start virtually any common 12V vehicle—from cars and trucks to motorcycles and boats—in about 30 seconds, even when the battery is completely dead. But it doesn’t stop at jump-starting. The integrated 150 PSI tire inflator with intelligent preset and auto-stop inflates tires, bicycles, and sports equipment with real-time pressure monitoring, so you’ll never have to guess or risk over-inflation. And when night falls, the M7 transforms into an ultra-bright emergency lighting tool with a dedicated window breaker built into the body, ready to help you escape a vehicle in seconds.

Powering all of this is a high-capacity 12000mAh rechargeable battery that doubles as a full-featured power bank. Need to charge your phone, tablet, or GPS while stranded? The M7 offers USB-A output supporting 5V/3A, 9V/2A, and 12V/1.5A, along with a Type-C input (5V/2A, 9V/2A) for fast top‑ups. Its intelligent display keeps you informed, whether you’re checking tire pressure or remaining battery life.

The flashlight system delivers real versatility. Three brightness modes—eco, standard, and high—cover everything from long‑lasting ambient light to a piercing spotlight. A variable beam zoom lets you switch instantly between wide flood and focused spot, while dedicated SOS and flashing warning signals turn the M7 into a high‑visibility rescue beacon. Throughout, the ergonomic, textured handle ensures a secure grip even with wet or gloved hands, and the rugged build protects the unit from drops and weather.

Engineered with 10 comprehensive safety protections, the M7 guards against overheat, reverse polarity, overcurrent, short-circuit, and more, so both you and your vehicle stay safe during use. By combining a jump starter, power bank, air compressor, multi‑mode flashlight, and window breaker into one tidy package, the M7 strips away the stress and clutter of emergency preparation. Instead of stocking jumper cables, separate inflators, and standalone flashlights—and paying far more for each—you’ll have everything you need in a single, surprisingly affordable tool that can be kept ready in your glovebox or trunk.

projects.html_story:

Play. Talk. Grow. Plappi is the screen-free language-learning device that helps young kids grow up bilingual - built on real curricula

Environmental commitments

Speak. Play. Grow. Completely screen-free.

Imagine your child hearing and speaking your language - even when you can't be there.

Why I'm building Plappi

I'm Nemanja, father of two. My partner doesn't speak my mother tongue - which means I am theonly sourcethrough which my child can learn my language. But between work, the household and everything else: when am I supposed to manage that?

Plappi grew out of exactly this frustration -not to replace me, but to make the time in between count, so my child keeps hearing and practising my language even when I can't be there.

Plappi is ascreen-free, voice-based language-learning devicefor children aged 2-10. At its core is not a chatbot - it is astructured language programme we built ourselves: weekly vocabulary that is introduced, practised and tested, organised into age-appropriate curricula and reinforced with spaced repetition so words stick for good. No screen. No ads.

Structured curricula- designed by us, updated monthly, based on how children actually learn a language best

Weekly vocabulary- introduced, practised and reviewed; difficulty grows with your child's progress

Spaced repetition- scientifically proven to make new words stick

Personalised bilingual stories- using your child's name, friends and favourite topics

15-minute sessions- matched to a child's attention span

27 languages from day one

Much more than "an AI"

Plappi isnot a typical AI appwith a chatbot bolted on. The real work - and our creative core - is thelanguage pedagogy: the curricula, the weekly vocabulary plans, the learning-progression logic and the spaced-repetition methodology, drawn from research on how children best acquire a second language. AI is simply the engine that delivers this human-designed programme by voice, screen-free - a means to an end, not the product itself.

Your data belongs to you. Full stop.

Privacy is built into Plappi's architecture from the start:

Processingexclusively on EU servers

No trainingon your children's conversations - private inference, not public APIs

GDPR- and EU-AI-Act-compliant,made in Austria

Made for parents

The parent app gives you a full dashboard: progress, words learned and upcoming reviews - and you decide what Plappi knows about your child and what it teaches next.

Why Kickstarter

We've developed Plappi - now we're bringing it into series production. Your support funds tooling, the first production run, certification (child safety and radio compliance), our EU infrastructure and worldwide delivery.Every backer brings us closer to a world where every child can speak the language of their family.

Risks and challenges

Hardware is demanding. We know the typical risks — supply chains, certification, timelines — and we plan for them deliberately: a conservative timeline (delivery September 2027), a buffer built into the budget, and personal on-site quality audits at our manufacturers in Europe or China. Should delays occur, we will keep you informed transparently and regularly — trust matters more to us than an optimistic promise.

We are building Plappi, a screen-free language-learning device for children, designed and made in Austria. The creative core of this project is our own pedagogy: structured, age-appropriate language curricula, weekly vocabulary plans, a learning-progression system and a spaced-repetition methodology — all designed by our team based on research into how children best acquire a second language.

AI is used only as the delivery engine that voices this human-designed curriculum and adapts difficulty and personalised stories to each child's progress. It is not a chatbot companion and not an AI-generated product — the curriculum, content structure, methodology and device design are human-made.

Privacy and child safety are core design principles: we use offline / on-device models wherever possible, process data exclusively on EU servers, never train AI models on children's data, and are fully GDPR- and EU-AI-Act-compliant.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

Plappi is built to last: a robust housing, a replaceable rechargeable battery and years of software updates instead of planned obsolescence.

Reusability and recyclability

Housing and components are designed to be separable and recyclable, with take-back guidance for end-of-life devices.

Sustainable materials

We prioritise recycled and recyclable plastics and minimise mixed materials to keep the device easy to recycle.

Environmentally friendly factories

We select manufacturing partners that actively minimise their environmental footprint (energy, waste, water) and audit this on site.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Nemanja, father of two based in Austria, founded Plappi to help children learn their family's language through structured, screen-free pedagogy.
projects.ai_description_en:
Plappi is a screen-free language-learning device designed for children aged 2–10, built to help kids grow up bilingual without a screen in sight. Created in Austria by a team that includes language pedagogy experts and parents, Plappi replaces the "chatbot + tablet" model with something more intentional: a structured, age-appropriate language programme delivered entirely by voice. Children interact with the device through speaking and listening—no screen, no ads, no distracting app store—making language practice feel like play rather than homework.

At the heart of Plappi is a human-designed curriculum that introduces, practises, and tests weekly vocabulary using spaced repetition, a scientifically proven method for long-term retention. The system adapts difficulty as a child progresses, generates personalised bilingual stories using the child's name and interests, and delivers the equivalent of 15-minute sessions matched to a child's attention span. From launch, Plappi supports 27 languages, giving families access to a wide range of mother tongues and second languages. A dedicated parent app provides a dashboard showing progress, words learned, and upcoming reviews, while letting caregivers decide what Plappi knows and teaches next.

Privacy and longevity are central to the design. Plappi processes data exclusively on EU servers, never trains AI models on children's conversations, and is fully GDPR and EU AI Act compliant. The hardware itself is built to last: a robust housing, a replaceable rechargeable battery, and years of software updates mean Plappi is designed to grow with a child rather than be replaced yearly. Plappi is currently a developed product entering series production, and Kickstarter backing funds tooling, certification, the first production run, and worldwide delivery—bringing a screen-first world one step closer to a screen-free alternative for early language learning.
