## Story

### Introducing EVERLITE

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/478/1ef8ec31428600c38fd982acb88824e3_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781760949&width=680&sig=yH%2FeCfXHzafJl2eVs0Yzndg%2Bmwb3B%2Fl9i8zVAiARkK4%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/193/54e38d9a961cc7f36b678cdb2f6fecf2_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232187&width=680&sig=5o3pT54tvz3jqLBdO982al%2FEQr0TP17YQnl5O4liKgY%3D)

### One Lighting Tool. Complete Experiences.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/487/68b9a8f06085655e55c9bb9fc75d6c98_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761024&width=680&sig=e5tm1RSgOTYlIbb%2F3K44xW6cReFCr4s1IPPwiqwuS14%3D)

Most flashlights are designed for brightness alone. But when you are inside a tent, reading before sleep, sharing a campsite table, or relaxing outdoors, brightness is not enough — comfort matters too.

EVERLITE was created to completely rethink outdoor illumination — combining

soft natural lighting, immersive ambiance, and wide-area visibility into one compact

everyday carry tool.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/212/061f7618171f11b98d1963dd095eb0c0_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232395&width=680&sig=N7nPdGnLhoIymmzHhfbJHEJNViO%2BKmhBN2WLNUdKbIU%3D)

### Superior Brightness Performance

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/489/622dcd7129631fdd5f224142bfa4efc6_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761053&width=680&sig=gU4IIWG1B7QkGnMykLvEA94pKNDWWBiXZJnU5KqctlM%3D)

EVERLITE is built for actual outdoor use.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/223/db599f822231b70bcbafdf4cc38346b3_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232533&width=680&sig=Glcs9usf83ROZk9dUlfnJ2PhrO4aSlYTwCuACzsAX8w%3D)

#### 3 Daily Modes:

With three adjustable brightness settings, the TwiLite lets you tailor the light output to your needs. A single press of the button cycles through Low, Medium, and High modes, providing optimal illumination for everyday tasks.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/226/af38ef2ce124d61dd2c28cfab6dacdc4_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232576&width=680&sig=gd7UsBiWT62qXPAUjq%2F079Jat%2BOaUGhx0%2BXnk5f3OnA%3D)

#### Strobe Modes:

When things get intense, rely on Ultra-High and Strobe modes, delivering up to 300 lumens. Whether you’re facing an emergency or navigating tough terrain, these modes ensure you're ready for any challenge.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/231/9283e2c4642bf2b8742a6ff9aa10aff0_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232631&width=680&sig=N2t0I1JzPMSV6%2BIFcDYlOpEFkPa2JGHZ%2Fbnc7hDzCoE%3D)

#### 100m Long-Distance Beam

Its main light delivers a crisp 5000K white beam with a beam distance of up to 100 meters, helping you see farther on trails, around campsites, and in low-visibility environments.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/240/dd713ca7975f0cf550def9582a108b80_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232711&width=680&sig=cIarZSitFYrLPBjd%2B%2FLMWKtHqpfp36am0IZBhGBL9XM%3D)

### 360° Soft Natural Light

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/491/f4c51e8621b6d4a74af2293c83f2bd24_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761072&width=680&sig=bkC6%2FuhVSnOHbvLDjhteiV1QzkurJ5eym1KZJkZ9PKY%3D)

Traditional flashlights create intense hotspots and hard-edged shadows that quickly cause eye fatigue. EVERLITE distributes light evenly across your environment, reducing glare while improving overall visibility. Instead of forcing your eyes to constantly adapt between darkness and concentrated brightness, EVERLITE creates a softer visual transition that feels significantly more natural outdoors.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/249/bc594d442052b7c0c06314009035bfb7_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232771&width=680&sig=UwyAUPYLpvexe%2BsZtybwEq6oyOzdHsaH3FW9n%2Bz4IqQ%3D)

EVERLITE uses high-color-rendering LEDs that restore more realistic colors and textures — making food look warmer, skin tones look healthier, and campsites feel more alive.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/263/109f5f378ea1065cc0b75d33a8b42d57_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232815&width=680&sig=ks2Qv%2FxvUgksEBtjzWRgMxDSnDxzaR7VxYWIffGvjNc%3D)

EVERLITE helps colors appear more natural and recognizable compared with low-CRI lighting. This is especially useful when cooking outdoors, reading, organizing gear, taking photos, or creating a more natural campsite atmosphere.

### Fantasy RGB for Campsite Atmosphere

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/530/6e40040bec24d1ea1be995ef98edfd26_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761328&width=680&sig=acf4gtTKBqVdCsyjgwAljfhcmsDFTm6giDxyrJv2xLM%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/295/747405da943cf7970097897420e03d23_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781232989&width=680&sig=%2FWd9s2cpavz91D2vSWO1rtBQk0T6tC56%2Bb1kI7u8FO4%3D)

EVERLITE is also a mood maker. The RGB taillight features multiple atmospheric modes designed to transform your campsite, tent, backyard, or nighttime setup.

### White-Light Modes for Any Tasks

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/534/42d92b1568590fe36ae7c86ded75576d_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761353&width=680&sig=mi04jX8cFOuj2jLHMmOr66JuYaeh4utWLX4aFZuC2nU%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/302/433ffbbd3d834c6f5e9f730b5caab855_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781233041&width=680&sig=zCILXAcHtC621aCukOsUPNT5MsodwRjXUaIU7Me3uuo%3D)

The taillight of EVERLITE gives you three practical white-light experiences:

2700K Warm White

For relaxing, winding down, and creating a cozy campsite atmosphere

4000K Natural White

For reading, cooking, organizing gear, and clearer close-range visibility

Breathing Mode

A gently pulsing warm glow for a calming and peaceful nighttime feel

These modes turn EVERLITE into a more comfortable light for real nighttime living outdoors.

### Magnetic Tail for Hands-Free Lighting

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/536/55eeab57fbeb8b8cb2ba0fe678e76529_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761374&width=680&sig=IT19U7wKZRp%2FMcSUToJYdS8TuNm3TvyeK73owVPEd8M%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/424/097baca082634d1233925930647bf764_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781233553&width=680&sig=aQTYhMiaQgDDMhgM6Eq7ml2CziLGclmZ8qiVxowdRUY%3D)

Attach the EVERLITE flashlight to compatible metal surfaces when you need both hands free — for gear setup, car repair, campsite organization, or emergency work lighting.

### Rechargeable 3500mAh Battery for Long Nights

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/553/1ed9d7614e9437b446d010d83c531d4e_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761439&width=680&sig=1dBObq%2F6zdeq0uzKy1ycz%2BFz1TRg2vrlY1Iw3%2B84OYQ%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/438/49bf0c08d5e1e67b9ac6fcc8bfe5ff34_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781233614&width=680&sig=%2FUoCyLVzRdAhSIvi7W%2F9GWKtdjUAZeuxkQpc6Vmsbnc%3D)

A 3500mAh battery and efficient low-power LEDs power EVERLITE.

It is designed to support short bursts of brightness, long campsite use, and extended low-light operation. From an evening walk to all-night tent lighting, EVERLITE gives you multiple runtime options for real outdoor needs.

### IP65 Water-Resistant

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/151/558/b810d5904f81e1c5b0ece40c5ad0f6c4_original.jpg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781761456&width=680&sig=fo0qJ15T%2BRVdXdf3Rv60oWbEMIFKd2JVLrIKILVpf1g%3D)

projects.ai_description_en:
EVERLITE is a dual-light outdoor flashlight that combines a powerful long-range beam with a versatile 360° ambient taillight, designed to handle every outdoor lighting scenario in one compact tool. The main spotlight delivers a 100-meter beam distance for trail navigation and spotting at range, while the secondary taillight serves triple duty—offering a 360° soft natural white glow for area lighting, a fantasy RGB mode to set a colorful campsite atmosphere, and three dedicated white-light experiences: 2700K warm white for winding down, 4000K natural white for task visibility like cooking or gear organization, and a calming breathing mode for a peaceful nighttime feel.

What sets EVERLITE apart is its magnetic tail cap, which gives users hands-free lighting by sticking securely to any metal surface—perfect for setting up camp, working under a vehicle cover, or hanging from a tent frame. Built around a rechargeable 3500mAh battery, the flashlight provides up to 40 hours of runtime, reducing the need for disposable cells on extended trips. The body is constructed from aerospace-grade aluminum alloy and rated IP65 water-resistant, ensuring durability against rain, splashes, and rough handling in the field.

The flashlight is available in four reward tiers: Super Early Bird at $39 (limited to 100 units, 55 remaining), Early Bird at $49, a Duo Pack at $89 for two units, and a Triple Pack at $129 for three units, with all tiers shipping worldwide in August 2026. Backers can also make a pledge at any level to support the project without selecting a reward tier.

projects.blurb: A clock project for the large VFD tubes ILC1-1/7 model made in the Soviet era. It uses a preprogrammed microcontroller & standard parts
projects.html_story:
A clock project for the large VFD tubes ILC1-1/7 model made in the Soviet era. It uses a preprogrammed microcontroller & standard parts

A clock project for the large VFD tubes ILC1-1/7 model made in the Soviet era. It uses a preprogrammed microcontroller & standard parts

The idea for this project began with a request from a kit builder who owned these vintage VFD tubes. These are very large vacuum fluorescent display tubes from the Soviet era. Here is the link to a partial description of the specifications of these tubes:Huge 7-Segment VFD ILC1-1/7 (ИЛЦ1-1/7).

After examining the specifications and studying the tubes, we developed a prototype PC board and driver and wrote some firmware to create the clock project. The kit we developed is DIY for anyone who can solder competently and identify some basic electronic components. Everything is standard sized with no surface mount parts so a novice solderer can do it. The chips including the preprogrammed microcontroller are set in sockets for easy replacement, and there are very few other components in the design.

The prototype PCBs are the "barebones" design which includes trace on the board only, no solder mask or silkscreen. The production run will include full coverage in solder mask and silkscreen, making it easy to assemble for a skilled kit builder.

The design is modular, so that seconds can be added. The board has a port for GPS or Wi-Fi module input as well.

Risks and challenges

The biggest challenge to this project was supplying the proper power for these large tubes, which draw about 200ma each on the filament only! We designed a robust "overkill" power supply for this, to drive the tubes and power the drivers.

projects.ai_intro_en: A DIY clock kit for the large Soviet-era VFD tubes (ILC1-1/7). It uses a preprogrammed microcontroller and standard through-hole parts, with no surface-mount components, making it accessible to novice solderers. The modular design supports adding seconds, GPS, or Wi-Fi, and production PCBs will feature solder mask and silkscreen for easy assembly.
ai_highlights_en: Vintage Soviet VFD tube clock kit with large 7-segment displays
Easy DIY assembly using standard parts and socketed chips
Modular design with optional seconds, GPS, and Wi-Fi modules
ai_specs_en: Robust design for high filament current
Tier: Deluxe kit with enclosure color PCB
projects.ai_risks_en: The main challenge is powering the large VFD tubes, which draw about 200mA each on the filament. The project mitigates this with a robust, over-engineered power supply designed specifically for these demanding tubes.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Electronics has been my interest since the days of the 1960's space race, and in recent years I became interested in sharing my project development to fund new designs, and this platform has been excellent for doing so.
projects.ai_description_en:
This is a DIY clock kit designed around the rare ILC1-7 vacuum fluorescent display tubes from the Soviet era. These are large-format 7-segment VFD tubes that draw approximately 200mA each just for the filament current, making them notoriously difficult to power properly. The project provides everything a skilled kit builder needs to bring these vintage displays back to life as a working timepiece, combining historical Soviet hardware with a modern pre-programmed microcontroller driver board.

The kit is built for competent hobbyists, using only standard through-hole components with no surface-mount parts required. The microcontroller comes pre-programmed and socketed for easy replacement, significantly reducing the assembly challenge. The power supply was specifically engineered from scratch—describing it as "overkill" because safely driving these power-hungry vintage tubes at the proper voltage and current was the project's primary engineering challenge. The modular design includes expansion ports for adding a seconds display, GPS module, or Wi-Fi connectivity, allowing builders to choose their preferred time source and level of complexity.

For collectors and electronics enthusiasts, this kit represents an accessible entry point into Soviet-era VFD technology. The large format of the ILC1-7 tubes makes them visually striking display components, and the chance to build a functional clock from genuine Cold War-era hardware carries intrinsic appeal. The DIY nature of the project—requiring only basic soldering skills and component identification—lowers the barrier to entry compared to other vintage VFD projects that demand specialist equipment or surface-mount expertise. The production PCBs will feature full solder mask and silkscreen coverage, further simplifying the assembly process for backers.

Whether completed as a standalone timepiece or expanded with GPS synchronization for automatic time accuracy, this kit offers a hands-on way to preserve and utilize a genuinely historical display technology. The modular hardware design ensures the project stays flexible, while the thoughtful integration of sockets and standard components makes troubleshooting and repair straightforward. For those seeking a unique blend of vintage Soviet engineering and modern DIY electronics, this kit builds something that's both technically rewarding and conversation-starting.

projects.name: PicoLaser: The World's Smallest Laser Engraver
projects.blurb: A 10 cm Arduino-powered open-frame laser engraver with exposed electronics, built for makers, STEM education and creativity.
projects.html_story:
A 10 cm Arduino-powered open-frame laser engraver with exposed electronics, built for makers, STEM education and creativity.

A 10 cm Arduino-powered open-frame laser engraver with exposed electronics, built for makers, STEM education and creativity.

WHAT'S UNDER THE HOOD?

Connectivity & Wiring

WHAT CAN YOU CREATE

WHAT'S IN THE BOX?

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

WHO AM I & WHY I NEED YOUR HELP

PicoLaser redefines desktop micro-machining. We have packed the precision of laser technology into an ultra-compact body, entirely engineered in CAD and 3D-printed to occupy minimal space on your workbench. But we didn't hide it behind a boring industrial plastic shell:PicoLaser proudly celebrates its hardware. The entire control electronics, circuit paths, chips, and wiring are completely exposed, creating a unique, high-tech aesthetic designed for those who love to see and understand how things work.

PicoLaser is designed with a dual-channel architecture that separates data management from power delivery. This ensures millimeter-level stability during movements and a consistent laser beam that preserves the lifespan of the diode:

Exposed Electronics, Maker Soul:No secrets. The control board and connections are completely visible. You can admire the custom PCB layout and component behaviors while the machine is running. It’s the ultimate desktop tool for anyone with electronics in their blood.

USB Type-C Data Connection:The module connects to your computer via a USB Type-C cable. After a quick and easy installation of the dedicated drivers (which allow your PC to recognize the serial COM port), you will have total control over movements and beam modulation through leading open-source engraving software.

Dedicated Power Supply (12V 1A):Many micro-lasers suffer from voltage drops because they try to draw power solely from the USB port. PicoLaser solves this at the root: a dedicated 12V 1A wall power supply(always included in the box)delivers clean, stable, and continuous energy to the 250mW diode, ensuring uniform engraving even during long project runs.

WHAT'S UNDER THE HOOD?

No closed boxes, no compromises. Every single component of PicoLaser has been selected to offer reliability, precision, and maximum accessibility:

Logic Core & Control (The Brain)

Arduino Nano:The central microcontroller (ATmega328P-based) that processes code and coordinates the entire machine. It guarantees 100% compatibility with the open-sourceGRBLfirmware and popular engraving software (like LaserGRBL or Engraver Master).

Custom "Naked" PCB (White):Our custom-designed motherboard, specifically engineered to showcase the exposed electronics. It routes all connections cleanly without hiding the raw beauty of the printed circuit board.

Stepper Motor Drivers (Red Modules):Dedicated chips (A4988/DRV8825 style) plugged directly into the shield to handle axis micro-stepping and ultra-smooth fluid motion with millimetric precision.

Precision Mechanics (X/Y Axes)

Linear Lead-Screw Actuators:Two stepper motor modules coupled directly to threaded rods. This architecture completely eliminates the need for bulky belts and cuts mechanical backlash to a minimum, ensuring rigid, stable, and repeatable micro-movements.

Steel Linear Guide Rails:Ground cylindrical rods acting as rigid tracks for perfectly smooth carriage gliding.

Optics & Power Management

250mW Red Laser Module:A semiconductor laser diode (~635-660 nm) housed in a solid cylindrical metal heatsink, complete with an adjustable collimation lens at the tip for microscopic spot focusing.

Discrete Power Components:Voltage regulators/MOSFETs (in TO-220 packages), electrolytic filter capacitors, and resistors left bare on the PCB to stabilize power delivery and modulate the beam safely.

Connectivity & Wiring

DC 12V 1A Power Jack:A separate power line (with wall adapter included) to keep the laser beam intensity steady and protect components from voltage sags.

FFC Flat Ribbon Cable & Compact Connectors:Flexible flat cables and low-profile pin headers that keep the laser head movements unrestricted, clean, and free of ugly wire tangles.

WHAT CAN YOU CREATE

Thanks to the microscopic focal spot generated by the red diode and the precision of the lead-screw drive, PicoLaser excels where larger, high-power lasers often blur or burn away fine details. It is ideal for working on high-absorption surfaces and dark organic materials:

Leather:Perfect for personalizing wallets, watch straps, patches, and small accessories.

Wood & Balsa:Engrave sharp logos, tiny text, and high-resolution vector graphics.

Cardboard & Dark Paper:Ideal for precision micro-cutting, stencil art, and papercraft details.

Dark Plastics & PCBs:Excellent for marking tiny components or photo-activating traces on presensitized boards for custom PCB manufacturing.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX?

We want your PicoLaser experience to be complete and safe from day one. Because of this,every single hardware reward tier includes everything needed to set up and run the machine:

PicoLaser Engraver(3D-printed frame, exposed Arduino/electronics, fully assembled and tested).

Specific Laser Safety Glassescertified for the red laser wavelength

Dedicated 12V 1A Wall Power Adapter(for the power line).

USB Type-C Cable(for the PC data connection).

Step-by-Step Digital Guidefor quick driver installation and software configuration.

TECHNICAL SPECIFICATIONS

Laser Source:Semiconductor Red Diode (~635-660 nm)

Optical Output Power:250 mW (Class 3B)

Brain (MCU):Arduino Nano (ATmega328P) running GRBL firmware

Aesthetic Design:Open-case structure with exposed PCB, electronics, and components

Data Interface:USB Type-C port (requires dedicated driver installation for serial port recognition)

System Power:12V 1A input (Wall power adapter included in the box)

Mechanics:Linear lead-screw axes with ground steel guide rails

Optical System:Adjustable high-transmittance collimation lens

Software Compatibility:LaserGRBL, Engraver Master, and major serial-control software

WHO AM I & WHY I NEED YOUR HELP

I am a designer, engineer, and artisan passionate about digital fabrication, exposed electronics, and DIY hardware. I have spent the last few months developing prototypes, routing traces on a custom PCB, testing control loops, and optimizing 3D printing profiles to ensure that PicoLaser isn’t just beautiful to look at on a desk, but solid, reliable, and consistent in performance.

As an independent maker, launching this project requires a collective push. The funds raised on Kickstarter will be used to buy the laser diodes, control chips, electronic components, and optics in large batches (drastically cutting down production costs), kick off the 3D printing production of the structural frames, and manage international shipping logistics.

If you love pure electronics and want a micro-precision tool that doesn't hide its true nature under an injection-molded plastic shell, PicoLaser is your next project. Join me, install the drivers, plug in the cables, and bring micro-precision straight to your desk. Back the PicoLaser Engraver today!

Risks and challenges

SAFETY NOTES 
PicoLaser is a powerful precision tool. The 250mW diode works in the visible/near-infrared spectrum and is classified as a Class 3B Laser. Our backers' safety is our absolute priority: the laser beam must never be looked at directly without protection. For this reason, we always include specific safety glasses in every single box. The machine must be operated in a controlled environment, requires driver setup on a PC, and is a product dedicated to adult hobbyists and builders—it is not a toy.

projects.ai_description_en:
PicoLaser is the world’s smallest laser engraver, an open-frame, 10 cm work area machine built for makers, educators, and curious minds who want to see exactly how a precision tool works. Its entire control electronics—Arduino Nano brain, custom PCB, stepper motor drivers, wiring, and voltage regulation components—are completely exposed, turning the engraver into a transparent window onto real electro-mechanics. Nothing is hidden behind a plastic shell; instead, every chip, solder joint, and cable route is on proud display, making the machine itself a piece of functional hardware art.

Performance matches the bold design. A 250 mW red diode laser (635–660 nm) produces a microscopic focal spot that excels where larger, more powerful workstations blur fine details—think ultra-fine engraving on wood, leather, paper, and anodized aluminum. The lead-screw actuators eliminate belts and mechanical backlash, while steel guide rails guarantee rigid, repeatable micro-movements. Data flows over USB Type-C to popular open-source software like LaserGRBL, while a dedicated 12 V 1 A wall adapter supplies clean, stable power to the laser diode, preventing the voltage sags that plague USB-only devices. This dual-channel architecture separates control from power, preserving both engraving consistency and diode lifespan.

PicoLaser ships as a kit with all electronics, mechanics, the laser module, power supply, and a pair of certified laser safety glasses inside the box. It is classified as a Class 3B laser and is strictly an adult maker’s tool, not a toy—the included eyewear, careful PC-side driver setup, and controlled-environment operation are non-negotiable. By blending a minimalist, industrial look with genuine desktop-manufacturing capability, PicoLaser invites you to learn, customize, and create while fully understanding the pulse of the machine in your hands.

PLOTARA is a compact CNC plotter designed to make digital fabrication simpler and more accessible.

With its fully 3D-printable structure, beltless mechanical system, magnetic pen-changing mechanism, and plug-and-play electronics, PLOTARA provides an approachable platform for makers, students, educators, and creative workshops.

It is designed to be simple enough for beginners while remaining modular and expandable for advanced users.

✏️ Magnetic Tool Changer

PLOTARA is more than just a plotter.

The optional magnetic multi-pen tool changer allows automatic pen switching during a single drawing session — without additional servos, motors, or complex mechanical systems.

The magnetic pen holder grabs and releases tools automatically while still allowing users to swap pens manually with ease.

Simple enough for beginners, yet modular and expandable for future experimentation and upgrades.

projects.ai_intro_en: PLOTARA is a compact, fully 3D-printable CNC plotter featuring automatic magnetic tool changing, a beltless mechanical system, and plug-and-play electronics. Designed for makers, students, educators, and creative workshops, it offers an approachable platform for digital fabrication that is simple enough for beginners yet modular and expandable for advanced users.
ai_highlights_en: Magnetic multi-pen tool changer enables automatic pen switching without extra servos or motors
Fully 3D-printable structure with plug-and-play custom PCB for quick 4-step assembly
Modular, repairable design using open-source software and widely available components
ai_specs_en: Custom PCB with integrated power circuit and fuse protection
Free and open-source tools, no proprietary licenses required
Accessible expansion pins for future upgrades
Step-by-step assembly guide and tutorials included
projects.ai_risks_en: PLOTARA is a fully working, tested prototype with validated mechanics, electronics, and firmware. PCB manufacturing for the first batch is complete but boards are still in transit/pending delivery. Supply risks are reduced by using 3D printed parts and widely available components. Shipping costs are not included in the pledge price and will be paid separately by backers.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: PLOTARA was designed, built, and tested by Yigit Arda Yilmaz as a real working machine, brought to Kickstarter to share the functional tool with more people.
projects.ai_description_en:
PLOTARA is a fully 3D-printable DIY plotter machine designed to make digital fabrication accessible, repairable, and approachable. Built around a unique beltless mechanical structure, the machine consists primarily of 3D-printed motion components combined with widely available electronics, which reduces both supply risks and part-hunting frustration. A custom-designed PCB eliminates complex jumper wiring, and the system is powered by an Arduino Nano, three stepper motors, and USB-C for power and data. According to the developer, real working prototypes have already been built, tested, and validated, so this is not an unproven concept.

One of its defining features is the optional magnetic multi-pen tool changer, which enables automatic pen switching during a single drawing session without adding extra servos, motors, or complex mechanisms. The tool station is modular, so users can expand or shape their pen setup as needed, while each pen can still be swapped manually when desired. This combination of automation and simplicity is meant to be accessible to beginners, yet flexible enough for advanced experimentation.

PLOTARA is positioned as a compact creative tool rather than a large-format plotter, aimed at creative coders, students, educators, and maker workshops. It relies on free and open-source software tools for the workflow: backers create or import artwork, convert it when needed, and send it to the machine without proprietary licenses or subscriptions. The project promises illustrated step-by-step assembly guides, recommended software lists, and detailed tutorials to help users go from parts to their first drawing quickly. With each kit built from off-the-shelf components and a repairable, 3D-printable body, PLOTARA is intended to be easy to set up, easy to expand, and easy to maintain over time.

projects.ai_description_en:
HUBi32 is a next-generation interactive USB development platform that reimagines the embedded hardware experience. Built around a powerful ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 MCU, it fuses the capabilities of a USB power analyzer, smart USB hub, HID automation device, multimedia controller, frequency-tunable RGB system, and motion-reactive anti-theft detector into a single compact cyberpunk-inspired device. It targets makers, hackers, embedded developers, robotics enthusiasts, IoT creators, and technology lovers who demand more than a bare ESP32 board — turning their workspace into an immersive command center.

At the heart of HUBi32 lies a real-time 3-channel USB power monitoring system driven by the INA3221AIRGVR IC, enabling engineers and hobbyists to visualize voltage, current, and power consumption across connected devices simultaneously. Integrated USB multiplexing allows independent ON/OFF control and smart routing of USB Type-C ports, ideal for automated device isolation, embedded testing, or desk power management. A QMI8658C IMU with accelerometer and gyroscope enables motion-reactive alerts, anti-theft detection, and gesture-triggered RGB effects. An onboard TSOP38438 IR receiver supports advanced infrared automation through the web dashboard, while HID control works seamlessly over both BLE and USB. Multimedia upload and playback with a built-in SD card slot adds creative flexibility for audio, video, and data logging projects.

HUBi32 distinguishes itself through a futuristic cyberpunk design language: a compact enclosure with glowing RGB lighting, animated TFT display, and accessible SD card slot makes it as much a desk showpiece as a development tool. The comprehensive web dashboard centralizes real-time power analytics, USB control, IR signal decoding, and RGB customization, removing the need for complex local tooling. Compliant with the QWIIC ecosystem, it supports hot-swappable sensor additions and expansion, perfect for iterative prototyping. Whether you're building automation systems, IoT nodes, robotics projects, multimedia interfaces, or eye-catching desk setups, HUBi32 delivers a uniquely immersive development environment.

projects.name: PFM Module | Zafira B & Astra H module to fold mirrors
projects.blurb: Custom build micro-controller for automatically folding and unfolding power folding mirrors on Opel/Vauxhall Astra H/Zafira B upon closing/opening the car with car's remote (key fob).
projects.html_story: Project storyCreatormirontomore infocontactCategoryTransportationTagscarsBacking informationCrowdfunding riskslearn moreSince I bought my Zafira in 2013, I dreamed of a modification, that would enable to automatically fold/unfold the mirrors via the remote key. Finally, after I tinkered with the driver door switch in December 2018, I decided to create a module that would enable me to fold the mirrors upon locking and unfold upon unlocking the car (like you get it with many other car brands as standard).Upon reverse engineering the driver door switch I discovered that the mirrors are operated via a switching relay controlled by a micro controller. Upon pressing the button, the relay is engaged, sending voltage to mirror motors for a defined period of time. The Opel implementation is really simple and there is nothing fancy like detecting the position of the mirrors or stop switches. The controller just cycles through unfolding/folding upon each press of a button.To mimic this behavior I’ve decided to use similar approach with a module containing a micro-controller and relays. The controller would detect lock/unlock signals from door lock motor wires and control two relays – one would disconnect mirror motors from driver door switch unit connecting them to the module during the operation of folding/unfolding (and connect them back to driver door switch unit afterwards) and the second relay would function the same way as the relay in the driver door switch unit – fold and unfold the mirrors by sending 12V to mirror motors for a defined time period.As I am very pleased of how well the Power Fold Mirrors aka PFM module turned out, I decided to produce a small batch of 20 modules for other Zafira B owners to enjoy. And since Zafira B and Astra H have so much in common, the PFM module can be fitted to Astra H as well as the electrical side of mirrors is 100% identical to Zafira B.Will ship to Europe and UK for aflat fee of 10€(not includedin the pledge amount).

projects.ai_description_en:
Upgrade your driving experience with the Power Fold Mirrors (PFM) module, a custom-engineered upgrade for your Opel Zafira B or Astra H. The PFM is an electronic control module that automatically folds and unfolds your side mirrors using your car's existing remote key. No more manually reaching out to adjust or fold your mirrors in tight parking spaces; the PFM seamlessly integrates with your vehicle to deliver the convenience of a premium factory feature.

At the core of the PFM is a micro-controller paired with a dual-relay system, designed after reverse-engineering the Opel driver door switch. When you lock or unlock the car, the module detects the signal from the door lock motor wires. It temporarily disengages the mirror motors from the driver door switch, sends the precise 12V voltage needed to fold or unfold the mirrors, and then safely reconnects them to the original switch. This unique relay logic mimics the factory cycling behavior perfectly, alternating between folding and unfolding with each press.

The PFM module solves the frustration of outdated manual mirror systems, bringing expected modern convenience to everyday drivers. By protecting mirrors from tight parking spaces and adding a premium touch to your daily drive, it bridges the gap between older automotive designs and current comfort standards. Furthermore, since the electrical systems of the Zafira B and Astra H mirrors are identical, the PFM module fits both models flawlessly without requiring complex position sensors or stop switches.

This sophisticated micro-controller upgrade is being produced in a small, limited batch of just 20 units, ensuring high quality and exclusivity. Shipping to Europe and the UK is available for a flat fee of 10€, allowing you to equipt your Opel with state-of-the-art remote mirror folding quickly and easily.

projects.html_story:

Transform your space. A fully modular, 3D-printed table with an interactive LED hex-grid and seamless smart accessory inlays.

Risks and challenges

Risk: Technical Delivery & File Access
The biggest challenge with digital rewards is ensuring that all backers receive their files securely, quickly, and without technical issues.

Our Solution: The core 3D models, structural engineering, and tolerances for the HEX-SYNAPSE table are already fully developed, prototyped, and tested. There is no manufacturing risk. To ensure a smooth delivery, we will use established, secure digital distribution platforms to host the files. Backers will receive clean, organized STL files immediately after the campaign ends and funds are cleared.

Challenge: Slicing & Print Settings
Every 3D printer is tuned differently. Varied filament brands and machine tolerances can sometimes lead to tight fits on highly precise parts like our 25mm slim drawer.

Our Solution: To minimize printing errors, we will provide a comprehensive printing guide alongside the files. This includes optimal print settings, recommended wall thicknesses, and advice on choosing the right print bed (such as utilizing a smooth PEI plate for the ultimate high-gloss finish). Additionally, we will host an active Discord community where backers can share settings, troubleshoot prints, and get direct technical support from me.

The technical development, CAD engineering (in Fusion 360), prototyping, and physical testing of all 3D printing files for the HEX-SYNAPSE system are 100% my own original human work. No AI generators were used to create any of the 3D models or functional parts.

Artificial intelligence tools were utilized solely as an assistant during the production phase of the campaign: specifically to optimize the English translation and grammar of the project story, to structure the presentation layout, and to assist in formatting the visual slide text.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Independent maker and CAD engineer who personally developed, prototyped, and tested all HEX-SYNAPSE 3D models and functional parts using Fusion 360.
projects.ai_description_en:
The HEX-SYNAPSE system is a fully modular, 3D-printed table designed to transform any workspace with its interactive LED hex-grid and seamless smart accessory inlays. At its core, this is a digital product that empowers makers to print their own custom furniture at home. The table features a striking hexagonal grid that integrates dynamic LED lighting, alongside a precision-engineered 25mm slim drawer with a rail system for hidden storage. The system is designed to be endlessly adaptable, offering smart accessory inlays such as smartphone docks, wireless charging mounts, and utility trays that fit seamlessly into the hex-grid.

Delivering a truly customizable experience, the HEX-SYNAPSE system is available in a Square Edition for standard setups, as well as an exclusive Circular Edition featuring mathematically aligned hex-cells for a flawless radius finish. Every component has been fully developed, prototyped, and physically tested using original CAD engineering in Fusion 360, ensuring there is zero manufacturing risk and that all tolerances are perfectly optimized for 3D printing. The digital STL files are instantly deliverable via secure platforms the moment the campaign concludes, meaning backers can begin building immediately without the delays or logistics of traditional hardware shipping.

One of the biggest challenges with precision 3D-printed assemblies is ensuring consistent results across different machines and filament brands. HEX-SYNAPSE directly addresses this by providing a comprehensive printing guide alongside the files, detailing optimal settings, recommended wall thicknesses, and the best print surfaces—such as smooth PEI plates for a high-gloss finish. Furthermore, the project fosters an active Discord community where backers can share print settings, troubleshoot issues, and receive direct technical support. By combining thoroughly tested digital files with robust community support, the HEX-SYNAPSE system makes advanced, smart furniture accessible to anyone with a 3D printer.

projects.ai_description_en:
The AirTrek SmartBag is a new breed of travel gear from LD BAG, engineered to replace multiple bags with a single, shape-shifting solution. It functions as a 2-in-1 trolley and backpack, then adds a smart compression layer to earn its “3-in-1” identity. Whether you need a rolling suitcase for terminal corridors, a comfortable backpack for cobblestone streets, or a bulk‑reduced compression bag that packs its own contents down, the AirTrek SmartBag transforms to match the moment. With a generous 60 L high-capacity interior, it carries everything for extended trips without forcing you to check bags or wrestle with separate carriers.

At its core is an intelligent auto-compression system that evenly presses clothing and soft goods to reclaim valuable space, so you can fit more without exceeding carry‑on limits. Smart organization is built in: dedicated compartments separate shoes, tech, and travel essentials, keeping items instantly accessible while protecting delicate gear. Switching between backpack and trolley modes is designed to be fast and intuitive, letting you pull the bag for smooth mobility on flat surfaces or shoulder it confidently when the terrain turns rugged.

Why it matters: modern travel rarely follows a single path, and fumbling with multiple bags kills momentum. The AirTrek SmartBag delivers genuine versatility for the way people actually move — through airports, onto trains, up stairwells, and into campsites — without compromise. It’s the all-in-one travel companion for backpackers, digital nomads, and outdoor adventurers who refuse to be defined by a single mode of movement. From a project built on real mobility challenges, this smart compression travel bag finally unifies protection, capacity, and adaptability into one streamlined design.

## Story

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/711/322f1eecc385a0befb89948fa1e9e622_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235306&width=680&sig=XRK4XIlD6T0uQ%2Fp%2Fi6sPzstfaypIzzeJzA2g9ASqfW0%3D)

Mixpower is a compact 3-in-1 travel power hub from MOXSEMI, built for people who want fewer chargers, fewer loose cables, and a cleaner everyday carry setup.

WHY WE ARE BUILDING IT

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/718/7d0e71ee2ce53555773a405a74b61c13_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235336&width=680&sig=Nua%2FVKa33tSnw%2BiKn8cKXQl08%2Fgx1GfDWXKYmwgFLI4%3D)

Most daily and travel charging setups turn into a pile of small accessories: a wall charger, a backup battery, a charging cable, adapters, and small-device charging gear. Mixpower is our attempt to make that setup simpler without pretending that one product can replace every specialized device.

WHAT MIXPOWER DOES

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/722/f51922fac47e0f82498d6fedaf71ae9a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235368&width=680&sig=A2O%2Bi3mTbpvRZSIjZeLoFoxp55ePoLGzNqpwgL7ZU98%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/775/8796f3a9313db6fd539c1750e99d3fa0_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235703&width=680&sig=UTsWXeOvlWqGVpIpWSERN1muWx%2BwZn0C1K8595FgKUE%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/778/a34bc56c8fdd7af79e68bea83c81926c_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235705&width=680&sig=MvKJO994q7kYa%2FeYbLYrvjU9xYCFWpWTdEwnreX1qm8%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/776/91de5469269fa72feb707b06fa874a1e_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235704&width=680&sig=qozMvOLoPYD5vuVWouCDU58zBdsQn2sl%2BJik8utUjDk%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/777/53272f1a1b434da4ad0917d10913e8b9_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235705&width=680&sig=Pmf1sBcWbCZgjh6bCWKWGiv9dM%2Bv2GjGVd47Djd2w3I%3D)

Mixpower combines AC wall input, backup power, USB-C output, a built-in USB-C cable output, USB-A output, and low-current earbuds support in one compact travel device. It is designed for workdays, commuting, short trips, hotel rooms, and everyday charging moments when you do not want to carry a separate charger, cable, and power bank.

CONFIRMED SPECIFICATIONS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/723/a9b4741079160085dd886329eaa55ddd_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235387&width=680&sig=B1FyAzbNfPtXSYLT1qcm55QM00Bsi3RJ5r0UhfuVpWg%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/730/8a9624a1672392fd76038c5d9f3820ee_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235444&width=680&sig=h7h2nov418G3xibC3xV8VoUe8xPrV9%2BFSbSn1t6p0q0%3D)

AC Input: 100-240V~ 50/60Hz 1.5A

USB-C Input: 45W Max

USB-C Output: 65W Max

USB-C Cable Output: 27W Max

USB-A Output: 12W Max

Earbuds: 200mA Max

Net Weight: 405g

EVERYDAY BLUETOOTH EARBUDS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/735/907877321b16dd316b322748dc312533_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235461&width=680&sig=U%2Fj8SM1tiS9s%2BE8kGpXXagdeC2706tjLQbe61rxYHpw%3D)

Mixpower is not only about charging larger devices. It also includes everyday Bluetooth earbuds that store and charge inside the main device, so you do not need to carry a separate earbuds case for quick calls, music, or backup listening.

To pair, take the earbuds out of the integrated compartment and select "CV101" from your phone's Bluetooth menu. The earbuds support HSP, HFP, A2DP, AVRCP, SBC, and AAC, with up to 10m Class 2 transmission range.

Basic earbuds details:

Bluetooth pairing name: CV101

Call time: approx. 3 hours

Music time: approx. 4-5 hours depending on volume

Earbuds battery: 3.7V 28mAh x 2

Charging from Mixpower: 200mA max

The earbuds are designed as a convenient everyday audio companion inside the Mixpower system. They are not positioned as premium HiFi or ANC earbuds.

WHAT COMES STANDARD

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/754/537eccf3c3a65e79e758cdd0e773eba5_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235581&width=680&sig=n3wDe2V8vOUPVe9MUslePKk2Wyvcj5iHuxZIqpPjMXI%3D)

Every 1-pack Mixpower reward includes:

\- 1 Mixpower 3-in-1 device

\- 1 USB-C charging cable, about 1 meter

\- 1 dustproof velvet pouch

\- 1 EU plug adapter

\- 1 US plug adapter

For 2-pack and 3-pack rewards, each included item scales with the number of Mixpower units in that tier.

REWARD STRUCTURE

We are keeping this campaign simple: no accessory add-ons, only clear product bundles.

Early Bird - 1 Pack: US$69 equivalent

Duo Pack - 2 Units: US$138 equivalent

Trio Pack - 3 Units: US$207 equivalent

Shipping is charged separately at pledge based on the selected reward tier.

CURRENT STATUS

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/080/786/73813eff4b1345f858f3219aa5f7ab38_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781235721&width=680&sig=3UbHfdhmfsbr7ZFIg8g8Y34IM%2F0%2FTouxTAmDsAY1PGs%3D)

Samples have arrived, and we are now using them for product photography, video production, handling checks, and campaign material preparation. Certification is currently in progress, and we will not claim completed certification until the relevant documentation is confirmed.

OUR PLAN AFTER THE CAMPAIGN

Funds raised will support final validation, certification follow-through, production preparation, packaging, and fulfillment. We will keep the campaign structure focused so that backers understand exactly what they are receiving and so fulfillment stays manageable.

MOXSEMI is building Mixpower for people who want a cleaner everyday travel setup: power and charging in one compact device, with fewer separate things to remember.

## Risks and challenges

Mixpower is a hardware product, so the main risks are sample validation, certification timing, manufacturing schedule, component availability, quality control, and international shipping. Samples have arrived and are now being used for photography, video production, handling checks, and campaign preparation, but certification is still in progress. We will not claim completed certification until documentation is confirmed. If certification or sample testing requires design or production adjustments, this may affect the production timeline or final public specifications.

Manufacturing and logistics can also be affected by component lead times, factory scheduling, customs processing, carrier restrictions, and destination-specific import requirements. The estimated delivery date is our current plan and is not a guarantee.

To reduce fulfillment risk, we are keeping the reward structure simple: no accessory add-ons, only 1-pack, 2-pack, and 3-pack bundles with the same standard package contents. We will communicate progress through Kickstarter updates and share meaningful changes as early as possible.

projects.ai_description_en:
Mixpower is a compact 3-in-1 travel power hub from MOXSEMI designed to replace a tangle of loose cables, wall chargers, and backup batteries with a single 15,000mAh device. It merges AC wall input, portable power, USB-C fast charging, a built-in cable output, and dedicated earbud charging into one everyday carry item for workdays, commuting, short trips, and hotel stays. At 405g, it targets users who want a cleaner, lighter setup without sacrificing the speed or versatility needed to charge phones, laptops, or daily accessories on the go.

The hub delivers targeted power through multiple confirmed ports. A USB-C output handles up to 65W Max for larger devices, while a built-in USB-C cable provides 27W Max, so you can leave a separate cable in the bag less often. USB-A output supports 12W Max for older gear, and a dedicated 200mA Max earbuds mode safely charges small devices. AC input accepts 100–240V with a 1.5A line, and a USB-C input allows 45W Max recharging of the internal battery, making it effective as a wall converter and a backup power source from a single source of AC power. A built-in swappable plug system (with US and EU adapters included) helps it move easily between regions.

Mixpower goes beyond the power pack by integrating everyday Bluetooth earbuds that store and charge inside the main unit, removing the need for a separate earbuds case. The supporting earbuds use CV101 as their pairing name and cover HSP, HFP, A2DP, AVRCP, SBC, and AAC with a 10-meter Class 2 range, providing approximately 3 hours of call time or 4–5 hours of music per charge from the 28mAh per-side batteries. They are positioned as a practical audio companion rather than a premium Hi-Fi or ANC solution.

Each 1-pack reward includes one Mixpower device, a one-meter USB-C charging cable, a dustproof velvet pouch, and both a US and EU plug adapter, with 2-pack and 3-pack tiers scaling contents to match fewer add-on choices. A sample validation and certification phase is currently underway, with the project stating that official certification will be confirmed only once documentation review is complete, keeping the structure deliberate and focused on straightforward fulfillment.

projects.ai_intro_en: The Goplay Roadster is an heirloom wooden toy car machined from a single block of solid North American maple. No glue-ups, no seams — one piece of wood, milled to shape, then sanded and oiled by hand. The wheels roll on steel axles with replaceable bearings, so the part that wears out is the part you can swap.
ai_highlights_en: Heirloom quality: machined from a single block of solid North American maple, built to last generations.
Serviceable design: steel axles with replaceable bearings and TPE tires for easy maintenance, reducing waste.
Proudly made in USA: CNC-machined in Milwaukee, hand-assembled in Cleveland, supporting local craftsmanship.

steel axles with replaceable bearings, smooth roll and serviceable for decades
TPE, gentle on floors and free of PVC
molded ABS in signature orange, durable and impact-resistant
about 11 inches long, with real weight in the hand
machined and hand finished in Milwaukee, Wisconsin; assembled by hand in Cleveland, Ohio
500 cars, individually numbered; Batch 001 is 500 Roadsters

IF WE DON'T STOP THEM THEY'LL KEEP COMING

The Pest Memo City Championship

One year. Every city on the list. One mission.

IF WE DON'T STOP THEM THEY'LL KEEP COMING

Bed bugs are not a cleanliness problem. They are a logistics problem. They hitchhike. They hide. And by the time you know they're there, they've been there for weeks. By then they number in the tens to the hundreds, and they are in multiple rooms or apartments.

In 2021, I ran 2 hotels 20 miles apart.  One ran smoothly, and the other did not.  It was at the "did not" hotel that I was having bed bug problems.  I can remember my head of housekeeping coming to me and telling me that a housekeeper refused to clean a room because she found a bed bug in the room.  The head of housekeeping said she would not clean it either because she did not want to take bed bugs home with her, either.  I went to the room and saw my maintenance person dragging the linen to the bathtub so that he could heat treat the room to 139 degrees.

I was not happy.  First, he should not have been dragging the linen.  It should have been bagged up or left in the room to be heat treated.  Heat treating the area to 120 degrees for 4-hours kills everything.  I wanted them to heat treat for 24-hours at 139 degrees.  I wanted assured destruction of all stages of bed bug life.  Because of the way he was doing it, I couldn't be sure if the bed bug was there due to his failure [our failure] or was a new introduction.  In my frustration, I began thinking that there has to be a better way to find them before my staff and before my guest find them.  I wanted a way that detects them as soon as a guest brings them in.

This got me thinking about doorbell notices, and then drawing the bug in.  That is when I began formulating Pest Memo and getting a notification or alert that a bed bug was in the room.

Initially, I thought hotels would love this. With it you could tell a guest you proactively monitor for bed bugs and there hasn't been a bed bug in this room for 10 years.  As I spoke to different hotels, I was reminded that most hotels don't really have problems with bed bugs.  It is only once in a blue moon.  Then I started hearing about all of the problems with bed bugs in low-income housing. There was a tenant sitting across the street from his apartment building complaining about bed bugs in his apartment and no one caring.  My cousin lived in the same building, so I asked him.  He told me that he maintains his lease but does not sleep in the apartment because the bed bugs are so bad.

I spoke to others and I heard account after account about bed bugs going unremedied in low-income, multi-family housing. I even encountered a problem at my hotel from someone who lived in a low-income, high-rise.  She was a 90-year-old woman visiting her 90-year-old male friend.  Each time she came to visit we found a bed bug in his room despite our having moved his room to treat the last encounter.  I finally had to tell her she was not able to return to the hotel because of the bed bug problem.  Thankfully, she and I had a good rapport.  She accepted the news and understood.

I also found research generated by a HUD pest control consultant.  He noted: "In high-rise, senior living buildings, over 70% of residents are unaware they have bed bugs. • Shame and mental health issues are usually the problem."  Research he cited further noted that bed bugs show up in surrounding apartments within 3 days of entering the first unit.

In HUD-assisted multifamily housing, the problem is systemic. Traditional detection methods — physical inspections, canine units — cost hundreds of dollars per visit and only happen quarterly. In the interim, infestations spread unit to unit. A single missed detection in one apartment can trigger a building-wide outbreak within 30 days.

THE SOLUTION: PEST MEMO

Pest Memo is a patented IoT bed bug detection device designed so that it is effective for multifamily housing. US Patent No. 12,268,201 B1 covers our core innovation: a micro-fan system that actively disperses a CO2, heat, and kairomone attractant blend, drawing bed bugs to the trap up to 3x faster than passive devices. When a bug enters, an onboard camera captures a timestamped photo and sends an instant alert to the property manager's phone.

Detection within 48 hours. Photo proof. No guessing. No waiting.

HUD Notice H 2012-5 specifically recommends "active bed bug monitors containing attractants" for HUD-assisted properties. That is Pest Memo, word for word.

THE CAMPAIGN: BUY 2, WE GIVE 1

Every 2 devices purchased on this campaign funds the donation of 1 device to a low-income family identified by Michigan DHHS (If you are not in Michigan we will look to donate to your state's cooperating DHHS agency). Donated devices are deployed in coordination with housing authorities and social service agencies. Each donated unit comes with a 12-month monitoring setup and emergency response protocol.

This isn't charity. It's infrastructure. We're building the detection network that this country's most vulnerable communities have never had.  By doing this we can help reduce the number of these hitchhikers.  It is a win for all!!

The Pest Memo City Championship

Detroit is #3 on Orkin's Worst Bed Bug Cities list. Chicago is #1. These aren't statistics — they're neighborhoods. For one year, starting the day this campaign closes, every city on Orkin's list is in the fight. Your $5 City Champion pledge goes into a pool for your city. When a donated Pest Memo device sends a verified bed bug alert in your city, pooled funds are dispatched to a licensed pest control partner for a service call. Every completed treatment adds a point to your city's score. The city that protects the most families wins — and more importantly, those families get to sleep.

Track the live standings all year atpestmemo.com/championship

Stacy Hawkins is the Founder and CEO of Pest Memo LLC, headquartered in Saginaw's HUBZone at 203 S. Washington Ave. He holds US Patent No. 12,268,201 B1 and brings 14+ years of hospitality management experience from Baymont by Wyndham.

I spent 14 years in the hotel industry at multiple properties — 10 of them as a manager. I didn't build Pest Memo because I read about bed bugs. I built it because I lived it. At a past property I managed, my housekeepers encountered bed bugs after my maintenance person had addressed the problem with heat treatment.  I did not know if the bugs were new introductions or if my maintenance staff was not handling the problem correctly.  I wanted a way to know when the bugs first entered into my room so that we can eradicate them before anyone else was ever at risk by them.

This problem was further illustrated when I had a family book 4 rooms for a 3-night stay. They inspected the rooms upon arrival and found no issues on night one. No issues on night two. No issues on day three.  On the day of checkout all four rooms suddenly reporting bed bugs — and the family is pointing at us.

Here's what I knew that they didn't: a vigilant hotel can do everything right and still be blindsided. That family may have stopped at a shop, visited a friend's house, or stayed somewhere else before checking in. Bed bugs hitchhike. They don't care who was careful.

We had no way to prove when those bugs arrived. Neither did they. That's the real problem — not negligence. Documentation.

Pest Memo fixes that. A traveler can inspect their room before they even bring their bags in. A hotel can pull up a continuous monitoring log showing zero detections for the last 6 months. Both sides get the truth. Nobody has to guess. Nobody has to fight.

The journey to provide this solution has been long and arduous. I started out watching YouTube videos to find out if what I wanted to create had been created or if there was something similar out there.  I found only pieces of the technology in varying devices. So, I found the code to some of them and tried to patch my device together.  In doing this, I found that I could get the pieces to work separately but not together.

I found TinkerCad and began designing my enclosure. I got a 3D print from the Mott Community College Maker's Lab and put together a breadboard to test my pieces.

I learned enough coding to get the camera and the sensor to work together.  I could get the fan to work by itself, but I could not get them all to work together.  I found someone to do a schematic of my electronics for me.

So, I hired someone from Fiverr to help me bridge this gap.  I got scammed.  I went back to trying to learn more code to see if I could figure it out.  I couldn't give up because I knew this device would be game-changing for so many people.

I reached out everywhere I could think of looking on LinkedIn for people with software skills, looking for people with First Robotics experience, and looking for people in my area. I contacted colleges to see if they had anyone that could help. I put up a flyer in the computer science department describing the project, saying I would pay for help, and put tear-off tags with my phone number on it.  I even had conversations with faculty.  One faculty member loved the idea and said he wished he would have had the device at his cottage.  They had forgotten a bag of food that they had meant to take back to their primary residence after shuttering the cottage for the summer.  Well that bag of food drew mice and the whole cottage was overrun by the time he and his family returned.  That conversation led me to a group of students.  I took all of my pieces to them, and they put together a schematic for the device and said they solved the problem. So, I paid them and brought their solution home.  But when I got home the solution did not work.

I went back to the internet to see if I could learn more about coding.  It was my belief that this schematic would work even though the coding did not.  So, I decided to get a PCB to help reduce the size of the device.  I found a company that can help me with mass producing my device, and they introduced me to a company that could make a PCB for me.  That company made the PCB and created a new schematic for my device.

I paid to have 3 PCBs made thinking I was ready as soon as the coding was ready.  You can see one of the PCBs at the bottom of the image above. I even paid the company extra money to create an additional 25 PCBs when we are ready for them

My company is part of the CMURC Smart Zone and has an office in their co-workspace. CMURC introduced me to a software company that told me it could get everything working in 30 days.  I emphasized that Wi-Fi provisioning was one of the most critical aspects of the design.  That company was not able to get the software working with Arduino.  It had me switch to Raspberry PI.  We spent about 9 months working on it each Saturday morning from 3:00 am until about 6:00 am.  This change also required that everything be re-designed, and a new mechanical engineer was brought in to redo the design of the device.

That company said Wi-Fi provisioning could not be done.  But, without Wi-Fi Provisioning I couldn't hand it off to a lab or beta testers.  So, I went back to the drawing board.  I tried to find another software programmer.  I found 2 or 3 that made promises but did not deliver the results I desired.

Finally, I met Saamer Mansoor.  He did what others claimed they could do in about 30-days.  He created a framework for Wi-Fi provisioning, he created the framework for the app, he created the backend for the email notifications, created the program for getting everything to work together, and created the dashboard to view the images taken.  We are still tweaking the Wi-Fi provisioning and the lighting in the box.  But we are polishing rather than creating.

The video above showing our device working shows the dashboard for viewing the images of bugs and shows the email alert.

Our CTO Saamer Mansoor, sourced through TechTown Detroit, built our proprietary full-stack IoT platform — firmware, cloud backend, and React mobile app. Our device runs on custom PlatformIO firmware with Firebase photo storage and real-time alert delivery.

Join us in making a difference in not only the lives of others but in our own lives.  1 in 5 households in the U.S. encounter bed bugs.  That is 20% of U.S. households or 66 million people in the U.S.  If we can exterminate them at a faster rate then they have less chance of spreading and less chance of crossing our paths.  Travelers and those with interest in multifamily units or cities. make ake your selection now.

We will have a booth at the upcoming Building Michigan Communities Conference on May 12, 2026, in Lansing, Michigan.  We are looking to hand out devices for beta testing to those who donate to this campaign.  We want them to test them in their units that have bed bugs.  We are also sending a device off to a lab for testing.

Join us in making a difference donate to our 2 for 1 campaign.

WHERE YOUR MONEY GOES

Risks and challenges

We need the money to get certifications and would like to conduct lab research to confirm the physics of our design.  We have used Claude AI to help create our estimations of Pest Memo's effectiveness and improvement over existing products.  So, our numbers are projections. We also want to pay for PCB boards to reduce the form factor and reduce the chance of jumper wires coming loose.  The funds will also help us re-design the enclosure to improve the clarity of the picture being taken given the size of the device and the size of the bed bug being captured.

projects.ai_intro_en: Pest Memo is a patented IoT bed bug detection device that uses a micro-fan system to actively disperse CO2, heat, and kairomone attractants, drawing bed bugs to the trap up to 3x faster than passive devices. When a bug enters, an onboard camera captures a timestamped photo and sends an instant alert to the property manager's phone. Designed for multifamily housing, it provides detection within 48 hours with photo proof.
ai_highlights_en: Patented active detection with CO2, heat, and kairomone attractants draws bed bugs 3x faster than passive devices
Onboard camera captures timestamped photos and sends instant alerts to property managers' phones
HUD Notice H 2012-5 specifically recommends active bed bug monitors with attractants for HUD-assisted properties
ai_specs_en: Timestamped photo sent to property manager's phone
Buy 2, donate 1 to low-income family via state DHHS
projects.ai_risks_en: Reward tier pricing details are incomplete in the campaign page. The City Championship starts only after campaign closure, adding timeline uncertainty. Donated device deployment depends on coordination with housing authorities and social service agencies, which may cause delays. The product is pre-revenue and has not yet shipped.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Hotel operator who experienced bed bug infestations firsthand and developed Pest Memo after witnessing the systemic problem in low-income, multi-family housing.
projects.ai_description_en:
Pest Memo is a patented IoT bed bug detector designed to identify infestations at their earliest stages—before they spread and before residents even know they're there. Born from firsthand experience managing hotels where bed bugs created crises for both staff and guests, this smart detection system aims to catch bed bugs the moment they're introduced into a room. By combining luring technology with automated monitoring and instant alerts, Pest Memo transforms bed bug detection from a reactive, quarterly inspection process into a continuous, proactive defense.

The device works by drawing bed bugs in and capturing visual evidence, sending real-time notifications to property managers or residents the moment a bed bug is detected. This early-warning capability is critical: research shows bed bugs spread to surrounding apartments within just three days of entering a first unit, and in high-rise senior living buildings, over 70% of residents remain unaware they have an infestation due to shame and mental health barriers. Pest Memo eliminates the delay between introduction and detection, enabling immediate intervention before a single bug becomes a building-wide outbreak.

What makes Pest Memo matter most is its mission-driven model. For every two devices purchased, the company donates one to a low-income family in need, directly addressing the systemic crisis in HUD-assisted multifamily housing where traditional detection methods—costing hundreds per visit—only happen quarterly. The "Buy 2, Give 1" approach ensures that the communities most vulnerable to unchecked infestations gain access to the same early-warning technology available to hotels and property managers. By closing the gap between detection and treatment, Pest Memo doesn't just protect individual families—it helps stop the cycle of infestation that threatens entire buildings and neighborhoods.

projects.name: MP26-01 Smart Iot Mini Irrigation Pump
projects.blurb: MP26-01’s smart app intelligently assists time-strapped users to water plants effortlessly with one tap, no matter where they are.
projects.html_story:
MP26-01’s smart app intelligently assists time-strapped users to water plants effortlessly with one tap, no matter where they are.

MP26-01’s smart app intelligently assists time-strapped users to water plants effortlessly with one tap, no matter where they are.

Environmental commitments

We’ve brought you a fun little cube: the MP26-01. It helps you automatically water your plants. Based on your understanding of your crops, you can customize your watering plan — from scheduled watering, watering duration, to interval between waterings — all customizable. With the companion app, you can record and review your past watering schedules. The MP26-01 is a mini smart water pump, and we hope it becomes your first reliable irrigation assistant on your planting journey.

Two main colors are available: brown and green. These are two basic colors, representing soil and vegetation, and they blend well into your garden or next to your plants. Of course, we’ve also experimented with some bold and vibrant colors.

The main body and internal structure of the MP26-01 are 3D printed, and the material is biodegradable PLA.

It fits multiple scenarios and supports various DIY usages. Suitable for all plants that need irrigation, and it is also perfectly applicable to rainforest tank landscaping.

The 5-meter silicone tubing is field-cuttable to accommodate variable plant spacing and diverse layout lengths. Its gray, light-shielding construction effectively suppresses algal proliferation, ensuring long-term pipeline cleanliness and uninterrupted flow performance.

Fine Drip Mode.Water comes out in tiny droplets with slow micro water output, ideal for succulents and drought-tolerant small plants, providing gentle water supply without waterlogging.

Water Column Mode.Water flows in a straight column with large water output, suitable for large green plants and vines for fast and sufficient watering.

When the temperature drops below 41°F, the water inside the product may freeze and expand, causing the product to crack.If used outdoors, please keep the product at a temperature above 41°F and store it indoors in a dark place to prevent damage from low temperatures and UV-induced aging.

MP26-10 is made of PLA biodegradable eco-friendly material. Do not expose the product to environments above 60°C, as this may cause softening, compromise performance and sealing. Also, keep it away from fire sources.

The SeedPixel app now fully supports setup and remote control of the MP26-01. Our latest development focuses on systematic human-computer interaction (HCI) optimization—including operation logic refinement and interface responsiveness enhancement—to improve user operational efficiency and system usability.

The MP26-01 Intelligent Watering Plan allows for customizable settings, including watering cycle, duration, and interval between watering sessions.

The app will be available on Google Play and iOS platforms, allowing you to design and customize irrigation schedules more conveniently.

We are a small studio, founded in 2025. In an era of rapid technological and digital advancement, we hope to connect plants and people through planting, gardening, and cultivation — by infusing technology and passion into the growing process. We focus on cultivation, irrigation, and farming, using design to help you better care for and attend to your crops.

If you have any creative ideas about gardening or any suggestions regarding the MP26-01, please feel free to contact us.

service@seedpixel.hk

Risks and challenges

MP26-01 is our upgraded and optimized product. We spent over a year enhancing the performance of both hardware and software—from pump water stability testing to software and electronic circuit upgrades. The design is now finalized, and our manufacturing partner has produced multiple batches of successfully tested units.

That said, a few risks remain:

1、Production Schedule Adjustment  
Although the parameters of our 3D printing facility have been optimized, minor delays may occur due to fluctuations in the global supply of electronic components, batch-to-batch performance variations in Bambu PLA material, or unexpected capacity constraints.  
To mitigate this risk, we have secured material suppliers and pre-scheduled production slots.

2、Software and Hardware System Integration and Mass Production Risks  
When the companion mobile application (app) is adapted to mainstream operating system versions—including Android 12 through 14 and iOS 16 through 18—compatibility inconsistencies may arise in edge cases. Ensuring consistency during mass production may require additional quality control measures.  
We will conduct multi-stage inspections for each production batch and continuously optimize functionality, release firmware updates, and perform necessary calibrations.

3、Logistics and Global Transportation Variability Risks  
International delivery may be affected by customs delays, holiday peak periods, or disruptions in express courier services. Delivery lead times to end customers may vary objectively across countries and regions.  
To mitigate this risk, we partner with reliable global logistics providers and provide real-time shipment tracking updates via the Kickstarter dashboard and email notifications to keep backers informed of transportation progress.

4、User Experience Assurance Risks  
End users may encounter a steep learning curve when initially configuring Wi-Fi connectivity, setting up multi-pump coordinated control networks, and debugging advanced functions. In extremely rare cases, individual units may experience performance degradation after prolonged operation under high load.  
Mitigation Measures: Provide a structured English user manual—including embedded QR codes linking directly to video tutorials; resolve after-sales inquiries within 48 hours and initiate replacement or repair within 72 hours.

We are committed to transparent communication. In the event of any unexpected issues, we will promptly share the latest updates and strive to find the best solutions for all our supporters.

Environmental commitments

Reusability and recyclability

We are launching a packaging recycling initiative with all backers.
Our product packaging is fully recyclable and eco-friendly.
We encourage you to reuse or recycle the packaging after unboxing, to cut down waste and support sustainable gardening together.

Sustainable materials

We utilize upcycled PLA material sourced from Bambu Lab, which is fully compliant with key EU regulatory standards—including RoHS Directive 2011/65/EU, REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006, EN 71-3:2019 (migration of certain elements), and Regulation (EU) No 10/2011 on plastic materials in contact with food. This ensures product safety, full regulatory conformity, and environmental sustainability.

Environmentally friendly factories

We select professional printing workshops equipped with Bambu Lab 3D printers for production. The emissions generated during printing and indoor air quality associated with Bambu Lab 3D printers strictly comply with the UL 2904 Standard for 3D Printer Emissions Test and Evaluation. The printers have obtained authoritative UL 2904 certification, ensuring a low-emission, safer, and more environmentally friendly production process.

projects.ai_intro_en: The MP26-01 is a compact smart water pump that automatically waters your plants via a companion app with just one tap. It features customizable watering plans including schedule, duration, and intervals, with two modes: fine drip for succulents and water column for larger plants. The device is 3D printed using biodegradable PLA material and comes with 5-meter silicone tubing.
ai_highlights_en: Smart app-controlled watering with customizable schedules and remote one-tap operation from anywhere
Two watering modes: fine drip for succulents and water column for large plants and vines
Eco-friendly 3D printed biodegradable PLA body with 5-meter field-cuttable silicone tubing
ai_specs_en: Fine Drip Mode and Water Column Mode
SeedPixel app for Google Play and iOS
Watering cycle, duration, and interval settings
projects.ai_risks_en: Risks include potential production delays from electronic component supply fluctuations and PLA material batch variations, software/hardware compatibility issues across Android 12-14 and iOS 16-18, international shipping disruptions from customs or courier delays, and user learning curve for Wi-Fi setup and multi-pump control. Mitigation includes secured suppliers, multi-stage inspections, reliable logistics partners, and structured manuals with video tutorials.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: SeedPixel is a small studio founded in 2025 focused on cultivation, irrigation, and farming technology to connect plants and people through smart gardening solutions.
projects.ai_description_en:
The MP26-01 Smart IoT Mini Irrigation Pump is a compact, cube-shaped watering solution that brings smart automation to home plant care. 3D printed from biodegradable PLA material, this eco-conscious device is available in two nature-inspired colors—brown representing soil and green representing vegetation—designed to blend naturally into garden environments or sit discreetly beside houseplants. The complete package includes the main pump unit, a USB-A to USB-C charging cable, and an accessory kit with five droppers, a check valve, six T-joints, a filter, and five meters of field-cuttable silicone tubing. The gray, light-shielding tubing specifically prevents algal growth, ensuring long-term clean water flow and uninterrupted performance across varied garden layouts.

The MP26-01's companion app allows users to create customized watering plans tailored to their specific plants and environment. Users can set precise schedules, adjust watering durations, and configure intervals between waterings—all remotely accessible whether at home or away. The system records and reviews past watering schedules, helping users track their plants' care history. Two distinct watering modes cater to different plant needs: Fine Drip Mode delivers gentle, slow-perfect droplets ideal for succulents and drought-tolerant plants, while Water Column Mode provides a straight, high-volume stream perfect for larger green plants and vines requiring substantial hydration. The smart app also supports multi-pump networks, allowing coordinated control across larger planting areas.

Designed for versatility, the MP26-01 adapts to multiple scenarios including traditional potted plant care, garden beds, and even rainforest tank landscaping. The five-meter silicone tubing can be cut to custom lengths, accommodating variable plant spacing and diverse layout configurations. The unit operates on USB-C charging for convenient power management and requires storage above 41°F to prevent freezing damage; the PLA material should not be exposed to temperatures above 60°C. A Basic Package supports approximately two square meters of planting area, accommodating up to six small to medium potted plants. Whether you're a busy professional seeking reliable plant care during hectic weeks, or a dedicated horticulturist wanting precise control over your watering routine, the MP26-01 offers a simple, sustainable solution that combines smart automation with eco-friendly design.
