projects.blurb: Instantly extracts toilet odors at the source and sends them outside before they spread.
projects.ai_intro_en: ODORUN is the first cordless toilet odor extractor that vents odor outside — no drilling, no filters, no cords. It captures odors at the bowl, routes them through the toilet drainage system, and expels them out of the building. Using -6.5 kPa of negative pressure and 2 gallons of air per second, it provides a full bowl air change every second.
ai_highlights_en: Cordless design with no drilling, filters, or cords required
-6.5 kPa negative pressure moves 2 gallons of air per second
13,500 mAh battery lasts 3-4 weeks per charge, 300-500 cycles

Installation must follow local plumbing/code requirements. Final production units may require additional testing or design refinements. Supply chain and component availability issues could affect delivery.

### Play Smarter

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/713/d8be12f15d83b1729cc90895329e0fdf_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781181906&width=680&sig=%2B8WOyQQRxuGHtbWFoNhqYI1%2FUBwGD3%2F9%2BpukaWAWqAE%3D)

#### Built-in Phone Stand — Finally.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/063/ab671865e4961e262004ba810b720695_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781238084&width=680&sig=zhCGPvu7Z704b%2FkOZZuofFCHLvBQvjMyJ1KMWMKFYEw%3D)

No more awkward setups.

Place your phone right in front of you — perfect for lyrics, chords, or tutorials.

#### Snap-On Mic. Instant Performance.

Turn your guitar into a mini stage in seconds.

Just snap on the magnetic mic and start singing.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/062/26b9cbd04fdf1eacb6c9843792026dda_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781238061&width=680&sig=mWUL%2FSv5ZNmT6%2F4kYa19b9diyv1P6Z1N0wfCwy5ajb0%3D)

#### Solo Mode — Immerse Yourself in Music

lets you plug in headphones for a more immersive and private music experience, allowing you to fully focus on your sound without distractions.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/083/785/562623235094d1a1563912448245e795_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781258645&width=680&sig=ay38ugUdX9M%2BWjlkPNmb2AAM941lNOCvLbrEk2%2FXn6Q%3D)

We include a pair of headphones in the box so you can start enjoying it right away.

### One Guitar, Endless Sounds

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/752/52122400cf14ac0148a785f22b0deae9_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781182082&width=680&sig=6U68D9pq6UG17nI%2B1nsfs2RmUNpk60Ro2hPZKBZxLVQ%3D)

Explore More Ways to Create

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/445/cfd8e5a9eb1d7baf808be365dd646d2f_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781180511&width=680&sig=1EXGCQqUTayOgZc5g4gypr%2FThUT%2BkioUFN1K5ztMlAA%3D)

#### 14 Instruments in One

Switch sounds instantly and turn your music into something new every time.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/042/2719258dbf30e9f2eb25f3bb655d4331_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781237901&width=680&sig=nrOYb%2BJVq6IaoOlk3PMtqhKCuKTs1rPig3qXPg2wUT0%3D)

Guitar · Piano · Drums · Bass · Sax · Guzheng · Ukulele · Electric Guitar · and mor

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/048/0d820bb2b36c5562db9ccd5098334a92_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781237930&width=680&sig=36w5lzr6o6KvNCZdxiKavtK%2Fl%2FQgUSRjCp8Xx1A6ZlE%3D)

#### Exclusive Meow Tone

Turn every strum into an adorable cat sound and bring a playful twist to your music.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/081/041/f216e9b24fe00f88bb305d30b9077f73_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781237883&width=680&sig=gk73LjmQQmh4spko2yuZwF5WjgeSVjyFppcnxnHNXIQ%3D)

### Feel Like a Real Guitar

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/800/f5cabb76a6b7aefdca6c60cfd6fe6ce0_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781182285&width=680&sig=eGpZNzlGQHAK8HB%2FhyYXfWM9ff0f4EXMmk1jIf%2Fi8HY%3D)

Authentic Design, Immersive Experience

#### Full-Size Design

Bigger, bolder, and more premium than typical compact devices.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/472/5cc4241638872e3203d638997260358a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781180611&width=680&sig=esJ3uOCRpGJf6YK9nZjwi1WhPxPxSW%2BfLQ03aXC%2BMvc%3D)

Inspired by the proportions of a real guitar, our design features a larger body and a more familiar form factor than most stringless guitars. The result is a more comfortable grip, a stronger sense of presence, and a more immersive playing experience.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/093/713/5f5465c6a66a50b21341122791905119_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781337795&width=680&sig=a6DkF1jD6Nv1TOt0v%2FLhFJkf3zQ89WdaHctaW%2BD7at0%3D)

#### 5 Playing Styles

Switch between five different playing modes and unlock more ways to perform your favorite songs.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/094/066/226008ac1e281cce416e372a07870a14_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781341951&width=680&sig=kP1dfkLbg8JTJAtKjgyW7RviH7vlj1g4h9HQy5aYork%3D)

### Play Anywhere

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/781/97985cfe212a8835fc870b2cc7c2ddab_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781182189&width=680&sig=QCdeO%2FX9TIX8FnDxejLuEhnqa%2F2aTn9gHStntuMc1VE%3D)

#### 30-Day Battery Life

Built-in 4000mAh battery delivers ultra-long battery life, allowing up to 30 days of use on a single charge.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/093/562/c00d9f238dc05b619eb4acd5d19e57db_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781336437&width=680&sig=F42ZKceklC3JQlPNvEFif4QSD67ThIbwAgxjL1ndRwA%3D)

Play Anywhere, Anytime

Take your music anywhere in real life — from campfires and home relaxation to small performances and content creation. No setup, no limits. Just pick it up and play.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/083/757/573241a3ce74dcd3ed0fa7da40392c0a_original.gif?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1781258515&width=680&sig=L7fKCPLO4ieSGz1daXq%2F%2BO%2FOVJp%2FNr9M0bmgb1UPNn8%3D)

### Reward

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/072/641/f452c239daf4803d569dd3d63c674fea_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781181527&width=680&sig=Y7usqshpqazssnYEulNbDXpOq1K6B4l7%2BlR8zeP8Brc%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/083/235/a8bc05c6f314fa2042076734d94d1e80_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781255120&width=680&sig=dJwAqsCBRNPiPTrdLJ53PgKiOZKrySYxDEeWCwFPL3Y%3D)

### Add-on

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/094/648/0ff8c1e1a4acd056e8c1eac254a872b8_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781349809&width=680&sig=%2F8hdoZn5POFq7hOPBovdhFdJ9aO9A17PEYOWbJMWA9E%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/094/634/45828d7466377fd582af1cd68baffd14_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781349648&width=680&sig=xoEKdd0LTpUdQOYbqTkMw1e%2FSNdGrxY%2F9aMITouR1Ww%3D)

### What's in the box

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/094/089/f61e2e4f7a9ffb52a5f7592526305721_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781342374&width=680&sig=N2RMI0uS6G7SUnQ%2BJV%2BusZi2wH%2FgZv1zuzGrjDgraOw%3D)

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/094/386/9c432ae6fd3cb3b0e736bc04ec7d2286_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781346317&width=680&sig=8JWQIUtpvk%2FHw02WAuRX9LbzK%2F1XRw3n8%2FZJPTe3PZM%3D)

### Timeline

### Design

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/054/094/091/f09017e6bc9efac1ddb18e2341b55c46_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1781342384&width=680&sig=yx3BARqN7uVku6Sz4SXjzHnqcQ9Oc1XqM8DMQq%2F76zs%3D)

Our design is fully original. For the guitar’s front panel, we take inspiration from high-quality audio speakers and use an acoustically inspired woven fabric surface, rather than the solid plastic panels commonly found on traditional guitars.

In speaker design, woven acoustic fabrics are widely used to help optimize sound transmission and diffusion. They reduce unwanted reflections and “muffled” resonance while allowing sound to pass more naturally and evenly.

Applied to our guitar, this structure helps deliver a clearer, brighter, and more transparent tone, with improved detail and a more refined overall sound character.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/647/958/0a39529eb0e144c85f04d0f37ef6fab7_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1778240250&width=680&sig=UztJTIHbElWM0OP4mtxRRFZKHnDqMxgc5q%2F0QOxcLWs%3D)

Traditional stringless guitars often place the volume control on the side for aesthetics. However, we found this is less intuitive in real use.

That’s why we moved the volume control to the top of the front panel, making it more direct and easier to adjust during play. We also integrated the power and control functions into a single switch, simplifying operation and improving the overall user experience.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/647/961/6c1ac4cab59d988830a1ca43ea6d34bb_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1778240256&width=1080&sig=x4Kv8OG4zTHw7brsfL5VyqTKjArRZDAQqQ54crwZ56Q%3D)

projects.ai_intro_en: The Stringless Smart Guitar is a foldable, stringless instrument that combines built-in band sounds, guided chords, a speaker, and a snap-on microphone for instant play and singing anywhere. It offers 14 built-in instrument sounds, a full-size design for authentic feel, and up to 30 days of battery life. With features like a phone stand, solo mode with headphones, and exclusive Meow Tone, it lets anyone make music instantly.
ai_highlights_en: Built-in phone stand for hands‑free lyric/chord viewing
Snap‑on magnetic microphone turns the guitar into a mini stage for instant singing
14 built‑in instrument sounds (guitar, piano, drums, etc.) plus exclusive Meow Tone for playful play
ai_specs_en: 14 built‑in (guitar, piano, bass, drums, sax, guzheng, ukulele, electric guitar, etc.)
Phone stand, snap‑on mic, solo mode with headphones
projects.ai_risks_en: As a hardware innovation, the stringless guitar integrates sensors, audio systems, and mechanical parts, which may lead to performance fine‑tuning, quality consistency, and manufacturing coordination challenges. Global logistics and shipping timelines could also be affected by external factors, though the team is building buffer time and maintaining transparent communication to mitigate these risks.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: We are a team of musicians, engineers, and designers united by a shared vision to make music more accessible, portable, and intuitive.
projects.ai_description_en:
Introducing the Sound For, a foldable smart guitar that revolutionizes portable music-making by letting you play anywhere, anytime. This innovative stringless instrument features a full-size body inspired by traditional guitars, offering a comfortable grip and an immersive playing experience without the weight and bulk. With 14 built-in instrument sounds—including guitar, piano, drums, bass, saxophone, guzheng, ukulele, and an exclusive playful "Meow Tone"—you can instantly switch genres and unlock endless creative possibilities. Combined with five distinct playing styles, this single instrument adapts to your musical vision whether you are strumming at a campfire, relaxing at home, or creating content on the go.

What truly sets this guitar apart is its thoughtful integration of premium materials and user-centric design. A high-capacity 4000mAh battery delivers an ultra-long 30-day battery life on a single charge, eliminating constant recharging. The front panel utilizes an acoustically inspired woven fabric surface rather than solid plastic, reducing unwanted reflections and muffled resonance to deliver a clearer, brighter, and more transparent tone. Practical refinements include a top-mounted volume control for intuitive adjustment during play and a built-in phone stand that keeps your lyrics and tutorials perfectly positioned. When you want to sing, the magnetic snap-on mic instantly transforms your setup into a mini stage.

The package comes ready for immediate use, including the guitar, a magnetic microphone, a phone holder, headphones for private solo mode, a guitar strap, a charging cable, and a dedicated backpack to carry it all. By removing the physical strings and traditional barriers, Sound For makes music more accessible, portable, and intuitive for everyone—from beginners to experienced musicians. Back this crowdfunding project and join us in bringing a new, effortless way of making music to life.

projects.ai_intro_en: Bidetsy is the world's only freestanding portable bidet that requires no plumbing or installation, making it perfect for renters. It delivers a powerful 35PSI water stream with a large 20L refillable tank and long-lasting rechargeable battery. The compact design fits easily next to any toilet for thorough sanitary cleansing.
ai_highlights_en: No installation or plumbing required - freestanding portable design
Powerful 35PSI water pressure with 20L large water tank
Rechargeable 12V 4800mAh battery with estimated monthly recharge
projects.ai_risks_en: Manufacturing delays from factory scheduling or tooling issues are possible. The team plans to work with experienced manufacturers and has a timeline targeting July 2026 delivery with pilot production in July and shipping in September 2026.
projects.ai_creator_bio_en: Bidetsy was created by a team frustrated by the inability to install bidets in rental properties, developing a freestanding portable solution.
projects.ai_description_en:
Bidetsy is the world's first freestanding portable bidet that requires absolutely no plumbing or installation, making it the ideal solution for renters, students, and anyone who wants the hygiene benefits of a bidet without the hassle of hiring a plumber or modifying their bathroom. Born from the simple frustration of not being able to install a traditional bidet in a rental property, Bidetsy sits neatly beside any toilet and is ready to use straight out of the box — no drilling, no pipes, and no leaks.

At the heart of Bidetsy is a powerful wash system that delivers up to 35PSI of water pressure, comparable to mains tap water, for a thorough and comfortable clean. The unit features an enormous 20-litre (5-gallon) self-contained water tank that holds enough capacity for countless uses before needing a refill from your sink faucet — roughly once a week for a single person with regular use. Power comes from a long-lasting rechargeable 12V 4800mAh battery that only needs charging approximately once every month, with a 4-8 hour recharge time. The slim footprint of 15cm wide by 48cm deep by 59cm high means it fits perfectly in tight bathroom spaces, while the stainless steel hose and high-quality durable plastic construction ensure it is built to last.

What makes Bidetsy truly matter is its accessibility. Traditional bidet attachments and built-in systems require permanent plumbing modifications, which are often impossible in rental homes or impractical for people who move frequently. Bidetsy removes that barrier entirely, offering a more powerful alternative to squeeze bottles, a more portable solution than electric bidet attachments, and a more hygienic option than wipes or toilet paper. The unit is CE and UKCA compliant, and the team is working with experienced small appliance manufacturers to ensure rigorous quality control, including water pressure testing, battery safety validation, and leak-proof checks before shipping. With a working final prototype already complete and a production timeline targeting delivery by July 2026, Bidetsy is poised to bring bidet hygiene to everyone — regardless of their living situation.

projects.name: Panco Arm MK-01
projects.blurb: A 100% 3D-printable, open-source 5-axis robotic arm built for everyone, for under $100.
projects.html_story:
A 100% 3D-printable, open-source 5-axis robotic arm built for everyone, for under $100.

A 100% 3D-printable, open-source 5-axis robotic arm built for everyone, for under $100.

The Story of the Panco Arm MK-01: 5-Axis Robotics Accessible to All

Environmental commitments

The Story of the Panco Arm MK-01: 5-Axis Robotics Accessible to All

Industrial robotics is a fascinating field, but it is traditionally expensive, closed-off, and difficult to access. My goal with the Panco Arm MK-01 is to break down this barrier. I want to allow every maker, student, or enthusiast to build a real, functional, and precise 5-axis robotic arm right from their desk.

What is the Panco Arm MK-01?

The Panco Arm is not just a simple toy; it is an open-source learning and automation platform designed to be 100% 3D printable.

An accessible and modular design:The complete arm features a robust structure that can be printed without the need for industrial machines. The parts diagram was designed for a logical and documented assembly, from the base of the robot down to the screws.

Standard and affordable electronics:The intelligence of the arm relies on a powerful and accessible ESP32 microcontroller. It drives a stepper motor via an ULN2003 driver for the base, as well as four dedicated servomotors for the shoulder, elbow, wrist, and gripper. The entire system is powered by a simple 5V / 4A power supply, keeping the total cost of the electronics under $100.

Why I need you (and where we are)

This project is more than just an idea on paper. The foundation stage (the V1 of the Panco Arm) is already 100% complete: the design, firmware, physical testing, and the detailed assembly guide are finished. Control via the USB serial port is fully operational. Today, I am launching this campaign to fund the transition to Version 2 (V2). The CAD design for this V2 is already validated: the parts have been redesigned to be more rigid while using less filament, the gripper has been improved, and the cable routing is now internal. The funds raised during this campaign will allow me to finance the current phase: the physical prototyping of the V2, robustness testing, and the production of the new assembly guide. If we exceed our initial goal, our "Roadmap" includes very ambitious stretch goals:

How to participate?

I have designed the reward tiers to suit all ambitions:

Panco V1: Maker Tier ($20):Perfect for getting started, it includes all V1 STL files, calibrated firmware, and the assembly guide for personal use.

Panco V2: Builder Tier ($40):This tier gives you access to all V1 content, plus the V2 STL files (rigid design), Wi-Fi web interface control, and internal cable routing.

Commercial Merchant Tier ($100):Aimed at professionals, this tier includes all current and future content (V1, V2, V3), along with a commercial license allowing you to sell fully assembled Panco Arms worldwide, with priority production support.

I am a maker passionate about sharing knowledge. I have spent countless hours modeling, printing, failing, reprinting, and coding this robotic arm to make it as simple and efficient as possible. I deeply believe in the open-source model, because it is by providing access to the tools (CAD files, code, wiring diagrams) that the community can innovate. This crowdfunding campaign is the necessary stepping stone to transform this functional prototype into a complete robotics ecosystem.

Thank you in advance for your support and trust in the Panco Arm project!

Risks and challenges

Transparency is essential to me in this project. Although creating a robotic arm presents a technical challenge, I have structured this project to minimize the risks for backers as much as possible:

    The biggest risk is already behind us: Version 1 (V1) of the Panco Arm is already 100% designed, tested, and functional, with a calibrated firmware and a completed assembly guide. This proves that the basic mechanics and the concept are viable.

    V2 Challenges (Prototyping): The main current challenge lies in the physical validation of V2. Although the CAD design is finished, the new rigid design and the internal cable routing require rigorous printing tests to ensure that the tolerances are perfect for everyone. Since I own my own 3D printing equipment, I can iterate and quickly correct the slightest design flaw.

    Software Challenges (Wi-Fi & OTA): If we reach the $10,000 stretch goal, developing the Wi-Fi web interface and OTA updates will require special attention to guarantee minimal latency when controlling the motors. The use of the well-documented ESP32 microcontroller and the existing V1 codebase greatly limit this risk.

    No major logistical risks: Unlike many hardware projects on Kickstarter that suffer from shipping delays or factory shortages, the rewards for the Panco Arm campaign are exclusively digital (STL files, open-source code, PDF guides). Once development is complete, delivery will be instant and guaranteed for all backers.

I plan to use AI-generated content in my project.

What parts of your project will use AI generated content? Please be as specific as possible.

In accordance with Kickstarter's transparency policy regarding the use of artificial intelligence, here is how AI was used in the development of the Panco Arm MK-01 project:

    Programming assistance: I used AI as a "copilot" to help optimize certain portions of the code for the ESP32, specifically to format certain data structures and speed up the firmware debugging process. The overall software architecture and physical testing were done entirely by me.

    Schematics and documentation creation: AI assisted me in generating and formatting the wiring and parts diagrams. The goal was to transform my technical notes and rough drafts into clear, clean, and understandable visuals for the final assembly guide.

What was NOT done by AI:
The entirety of the 3D CAD modeling (for both V1 and V2), mechanical engineering, selection of electronic components, physical assembly of prototypes, and the writing of this campaign's text are the result of 100% human work. AI was only used as an assistive tool to save time on specific tasks.

Do you have the consent of owners of the works that were (or will be) used to produce the AI generated portion of your projects? Please explain.

No, because this does not apply to my workflow. I have not trained a personal AI model using third-party works.

For the elements where AI was used (code assistance and schematic formatting), I used mainstream, commercial generative artificial intelligence tools.

    The input data belongs to me: All the information provided to the AI (my hand-drawn drafts, technical notes, project logic, and initial code) are my own original creations. I did not provide any copyrighted works belonging to third parties to generate this content.

    The role of the AI: The models used operate on the training databases of their respective developers. My use was limited to that of a productivity tool: the AI cleaned up, formatted, and optimized my own ideas and intellectual property, without plagiarizing the work of other creators.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design
The Panco Arm MK-01 is inherently designed for repairability. Unlike closed commercial products, if a mechanical part wears out or breaks over time, you simply need to reprint that specific part individually, without having to replace the entire robot. Furthermore, the electronics rely on standard and modular components (ESP32, standard servos) that can be easily replaced or even reused for other projects in the future.

Sustainable materials
The robot is optimized to be fully printed in PETG, a highly resistant, durable, and recyclable plastic. Depending on your intended use for the arm, you can also print a large part of the structure in PLA, a bio-sourced bioplastic made from corn starch or sugarcane.

Sustainable Distribution
The carbon footprint associated with transportation and packaging is reduced to an absolute minimum. This project requires no international shipping of heavy or bulky plastic parts. By exclusively distributing open-source digital files, guides, and code, production is completely decentralized. You manufacture the structure directly at home and source the electronics locally, thereby eliminating the waste related to shipping materials and the CO2 emissions from global freight.

projects.ai_description_en:
The Panco Arm MK-01 is a 100% 3D-printable, open-source 5-axis robotic arm designed to bring industrial-grade mechanics to the desktop of every maker, student, and enthusiast for under $100. Far from a simple toy, it is a fully functional learning and automation platform that proves precision robotics doesn't have to be expensive or proprietary. Built around a powerful and accessible ESP32 microcontroller, the arm drives a stepper motor for the base via a ULN2003 driver and commands four dedicated servomotors for the shoulder, elbow, wrist, and gripper—all powered by a simple 5V / 4A power supply. This commitment to standard, affordable electronics ensures that the barrier to entry is as low as the cost of the filament itself.

This campaign represents a major evolutionary step for the project, aiming to fund the transition from a proven V1 prototype to an enhanced V2 production model. The foundational version of the Panco Arm is already complete, with a calibrated firmware, a functional assembly guide, and fully operational USB serial control. The current engineering milestone involves physical validation and rigorous printing tests for the V2 redesign, which focuses on a more rigid structure that uses less filament, an improved gripper, and refined internal cable routing for a cleaner aesthetic. Because the creator operates their own 3D printing equipment, design tolerances can be iteratively corrected with speed and precision, directly de-risking the prototyping phase.

What makes this project particularly unique is how it eliminates the logistical nightmares that often plague hardware crowdfunding. All rewards are composed exclusively of digital assets—STL files, open-source code, and PDF guides—meaning delivery is instant and guaranteed to backers worldwide upon completion. Backers can pledge for the V1 Maker Tier to build the base model or the V2 Builder Tier to access the more robust design, internal cable management, and stretch-goal features like a Wi-Fi web interface with minimal latency control and Over-The-Air (OTA) updates. For entrepreneurs, a Commercial Merchant Tier offers a license to sell fully assembled arms globally. This is an opportunity to back a transparent, community-driven vision that transforms a functional desktop prototype into a polished, accessible hardware platform built entirely on the open-source model.

CCBOT Indoor: Patented Modular Robot Platform

Environmental commitments

CCBOT Indoor: Patented Modular Robot Platform

CCBOT Indoor is a small patent-backed modular indoor robot platform designed for robotics learning, research, indoor inspection, Python development, and ROS-ready experimentation.

Single-take demo of the current CCBOT Indoor prototype.

The video shows the actual unit being controlled by phone, moving indoors, showing live camera support, basic autonomous driving test mode, and displaying ToF distance sensing.

Phone control interface operating the actual indoor prototype in real time.

Live camera support shown on the phone interface during prototype testing.

Distance readout and manual drive controls used during the indoor demo.

Current Working Prototype

The current CCBOT Indoor prototype integrates a compact wheeled robot body, smartphone control, live camera support, ToF distance sensing, onboard electronics, motor control, and battery power.

The prototype shown here is the actual unit used in the supplementary demo video.

Current assembled CCBOT Indoor prototype - front view.

Top view showing the compact indoor robot body.

Current assembled CCBOT Indoor prototype - side view.

Current assembled CCBOT Indoor prototype - rear view.

Hardware and Software Integration

CCBOT Indoor is not just a remote-control toy. The current prototype combines physical robot hardware with a phone-based control interface, live video support, and sensor feedback.

Current prototype with the top cover removed, showing the internal electronics, battery, wiring, and wheeled chassis used in the working demo unit.

Camera module used for live video streaming.ToF sensor used for distance sensing and basic obstacle detection experiments.Internal electronics layout with battery, motor control hardware, sensor wiring, and camera connection.

Phone interface showing live camera, distance readout, and manual drive controls.Hardware configuration of the current prototype: robot body, camera, ToF sensor, motor control, battery, and onboard electronics.

What Backers Receive

The Founder Batch reward is the indoor wheeled CCBOT Indoor robot only.

Each Founder Batch robot is planned to include:

- 1 assembled CCBOT Indoor Developer Robot- Modular robotics body- Indoor wheeled drive platform- Smartphone control access- Live camera video support- ToF distance sensing- Basic obstacle detection experiments- Python development direction- ROS-ready development direction- Founder updates- Early feedback channel

What Is Not Included

This first Founder Batch does not include:

- Outdoor utility robot platform- Track-based mobility- Water-surface mobility- Snow, lawn, trailer, or heavy-duty modules- Fully basic autonomous driving test mode navigation- Future CCBOT roadmap modes

Those ideas belong to the broader CCBOT platform direction. They are not included in this first indoor robot reward.

CAD Design and Chassis Development

Before assembling the current prototype, we developed the indoor robot chassis in CAD. The design work helped us plan the robot body, removable top cover, internal electronics space, front hardware opening, side access openings, and the general layout for a compact indoor wheeled robot.

CAD design screenshot showing the indoor robot chassis, removable top cover, internal hardware compartments, and front/side module openings during development.

This CAD image shows the development stage before the current physical prototype was assembled.

Patent-Backed Platform Background

CCBOT Indoor is connected to the broader CCBOT modular robotics platform. CCBOT's modular robotic vehicle technology is supported by U.S. Patent No. 12,539,598 B1, issued February 3, 2026.For this Kickstarter campaign, the Founder Batch reward is the indoor wheeled CCBOT Indoor robot shown in the prototype video and photos. The patent image below is included as technical background for the platform architecture behind CCBOT.

For this Kickstarter campaign, the Founder Batch reward is the indoor wheeled CCBOT Indoor robot shown in the prototype video and photos. The patent image below is included as technical background for the platform architecture behind CCBOT.

Patent drawing showing the core chassis and internal modular layout concept behind the CCBOT platform.

Why Kickstarter?

We are launching this campaign to build a small Founder Batch of 10-15 units and get real feedback from early users before scaling.

Funds will help cover:

- Robot base components- Cameras and sensing hardware- 3D-printed body parts- Electronics and wiring- Assembly and testing- Packaging- Backup parts and repairs- Kickstarter and payment processing fees

Keeping the first batch small allows us to stay hands-on, test each unit carefully, and support early backers directly.

Risks and Challenges

CCBOT Indoor is a small Founder Batch hardware project, and we are keeping the first run intentionally limited to 10-15 units so we can manage quality, assembly, testing, and support closely.

The main challenge is moving from a working prototype to a small batch of reliable units. The current prototype demonstrates indoor movement, smartphone control, live camera video support, basic autonomous driving test mode, and ToF distance sensing. The remaining work is focused on repeatable assembly, testing, documentation, packaging, and small mechanical refinements before shipment.

Because the robot uses a modular design and 3D-printed body components, small mechanical improvements can be made quickly. If a printed part needs adjustment, we can revise and reprint it instead of relying on expensive tooling.

Some components, such as cameras, ToF distance sensors, robot base parts, batteries, motor control hardware, or electronics, may have minor supply or pricing changes. To reduce this risk, we plan to use widely available components where practical and keep extra parts on hand for testing and replacement.

Each CCBOT Indoor robot will be assembled and tested before shipping. We plan to check basic movement, smartphone control, live camera video support, ToF distance sensing, and basic obstacle detection behavior before sending units to backers.

CCBOT Indoor is designed as an early developer robot platform for learning, research, indoor inspection, Python development, and ROS-ready experimentation. Some software examples, documentation, and navigation experiments may continue improving after the Founder Batch ships.

Future outdoor, track-based, water-surface, and other CCBOT platform modes are not included in this first CCBOT Indoor Founder Batch.

Overall, we believe the risks are manageable because this is a small batch, the design is modular, many parts can be replaced or reprinted, and we can work directly with early backers to improve the platform.

Future Software Experiments

We have also developed an experimental CCBOT-based game product calledMow My Worldas part of our broader software exploration. It is on Steam around 7/15/2026. It is not included as a guaranteed reward in this Founder Batch. The first Kickstarter reward is focused on the indoor wheeled robot hardware, phone control, live camera support, and ToF distance sensing.

Risks and challenges

CCBOT Indoor is a small Founder Batch hardware project, and we are keeping the first run intentionally limited to 10–15 units so we can manage quality, assembly, and support closely.

The main challenge is moving from a working prototype to a small batch of reliable units. Since the robot uses a modular design and 3D-printed body components, small mechanical improvements can be made quickly. If a printed part needs adjustment, we can revise and reprint it instead of relying on expensive tooling.

Some components, such as cameras, ultrasonic sensors, robot base parts, batteries, or electronics, may have minor supply or pricing changes. To reduce this risk, we plan to use widely available components and keep extra parts on hand for testing and replacement.

Each CCBOT Indoor robot will be assembled and tested before shipping. We plan to check basic movement, smartphone control, live camera video support, and ultrasonic / sonar distance sensing before sending units to backers.

CCBOT Indoor is designed as an early developer robot platform for learning, research, indoor inspection, Python development, and ROS-ready experimentation. Some software examples, documentation, and navigation experiments may continue improving after the Founder Batch ships.

Future track-based and water-surface mobility modules are part of the broader CCBOT platform roadmap. They are not included in this first CCBOT Indoor Founder Batch.

Overall, we believe the risks are manageable because this is a small batch, the design is modular, many parts can be replaced or reprinted, and we can work directly with early backers to improve the platform.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

CCBOT Indoor is designed as a modular robot platform rather than a disposable toy. The body, sensor mounts, electronics, battery, and internal components are designed to be serviceable, replaceable, and upgradeable where practical.

Reusability and recyclability

The robot uses modular parts that can be removed, repaired, replaced, or upgraded. Where practical, we will use reusable or recyclable packaging materials and avoid unnecessary single-use plastics.

Sustainable materials

We plan to use 3D-printed body components where appropriate, which allows small-batch production with reduced tooling waste. When possible, we will use commonly available materials such as PETG and design parts to be replaceable rather than discarded.

Environmentally friendly factories

For this first Founder Batch, we do not plan to use large-scale mass production. We plan to use small-batch 3D printing and hands-on assembly where appropriate, which helps reduce tooling waste, avoid unnecessary overproduction, and keep inventory limited to actual backer demand. If we work with outside suppliers, we will consider component availability, quality, repairability, and responsible small-batch production practices.

Sustainable Distribution

We plan to keep fulfillment small and direct for the Founder Batch. Units will be packed in compact packaging where practical, with reduced excess material and limited unnecessary plastic. Because the first batch is only 10-15 units, we can avoid overproduction and keep shipping volume limited to actual backer demand.

projects.ai_description_en:
CCBOT Indoor is a patent-backed, modular robot platform designed for indoor robotics learning, research, and inspection. This compact wheeled robot combines smartphone control, live camera video streaming, and ToF (Time of Flight) distance sensing in a ready-to-use developer unit. Unlike remote-control toys, CCBOT Indoor is built around Python and ROS-ready experimentation, giving developers and researchers a tangible platform for coding real robotics applications. The entire system integrates onboard electronics, motor control, battery power, and a phone-based control interface that displays live camera feeds and real-time sensor data.

At its core, CCBOT Indoor delivers practical indoor functionality. The prototype demonstrates phone-controlled movement, live camera support, basic autonomous driving test mode, and ultrasonic/sonar distance sensing for obstacle detection experiments. Each unit features a modular robotics body with an indoor wheeled drive platform, allowing developers to interact with sensor feedback in real time. The platform is designed to run Python scripts and support ROS (Robot Operating System) development paths, making it suitable for both educational exploration and advanced robotics research in home or lab environments.

What makes CCBOT Indoor stand out is its modular, patent-backed architecture and the team's commitment to iterative improvement. Using 3D-printed body components means mechanical adjustments can be made quickly without expensive tooling—if a part needs refinement, it can be revised and reprinted. As a limited Founder Batch project capped at 10–15 units, the team focuses on close assembly, testing, and direct backer support. While future modules like track-based and water-surface mobility are planned for the broader CCBOT platform, this first batch delivers the indoor wheeled robot only, assembled and tested to verify movement, smartphone control, and live video support before shipping.

## Story

### Meet Poop-Alert™ by BarkBack

Poop-Alert™ by BarkBack is a motion-activated talking yard sign designed to remind dog owners to clean up after their pets in a fun, attention-grabbing way.Unlike ordinary signs that people ignore, Poop-Alert™ speaks up when someone walks nearby using a built-in motion sensor and customizable voice messages.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/832/381/5c6bbe4bf27a2750b13cbf652e67b2e6_original.jpeg?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=92&v=1779464706&width=680&sig=31pF52%2BJT1U6VsMMFs963UJ5lkbeb1R0hM2hM6j4ywY%3D)

### The Problem

Dog waste has become a frustrating problem for homeowners, neighborhoods, parks, and businesses. Traditional yard signs are often ignored, leaving property owners dealing with an unpleasant and unsanitary issue.

We wanted to create something impossible to ignore — a sign that actually speaks up.

After months of testing and refining prototypes, we developed Poop-Alert™ by BarkBack: a motion-activated talking sign designed to grab attention in a fun, memorable, and effective way.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/832/510/b0278605cfbf9dcc824e26e468d55b7a_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1779465555&width=680&sig=Zw5YZYYV8dwq7I69vfWcRAyBeTCeUf2i6mFWbVHQHdU%3D)

## Risks and challenges

We have already completed working prototypes and spent months testing and refining the current Poop-Alert™ system. Through real-world testing, we’ve continued learning how to improve durability, motion sensitivity, weather resistance, and overall user experience.

Like any hardware-based product, manufacturing timelines and electronic component sourcing can present challenges, but we are actively working with suppliers and refining our production process to help ensure quality and reliability.

Our goal is to communicate openly with backers throughout the process and deliver a product that continues improving over time.

[Learn about accountability on Kickstarter](https://www.kickstarter.com/help/hc/sections/115001107133)

AI-assisted tools were used to help create some promotional marketing images and visual concepts used within the Kickstarter campaign. These visuals are intended for advertising, storytelling, and product presentation purposes only.

## Environmental commitments

[Visit our Environmental Resources Center](https://www.kickstarter.com/environment) to learn how Kickstarter encourages sustainable practices.

### Long-lasting design

Poop-Alert™ has been designed with durability and long-term outdoor use in mind. The sign is built using weather-resistant materials and a rechargeable power system, with an optional solar panel for extended use. We continue testing and improving the design to increase reliability, durability, and overall product lifespan

### Reusability and recyclability

projects.html_story:
Your desktop PC, untethered: A portable case with a built-in 24” 2K 165Hz screen.

Your desktop PC, untethered: A portable case with a built-in 24” 2K 165Hz screen.

Stride 24: The World’s First Truly Portable, Modular PC Case with a Built-In 24" 2K 165Hz Screen

Mobile Mode: Your Desktop, Anywhere

Desktop Mode: Your Standard PC, Elevated

Sidecar mode: No such thing as too many monitors

Suitcase Mode: Pack Up and Go

Built for Mobility, Engineered for Power

Open Source & DIY-Friendly

Environmental commitments

Stride 24: The World’s First Truly Portable, Modular PC Case with a Built-In 24" 2K 165Hz Screen

The Problem: Your PC Shouldn’t Chain You to a Desk

Gamers, creators, and professionals deservepower without limits—but traditional PC setups tether you to a single spot. Laptops sacrifice performance, and most portable cases force you to lug around extra monitors, keyboards, and cables.What if your PC could move with you?

The Solution: One Case, Four Modes, Zero Compromises

Stride 24 is thefirst PC case designed for real mobilitywithout sacrificing performance. With abuilt-in 24" 2K 165Hz screenandfour adaptive modes, it’s the ultimate fusion ofdesktop power and portable freedom.

Mobile Mode: Your Desktop, Anywhere

24" 2K (2560×1440) 165Hz Display:No need for an external monitor. You always have one with your PC

Plug-and-Play:Just connect power cord and you are ready to go. The monitor is powered from your PSU through MOLEX, SATA or GPU power connector

Ergonomic screen position:Screen positioned at your eye-level. No more slouching looking at your laptop screen

Desktop Mode: Your Standard PC, Elevated

Small base:At only35x24 cmit will fit on any desk. The legs are on both ends so you can place it either side up as you see fit.

Easy Access:Tool-less modular bays for quick upgrades or maintenance. Filters are attached on magnets for easy access

Sidecar mode: No such thing as too many monitors

Just flip it on its side to get additional portrait monitor

Suitcase Mode: Pack Up and Go

Rugged latchesandpadded interiorprotect your keyboard and mouse on the move.

Lightweight yet sturdy—engineered for durability without the bulk. All PC components are mounted to 1.5mm thick aluminum sheet

Small-ish.60x37x12 cm

Keyboard Slot:Optimized fortenkeyless (TKL) or 75% keyboards(350mm x 140mm max).Tested withReddragon Azure,Keychron K2 MaxandLogitech K400 Plus-perfect for travel or minimalist setups.

Mouse + Keyboard + Cable Storage:Secure compartments keep your peripherals and cables organized.

Built for Mobility, Engineered for Power

✅High-Refresh-Rate Display:2K, 165Hzdisplay

Connected directly to your GPU via internal DP or HDMI cable. Display Port cable is included with the case.

Monitor control panel is placed in the keyboard slot, right below USB ports

One button to get an on-screen crosshair, right next to your keyboard - no-scoping have never been easier

There were a few available options when choosing display:

MV238QHM-NF0(The one we selected)- While 1080p would still look ok on 24 inch screen, 1440p provides just perfect clarity at this size. The tradeoff is refresh rate. Given the diminishing returns nature of going for higher refresh rate, 165Hz feels like perfectly acceptable rate for FPS games for most people

MV238FHM-NG2- exactly same package (dimensions, mounting holes etc.) as the panel above but 1080p and 240Hz. Depending on the amount of backers interested this panel could easily be substituted for the default one.

LM245WFA-SSA1- the panel itself costs way more than the price of whole case but it is 1080p at 480Hz. It is also a bit larger than previous two so case would have to be slightly modified but it is nothing that can't be done with 3d printer and some patience.

How is it powered? The driver board needs 12V and 36W. This gives us few options:

Molex- preferable, a Molex to 12V adapter is provided with the case. 12V connectors of Molex are rated to 11A so this leaves plenty of headroom. Unfortunately it is quite dated connector and not every PSU has molex outputs in 2026. Just make sure your PSU has one and you will save yourself some headaches.

GPU power connector- your second best bet. You can easily find adapters on Aliexpress or Amazon that will provide you with 12V from GPU power connector. I just don't feel like connecting something else to the same circuit as the the most expensive part of any PC build. So have fun experimenting

SATA power connector- the least preferable option. While it is theoretically rated for 4.5A at 12V, plenty of people told us to not go above 3A for sustained load which is right at the limit for driver board. But, of course, you can excercise your free will here and adapters are also easily available on the internet

External power brick- always nice to have fallback option so there is a 5,5x2,1mm socket hole drilled next to the GPU bracket slot

✅Semi-open design:GPU, CPU and PSU fans draw air directly from outside the case. This keeps temperatures in check despite small60x25mm exhaust fanmounted on the back and optional60x15mm exhaust fanon the side, near GPU. Maximum CPU cooler height is62 mmallowing popularThermalright AXP90-X53to be fitted inside case

✅ Mini-ITX Motherboard Support:Designed for small-form-factor powerhouses. I won't lie - it is a bit cramped inside but the case is not made to carry free space inside. The most annoying thing is routing regular flat 40cm PCIE riser under the motherboard and monitor driver board - you can see it sticking out on the left, close to PSU. But you can find fancy non-flat riser that you can route along with rest of the cables. It makes assembling everything so much easier and we really recommend it. It is just a bit more expensive than regular risers. You can find it in this project Addons or order it yourself - it is not hard to find.

As for cable routing we offer only the best possible solutions - zip ties

✅ No need for fancy mobile flex PSUs:Designed forSFX or SFX-LPSUs. To reiterate here - just try to get one with Molex connector.

✅ 3-Slot GPU Compatibility:SupportsGPUs up to 340mm long(e.g., RTX 4090, RX 7900 XTX).

How is it mounted? On the back there is a regular 3 slot PCIE bracket and keeping it secure on the other end are the strongest and most fexible mounting devices known to humanity - zip ties. There is a single, reusable ziptie, on each side of the GPU - the rest is your imagination

2xUSB 2.0 Type-A, 2xUSB 3.0 Type-A, 1xUSB 3.1 Type-C,mic/speakerextensions at the front, on the left of keyboard slot. Ideally there would be two USB type-C connected through type-E to the motherboard but it is hard to find such extension panels

Uses only single DP port of your GPU. Rest is free to connect any external monitors you wish

Just a pair of cheap speakers for stereo sound. They don't sound great because no speakers this size will. Still better then any laptop speakers

Open Source & DIY-Friendly

We believe inempowering the community. After hitting100 backers, we’llopen-source all design filesincluding:

3D-printable plastic parts -Can be 3D printed on 320x320x320mm printers like QIDI Xmax3 (that's what I used for prototypes), H2S, Core One L etc. Available in Freecad .FCStd format.

Aluminum metal sheet parts- can be easily ordered in small quantities at your local CNC workshop. Available in Freecad .FCStd format with Metal sheet addon

Full bill of materials- using only off-the-shelf components. The hardest to source is probably Display matrix and driver board but there is nothing you won't be able to order yourself

Step-by-step assembly guides.

⚠️Note:DIY builds may cost more than pre-ordered units due to bulk pricing on parts but you’ll have the freedom to customize every detail!

Risks and challenges

Unlike laptops that are mostly buy and throw away the PC can be upgraded and next generation of CPUs and GPUs arrive on the market making them last decades

The monitor control panel sits in the keyboard slot, conveniently featuring a one-button on-screen crosshair for gaming. Powered by the PSU through flexible options—Molex (preferred and included with adapter), GPU, or SATA connectors—the 1.5mm aluminum chassis is open source and DIY-friendly. Capture the Shot You'll Talk About Forever

Golfeye G20 is the AI golf camera built to film your shot on a real golf course — not just analyze it indoors.

Most great shots disappear before anyone gets to see them. The swing happens fast, the reaction happens once, and a phone rarely captures the full moment from impact to landing. Golfeye changes that.

Set it up on the tee box with the included ground spike. Aim it toward the target. The system handles the rest — capturing your swing, following the ball over distance, and zooming into the landing point. All automatically.

Whether it's a routine round, a coaching session, or that once-in-a-lifetime hole-in-one — Golfeye gives youproof of the moment, not just the memory.

How Golfeye Works

Set it up. Take your shot. Get the moment.The whole automatic capture takes about10 seconds end to end.

Place Golfeye on the tee box using the included ground spike.

Press Start to activate the system.

Golfeye's AI scans the green and locates the flag, then locks onto the ball at the tee.

The voice prompt confirms: "Please hit the ball."

As you swing, Golfeye captures the moment with its variable optical zoom — the AI adjusts the focal length in real time to keep your swing, the ball, and the landing in frame.

The 3-axis stabilized gimbal pans with the ball flight, tracking it across the fairway.

The 18× zoom locks onto the landing point and captures the impact.

Golfeye sweeps back along the ball path and records your reaction for ~10 seconds.

Why Phones Don't Work for Real Golf

Golfers have always struggled to capture their best moments. Here's why every existing setup falls short:

❌ Phones need a second person.If you're playing, you're not filming. Most golfers don't have a dedicated cameraman standing behind the tee box.

❌ Even when a phone captures the swing, it loses the ball.Golf shots travel up to 400 yards — far beyond what a phone camera can track clearly. The ball disappears the moment it leaves the screen.

❌ The landing spot is invisible.By the time you walk to the ball, the trajectory is forgotten and the proof is gone.

❌ Pro broadcast setups are not for individuals.Tour-grade tracking systems cost tens of thousands of dollars and require an entire crew.

The result?Your best shots survive only as stories — not as footage.

Golfeye is built to fill exactly this gap.Automatic capture. Long-range tracking up to 400 yards. Clear landing-point recording. All in one portable system that works for a single golfer.

Hands-Off Capture, Start to Finish

You hit the ball. Golfeye does everything else.

From the moment you step onto the tee box to the moment you walk down to retrieve your ball, Golfeye handles the entire capture sequence on its own. No buttons mid-swing. No app fumbling. No ruined moments because someone forgot to press record.

Place it. Aim it. Take your shot. Walk to your ball. Watch the replay.

That's the whole experience. Designed so youstay in the game, not behind the camera.

No Second Person Needed

Most great golf shots are lost because the camera was never running.

Maybe you're playing solo. Maybe your buddy is on his own shot. Maybe nobody wants to be that guy holding a phone. The result is the same — your best moments don't get filmed.

Golfeye changes the equation. Once it's set up, it doesn't need anyone behind it. You can:

Play alone and still get every shot recorded

Play with friends and let everyone focus on their own game

Hand the round to Golfeye and trust that the moment will be there when you walk back

No more "I wish someone had filmed that."The camera is already running.

AI Ball & Flag Detection — Up to 400 Yards

Long-range tracking that doesn't lose the ball.

Golfeye's Smart Vision System is built on multiple AI models trained specifically for golf. It recognizes:

The flagat the green, locked from up to 400 yards away

The ballat the tee, ready before you swing

The swing motionthrough human-pose detection

The ball flightin real time using optical flow

The audio of impactas a backup trigger

These models work together inside a Qualcomm Snapdragon QCS6490 processor (12.5 TOPS INT8) to track the ball across long distance — the kind of distance phone cameras lose at 30 yards.

This is not motion-detection that just records "something moved."This is a system that knows what a golf ball looks like, what a swing looks like, and what the moment of impact sounds like.

3-Axis Stabilized Gimbal

Smooth tracking, even when the ball moves fast.

A golf ball can travel 200 mph off the club face. Following it requires more than a fixed camera — it requires a precision gimbal that can pan, tilt, and stabilize all at once. Golfeye uses a 3-axis anti-shake gimbal:

Pan (left/right rotation):±90°

Tilt (up/down rotation):±45°

Roll (camera horizon stabilization):±30°

The gimbal works in coordination with the AI tracker — once the ball is detected, the gimbal pans across the fairway in real time, keeps the horizon level even on uneven ground, and locks the zoom lens onto the landing point.

The result:broadcast-grade footage, captured by a single golfer with a one-button setup.

Variable Optical Zoom — Up to 18×

One lens. Built to cover every distance on the course.

Most cameras force you to choose: zoom in and lose the context, or stay wide and lose the detail. Golfeye solves it with asingle high-quality variable optical zoom, driven by AI tracking that decides when to zoom and how much.

Short focal length (tee box / setup)— captures your full swing form and stance

Mid focal length (ball flight up to 200 yards)— follows the ball through the air with real-time AI tracking

Long focal length (300–400 yards landing point)— locks onto the landing, the flag, and the result

One lens, the whole fairway. No second camera bolt-on, no digital crop, no detail loss — actual physical lens elements moving across the zoom range. Powered by a 4K Sony 1/1.8" sensor with high-FPS capture, even subtle details — clubhead path, ball spin, divot pattern — stay readable when you slow the footage down.

App Review & Cloud Sharing

Your shots, your phone, the cloud — all in one place.

The Golfeye companion app is your post-round home base. Once you finish your round, just connect to Golfeye over Wi-Fi and download your highlights:

Review every shotthe system captured during your round

Save the ones worth keepingto your phone library

Upload highlights to Golfeye Cloud(built on AWS) for permanent storage

Share directlyto Facebook, WhatsApp, Instagram, or WeChat — no extra editing tools required

The app handles the boring parts (file transfer, format conversion, compression for sharing) so you only deal with the part that matters — picking the shot worth talking about.

Trajectory & Distance Metrics

See the path the ball took. Know exactly how far it went.

Golfeye doesn't just record video. The app overlays the ball's flight as a visibletrajectory lineon top of your replay, so you can see the actual path your shot took — its arc, its angle, its drift.

Each shot also comes withdistance metrics:

Carry distance— how far the ball flew through the air

Total distance— including roll and final resting point

Lateral deviation— how far left or right of the target line

For self-coaching, this turns a video clip into a training data point. For storytelling, it turns"I crushed that 7-iron"into"I hit a 178-yard 7-iron with a 3-yard draw."

Driving Range Mode

Practice better. Track every swing.

Golfeye also works at the driving range, with a setup designed for repetition rather than one-and-done captures. Use the included tripod (instead of the ground spike), aim toward your target line, and switch the app toDriving Range Mode.

In this mode, Golfeye:

Auto-detects each shotin sequence — no need to press Start between swings

Logs every ball flightas a separate clip with its own trajectory

Builds a session summaryyou can review at the end (consistency, dispersion, distance trends)

A 60-shot bucket becomes 60 reviewable swings, each with its own data — instead of a single blurry phone video that loses every other ball.

Made for Every Golf Scenario

One camera. Every kind of shot.

Golfeye is designed to capture the full range of moments that happen on a golf course — not just the picture-perfect Par 3 hole-in-one (though we love those too).

Par 3 Tee Shot— The hole-in-one moment you'll wish you had on video

Par 4 / Par 5 Long Shot— The 250+ yard bomb most cameras can't track

Bunker Recovery— The escape shot that earned you the par

Putting— The breaking putt that finally dropped

Short Game— The chip-in from off the green

Coaching Review— The session your instructor wants to break down later

Whether it's the moment that becomes a story, the shot that fixes your handicap, or the round you want to remember —Golfeye is built for all of it.

Lightweight & Portable — Travels with Your Clubs

Built like a club. Carries like a club.

Golfeye's full setup measures120 cmin total height — about the same length as a standard golf club. The camera module isdetachable, so you can pack the whole system inside your golf bag right alongside your irons.

Camera body:Detachable, fits in any side pocket

Ground spike + pole:Slides into your bag like a club

Tripod (for driving range):Folds into the included carrying case

All accessories:One protective bag, included

No tripod-laden trip to the trunk. No special crate.Just one extra "club" in your bag and you're ready to film a full round.

Premium Industrial Design

Designed to feel as serious as the game itself.

Golfeye's exterior is shaped to look at home on a championship course — not like a piece of consumer tech tacked onto the tee box. The body uses aForest Green and Matte Charcoal palette, with subtle metal accents on the gimbal and lens housing.

Every detail is built around how golfers actually use it:

Anti-glare matte finish— no reflective glare distracting your shot or your replay

Reinforced lens housing— protects the optics from the bumps that come with course transport

Rubberized base— keeps the unit stable when planted in soft turf

Single-press tactile button— gloved hands work just fine

The look is intentional. The materials are intentional.Golfeye is designed for golfers who care how their gear feels, not just what it does.

6–7 Hour Battery + USB-C Fast Charge

Powered for the round. Charged with the cable you already own.

Golfeye runs on a15,000 mAhrechargeable lithium battery (swappable) — enough for6–7 hours of continuous capture, or roughly the length of a full 18-hole round at an unhurried pace.

Battery capacity:15,000 mAh

Continuous capture:6–7 hours

Charging port:USB Type-C (universal)

Battery design:Hot-swappable for extended sessions

USB-C means you charge it with the same cable that powers most modern phones, tablets, and laptops. No proprietary adapters. No specific brick.Pack one cable, charge everything you own — including Golfeye.

Built for Real Courses, Not Simulators

Outdoor-rated, golf-rated, real-condition-rated.

Most "AI golf" products are designed for indoor simulator bays — climate-controlled rooms, perfect lighting, fixed distances. Golfeye is the opposite. It's built to perform in the conditions where actual golf happens:

Splash & dust resistance:IP4X-rated against light rain, sweat, and course dust

Operating temperature:−10°C to 55°C (14°F to 131°F)

Sun & glare:Anti-glare lens coating + AI-assisted exposure adjustment

Long distance:AI tracking up to 400 yards

Golfeye is not designed for the perfect indoor swing. It's designed for the windy mornings, the dewy fairways, the harsh midday sun, and the occasional mid-round drizzle that defines real golf.

Real conditions. Real shots. Real proof.

4K + Sony 1/1.8" Sensor + 18× Optical Zoom

Real optical hardware. Not digital tricks.

Golfeye's image system is built around aSony 1/1.8" sensor— the same class of sensor used in premium pocket cameras and high-end smartphones. Combined with atrue 18× optical zoomlens, Golfeye captures detail across distances that no smartphone-based "AI camera" can match.

Resolution: 4K— Slow-motion playback stays sharp; you can see clubhead path and ball spin

Sensor: Sony 1/1.8" with high-FPS capture— Performs in low light (dawn, dusk) and high contrast (midday sun)

Variable optical zoom: up to 18× true optical (single camera, not digital crop)— Tracks balls clearly past 300 yards without loss of detail; the zoom covers short, mid, and long focal lengths in one lens

Optical Zoom vs Digital Zoom — Why It Matters

Most "long-range" smartphone cameras usedigital zoom— they crop and upscale, losing detail. Golfeye usesoptical zoom, which means actual physical lens elements moving — preserving every pixel of the ball, the flag, and the fairway.

The result is footage that holds up at 200%, 300%, even 500% zoom in playback.The shot stays sharp.

Golfeye Smart Vision System

AI built specifically for golf. Trained on golf. Running on-device.

The Golfeye Smart Vision System is the AI engine that makes everything else possible — flag detection, ball tracking, swing recognition, automatic capture decisions. But unlike generic computer vision used in consumer cameras, ours is built around three principles:

1. Trained on golf, not stock footage.Our models were trained on real golf course footage — different lighting conditions, different course layouts, different swing styles. Generic motion-detection systems trained on car traffic or living-room scenes don't recognize the unique pattern of a golf ball, a flag, or a swing.

2. Runs on-device, not in the cloud.The Smart Vision System operates entirely on the Qualcomm Snapdragon QCS6490 chip (12.5 TOPS INT8 compute). No cloud lookup, no internet required during capture — every AI feature is built into the hardware you own, free forever. Your AI tracking happens at the edge — fast enough to keep up with a 200 mph ball flight.You don’t operate anything mid-swing — the AI works inside the camera so the camera captures better.

3. Improves with firmware updates.We continue training and refining the AI models. Each major update gets pushed to your Golfeye via the app —the camera you buy at launch will be smarter at month 12 than it was at month 0.

This isn't off-the-shelf computer vision. It's a system purpose-built for the specific task of capturing the moment of a golf shot.

Voice-Prompted Operation

The camera tells you when to swing.

Once Golfeye locks onto the flag and your ball, it gives a clear voice prompt:

"Please hit the ball."

That's it. No screen-watching. No second person yelling "Now!" No timing guess. The system tells you it's ready, you swing when you're ready, and the capture begins automatically.

After your shot, Golfeye beeps to confirm it tracked the ball, and gives a second prompt when it's recorded your reaction.

This sounds small. In practice, it's the difference between a tense "Did that thing actually start?" feeling and the relaxed "OK, I just play golf" feeling that lets you concentrate on the shot.

One unforgettable shot changed everything. It was the kind of golf moment players talk about for years — but no one had it on camera. Only memory remained.

That regret became the starting point for Golfeye: a portable AI-powered golf camera built so the next once-in-a-lifetime moment doesn't disappear.

Golfeye was started by its founder — a lifelong golfer who hit a hole-in-one nobody filmed, and decided no other golfer should lose that moment. Risks and challenges

Golfeye combines optical hardware, on-device computer-vision helpers, and a 3-axis stabilized gimbal. We've completed multiple prototype rounds, validated core functions on real golf courses, and produced a 200-unit pilot batch to de-risk production. Below are the main risks we've identified and how we plan to mitigate them.

HARDWARE & MANUFACTURING. Minor last-mile surprises are normal for any hardware project. Our 3-4 month delivery window includes buffer to absorb minor delays, and the 200-unit pilot batch has already given us real production-line learnings before mass production starts.

SUPPLY CHAIN. Some components — the Sony image sensor and Qualcomm processor — have global lead-time variability. We've pre-allocated key components with signed quotes and a 60-day inventory buffer, with backup suppliers identified for non-critical parts. If a critical component faces a true shortage, we will communicate immediately and offer backers a clear refund or wait option.

INTERNATIONAL LOGISTICS. Shipping to Canada, the UK, and the EU involves customs and freight steps outside our direct control. We work with an established 3PL partner serving these regions, and we pay all customs and import duties for CA / UK / EU backers — no surprise charges at delivery.

SOFTWARE & FIRMWARE. All core capture functions ship working at launch — auto-detection, swing capture, ball tracking, gimbal control, and app review. Software refinements and any expanded on-device model capabilities will roll out post-delivery via free firmware updates. We will publish a firmware roadmap so backers know what ships at launch vs. what arrives later.

COMMUNICATION COMMITMENT. Hardware projects fail more often from poor communication than poor execution. We commit to transparent monthly Kickstarter Updates throughout production and fulfillment — through good news, bad news, or "still grinding through this part." We won't be that project.

Golfeye is a hardware golf-tracking camera, not an AI product. The device includes on-device computer-vision helpers that assist framing during a shot — ball and flag detection, and motion-following auto-zoom — running locally on the embedded Qualcomm processor. These helpers are an internal framing aid; the product does not generate AI content for users, does not analyze swings with AI, and is not marketed as an AI assistant. No inference data leaves the device. Any expanded on-device model functionality would arrive via post-launch firmware updates, not as a launch feature. No AI tools were used to generate product photography; all product imagery on the campaign page is real product captured by our team or contracted photographers.

Environmental commitments

Long-lasting design

Golfeye is built for many seasons of use, not single-season disposability:

- Reinforced lens housing, anti-glare matte body, rubberized base, IP4X splash/dust resistance, and an outdoor operating range of -10°C to 55°C — engineered to survive real on-course transport and weather, not just indoor showroom use.

- User-swappable 15,000 mAh battery + universal USB-C charging — the device is not bricked when one battery wears out or when a proprietary cable goes out of production.

- Lifetime free basic firmware updates — the on-device detection and tracking helpers keep improving long after purchase, extending useful product life.

- 2-year hardware warranty from delivery date.

- Modular accessories (ground spike, tripod, extension rod, carrying bag) are individually replaceable via the Pledge Manager, so a single broken accessory doesn't end the whole product's life.

These choices target a multi-season golf-camera, not a 12-month consumer-electronics replacement cycle.

projects.ai_creator_bio_en: We started in 2024 because of one regret: a once-in-a-lifetime shot was lost to memory because no one had a camera ready. Phones, action cams, broadcast setups — they all failed at the moment that mattered most.
projects.ai_description_en:
Golfeye G20 is a portable AI golf camera designed to automatically capture your full shot on a real golf course — from swing to ball flight to landing — without requiring a second person to operate it. Built around a Sony 1/1.8" image sensor, a 3-axis stabilized gimbal, and a variable optical zoom lens reaching up to 18×, the device uses on-device computer vision to detect the flag, lock onto the ball, and track the shot across distances of up to 400 yards. The entire capture sequence runs in roughly 10 seconds: you place the camera on the tee box using the included ground spike, press start, and the system handles swing capture, ball tracking, landing-point zoom, and reaction recording automatically, with voice prompts guiding you through the process.

The hardware package includes the Golfeye G20 camera body and an eight-piece accessory kit — ground spike, tripod, power adapter, USB-C cable, protective lens cover, carrying bag, extension rod, and a golf cart connector — making it portable enough to travel with your clubs and adaptable to different course scenarios, including driving range use. A 6–7 hour battery with USB-C fast charge supports a full day on the course. On the software side, the Smart Vision System delivers auto-detection, swing capture, ball tracking, gimbal control, and in-app review at launch, with trajectory and distance metrics, cloud sharing, and expanded on-device AI capabilities arriving through free post-delivery firmware updates. Backers also receive early access to the firmware roadmap and lifetime basic updates.

Golfeye is positioned as a purpose-built alternative to using a phone to film golf shots, addressing the limitations of handheld capture — no operator, no missed moments, and no reliance on digital zoom. The project has moved beyond concept stage, with multiple prototype rounds completed, core functions validated on real courses, and a 200-unit pilot batch already produced to de-risk manufacturing. The team has identified key risks around hardware production, supply chain variability for the Sony sensor and Qualcomm processor, international logistics, and software refinement, and outlines specific mitigation strategies including pre-allocated components with a 60-day buffer, backup suppliers, a 3PL partner handling CA/UK/EU shipping with all duties covered, and a commitment to transparent monthly Kickstarter updates throughout production and fulfillment.

### Why DirectDraw™ Was Created

As a solo operator, I set out to create what would eventually become the DirectDraw™ Precision Injection System.

After years of operating lawn and landscape spray equipment, I encountered the same challenges every day:

• Measuring chemicals

• Mixing tanks

• Cleaning equipment

• Product waste

• Calibration uncertainty

• Lost production time when changing products and rebatching chemicals

#### I believed there had to be a better way.

The original proof of concept came together quickly, but solving the larger problem took years. A system is only useful if it works with the wide variety of products operators use every day. Many liquid products vary significantly in viscosity, formulation, and suspended particulate content, creating challenges for traditional injection technologies.

What frustrated me most wasn't just the waste—it was the lost time. Every product change meant draining tanks, rinsing equipment, measuring chemicals, mixing new batches, recalibrating, and getting back into the field. While the equipment sat idle, valuable production time was being lost.

Development continued until the right technology became available. As flow measurement technology advanced, it finally became possible to accurately monitor and verify chemical flow rates across virtually all liquid products used in the industry.

The result is DirectDraw™.

Rather than estimating chemical application through tank concentrations, dilution ratios, and assumptions, DirectDraw™ directly measures the chemical being injected into the spray stream in real time. Operators can see exactly what the system is doing, make immediate adjustments, and verify application rates with confidence.

What started as an effort to solve everyday frustrations evolved into a patented system designed to help operators spend less time mixing and more time spraying.

### The Industry Has Been Calibrating the Same Way for Decades

For decades, applicators have calibrated water flow and then calculated chemical rates.

The process works, but it is time-consuming and relies on multiple assumptions being correct throughout the application.

A typical calibration starts by filling the spray system with water and determining how much water is applied over a known area. The operator measures output, calculates gallons per acre or gallons per 1,000 square feet, and then uses those numbers to determine how much chemical should be added to the spray tank.

Once the calculations are complete, chemicals are batch mixed into the tank. From that point forward, the operator assumes the correct amount of chemical is being applied based on the original calibration.

But real-world conditions change.

Ground speed varies. Pressure changes. Nozzles wear. Flow rates fluctuate. Tank volumes can be estimated incorrectly. Product mixing errors happen. If something changes during the application, the actual chemical rate being applied may differ from the intended target.

Verifying the true chemical application rate often requires collecting samples, measuring volumes, performing calculations, or recalibrating the sprayer.

The industry has accepted this process because there has never been a practical way to directly measure the chemical itself while spraying.

#### DirectDraw™ approaches calibration from a different direction.

The operator only needs to know two things:

1. How long it takes to treat a known area.

2. How much product should be applied to that area.

![](https://i.kickstarter.com/assets/053/919/769/440dec5960a1ff7da8d62d993b4291e5_original.png?fit=scale-down&origin=ugc&q=100&v=1780097317&width=680&sig=p0YDdqs%2BqzUBVUf8vggyPVT7uM4nmJmXs1T1EvIhFPc%3D)

For example:

An applicator determines their spray setup treats 1,000 square feet in 22 seconds.

The product label calls for 0.75 fluid ounces per 1,000 square feet.

Rather than calculating tank concentrations and batch mixes, DirectDraw™ simply converts the required application rate into a chemical flow rate.

- 0.75 fluid ounces equals approximately 22.2 milliliters.

- If 22.2 milliliters must be applied in 22 seconds, the required injection rate becomes:

- 22.2 mL ÷ 22 sec × 60 sec/min = 60.5 mL/min

The operator then adjusts DirectDraw™ until the display reads approximately 60.5 mL/min.

- Calibration complete.

- No tank concentration calculations.

- No determining how much product to add to 50, 100, or 200 gallons of water.

- No estimating whether the correct amount of chemical is actually being injected.

- The operator is directly measuring the chemical entering the spray stream in real time.

Need to change products?

Simply determine the required amount per 1,000 square feet, convert it to a target flow rate, and adjust the system accordingly.

For the first time, calibration can be based on the actual chemical being applied rather than assumptions about what should be happening inside a spray tank.

DirectDraw™ turns calibration from a batch-mixing exercise into a direct measurement process.

### Bypass Pump Integration

DirectDraw™ integrates seamlessly with bypass-pump spray systems while preserving the pump's normal operating characteristics. In a bypass configuration, the pressure-relief return line is rerouted from the carrier tank to a point upstream of the pump and downstream of the DirectDraw™ injection system. This allows the pump to continuously circulate carrier fluid through the pump, maintaining stable system pressure and flow.

Because the bypass return is located after the DirectDraw™ injection point, only fresh carrier fluid entering the closed-loop system receives chemical injection before reaching the discharge outlet. The core DirectDraw™ process remains unchanged, requiring only slightly longer prime and purge times compared to demand-pump systems.

Traditional bypass systems often rely on continuous circulation to agitate tank mixes and keep products suspended. Since DirectDraw™ eliminates batch mixing and injects products on demand, tank agitation is no longer required. Operators can shut the pump off whenever spraying is not actively taking place, reducing unnecessary wear, lowering power consumption, and helping maintain proper operating temperatures.
